sogs nang nas ni/ /gtso bor sgyu 'phrul dra ba ste/ /dbang bskur ba yi khyad par yang / /skal par ldan yang skal med gyur/ /grub pas nang gi bdag nyid spyor/ /mtshan brjod pa la sogs pas gsungs/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa bya ba sogs/ /de bzhin gzhan yang rgyud kun las/ /mtshan brjod pa ni thams cad kyis/ /bstod pa zhib mo'i rgyal po ste/ /gang de rgongs pa'i bdag nyid dang / /snyigs ma lnga yi dus yin pas/ /dka' ba'i sems ni 'ba' zhig dag/rtog ge skam po'i bdag nyid do/ /gzhan yang rtog ge skam po yis/ /gal te sems ni zhi gyur na/ /des na thams cad sangs rgyas su/ /mngon sum nyid du gdon mi za/ /nye bar bsdus pa las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi lkuming bstan pa'i rnam par rtog ge zhes bya ba ste bdun pa'o// //'dir ni gzhan yang brjod bya ba/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te/ /gang phyir tshigs bcad bco lngas 'dir/ /dgu bcu rtsa lnga'i ming can te/ /'od gsal las ni yang dag byung / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams so/ /de dag mtshan ni bstan pa yang / /sems nyid sgom par 'gyur phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas kun zhes rdzogs pa nas/ /dpal dang ldan pa mchog mthar ro/ /de la mtshan ni 'di dag kun/ /rnal 'byor sgom pa po yi rtags/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rtogs bya ni/ /dbang du byed pa'i rgyal por gsungs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ces pa'i sgra/ /bdud rtsi rab tu zhi ba'i mtshan/ /bla med de bzhin gshegs gubya ba/ /sangs rgyas mnyam pa'i bsam gtan can/ /yi ge med cing rtog bral ba'o/ /gsang sngags las byung zhes pa ni/ /dri ma rab tu zhi 25—208

ba'i mtshan/ /gsang sngags zhes pa rigs gsum pa/ /rmongs pa ston pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /gsang sngags don kun skyed pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rol pa'o/ /thig le chen po zhes bshad pa/ /dge bzang po yi mtshan zhes bya/ /gang phyir yi ge med pa'i tshig /gzhan yang rnam pa'i ye shes shugs/ /yi ge lnga ni smra ba'i dbang / /stong pa che ni lha chen po/ /thig le stong ni blo gros zab//yi ge drug ces bya ba ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam 1med ni/ /chos kyi stobs zhes bya ba'i mtshan/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'chang / /'jig rten gsum mchod sangs rgyas so/ /dus dang dus min zhes pa ni/ /de bzhin sgra gcan nyi ma'i snying / /bsam gtan bzhi yi rtse mo can/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal mtshan grol/ /bsam gtan dus kun shes zhes pa/ /sman pa mchod pa'i mtshan zhes pa/ /ting 'dzin rigs 2dang rgyud 'dzin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog 'od/ /nying 'dzin lus te lus mchog ni/ /dge ba'i gtsug phud ces pa'i mtshan/ /longs spyod rdzogs sgu kun gyi rgyal/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi 'od/ /sprul pa'i sku ste sgu mchog ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje 'od/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyud 'chang ba/ /rgya mtsho brtan zhes bya ba'i mtshan/ /phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs ni/ /bde gshegs rin chen phung po'o/ /ji bzhin 'gro ba'i don byed pa—/ /rol pa'i stobs zhes bya ba'i mtshan/ /lha yi lha ni nyi ma'i mtshan/ /lha yi dbang po dag pa'i 'od/ /lha min dbang ni rin chen gtsug /srid pa'i bdag po zhes pa ni/ /dpal ni rjes su mthun pa'i mtshan/ /'chi med dbang po seng ge'i 'gros/ /lha yi bla ma zhes pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas 25—209

gsungs pa'o/ /'joms byed ces pa me tog sbyin/ /'joms byed dbang phyug grol ba'i 'od/ /srid pa'i dgon pa las rgal ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo'i mtshan/ /gcig ces pa ni ye shes 'dor/ /ston pa rol pa bkod pa'o/ /'gro ba'i bla ma zhes pa'i tshig /don yod gnas pa zhes pa'i mtshan/ /rab grags la sogs brtan 1pa'i 'od/ /che ba po —ni rgyal mtshan tog /byams pa'i go cha rngubagos pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bde ba'i bsam/ /snying rje'i ya lad gyon pa ni/ /rnam grol rgyal po zhes pa'i mtshan/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul shes pa/ /nyon mongs mi shes g.yul ngo jesel/ /rgya mtsho zhes pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /bdud dgra 5zhes pa rin chen 'dzin/ /bdud 'dul zhes pa mi thub pa'o/ /dpa' bo 'gro ba mnyes pa'o/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa sel byed pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra chen po/ /bdud kyi dpung las rgyal byed pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dul ba'i mtshan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes mngon gsungs pa/ /dkyil 'khor drug po dag gi lha/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /de dag kun gyi rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de bzhin gzhan yang nang du gnas/ /'jig rten 'dren pa zhes pa'i mtshan/ /dngos po srid pa'i dri ma spong / /phyag ces pa ni mchog gi mu/ /mchod pa zhes pa lha mang sgra/ /bstod pa'i gnas ni rin chen stobs / /rtag tu rim gro bya ba'i 'os/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma'i phyag/bkur 'os mchod ces bya ba ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra las rgyal/ /phyag ces pa ni rtog 6pa grub/ /bla ma'i rab ni yul bzang po/ /'jig rten gsum po gom gcig bgrod/ /mi rtog 'od ces bya ba'i mtshan/ /mkha' ltar mtha' 25—210

med rnam med de37/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i sgra/ /gsum rig khya pa ni zla ba smra/ /thos pa po ni rdul bkrus pa'o/ /gtsang ma byezhes pa mi g.yo'i mtshan/ /mngon shes drug ni blo gros mtshan/ /rjes drug ldan zhes bya ba'i sgra/ /bsod nams mar me'i rgyal po'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes pa ni/ /rtog rgyapa'i sgra zhes bya bar brjod/ /sems dpa' che ni go ta ma/ /'jig rten las 'das gzi brjid stobs/ /sgyu 'phrul che zhes bya ba'i tshig /blo rnams gzugs zhes bya ba'i ming / /shes rab pha rol phyin mtha' ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba bzang / /shes rab de nyid ces pa ni/ /byang chub yan lag me tog mtshan/ /thob ces pa ni ston pa'o/ /bdag rig ces pa gzi brjid bzang / /gzhan rig ces ni bya ba'i tshig /ye shes gzi brjid stobs zhes brjod—/ /thams cad ces pa dge ba'i 'od/ /kun la zhes pa brten pa'i stobs—/ /gang phyir gang zag mchog ces pa/ /lha yi bu zhes pa yi mtshan/ /dper bya kun las 'das pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab zhi ba'o/ /shes bya zhes pa nyi ma'i zhal/ /shes bya'i bdag po grol ba'i 'od/ /mchog ni tshul khrims 'od ces brjod/ /chos kyi sbyin bdag ces pa ni/ /dka' thub rnam pa zhes pa'i mtshan/ /gtso bo de bzhin rdul med pa'o/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi don ston pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho'i gsung / /bsnyen bkur gnas kyi mchog ces pa/ /mig sman zhes pa'i mtshan du brjod/ /'gro ba zhes pa kun las sargyal/ /nges 'byung gsum ni sems can 'od/ /bgrod rnams shes kyepa dri ma med/ /dam pa'i don zhes bya ba ni/ /dran pa'i dbang po zhes su brjod//rnam dag dpal ni zhal ras sdug /'jig rten gsum skal bzang zhes pa/ /25—211

rgyal mtshan mtha' yas zhes pa'i mtshan/ /chen po zhes pa blo mchog go/ /'byor pa kun zhes bya ba ni/ /de bzhin dpung zhi ⑫/rab zhi'i mtshan/ /dpal ldan zhes pa rin chen 'dod/ /'jam dpal zhes pa chos dbang phyug /dpal dang ldan pa mchog gi ming / /de bzhin gshegs pa sna tshogs lha/ /kun gyi ge tshig don brjod pa dag /ming nyid sngags kyi mtshan dag ste/ /de dag ltar na bu ga'i mda'/ /sangs rgyas mtshan ni sbyor la skye/ /dkyil 'khor gcig gi dbus su yang / /sngar bshad ltos pas bzhi pa'o/ /a wa dhū la brten rnal 'byor/ /sa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /g.yas pa dang ni g.yon gnyis la/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba 'bab/ /dkyil 'khor re re dag la yang / /dkyil 'khor bzhi bzhi dag tu brtags/ /yang na dbus zhuni gcig la yang / /khyab par thams cad skye bar 'gyur/ /go rims ji ltar bzhi 'gyur gyis/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'o/ /de dag bgrangs pa'i yon tan 'gyur / /stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /lhag ma brgya phrag drug po ni/ /drug dang brgyad kyi grangs 'gyur las/ /stong phrag brgya dang drug brgya'o/ /re re la yang go rims bzhin/ /brgya phrag drug tu shes par bya/ /drug brgya dag gi yon tan ni/ /de kun ston pa'i grangs shes dāni/ /khri phrag bzhi dang stong phrag gsum/ /de ni brgya phrag gcig gi 'gyur/ /gnyis ka bsdom pa'i grangs nyid kyang / /'bum phrag bzhi bcu rtsa gsum mo/ /bya dang byed par gsungs pa ste/ /de ltar 'khor lo drug po la/ /dbugs rgyu ba ni lha rnams so/ /'khor lo gnyis su bshad par bya/ /gcig ni nang du bsgom bya ste/ /spyi gtsug sogs nas gsang ba'i mthar/ /rgyud dang rgyud kyi nang du gsungs/ /25—212

gnyis pa rdo rje dbyings la sogs/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mthar/ /de dag ji bzhin rim pa bzhin/ /mgrin pa spyi gtsug snying ga dpral/ /de bzhin gsang ba lte ba ru/ /yang na 1ming gi rnam grangs ni/ /ngag gi dbang phyug chos dbyings kyi/ /ming can spyi gtsug 'khor lo'o/ /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa yi/ /ming ni mgrin par gsungs pa'o/ /me long ye shes sgu yi ni/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor rngu'adod pa'o/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ /lte ba'i 'khor lo'i ming can no/ /dpral ba'i 'khor lor gsungs pa ni/ /de bzhin mnyam nyid ye shes kyi/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i bdag nyid do/ /de ltar rnal 'byor rgyud kun la/ /ston pa'i rgyal po chen pos khyab/ /sna tshogs ye shes lnga bdag nyid/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi bdag nyid dngos / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /gong nas gong du brgyud pa'o/ /gzhan dag lhag ma gzhan kun ni/ /slob dpon la sogs bdag chen rnams/ /kun gyis bsgom par bya ba dang / /bklags /pa tsam gyis grol bar 'gyur/ /nye bar basbus pa las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i rnam par rtog ge zhes bya ba ste brgyad pa'o// //da ni rnal 'byor de dag gi/ /ye shes lnga po brjod par bya/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud la sogs pa nas/ /ye shes sku nyid tshig gi mthar/ /gang phyir tshigs su bcad pa'i tshig /nyi shu bya dang byed pa ste/ /bdag nyid chen po'i tshigs bcad ni/ /dang po nyid du byed pa'i rgyud4/ /lhag ma bzhi ni gsungs pa ni/ /gang phyir bya ba ji ltar rim/ /de dag ye shes lnga nyid de/ /rgyu la 25—213

sogs pa ji ltar rim/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyi ye shes dang / /gnad kyi ye shes de bzhin gzhan/ /sgom pa'i ye shes gsungs pa dang / /lnga pa grol ba ye shes so//rgyu ni me long yang dag bshad/ /rkyen ni chos kyi dbyings nyid do/ /so sor rtog pa gnad kyi'o/ /mnyam pa nyid ni bsgom 3pa'i mchog /grol ba'i ye shes bya grub kyi'o/ /de ltar rim 2bzhin shes par bya/ /rgyu yi ye shes rnam pa bzhi / /phyi rol dang ni nang du 'dod/ /phyi rol dpe yi mtshan nyid de/ /nang nyid dpe yis mtshon pa'o/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje 'dud ces pa/ /dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin nas/ /yang dag mtha' yi bar du ni/ /bde ba'i longs spyod bzhi yi mchog /gang phyir stong pa nyid kyi tshig /rtag tu gzhi la dran med thob / /de bzhin snying po zhes pa'i tshig /bde dang stong nyid dbyer med pa'o / /sangs rgyas byang chub ces pa yang / /rnal 'byor dag treni sngon byang chub / /de dag dpe tsam gzhan yod min/ /bde yang gsungs shing bstod pa'i mchog /phyag 'tshal 'dud pa rnam bzhi ste/ /mchod dang mchod 4bya'i rang bzhin can/ /rtag tu mchod bya'i las bya ba'ang / /sngar gsungs me long ye shes la'o/ /de bzhin du ni 5mchod pa'i ming / /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dngos / /de nyid 'od gsal bar ni bshad/ /steng 'og spyor la 6phyag 'tshal lo / /de ltar rnal 'byor rnam gsungs pa/ /dpe yis nye bar mtshon pa'i mchog /phyi rol gnyis gnyis snyoms 7'jug pas/ /gzhan yang shes rab ye shes so/ /thabs dang rgyu yi sbyor bas ni/ /phyi rol ston pa ma yin no/ /des na sangs rgyas chags pa sogs/ /bcu drug po yi tshig rnams ni/ /de bzhin dga' ba bcu drug ste/ /tshig ni re re'i mtha' nyid do/ /de la sangs rgyas 25—214

chags pa'i tshig /dga' ba bzhi yi mtshan nyid do/ /rnal 'byor dbang po mdzad dus su/ /thog ma tha ma dbus nyid yin1/ /de yi chags chen zhes pa nas / /gang de bzhi pa zhes pa'i mthar/ /gang phyir rtag tu chos dbyings ni//rdo rje mchog ces bya bar gsungs/ /sangs rgyas sku zhes bya ba'i gzhi2/ /yang dag mtha' ru gsungs pa'o/ /chos kyi sgu zhes gsungs pa ni/ /dga' bral ba ni bzhi pa'o/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i tshig nyid ni/ /de bzhin stong nyid snying po las/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dus nyid du/ /gnyis spangs par ni gsungs pa'o / /de bzhin sangs rgyas rol pa ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rkyen can no / /dga' ba la sogs bzhi pa yi/ /lhag ma lhag 4ma'i bar du ste/ /gang phyir sangs rgyas 'dzum pa'i tshig /so sor rtog pa gsung 5ba'o/ /gnad kyi ye shes bshad pa yang / /bcu gnyis dang po gnad kyi sgo/ /sangs rgyas bshad pa zhes pa'i tshig / las kyi 6bya ba'i rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa gnyis su yang dag bshad/ /phyi rol dang ni nang du 'dod/ /sangs rgyas nyid ces bya ba'i mtshan/ /las kyi phyag rgya nyid kyi brdas/ /de la a wa dhū tī gnas/ /srog dang rlung du rnam par gsungs/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba zhes pa'i tshig /longs spyod du yang gsungs pa'o/ /sprul pa dag ni ma lus dang / /lhan cig skyes dang chos sku mchog /de dag gang phyir med las byung / /med pa rtag tu stong pa ste/ /ye shes 'byung ba nyid du bshad/ /sku bzhi po dag grangs med pa'i / /de la 7gzhan yang sangs rgyas 'byung / /rang bzhin nyid ni sku dang ldan / /nam mkha' zhes pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /bzhi pa la ltos lnga pa yi/ /de yi rang bzhin sangs rgyas nyid/ /nam mkha' las byung rab brtags 8pa/ /25—2/5

mkha' ni lhan cig skyes par bshad/ /rnal 'byor pa dang rang las skyes/ /ye shes las byung ba yi tshig /ji ltar sems ni bzhi pa'i mtha'/ /yod dang med las rnam par 'das/ /rang rig pa yi sangs rgyas mchog /sgyu 'phrul zhes pa'i tshig nyid kyang / /bshad pa nang gi bdag nyid 'dod/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams sgyu 'phrul tshig /dra ba mchog tu bde ba'o/ /sangs rgyas rol pa zhes pa'i tshul/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang rnal 'byor ma'otu/ /thams cad lhan cig skyes pa tsam/ /bsam gtan bzhi yi nang las skye/ /thams cad thams cad ces pa ni/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can/ /shes dang shes bya nyid du gsungs / /rdo rje snying po rtse mo can/ /dga' ba zhes pa'i ming nyid ni/ /gsang ba'i gnas su skye ba ste/ /bcu drug tshig tu shes par bya/ /dang po sogs nas gang ba'i mthar/ /dang po reg pa'i dga' ba'o/ /de bzhin gzhan yang chags pa'i dga'/ /'dod pa'i dga' ba gsum po yang tsosna /rus sbal dga' ba mchog tu 'dod/ /zla ba'i dga' ba de bzhin gshegs/ /keng rus dga' ba drug pa'o/ /bdun pa ru ni gsungs pa ni/ /sgra yi dga' ba ma lus pa'o/ /'jigs pa'i dga' ba brgyad par gsungs/ /de bzhin gzhan yang sna tshogs dga'/ /bcu pa bcu yi dga' ba'o/ / gzhan yang snying gi dga' ba'o/ /dbacu gnyis pa ni nam mkha'i dga'/ /de dga' ba dang mchog tu dga'/ /bco lnga par ni gsungs pa ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bar 'dod/ /bcu drug pa yi mtshan nyid ni/ /dga' bral du ni bshad pa yin//de dag dga' chen bcu drug ni/ /zla ba lta bu'i dbus na'o/ /dkar po'i 4 phyogs la yang dag bshad/ /gang ba gsum gyi 5bye brag gis/ /go rims ji 25—216

bzhin bshad pa yang / /dga' ba gsum ste rtsa gsum pa'o/ /thams cad gzung bar ldan pa ni/ /go rims ji bzhin 'pho ba ste/ /shes rab de nyid khyab sna par ro/ /thabs ni bcu drug gsungs pa yang / /rtag tu stong pa nyid la bshad/ /dang po sogs nas sa/nam stong bar/ /gang phyir phyag 'tshal ba yi tshig /bcu drug pa yi ming can no/ /gnyis med rnal 'byor phun sum tshogs//dkar nag phyogs ni gnyis med 'dod/ /bdag nyid chen por gang spyod de/ /srid pa las ni rgal nas 'gro/ /lhan cig skyes pa gtsang ba yin/ /lhan cig skyes pa rtogs 3pa'ang yin/ /lhan cig skyes pa bla ma yin/ /mchod pa'i gnas kyang lhan cig skyes/ /slob ma lta bu mkhas pa'ang de/ /mchod pa po ni sgom pa dngos / /gang phyir lhan skyes gnyis med ni/ /lhan skyes bya ba de yi mchog /lhan skyes —bya ba ru yang bshad/ /ldang dang nyal la sogs pa'ang de/ /ji srid lhan skyes tsam nyid la/ /sems nyid ngal so spyod yul lo/ /de la bya dang byed pa yi/ /gnyis po dag las gnyis med 'byung / /de ni rtog med mtshan nyid de/ /rnal 'byor ma yi kha 4na las/ /de dag de rnams gsungs 5 pa ni/ /bdag nyid 'ba' zhig dran pa'o/ /yang na dad pa can dag gi/ /rang gi slob ma brgyud pa las/ /mngon par dga' dang klags pa dang / /mnyan pa dang ni sgom pa dang / /gzhan dag la 7ni bstan pa ste/ /skal dang skal gred rnam dpyad nas8/ /de dag gsang ba'i 'khor lo yi/ /tshigs bcad dag la go rims bzhin/ /dgu pa dang ni bco lnga lnga/ /de bzhin du ni steng 'og gnyis/ /gcig pa nyid ni spyi gtsug dbus/ /kun bsdus sum cu rtsa gnyis mchog /nye bar basbus pa las ye shes lnga'i bstod pa don bsdus pa rnam 25—217

par rtog ge zhes bya ba ste dgu pa'o// //de bzhin gzhan yang phan yon ni2/ /tshigs bcad lnga yi nang du ste/ /'di de rdo rje la sogs pa/ /bstod pa yi 2ni nang du gsungs/ /gzhan dag kyang ni rnyed bla ba / /nye bar bsnyus par ngas ma bshad/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /sangs rgyas gzugs ni grangs med rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs mchog nyid/ /ma lus bdag la bzod par gsol/ /sgyu 'phrul dra sogs mdor bsdus nas/ /gleng gzhi mchog tu gsungs pa ste/ /bsod nams de yis 'jig rten pa/ /ji ltar de bzhin rol par smon/ /gnas ni phra ba pu ri ru/ /gzhan dag gis ni gsol btab nas/ / mtshon ma 4mchog dag mthong gyur pas/ /gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes 5byas/ /nye bar bsdus pa las phan yon rtogs par sla ba rnam par rtog ge zhes bya ba ste bcu pa'o// //mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i nye bar bsdus pa rnam par rtog ge zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po nges par sbyangs pa dpal gnyis su rnged pa'i rdo rje zhes bya bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po shrī badz+ra bo bye dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpyal 6ser tsa spre bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul gyis / /gnas mchog smin lung gtsug lag khang / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i skal ldan mang 7/ /de dag don du legs par bsgyur// //

tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /zhus la tshigs bcad bcu drug ste/ /de la nang gses 1rnam pa bdun/ /gang gis zhus la tshigs bcad lnga/ /gang ltar zhus la tshigs bcad gcig /gang phyir zhus la gnyis su gnas/ /gang la zhus la gcig yin no/ /gang zhus pa la tshigs bcad bzhi/ /ji skad zhus pa'i don bzhin du//sgrub par khas blangs pa la gnyis/ /de phyir gus 2nyan tshigs bcad gcig /slar gsungs pa la tshigs bcad drug /nang gi dbye ba rnam pa bdun/ /gang gis gsungs la tshig rkang gnyis/ /gang ltar gsungs la sh+lau ka 4gnyis/ /gang la gsungs la sh+lau ka 5phyed/ /gang phyir gsungs la tshig rkang gnyis/ /gang gsungs dzopa la rkang pa gsum/ /rna gtod nyon cig 'doms pa la/ /tshigs bcad phyed dang gnyis su bzhed / /gnang nas gtang rag phul rkang gcig /ris drug gzigs la tshigs bcad gnyis/ /'dis gzigs dang po tshig rkang gnyis 9/ /de 'og tshig gcig spyi la gzigs/ /lha drug don yod rnam snang mdzad/ /mi bskyod mtha' yas rin chen 'byung / /rdo rje sems dang drug rim bzhin/ /gzhung 7lugs gzhan la gzhan du snang / /de la gzigs nas 'di mtshan brjod/ /dkyil 'khor drug dang 5bstod pa dang / /phan yon sngags rigs bsdus sogs kyi/ /gzhung tshad mtshan don go rims bzhin/ /rang rang skabs su 'og nas 'chad/ /bsnyus pa'i don bzhir gzhag 1 pa yin/ /rnam par dbye bar bya ba ni/ /zhus dang slar gsungs rigs 7drug gzigs/ /dmigs pa'i yul du gzhag sapar bya/ /mngon rtogs dkyil 'khor drug dang bstod / /sngags rings dang dgus nyams blang lathabs/ /phan yon gyis ni bskyed pa dang / /thob bya'i 'bras bu bstan pa yin/ /bsdus pa'i tshigs su 25—225

bcad pa lngas/ /dmigs thabs 'bras bu gsum bsdus bstan/ /'dis zhus 'dis gsungs 'di 7gsungs gsum/ /'khor dang ston pa rnam pa gsum/ /mchog gsum rgyu 'bras thabs dang gsum/ /thob bya'i yul du gzhag 2pa yin/ /gzhan yang zhus lan gzigs pa gsum/ /thabs dang de bzhin shes rab dang / /gnyis su med dang rnam gsum du/ /nang gi tshe na gzhag pa yin/ /nyams su blang ba'i thabs dag ni/ /rnal 'byor gzhung gi 'khor lo ste/ /de yang phyi nang dbye ba yis/ /rnam pa gnyis su bstan pa yin/ /phyi rol la yang rnam gsum ste/ /snying ga shes rab 'khor lo dang / /pho brang lha yi 'khor lo dang / /'khrul 'khor las kyi 'khor lo'o/ /nang gi 'khor lo gcig nyid de/ /lus gnas rtsa yi 'khor lo'o/ /'khor lo bzhi po de dag la/ /re re la yang bdun bdun no/ /de la shes rab 'khor lo ni/ /ji ltar rnam par bsam zhe na/ /dang por rang rang 4'dod pa'i lha/ /sa bon mdog dang so so'i rgya/ /de thugs dang po'i sangs rgyas ni/ /zhal lnga phyag brgyad kun thun mong / /de yi thugs kar 'khor lo ni/ /rigs 5drug dbye bas rnam pa drug /bsdus pa dang ni bdun gyur te/ /lte ba rtsibs dang rtsibs rten can/ /lte ba mu khyud gnyis kyis bskor/ /rtsibs rten mu khyud gnyis yod pa/ /lte ba'i mu khyud nang ma la/ /sngags rings gnyis phyi 6rtsa ba dgod/ /phyi la ā li rnams dgod de7//rtsibs rten mu khyud nang ma la/ /sngags rings gnyis phye phreng sngags dgod/ /phyi la kā li legs par dgod/ /mu khyud sngags dang mdog dkar mtshungs/ /rtsibs grangs so so'i dang po la/ /drug ste sngags drug mtshan re dgod/ /mdog drug ldan par dgod 9par bya/ /dbus su a ni dkar por bkod/ /25—226

so sor rtog pa'i rtsibs brgyad la/ /badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha la sogs dgod/ /yig 'bru re re kha dog dmar/ /dbus su dhīḥyang kha dog mthun/ /me long lta bu'i rtsibs kyi brgyad 1—/ /duḥkha ts+tsha da la sogs pa/ /'bru re re ste kha dog sngo/ /lte dbus hūṃ yang mdog mchog sngo/ /chos dbyings ye shes rtsibs bcu pa/ /rtsibs rnams kun la dgod pa ni/ /pradz+nyā dz+nyā na la sogs bcu/ /dbus kyi a dang de kun dkar/ /bya grub ye shes 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad dz+nyā na kā la sogs—/ /rtsibs re 'bru re lte bar ā / /shin tu mdzes pa'i ljang gu'o/ /mnyam nyid 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ /de la bā gī shwa ra sogs/ /'bru re dgod cing kha dog ser/ / dbus su oṃ yang rab tu ser/ /4drug pa'i 'khor lo 5rtsibs brgyad 6pa/ /a ra pa tsa la sogs pa/ /yig dgu gcig la gnyis dgod bya/ /dbus su ā 7ni rab tu dkar/ /shes rab 'khor lo'i lte ba ru/ /dang po la ni ye shes sems/ /thun mong mtshan dang ldan par bsam/ /gzhan la mtshan yang so so ste/ /so sor rtog la rdo rje rno/ /me long ral gri sdug bsngal gcod/ /chos dbyings shes rab ye shes so/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes sku/ /mnyam pa nyid la ngag dbang phyug /rdo rje sems la mtshan mchog ni/ /a ra pa tsa na zhes pa/ /mdog dang phyag mtshan so sor bsam/ /mngon rtogs la ni tshigs bcad gsum/ /tshigs bcad dngos gcig sngags la gnyis/ /de ltar shes rab 'khor lo ni/ /gzhung tshad bcas 9pa legs bstan nas/ /da ni pho brang lha 'khor lo/ /de yi dbye ba bstan par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad che zhes pa/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rje ni/ /lnga yi rang bzhin drug pa ste/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha dang mtshan/ /gtso bo'i thugs ka'i ye shes sems/ /25—227

'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /mtshan rnams rnam pa gnyis su bzhed//de yi thugs ka'i zla dkyil na/ /mtshan ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang a las byung / /de steng a la rnam gsum ste/ /a ni yig 'bru kun mchog dang / /don chen zhes ni 'byung ba dang / /yi ge dam pa zhes pa gsum / /de ltar de dag gsum po ni/ /mtshan mchog rnam pa bdun du bzhed / /gsang ba'i yum bzhi'i rnams la ni/ /khong nas byung dang skye med gnyis / /satwa badz+re ma yi mtshan/ /tshig tu brjod pa spangs gcig pu/ /raṇ+ḍa 1badz+re ma yi mtshan/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu mchog nyid/ /dharma badz+re ma yi mtshan / /tshig kun shes ni 'byung ba dang / /rab tu gsal byed ma dang gnyis / /karma badzi ma yi mtshan/ /de dag la ni mtshan drug ste/ /dang po tha ma gnyis gnyis so/ /rgyal ba lnga la tshan pyagasum gsum/ /tshig rkang dang po gnyis gnyis so/ / gong ma gong ma la gnyis gnyis/ / 'og ma 'og ma re re la / /mchod pa chen po chags chen nas/ /khro ba chen po dgra che'i mthar/ /rgyal rnams bco lnga yum bzhi drug /nyi shu rtsa gcig dag tu bshad/ /'dod pa che dang bde ba che/ /rdo rje sems dang rgyal po gnyis/ /dga' ba che dang mgu che gnyis/ /chags pa dang ni legs pa'i mtshan/ /tshig rkang gnyis la bzhir bzhed de/ /byang chub sems kyi mtshan rnams so/ /gzugs che lus kyang che ba nas / /dkyil 'khor chen po yangs pa yin/ /tshigs su bcad pa gcig la ni / /sems dpa' bzhi ste mtshan rnams lnga/ / gzi brjid mchog che lus che gnyis / /zide dag dbang bsgur sems dpa' bzhi/ /shes rab mtshon chen 'chang ba nas/ /snang ba chen po gsal che'i mthar/ /tshigs su bcad pa 25—228

gcig la ni/ /sems dpa' bzhi ste mtshan mchog bdun/ /rkang pa dang po rdo rje chos/ /mtshan mchog gcig tu shes par bya/ /rnon po la ni gnyis yin te/ /nyon mongs lcags kyu che dang mchog /rgyu la grags chen snyan grags gnyis/ /smra la snang che gsal che gnyis/ /ye shes sems dpar grags pa yin/ /mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul che 'chang nas/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po mig 'phrul mthar/ /tshigs bcad gcig la sems dpa' bzhi/ /mtshan rnams drug tu bzhed pa yin/ /mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul che 'chang gnyis/ /rdo rje las su shes par bya/ /sgyu 'phrul che dang don grub pa/ /rdo rje bsrung ba'i mtshan yin no/ /lhag ma gnyis la re re'o—/ /sems dpa' de dag bzhi po ni/ /las kyi sems dpa' rnams yin no / /sems dpa' bcu drug rnams la ni/ /tshigs su bcad pa phyed dang bzhi / /mtshan rnams nyi shu rtsa gnyis te/ /sems dpa'i bsdus don de yin no / /sbyin bdag chen po zhes pa nas/ /smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho'i bar /pha rol phyin bcu'i tshigs bcad gnyis/ /lha mo brgyad dang sgo mar 7bzhed/ /sbyin bdag chen ༄ dang gtso bo gnyis/ /sgeg mo yi ni mtshan yin no/ /tshul khrims chen dang 'chang mchog ni/ /phreng ba ma la gnyis su bzhed/ /bzod chen 'chang dang brtan pa gnyis/ /glu ma yi ni mtshan yin no/ /brtson 'grus che dang brtul ཿba gnyis/ /gar mkhan ma yi mtshan yin no/ /me tog ma la mtshan gcig 4ste/ /bsam gtan chen po'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /shes rab che dang lus 'chang gnyis/ /bdug pa ma yi mtshan yin no/ /bsam gtan zhes pa mar ske ma/ /thabs chen zhes pa dri chab ma/ / stobs ni dad sogs rnam pa lnga / /ye shes rgya mtsho mthong sgom gnyis/ /5yan lag bdun dang 'phags 25—229

lam brgyad/ /stobs dang ye shes sgom par snabazhed/ /gsang mchod la brgyad phyi la lnga/ /sgo ba la gnyis spyir bco lnga/ /byams chen rang bzhin zhes pa nas/ /mkhas pa chen po thabs che'i bar/ /tshig rkang bzhi la rim bzhin du / /shar phyogs gnas pa'i skal bzangs bzhi/ /tshig rkang dang po byams pa yin/ /snying rje dang ni blo mchog gnyis/ /'jam dpal gye ni mtshan yin no//spos glang shes rab blo chen gnyis/ /mkhas pa che dang thabs che gnyis/ /ye shes tog gi mtshan yin no/ /sgo yi sems dpa' rnam bzhi ni/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan bzang skyong gi/ /shugs chen mgyogs pa chen po ni/ /blo gros rgya mtsho'i mtshan yin no/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po cher grags pa/ /blo gros mi bzad pa yi mtshan/ /spobs pa brtsegs pa zhes bya ba/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon gcig 4pu/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi/ /srid pa'i ri bo che 'joms nas/ /'jigs chen 'jigs par byed pa'i mthar/ /mthu chen thob dang ngan song 'dren/ /mya ngan 'joms dang dra ba can/ /go rims bzhin du tshig re la/ /mtshan yang re re dag tu 'dod/ /byang phyogs kyi yang sems dpa' bzhi/ /mgon po rigs mchog chen po nas/ /theg pa chen po tshul mchog mthar/ /go rims bzhin du legs sbyar te/ /mgon po rigs dang mchog chen gnyis/ /zla 'od gzhon nu'i mtshan yin no/ /'od dpag med dang nam mkha' mdzod/ /sgrib pa rnam par sel dang gsum/ /tshig gsum mtshan gsum go rims bzhin/ /tshigs bcad dag ni bcu bzhi ste/ /mtshan don brgyad cu rtsa drug bzhed/ /rigs bsdus tshe na dbus dkyil 'khor/ /bde gshegs dkyil 'khor lha rnams ni/ /seng ge dang ni rab gsal byed/ /25—230

thub pa dang ni me tog dang / /me tog mdzes dang spyan bzang po1/ /kun ded dpon dang phyag rgya che/ /stobs po che dang rgyu skar rgyal/ /sman pa dang ni grags pa dang / /rgyal mtshan dang ni 'od zer che/ /grol phung dang ni rnam snang mdzad/ /nyi bzang po dang zla ba bzang / /'od zer can dang 'od 'phro bzang / /mya ngan med dang de bzhin skar2/ /'od 'phro 'dzin dang yon tan 'od / /don ston pa dang mar me ldan/ /rab bzang dang ni sman bzang po/ /dpa' bo dang ni mdzod spu dang / /brtan po dang ni dpal gyi lha/ /mthong bar dka' dang yon tan 'od/ /skra can dang ni grangs can dang / /tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang brtan pa'i mtshams/ /rig pa ldan dang 'od mdzad pa/ /ri bo che dang rdo rje che/ /rgyal min dang ni 'jigs med pa/ /rin po che dang pad+ma dang / /stobs sde can dang me tog 'od/ /ye shes 'od dang lha chen po/ /tshig gi bdag dang snang mtha' yas/ /klus sbyin dang ni bstan 4pa'i rim/ /don yod mthong dang dbang po sbyin/ /mi lhung ba dang seng rgyal mtshan/ /rgyal ba dang ni tshogs pa po/ /dga' ba'i rgyal dang don 'dod pa/ /dga' bar mdzad dang chu yi lha/ /yon tan lag dang spos glang po/ /don yod dbyangs dang thugs bzang po/ /zla ba dang ni ri bong can/ /grags chen pa dang gtsug nor bu/ /drug po dang ni seng ge 'gros/ /ngang pa dang ni rnam rgyal don / /shes rab brtsegs dang legs gnas pa/ /blo gros dang ni yan lag skyes / /bdud rtsi bu dang gzugs bzang po/ /ye shes can dang 'od zer can—/ /dka' thub brtan dang bkra shis ldan/ /bde ba'i tog dang pad+ma dang / /mi yi theg dang bde ba'i phyag /ye shes mdzad blo dang 'od bral/ /25—231

tshangs pas byin dang rin chen mdzod/ /me tog lha dang legs pa'i don/ /chos dbang phyug dang blo gros grags/ /rdo rje tog dang pad+ma sgrub/ /rnam par rol dang du ma'i lha/ /ri yi tog dang 'od kyi tshogs/ /mi zad pa dang rin chen snying / /bzod chen pa dang chos kyi blo/ /yid kyi yul dang yon tan grags / /zla ba'i 'od dang gsal ba'i ro/ /seng ge tog dang lus las bzlog /snying po'i dpal dang nges pa'i tog /glog gi 'od dang gser sbyin cha / /gzhan gyis mi thub tog gi rgyal/ /rab tu grags dang brtson 'grus brtan / /dpe bral grags dang gshin 'jigs 'gyur/ /dgra bcom lha dang mar me che/ /'jig rten 'od dang dri dang po/ /yon tan 'dzin dang mun bral 'gyur/ /seng ge spro dang rin chen grags/ /skye rang bzhin dang yid skyes zla / /legs par ston dang gzugs brnyan brgyan/ /nor bu bzang dang rin chen tog /chos 'byung gnas dang rnam nges don/ /chos rtester ba dang rin chen gnas/ /rgyal dbang po dang rin chen mnan/ /gnas pa'i blo dang bskal bral gdugs/ /rnam snang dpal dang seng ge sgra/ /rnam par rol dang klu yi 'od/ /me tog ro dang klu dbang can/ /ri dbang phyug dang shin tu bsam / /stobs kyi lha dang yon tan phreng / /klu yi phyag dang gzugs brnyan brgyan / /rgyal ba'i blo dang ye shes khyab/ /bdud rtsi sgra dang bden par smra/ /rab zhi blo dang mtha' yas gzugs/ /rnam snang mdzad dang rin chen tog /'dod pa bral dang legs gzhibs pa/ /don yod sangs rgyas rtogs pa 'chang /me tog dang ni rdor dbang rgyal/ /gzi brjid can dang don ston pa/ /tshe dpag med dang khro dbang phyug /don gnas can dang mi shigs grags/ /mya 25—232

ngan med dang dri ma bral/ / tshangs pa'i kyilha zhes bya ba'o/ /'di yi gzhung gi tshad dag kyang / /tshigs bcad nyi shu rtsa lngar ni/ /tshig rkang gcig gis ma tshang ba/ /rgyal ba lnga la rim bzhin du/ /sum cu rtsa drug rtsa drug mtshan/ /bsdoms pas brgya dang brgyad cu gcig /mi bskyod dkyil 'khor lha rnams ni / /rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyud las gnyis/ /khro bo rnam rgyal sgyu 'phrul dra/ /phyag rdor dbang bskur rgyud las gnyis/ /rdo rje brgyan dang rig pa mchog /bde mchog rgyan dang rdo rje 'dus/ /don yod zhags dang rdo rje thod/ /gsang ba 'dus dang rnam snang dra / /dam tshig che nang zla gsang thig /gnyis med mnyam dang zla gsang thig /rgyu de rnams las mtshan re re/ /sgyu 'phrul drug stong pa las gnyis/ /'byung po phyag rdor sa 'og rgyud/ /sgyu 'phrul dra dang bde mchog rgyud/ /khro bo bde mchog sad dang ni/ /rgyud de rnams la mtshan re 'byung / /khro bo rnam rgyal rgyud gnyis las/ /khro zla dang ni rta mchog rgyud/ /mtshan ni re re 5shes par bya/ /mi mnyam mnyam dang gsang rgyud de/ /rgyud de las ni bzhi 'byung ngo / /dpal mchog dang po gsang ba 'dus/ /gsang ba mdzod dang gsang ba 'dus/ /rdo rje gsang rgyan nor bu gsal/ /de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud dang ni/ /rgyud de rnams las mtshan re re/ /dam tshig chen po'i rgyud las gnyis/ /rnam snang mngon byang chub las gnyis/ /gnyis med mnyam dang khams gsum rgyal/ /rgyud de las ni re re'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyud las gnyis/ /phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i/ /rgyud las khro bo bzhi 'byung ngo / /rdo rje snying po'i rgyud las gnyis/ /rdo rje thod phreng 6rgyud las gnyis / /khro bo rnam rgyal rgyud las gnyis/ /dpung bzangs rgyud dang legs 25—233

———par grub/ /yi ge drug dang 'bum pa dang / /'jam dpal rgyud dang mngon dam rgyan/ /de bzhin khams gsum rnam rgyal dang / /rgyud de rnams las re re'o / /'jam dpal rgyud las gnyis 'byung ngo / /'di yi gzhung tshad bstan pa ni/ /tshigs bcad bcu dang rkang pa gcig /mtshan rnams bdun cu rtsa gcig ste/ /rgyal ba lnga la bcu bzhi re/ /rgyud sde so sor lha dbye byas/ /pad+ma gar dbang dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lha rnams nges par brjod pa ni/ /ye shes grags dang de bzhin rgyal/ /yon tan 'od dang khyad par che/ /zla ba rgyal dang pad+ma'i 'od/ /dka' thub rgyal dang mar me bzang / /glog gi tog dang 'od kyi rgyal/ /gsal ba pa dang dpe bral grags/ /pad+ma grags dang me tog mtshan / /spyan bzang mchog dang grangs med don/ /drag po sde dang bsod nams 'od/ /khyad par can dang thogs dzomed blo/ /rā hu la dang ye shes 'od/ /grags dbang dang ni ye shes dbang / /skar ma'i tog dang rā hu la/ /sman pa che dang sman pa'i rgyal/ /bsod nams dbang dang rgyu ba po/ /skar ma'i rgyal dang rgyal ba pa/ /nyi 'od 'char dang chos kyi mdzod/ /blo gros legs dang rgyal dbang po/ /rdo rje sde dang rdo rje brtsegs/ /legs par gnas dang rgyal ba'i blo/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang klu dbang po/ /yon gsal dbang dang mngon shes tog /'od kyi tog dang dga' tshangs pa/ /sgra mi snyan dang rol pa'i gar/ / klu sbyin dang ni bde ba'i tog / snamakhas dang gzhan gyes mi thub dbyangs/ /rin chen 'od dang gsung dbyangs sbyin/ /seng ge dang ni nyi sna tshogs/ /ye shes dpal dang pad phung po/ /me tog dang ni rnam mnan 'gro// bsod nams dpung dang mchog gyur blo/ /1gsal ba dang ni zla mar me/ /25—234

mi bzad pa dang blo bzangs spyan/ /yan lag gtsug kyedang shes rab yul/ /mchog tu gyur dang rab 'joms zer/ /shes rab sbyin dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs—/ /tshig 3med spyod dang thu bo sbyin/ /dag pa dang ni ye shes gnam/ /bde gshegs 'od dang dbang po'o/ /thub pa 'chang dang lha zhes pa/ /'od zer bzang dang gzugs bzang po/ /rgyal po dang ni don grub mdzad/ /seng ge dang ni dri ldan dang / /grags pa zhes dang rgyal ba'o/ /mchog snying dang ni bsod nams zer/ /mdog bzangs dang ni nyan 'dod pa/ /mar me dang ni rin chen brtsegs/ /tshogs rngumed lha dang sa yi 4bdag /grol bar 'gro dang gser gtsug phud/ /sgra gcan bzang dang mi thub pa/ /rang bzhin thub dang zla thuba'i 'od/ /gser mdog bzang po dang dge ba/ /yon dbang lha dang chos kyi gdugs/ /yon tan legs dang grol zhes pa/ /ye shes rdzogs dang zhib mo'i blo/ /'od rab 'bar dang skyabs kyi sman/ /rnam grol tog dang shes rab mchog /ye shes rgyal dang 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /glo bur 'joms dang thogs med grags/ /bden par gsung dang ngag snyan pa/ /ri dbang grags dang chos brtsegs la/ /'gro ba'i 'od dang legs par brgyan/ /rang gi lus dang ye shes dag /seng mche rno dang sel ba po/ /'gro ba mchod dang seng ge grags / /chos kyi mtshan dang skal ba bzang / /mi bskyod mdog dang 'bar ba'i rgyal/ /rtogs thupa dang ni spyan bzang po/ /don rig blo dang 'jigs med gser/ /dri yi 'od dang dga' ba'o/ /don yod 'gro dang khro thal mdog/mchog gi gzugs dang nyan pa po/ /gtso bo grags dang drag po sbyin/ /nyi ma'i lha dang gshin 'joms lhag /shing rta'i 'gros dang blo gros bzang /25—235

gser 'od bcom shādang skal ldan gtsug /dbang phyug dang ni dga' ba bstan//mos pa 'joms dang ye shes mdzod/ /tshangs pa'i 'gros dang tsan+dan dang / /mya ngan med dang seng ge'o/ /rtog rngo 7gi yul dang pad+ma'i snying / /'od mtha' yas dang lha yi yul/ /bsod nams me tog rig pa'i lha/ /ye shes dbang dang tshangs pa gsal/ /rin chen phyag dang dbang po ldan/ /dpe bral 'gros dang the tshom 1ldan/ /mchod pa dang ni 'bar ba dang / /sangs rgyas gdugs dang 'dam gyi mchog /yid 'ong ldan dang bya grub pa/ /rma bya dang ni chos ldan dang / /phan ldan gzugs dang ye shes dang / /grags pa dang ni 'od zer 'bar/ /ma lus phan dang bai ḍūr kyisnying / /rgyu skar dang ni lha nyid ldan༄ sna/ /ri bong can dang dra ba'i 'od/ /dge ba'i 'od dang yon tan zer/ /yid lags pa dang rigs kyi 'od/ /spyod pa po dang rigs kyi mtsho/ /chos dbang phyug dang sgu yi lha/ /yon tan stobs dang 'khor lo dbang / /legs pa'i dbyangs dang legs par reg /don grub pa dang gzi brjid dpal/ /kun mnyam nyid dang bdud rtsi dbyangs/ /bde bar snang dang legs pa'i blo/ /rnam grol don dang khyad dbang phyug /rol pa'i mchog dang lhag mthong nas 3//nyes pa spangs dang nyi ma'i 'od/ /bkra rgyal blo dang pad+ma'i mchog /nyi ma'i 'od dang so sor gsungs/ /legs pa dang ni tshogs dbang po/ /'jigs pa bral dang ye shes srid/ /spobs pa'i mtshan nyid dang blo mchog /ri bong can dang rin chen zla/ /mi 'jigs pa dang me long che/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang snyan pa'i gsung / /shes rab 'od dang kun mnyam blo/ /rdo rje dang ni rublo dang ldan/ /nam mkha'i dbang dang ngag dbang phyug /yon tan dpal dang 25—236

gnas kyi dpal/ /'phags pa'i 'od dang gsal ba'i shugs/ /gsal ba'i ro dang dri dbang phyug /'dod can gdong dang ye shes gsung / / zhi gnas dang ni ye shes legs/ /rmyerab tu 'dug dang chos rgyal mtshan/ /dri ma bral dang chos dbang phyug /skal bral sgra dang gzi brjid 'od/ /drang srong dbang dang blo gros ngan 'u/ /spobs pa'i 'khor lo dang zla zhal/ /nyi zla'i 'od dang yon tan mtsho/ /yon tan gsung pad bla med rtogag /bsod nams rtog ngadang sgobs pa'i yul/ /rigs pa bskyed dang rgyal rigs dang / /rnam grol bsam dang dbang phyug go⑤ / /mchog ces pa dang ye shes dbyangs/ /nam mkha'i mtha' pya dang mchod pa dang / /dpung tshogs dpal dang yon tan zla/ /rā hu la dang bdud rtsi 'od/ /rin chen 'od dang zla ba'i 'od/ / seng ge ྅stobs dang ye shes sku/ /'di yi gzhung tshad bstan pa ni/ /tshigs bcad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis so/ /mtshan ni nyis brgya bdun cu lnga/ /ye shes lnga po re re la/ /lnga bcu rtsa ni lnga lnga'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lha rnams ma lus bstan pa ni/ /don grub dpal dang yes nyi ma/ /don yod grub dang ri dbang brtsegs/ /dgras sbyin dang ni pad+ma dang / /dgra bcom grags dang ye shes tog /nyon mongs 'joms dang me zhes pa/ /bde ba dri dang dpe bral 'od—/ /ri bo grags dang srid mtha' ston/ /zla ba dang ni rin chen zla/ /seng ge rgyal dang bsam gtan 'dod/ /dpe dang bral dang rnam par rol/ /yon tan rin chen dang don grub/ /dgra bcom grags pa rin chen 'od/ /srid pa bcings dang spyod lam snye'aphrul/ /mdzod sru dang ni spobs pa grags/ /rdor nor bu dang tshe dpag med/ /nor bu bkod dang dbang chen po/ /yon 25—237

tan 1'od dang ri bo grags/ /'od zer bcu dang gnyis dang bral/ /klu yi stobs dang yid du 'ong / /rin chen zla dang shugs can dang / /gsal ba dang ni dga' dbang phyug /gtsug phud 'od dang 'jigs bral dang / /yon snying bo dang dri med grags/ /gzi brjid zhing pyadang gdang ba grags/ /lha mang po dang legs par grags/ /sangs rgyas lnga 'dod rin chen gzugs/ /sangs rgyas stobs dang seng ge gshog /grong chen —mtho dang blo gros legs/ /'jig rten 'od dang rin chen lha/ /skal ldan shing rta yang dag rgyal/ /dga' ba bkod dang 'od kyi mu/ /dka' thub che dang zla ba dang / /chos bstan pa dang mi thub zla/ /ri bo 'od dang tshangs pa'i ④dbyangs/ /bden pa'i lha dang yon tan brtsegs/ /seng ge zla khyadang nor go cha/ /zla ba dang ni skra byudang mtshungs / /grags chen dang ni gzi brjid shugs/ /chos kyi grags dang dga' ba ldan/ /dri bzang po dang ri rgyal mtshan/ /dga' ba'i 'od dang mchod yon can/ /srid mtha'i nor bu dang bden mtshungs3/ /rnam snang mdzad dang rnam par nges/ /grags pa'i mtha' dang glog 'chang ba/ /seng ge 'od zer srog dang ldan/ /'gro ba'i theg dang thun tshod dang / /grags pa mchog dang blo bzang chub/ /nor lha 'od srungs 37thub mi bzang / /skar rgyal don byed dang nor 'khor/ /seng ge glang des yon tan brgyan/ /rin chen 'od sa bya ba ste/ /mnyam nyid ye shes 'khor lo la/ /gzhung ni tshigs bcad nyi shu bzhi/ /mtshan ni brgya dang rtsa bzhi'o/ /rigs re nyi shu nyi shu ste/ /nyi shu rtsa she gcig grangs lhag pa/ /bzhi phrag bzhi dang lnga phrag gcig /rigs rnams bzhi dang ⑩gtso bo la/ /go rims bzhin du brtag par bya/ /de phyir 25—238

brgya dang rtsa bzhir nges/ /don yod grub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /nges par sbyar bar bya ba ni/ /dbang byed rgyal dang bdud rab zhi/ /sangs rgyas mnyam dang rtog bral dang / /dri rab zhi dang rmongs la ston/ /rol pa dang ni dge bzang po/ /ye shes thugs dang smra ba'i dbang / /lha chen po dang blo gros bzang / /tshe dpag med dang chos kyi stobs/ /'jig rten mchog dang sgra gcan nyi/ /rgyal mtshan grol dang sman pa mchog /me tog dang ni dge gtsug phud / /bdud rtsi 'od dang byang sems rdor/ /rgya mtsho brtan dang rin chen dpung / /rol pa'i stobs dang nyi ma'i dpung / /dga' ba'i 'od dang rin chen 3dang / /rjes mthun dpal dang seng ge 'gros/ /gsungs pa po dang me tog sbyin/ /grol ba'i 'od dang pad+ma dang / /ye shes 'od dang rol pa'i bkod//don yod gnas dang brten 27pa'i 'od/ /rgyal mtshan tog dang bde ba'i bsam/ /rnam grol rgyal dang sems tshul shes/ /rgya mtsho dga' dang rin chen 'dzin/ /mi thub pa dang 'gro ba mnyes/ /sgra chen po dang dul ba dang / /dkyil 'khor sngar nagasungs kun lha dang / /srid dri spong dang mchog gi mu/ /lha mang sgra dang rin chen stobs/ /pad+ma'i phyag dang dgra 4las rgyal/ /rtogs grub dang ni yul bzang po/ /me tog 'od dang seng ge sgra/ /zla ba smra dang rdul spangs pa/ /mi g.yo ba dang blo gros dang / /bsod nams mar me dang rtogs sgra/ / go ta ma gza' yi tog /5gzi brjid stobs dang blo gnas gzugs/ /zla ba gsang dang byang yon tan/ /ston pa dang ni gzi brjid bzang / /ye shes gzi stobs dang dge'o6/ /brten pa'i stobs dang lha yi bu/ /rab zhi ba dang nyi ma'i zhal/ /grol ba'i 'od dang tshul khrims 'od/ /dka' thub dang ni rdul 25—239

med dang / /rgya mtsho'i gsung dang mig sman dang / /kun las rgyal dang sems can 'od/ /dri med 'od dang dran pa po/ /zhal ras sbug dang rgyal mtha' yas/ /blo yi mchog dang dpung rab zhi/ /rin chen 'od dang chos dbang phyug /sna tshogs lha zhes bya ba'o/ /bya grub ye shes 'khor lo la/ /tshigs bcad bco lnga gzhung tshad yin/ /mtshan ni dgu bcu rtsa lnga ste/ /rigs re re la bcu dgu dgu'o/ /sgyu 'phrul mngon par byang chub pa/ /tshig gi bdag pos tshigs bcad nas/ /ya te na ma'i mthar ri4tshig gsum/ /ma lus pa dang de bzhin du/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gye/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan nas/ /tshig kun gsal bar byed pa'i mthar/ /gnyis te lnga yis spyi gtsug 'khor/ /byams chen rang bzhin zhes pa nas/ /zeg pa chen po'i tshul mchog mthar/ /tshigs bcad bzhi dang bde gshegs kyi/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga 'chang ba dang / /me long rdo rje 'jigs byed nas/ /glang chen ko zlon zhes pa'i mthar/ /tshigs bcad gsum dang rkang gcig ste/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis dpral 'khor lo/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dum bu yi/ /mchod pa chen po chags che nas / /smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /tshigs bcad brgyad kyis snying 'khor lo/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi/ /grags rngo chen ha ha zhes sgrogs ༄ 7nas//sgra dang ldan mthar tshigs bcad bdun/ /lte ba'i 'khor lo'i tshig tu 'gyur/ /so sor rtog 4pa'i ye shes kyi/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis 'chang ba dang / /mnyam nyid ye shes dkyil 'khor gye/ /'dod pa'i don grub dam pa nas/ /rnam pa kun rig sangs rgyas par/ /tshigs su bcad pa bco lnga ste/ /spyi sdom drug cu rtsa bzhi yis/ /lte ba'i 'khor lor rab tu grags/ /mnyam nyid ye shes dgu 25—240

lus rmyepa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul sku nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin mthar/ /brgyad ni mgrin pa'i 'khor lor bzhed/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi/ /tshigs bcad bco lnga tshang ba la/ /mnyam nyid tha ma'i tshig bsnan pas / /bcu drug gsung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /sgyu 'phrul mngon par byang chub dang / /rdo rje dbyings dang de bzhin gshegs/ /rdo rje'i rigs dang pad+ma'i rigs / /rin po che dang las rigs bdun/ /tshigs bcad brgya dang sum cu gsum/ /nang gi 'khor lo drug pa'o/ /'dab nagrangs tshigs bcad grangs kyang mnyam/ / tshig gcig lhag pa lte bar brtags/ /kun gyi lte bar de 'gyur brtags/ / kyeganas lugs gong du bstan pa yin/ /las su bya ba'i 'khrul 'khor yang ④/ / nang gi 'khor lo ji bzhin du/ /'khor lo zlum po rim pa drug /dang po 'dab bde gnyis pa brgyad/ /rim pa gsum la bcu drug ste/ /bzhi pa sum cu rtsa gnyis po/ /lnga pa drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /drug pa yang ni sum cu gnyis/ /shri kha dha sogs kyi ni bris/ /dbus su bsgrub bya'i ming bzhag la/ /shar du aḥdang byang du āḥ/ /nub tu aḥdang lho ru ldi/ /de yi phyi rol 'dab brgyad la/ /shar du i dang shar lhor ā+o/ /lho ru ṛ dang lho nub dzā/ /nub tu '-i dang nub byang lbo/ /byang du u dang byang shar u/ /de yi phyi rol 'khor lo ni/ /gsum pa'i 'dab ma bcu drug la/ /shar du e e shar lhor yang / /yi yo de bzhin sgo ru ni/ /ar ār ra rā bden bral gnyis/ /nub kyi gnyis la a ā la khā/ /nub byang la khā byang du o o/ /byang shar rtsibs gnyis waṃ waṃ'o/ /rim pa bzhi pa sum cu gnyis/ /shar gyi rtsibs la tsa sde lnga/ /lho'i rtsibs la ṭa sde lnga/ /nub kyi 'dab ma ta sde lnga/ /byang gi 25—241

'dab mar pa sde lnga/ /byang shar mtshams kyi 'dab gsum la/ /ka kha ga nga legs par dgod/ /shar lho mtshams su gha da k+ṣa/ /lho nub mtshams na na thāṣ+ṭa//nub byang mtshams na sha thā ha/ /de yi phyi rol 'dab ma ni/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi pa de la/ /phyogs bzhir bsgrub bya'i ming bzhi bri/ /shar gyi 'dab ma bcu gnyis la/ /ya yā yi yī yī yī drug /yu yu yī l+lī yo yo drug /de ltar bcu gnyis dgod par bya/ /de nas lho yi bcu gnyis la/ /ra rā ri rī ṛ dzā drug /ru rū dṛ dz+nyā re ra ste/ /de ltar bcu gnyis dgod par bya/ /nub kyi 'dab ma bcu gnyis la/ /la lā li lī z-i bye dang / /lu lu smṛ l+lī lo la drug /de ltar bcu gnyis dgod par bya/ /byang gi 'dab ma bcu gnyis la/ /wa wā byu shī dza spru dang / /wu lha smṛ ṭā waṃ wa drug /de ltar bcu gnyis legs par bris/ /phyogs kyi bsgrub bya'i ming bzhi dang / /lhan cig shar du ha bri ste/ /nub tu'ang ha ste byang du hūṃ/ /lho ru hāḥni tsheg drag can/ /hi tī shar stod g.yon skor du/ /j-i hṝ lho stod me mtshams su/ /dṛ d+dhā nub stod bden bral drug /hu ju byang stod rlung mtshams su/ /hūṃ ni shar du āḥni lhor/ /ho ni nub ste oṃ ni byang / /de ltar yi ge bzhi po yang / /bsgrub bya'i ming dang lhan cig tu'o/ /dbus kyi ming dang lhan cig tu/ /hūṃ gcig legs par bri bar bya/ /de yi phyi rol rim drug pa/ /'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis la/ /shar nas brtsams nas g.yon skor du/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi bzhi bzhi la/ /badz+ra tikyā zhes pa nas / /ya te na maḥzhes pa'i mthar/ /rim pa bzhin du g.yas skor du/ /yi ge bzhi bzhi dgod par bya/ /de yi phyi rol las kyi ni/ /dbye bas 'byung ba bzhi rnams kyi/ /yi ge ya ra waṃ la yis/ /bskor ba 'khrul 'khor 'khor lo ste//25—242

zhus nas bya grub 'khor lo'i mthar/ /spyi don bcu bzhi'i tshig grangs dang / /brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bdun mnyam/ /tshig gcig lhag pa lte bar brtag / tsho bstod pa'i rim par phye ba la/ /tshig rkang nyi shu tshigs bcad lnga/ /me long chos dbyings so sor rtog /mnyam nyid bya grub go rims bzhin/ /byang sems rdo rje'i 'khor lo la/ /tshigs bcad lnga po kun gyis bstod/ /lhag ma 'khor lo lnga la ni/ / sngar smos ye shes lnga dang ni/ /2 'dud kyi snatshigs bcad re re dang / /sbyar zhing so sor bstod par bya/ /rigs kun bsdus pa'i 'khor lo la/ /dang po'i sgo nas 4kun gyis bstod/ /lhag ma sgo rnams so so la/ /tshigs bcad ye shes bstun zhing bstod/ /gsang ba lus kyi 'khor lo la / /bstod pa dag dang ye shes su/ /sbyar te dang po 'dud bzhi'o/ /mchog gi dga' bzhi me long ngo / /lhag ma bzhi tshig bcu drug go/ /dga' ba bcu drug rim pa bzhin/ /chos dbyings kun rtog mnyam nyid dang / /bya grub rim rngogazhin 'dud bzhi bzhi/ /nang gi rgyas bshad 'dir ma byas/ /gsang ba'i phyir dang mdor basbus phyir/ /phan yon brjod pa'i gzhung tshad ni/ /brgya dang lnga bcur shes par bya/ /lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'chang / /zhes pa pos nas gsungs bdun la/ /dang po gnyis kyi 'khor lo ni/ /dang po yi ni phan yon bstan/ /lhag ma bzhi ni 'khor lo bzhi'i/ /rim pa bzhin du phan yon yin / /zhes pa rang la bsnyus phan yon/ /yang na klog sems la sogs so//gsang sngags rim par dbye ba yis/ /gzhung tshad tshigs bcad phyed dang bzhi / /de la dbye na rnam gnyis te/ /oṃ zhes pa nas saṃ aḥ'i tshomathar /rtsa ba'i sngags su shes par bya/ /pra kṛ ti nas a yi mthar/ /phreng ba'i sngags 25—243

zhes bya ba yin/ /snying po la sogs sngags kun la/ /thun mong ming ni rnam bzhi ste/ /mgo stimed mtha' med bsdus pa sprul/ /'di ni mtha' med ces bya yin / /sgu kun bskyed pa'i sngon du ni/ /bzlas dang rgyun du bzlas pa dang / /'khor lo dgod par bya ba dang / /bya ba thams cad 'dis byed de/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa kun byed phyir/ /bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa la/ /tshig rkang nyi shu tshigs bcad lnga/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi dri med shes rab sku/ /'jam dbyangs mtshan gsol zab cing rgya che ba/ /des lung mi 'gal bla mas man ngag rgyud/ /de la brten nas bdag don tsam brtsams te/ /bshad mdzad dgongs 'grel bdag gis 'gal ba med/ /nyes pa ci mthong bdag blo dpyad pa'i byerigs/ /bdag pas dman la phan pa 'ga' srid na/ /dge des 'gro kun mtshan mchog rtogs gyur cig/ //'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba khri drug stong pa ting nge 'dzin dra ba'i le'u las/'phags pa mtshan yang dag par brjod pa phan yon dang bcas pa'i bshad pa/nor bu'i gling du sku 3'khrungs pa dpal ldan byang chub mchog gi skal ba can/dpal sna tshogs gzugs kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ sngags don rnam par gzigs pa dang / de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i ④slob dpon chen po gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ nye bar bsdus pa'i rnam par rtog ge dang sbyar ba'i bsdus don mtshan gyi sgon ma zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //pradz+nyā gu rus mdzad do// //25—244

rnam par bsgom 1par bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' 'gro ba'i bla ma dang ldan pa spyan drangs te/ 'dud nyi shus bstod par bya'o/ /de nas sngags kyi phreng ba lan bdun du blangs te/ me tog gi mchod pas sangs rgyas kyi dbang bskur ba mi bzad 2pa gnang bas byen gyes brlabs pa'i sems mi g.yo bar bya'o/ /de nas yang ā lis sbyangs te/ 'od zer rnon po can dang ldan pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bya'o/ /de'i dkyil du sna tshogs pa'i pad+ma shes rab dang thabs yang dag par 'dus pa'i blo gros chen po ye shes kyis 4 mtshan pa'i sa bon las sngar gye bde bar gshegs pa bla ma dang ldan pa'i tshogs ji snyed pa bcug ste/ de dag las skyes pa'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' ni zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung las 5cung zhig 'gying ba/dkar ba dang sngo zhing dmar ba dang / dmar zhing dkar ba'i mdog can nyi ma dang / zla ba 6dang / ut+pal blo gros chen pos mtshan pa dang / zla ba dang /gzhu dang / ut+pal rtsa ba dang ldan pa ye shes chen pos mtshan pa'i phyag rgya can/khro ba dang zhi ba mnyam pa'i nyams mnga' ba/ rin po che'i rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs pas spras pa/ zla ba rgyas pa lta bu bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyis 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' 'am7/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo chen po spyan drangs te/ yang bstod nas rab tu gnas pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / byen gyis brlabs pa ni de nyid las yongs su rdzogs par bya'o / /de nas yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi —snang ba thob nas/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i bstod pa bya'o/ /de dag ni brjod pa'o/ /25—249

bstan na/ /pad+ma'i mdangs 'phro gnas las 1ldog /dam tshig gsum ni mig bzhin du/ /srung byed rin chen phyag rgya'i snod/ /de la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis yid la mos par 'gyur ba'i skyes bu des ni grub pa'i tshegs chung ngus bdag gis 4byed par 'gyur ro/ /de yang bsam gtan gyi khang par yid du 'ong ba'i ras ris 5kyi mdun du glegs bam rab tu gnas par byas te bzhag 7la/ de dang nye bar tsan+dan dkar pos byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal khru gang ba gru bzhi pa'i steng du me tog gi tshom bus mchod la/ tsan+dan gyi bdar bu dang / me tog dkar po snyim pa gang thogs te/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes sems dpa' chen po mchog nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan gyi 'khor lo thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//bdag gi / rnam par shes pa'i tshogs thams cad dang yang dag pa'i don gyi rnal 'byor du mdzad du gsol zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu brjod la/ me tog dkar po'i phreng ba mgo la bcings te/ tsan+dan sen rtse dang / til mar la bdar ba'i chu mig la byugs la/ rmi lam brtag pa'i ltas kyang shes par bya'o/ /de nas tho rangs ci rigs pa'i rnal 'byor du gnas te/ slob ma rtags dang rmi lam gyis shes par ཿyo byad kyis spras nas nye ba dang lha'i maṇ+ḍal dang / sems bskyed pa sarin po che'i phyag rgya'i yon phul te/ tshul dang mthun pa'i gnas la/oṃ kye kye kye ye shes sems dang zhi ba rab mdzes sku/ /khyod thugs bskyed pa 'gro la sman pa'i gtso/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgyas gti mug dral slomadzad cing / /me long lta bu'i mtshan bstod thugs chud ltar/ /sems bskyed la mos bde gshegs rigs 'gyur dag /'gro ba rnams kyi sku yi gdul bya'i phyir/ /bde 35—2bye/

gzhag 〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉bdag 8〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉ce/ 〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉chen / 9〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉gos/ 10〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉'phreng / 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉rtse/ te 〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉brtags/ 1 〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉rtag pa/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉pa'i/ kyi〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉pa'i/ 7〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉bul/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉stenas/255 〉〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉wagasum/ 2〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉dang / 0 〈〈pe 〉〉bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉pa'i bstan/ ④〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉sngaganyen po/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsams dang blo/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlab/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉'gyur—/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torathug po/ 〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉thug pos/ 〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉torathug pos/ she〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉rtse'i/ 7〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉smos/ 11〈〈pe 〉stonas bo〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉〉de/ 15〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o/256 ྅7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagacad/ zhe〈〈pe bskyar zlos 〉〉〈〈snar bskyar zlos 〉stanapa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (933)25wa 257

༄ / /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa sgong po mngon par rtogs pa jes bya ba/dzo༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañdzu shrī nā ma saṃ gī ti ṭī kā sru ra no pi ka nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa snying po mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs sogs dbang po'i yul las 'das pa yi/ /rnam dag 'dus ma byas pa'i chos kyi sku/ /dbang po'i gzhu 'dras sa lam rab grol zhing / /gzhon nu'i 'o mas bu ltar gso mdzad lha / /dam pa'i skyes mchog nges ston mdzad pa yi/ /zhabs kyi mtsho skyes gnas der spyis 4btud nas/ /tshig rgyas pa yi las rab bsdus pa'i don/ /dpag med 'byung gnas thabs mang ston pa'o/ /blo ni rmongs 'gyur rig pa'i gnas med kyang / /rje btsun drin gyes rgyud rnams kun gyi bcud/ /rtogs shing gsung rab la sogs gzhung gzhan yang / /mthong bas snying po'i mngon 25—258

rtogs bshad par bya/ /rgyud gzhan rim pa ma yin pa'i/ /'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /thig le bzhir 'gyur dgur bcas pa/ /mda' gnyis rab tu phye ba la/ /rim gnyis rab tu spyor ba ste/ /rgyud kyi rgyud nyid bshad kyis 1nyon/ /de la rgyud 'di ni rin po che lta bu yin te/ dbang po bzhi dang shin tu sbyor ba'i phyir ro/ /la la dag ni bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyud kho na'o zhes zer te/ de dag ni snying po la spyod pa'i gang zag ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa thams cad kyis dben zhing brtags pa'i rtog pa gang gis kyang ma gos par gcig pas du ma mi gnas kyis kyang gdul bya'i blo'i khyad par gyis du mar snang zhing rang rang gi rtog pa la bden par 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'ga' zhig tu/ /yi ge gcig kyang ma gsungs par/ /chos kyi char gyis tshim mdzad pa//sems can gzhug pa'i ched du gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de bas na kho bo ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'bras bu ni gtso bor ston to / /gzhan gyi rig pa ma yin pa'ang / /chos kyi dbyengs la dbyer me+ed phyir/ /gtso bos theg dbye ma mchis kyang / /gang gis theg pa gsum bstan pa/ /nga ni thabs la mkhas pa'i dngos/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ dman pa dang 'bring dang rab kyi khyad par gyis nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / theg pa chen po bstan pa yin no/ /rgyud du ston pa nyid du yang rigs te/ sngon du byung bas yang rgyud gcig nyid la du mar gzhag —pa nyid de/ de ltar yang rgyud gcig nyid la du mar go ba'o/ /de yang mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje dra ba'i gur las/ skyes bu bsdu 25—259

bar bya ba'i 1phyir/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyud bshad do/ /btsun mo bsdu bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud bshad do/ /dman pa las ni las kyi rgyud / /las kyi rnal 'byor de lhag la2/ /sems can mchog la lhag rnal 'byor / /bla med rnal 'byor de lhag la/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ rten la sogs pa'i khyad par du shes par bya'o/ /gleng gzhi bstan pa nyid kyis chog pa ma yin te/ sngar bzhin no/ /dbang po rab dang yang rab tu gyur pa la/ e waṃ ma ya shu ta sa ma ya e 4ka /zhes gsungs pa nyid kyis snying po la 'gro ba brtson par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad kyang ldan pa yin te/ /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong gi ni grangs snyed kyi/ /kun gyi gzhi dang pha ma ni/ /yi ge gnyis su yang dag bstan/ /yi ge e ni mar gyur la/ /waṃ 5ni pha zhes bya bar grags6/ /thig le de gnyis sbyor ba ste/ /sbyor de shin tu rmad du 'byung / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /thams cad du mi 'gyur ba ma yin te/ thabs dang shes rab 'dus byas pa'i spyor ba las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos gsungs par gyur to/ /de bas na skyes pa dang bud med gnyis spyor ba ni ma ning ste/ de 'jug pa'i khyad par gabyug pu pa lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin phyag rgya chen po brjod pa ni nges pa ste/ de bas na/ gcig pu thams cad mkhyen pa ste/ /kun du 'gro ba shin tu phra/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /gzhung gzhan gyis kyang shes par bya'o/ /de ltar don gyi rang bzhin gtan la phab nas/ tshig gi tshogs blo la rab tu spyor ba'i dgos pas don bsnyus nas bstan par bya ste/ de nas dpal ldan 25—260

rdo rje 'chang / /zhes pa nas/ yang dang yang du gsor byed pa/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gyes thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor bstan to/ /khro gnyer rim par 1ldan la sogs/ /zhes pa nas/ lus btud rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis thun mong gi 'khor bstan to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das / /zhes pa nas/ spyan sngar 'dug ste 'di skad gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod par brjod pa bstan to/ /khyab bdag bdag la sman pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ byang chub ci nas bdag thob mdzad / /ces pa'i bar gyis bdag gi don du gsol ba bstan to/ /nyon mongs pas ni sems dkrugs shing //zhes pa nas/ bla rnged 'bras bu thob bya'i bar gyis gzhan gyi don du gsol ba bstan to/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa nas/dbang po'i bsam pa mkhyen mchog gis/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis spangs pa dang ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas 4bstan to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes sgu//zhes pa nas/ glur blangs gang lags bshad du gsol/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gyis yang dag pa'i mtshan gyi don gsol ba bstan to/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyi/ /zhes pa nas/ sems can rnams la bshad par 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i don gyi 7gsol ba'o/ /de dag ni gleng gzhi'i don gleng bslang ba dang 'byel bar bstan pa ste 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'o / / gsang dbang lag na rdo rje yis/ /zhes pa nas/lus 9btud nas ni spyan sngar 'dug /ces pa rgyud nyan pa la gus pa'i sbyor ba bstan to/ /de nas bcom ldan shākya thub/ /ces pa nas/ spyong bar byed pa'i 'dzum bstan nas/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis ljags byen gyis brlabs —pa 25—261

bdud mthar byed pa'i spyor ba bstan to/ /tshangs pa'i gsung ni snyan pa yis//zhes pa nas/ legs so dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /zhes pa'i bar gyis tshangs pa'i gsung gi 1'khor la ched du brjod pa bstan to/ /lag na rdo rje khyod legs so/ /zhes pa nas/ khyod ni rtse gcig yid kyis nyon/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis nyan pa po thos pa dang sbyar bar bstan to/ /rkang pa ya gcig gis mtshams sbyar bar bstan to2/ /'di dag ni spyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan shākya thub/ /ces pa nas/ rigs chen gtsug tor cher gzigs nas/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rigs la gzigs pa bstan to/ /tshig gi bdag pos tshigs su bcad/ /ces pa nas/ sde tshan bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i mthas 4byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin bstan cing bshad do/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa nas/ tshig kun rab tu gsal bar byed/ /ces pa'i bar gyis chos thams cad yi ge gcig gi lus la gnas par bstan to/ /mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che/ /zhes pa nas/ chags pa thams cad sel bar byed/ /ces pa'i bar gyis nyon mongs pa dang rigs rnam par dag pa'i mchod pa bstan to/ /'dod pa chen po bde ba che/ /zhes pa nas/ sgyu 'phrul chen po mig 'phrul che/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis khams dang che ba bcu drug gi rnam dag 5bstan to/ /sbyin bdag chen po gtso bo che/ /zhes pa nas/ bsam pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rnam shes tshogs dang lha mo'i rnam dag bstan to/ /byams chen rang bzhin dpag tu med/ /ces pa nas/ theg pa chen po'i tshul gyi 6mchog /ces pa'i bar gyis sa dang bskal bzang 7bcu drug gi rnam dag bstan tor/ /de dag ni rdo rje 25—262

dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i rnam dag de kho na nyid kyi snying po bstan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /zhes pa nas/ gsang sngags tshul chen bdag nyid can/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin bstan to/ /pha rol phyin bcu thob pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis lam gyi yon tan rdzogs par 1bstod pa bstan to/ /thog ma med pa spros sked bdag /ces pa nas/ yang dag mtha' la rnam par gnas/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis thugs kyi byen rlabs la bstod pa bstan to/ /bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ /zhes pa nas/ 'khor los sgyur ba stobs po che /zhes pa'i bar gyis gsung gi byin rlabs la bstod pa bstan to/ /tshogs kyi slob dpon tshogs kyi bdag /ces pa nas/ tshul chen gzhan gyi dreng mi 'jog /ces pa'i bar gyis sku'i byen rlabs la bstod pa bstan to / /tshig rje tshig bdag smra mkhas pa/ /zhes pa nas/ bden pa bzhi ni ston pa po/ /zhes pa'i bar gyes 'gro ba'i 'dren ston du gyur pa bstan to/ /phyir mi ldog pa phyir mi 'ong / /zhes pa nas/ bde gshegs 'jig rten rig pa'i mchog /ces pa'i bar gyis theg pa gsum gyi lus ye shes su bstan to/ /bdag gir mi 'dzin ngar mi 'dzin/ /zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten snang bar byed pa'i mchog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i ye shes bstan to/ /chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal/ /zhes pa nas/ bsam gtan bsam bya blo ldan bdag /ces pa'i bar gyes de thams cad rnal 'byor gyi 4ye shes kyi bdag nyid du bstan to/ /so so rang rig mi g.yo ba/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas sras po dam pa'i mchog /ces pa'i bar gyis rang rig tu gzhi gcig par 25—263

bstan to/ /shes pa srid 'byung skye gnas med/ /ces pa nas/ gzi brjid chen po 'od gsal ba/ /zhes pa'i bar gyes de nyid la rnyog 1pa bcus ma gos par bstan to/ /sngags mchog mnga' bdag rig sngags rgyal/ /zhes pa nas/drang srong che dgus mchod cing rjed / /ces pa'i bar kyis sku'i 'khor lo bstan to/ /rigs gsum 'chang ba gsang sngags 'chang / /zhes pa nas/jeg pa mchog gsum ston pa po/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo bstan to / /don yod zhags pa rnam par rgyal/ /zhes pa nas/ rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rigs kyi 'khor lo bstan to/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /ces pa nas/ sgra dang ldan pa rnams kyi 4mchog /ces pa'i bar gyis me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo 5bstan to/ /yang dag bdag med la sogs pa'i rkang pa gnyis kyis don gyi 6rgyud la bstod pa bston7to / /stong nyid smra ba'i khyung 8mchog ste/ /zhes pa nas/ chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi 9sgra bo che/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis tshig gi rgyud bstan to/ /mi gnas pa la sogs pa rkang pa gnyis kyis rab tu byed pa'i rgyud bstan to/ /gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ gzugs rnams ma lus 'chang ba po / /zhes pa'i bar gyis bde ba chen po'i rgyud bstan to/ /mtshungs pa med cing che bar grags/ /zhes pa nas/ dar ba chen po chos kyi tog— /ces pa'i bar gyis bsam kyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud bstan to/ /'jig rten gsum na gzhon lus gcig /ces pa nas/ snyu rta gu 'jig rten gsum na mdzes/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis 'bras bu'i rgyud bstan to/ /'jig rten shes legs slob dpon te/ /zhes pa nas/ skyabs dang skyob pa bla na med/ /ces pa'i bar 25—264

gyis thabs kyi rgyud bstan to/ /nam mkha'i mtha' la longs spyod pa/ /zhes pa nas / 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho pha rol phyin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis thabs ye shes sems dpa'i rgyud bstan to/ /ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can/ /zhes pa nas / gsum sel mtha' yas grol gsum thob/ /ces pa'i bar gyis dri ma rnam par dag pa'i rgyud bstan to/ /sgrib pa kun las nges par grol/ /zhes pa nas/ lus kun las ni rnam par gnas/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bya ba dang 1bral ba'i rgyud bstan to/ /nam mkha'i mtha' la rab gnas pa/ /zhes pa nas/yon tan ldan zhing yon tan shes/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa bstan to/ /chos shes bkra shis bkra shis 'byung / /zhes pa nas/bkur ste rim gro phun sum tshogs/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gyis rang don bkra shis rgyud las skye bar bstan to/ /mchog tu dga' ba grags bdag dpal/ /zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten sgra ste rab kyi mchog /ces bya ba'i bar gyis rang bzhin brtags pas dbe+en pa bstan to/ /'jigs pa ma lus sel ba po /zhes pa nas/ gdong lnga gtsug phud lnga dang ldan/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis tha mar dge ba phyag rgya chen por bstan to/ /zur phud lnga pa me tog thod/ /ces pa nas / dka' thub mthar phyin dka' thub che/ /zhes pa'i bar gyes bar du dge ba chos kyi phyag rgya bstan to/ /gtsang gnas dam pa go ta ma/ /zhes pa nas / grol ba thar pa rnam grol lus/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis tha mar dge ba las kyi phyag rgya bstan to/ /rnam grol zhi ba zhi ba nyid/ /ces pa nas/ ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gyis bde ba chen po'i lus lhan cig skyes pa bstan to/ /tshig gi dbang phyug smra ba che/ /zhes pa nas/25—265

smra ba'i 1seng ge tshugs pa med/ /ces bya ba'i bar gyis tshig la mi gnas pa'i tshig gi gnas su bstan to/ /kun du dga' ba mchog tu dga'/ /zhes pa nas/lag na 'od 'bar snang ba bo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis sku dang ye shes la sogs pa'i snang ba bstan to/ /sman pa che mchog gtso bo ste/ /zhes pa nas/ nad do cog gi dgra 2che ba/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis 'gro ba la sman par snang ba bstan to / /sbu gu 'jig rten gsum gyi mchog /ces pa nas/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzugs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis chos kyi thurgyal mtshan du snang ba bstan to/ /'gro na gdugs gcig yangs pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa gcig /ces pa'i bar gyis rim pa gnyis su snang ba 5bstan to/ /rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur dpal/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung yang yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rigs su snang ba bstan 6to//rdo rje'i nyi ma nas rkang pa gnyis kyis bklag pa'i thabs dang mi gnas pa bstan to//chags bral la sogs chags pa che/ /zhes pa nas/ yi ge mchog ste rnam par dag /ces pa'i bar gyis lam gyi 7ye shes lhun gyis grub pa bstan to/ /jeg pa chen po sbug bsngal gcod/ /ces pa nas/ rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /ces pa'i bar gyis ye shes lhun gyis grub pa bstan to/ /rdo rje gdan ni ma lus ldan / /zhes pa nas/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang / /zhes pa'i bar gyis gsang don lhun gyis grub pa bstan to/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /ces pa nas/ ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis ye shes lhun gyis grub pa bstan to/ /'dod pa'i don grub dam pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ sems can thams cad rab grol byed/ /ces pa'i bar gyis mnyam 25—266

pa nyid kyi snaye shes mdor bstan to/ /nyon mongs g.yul du gcig dpa' ba/ /zhes pa nas/ tshangs pa'i g.yul sa rtse nas gnon/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis las kyi phyag rgya bstan to/ /don gcig gnyis med chos kyi don/ /zhes pa nas/nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis dpe don gyi 'byel ba bstan to/ /sen mo'i 'od ni shas cher dmar/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyud dang ldan/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis mtshan dpe bstan to/ /'jig rten khams brgya kun bskyod pa/ /zhes pa nas/ nges par 'byung ba kun ston pa/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis thun mong gi lam rdzogs par bstan to/ /yan lag bcu gnyis srid rtsa bton/ /zhes pa nas/ bye ba dpag med 'gyed pa po/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa bstan to/ /skad cig thams cad mngon par rtogs/ /zhes pa nas/ jeg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis skad cig gi 2ye shes bstan to/ /nyon mongs khams rnams dag pa'i bdag /ces pa nas/ spyor ba'i dgon pa las byung ba/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gyis gsang sngags mtha'i don du bstan to/ /nyon mongs pa la sogs pa rkang pa gnyis kyis 'khor ba'i sa bon dang bral bar bstan to / /snying rje chen po shes rab thabs/ /zhes pa nas/ nor ba thams cad rnam par spangs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gzhan don mdzad pa bstan to/ /don gsum the tshom med pa'i blo/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'chang / /zhes pa'i bar gyes de nyid kyi 'thad pa bstan to/ /lus med lus te lus kyi mchog /ces pa nas/ nor bu chen po rin chen tog /ces pa'i bar gyis ye shes kyi lus kyi mdzad pa bstan to/ /sangs rgyas la sogs pa rkang 25—267

pa gnyis kyis 1bya ba nan tan kyi ye shes mdor bstan to/ /gsang sngags las byung yi ge med/ /ces pa nas/ thig le stong pa yi ge brgya/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis yi ge thams cad tshogs gcig pa'i stong par bstan to/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /ces pa nas/ bsam gtan bzhi yi rtse mo can/ /zhes pa'i bar kyis e waṃ gyis dbugs dbyung ba bstan to/ /bsam gtan yan lag kun shes shing / /zhes pa nas/ phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /ces pa'i bar gyis sgu gsum du bstan to/ /de bzhin 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /zhes pa nas/ srid pa'i dgon pa las brgal ba/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis 'gro ba gsum gyi gtso bor snang ba bstan to/ /ston pa gcig pu 4'gro ba'i bla/ /zhes pa nas/ bdud kyi dpung rnams pham byed pa/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bdud pham par byed pa bstan to/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dren/ /zhes pa nas/ phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bsten bkur gyi gnas su bstan to/ /'jig rten gsum po gom gcig bgrod/ /ces pa nas/ shes dang shes bya'i bdag po mchog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sprul pa mnga' bar bstan to/ /gtso bo chos kyi sbyin bdag ste/ /zhes pa nas/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /ces pa'i bar gyis mjug basbu ba bstan te5/ de dag gis ni byang chub kyi sems rdo rje zhes bya ba'i snang ba ye shes lngar bstod pa'o/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /ces pa nas/ yi ge re re zhing 6chos kyi dbyings la sogs pa la bstod pa bstan to/ /rigs kyi bdag po nas bzung ste/an+tasba 7dang / uthra ṣa'i gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa'i bar gyis ye shes sngags 25—268

kyi 1rang bzhin du bstan to/ /rigs kyi bdag po nas bcu drug pa'i bar gyis de yang 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sngags kyi rang bzhin du bstan te /de dag ni don gyi snying po yon tan bsnyus pa'i don gyi bstod pa'o/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /zhes pa nas/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal nas / /zhes pa'i bar gyis 'khor gyi mchod pa brjod par bstan to/ /de ni mgon po gsang ba'i bdag /ces pa nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis bshad/ /ces pa'i bar gyis ched du brjod pa'i bstod pa bstan to/ /de dag ni ye shes kyi rjes su mthun pa'o/ /mtshan nas rjod 4pa'i yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa ni sgo lnga'i khyad par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar bsdus pa'i don yongs su shes shing / don lhag par rnyed 5pa'i gang zag gis rgyud kyi rab tu byed pa'i don 'di nyid kyang bde blag tu rnyed par 'gyur ro / /6da ni tshig gi don gsal bar dbye bar bya ste/ de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa la mchog dang thun mong gi 7dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas mtshon pa la gang nas she na/ man+t+ra'i rang bzhin shes shing skyob pa'o/ /des spangs pa dang ye shes phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang ngo / /gdul dka' ba ni theg pa gsum ste/sprul pa dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'dul ba rnams so/ /kyi zhes pa ni drug pa'i don gyi gnyis pa'o/ /'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug rnam par dag pa ni theg pa'i yang rnam par dag pa ste/ bde ba dang / stong pa dang / gnyis su med pas na 25—269

mchog go/ /dpa' bo ni 'jigs shing thub pa med pa ste sku dang / gsung dang thugs kyi khyad par gyis sa 'og dang sa steng dang / sa bla las rgyal ba'o/ /rdo rje ni stong pa nyid bde ba chen po'i snying po can te/ gang la yod pa ni 1dbang phyug go/ /de lnga'i gsang ba las thob pa ni rgyal po'o/ /pad+ma dkar po ni dkar ba la sogs pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa ste/ 'dir rnam par rtog pa zhi ba la sogs pa dang ldan pa'o/ /ye shes la ched du brjod pa ni rang las te/'gro ba 'dzin pa'i don gyis na yang zhes sbyar ro/ /khro gnyer dang sku dang /og spu ser la badze+es pa dang / mig dmar dang / lce 'dril zhing ya sos ma mchu mnan pa dang / thung zhing gel ba dang / gsus pa che ba dang / yan lag rab tu bgrad pa dang / nying lag rdo rje rtse mo lta bu dang / dur khrod dang /gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / mtshon cha 'bar zhing 'phro ba dang /mgo bo'i do shal dang / me 'bar ba'i gnas ni rim par ldan pa la sogs pa ste/lag na rdo rje dang mtshungs par mtha' yas pa la yod pa ni ma rig pa la sogs pa rten cing 'byel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis zad pa'i don to/ /de snyed 4kyi ba spu'i khyang nas 'phro ba yang rdo rje rtse mo ste khro bo'i gzugs so/ /rang gi lag gis gsor bar byed pa ni snga ma bzhin te/ de'i don kyang snying rje chen po dang shes rab dang zhes pa'o/ /thabs ni sngon rang gi don du gyur pa ji ltar de nyid kyis gzhan don du 'gyur ba'o/ /de ltar sprul pa dang yang sprul gyi gzugs thams cad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi rang bzhin lus ngag yid gsum gyis 5mchod pa'i phyir/ dga' mgu 6rangs pa'i bsam pa can no/ /khro bo 'ba' zhig mi rigs pa ma yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin 7las sems can gyi mgon 25—270

—du gyur pas so/ /de dang lhan cig pa ni phyag na rdo rje'o/ /thams cad bsam pa mthun par zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni de bzhin nyid snang ba med pa'i ye shes thugs su chud nas 'gro ba'i don la gshegs pas so/ /shes rab kyis bcom pa nyid kyi phyir dang / dbang phyug la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas mi gnas pa brnyes pas na bcom ldan 'das so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba'i sgra ni byang chub sems dpa' la yang gsungs shing bshad pa ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i yon tan ni bde ba chen po 1snathob pa 'ba' zhig la'o/ /khyab bdag ni yongs su dag pa'i ye shes thams cad la khyab pa'i bdag nyid do/ /yang na sems can thams cad kyi snying por gnas pa dang / chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba'i byed pa po nyid kyis 'gro ba bzhi'i dbang po la khyab pa'i bdag nyid do/ /bdag ni bdag nyid kho na'o/ /sman pa ni tshig dang / don dang spobs pa'i gzungs 2kyis so/ /bdag don ni mthar thug pa'i don to/ /phyir ni dgos pa'o/ /thabs khyad par can gye sgyu ma dang 'phrul gyi rnam ‘/ lta bu ste/ nang gi rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i spyor bar —bde ba chen po'i dra bas kun la g.yogs 4par bya ba nyid kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gyur bar ro/ /ci nas zhes pa ni/ nan tan du bya ba'i tha tshig go / /theg pa chen por 'gyur ba nyid yin te/ dper na sa bon gyi ma gtogs par myu gu la sogs pa'i yon tan 'byen par ga la nus/ de bas na/ma rdzogs rdzogs 5byed mda' yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rgyu'i gnas skabs kyi 6thabs kyi sbyor ba la yang bkag na/ phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras 25—27

bu'i phyir lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dang por nang gi bdag nyid la bzhag cing sbyar bar bya ba'i phyir/ sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /rgyal bas kyang ni ma gsungs na/ /bdag 'dra ngan pa smos ci dgos/ /de bas 'jig rten bsam pa btang / /zhes gsungs pa'i don kyang de'o/ /rgyu 'bras rjes su mi mthun pa ma 1yin te/ byams pa dang snying rje sngon du song ba'i byang chub kyi sems smon pa dang 'jug pa dang / shin tu 'jug pa la sogs pas sems can gyi don gyi phyir nang du gzhag 4pa'o/ /de bas na rnam par rtog pa gang gang gis/ gang gang blo ni bsgoms pa dang / /bsgoms 5pa'i stobs ni rdzogs pa dang / /bde gsal mi rtog blo 'bras can/ /zhes pas kyang shes par bya'o/ /nyon mongs pa ni thams cad rang bzhin dngos po dang / dngos po med pa dang / btang snyoms kyi rnyog pas sems dkrugs pa'o/ /mi shes pa ni brgyud 6pa'i gzhung lugs dang bral bas don ma phrad de smig rgyu la chur bzung bas dal zhing gdungs pa bzhin/ 'dir yang brtags pa'i rnyog pa'i 'dam du bying bar gyur pa rnams so/ /sman pa ni gzhan 7shes rab gsum la sbyar ro/ /nang gi bdag nyid la 'jug pa'i dgos pas na phyir ro/ /bla ni 'bras bu ster ba'i don gyis so/ /ston pa ni log rtog bzlog pa'o/ /dam tshig ni sdom pa ste/bde ba dang stong pa'i dra ba phyed pa de nyid ji lta ba mkhyen cing thugs su chud pa'o//de nyid kyi phyir sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni/ e waṃ las ni rab tu zhugs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dbang po gdul bya'i rgyud mkhyen pa'o/ /bsam pa ni gdul bya'i 'dod pa mkhyen pa'o/ /de dag ni gnas su gyur pas mchog go/ /gis 9ni drug pa'i don gyi gnyis pa'o/ /ye shes sku ni ye shes phung po can te 25—272

bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyis rtag pa nyid rtag tu 'byung ba'o/ /de bas na/gang gis nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang gis nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log par rtog pa spang ba 1ste/ /skye bo de yis nga mi mthong / /sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi sku/ /'dren pa rnams kyi chos nyid ni/ /de ni rnam par shes mi nus/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gtsug tor ni bltar mi mngon pa ste/ de nyid zil gyis mi non pa'i rtags yin pas na gtsug tor chen po'o/ /tshig gis rjod par snabyed pa ste/ mi zad pa'i gsung mnga' bas bdag po'o/ /ye shes ni mtha' dang bral ba ste mi 'gyur bas na sku'o/ /de'i mtshan nyid ni rang 'byung ba ste / 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan gyi don brjod pa'o/ /'byel pa gcig pas mchog go/ /don zab pa ni rtogs par dka' ba'o/ /don rgya che ba ni blo'i yul ma yin pas so/ /don chen po ni rang gzhan grub pas so/ /mtshungs pa med pa ni gcig pur gyur pas so/ /zhi ba ni glo bur kyi dri ma dang bral bas so/ /dge ba gsum ni skye ba dang / gnas pa dang / 'gag pas nadaben pa'o/ /yang na lus dang ngag dang / yid gsum las 'byung ba gsum mo / /yang na dus gsum du gsungs pa dang / gsung bar 'gyur ba dang gsung ba'o/ /de nyid ni yang dag pa'i shes par sgrub par byed par yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyud ni tshig dang don to/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu chen po ste/de rab tu rgyas par gsal bar byed pas tshig la yang ngo / /thabs kyi rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba 4mtshon pas btags pa ste/ lha sbyin zhang po can zhes bya ba lta bu'o/ /las ni skal ba'i rgyud de gong du bstan zin to/ /rdo rje 'chang chen ni grags chen la/ gsang sngags 'chang ni snying po don gyi sangs rgyas so/ /ji snyed pa 25—273

—ni dpag med rnams kyis so/ /dgyes bzhin du glur blangs pa bshad du gsol zhes pa ni nges pa'i don to/ /gsang 'dzin ni rgyud 'di nyid sngar bshad pa'i don yang ngo / /phyir ni gtso bor gyur pa gzhan med pa'o/ /nges pa ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ der ma byung gi bar la snye4'byung gi bar zhes bya'o/ /gzung ba ni bdag don du'o/ /gsang ba spang ba ni gzhan gyi don gyi phyir ro/ /bsam pa'i khyad par ni dbang po'i bye brag la'o/ /bshad par 'tshal ba ni de kho na nyid bcu dang / rim pa gnyis dang zung du 'jug pa'o/ /gsang dbang ni dug bcom pa'i de nyid la dbang ba'i lag na rdo rjes so/ /de skad du zhes pa ni lnga'i gsol ba gdab bo/ /spyod lam ni gus pa'i rtags so/ /de nas de ma thag tu'o/ /rigs dang stobs mtshon pas shākya thub pa'o/ /rkang gnyis ni lha dang mi'i ste/ de'i mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /bzang ba dang / kha dog dang dbyibs phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /ring zhing yangs pa ni chu dang zheng ngo //brkyang ba dang / 'od phyung ba dang / 'dzum pa bstan pa'i bdud btul ba dang / 'khor bag dang ldan pa la dgod pa dang / thugs rje chen pos sems can gyi yid dang mthun par bstan pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs ni yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa ste/ 'dir snyan pa dang / che ba dang gsal ba dang /don go bar nus par 'dus pa ston pa'o/ /bkang ba ni grags pa'o/ /gsang ba ni gsang ba chen po la'o/ /slar gsungs pa ni zhus pa'i lan no/ /snying rje chen po ni thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /dag par byed pa ni nyon mongs pa dag par byed pa ste/ bkra shis par ro/ /sdig sel ba ni rdul dang bral ba'o/ /brtson pa ni ma yengs par rtse gcig pa'o/ /rang don nyid kyis 25—27

legs so zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pas gzhan don gzung rtaba'o/ /legs par bstan pa ni 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i lam du'o/ /nyon zhes pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin du blta ba dang rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di nyid yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches brtan pa ltar blta ba dang / thun mong gi 'khor rin po che lta bu'i gang zag tu blta ba dang / bshad bya sems kyi rang bzhin shes rab dang snying rje dbyer mi phyed par blta ba dang / gsung dri ma med pa'i bdud rtsis dbang po tshim 4zhing khyab par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gsang sngags ni 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dum bu lha'i 'khor lo ste/ snying po dang / phyag rgya dang /rig sngags rnams la thams cad ces bya'o/ /de dag ni rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i lha'i 'khor lo gzung ngo / /de nyid kyi rigs shes par yang bya'o/ /rigs chen ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i rang bzhin lnga pa 5dang drug pa'o/ /kho bo ni rigs 'pho bar 'dod pa ste/ dam pa'i zhal las 'ongs pa ni rgyas gdab gsum gye 6ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir te mdor bstan pa'o/ /gsang sngags rig sngags 'chang ba'i rigs/ /zhes pa ni gsang sngags la sogs pa ni rig sngags kyi las byed cing / don bsgrubs 7na 'chang ba ste las kyi rigs so//yang na thams cad shes rab kyi rtags su shes par byas la/ des de la nan tan du byas pas de 'grub ces pa'o/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs ni rigs gsum ste/la ni de nyid gzhir byas pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la ni/ /zhes bya ba la rnam par gzigs pa ni sku'o/ /'jig rten ni log pa'i shes pas brtags pa'i 'khor ba ste/ de nyid rang gi ngo bo rnam par dag pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rang bzhin la/ 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pas na pad+ma'i 25—275
