1017༄༅/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañdzu shrī nā ma sadhī ti lnga dha na nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs / 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan ye shes mchog gi mchog gyur pa'i/ /bde ba'i stobs kyis bde ba'i ro myang ba'i/ /rang gi rgyud gsum dag pa'i 'jam dpal de la 'dud/ /'jam dpal mtshan ni brjod pa yi/ /gzhung lugs thob par gyur pa yi/ /yongs bsnyus sgrub thabs gsal bar bsdeb / /de'i gzhung bdag gis bshad par bya/ /shes rab snying rjer ldan pa yi/ /zab mo'i don la dgongs pa yis/ /theg chen sngags pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /yid dga' ba yi gnas nyid du/ /bde ba'i stan la nyer 'dug ste/ /snying gar nyi dkyil a bsams la/ /'od phyung 'phags pa bla mar bcas/ /yid kyis 4mdun du spyan drangs la/ /maṇ+ḍal 25—40/

mchod pa phul byas la/ /gsum la skyabs su gsol ba dang / /sdig pa ma lus bshags pa dang / /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /de yang rgyud las/dpal ldan pad+ma sangs rgyas skyes/ /tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa po/ /rtag pa kun rgyal rnal 'byor can/ /bsam gtan bsam bya blo ldan mchog /rdo rje dregs pa rdo rje'i snying / /rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che/ /rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /'phags lam shin tu mtho la gnas/ /bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog /sems can kun gyi yid ltar mgyogs1/ /dkyil 'khor chen po yangs pa yin/ /mchod cing brjod pa drang srong che/ /gtso bo dkon mchog gsum 'dzin pa/ /dag par byed pa sdig sel ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas skad cig ma la bdag nyid 'jam dpal du bsgoms la/de'i thugs ka nas a las/ rdo rje shugs can 'jigs par byed/ /ha la ha la gdong brgya pa/ /dpal ldan lag pa brgyas gang la/ /brdung 2ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed pa'o/ /oṃ mañdzu shrī kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ ste ro ha na ra da ha ra/ pa tsa ra sarba a mu ka badz+ra khaṅga ts+tsha da rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod pas mtshon cha dpag tu med pas mtshams bcad do/ /de nas oṃ shu n+ya tā 4dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3haṃ 5 zhes brjod pas na shistong par bsam/ snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i/ /'byung paṃlnga'i yi ge rang bzhin chad / /e/ yi/ baṃ/ re lo/ nam mkha' rlung chu ri rab me dang bcas/ /de steng pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /rja las ye shes gzhal yas khang / /pho brang pad+ma 'khor lor bcas/ /gru chad sgo bzhi mu 25—402

khyud ldan/ /rgyud las/ stong pa nyid dga' 'dod chags blo/ /rdo rje snying po mkha' 'dra ba/ /phra zhing zag med sa bon bral/ /'byung ba chen po rgyu gcig po / /dkyil 'khor chen po yangs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs1/ de nas gdan sgom ste/ paṃ las pad+ma zla ba'i gdan/ /a dang ma las nyi ma'i gdan/ /de steng a yi 'phro 'du las/ /a las 'jam dbyangs rdo rjer gyur/ /sku mdog dmar ser gdong lnga pa/ /dkar sngo dmar ljang dmar ser ro/ /zur phud lnga ldan cod pan can/ /me tog rin chen phreng bas brgyan/ /phyag brgyad rim par bsnams pa ni/ /ral gri mda' dang lcags kyu rdo rje g.yas/ /po ti gzhu dang zhags pa pad+ma g.yon/ /gzhon nu mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /kha dog lnga ldan 'od kyi dbus/ /rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs pa la/ /thugs kar shes rab 'khor lo'i dbus/ /nyi ma'i steng na ral gri a yis mtshan/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs la gsang sngags dgod/ /yang na gnas bzhir 'khor lo bsam de ltar bsam gtan ting 'dzin dben/ /de yang rgyud las/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che/ /rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /gzugs che lus kyang che ba ste/ /gdong lnga zur phud lnga dang ldan/ /zur phud lnga pa me tog spos/ /lag pa brgya po kun bskyod cing / /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs/ /rdo rje be+egs kyu zhags pa che/ /rdo rje las skyes rdo rje'i bdag /dpal ldan pad+ma gar gye bdag /'jig rten gsum na gzhon lus gcig /kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang / /nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes/ /gsang sngags chen po rigs gsum pa/ /25—403

zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas de yi thugs ka ru/ /oṃ las gyur pa'i rnam par snang mdzad ni/ /sku mdog dkar ba'i rang bzhin la/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /dang po ral gri po ti'o/ /tha ma byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya'o/ /sangs rgyas de yi thugs ka ru/ /ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang pa / /sku mdog dmar ser gser mdog la/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu bsnams / /sangs rgyas de yi mdun nyid du/ /pad+ma'i gdan la shāka thub bsgom / /pho brang pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /shar du hūṃ las gyur pa'i rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ /sku mdog sngo skya'i rang bzhin la/ /dang po gnyis ni po ti ral gri bsnams / /tha ma gsang ba sa gnon la/ /g.yon pa mnyam gzhag rdo rje bsnams / /lho ru ṭ+wā 1las rin chen 'byung ldan ni/ /ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas g.yon kun gyi dang po 'gre lte/ /tha ma mchog sbyin rin po che / /nub tu dhīḥlas snang ba mtha' yas ni/ /dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /mnyam gzhag phyag rgya pad+ma bsnams/ /byang du hā las gyur pa'i don yod grub pa ni/ /ljang gu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /khu tshur phyag na rgya gram bsnams/ /kun la rin chen sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum byin gyis brlab/ /zhabs ni rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs/ /phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ /ā li yongs su gyur pa las/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan stengs su/ /yab kyi thugs kar rī.a yi 'phro 'du las/ /i yī u u/e e o au 'phros/ dbyangs yig 'od du zhu ba las/ /chos 'khor rim bzhin bskor bar 5bya/ /kun du bzang po nam mkha'i snying po dang / /'jam dpal sa yi snying po dang / /spyan ras gzigs dang sgrib pa sel/ /phyag na rdo 25— 7/04

rje byams pa'o/ /'khor lo pi wang ut+pa la/ /dung phor pad+ma rin chen dang / /myu gu rdo rje bum pa'o/ /g.yon pa thams cad mchog sbyin no/ /rin chen phreng ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /gdan la bzhugs shing 'gyings pa'i 1tshul/ /rgyud las / gsang sngags tshul chen las byung ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rnam shes brgyad po rtog 2pa 'chang / /kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /dpal ldan blo dang sgeg par ldan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /phyogs kyi sgo bzhir bsgom pa ni/ /gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'phro 'du las/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbazhi 'phros pas/ /'od zhu 'phros shing 'dus pa las/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgog dril/ /sgu mdog rang rang phyogs dang mthun/ /rgyud las/rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che/ /'dzin pa chen po rdo rje'i zhags/ /'jam dbyangs chen po sgra che ba/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas thugs ka'i sa bon a las 'od 'phros ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ a ā sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta a sgyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hūṃ hi tai oṃ/zhes dbang bsgur bar bya/ rgyud las/ sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med/ /ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas snying po bzlas par 4bya/ /thugs ka'i 5shes rab 'khor lo la/ /de dbus lte ba'i 'khor lo la / /sngags phreng 6me tog dkyus pa ltar/ /de la dmigs te bzlas par bya/ /oṃ wā 7gī shwa ri sum̐/ oṃ badz+ra tīṣ+ṭha duḥkha ts+tsha da/ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta ye/ dz+nyā na kā ya wā gī shwa ra a ra pa tsa na ya te na maḥ.a ā sarba 1 ta thā ga ta j-i da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ s+thā bha ga bān/ dz+nyā na rūrti/ wā gī shwa ra/ ma hā pā tsa/sarba dharmā ga ga na/ a ma la su pa ri shud+dhā sadhan+d+ra dh+wa tu dz+nyā na gar+bha a / de yang 25—405

rgyud las/ 'od bzang 1'bar ba dpal gyi be'u/ /'od chen rnam par snang bar byed/ /gzi brjid phreng ba blta na sdug /gsang sngags chen po rigs gsum pa/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de nas mchod pa rgyas pa dbul/ /a ā sarba 3ta thā ga ta dhū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ pu྾/ a zu lo ke gabye/ nai bi h+ye/ shak+ta④/ rgyud las/ mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che / /sems can thams cad dga' bar byed/ /ces pa la sogs pa dug lnga rang grol gyi mchod pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra gī ti hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ 5bye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā le hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra lā gye hri/ de yang rgyud las/ mchod cing brjod par 6drang srong che/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas/ /zhes pas bstod de/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /gdong lnga zur phud lnga dang ldan/ /lag pa brgya pos kun bskyod cing / /sprul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang / /gom pa'i stobs 7kyis gar byed pa/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ /rnam snang gtso la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rigs lnga la 'dud kyi bstod pa bya'o/ /'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /ming ni yang dag brjod pa mchog /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgon mes rab gsal zhing / /'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /nyid kyi 'dab bzang 9tshogs kyis ni/ /zla ba rgyas pa zil gnon cing / /rig pa rnam par gsal bsgyur la/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ma bgyis zur phud gsal ba la/ /nor bu 'bar ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /nyid ni 25byed406

kun du dga' ba'i sgu/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdud rtsi 'dra zhing 'jam la zab/ /yid dang gsung gi sgra sgogs pa/ /dam pa'i snachos kyi rin chen mdzod/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gangs kyi chu ltar gdangs gsal ba/ /'jig rten khams na rnam par bzhugs/ /nyon mongs dri ma rab spangs pa/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /mche ba gcigs dang bsgyings pa yi2/ /'jigs pa'i sku yi tshul gyes ni/ /ya ma'i dregs pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rang gi spyan dang mdangs 'dra ba/ /ut+pal sngon pos rab mdzes pa/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /rgya cher bstod pas 4rab bstod pa/ /'gro ba'i lam ni ston pa po/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /de nas sems dpa' brgyad la bstod de5/ mkhas pa chen po thabs che ba /mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul chen po 'chang / /'jig rten khams brgya kun bskyod pa/ /kun du bzang po khyod la 'dud/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs chen ldan/ /nam mkha'i bdag po sna tshogs ston/ /nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ /nam mkha'i snying po khyod la 'dud/ /shes rab chen po blo chen ldan/ /shes rab ye shes me bo che/ /shes rab chen po skad cig la/ /'jam dpal shes rab khyod la 'dud/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po cher grags pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i stobs dang ldan—/ /sa yi snying po 'gro ba 'dzin/ /sa yi snying po khyod la 'dud/ /snying rje chen po blo yi mchog /snying rje che dang shes rab dang / /sangs rgyas kun gye snying po che/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang khyod la 'dud/ /shugs chen mgyogs 3 25—407

pa chen po ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yid ltar mgyogs/ /rgyal ba rnam rgyal dgra las rgyal/ /sgrib pa sel ba khyod la 'dud/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa po/ /stobs po che la thabs che ba/ /smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /phyag na rdo rje khyod la 'dud/ /byams chen rang bzhin dpag tu med/ /byams pa'i go cha chas pa ste/ /byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor can/ /dpal ldan byams pa khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che/ /'dzin pa chen po rdo rje zhags/ /'jam dbyangs chen po sgra che ba/ /ye shes sgo ma khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje satwa satwa che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun du bzang / /phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la'o/ /rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs/ /nges pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gugs khyod la'o/ /rdo rje chags pa bde ba che/ /rdo rje mda' ni dbang byed pa/ /bdud kyi 'dod pa rdo rje che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gzhu khyod la'o/ /rdo rje legs pa bde ba che/ /rdo rje mgu ba dga' ba che/ /rab dgyes rgyal po 1bud+dhā mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dgyes pa la/ /rdo rje rin chen rdo rje'i don/ /rdo rje nam mkha' nor bu che/ /nam mkha'i snying po rdo rje phyug /phyag 'tshal rdo rje rin chen la'o/ /rdo rje gzi brjid cher 'bar ba/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje gzi brjid gzi brjid che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'od khyod la'o/ /rdo rje don rab rdo rje dbal / /rdo rje rgyal mtshan rab dga' byed/ /rdo rje chen po rin chen tog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dbal khyod la'o/ /rdo rje bzhad mo bzhad pa che/ /rdo rje 'dzum pa ngo mtshar che/ /dga' zhing rab dga' rdo rje ston/ /phyag 'tshal rdo 25—408

rje dga' ba la'o/ /rdo rje chos rab de bzhin don/ /rdo rje pad+ma rab dga' byed / /rdo rje dbang rab rdo rje'i spyan/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje spyan khyod la'o/ /rdo rje rno ba theg pa che/ /rdo rje ral gri mtshon chen po/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rab tu zab/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje blo gros 1la'o/ /rdo rje rgyu dang snying po che/ /rdo rje 'khor lo tshul chen po/ /rab bskor rdo rje las byung ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying khyod la'o/ /rdo rje gsung ba rang rig mchog /rdo rje bzlas pa rab 'grub phyir/ /mi gsung rdo rje mchog bsgrub pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gsung khyod la'o/ /rdo rje las rab rdo rje bka'/ /las kyi rdo rje kun rab 'gro/ /rdo rje nges pa rgya che ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje rgya gram la'o/ /rdo rje sgu ni brtan pa che//rdo rje go cha sra ba ste/ /brtson 'grus mchog ste dka' thub che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje brtson 'grus la'o/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po/ /rdo rje mche ba gcigs pa che/ /bdud 'joms rdo rje mi zad pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la / /rdo rje mtshams sbyor rab tu 'dud/ /rdo rje bcings pa rab grol cing / /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gnyis med la'o/ /lhag chad yi ge brgya pas bshags / /a ti gats+tsha muḥyis gshegs4/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ /'gro ba ma lus 'dren par shog /'jam dpal gye sgrub thabs zhi ba 'od kyi 5rim pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //sdom pa bzang po'i thugs dam/ lo tsā ba dar ma bhis bsgyur ba'o// //625—/09
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (944)25—411

༄khya/ /'jam dpal sde bo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ mañdzu shrī kro dha sā dha na nā ma/ bod skad du / 'jam dpal khro bo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam nadapal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams thams cad 'joms mdzad de/ /bdud kyi snying gar zhabs kyis gnon mdzad de/ /bcom ldan gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs bshad/ /dad pa'i stobs dang ldan pa yis / /rten gye gang zag tho rangs langs/ /snying gar nyi dkyil hūṃ bsams te/ /de las 'od zer lcags kyu 'phros/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed nyid dang / /bla ma sangs rgyas spyan drangs la/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod pas mnyes par byas/ /yan lag bdun pas mchod pa bya/ /thugs kar hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las/ /rdo rje shugs can spros te mtshams kyang bcad/ /de nas oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophoho / zhes brjod stong pa'i ngang las ni/ /hūṃ tsho )——— / /2

nyid nam mkha'i dbyings su bsgom/ /de las byung ba'i yig 'bru chad/ /de steng hūṃ gyi 'phro 'du las/ /pho brang rgya gram 'khor lor bcas/ /gzhal yas sgo bzhi rdzogs pas 3bskyed/ /e nayam̐ baṃ lo re rgyu 1zhes pa'o/ /de steng nyi zla pad+ma dang / /dregs pa ma he'i gdan la bzhugs/ /hūṃ las 'jam pa'i rdo rje bsam / /de zhu gshin rje gshed du gyur/ /zhal drug pa la phyag bcu gnyis/ /sku mdog nag po nam mkha'i mdangs/ /g.yas sngo g.yon dmar dud kha'o/ /steng du zhal nyid ser po'o/ /g.yas pa gri gug ral gri mda'/ /'khor lo tri shul rirtse gsum mdung / /g.yon na thod pa phub dang gzhu/ /be con mgo bo sdigs mdzub zhags/ /glang stag zhing chen sbrul gyis brgyan/ /rgyal thod bram snyan rje mgur dmangs 1rigs lhug /thod skam dbu rgyan 5thod rlon do shal byasarka/ /skra kham rdo gdug /7mche ba rab gcigs shing / /zhal nas ha la'i sgra sgrogs 'jigs par byed/ /bskal pa'i me dpung dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gyad kyi dor stabs bzhugs/ /nyi zla pad+ma dregs pa pho mo dang / /ma he sngo nag brjid pa'i gdan la 'jigs tshul bzhugs/ /baṃ las bskyed pa'i yum nyid ni/ /g.yas pa gri gug yab la 'khyud/ /g.yon pa thod khrag gtso la stobs8/ /gnyis med 'khyel pa'i tshul du gnas/ /pho brang rdo rje rgya gram la/ /yab yum gnyis med sbyor mtshams nas/ /shar du k+ṣe las gyur pas dkar/ /lho ru ma las gyur pas ser/ /nub tu me las gyur pas dmar / /byang du da las gyur pas ljang / /thams cad zhal gsum phyag kyang drug /gti mug nga rgyal gshin rje gshed/ /'dod chags phrag dog 9gshin rje gshed/ /rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mthun/ /phyi rol gyi ni rtsibs bcu la / /25—413

sbyor ba'i mtshams nas hūṃ bcu 'phros/ /'phros shing 'dus pas hūṃ bcur gyur/ /shar du shes rab mthar byed la/ /lho ru gshin rje mthar byed do/ /nub tu pad+ma mthar byed do/ /byang du bgegs ni mthar byed do/ /shar lhor dbyug pa sngon po la/ /lho nub mi g.yo mgon po'o/ /nub byang 'dod pa'i rgyal bo ste/ /byang shar khro bo gnod mjos so/ /steng du hūṃ mdzad 'og tu stobs po che/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis thams cad mthing / /g.yas pa sna tshogs g.yon pa spyigs mdzub bsgreng / /brkyang bskum dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /bskal pa'i me 'bar dregs pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /spyor mtshams dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥlkulas//sgo ba bzhi rnams rim —bzhin bskyed/ /thugs kar shes rab 'khor lo hūṃ/ /ye shes gsum gyis gnas gsum brlab/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs/ ye shes khro bo dgug gzhug bya/ /de nas bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ /oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra yak+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni rā ma ya/ya ta ya —ya ta/ rtsa sngags so/ /oṃ spyoḥbyeḥ gyewi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'o / /oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ yang snying ngo / /oṃ dī ṣa ra ti mu ta hūṃ dzaḥswā hā / rje btsun ma'i'o/ /de yang rgyud las/ khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs / /mig drug lag drug stobs dang ldan/ /keng thurus mche ba gcigs pa po/ /skra yang rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /mig brgya pa ste rdo rje'i mig /lus ni rdo rje'i ba spu can/ /khro bo'i lus kyi gzugs ldan pa/ /rnam pa bcu po don bcu'i don/ /khro gnyer rim par kyeldan la sogs/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che/ /'jigs pa chen po rdo rje zhags/ /'jam dbyangs chen po sgra che ba/ /gad chen ha ha zhes sgogs pa/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /25—4/4

gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal/ /rigs gsum 'chang ba gsang sngags 'chang / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gtor ma dbul ba ni/ /saṃ 1dang ram̐ gyis me rlung bskyod/ /shaṃ gsum sgyed po a las thod pa'i snod/ /go ku da ha na bi mu ra su khaṃ/ /dam rdzas bcu sbyar a las zla ba'i khabs—/ /hūṃ dzaḥ'i 'phro 'dus bdud rtsi bsrubs/ /oṃ sarba dharmā a bhā ba swa bhā ba bi shusgopho/4haṃ/zhes brjod pas skyon rnams dag par bsam/ 'bru gsum pa yis byin gyis brlab / /a ā sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ dhīḥbha ga bān—/ dz+nyā na kā ya wā gī shwa ra/ ma hā pa tsa mañdzu shrī pa ri shudhe i rda ba lo kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa 5rka/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ de nas bstod de/ hūṃ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i gzugs su bstan/ /be+e ḍūr+ya yi mdog 'dra sku mnga' zhing / /gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs byed sku la bstod/ /shin tu khro zhing gnag pa ma he'i zhal/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal bzhi 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /steng zhal gcigs pa'i zhal ni shin tu 'khrug /zhal drug spyan gsum 'jigs byed zhal la 'dud/ /g.yas kyi phyag drug mtshon cha gri gug dang / /ral gri mda' dang 'khor lo tri shul 6mdung / /g.yon na thod pa phub gzhu be con mgo bo bsnams/ /bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha 'jigs byed phyag 'tshal bstod/ /brkyang bskum tshul kyis zhabs bzhi thur du bgrad/ /ma he sngo nag brjis pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /'jigs byed stobs ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /glang stag zhing chen sbrul gyi 3rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rus pa'i rgyan cha drug ni dbang du 'khrol/ /thod skam dbu rgyan thod rlon do shal byas / /rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyan la rab tu bstod/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen 25—415

du brdzes/ /rno gdug mche ba rab tu gcigs/ /ha ha zhes bzhad srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ /dze gyi sgra sgogs rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i khrong dkyil nas/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i 'od zer tsha tsha 'phro/ /bdud dang dgra bgegs ma lus skrag snapar byed/ /ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mun nag lta bu'i sku brjid cing / /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ /gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams/ /bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal po khyed la bstod/ /hūṃ dmar nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /g.yas pa gri gug yab la 'khyud/ /g.yon pa thod khrag gtso la stobasari / /spyan gsum me stag rab tu 'phro/ /zhal nas ha ha nges par sgrogs/ /dbu skra dmar ser rab tu 'bar/ /phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod / /hūṃ gti mug nga rgyal gshin rje gshed/ /'dod chags phrag dog gshen rje gshed/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /glang stag zhing chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /thod pa'i do shal rgyan drug ldan/ /sku las 4me 'bar gdug pa 'dul/ /gshed bo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mi dge bcu spangs sa bcu bgrod/ /phyogs bcu'i bdud 'dul khro bo bcu/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing / /gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams/ /lha dang lha min thams cad 'dul/ /rgyan drug thod pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /'jigs byed bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ ye shes rnam bzhi yang dag rtogs/ /g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭī ga /rgyan dang lnga bcus sku la brgyan/ /brkyang bskum ha ha zil gyis gnon/ /lcags kyu ma dang zhags pa mo/ /lu gu rgyud dang 25—4/6

'be+ebs pa mo/ /mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhag chad yi ge brgya pas bshags/ /de nas dang la tshomajug bsdu ba ni/ hūṃ zhes pa yi sgra brjod de / /gcig gis ṭ+wāngang la yab la bsdu/ /yab nyid 'od du zhu las hūṃ/ /hūṃ de rim gyis zhu ba las/ /zag med bde ba'i ngang la gnas/ /rtag pa'i mtha' las grol bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje skad cig lhar bsgoms la/ /sngags kyi 'khor lo rab brjod pas/ /chad pa'i mtha' las grol bar 'gyur/ /de nas spyod lam ci bder gnas/ /'jam dpal khro bo'i sgrub thabs rdo rje 'od kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma sdom pa bzang po'i thugs dam/ bla ma lo tsā ba dharma rngu bhis bsgyur ba'o// ④ //babyir mchan/412 rmye/mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉thajam dpal khro bo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 〈〈snar 〉skorajam dpal khro bo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / tre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gin/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉gi'ajam—/ ④〈〈pe 〉s+dza/ 3〈〈pe 〉tha/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rka haṃ/413 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thar/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sgra/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shaṃ/ gye 〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉pho/ rmye 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kugur rmang / ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thargyan/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdug pe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lkeb/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tsa dogs/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rolas/414 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ams/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉riya/ kru 〈〈pe 〉〉hriḥ1ཿ/ 〈〈snar 〉〉trīḥskṛḥ—/ she〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rkeng / dzi〈〈snar 〉s+dzas/ dz+wa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/415 tso〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ 3 〈〈co 〉khims/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ri.a/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ripho/ bye〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grisna grit+na/ byu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shul/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉gyis/ dwa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rgyan/416 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskrag 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadud/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lkeb/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/417 kye〈〈pe 〉rang ma/ 〈〈snar 〉ridang la/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rar ma/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rdzogasaso/ /25—417

༄༅/ /'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga bzhugs/1 ༄gro/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya thub pas gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal mtshan brjod 'di la zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis las/'di rgya che ba'i man ngag go/ /don brgyad las 'di man ngag gi sa'o/ /de la rim gyis pa dang cig car ba las 'di rim gyis pa'i sa'o/ /de la bum pa'i dbang gi rtedus su/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ de yang /sa yi dkyil 'khor bzhi yi khyen / /zhes 1/zer/ de la brten nas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bstan te/ smon 'jug gnyis kyis slob ma las la 'jug pa'i dus su/ ri yi phug gam chu 'gram mam/ /lha khang mchod rten dben sa dang / /dur khrod gnas dang shing drung du/ /de la sogs te gnas yid du 'ong bar/slob dpon stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ bsam gtan la gnas par bya'o/ /rgyud nas/ bsam gtan chen po'i nying 'dzin gnas / /gsungs so / /25byed419

de nas rang 'jam dpal du bsgoms la/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de'i rjes la/ a ā sarba snata thā ga ta dṛ byed ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ s+thāḥbha ga wān/dz+nyā na mūrti / wā gī shwa ra ma hā pā byetsa/ sarba dharmā ga ga na/ a ma la su pa ri shud+dhā dharma dādh+wa tu dz+nyā na gar+bha aḥzhes pas bdag dang snang srid stong par bsam/de'i ngang las bdag gshin rje gshed du bsgoms la/ sa snang ba la babe+eng ba dang / mi snang ba la basbang ba dang / bgegs bskrad pa dang / sa sbyang ba dang / sa gzung ba dang / mchod gtor gyis mnyes par bya ba dang / klog 'don bya ba dang / sngon 'gro rnams bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sta gon ni bdud rtsi'i hūṃchus chag chag btab la/gnam thig gdab pa dang / sa thig gdab pa dang / ④byin gyis brlab pa dang / bri ba la 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas lha dang bum pa'i sta gon bya ste/ bum pa dkar po nag po ra ri spangs pa la ras kha tshar ma nyams pa'i mgul chings byas la phyag rgya lnga ⑪gdags/de la sogs pa'i yo byad rgyas par bsog /de ni bum pa'i sta gon no/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa sta gon la gnas par bya ste/ spyir khrus dang ldan par bya/ sdig bshags bya/ skyabs 'gro byas la/ slob dpon 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i nying nge 'dzin la gnas par bya'o/ /de ni slob dpon gyi sta gon no/ /slob ma'i sta gon ni phyir khrus byas la/ sdig pa bshags pa dang / skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bar chod bsrung ba'i phyir srung skud gdags pa dang / dpa' bo 25—420

'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de ni slob ma'i sta gon no/ /bar der zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rgyas par bya'o/ /dbang thob pa dang ma thob pa gnyis su shes par bya'o/ /dbang thob na sems bskyed tu3bya mi dgos/ ma thob 1na sems bskyed bya/ gnyis pa la 'jug /gsum pa la rdzogs par bya'o/ /de yang gsum rig 3gtsang ma dag pa ste / dbang thob pa yin na bum pa gcig la dbang bzhi stan thog tu bskur/ byin rlabs 3brtan par bya ba'i phyir slob dpon la yon dbul lo/ /de'i cho ga ni dang po kho gyenas sa bslang ste/ sa bdag lha klu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /sa yi dmigs dang ṣ+pe'u gseng lu ma rnams/ /rdzing dang lteng ka so so'i gnas rnams nas/ /sa bdag klu gnyan sde dang 'khor du bcas//sa yi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren mchod kyis gshegs su pyagasol/ /dkyil 'khor chen po 'di yi ༄ —sa bslang phyir/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rin chen gser gyi sa gzhi bslang du gsol/ /lag pa g.yas pa sa la brdabs pas/ sa gas pa'i ser ga nas sa'i lha mo ro stod bsnyems te / byung nas/ lag pa g.yas pa khas len gyi phyag rgyaḥ/g.yon pa bum pa bsnams pa de ltar byon par bsam/ de la gtor ma dang me tog dri zhim pos mchod la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab ste/ sngon bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas srod la bdud btul/ tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa rmye1yang sa gzhi rin po che 'di'i steng du mdzad pa lags 8pas / rnal 'byer pa che ge mo zhes bkyi ba la sogs pa yang / tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i rten 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i pho brang 'debs par 'tshal 25—421

bas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pas sa bdag klu gnyan kun/ sa rin du rin po ches brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ dang po dge sbyor dbu bzung ba nas—/ tha ma rdzogs pa mthar phyin rmyedu sa gnas 'di bdag la tsogayar lags pas / sa 'di brtan pa dang bkra shis par mdzad du gsol byezhes brjod la gtor ma sbyin no/ /de'i cho ga 'di skad do/ /hūṃ skyob pa sangs rgyas rin po che/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo 'khor bcas dpang du gyur/ /shākya thub pa skyob pa yis/ /bdud kyi sde rnams bcom pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud rnams gzhom/ /pham par byas te zidakyil 'khor bri/ /lha mo de/ de nyid du thim par bsam mo/ /de ni sa bslang ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas bdag nyid 'jam dpal du gsal bar bsgoms la/ de nas rdo rje gsor dril bu gsil zhing / rdo rje 'gros kyis bskor zhing sa gzhi gzung ngo / /de nas bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gye dbus su bsdad de/ las thams cad pa'i sngags brjod cing sdang mig phyogs bcur blta/ rdo rje nam mkha' la gsor zhing mtshams bcad do/ /de nas dri sna tshogs dang spos kyi chus sbyar la lag tu thogs la/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs la 'di skad do/ /hūṃ bcom ldan ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /dkyil 'khor kun gye bdag po ste/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /de dag slob mar bcas pa dang / /mgon po bdag ni 'byung bar 'tshal/ /las thams cad pa'i sngags kyi dri'i chus byug go/ /bdag gi thugs kar thig sgud kyi sna gcig 25—422

gzung / slob ma de phyag na rdo rjer gsal btab la/ thig skud de lte ba'i khung du gzung la/ hūṃ nam mkha' gang ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /khyod kyis sems can 'gro don mdzad/ /las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis thig gdab po/ /thig skud kyi sgra yis bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs dam bskul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par bsam mo /da tsoni sa tshon byen gyis brlab ste/ oṃ hūṃ swā dī hā 27bris la rigs lnga'i dgug gzhug bya'o/ /de zhu bas rin po che lnga'i phye mar gyur nas/ des bris te g.yon pas de nas pad+ma'i gdan re dgod/ de las lha'i 'phro 'du dang bskyed pa gzhan nas gsal lo/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bla ma sdom pa bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //25—423

༄ga /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbang bzhi'i gdams pa bzhugs/ri1༄go/ /da ni smon 'jug gnyis dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed par snyebya ste / de la yang dang por sdig pa bshags par bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba skye ba nas da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa tshun chad mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang /bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba rnams bla ma dkon mchog yi dam/ mkha' 'gro'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /da ni skyabs su 'gro ste/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba snying po byang chub la thug gi bar du/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /da ni sdom pa gzung choste/ bla ma dkon mchog gi spyan sngar/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni babe+eb pa dang / /dge ba'i 25—425

chos ni sbud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis rtag par gzung bar bgyi/ /de ni smon pa'i sems bskyed denye / /da ni 'jug par bya ste/ dang po bshags pa bya ste/ mam yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bkyi bas skye ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa yan chad du mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / gzhan bgyed pa la rjes su yi rang ba rnams / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba snying po byang chub la thug gi bar du bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' 'gro la skyabs su mchi'o / /da ni sdom pa gzung ḍa bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi gtong ngo / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi zhe/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dbon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po yi/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgye/ /byang chub sems ni 25—426

bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung ri1/ /ma bsgral 1ba rnams bdag gis sgrol1/ /ma grol thub rnams bdag gis dgrolathu// /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces 'jug go//nub dang po la smon 'jug gi sems bskyed do/ /so shing dor la rang re'i rmi lam brtag go/ /de nas dbang bskur bar bya ste—/ dkyil 'khor sgrub me pa'i dus su bzlas pa bya ba ni/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri sum̐/oṃ badz+ra tīkyā meduḥkha ts+tsha da pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta tre7ye/ dz+nyā na kā ya wā gri shwa ra a ra pa tsa nā ya te na maḥ/ a ā sarba ta thā la sogs pa las thams cad pa'i bsnyen pa rdzogs par bya'o/ /nub gnyis pa la byang chub lam du drang ba ni/ mig ras kyis bkab la lag tu me tog thogs la/ sgo'i phyi logs su bzhag la/ slob dpon nyid kyis 'di skad brjod do/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu mchog khyodakye/ /dad dang mos pa ci la dga'/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ slob mas 'di skad brjod do/ /bdag cag 'khor ba las bsgral phyir/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo gnas spyor ⑫ba/ /di ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin gsol/ /zhes lan no/ /yang slob dpon gyis/ma rig rmongs pa'i bu mchog khyod/ /rdo rje byang chub lam nas nyurmidrangs nas ni/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan pas 8bya/ /bla med byang chub lam nas drang bar bya'o/ /25—427

badz+ra saṃ ku sha dza ①zhes brjod pas las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad do/ /de nas las kyi slob dpon lag tu rdo rje gtad la/ lag pa nas drangs nas gral so sor bya'o/ /rang gi gdong g.yogs byas la gzhag ②go/ /yang slob dpon kho ①rang gis/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu mchog khyed/ /las dang spyod pa ci la dga'/ /byas pas/ yang slob mas/ bdag ni skal ldan bde chen la/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal dngos grub gsol/ /zhes so/ /de nas me tog lag tu thogs la/ thal mo sbyar la 'di skad brjod do/ /byang chub rdo rje 'jam dpal la/ /rin chen me tog dam pa 'bul/ /bdag kyang 'jam dpal sgur gyur cig /'jam dpal sku yi rdo rje gsol/ /pra tīts+tsha ho zhes me tog dbul lo/ /me tog lha la tshud na des chog go/ /ma tshud na lan gsum bskyar ro/ /de yang ma tshud na las thams cad bskyar ro/ /de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod do/ /de ring dang ba'i ④shugs kyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan par bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas rngubyin gyis brlabagye/ /dam tshig mchog tu gyur par byed/ /badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha phaṭa ces mig dbye'o/ /de nas dbang bskur te/ dang po bum pa'i dbang bskur te bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas bum pa 'od du zhu ba las de 'khor lor gyur/'khor lo 'od du zhu/ hūṃ du gyur/ de la rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i dbang ngo / /de spyi bo'i thog tu bzhag 7la mchod pa dbul te/ mchod pa chen po 'dod chags 25—428

che—/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar byed/ /mchod pa chen po zhe sdang cheske/ /nyon mongs kun gyi sgra che ba/ /mchod pa chen po gti mug che/ /gti mug blo ste gti mug sel/ /mchod pa chen po khro ba che/ /khro ba chen po sgra che ba/ /mchod pa chen po chags pa che/ /chags pa thams cad sel bar byed//oṃ badz+ra pu྾ hūṃ/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gadhe/ ṣ+pe we 1h+ye/ shalda 27hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra tīkyā 1duḥkha ts+tsha da pradz+nyā dz+nyā na rūrta kruye dz+nyā na kā ya wā gī shwa ra a ra pa tsa nā 5ya te na maḥ.a ā i yī u spru e i o au e aḥkye7sbi to j-i diṣ+ṭa/ dz+nyā na mūrti kye7ra haṃ burnyo bud+dhā dzā a ā sarba ta thā ga ta la sogs pa las thams cad pa'i sngags btang /de ni bum pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /de nas dbu rgyan dang cod pan gyi dbang bsgur te/ dbu rgyan dang cod pan mdun du bzhag la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od kha dog lnga 'phros te/dbu rgyan dang cod pan 'od du zhu rin po che'i sul mangs cig tu gyur/ rin po che 'od du zhu bas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi byedabang ngo / /slob ma'i mgo la bskon ⑫la/ gong gi mchod pas mchod do/ /de nas rdo rje'i dbang bskur te rdo rje las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje 'od du zhu nas pad+ma dmar po cig tu gyur/ pad+ma de zhu bas saṃ du gyur/ saṃ zhu bas snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbang bskur ro/ /de slob ma'i lag tu bzhag pas mchod bstod gong bzhin du bya'o / /skye de nas dril bu'i dbang bskur te/ slob dpon gyi mdun du dril bu bzhag la thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas dril bu zhu/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cig tu gyur/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de ha cig tu gyur/ de las don yod 25—429

grub pa'i dbang ngo / /dril bu slob ma'i lag tu bzhag la mchod bstod gong bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas ming gi dbang bsgur te/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas pa'i steng du thugs ka nas a de 'od du zhu zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cig 1tu gyur/ zla ba 'od du zhu oṃ du gyur/ de las rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang ngo / / slob dpon gyi phyag slob ma'i spyi bo'i steng du bzhag ste/ mchod bstod gong bzhin du bya'o/ /de ltar dbang bskur ba ni phung po lnga ni rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas te/ ye shes lnga'i dbang thob pa'o/ /des ni bum pa'i dbang ngo / / —gsang ba'i dbang ni/ bdag lha'i rnal 'byor du byas la/ de'i spyi gtsug tu bla ma bsgom/ de'i spyi gtsug tu gshin rje gshed yab yum bsgom/de'i spyi gtsug tu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams bsgom mo/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems gshin rje gshed yab yum la thim par bsam/ gshin rje gshed yab yum snyoms par zhugs byang chub kyi sems la babs nas/ bla ma yab yum la zhugs 4par bsam/bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems de dag gi lam du zhugs nas lce steng du sbyar la/ ar+gha dang bsres la slob ma'i lce steng du 6bzhag la slob ma'i ngag skyon dag par bsam/ de mgrin par/ de snying gar/ de lte bar / de rim gyis yar drangs pas ngag gi lam du zhugs/ de 7sna bug g.yas su zhugs / de g.yon du zhugs/ ngag 9rlung ni 'gro 'ong bzlas pa byas pas sgra ngos gzung med pas ngag gi sgra grag stong du 'gro ste ngo sprad do/ /25—430

shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ rnal 'byer pa g.yas su gzhagatsho /rnal 'byor ma g.yon du gzhagatre /de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang dril bu mdun du bzhag la/ gshin rje gshed yab yum du bskyed do/ /rdo rje de la bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje 'od du zhu 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slar 'dus pas yi ge hūṃ cig tu gyur/ hūṃ 'od du zhu ba las 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas dbyug totwo/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa bcas pa/ glang chen stod g.yogs/ zhing chen g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thabs dang / sbrul gyi chun po dang thod pa'i phreng ba dang / dur khrod kyi chas can du bskyed la slob ma'i thugs kar bzhag la/ ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje de zhesnaslob ma'i lag tu gtad thabs kyi rang bzhin du dbang bskur ro/ / dril bu 6la bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas dril bu 'od du zhu/ dril bu'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ tshur 'dus pas yi ge a cig tu gyur/ a de 'od du zhu ba las rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pa cig 7tu bskyed la slob ma'i spyi bo thog tu bzhag la ye shes dgug gzhug bya'o/ /de nas mo'i lag pa g.yon du gzhag /dngos kyi rig ma rnged na dril bu'i 'od kyis 9rig mar bsgom mo/ /de ltar shes rab kyis rka rim par dbang bskur ro/ /de nas slob dpon gyis mkha' gsang byen gyis brlab/ slob dpon gyi 1125—431

gsang ba'i gnas nas hūṃ cig 'phros pas slob ma'i gsang bar thim/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pa rngucig tu gyur/ rdo rje'i bum par oṃ gyis mtshan pa cig tu gyur par bsgom/ yum gyi 3mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab ste/ bdag gi yum gyi mkha' las ma dmar mo cig 'phros pas slob ma'i yum gyi gsang bar thim ma de 'od du zhe zhu ba las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad ze'u ngu'abru dang bcas pa cig 7 bsgom/de nas slob dpon kyis hūṃ zhes brjod pas rdo rje bskul/ a zhes dril bu bskul/a ā sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ byā zhwaḥbha ga wān/ dz+nyā na mūrti wā gī shweshwa ra ma hā pa tsa/ sarba dharmā ga ga na/ a ma la su pa ri shudhe dharma trīkhye tu dz+nyā na gar+bha aḥzhes pas skad cig ma la bskyed de/ bde ba ngos bzung 9ngo / /de ni bde ba bskur ba'i rim pa'o 7 dbang gi don lam du bslang ba ni/ de'i dus las ma g.yos par yab yum gnyis kyi bsrubs pas rlung me'i drod can gyi me lce a ba dhū tī na yar zhugs te / spyi bo gtsug tor gyi haṃ nyubyezhu ba las/ klad rgyas bde ba'i 8'khor lo'i rtsa 6'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis grolathu/ de la bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems babs te dga' ba'o/ /byang chub kyi sems de mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor bskyil bas rtsa 'dab ma bcu drug grol te mchog dga'/ de chos kyi 'khor lor bskyil bas rtsa 'dab brgyad grol te dga' bral/ de lte ba sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du babs rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi grol te/ de lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o / /de rang gnas /kyisu 'phangs te ha ha zhes pas lte ba nas snying gar drangasalte / hi nyi zhes pas snying ga nas mgrin par drangs⑩/ hūṃ hūṃ zhes pas mgrin pa nas klad pa bde chen du drangs pas gtsug tor chen po'i haṃ la kyesbur 25—432

len la sbur 'dus pa'am khab len la lcags 'dus pa bzhin du 'ub kyis 'dus so—/ /de la seng ge rnam par rol gyi ①khyab par bsgom mo/ /de ltar yar drangs dumar dbab byed kyin 1bde stong gi nyams ngos zin par bya'o/ /dbang bzhi pa ni bzhi par ming btags kyang gsum ④las bskur bar mi 'dod do/ /gong ma'i nyams de sems nyid la ngo sprod pa la bzhi las shes zer ro//de la bzhi pa'i dbang gi ⑤ngo sprad de/ gdams ngag ngo sprad kyis sems ngos zung shig bya/ dar cig lon pa dang / de ka rang yin byas la/ lag pa nam mkha' la yug byas la/ bzhi pa bde ba'i don no/ /phyag rgya chen po'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de gzugs gyekha dog tu ma grub pas nam mkha' la ngo sprad do/ /gsum pa'i nyams de ngos gzung dang bral bas/ gzhon nu ma'i bde ba nyams su myong du yod pa la dngos mepo mngon sum du bstan du med/ de ka la ngo sprad pas dbang bzhi pa'i gdams ngag go/ /lta stangs bzhis rigs rkyepa spros pa dang bral bar ngo sprad do/ /bum pa'i dbang gi pedus su rigs lnga'i bkra shis gsol zhing dbang bskur/gsang dbang man chad rmye /dbang bzhi pa rdzogs nas bkra shis kyi dbang bskur te dngos grub blang ngo / /bkra shis gsol ba ni/ rgyud las/ bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /grags pa'i bkra shis snyan grags dge/ /dbugs 'byin chen po dga' ston che/ /zhes so/ /rdzas la brten pa'i bkra shis kyi ston mo ni/ 'brang rgyas dang / mar 25—433

dang / thud dang / zho dang / mngar gsum dang / khur ba dang / la phug dang / zas sna mang du thogs la rigs lnga'i bkra shis gsol te/ bkra shis dam pa chos dbyings bskyod pa med mod kyang / /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bkra shis bde legs shog /bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /grags pa'i bkra shis snyan grags dge/ /dbus phyogs sangs rgyas rigs kyi zhing khams nas/ /spros dang bral ba'i bkra shis gang lags pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /1shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi zhing khams nas/ /rdo rje rigs kyi bkra shis skye 'chi — med/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /grags pa'i bkra shis snyan grags dge/ /lho phyogs rin chen rigs kyi zhing khams nas/ /rin chen rigs kyi bkra shis dgos 'dod 'byung / /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /grags pa'i bkra shis snyan grags dge/ /nub phyogs pad+ma rigs kyi zhing khams nas/ /skyon med pad+ma lta bu'i bkra shis pa / /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /grags pa'i bkra shis snyan grags dge/ /byang phyogs las kyi rigs kyi zhing khams nas/ /las rnams grub pa'i bkra shis gang lags pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /oṃ budhe kā la sha a bhe ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ raṇ+ḍa kā 4la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ5/ oṃ pad+ma kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa dī6/ oṃ karma kā 7la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sgu mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bkra shis pa de bzhin du/25—434

bdag cag dpon slob bkra shis par gyur cig /bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi bkra shis ni/ bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzugs/ /sangs rgyas sku yi bkra shis shog /chos kyi dung ste sgra chen ldan/ /bud+dhā gsung gi bkra shis shog /'od bzang 'bar ba dpal gyi be+e'u/ /budhe thugs kyi bkra shis shog /khyab bdag chen po rin chen gdugs/ /budhe dbu yi bkra shis shog /spyan lnga chags pa med pa 'chang / /bud+dhā spyan gyi bkra shis shog /bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog /bud+dhā mgul gyi bkra shis shog /nyid kyi zhal nas ljags bzang ba/ /budha ljags kyi bkra shis shog /bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa//grags pa'i bkra shis snyan grags dge/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang //sangs rgyas zhabs kyi bkra shis shog /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbang bzhi'i gdams pa slob dpon sdom pa bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //25—435

sngal/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar dge ba'i don/sprul sku lam du byed pa rdo rje'i glu ni/ oṃ badz+ra tīkyā rdo rje rnon po bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas so/ /duḥkhats+tsha da mi mthun pa'i sbug bsngal gcod 2pa mi bskyod pa'o / /pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta ye/ shes rab ye shes gti mug sel ba rnam snang ngo / /dz+nyā na kā ya/ ye shes kyi sku phrin 4las byed pa don yod grub pa'o/ /wā gī shwa ra ngag gi dbang phyug gdul bya tshim pa/ a ra pa tsa ma skyes pa'i don rin chen 'byung ldan/ oṃ te te hūṃ bde ba'i don rtogs/ 5te na hūṃ bde ba'i lam rnyed/te te te na hūṃ gnyis su med pa'i bde ba thob pa'o/ /ya te na maḥtheg chen ma nor ba yin no/ /bar du dge ba'i don ni/ longs sku lam du byed pa rdo rje'i glu ni/25—438

oṃ sbi to dṛ 1di chos thams cad rang bzhin skye med kyi ngo bor gnas/ dz+nyā na mūrti nar haṃ/ ye shes kyi bde ba rang la yod/ burjo bud+dhā nān/ sangs rgyas sems can ye nas gnyis su med/ bye d+dhā brte nān/ dus gsum gyi don brjod pa las 'das pa'i gnas yin/ bde ba'i don ston/ te na hūṃ/bde ba'i lam rnyed/ te te te na hūṃ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i bde ba thob po/ /mthar thug dag 4pa'i don ni/ chos sku lam du byed pa rdo rje'i glu ni/oṃ sarba dharmā a ā/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa nyid/ oṃ sarba dharmā/ i spyi/skye med 5skye ba med pa nyid du snang / /oṃ sarba dharmā u spru/ ma skyes chos rnams dus gsum yid kyis dran/ /oṃ sarba dharmā e i/ chos rnams skye med mi 'da' dam tshig nyid/ /oṃ sarba dharmā 6o au/ chos rnams thams cad longs spyod mchog /oṃ sarba dharmā e/ chos 7thams cad 'bras bu bde ba che/ oṃ sarba dharmā aḥchos sku bde ba chen po nyid kyi don/ oṃ te te hūṃ bde ba'i don 8rtogs/te /—snan hūṃ bde ba'i lam rnyed/ te te te na hūṃ gnyis su med pa'i bde ba thob/ya te na maḥjeg pa chen po ma nor ba yin glu dang po bum dbang thob pas blang /glu bar pa de gsang dbang dang / shes rab ye shes thob pas blang / glu gsum pa de dbang bzhi thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen pos blang ngo / /rdo rje glu'i gdams ngag rdzogs so// shā //25—439

1022da༅/ /khrus kyi cho ga bzhugs so//⑫ ༄zhe/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khrus kyi cho ga bya ste/de yang rgyud na du/ dag par byed cing sdig sel ba/ /zhes pas/ khrus kyi cho ga bshad de/ de la gnyis/ phyi'i khrus dang nang gi khrus so/ /dang po phyi'i khrus bya ste/ sa gtsang ma la maṇ+ḍal byas la/ de'i steng du bum pa skyon spangs pa gzhagarngu /ras kha tshar ma nyams pas bum pa'i mgul chings bya/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gis bum pa'i kha rgyan bya/ nang jedu chu gtsang mas bkang la/snying po rnam pa lnga la/ 'bru'i snying po til/ rtsi thog gi snying po mar/ shing thog gi snying po bu ram/ me tog gi snying po sbrang rtsi/ chu'i snying po lan tshu'/ /'bru lnga la/ nas/ gro/ til/ khre/ 'bras so/ /sman lnga la/ stag tsher ma/ rgya mtsho dbu ba/de dbang po lag pa/ 'ushu dag /sle tres so/ /spos lnga la/ a ga rtseru/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ ga pur/ dzā ti/ gla rtsi'o//25—441

de dud 'gro'i sa bon yin par 'dod/ rdzas de rnams bum pa'i nang du drugs la / maṇ+ḍal gyi 1steng du gzhag /de nas rang 'jam dpal du skad cig gis bskyed la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags lan cig brjod la stong —bsam mo/ /de'i ngang las bum pa'i nang du rgyu 4'phros 'dus pas phyi rin po che gser gyi bum pa la/ nang rin po che lnga'i gzhal yas khang phyi nas bltas na nang gsal ba5 /nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba cig tu bsgom/ bum pa'i khar pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa cig bsam/ rgyud la6/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /gsung ngo / /de la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs a las 'jam dpal bsgom/ rgyud las/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /gsung ngo / /de la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs 7ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ las thams cad pa'i bsngags bzlas pas/'jam dpal gyi gsang ba nas bdud rtsi'i trechu rgyun byung nas bum pa khengs par bsam mo/ /ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas khrus chu dang 'dres par bsam mo/ /nang zab mo sngags kyi khrus ni/ 'jam dpal du skad cig gis bsgoms la/'dud dang sngags kyi mjug la a nyi shu rtsa gcig 9—brjod la/ de nas ye shes kyi me long gi ngang la gzhag pas sgrib pa lnga ni sems nyid la gser gyi g.ya' tsam yang ma gos te/ de ni nang gi khrus zhes bya'o/ /phyi'i dri ma 'khru ba ste/ nang gi rnam rtog gi dri ma rnams 'khrud pa'i brda yin/ phyi khrus nang khrus slob dpon sdom pa bzang po'i lugs 'bro lo tsā ba dharmā bhis bsgyur ba rdzogs so// //25—442

1023༄ga /gtor ma'i cho gahūṃ༄go/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyin bdag chen po gtso bo ste / / gsungs pas ༷gtor ma bshad de/ de la rnam pa gnyis te/ phyi'i gtor ma dang nang gi gtor ma gnyis so/ /dang po phyi —gtor gtang bce/rin po che'i snod du kha zas gtsang ma dang chu gtsang mas bkang la/ dang po skyabs 'gro bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs5 / de nas las thams cad pa'i sngags gsum gye rting la/ na maḥsarba 6 ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ zhes pa gsum gyis bsngo / dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams dang / gtsang rigs kyi mgon po rnams dang / 'gro ba ris drug gi sems can rnams la 'dod pa'i longs spyod char bzhin 'bab par gyur cig ces bsngo'o / /7 25—444

nang gi gtor ma ni/ yi las rlung / re las me/ kai las thod pa gsum gyi sgyed pu/ ā hūṃ7las thod pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ go ku da ha na/ bi mu shu na da/ de la a las zla ba'i khams rdo rje rtse lnga pa skyug pa cig bsgom mo/ /de la oṃ hūṃ dhīḥzhes brjod pas las kyi rlung bskyod pas bsod nams kyi me sbar bas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dros ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/las thams cad pa'i sngags kyi mjug la/ ga ṇa tsakra i rda ba lo/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa khā hi khā hi zhes lan gsum gyis bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams dang / chos skyong ba'i srung ma thugs dam can rnamasaphyi'i mchod pa / gsang ba'i mchod par bzhes shig /bag chags kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rgyu dang 'bras bu nas zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo zhes brjod la gtor ma gtang / de nas chos kyi sbyin pa gtang je/ gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so//5 //25—445

1024༄༅/ /ro'i rab gnas cho gahūṃ༄spro/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pas zhag bdun ro'i snyerab gnas bya ste/ de yang / ngan song thams cad rnam sbyong ba/ /mgon po sems can kun gyi mchog /gsung ngo / /shi ba sbyang ba bstan te/ dkyil 'khor cho ga rdzogs bya ste/ /zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du bya/ /khro bo de la 'og tu bya'o/ /thig gdab tshon gyi cho ga bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su bum pa gtsang ma la ras kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul chings bya/ der snying po lnga dang / 'bru lnga dang / sman lnga dang / chu gtsang mas dgang / dkyil 'khor gyi zur bzhir mda' bzhi la dar sna lnga —btags la gzhagaṣe /gshin bum mgul chings sngon por byas la gzhag sdego/ /de nas dri ma bca' ste/ dri ma la mtshan byang btags la/ gdugs dang dar sna dang me long btags la gzhag 6go/ /de nas bgegs bskrad pa ni las 25—447

thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas shing nyungs 1 kar phyogs bzhir gtor ro/ /de nas bgegs mthong 2/ba rnams la phyi'i gtor ma btang bye la bden pa bdar te 'di skad do/ /tshe 'das pa'i blo 'di rgyal po'am/ ma mo'am/ btsan nam/bdud dam/ dmu'am4/ klu'am/ sa bdag gam/ the'u rang ltal sogs te/ gang gi lag na yod kyang rung ste/ khyed la glud spegator rin po ches brgyan pa 7'bul gyis/ 'di bzhes la gson gyi tshe la ma gnod/ gshin gyi bla ma bcad par rnal 'byor pa'i bka' la nyon cig /de skad byas la las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad la/ gtor ma sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab po/ /bgegs dma' ba rnams la pho nya dgyesnye/ rdo rje'i le'u gdon/nyungs / kar gtor to/ /de ltar byas la dri ma la bla yang yang dgug go/ /de nas til la sdig pa'i gzugs byas la tshe 'das kyi sdig pa 'di la bstems 1 sna/de nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ dus gsum du mchod pa dang gtor ma cha gsum gtong nya1ngo / /dug sbyang ba ni de yang dag par byed cing sdig sel ba zhes so/ /khrus cho ga bshad de/ bum pa'i nang du chu dang sman dang / spos lnga la sogs pa blugs la/ bum pa'i khar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dkar po cig bsams 6la/rgyud las/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /zhes so/ /de'i steng du a las 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bsgom mo/ /rgyud las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /gsung ngo / /de la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas/ 'jam dpal gyi gsang gnas nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung nas bum pa dkar mer gyis khengs par bsam mo/ /de nas khrus byas teṅka/ me long nang du mtshan byang gsal bar 25—448

byas la/ a 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /sangs rgyas bden pas dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ /chos dang dge 'dun yang de bzhin du sbyar ro/ /sa ni dug gi pha yin te/ /sa ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /tshe 'das dug ni dug med shog /las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis khrus dus gsum du bya'o/ /zhag bdun pa'i tha ma la phyir mi ldog par bya ba'i phyir/ bum pas dbang bskur la/ phyogs bzhir phyin la 'di skad do/ /tshe 'das nyon mongs snying re rje/ /gal te las kyi dbang btsan nas/ /shar gyi phyogs su skye srid do/ /shar gyi phyogs su skyes pa ni1/ /de na skyob pa'i mgon po bzhugs/ /mgon po'i ming ni rnam snang mdzad/ /mgon po'i ming ni yul 'khor srung / /sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po de la skyabs song cig /des phyogs 'og ma gsum 'gre'o2/ /lhor rin 'byung mgon po'i ming ni 'phags skyes po/ nub snang ba mtha' yas/ mgon po'i ming gi spyan mi bzang / byang sangs rgyas don yod grub pa/ mgon po'i ming ni rnam thos sras/ de nas tshe las 'das pa'i rig pa a dkar bo bsam/a de 'jam dpal gyi thugs kar 'phang ngo / /de nas byang bu mar me la bsreg /tha ma la sāts+tsha gdab/ tshe 'das pa'i don du smon lam rgya chen po gdab po/ /sdom pa bzang pos mdzad pa 'bro lo tsā ba dharmā bhis bsgyur ba ro'i rab gnas cho ga rdzogs so//khye //25—449

1025༄ga /ro sreg pa'i cho ga tsho sna༄gro/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo//shi ba la phan gdags pa ro sreg pa ni 2/ maṇ+ḍal drug gi cho ga bya/ de nas ro khang bur bcug la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis ro 1de la bsngags 4sam/yungs kar la bsngags te mi dmigs par bsam/ de la dang po 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bsgom/ bdag gi thugs ka'i a las 'od 57'phros pas 'gro ba rigs 'udrug gi sgrib pa sbyang bar bsam mo/ /de nas me bcug la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ de nas mchod pa dbul 'dud 7dang 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa bya/ de nas ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol/ ro sreg pa'i cho ga slob dpon sdom pa bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //25—451
