༄༅/ /sāts+tsha gdab pa'i rim pa/1 ༄77/ /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' —la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas sāts+tsha kyegadab pa ni/ rus pa la las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis brab po/ /de nas lag pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya bcas la las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis byen gyis brlab/ sa rin po che sna lnga'i phye mar bsam/ de la dri sna tshogs pa sbyar ba'i chus sbrus shing brdung ngo / /de la rin po che yang bdar ro/ /de nas 'jim pa'i gong bu la rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas reg ge byas la las thams cad pa'i sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la rin po che'i gong bur gyur par bsam/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kun la sbyar ro/ /'bi 'bi thabs/sku par shes rab/ 'debs pa thams cad thabs shes rab zung du 'byel/'bi 'bi zab pa/ sku par rgya che snyeb/ 'bi 'bi chos sku/ skur gyur pa longs sku/ 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du byed pa sprul sku'i don no/ /sāts+tsha 6gdab 25—453

pa'i rim pa slob dpon sdom pa bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/453 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉tsa tsha gdab pa bzhugs so/ /2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/dpa'/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa tsha/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉76/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉na cha/6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (953)25wa 454

1027༄༅/ /rab tu gnas pa'o cho galku༄4/ /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ni rab tu gnas pa bya ste/ dkyil 'khor bris la mtshan rnams dkyil 'khor la bkod la/ sku'i rab gnas rnam snang la bstem/ gsung gi rab gnas snang ba mtha' yas la bstem/ thugs kyi rab gnas mi bskyod pa la bstem par bya'o/ /gong ltar sāts+tsha tresnabatab nas mchod rten gyi mnga' gsol te/ mchod pa rnams gzhung bzhin du bsams la/ dang po spyan drang ste/ ye shes rang snang sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas/ /'khor lo thig ma thig bzhi bang rim can/ /gnas bzhi'i dbyibs tshul sgo bzhi sgo brtsegs 1ldan/ /rang bzhin lhun grub mchod rten brgyad po gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan sprul sku mdzad pa las byung ba'i/ /lha las babs pa'i mchod rten gshegs su gsol/ /pad+ma can gye mchod rten gshegs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gshegs su gsol/ /cho 25—455

'phrul chen po'i mchod rten gshegs su gsol/ /rang bzhin lhun grub 1mchod rten gshegs su gsol/ /rnam par dag pa'i mchod rten gshegs su gsol/ /ka ni ka yi mchod rten gshegs su gsol/ /bkra shis sgo mangs mchod rten gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes blo stegs mchod rten gshegs su gsol/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod rten gshegs su gsol/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten gshegs su gsol/ /dregs pa'i phung po dur khrod brgyad kyi rten/ /mkha' 'gro'i gnas dang dngos grub kun gyi gzhi/ /bde gshegs rten dang ri bo la sogs pa/ /sgrub pa'i mchod rten brgyad po gshegs su gsol/ /de dag kun dang jeg pa so so yi/ /tha snyad rnams dang mthun par rten bzhengs pa'i/ /sprul pa'i mchod rten mtha' dag dang / /'gro ba'i don phyir gshegs su gsol/ /e bye hi dharma kā ya kha da la bh+yo bye dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya ste/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/de nas gdan 'bul ba ni/ dag pa'i me tog dkyil 'khor dang / /rin chen sna tshogs 'bru nyid dang / /thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i gdan/ /pad+ma'i gdan la gzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye hūṃ/de nas phyag bya ba ni/ mdzad pa rdzogs pa'i byen rlabs 4las byung ba'i/ /shar nas byams ldan mthar legs rdo rje rdzogs/ /lho nas yid bzhin lhun grub ka ni ka /nub nas bsam 'das bde byed pad+ma brtsegs/ /byang nas khams gsum rmad grags bde rgyas sgron/ /byin rlabs 5mchod rten brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bskor ba byas/ me tog gtor la/ de nas mchod pa rnams 25—/56

de nas smon lam gdab ste/ bdag cag gis 1dge spyor du bya ba ni/sems can 7snyemathun pa bskyed nas sa gzhi legs par stoms ju nas chag chag btab pas/ sems can thams cad byang chub kyi sems su mnyam gyur cig /rmang banying ste 'gyed 'dud btang nas rab gnas dang mchod pa gzhung bzhin du bgyis pas dge bcu'i lam spyod cing ma chags par gyur cig /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun lam la sbyor ba la/ tshogs kyi lam sbyor ba'i lam mthong ba'i lam bsgom pa'i lam bye/ mthar phyin pa'i lam mo/ /tshogs lam bzhi sum cu gnyis la bang rim dang po brtsigs te/ rab gnas dang mchod pa gzhung bzhin du bgyis pas tshogs phyokyi lam du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la/ lus dran pa nye bar gzhag thupa dang / tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag chopa dang /sems dran pa nye bar gzhag 7snapa dang / chos dran pa nye bar gzhag ⑩pa dang ldan par gyur cig /bang rim gsum pa brtsigs te rab gnas dang mchod pa gzhung bzhin du bgyis pas yang dag par spong ba bzhi la sdig pa'i chos mi skye ba dang / skyes pa spang ba dang dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang / skyes pa'i chos rnams 'phel ba'o/ /bang rim gsum pa brtsigs te/ de la rab gnas dang mchod pa gzhung bzhin bgyis pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la mos pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /sems la spyod pa rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang ldan pa dang / brtson 'grus dang ldan pa rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang ldan par gyur cig /bang rim bzhi pa brtsigs te/ brtson 'grus 25—457

kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po dang / dad pa'i dbang po dang ldan par gyur cig /bum rten nor bu brtsigs te/ de la rab gnas dang mchod pa gzhung bzhin du bgyis pas/ des mi mthun pa'i phyogs 'joms pas/ stobs lnga la dad pa'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang / dran pa'i stobs dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs lnga dang ldan par gyur cig /bum pa brtsigs te rab gnas dang mchod pa gzhung bzhin du bgyes pas/ mthong lam la/ byang chub yan lag bdun la dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang ldan par gyur cig /bye legs par brtsigs te/ de la rab gnas dang mchod pa gzhung bzhin du bgyis pas/ bsgom pa'i lam 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad la/ yang dag pa'i lta ba/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa/ yang dag pa'i ngag /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba/ yang dag pa'i dran pa/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad la rgyun du gnas par gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/2 chos kyi sku'i srog shing la/ srog shing phul ba'i byen rlabs kyis sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ pra marda na ye swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la/ 'khor lo phub pa'i 25—458

byin rlabs 1kyis mthar phyin pa'i sems can thams cad ma 'dres pa rnam par thar pa brgyad dang ye shes dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ bh+ra ma na ye swā hā/chos kyi sku'i mchod rten la 'gre/ gdugs 4phul ba'i byin rlabs 5kyis/sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i skyabs dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ rku bhe ra dh+wa dza ya 6swā hā/ chos kyi sku'i 'gre7/ chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis sems can la 'khor ba mi 9spong mi stongs shisakho/ mi nub pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan thob par gyur cig /oṃ pa tai kā ya swā hā/ chos kyi sku'i mchod rten la/ ba dan phul ba'i byin brlabs kyis/ chos kyi snyan grags bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par gyur cig /oṃ pa tai kā laspra ya kiswā hā/ chos kyi sku'i mchod rten la/ dar gyi cod pan phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i skur gyur te/ dar gye lhab lhub dang /bsnyen bkur —mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa thob par gyur cig / oṃ rat+na mā la rja/wīchos kyi me tog gi wīphreng ba phul bas/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang 7dpe byad kyis brgyan pa dang / blta bas chog mi shes par gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra da ra swā hā/ chos kyi dar dpyangs phul ba'i byin rlabs 1 kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres par so sor gsal bar gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa swā hā/ chos kyi dril bu phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi rnga thob par gyur cig /chos kyi me tog phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ rnam par thar pa mthar phyin pa'i lam la 'khor 'das dbyer mi phyed pa kun du bzang po lta bu thob par gyur cig /chos kyi sku'i mchod rten la nyi zla gnyis kyi rgyan phul 1ba'i byin rlabs nakyis/ rang 'byung gi chos rnams rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar gyur 25—459

cig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung rnams spyan drangs/ gdan phul phyag btsal hūṃmachod pa phul bas/ sa dang po nas sa bcu gcig gi bar dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab sa bcu pa dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje/ de gnyis dbyer med pa rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang gis khyobacu gsum pa ye shes thob par gyur cig /sku'i rab gnas ni/ mchod pa go rims gzhung bzhi bgyis la/ spyan dbye ste/spyan lnga rab rib rnam dag skyon bral ba/ /gsal dang mi gsal rnam rtog mi mnga' yang / /sri zuzhu bkur snyi rim gro'i tshul du ni/ /spyan gyi dbang po gsal ba'i tshul bstan nas/ /lha yi spyan dang rtag tu ldan gyur cig /ye shes spyan dang rtag tu ldan gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu swā hā/ lhan cig skyes pa'i nang gi gzugs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan la 'bul/ /gzugs kyi longs spyod rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ā ④lo ke hūṃ/ sgra skad kun la 'phrul 3gyi snyan mnga' ba/ /'on dang rmongs pa'i rnam rtog mi mnga' yang / /sri 9zhu bkur ste rim gro'i tshul tsam du/ /snyan gyi dbang po gsal ba'i tshul bstan nas/ /lha yi snyan dang rtag tu ldan gyur cig /snyan cing yid du 'ong ba'i sgra/ /sgra yi longs spyod rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hūṃ/ shangs kyi dbang po rnam dag skyon med pa/ /dri min dri ma'i rnam rtog mi mnga' yang / /srid 7zhu bkur ste rim gro'i tshul can byedu/ /shangs kyi dbang bo gsal ba'i tshul bstan nas/ /ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs gtor byas te/ /rnam par byang ba'i tshogs dang ldan gyur cig /lhan cig skyes pa nang gi dri/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi shangs la 'bul/ /dri yi longs spyod rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pu྾ hūṃ/ ljags kyi dbang po le brgan 'bar ba la/ /mngar rmyedang 25—460

kha yi rnam rtog mi mnga' yang / /sri dzozhu bkur ste rim gro'i tshul tsam du/ /ljags kyi dbang po gzhar po'i bye tshul bstan nas/ /gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu ldan pa dang / /'gro ba kun gyi sgra ru chos ston shog /ro brgya ldan pa bdud rtsi'i zas/ /lhan cig skyes pa nang gi ro/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi ljags la 'bul / /ro yi longs spyod rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ṣ+pe bi bye hūṃ / rgyal ba'i sku mchog lta bas mi 'bral yang / /'dod pa'i dri ma'i skyon gyis thum gos te/ /sri byezhu bkur ste rim gro'i tshul tsam du/ /ras mchog 'di yis rgyal ba'i sku phyis pas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa dang / /'gro ba kun gyi yid du 'ong bar shog /'jam mnyen 6'khril dang ldan pa'i mchog /lhan cig skyes pa nang gi reg /rgyal ba rnams kyi sku la mchod/ /reg bya'i longs spyod rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tisti sernyi ri hūṃpe/kun tu rtog pa ma lus pa/ /dri ma bral ba'i bdag nyid can/ /chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /bde gshegs gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams / /sgu ni mi yi rten 3la bzhugs/ /gsung ni brjod pa rnam par rgyal/ /thugs ni mnyam gzhag mi rtog kyang / /sems can rnams kyi don be+ed du/ /dbu yi gtsug byen yi ge oṃ/ /rnam snang yi ge phyogs bcur 'phros/ /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyong / /ljags kyi steng na yi ge saṃ/ /snang mtha' yi ge phyogs bcur 'phros/ /sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyong / /de nas mchod pa rnam pa lnga dbul/ bstod pa bya/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga slob dpon sdom pa bzang pos mdzad pa sgogs so// //25—461
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (954)25wa 463

1028༄༅/ /sbyin sreg gi cho gasnadagye/ /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la/ /ye shes me lce 'od 'bar gsal/ /'dod pa'i don grub dam pa ste/ /zhes pas/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bstan par bya ste/ de yang nub dang po lhan cig skyes pa'i bdud dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ de nas bar chod kyi bdud dang dbral bar bya ba'i phyir drag po'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /dang po thab zi dang rdzas kyi mtshan nyid bstan te zhi ba 5la dbyibs zlum po/ dpangs dang zheng du sor bzhi pa bya'o/ /rgyar khru gang kha dog dkar po'o/ /yang na chur mdzub gang / dpangs su chag gang ngo / /rdzas la me tog dang / dkar gsum mngar gsum gu gul dkar po de rnams so/ /drag po la zur gsum dpangs 6sor bzhi zheng 7chur khru re'o/ /rdzas khrag dang dug dang til nag dang nyungs nag liṅga dmar nag dang rdzas rnams thams cad nag po'o/ /dbang la 25—464

zla gam zhi ba'i phyed de kha khyer la'o/ /dpangs dang zheng gong dang 'dra/ rdzas dmar po la sogs pa bya'o/ /tsan+dan dmar po/ me tog dmar po/ mar dang nas smug po rnams so/ /rgyas pa la gru bzhi rtse khru gang zer/ zheng rngu khru gang ba/ sbom phra chag gang ba me tog la sogs pa'i rdzas thams cad ser por bsag go/ /thun mong gi mchod pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ mar dang 'bras dang sran ma dang / u dusmra rngura'o/ /dus ni zhi ba la —nyin phyed/ kha shar du blta'o—/ /drag po la nam phyed kha lhor bltas la bya'o/ /dbang la nyi ma nub ka kha nub tu bltas la bya'o/ /rgyas pa la dus snga dro kha byang du bltas la bya'o/ /dgang gzar ni zhi ba la dngul/ dbang la zangs/ drag po la lcags/ rgyas pa la gser las ④ bya'o/ /de nas me lha bskyed pa ni/ rang 'jam dpal du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ hūṃ dang dzaḥkhye'aphros pas thab bye kyi nang du babs/ hūṃ zhu ba las klugudher gyur/ dzaḥdze+elas lcags kyur gyur/ gudhe zhu ba las me lha sku mdog dkar por gyur/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ gsus pa ldir ba tshangs pa'i skud pas brgyan pa/ g.yas pa na gudhekye/ de 'og mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang po na se 'bru/ de 'og bgrang phreng ngo / /dzaḥrmyezhu ba las yum sku mdog ser mo g.yas lcags kyu g.yon phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /yab kyi g.yon ngos su 'khril par bsgom mo/ /me lha'i thugs kar me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum cig bsam/ bdag gi thugs ka nas me'i dkyil 'khor la rdzu ⑪cig 'phros de zhu ba las gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bsgom/ de'i nang du lha nyi shu rdzus muskyes su bsgom/rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa gsung ngo / /rdzus skyes ni/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ /dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /25—465

—de nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs sems dpa' che/ /lha yi rgyal po bram ze yin/ /'bar ba'i nang du gshegs nas kyang / /sreg 1rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes shig / abyā dṛ sh+ya i 2ku sha dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes gnyis su med par bsnyim/ de nas me lha la sreg rdzas dbul ba ni/ rdzas gong ma rnams dbul lo/ /oṃ wā sbi shwa ri sum̐/sarba ta thā ga ta asni 4ha bya ka bya zhi ba shādzhai ku ru swā hā/ rgyas pa la puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ dbang la ba bye ku ru swā hā/ drag po la mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā/ nyi shu rtsa gcig dbul lo/ /de nas me lha bstod de/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras / /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'jig rten yongs la bskyab pa'i phyir / /thugs rje dbang gis 5sku sprul pa/ /rig sngags 'dzin cing gsang sngags gsung / /bdud rtsi bcud ldan gudhe bsnams/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas/ /thugs rje'i sprul pa khyed la bstod/ /ces bstod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa 'bul 5te/ oṃ na maḥs man+ta mā ra ṇi 7zhi ba shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye zhi ba shādho ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ma le pa /—sha zhi ba shārnyi 7swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ba le zhi ba shādho ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ka ma ri zhi ba shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ti ti pra be zhi ba shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ rgyas pa la puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ dbang la ba bye ku ru swā hā/ drag po la mā ra ya phaṭa swā hās/ nyi shu rtsa gcig dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra pu྾ zhi ba shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ dhū pe zhi ba shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ badz+ra ā lo ke zhi ba shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ badz+ra gadhe zhi ba shān+ti ku ru swā hā/badz+ra nai bi bye zhi ba shāzhi ku ru swā hā/ badz+ra shab kizhi ba shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ baṃ 5bye ku ru pusbyo ku ru/ mā ra ya phaṭa/ mchod pa'i mjug tu re re brjod do/ /de nas 25— /66

bstod pa bya ba ni/ /gzhon nu'i sgu lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgon mes rab brgyan cing / /'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba'i/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nyid kyi 'dab bzang tshogs kyis ni/ /zla ba rgyas pa'ang kyezil gnon cing / /rig pa rnam par gsal 'gyur ba/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma bkyis don gyis zur gsal ba/ /nor bu 'bar ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /nyid ni kun du gsal ba'i sku/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdud rtsi dri zhim 'jam pa yi rte/ /yid 'ong gsum gyi sgra sgogs la/ /dam pa chos kyi rin chen mdzod/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal bstod / /gangs kyi chu ltar gsal ba la/ /'jig rten khams rnams rnam par bzhugs/ /nyon mongs dri ma rnam spangs pa/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mche ba gatshigs shing 'jigs pa yi / /'jigs pa'i sku yi tshul gyis ni/ /gshin rje'i dregs pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ras kyi spyan dang mdangs 'dra ba/ /ut+pal sngon po rab mdzes pa//shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /rgya che'i spyod pa rab ston pa/ /'gro ba'i lam ni ston pa po/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas 'dud pa 3nyi shus bstod do/ /de nas smon lam gdab ste/ bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang //gdug pa tshar ni gcad byupa dang / /'jig rten dbang du bsdu ba dang / /tshe dang dbang thang bskyed pa'i phyir/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsolaṣ+pe/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ/zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig sems dpa' bdag la bsdu/ /slob dpon sdom pa bzang pos mdzad pa sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdzogs so// //25—467

༄/ /thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi man ngag1 ༄gro/ /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thun mong gi dngos grub rin po che gter sgrub pa/ 'jam dpal gyi bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin du byas — 7la/ de nas grong khyer chen po'i dbus sam/ rgyal po'i pho brang du maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzhi pa byas la/ ba'i rnam lnga dang dri zhim po sna tshogs kyis byugs la/ glegs bam gru bzhi pa cig —la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bris la/ pad+ma'i lte ba la/ dze+e bha la'i gzugs ser po/ gsus pa che ba byin sha rgyas pa rgyan ma lus pas brgyan pa/ g.yas pa na bī cidza pū ra bsnams pa/g.yon pa na ṣ+pe'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams pa bum pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i mdun du gnod sbyin sku mdog ser po rin po che bsnams pa/ g.yas su cho gnod sbyin sku mdog dmar ser bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyab tu gnod sbyin sku mdog dkar po rin po che thogs pa/ g.yon du gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po 25byed469

ral gri thogs pa/1 shar lhor sku mdog ser skya ral gri bsnams pa/ lho nub tu sku mdog smug nag mdung thogs pa/ nub byang na sku mdog ser skya rin po che'i khang pa thogs pa/ byang shar na sgu mdog ser po gri phub thogs pa2 /g.yon thams cad rin po che'i rgyal mtshan thogs pa༄ / dar sna tshogs kyis thod bcings pa'o/ /yang glegs bam gru bzhi pa cig sngul pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa 5 lte ba la lha mo nor rgyun ma ser mo rin po che'i rgyan gyis 6brgyan pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa'o/ /lha mo brgyad kyang gtso mo'i cha lugs can no/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal gyi khar bum pa nas dang 'bras kyis bkang la gzhag 7go/ /de'i khar lha mo'i glegs bam bzhag la/ de'i khar dze+e bha la'i glegs bam gzhag /glegs bam gnyis kyi bar du rin po che'i ka ba gzugs/de la dgug gzhug legs par byas la bdag 'jam dpal du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'aphros pa hūṃme tog lug ru dang / dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis mchod la gtor ma sum treyar du gtang / mchod pa rnam lnga dbul/de'i mjug la 'khor dang longs spyod dngos grub stsol kye cig ces bya'o/ /nyin mo lha mo rnams kyi snying po bzlas te/ oṃ ba sun+t+ra rkyeri bye swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kabye swā hā / oṃ dadh+ri swā hā/ oṃ su dadh+ri swā hā/ oṃ ār+ya yi / swā hā/ oṃ su bha bye 6swā hā/ oṃ gubye swā hā/ oṃ de bye swā hā/ oṃ sa ra swa h+ye muswā hā/ zas sna tshogs kyi spugator mas mchod/ mchod pa rnam lnga dbul/ dngos grub blang ngo / /nub mo pho sngags te/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dā ya swā hā/oṃ pur+ṇa 7bha dā ya swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ba zla ya swā hā/ oṃ ki li mā la naye swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ni swā hā/ oṃ mu khed+dhā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa 25—470

reṭ+wā ya swā hā/ gtor ma dbul/ mchod pa lnga dbul/ dngos grub blang /'jam dpal gyi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i gtor ma la/ gnod sbyin pho mo la zla ba gsum du mchod pa tson 'dod pa phun sum tshogs so/ /me tog lug ru dang /gu gul dkar po dang / dkar gsum mngar gsum dang nas dang 'bru sna lnga'i sbyin sreg lan brgya rtsa brgyad byas na lha'i longs spyod dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /tho rangs bya ze tsa na pho sngags mo sngags zlos pa yin/ /chu sbyin yang nas yang du btang na longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan no/ /de yang 'dod pa'i don grub dam pa ste/ /gsung ngo / /'di ni rin po che gter gyi sgrub pa'o/ /rgyud las/ yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'chang / /gsung ngo / /thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi man ngag /slob dpon sdom pa bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //25—471

༄gro/ /dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal dbul te/maṇ+ḍal tshad dang ldan pa la/ ba'i rnam lnga byugs la badz+ra re khe hūṃ zhes pas dri zhim po'i 'de gu byas la byug pa bya/ oṃ haṃ ma hā me ra ba ye na maḥ snye/ oṃ yaḥg dza raṭ+wā ya na maḥ.oṃ ra pu ru ṣa raṭ+wā 1ya na maḥ/ oṃ la n+d+ra rad+dhā lgoya na maḥ/oṃ wa a shwa raṭ+wā khruya na maḥ/ oṃ ya sgyekhaṅga raṭ+wā ya na maḥ/ oṃ ra ma ṇi raṭ+wā ya na maḥ.oṃ waḥsarba ni dhi rku bhā 7ya na maḥ.oṃ la tsakra raṭ+wā ya na maḥ/ de ltar me tog tshom bu dgu dgur bya'o/ /paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma srur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal zhes gdan dbul lo/ /gdan de'i steng du tsadh+ri thupa la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams spyan drangs la/ de la phyag bya ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bskor ba bya/ de nas mchod pa bya ste/ mchod 25—473

pa chen po 'dod chags che/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar byed/ /mchod pa chen po zhe sdang che/ /nyon mongs kun gyi dgra che ba/ /mchod pa chen po gti mug che/ /gti mug blo ste gti mug sel/ /mchod pa chen po khro ba che/ /khro ba chen po dgra che ba/ /mchod pa chen po chags pa che/ /chags pa thams cad sel bar byed/ /'dod pa chen po bde ba che/ /dga' ba chen po mgu ba che / /oṃ badz+ra puste hūṃtshosna/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gabye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe bi bye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shaja nahūṃ/ de nas sdig pa bshags/chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab / de nas dge ba'i rtsa bar debasngo'o/ /de nas yi dam gyi maṇ+ḍal dbul te / maṇ+ḍal tshad dang ldan pa la/ dri'i 'de 4gu byug par bya/ oṃ badz+ra re khe hūṃ/ oṃ budha mañdzu shrī na maḥ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ na maḥ/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na hūṃ na maḥ / oṃ badz+ra pad+ma hūṃ na maḥ/ oṃ badz+ra karma hūṃ na maḥ/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ma srur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ 57de la ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug bya/ de nas phyag bya ste/ chos sku longs sgu sprul sku nyid/ /gzha' tshon nam mkha' dbyer med kyang / /rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen 'byung / /snang mtha' don yod grub pa la / /lus ngag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgon mas rab brgyan cing / /'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba'i/ /'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa gong dang mthun pa bshams 6nas dge ba'i rtsa bar bsngo ba yan chad gong dang mthun/ de nas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ yi ge brgya pa'i bshags pa bya/ bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal yi dam gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi nacho ga 'bro lo tsā bas bsgyur 25—474

ba cardotha/bsu theṭa// //bsdur mchan/473 17mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉ltar bkod/ 3 〈〈pe 〉sko/ ('di'o 'og gi rnam bcad rnams 〈〈pe 〉〉pa:'di ltar 'khod 'dug kyang bsdur mchan du bkod med/) ri da 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skab ra / ji〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyamar tā/ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torat+na/ kye〈〈pe〉〉〉:/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 ཿ/ ma/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyo/ 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mos/474 kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉spyi/ ('di'i 'og gi // rnams 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gsum la ༷ni zhes 'khod 'dug kyang bsdur mchan du bkod med/) 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shabha/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ ji〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sde/rgya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tshasdog pa bshags/ tshom〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wamaṇ+ḍal gyi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (957)25wa 475

༄/ /dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/she sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī e ka dza ṭī rdubha ga wān ༄ shāmaṇ+ḍal tsakra sā dha shaṃ / bod skad du/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku rang sems bde chen 'od gsal rnam mi rtog /'bar ba'i sku mchog sna tshogs tshul 'chang mkha' 'dra ba/ /longs spyod rdzogs sprul chos bdag dbyer med ro gcig tshul/ /ral pa gcig 'phyang rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gtso la 'dud/ /lnga phung dang ni dri ma bzhi/ /chen po bzhi dang spyod yul brgyad/ /rnam bzhi tshor ba rnam dag lha/ /ye shes 'khor lo 'dir bshad bya/ /dang po kho nar rnal 'byor pas bla ma mchog la rim gro yongs su rdzogs par byas te/ de'i bka' drin thob pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bdag po la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / ma smin pa la sogs pa thams cad la snying rje chen 25—476

pos go 'phang bla na med par sems bskyed la/ sgu gsung thugs ye shes rol pa'i nang du chud pas dbang bskur ba yang dag par bzung nas/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i de kho na nyid nges par 'byung ba 'di bsgom par bya'o/ /yid dang rjes su mthun lam bsam/ /dur khrod dang ni shing drung sogs/ /yang na bdag po'i tshul 'dra 'am/ /dngos grub gnas ni rgyud las bsngags/ /der bar chad bsal ba'i phyir gtor ma sbyin pa sngon du 'gro bas bka' bsgo zhing lha la sogs pa yang dag par mchod de sgrub pa'i don du gsol ba gdab par bya'o//gzhan yang ji snyed mchod pa'i yo byad dang / cho ga'i khyad par thams cad la dgos pa'i rdzas rnams thams cad bsags pa dang / gnas nye bar bkod pas dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rgyur gyur pa dang ci nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan ma 1mthong bar phyir mi nur 'bad pa dang / brtson pa drag pos spro bar bya'o/ /de nas sgrub po grudam tshig can/ /rab tu bde ba'i stan la 'dug /shel ltar dngas pa'i yid kyis su/ /tshogs rten dkyil 'khor dgug par bya/ /se gol gtogs pas 1lag pa gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur bcings te/ gar bskor nas mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar byas pas spyan drang ba dang / mdzub mo gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis mdud de 'khor lo ltar bzhag la gzhug par bya'o/ /oṃ e bye hi bha ga wān ngushrī/ e ka dza ṭī hūṃmaṇ+ḍal tsakra ma hā kā 6ru ṇi ka ho sa ma ya dzaḥs ma ste3/ sa ma ya hūṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥzhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so/ /bdag gi dad dang mgon po yis/ /thugs rje dang ni dam tshig gis/ /nam mkha' la ni nyi ma ltar/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po byon par 'gyur/ /ji skad 'chad par 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi rten ṣ+pebalta bas ma 9ngoms pa'i rnam 25—477

par bkod pa rgya chen po mdun snagyi nam mkha'i ngos la byon par bltas la bdag nyid kyi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ mthing nag las 'phros pa'i phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa thams cad kyis rab tu mchod nas gus pa drag pos sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /thog med dus nas de ring bar/ /mi dge gang bgyis so sor bshags/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dge ba la ni rjes yi rang / /ral pa gcig mchog lha dang sngags / /de yi sras la bdag skyabs mchi/ /bde chen 'od gsal rnam mi rtog /byang chub mchog sems snying rje gzung / / srid pa 3dus gsum tshogs bsags pa/ /de dag 'gro ba'i don phyir bsngo/ /bdag sogs mgon med mgon gyur pas/ /dngos grub bgyi phyir brtan pa dgongs/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi'i lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pos blo gros yongs su sbyongs blul/ chos thams cad rang bzhin kyis de kho na nyid ji lta ba bzhin du yid la bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyo3④haṃ/dngos kun ma lus bsdus pa'i sngags/ /rten cing 'byel par ⑤'byung ba che/ /de yi rang bzhin rang bzhin med/ /nam mkha' lta 'ubur mkhas pas bsgom/ /oṃ a sarba dharma pra tī sa mun+d+ra da spuhūṃ/ o shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā āt+pa ko3⑧haṃ zhes bya ba brjod do/ /stong pa nyid chen po'i ngang las re las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig las dag par byeskyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba chen po 6bsams la/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi lce rab tu rnon po 'khrigs pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / ra ba dang / dra ba dang / gur du grub par blta'o/ /de dbus a ṅku/dbyibs nam mkha' dri med la/ /in+d+ra byi ru dung 25—478

dang gser mdog can/ /yam̐ ram̐ baṃ lo gzhu dang me thab dang / /zla rgyas ri dbyibs de steng rnam par shes/ /de dag nyid gnas yongs su gyur pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gru bzhi pa dang ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa'o/ /dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang twa ra na la sogs pas mdzes par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shudhaḥ rmyesarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyophozhuhaṃ/ de'i dbus su bsgom par bya ba ni cung zad gyen du 'phags zhupa'i pad+ma'i sdong po kha phye ba'i steng du gnas pa dbang phyug chen bo dang /u ma de ba bltas la/ de'i steng du kā li las grub pa'i nyi ma dang / ā li las grub pa'i zla ba kha sbyor gyi nang du hūṃ dang baṃ gyi 4sa bon rab tu 'phro bar bsams te/ de gyur pa las rdo rje gri gug dang thod pa snying po gnyis nyid kyis mtshan par blta zhing / yang 'od zer can gyi 'umadzad pa yongs su bsgrub pas/bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa ral pa gcig pa sku mdog mthing nag g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhabs bskum pa dang brkyangs pas 6'jigs byed dang /dus mtshan mnan cing brdzis pa/ zhal gsum dang phyag drug pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bo nyid shin tu dbang du gyur pa'i/ dbu skra dmar ser ral pa'i thor cog gcig tu 'phyang ba/ rdo rje ral pa gcig ma dang lhan cig mchog tu dga' bas 'khyud pa/ rdo rje dang rin po che dang rus pa dang sbrul gyi )rgyan gyis brgyan cing / phyag rgya drug gis nye bar spras pa/ mi mgo mang po'i phreng ba'i do shal brgyud pa dang / ḍa ma ru dang / g.yer kha dang / sel khrol gyi rgyan dpyangs 3snapa/ keng rus kyi thod pa dang / lag pa rlon pa dang / u dusmra rngura'i me tog gi phreng bas dbu spras pa/ glang po che'i pags rngupa dang / stag gi pags nyu1 pas g.yogs shing smad dkris pa/ cung zad khros pa'i cha byad can/25—479

'jigs par byed pa'i gad mo dgod cing zhal mche ba cung zad gcigs pa'i bar nas me stag rnam par 'phro ba/ nyid kyi sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 1 dpung chen po rnam par 'khyil pa'i dbus na gar gyi rol pas nye bar mdzes pa'i bdag nyid do/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal spyan gsum/ /phyag drug gri gug thod pa ral gri dang / /ut+pal 'khor lo tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin / /ji bzhin zhal phyag yum ni dmar ba'o/ /de nas snyom rngupar 'jug pa'i spyor ba las lha'i 'khor lo dbyung bar bya ste/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la lhung ba'i sa bon ni/ a i u e zhes bya ba ste/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i sbubs su chud cing dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang gu'i kha dog can gu'od kyi sbyor bar 'khor lo dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang rdo rje rgya gram snying po de nyid kyis mtshan par gang gyur pa'o/ /de dag yongs su gyur pa ni rdo rje 'khor lo dang rdo rje rin chen dang rdo rje pad+mo dang / rdo rje sna tshogs rnams su grub par blta'o/ /de dag gi sa bon ni rang gi nye ba'i rgyu'o/ /sku mdog ni sa bon gyi kha dog go/ /byang shar la sogs pa mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la ni sa bon gyi 'od zer las mngon par grub pa'i dre chen dang dri chu dang / rak+ta dang /byang chub kyi sems yongs su dag pa'i bdag nyid kyi bum pa ka pā las mtshan pa dag blta'o/ /de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la shar nas brtsams pa'i rim gyis phyogs bzhir lhung ba'i sa bon ni/ ā yī spru e zhes bya ba ste/ snga ma bzhin du dkar bo dang ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu'i kha dog can no/ /nyi ma dang zla ba'i sbubs su chud cing 'od kyi sbyor bas sgon ma dang /rdo rje dang / zhags pa dang / ral gri dang / snying po de nyid kyis ④mtshan 25—480

par gang gyur pa'o/ /de dag yongs su gyur pa ni gti mug rdo rje dang bag chags rdo rje dang / 'dod chags rdo rje dang / zhe sdang rdo rje rnams su grub par blta'o/ /de dag gi phyag mtshan ni rang gi nye ba'i rgyu'o/ /sku mdog ni sa bon gyi kha dog go/ /byang shar la sogs pa mtshams kyi rtsibs bzhir lhung ba'i sa bon ni/ o au i aḥzhes bya ba ste/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i sbubs su chud cing ser po dang dkar po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu'i kha dog can no/ /'od kyi sbyor bas ri rab dang zla ba dang / nyi ma dang ba dan dang / snying po de nyid kyis mtshan par gang gyur pa'o/ /de dag yongs su gyur pas ni brtan pa'i rdo rje ma dang / sbyor ba'i rdo rje ma dang / 'bar ba'i rdo rje ma dang /stobs kyi rdo rje ma zhes bya ba'i lha mor mngon par grub par blta'o/ /de dag gi phyag mtshan ni rang gi nye ba'i rgyu'o/ /sku mdog ni sa bon gyi kha dog go/ /dpal ldan lha tshogs 'di dag thams cad kyang / /nyi zla dbugs bral gdan la brjid pa dang / /g.yon phyag bde chen ros gang thod pa 'dzin/ /rin chen rus pa sbrul rgyan mtshungs pa yin/ /de bzhin du khyams shar la sogs pa phyogs bzhir lhung ba'i sa bon ni/ ka tsa ṭa ta zhes pa ste/ dkar po dang / sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po'i kha dog can nyi ma dang zla ba'i sbubs su chud cing 'od kyi snasbyor bas me long dang / pi wang dang dri mchog dang / zhal zas snying po de nyid kyis mtshan par gang gyur pa'o/ /de dag yongs su gyur pa ni gzugs rdo rje ma dang / sgra rdo rje ma dang / dri rdo rje ma dang / ro rdo rje ma'i lha mo rnams mngon par grub par blta'o/ /de dag gi phyag mtshan ni rang gi nye ba'i rgyu'o/ /sgu mdog ni sa bon gyi kha dog go/ /byang shar la sogs pa'i 25—7/81

—khyams kyi grar lhung ba'i sa bon ni/ sa hūṃya sha k+ṣa zhes pa ste/ ljang gu dang /dkar po dang / sngon po dang / dmar bo'i kha dog can/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i sbubs su chud cing / 'od kyi sbyor ba ni na )bza' dang / chos 'byung dang / maṇ+ḍal dang / mar mes mtshan par gang gyur pa'o/ /de dag yongs su gyur pa ni/ reg bya rdo rje ma dang / chos rdo rje ma dang / zhing snyerdo rje ma dang / snang ba rdo rje ma'i lha mo rnams mngon par grub par blta'o/ /de dag gi phyag mtshan ni rang gi nye ba'i rgyu'o/ /sku mdog ni sa bon gyi kha dog go/ /de nas shar la sogs pa'i sgo bzhir yang de bzhin du blta bar bya ste/ ṛ dkar po las byung ba'i lcags kyu yongs su gyur pas ni rdo rje lcags kyu'o/ /dzā ser po las byung ba'i zhags pa yongs su gyur par ni thurdo rje zhags pa'o/ /'-i khyedamar po las byung ba'i lcags sgog skyoyongs su gyur pas ni rdo rje lcags sgog go/ /khru ④ ljang gu las byung ba'i dril bu yongs su gyur pas ni rdo rje dril bu'o/ /khyams na bye lha brgyad pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan/ /rin chen rus brgyan skyil krung phyag mtshan gcig/sgo bzhir gnas ni nyi zla dbugs bral gdan/ /sbrul rgyan stang stabs g.yon phyag ka pā la'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa'i khor yug chen po la ni grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba ste/ ji skad du/ gtum drag tshang 1tshing dkrigs pa dang / /'ur 'ur 'bar bas skyekhyab pa dang / /keng rus 'jigs rung shar sogs kyi/ /phyogs su g.yon skor gyis legs gnas//ha ha dgod pa dbang ldan du/ /byin zar dpal kyi nags tshal lo/ /mun pa mi tso1bzad bden bral du/ /rlung du tī la mutī lar sgogs/ /zhes byung ba bzhin no/ /de dag re rer yang shing dang phyogs skyong dang klu dang / sprin 25—482

dang zhing skyong dang / dgra bcom pa dang / grub pa dang mkha' 'gro dang /mchod rten dang / me dang chu chen po la sogs pa brgyad brgyad yod par blta'o/ /1de'i 'og tu bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor chen po'i bdag nyid ༄23shin tu mi 'phrogs 1pa'i bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ros rab tu 'jus ④pas ha cang dga' bas mi zad pa'i ngo bor mos shing / rim gyis stong pa nyid du thim par gyur te/ bcom ldan ma dang lhan cig tu zhu nas rab tu dang ba'i gzugs can gyi nā da dkar ba dang dmar ba'i rnam par gnas par bsam mo/ /de'i tshe phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhir rgyal ba bzhi'i thugs ka las tshad med bzhi'i lha mo sprul pas sems can gyi don du slar ldang bar gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /'jig rten mgon po bcom ldan bzhengs/ /'gro ba nyon mongs yongs su skyobs/ /stong pa'i ting 'dzin spangs nas su/ /byams chen sgu mchog bltams par mdzod//thugs rje chen po bcom ldan bzhengs/ /sems can sdug bsngal rab tu sgol/ /zhi ba'i mtha' la gyemi gnas par/ /brtse chen rnam par 'phrul par mdzod/ /bde chen rgyal po bcom ldan bzhengs/ /lus can bde don yang dag gzigs/ /zag sped dbyings thugs ma gzhom par/ /dgyes chen kun du snang bar mdzod/ /gtso chen rdo rje bcom ldan bzhengs/ /skye bo dub pa mngon dgongs la/ /mtha' gcig rgyun chad mi bzhugs par/ /ma lus 'tshal 6ba sgrub tu gsol/ /zhes bya ba'i glus kyeganyid sad pa dang 'dra bar byas te/ slar sa bon gyi yi ge gnyis dang mtshan ma gnyis las bcom ldan 'das yab dang yum mngon par grub pa'i rim pa sngar ji skad smos pa bzhin du sprul par bya'o/ /gsang sngags las grub 'khor los zusgyur rgyal bzhin/ /khrag 'thung 9ral pa gcig 'phyang thugs 25—483

rje yi/ /dbyings las sku bltams mkha' las nyi ma ltar/ /ma lus don grub 'bar ba de rjes bsam/ /de nas gzhal yas khang dang lha byernam par dag pa khong du chud par bya ste/ 'di skad du mi mnyam med pas zur bzhi yin/ dran dang dbang po'i sgo bzhi yin/ /bsam gtan bzhi ni rta babs bzhi/ /rnam thar brgyad phyir ka ba brgyad/ /byang chub yan lag bdun dag phyir/ /dra ba dang ni dra ba phyed/ /phyogs bzhi tshad med bzhi yin te/ /pad+ma 'khor lo shes rab thabs/ /rnam par shes brgyad yongs dag pa/ /de ni dur khrod chen po brgyad / /ces bya ba lta bu dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa gang yin pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa yang / /re zhig zla ba ni me long lta bu'i kyerang bzhin no/ /nyi ma ni mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /sa bon dang mtshan ma ni so sor kun du rtogs jepa'i rang bzhin no/ /yongs su gyur pa ni bya ba grub pa'i rang bzhin no/ /gzugs brnyan nye bar rdzogs pa ni/ /chos kyi dbyengs kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa ni dpal rdo rje ral pa gcig pa'o/ /gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje 'khor lo'o/ /tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje rin chen no/ /'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa ni 5rdo rje pad+ma'o/ /'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje sna tshogs so/ /gti mug rnam par dag pa ni gti mug rdo rje'o / /bag la nyal rnam par dag pa ni bag chags rdo rje'ogye/ /'dod chags rnam par dag pa ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /zhe sdang rnam par dag pa ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams rnam par dag pa be+e brtan pa'i rdo rje ma'o/ /chu'i khams rnam par dag pa ni spyor ba'i rdo rje ma'o/ /me'i khams rnam par dag 25— 481

pa ni 'bar ba'i rdo rje ma'o/ /rlung gi khams rnam par dag pa ni stobs kyi rdo rje ma'o / /gzugs rnam par dag pa ni gzugs rdo rje'o1/ /sgra rnam par dag pa ni sgra rdo rje ma'o/ /dri rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje ma'o/ /ro rnam par dag pa ni ro rdo rje ma'o/ /reg rnam par dag pa ni reg rdo rje ma'o/ /chos rnam par dag pa ni chos rdo rje ma'o/ /zhing rnam par dag pa ni zhing rdo rje ma'o/ /snang ba rnam par dag pa ni snang ba rdo rje ma'o/ /tshor ba bde ba rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje lcags kyu'o/ /tshor ba sdug bsngal rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje zhags pa'o/ /tshor ba btang snyoms rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje lcags sgrog go/ /de dag gi bag chags rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje 4dril bu'o/ /'od gsal bde chen mi rtog rtag chad rnam par dag /pad+mo thod pa dbugs bral dbang phyug u ma'i gdan/ /dus gsum mthar phyin skyob drug thabs dang shes dag phyir/ /zhal gsum phyag drug phyag rgya drug zhabs brgyad 5bskum nyid/ /de bzhin du rdo rje 'khor lo la sogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyi gdan dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa rnam par dag pa yang ci rigs su rig par bya'o/ /gang yang dkyil 'khor pa la rgyas gdab pa'i phyag rgya lnga'am drug kyang rnam par rig par bya ste/re zhig bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal ba'i don du spyi gtsug tu 'khor lo ste/de ni mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid rnam par dag pa'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bsgo ba nyan pa'i phyir rna ba la rna cha ste/ de'i 'od dpag med kyi bdag nyid rnam par dag pa'o/ /gsang sngags zab mo bzlas pa'i phyir mgul ba la mgul do ste/ de ni rin chen 'byung ba'i bdag nyid rnam par dag pa'o/ /srog chags thams cad la 'tshe ba spangs pa'i phyir 7lag pa la lag gdub ste/ de ni 25—485

rnam par snang mdzad kyi bdag nyid rnam par dag pa'o/ /phyag rgya nye bar bkod pa bstan pa'i phyir rked pa la dze+eske rags te/ de ni don yod grub pa'i bdag nyid rnam par dag pa'o/ /rang gi shes rab dang 1/lhan cig pa'i phyir tshom bu ste/de ni ral pa gcig pa'i bdag nyid rnam par dag pa'o/ /de nas gzhal yas khang gi cha nyi shu rtsa bzhi shar gyi 'dab ma nas brtsams te byang gi sgo'i bar yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir rnam par dag pa sbyar bar shes par bya zhing rang gi lus kyi cha nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir rnam par dag pa lha dang sbyar ba yang rtogs par bya ste / dang po kho nar de kho na nyid kyi gnas snying gi dbus su dpal rdo rje ral gcig pa'o zhes pa 'di ni khyad par ro/ /pul+lī ①ra mā ④la ya mgo la rdo rje 'khor lo zhes pa nas/ dzā lan+ta ra spyi gtsug dang / / au byen rngurna ba g.yas/ /arbu dā ⑥ste glad pa'i rgyab/ /go dā wa ④ri rna ba g.yon/ /ra me dushwa ra smin ma'i dbus/ /de bī spuko ṭa mig gnyis dang / /ma la wa ni phrag pa gnyis/ /kā skyem ru pa ⑫ni mchan khung gnyis/ / o tre ⑫nu ma gnyis yin no/ /tri sha ku ṣ+pe lte ba dang / /ko sa la ni sna yi rtse/ /ka lo ga ⑫ni kha nyid de/ /laspra ④ka ni mgul pa'o/ /kāñtsi ⑫snying gi rtse mo dang / /hi ma la ya lgang ba gnyis/ /pre ta pu ri mtshan ma dang / /kṛ ha de ba gsang ba'i gnas/ /sau rāṣ+ṭa ⑩ni brla gnyis te/ /su bar+ṇa dī pa mubyin pa gnyis/ /na ga ra ni sor mo rnams/ /sen+t+ra /rkang pa'i rgyab tu'o/ /ma ru mje bo rnam gnyis te/ /ku lu tā ⑪ni pus mo gnyis/ /rdo rje dril bu zhes bya ba'i bar du grangs ji lta ba bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o—/ /de rjes yab dang yum rim rdo rje sngon po dang / /pad+ma dmar po'i rgyas gdab go cha drug drug bcing / /dud mdog ha nyi hu he ho haṃ zhes dang /25—486

khrag mdog a i u e o dang i nyid do/ /de la snying gar ni ha'o/ /mgo bo la ni hi'o/ /spyi gtsug tu hu'o/ /phrag pa gnyis ni te'o/ /mig gnyis la ni ho'o / /yan lag thams cad la ni haṃ ngo / /de bzhin du lte bar ni a'o/ /snying gar ni i'o/ /khar k+ṣeni u'o/ /mgo la ni e'o/ /spyi gtsug tu o'o/ /yan lag thams cad la ni saṃ ngo / /de'i 'og tu dam tshig pa'i 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa nyid brtul zhugs dang / cho ga de kho na nyid kyis byin gyi 3rlabs bcug pas nges par brten 1par bya ba'i don du/ ye shes pa'i 'khor lo dri ma med pa de spyan drangs tethu/ yang dag par gzhug ༄par bya'o/ /mdzub mo mdud byas gung mo rtse sprad cing / /mje bong rdo rje brtan por dzirab tu sbyar/ /sor mo gzhan kyegadengs dpral ba'i dbus gzhag sal/ /bskor zhing bskor bas yongs su bsgyur bar bya/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas mnan gyen du blta/ /mig sgyur dze gyi rngusgra sgrogs pas/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs dgug /ces bya ba 'di lta bus nyid kyi ⑫gnas nas dam tshig rjes su dran pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i ngos 'dir mngon par byon par gyur tophya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhe ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri 1 ye hūṃ/ thog mar sku khrus gsol ba'o/ /oṃ pā bye 5pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhal —bsil dbul ba'o/ /oṃ añtsa mā muni pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhabs bsel ba'o/ /oṃ pad+ma srur+ya tsaṇ+ḍa pomaṇ+ḍal ma ye swā hā/ gdan dbul lo༄ / /de nas thog mar lus thams cad nye bar 'dud pas phyag byas te/ gang zhig sna tshogs ro gcig dbang po'i gzhu 'dra ba/ /nyon mongs rdul bral bde chen 'od gsal spros bral zhing / /ye shes rgyun 'bab rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung la/ /gus pa'i khur gyis 4 8mgrin pa smad nas 25—487

bdag phyag 'tshal/ /de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas dbul bar bya ste/oṃ badz+ra pu྾ āḥrtehūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥ trehūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe ā hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gabye āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nai bi bye aḥ hūṃ/ lan gsum rngugasum gyis so/ /kha dog sna tshogs dri zhim dbyebs mdzes me tog dang / /bdug spos a ka ru dang sbrul gyi snyeng po dang / /snod mdzes rin chen sgron me snang ba drir bcas dang / /chu gtsang dri mchog snying po sbyor tshib dpag med dang / /mdog bzang ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas mang po rnams/ /gus bcas yid 'ong lha mchog tshogs la 'bul lags kyis/ /sems can ma lus srid pa'i gdung ba zhi ba dang / /zag med bde chen ye shes bdud rtsis myos par mdzod/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wān 7e ka dza ṭī 8/sarba maṇ+ḍal tsakra de ba tā shepu྾ pu dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes pa nas/ ṣ+pe bi bye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba'i bar du sbyar bas dbul bar bya'o/ /pi wang gling bu rdza rnga rnga zlum bzhad ma dang //sgeg mo glu ma gar ma gzugs mdzes ro dang reg /maṇ+ḍal chos ma rgyan sogs de bzhin bkod pa ni/ /zab cing rgya che rgya mtsho sprin 'phro gzhan yang mchod/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra bi ni hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra baṃ se hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra murdzi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ1rtemṛ tai ge hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra hā 1 gye hūṃ/ nyu oṃ āḥbadz+ra gī ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dṛrti mu dh+ri / oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā skedasgo hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra se hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra spak+ṣe /nahūṃ/oṃ āḥbadz+ra maṇ+ḍa le hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dharme hūṃ/ oṃ a badz+ra sarba a lam̐ kā ཿ— re hūṃ/oṃ āḥbadz+ra sarba pū dzāza ske gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya 21hūṃ/ 'di dag ni phyi'i yo byad kyi mchod pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas rgun 'brum mam bu ram shing la sogs pa las btung ba bzang po 25byed( 88

sbyar te/ mtshan ma bzang po'i ka pā la gang bar byas nas sgron ma dang /bdud rtsi'i ro dang lhan cig tu gyur pa mdun du gzhag 1ste snod sbyangs la/ oṃ ardo snaḥbadz+ra ma hā sa ma ya ho zhes bya bas dam tshig dran par bya'o/ /man ngag ji bzhin pas lag pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byen gyis brlabs te/ g.yas kyi mthe bong dang / mdzub mo dang / gung mo dang / srin lag dang / mje'u chung dang / lag mthil rnams la go rims ltar/ ha hi hu he ho haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i yig 'bru gnas 4la dkar ba dang / sngo ba dang / ser ba dang /dmar ba dang / ljang ba dang / mthing ga'i mdog can yab kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer reg pa las yongs su gyur pa'i gzugs kun du 'od dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / nor gyi dbyig dang / 'od zer can 5dang las kyi bde dang / 'jigs byed rgyal po rnams/ g.yon zla ba'i gdan la rnam par gnon cing / g.yas skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis mngon par dgyes pa rang gi sa bon gyi kha dog can/ 'khor lo la sogs pa sangs rgyas lnga'i mtshan ma dang / gri gug gis g.yas kyi phyag mtshan pa dang / thams cad kyang g.yon na khrag gi thubadud rtsis rab tu gang ba'i thod pa can no/ /de bzhin du g.yon gyi mthe bo la sogs par yang grangs ji lta bas/ a i u e o i zhes bya ba'i yig 'bru gnas pa shaṃl dkar ba dang / sngo ba dang / ser ba dang /rab tu dmar ba dang / ljang gu dang / sesgo ra'i mdog can/ yum gyi thugs ka'i baṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer reg pa las yongs su gyur pa'i gzugs rab gsal ma dang / rab brtan ma dang / rgyan can ma dang / 'od 'chang ma dang / tshogs can ma dang / skrag mdzad ma rnams g.yas nyi ma'i 25—489

gdan la 1gnon cing g.yon gyi skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis yongs su dgyes ma/rang gi sa bon gyi kha dog can 'khor lo la sogs pa sangs rgyas ①lnga'i mtshan ma dang / ka pā la g.yas kyi phyag mtshan pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon na khrag gi kyebadud rtsis rab tu gang ba'i thod pa can no/ /de nas go cha de dag la ye shes kyi lha yang dag par bkug ste/ dam tshig la bcug nas yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod cing thal mo mnyam par sbyar bas phan tshun rjes su zhugs pa dang /de bsdams pas phan tshun yongs su thim par blta'o/ /gang thim par gyur pa de yang hūṃ a zhes gsung mthon pos bos pas stong pa nyid dang thig ler mi gnas par yi ge gnyis kyi gegazugs su mngon par blta bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas g.yas kyi srin lag gis dzidam tshig la reg cing chos 'byung bsnol thub bri bar bya ste / zur drug la go cha'i yi ge drug brjod pas yi ge de dag gis mtshan par bye bya ba dang / de'ang g.yas kyi mthil gyi sa bon hūṃ las mngon par skyes pa'i rgyun bdud rtsir 'dzag pa nas 'byung ba'o/ /de bzhin du g.yon pa'i srin lag gis dam tshig can la reg cing chos 'byung bsnol ba sngar gyi rjes su bris pas 'og tu gsal bar bya ste/ zur drug la go cha ma'i yi ge drug brjod pas yi ge de dag gis mtshan par bya ba dang /spu de'ang g.yon gyi mthil gyi sngar gyi sa bon a las mngon par skyes pa'i rgyun bdud rtsi 'dzag pa nas 'byung ba'o/ /mthar g.yas dang g.yon gyis yab dang yum gyi cho ga'i 1bye dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su reg pas ho dang baṃ lhan cig gnas pa yang bltas la/ se gol gtogs te ⑪ ha cang mi ring ba'i steng gi mkhar 'phags par bzhugs so/ /de rjes g.yas g.yon snying gar zla ba nyi ma dang / /chu skyes dbus nas sku gsung thugs bltas 25—/90

ming brjod pas/ /dkar bsel dmar tsha rab tu sngo 'jam 'od reg phyir/ /dri med rab bzhu lha tshogs sbyor 1bas bdud rtsi dbab/ /de ltar 'od kyis bskul sneb na dbus kyi yi ge las gyen du 'greng ba'i zer gyi cho ga dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das yab yub spyan drangs nas nam mkha'i yi ge la bstems te/de ma thag tu lha bcu bzhi'i bdag nyid du gyur nas snyoms par zhugs pa dang /thams cad kyi spyor mtshams nas thig le bdud rtsi rgyun ltung 4bas dam tshig bzhu ba'i khu ba bsil zhing rnam par dkar ba gya nom par bya'o/ /rim gyis bde ba chen po'i ro ma bzod pa'i khyephyir go cha bcu bzhi stso'od kyi rnam par zhu ba bdag po la thim pa dang / de yang mi 'phrogs pa'i dga' bas rnam par myos pa'i phyir sa bon gyi ngo mtshar zhu bar ④bsam mo/ /de nas baṃ ho brjod pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ro can rnam pa thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan byed par blta'o / /de bzhin du yi ge de yang rtsa ba'i yi ge la thim zhing de yang 'od kyi gong bur zhu bas dam tshig la khyab par bstems la/ /ma lus pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mnyes par gyur pas dgyes pa'i rgyur byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje thal mo'i gar sgyur ba dang ldan pas yang dag par mchod par bya'o/ /'di dag ni nang gi dam tshig gis mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /lte ba'i dbus las byung ba yis/ /dpal mo dang ni sgra ldan ma/ /dung can ma dang bdud rtsi 'dzag /dga' byed ma dang myos byed ma/ /zhing skyong ma dang 'od kyi dpung / /sna tshogs glu gar rol mo byed/ /rdzas bcu dag pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /pad+ma'i snod thogs mchod par bsamabye / /gtso chen dur khrod bcas dkyil 'khor/ /dngos dang bdag po las sprul pa'i/ /shes rab 25—491

thabs ldan stoms zhug hūṃpas/ /zag med bde chen myos gyur mchod/ /dga' ba chen po 'od skyed de/ /lus can kun gyi sdug bsngal bsal/ /slar 'dus chags pa chen po'i ro/ /sad 3par byas te snying rjes bslang / /'di dag ni gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i khyad par ro/ /de'i 'og tu sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa rang nyid kyi phrin bye las la nye bar sbyar bar bya ste/ 'bras bu mi bzad rang bzhin mi dge dpag med dang //bgyi ba ma lags —thub pa'i bka' palas 'das gyur gang / /zab mo legs sngags dam tshig rdo rje'i rgya dral ba/ /ring nas gang bsags sdig pa'i phung po de ring bshags/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po rgyal ba yab yum 'gro don brtson/ /lha tshogs sras mang de yi rjes 'jug phrin 6las byed/ /sngags 'chang rnams kyang nyin re mchod pa'i las brtson pa/ /ma lus ngo mtshar bsod nams rgya mtsho rjes yi rang / /khrag 'thung meye shes dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsal ba la/ /thugs rje'i rgyun gyis zag med snyoms 'jug rol pa dang / /'bar ba'i 'od bkye gsang sngags rgyal po bka' bsgo zhing / /bla med lam ston chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /stong par bzhugs dang ha cang mi bsnyel bye zhi ba dang / /sgrub po gang zhig dam tshig med dang bag med la/ /sdang rmyemadzad snyoms mdzad mi snang ston par bzhed rnams la/ /gdung bas ji srid dngos grub bar du brtan bzhugs gsol/ /sku gsung rang bzhin ral pa gcig mchog ston pa dang / /de yi nyer khobastan rim gnyis bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dra'i chos/ /rjes 'jug blo bzang go cha bzang la rtul phod pa/ /mnyam med skyabs mchog rin chen gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /shin tu ngo mtshar de nyid snying pos kun khyab kyang / /25—7 92

ma rtogs sdug bsngal rnam mang skyon gyis gzings pa yi/ /mgon med gnyis —1tshogs 'gro ba nam mkha' mnyam pa'i phyir/ /sa gsum dbang phyug rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs thob bgyi/ /rdo rje 'khor lo 2pad+ma las kyi rigs/ /ji bzhin ji snyed dam tshig sdom pa ma lus gzung / /gang zhig sngon chad ma smin ma sgrol ma bsgral ba/ /de dag smin cing myur grol bsgral phyir bdag gis 'bad/ /nyi zla'i spyor bas mun pa zad 'gyur grong mchog lam/ /bdud rtsi sgron ma chu gter yid 'ong rin po che/ /rdul med rdul bral ye shes dbang phyug phyag rgya che/ /bde chen 'od gsal mi rtog 'phrul pa thob par shog /de rjes gzhan yang sna tshogs mchod byas bstod sprin rgya mtsho rab bstod de/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bor 4dbang bskur phyir ni gsol btab rtse gcig yid kyis 'dug /de nas des sprul snying ga las 'ongs bde gshegs lnga bdag lha mo lngas/ /rnam dag ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun phab bdag lus ngag yid dag par bya/ / rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par smin/ / phyornam par 'joms dang rnam mtshan bral/ /dga' dang mchog dga' dga' 'ubral dang / /lhan cig skyes dga'i mtshan nyid do/ / dgod dang 'phrad ④/'khyud 'khrig pa dag /rnam par dag phyir bum pa dang / /gsang dbang shes rab bde ba che/ /dbang bzhir rgyal po thob par 'gyur/ /tha ma'i thigs pas rigs 'jog pa/ /gtso bo mi bskyod rdo rjes mtshan/ /rdo rje 'khor lo la sogs bzhi/ /'khor lo la sogs bzhi nyid do/ /gti mug rdo rje sogs bzhi yang / /'khor lo la sogs rim bzhin te/ /sbyor ba'i rdo rje ma la sogs/ /mtshams bzhir bdag po'i rgya nyid dam/ /yang na 'khor lo sogs chorim nyid/ /de bzhin gzugs mdzes rdo rje sogs 9/ /25—/93

'khor lo la sogs rim bzhin te/ /phyogs bzhir reg bya rdo rje sogasanyu/ /grangs bzhin rigs bzhin rtanyid dang ni/ /gtso bo'am rim de nyid bzhin brtag /de nas mdun gye nam mkha' la gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid cher dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / mnyes par bya ba'i phyag rgya dang / sngags kyis rang gi dam tshig la mngon par gzhug par bya'o/ /rdo rje thal sbyar mdzub gnyis bkug /rdo rje bsdams pa nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin mje bong gnyis nang bcug /slar yang gar bskor 'di yi rgya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥde ltar dpal ldan dam tshig che bkod ye shes mthu ldan ro gcig gis/ /sgrub po mkhas 4rnams nga rgyal brtan gnas dngos grub mchog phyir be+er yang ni/ /gsang sngags rgyal po don kun sgrub byed nyi shu drug bcas mgal me'i tshul/ /de bzhin gang yang sngags rigs gzhan bzlas rang rang dbus gnas 'od 'phro ba'o//oṃ yo ga shudhaḥsarba dharmā muyo ga shusgophokhyahaṃ/ dpal chen dpal shaṃmo chen gnyis thugs / /'dam skyes dmar dbus hūṃ dang baṃ/ /kha dog sngon po dmar bsams la/ /de mtha' nyid gnyis sngags kyis bskor/ /oṃ āḥsarba ta thā ga to gasgo badz+ra ta twa dz+nyā na dzā rul hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ā sarba ta thā ga to mā tri kyebadz+ra ta tā pa ya spa ra ṇa baṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyi sngags so/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dz+nyā na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥbadzo pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyi nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra tsakra a hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rat+na e 6hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ṣ+ṭabadz+ra pad+ma u hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra bi shwa e hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/oṃ āḥbadz+ra mo ha ā hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ba ra na nyu1yī hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā ga spru hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dz+wa ṣa e hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ oṃ25—194

badz+ra spri ra o lam̐hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra yo ga au hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dz+wa la e guhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ba la aḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rū pa ni ka hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ aXbadz+ra shaja tsa hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dha ṭa hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra sa ta hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra spar+ṣa pa hūṃ phaṭa sru hā/oṃ āḥbadz+ra dharma ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra k+ṣe tra sha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā lo ka k+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra e ku sha ṛ 4hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā sha dzā /rnguhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ban+dha lo 6hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa lbo 3hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lha nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i snying po'i sngags so/ /yi ge re re 'bum phrag gang yin yab yum mnyes byed yin bshad gzhan/ /pad+ma dang ni 'khor lo'i lha dang khyams bcas go rims bzhin/ /'bum phrag gsum dang gnyis dang gcig bzlas mngon sum gzhal yas khang / /mthong ba'am rmi lam brtan rudang gsal snang mchog thob ting 'dzin mthu grub brtan pa'i ltas/ / /dmigs pas dub par gyur pa dang / /rtse gcig bsam gtan go 'phang gnyer/ /rim pa gzhan yang goms 'dod pas/ /de nas rnam par mi rtog bsgom/ /spyi yi snying ga lte bar ni/ /zla ba pad+ma nyi steng du/ /haṃ dang hūṃ dang saṃ zhes kyi/ /yi ge bde gsal mi rtog rgyu/ /snod bcud rlung rgyun brtan g.yo mkha'/ /nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan 'dzin/ /rmi lam nam mkha'i spyor ba yis/ /blo chen rnal 'byor bsgrub par bya/ /spro dang snyud dang gzung ba dang / /dmigs bral dang ni rnam par dag /sna tshogs mngon par sprul pa ni / /rim sogs bla ma rgyas par 'chad/ /thun mtshams rtag tu gtor ma sngon 'gro ji snyed 'byor pa'i tshogs 'khor los/ /legs mchod thal sbyar dngos grub gsol btab dam tshig 25byed 95

ma gyur kun bzod gsol / /1de rjes mdud pas rdo rje'i gar bskor — se gol brdabs pas ye shes kyi/ /dkyil 'khor mkhar bskyod shin tu legs zhes 1 dbugs phyung mi snang gyur par bsam/ /de ltar sngags pa blo gros can brtul zhugs zab mo spyod par nus pas ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga 'di dag nyin re bzhin thun gsum gsum bsnyen par byed cing / bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la mngon par dad pa rgyun mi 'chad pas spyor bar byed na/ des ci nas kyang zla ba bdun las mi ring bar bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi mtshan ma gdon mi za bar mthong bar 'gyur te/ 'di la the tshom mi bya'o/ /ji snyed 'dod pa'i dngos grub dang las thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes dang gzungs kyi sgo dpag tu med pa yang mngon gedu 'gyur ro/ /sbyin bdag dang slob ma'i tshogs dang / rgyal po dang / bram ze la sogs pa thams cad kyi rje dpon thob par 'gyur zhing / skye bo thams cad kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bur 'gyur te/ mdor na de ni lha dang chomi dang lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ston pa lta bur blta bar bya'o/ /dpal ldan bla med rgyud rgyal de nyid rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs mdzad ma lus pa yi gter gang yin/ /sngags 'chang nyid kyi shin tu bka' bsgos rdo rje can dang thod phreng zhes bya mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis 5rim gsum rgyas btab sbas pa ni / /mgon po de nyid mthong ba'i blo mnga' spyan gsum ldan pas glo bur kha phye khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /spros med ral pa gcig 'chang ji bzhin sgrub thabs bdag gi bla ma mchog gi sgon me la brten mthong / /gnas 'dir 'bad byas pa las rnyed pa yi/ /dge ba dri med bdag la gang zhig yod/ /25— 96

de myur 'gro 'dir ral pa gcig mchog gi/ /go 'phang nyi shu lnga yi bdag nyid shog /dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ grub pa brnyes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a dzi ta mi tra gup+tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nan+da dang / de nyid kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo'i rdul la spyi bos reg cing gsung gi bdud rtsi'i ro myang ba/bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab nga shes 1 //bsdur mchan/476 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉rapal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉dzā tri/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dzā ṭi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dz+ra/477 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ma/ 〈〈pe 〉tha/ 〈〈snar 〉ra ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉man/5〈〈pe 〉mdo ṭi/ 〈〈snar 〉spro ṭi/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉ka 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa sta/ 8〈〈pe 〉tharten/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sa/478 1〈〈snar 〉thadun/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra srid/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyangs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi3/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉ltar/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉ta sa mut+ta pra/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ta sa mut+ta pa/ 〈〈pe 〉rab at+pa ko/ 〈〈snar 〉snga ad+ma ko/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpa'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pos/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mo /479 1〈〈pe 〉mthurtse:/ 〈〈snar 〉〉byurtseḥ/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ripho/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaphangs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wa gi/5〈〈pe 〉〉gyis/ ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rkyang bas/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉gyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyangs/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dum ba/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bogs/4naX 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gime/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesams/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da gyi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gikyis/481 1〈〈pe 〉7)sa/482 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 2〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7na/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thas na/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 / 6〈〈pe 〉〉sgogs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mo'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganas/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉tshangs/25—497

༄ / /dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/1 ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī e ka dza ṭī 2bha ga wān sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun ral pa gcig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas tshogs bsags pa sngon du 'gro bas pad+ma dang / ka pā la dang / ro'i gdan bltas la de'i steng du hūṃ dang baṃ las yab dang yum ral pa gcig 'phyang ba'i bcom ldan 'das bsgom par bya'o/ /shar dang / lho dang nub dang / byang gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma dag la ni rdo rje 'khor lo dang / rdo rje rin chen dang / rdo rje pad+ma dang / rdo rje sna tshogs rnams bsam mo/ /byang shar la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir ni bdud rtsi ka pā la dag go/ /de'i phyi rol du khyams kyi phyogs bzhir gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo sgon ma thogs pa dang / bag chags rdo rje ma jeser mo rdo rje thogs pa dang / 'dod chags rdo rje ma 5dmar mo zhags pa thogs pa 25—500

dang / zhe sdang rdo rje ma 1ljang gu ral gri thogs pa rnams bsgom mo/ /khyams kyi grwa bzhir ni byang shar nas brtsams te brtan pa'i rdo rje ma ser mo ri rab thogs pa dang / spyor ba'i rdo rje ma dkar mo zla ba thogs pa dang / 'bar ba'i rdo rje ma dmar mo nyi ma thogs pa dang / stobs kyi rdo rje ma ljang gu ba dan thogs pa rnams dgod do/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni pad+ma dang ro'i gdan la rnam par dgod 2pa yin no/ /de bzhin du shar dang / lho dang nub dang /byang gi sgo bzhir yang go rims ltar rdo rje lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang /lcags sgog —dang / dril bu 'dzin pa rnams dkar ba dang / ser ba dang /dmar ba dang / ljang gu'i mdog can rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /ji ltar dam tshig bskyed pa dang / /ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa nyid/ /gsang sngags bzlas shing bsgom pa dang / /sgogs pa'i rim 4sogs cho ga bzhin/ /dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i man ngag khungs phyung ba/ slob dpon chen po mi pham sbas pas bsdus pa sgogs so// //rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī mi tra dang / gnubs lo tsā ba mo tri shrīs bsgyur ba'o// //25—501

bsdur mchan/5༷༷ she mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanapal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po mi paṃ sbas pas mdzad pa bzhugs so/ / bhu)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ོ ṭi/ ②④⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉bom/501 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wam/ ldu/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toganon/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉shesgogs/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rems/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (959)25wa 502

༄༅/ /dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/7༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī bha ga wān e ka dzā ṭi sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i 2sgrub thabs/ rje btsun ral pa gcig ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu gsang ba'i rtog pa las/ /rnal 'byor pa la phan byed pa/ /bla ma'i drin thob dga' ba'i mthus/ /ral pa gcig 'phyang sgrub thabs bri/ /rab tu bsngags pa'i gnas su ni/ /blo mchog sgrub pa po yid thul/ /dam tshig tsha dang rab ldan pas/ /dang po stong nyid bsgoms par bya/ /oṃ swā 4bhā ba shudheḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha ba shurnyophohaṃsnye/de rjes 'khor lo bcing byas la/ /sna tshogs pad steng nyi zla dang / /thod pa dang bcas dbugs bral la/ /hūṃ yig 'bar ba bsam par bya'o6/ /hūṃ baṃ ma a k+ṣe don gnyis mdzad de yongs gyur pas/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug can/ /rdo rje'i 'od kyis rnam brgyan pa/ /ye shes sku mchog bsgom pa'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ )25—503

brkyang bskum zhabs gnyis stabs mdzad cing / /zhal gsum phyag bzhi 'gying bag can/ /rdo rje dang ni thod khrag 'dzin/ /ral gri ut+pal g.yas dang g.yon/ /nam mkha'i mdog can zhi zhing khro/ /dmar ser ral pa gcig 'phyang ma mi thung gzugs can bzhad mo che/ /rdo rje rin chen rus pas brgyan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis dbu brgyan —1cing / /dus gsum sangs rgyas rtags 'chang ma /gar gyi nyams dgus nadagyes bzhugs nyid/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam brgyan pa'o//sgu gsung thugs kyi dag pa yis/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya brtan byas la/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgog dang / /rdo rje dril bu'i rigs pas sbyang / /de rjes mchod sogs sngon 'gro bas/ /snying rje chen po mdun bzhag ste/ /sa gsum rnam par sbyang 4ba yi/ /rig 5sngags rgyal po bzlas par bya/ /dhī tri srehūṃ phaṭa/ting 'dzin tshogs pa tshang ba yi/ /sgrub pa po ni rab dang ldan/ /bla ma mnyes byed rnal 'byor brtson/ /'bum phrag bzhi yis dngos grub byed/ /sdig pa thams cad 'jig byed cing / /don kun sgrub byed gsang sngags 'di/ /de rjes lus can snying brtse bas/ /gtso bo nye bar bya phyir bzlas/ /oṃ uhūṃ brjod bha ba ka ra dz+nyā na pra tiṣ+ṭha ta hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje ba//gsang sngags rgyal po rdo rje can/ /ral pa gcig mchog dpal ldan ma/ /de mnyes man ngag 'di yin no/ /dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ma hā shrī dz+dza ga ta mi 7tra ā nan+da rā dza dang /gnubs lo tsa ba mai tri shrīs bsgyur ba'o// //25—504

༄ / /dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i grub thabs/kye ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī e ka dza ṭī 2bha ga wān sā dha narngu/ bod skad du/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gsum bdag nyid rnam gsum po/ /de dag dngos med dngos bral ba/ /mkha' 'dra dbang po gzhu 'dra ba/ /'bar ba'i sku gsung thugs rtag 'dud/ /de zhal de yi bka' drin gyis/ /mthong thos byin gyis brlabs pa'i rgyus/ /rgya mtsho che las mar bzhin du/ /dad ldan rnams la bsdus te bstan/ /de la re zhig sngags pas phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas su 'dug ste/ ji skad 'byung ba'i legs par spyad pa rnams kyis lus dang 4ngag dang yid bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar byas la lus dang sems rab tu sbyangs pa las ngang gis 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum bsgom pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma 25—506

mdzes pa'i dbus/ /mtshan ldan ka pā la yi nang / /rol pa'i bdud rtsis rab gang la/ /mi ro yis ni kha brgyan pa'o/ /de steng ①gri gug thod pa dag /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid bsam/ /sangs rgyas la sogs mchod tshogs dang //ma lus 'gro ba'i don bsgrubs pa'o/ /'od phreng du dkar po 'dus pa las /chos kun ro gcig ye shes dngos/ /ye shes snying po hūṃ yig bsam/ /de bzhin de las rdo rjer gyur/ /de bzhin de gyur dpal chen po/ /bcom ldan ral pa gcig mchog bsgrub/ /dmar mo gzhon nu sgeg mo dpal/ /ral gcig ma ni mdun du'o/ /nam mkha'i mdog can zhi zhing khro/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyes mdzes par spud/ /gri gug thod khrag phyag gnyis kyis/ /dam par 'khyud pas bde chen 'chang / /ral gri at+pal g.yas dang g.yon/ /rnam bzhi yum yang de bzhin no/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum lha mo dang / /dbang phyug 'jigs pa mnan par ④blta/ /de yi thugs kar pad dbus su/ /rang rig rgyal po hūṃ yig go/ /snying po gsang ba'i sngags 'bru bzhi/ /zla ba skar ma'i phreng ba bzhin/ /s+thā tre ④hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas tshad med rnam bzhi yi/ /mi zad yid kyi rlung bskyod pas/ /'od zer me lce ltar 'bar gyur/ /don gnyis don gsum bsgrubs nas ni/ /bzlas pa'i 'khor lo 'khor lo bzhin/ /sa gsum yi ge gsum gyi 'od/ /sa gsum 'khor lo gsum dngos te/ /dngos gsum dag pa gsum du 'dod/ /bde gsal rnam par mi rtog 5dang / /gdod nas de bzhin nyid rdzogs bsgom/ /de nas gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ /cho ga sems bskyed sngon btang nas/ /rang nyid lha myur bskyed nas ni/ /cho ga rnam 6 gsum phyag rgyar bcas/ /dpa' chen rang nyid lhar dran las/ /mchod rdzas 25—507

bdud rtsi mchog gyur par/ /bsam byas snying gi 'od zer gyis/ /dgug pa'i 'gron rnams tshim par bya/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ s+thā tro snahūṃ byin kyis brlab pa'o/ /oṃ āḥrat+na gu ru shrī bha ga wān e ka dza ṭī sarba aṣ+ṭa de ba tā sarba dharma ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi4/ ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ nye bar sbyin pa'o/ /ma lus lha sku gsang sngags dang / /ting 'dzin gang zhig gang gis ni/ /gang du ji ltar bsgom pa nyid/ /kun rdzob don dam mtshan nyid kyis/ /rmi lam nam mkha' dpe yis ni/ /mkhas pas chos rnam snyertogs par 'gyur/ /blo sgra dpe zhes bya ba yis/ /bsam brjod mtshon par mi nus pa/ /so so rang rig 'od gsal yul / /gang de nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do/ /ji srid sna tshogs sku gsung thugs / /'di dag snang ba rang snang ba/ /bden brdzun gnyis dang gnyis min tshul/ /rmi lam gyi ni grong sogs bzhin/ /dpal ldan shar phyogs rig 'byung gnas/ /ga u ra yi bram ze'i grong / /mnyam med tshangs dbang gtsug lag tu/ /grogs po'i ming don ldan bskul nas/ /rjes 'dzin 'gro ba'i don du byas/ /dge bas rdo rje 'dzin thob shog /rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po shrī badz+ra tīrti'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa sdogs so// //25—508

bsdur mchan/5༷6 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stanapal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya ṭi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉dha rna/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dhe rna/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dbang /5༷7 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stengs/ 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'phreng / da〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〉/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tri/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gtog 6〈〈snar 〉〉rnams//jiX/ )mi/dz+nyā/bye// /khro///bye// 1stuX /jiX//ste// 1stuX /jiX 5༷/ nye7〈〈 〉 / 〈〈snar 〉〉 / 〈〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉log / 〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta sarba dharmā/ 4〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉bokhā hi/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rams/ bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (961)25—509

1035༄ / /dpal ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī e ka dza ṭī sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/dpal ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs/ jo mo byin rlabs khucan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dran pa tsam gyis sems can rnams/ /yo byad 'phel zhing bar chad zhi/ /dgra rnams 'dul zhing byang chub nye/ /ral gcig ma la phyag 'tshal lo sems can nyon mongs bsod nams chung / /'khor bar yun ring gnas pa la/ /mchog dang thun mong thob bya'i phyir/ /jo mo'i sgrub thabs brtsam par bya/ /dur khrod la sogs nyam nga bar/ /mi ro'i stan la rab 'dug nas/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /dngos sam yang na yid kyis kyang / /yan lag bdun nam rnam bzhi sgom —/ /stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma'i gdan/ /ro dang nyi ma zla ba la/ /skad cig dran pa tsam kyis kyang / /dpal ldan chen mo sku mdog gnag /zhal gcig ma la phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas gnyis ral gri gri 25—510

gug dang / /g.yon pa ut+pal thod pa bsnamasate/ /ral pa ser po'i thor tshugs /snyedang / /'phyang ba'i tshul la rnam par brgyan/ /spyan gsum zhal ni mche ba gcigs/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa'o/ /stag gi sham thabs byas pa'i zhabs/ /g.yas pa bskum nas g.yon pa brkyang / /sems dpa'i skyil krung gar gyis bzhugs/ /sbrul dang thod pa'i rgyan la sogs/ /dur khrod chas kyis rngubargyan par bsgom/ /yul gsum sku gsung thugs kyi dbang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul du yang / /skad cig nyid la dbang bsgur bya/ /de lta bu yi sbyor ba la/ /bag tsam skyo bar gyur pa na/ /rig pa 'di yang brjod par bya/ /s+thā tri 5hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshan dang ldan pa'i thod pa 'am/ /yang ni 5ci yang rung ba'i sgod/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi la sogs pa'i/ /ba lo rgyan kyis mchod pa bya/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bstod pa 'dis/ /gdangs dang ldan par bstod par bya/ /pā ta ni ni ḍa la a ro pi tagye/ sgru ta bh+ri ta gh+ra ra aṣ+ṭa hā sa na da/ pra 3ya hūṃ khaṣ+ṭa ghā m+bi la la ga la rngo dza tra dzu tra u ghā ni ghā pa rā 9 ga ti ga bu dz+nyā dza tra ma /na sa sa ka pā skyel/ ki ti ra dzu gu tai haṃ ut+ta 4ra ye saṃ/ thal chen khrag dang sbyar ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor dag kyang rtag tu dbul/ /zab mo'i don yang bsgom bya stenyun/ /de lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /mi yi ro 'am dur khrod dam/ /gtsug lag khang ngam khyem dag tuthu/ /lus ngag yid gsum 'bad pa yis/ /zhag gcig bdun bdun dang rtsa gcig /gsum lo gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur—/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor bstan nas ni/ /gang ltar 'dod pa dri ba gyis/ /de lta bu yi lung bstan nas/ /dngos grub rnam pa gnyis kyang thob / /thun mong tshe ring nad med cing / /yo byad dang ni rigs rgyud wī 25—511

'phel—/ /kun gyis lta ba'i 'os su 'gyur/ /mchog ni byang chub the tshom med / /dpal ldan chen mo grub nas kyang / /gdug pa'i gnod sbyin rnam pa gnyis/ /drag po'i shugs kyis phrin (las byed/ /g.yas na kā la nag po ni/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du badze+es/ /sbrul dang thod pa'i rgyan dang bcas/ /dar nag gos kyi la'u can/ /zhabs la sag ti — snayu thung gon/ /sbrul nag gcus pa'i ske rags byas/ /g.yas pa ral gri klad la bskor/ /g.yon pa ut+pal dkar po bsnams / /mche gadzigs tog tog rkan sasgra can/ /g.yon na snyi ka la dmar po/ /ral pa gsigs pas sa gzhi khebs/ /khro gnyer dpral bar g.yo bzhin bsdus / /le brgan dmar po sku la gsol/ /rkang pa rdeb dzacing gdug pa 'dul/ /gri gug g.yas pa thod pa g.yon/ /zhal nas drag po'i ngan sngags sgogs/ /a yin hring sring has phring / /hang sa hu hang sa hung / /has phring a yin dz+dzang sring / /gdug pa'i drag sngags 'di dag kyang / /gnod sbyin gnyis kyi srog kyang yin/ /de dag 'grub par gyur pa na/ /bsams shesnapa tsam gyis rengs pa dang / /khros pa tsam gyis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /thal mo brdabs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mi ma yin pa'i 'byung po rnams/ /seng ge mthong ba'i ri dwags bzhin/ /mthong ba tsam gyis 'bros par 'gyur/ /de ltar yin gyis gdams pa 'di/ /'gro ba rnams la phan gyur cig /'di 'dra'i gdams ngag dam pa 'dirkya/ /kha nas me 'bar khong du sbrul zhugs pa'i/ /bu ngan phal la sbyin pa min/ /dpal ral pa gcig ma'i sgrub thabs 'khor lo 13gnod sbyin dang bcas pa rdzogs so// //rje grub thob chen po'i thugs dam gnubs kyilo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o// //25—512

༄ / /bsngo ba nor bya'o sgon ma zhes bya ba/rmye༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma ṇi ā lo ka napa ri nā ma/ bod skad du/bsngo ba nor bu'i sgon ma zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye kye rdo rje 'dzin sogs bdag dgongs gsol/ /dpal — —chen khyod kyi ④drin tshad 5kyis / /bdag cag nyon mongs dgra las rgyal/ /legs so mgon po khyod legs so / /e ma ho rdo rje'i thugs sangs rgyas/ /e ma ho e waṃ rdo rje'i chos/ /e ma de sgrub dge 'dun tshogs/ /skyabs gsum rdo rje gcig khyod 'dud/ /sa gsum mkha' spyod gnas gsum dang / /sgo gsum rdo rje khusku gsung thugs/ /mngon gsum zab zhi dri bral du/ /ston pa khyod la bdag dga'o/ /de phyir bdag dang 'gro kun gyis/ /bgyis dang bgyid 'gyur dge chen 'di/ /'od gsal bde chen rnam mi rtog /sgu gsum rnam dag mthar phyin shog /skye zhing skye ba kun du yang / /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /lag na rdo rje dril 25byed514

༄ / /dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa la bstod pa/ 1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī e ka dza ṭī bha ga wān sto tra/ bod skad du/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa la bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo gang zhig dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje thugs las sprul pa'i sku/ /mkha' ltar stong nyid ma ltar snying rje byams sogs tshad med las byung ba/ /pad+ma nyi 4dbus bde chen thob pa de bzhin mi ro khros pa yi/ /sna tshogs gdan stengs ye shes yig 'bru ṭi las yongs gyur 5thod pa dang / /gri gug las grub hūṃ dang phyag mtshan 'gro ba'i don sgrub byed pa'i rgyu/ /'bar las gtam 6byas 'jigs pa'i sku chen shin tu mi bzad rngams 7pa'i sgu/ /'gyings — bag rab brtan gzi brjid dpal 'bar nyon mongs sgrib tshogs bsreg pa yi/ /ye shes me 'bar kun nas 'khyil ba'i 'od zer drag po dpung 'khrigs shing / /sdig pa'i rngom 9stabs hūṃ sgra dang bcas 25—516

drag po'i gad mo can/ /phyogs bcur gar 'gyed mi thub gcig tu lha klu lha min dpung las rgyal/ /bde chen rgyal po gnyis med mchog dgas rtag tu sdug bsngal rnams gnon rtsal/ /rgyal ba dgra rgyal snyug bsngal sdig 'joms dpa' bo dpa' hūṃchen la phyag 'tshal/ /gar dgu'i tsonyams ldan cung zad zhi la zhi zhing khro dang khro zhing zhi/ /brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin stobs bcu'i dbang phyug mi dang lha las rnam par rgyal/ /sa gsum bdag po lha yi lhar gyur bde gshegs ma lus phrin ngalas bsgrubs/ /mi g.yo mi 'gyur rtag tu brtan nas de bzhin nyid yul zab mo'i lam/ /sgyu ma mkha' 'gro nyid kyi thugs chud ma lus 'gro la rjes chags nas/ /slar yang 'dir zhugs skal ldan srog chags snying gi pad+mo kha phye nas/ /chags med chags bral gti mug las grol rab tu sdang ba rnam par bshig /kun du rtog spangs rab tu brtan gnas nges pa'i sar chud de nyid thugs rjes 3khros pa yi/ /'jigs byed skur 6bstan 'bar ba'i zhal gsum dkar dang dmar po sngon po'i mdog /spyan gsum thogs med smra 7ra smin ser g.yo ba'i ba spu gyen du 'greng / /dmar zlum spyan bzlog 'od 'bar las byung bgegs tshogs bsreg pa'i me stag 'phro/ /ye shes rdon po'i mche ba gnyis gabyugs rngams shing bzhad pa'i zhal bgrad de/ /ha ha'i sgra sgrogs rta skad mtsher 9ba'i nga ro ku co gad rgyangs 'byin/ /rtabs shing rab brgyal 'khrugs pa'i skad gsang ngar ngar rab ser 'o dod 'bod/ /gdug pa'i snying 'byin ma rungs snang 'chod /1gcong sgra drag pos sa 'khrugs rtartapa/ /rnam rgyal khro bo bdud dgra dpung 'dul phrin kalas lha dbang khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dmar ser 'gying ba'i ral pa gcig bcas bde gshegs gtso bo mi bskyod pas/ /dregs pa'i 25—517

dbu rgyan 1sangs rgyas rnam lnga'i mi thod 'jigs pa'i phreng ba can/ /ut+pal pad+mo mi yi rgyu 2zhags sbrul gdug khros pa'i rna rgyan can/ /de bzhin mi rus rin chen sbrul rgyan 4shin tu 'od 'bar 'jigs pa yi/ /rgyan rnams kyis brgyan sel sil sgra sgrogs kun nas bsdigs pa'i stabs kyis 'gyed pa'i tshul/ /phyag g.yas gri gug rdo rje ral gri de bzhin g.yon phyag mgo phyed dang / /ut+pal sdong mdzes dri bsung yid 'phrog saphyogs bcur ngad ldang thugs kar 'dzin/ /dpal ldan gtso bo'i thub pa thub mchog mi pham gcig pu rnam par gnon/ /stang 6stabs bgrad pas phaṭa ces brjod cing lha yi brtan po )mi 'gul zhabs g.yas ni/ /dbugs bral gtso bo'i mgo bo nas brjis — g.yon pas gzhibs pa'i rkang gnyis mnan/ /dpa' bo stag lpags thusru rtse rab 'khrug du ba 'khyel 'dra gson pa ni/ /bshus pa'i mod la da ltar khrag 'dzag glo bur stabs pas blangs nas su/ /khros pas bskyod 'dra mi yi skyob pa pha rol dpung rnams rnam bzlog cing / /nyid kyi phyogs bsrung zhi rgyas dbang drag ma lus gsang sngags mngon par bsgrub/ /thog med rab ltar shin tu mi zlogs kun gyis mi thub thub dka' ba/ /nam mkha' kun khyab sa chen g.yos mdzad bde gshegs gtso bo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi snying ni gtso bo chu skyes gsar 'khrungs phyogs kyis mtshon 'dra'i kha dog can/ /dkar ser dmar ljang rab tu gsal rgyal nyuce de dbus rab tu 'bar ba'i hūṃ/ /ye shes 'od 'phros 'gro ba'i sdig bsregs phyogs bcur mkhas skrukhyab 'gengs pa yi/ /me lce'i phreng dkrigs mkha' la nyi ltar kun nas rtag tu lham me ba/ /de yi mthar ni ngag gi yig 'bru skar ma'i 'od can rnam pa bzhi/ /gsal bar bltas rmye te mchod sogs sngon 'gro ji 25—518

bzhin ji snyed tshogs bsgrubs nas/ /grub pa'i las ni rnam bzhi'i phrin 1snalas sa gsum lus can kun spro mdzad/ /de las slar 'ongs dkar bsel lus ngag yid kyi dri ma rnam par dag /byas nas rdo rjes bla ma'i zhal blangs de nyid ye shes mnyam gzhag ste/ /sku gsung thugs dag de bzhin dag de'ang dri med gang yin gang / /de nyid ye shes shes dang shes bral mtha' rnams las dben kun spyod pa/ /rnal 'byor chen po bde chen de ni bla ma'i drin thob khyod kyis bsgrubs snye/ /brtse ba'i rgyud bskyod byin rlabs me ni rnam mdun 4rnam gsum ye shes snying po lce mdud phya/bcas/ /sa gsum na khyab bdag dang 6bdag med yod med dri ma ma lus las/ /rnam dben de ni rgyal ba'i sku zhes 'dren pa khyod kyis mthu ston cing / /de rjes dri med sgyu 'dra mkha' 'dra rnam gsum rnam thar sgo spyod pa/ /so so rang rig snying gi dbus gnas bde gshegs snying po rtogs dka' ba/ /rtogs mdzad dam pa drang srong mi dbang lha yi dbang phyug ral pa gcig /kun rtog gyemi zad 'ching ༄ ༷ba mi gnas shes rab pha rol phyin dbang gis/ /gcod pa'i mtshon cha shes rab ral gri chags med chags bral ut+pal mtshan/ /bzlas brjod dka' thub sbyin sreg gtong sogs sgrub pa'i mtshan ma brgya phrag gis/ /mnyam / par mi nus gang zhig lam min de nyid de lam gzhan min pa/ /shin tu zab mo gsang ba'i lam gyur yang dag sbas pa mngon rnyed pa/ /dpal gyi dpal dbang srid gsum thibs po'i mun 'joms ral pa gcig 'chang khyod/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum rgyal po/ /sgu gsung thugs dag srid 'joms pa /zhi bas mi bsnyel phrin 11las sgrub/ /lha yi lha mchog ral pa gcig /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi/ /mkha' dbyings las byung lha mchog nyid/ /ye 25—519

shes 'od zer stong 'bar ba/ /gzhan gyis mi thub ral pa thub pa rmyegacig /sna tshogs pad nyi thod par ro/ /hūṃ dang gri gug las byung ba/ /ye shes sku mchog zhal gsum phyag /bzhi ldan bcom ldan khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gri gug ral gri thod pa dang / /ut+pal 'dzin mdzad 'jigs pa'i sku/ /pad+mo yi ge rnam pa lngas/ /sa gsum sbyong mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ma dag pa dang dag pa dag /dri med de ni ye shes dngos/ /thogs med rtag tu bsgyur nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don bsgrub khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dran pa tsam gyes byebadud 'dul zhing / /dgra 'joms 3nyon mongs kun bsreg pa/ /bde chen snying rje stong pa nyid/ /ro myong 4mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan dpa' mo khro mo'i sku/ /gzhon nu 5sgeg mo 'jigs ma yithu/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi dgyes rol gcig /dam du 'khyud phyag bcas khyod 'dud/ /gdul bya'i rigs ni ji bzhin du/ /khyed dza kyis mdzad pa'i rim pa yang / /de bzhin nyid de phun sum tshogs/ /ral pa gcig mnga' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal ral pa gcig pa la bstod pa/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po budhe shrī bha dra dang / bod kyi lo chung gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o ṣ+pe / //25—520
