spre spreganang bya ba' ram pa bzhugs/ 1༄4/ /'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/ gnas dben par stan bde ba la sems dpa'i skyil krung ngam 2ji ltar bde bas 'dug la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sdug bsngal ba du mas gdungs pa'i sems can 'di rnams kyi don du/bdag gis rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrub snyam du byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar paṃ 4las pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 5steng du/ yi ge dhīḥ'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa bsam/ de las 'od zer lus kyi nang kun du 'phros pas/ lus mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis gang ba snying po med par bsam pa lus rjes su dran pa dang / de la brten pa'i sems gzung 'dzin sna tshogs su snang ba ngo bos ma grub par bsams pa sems rjes su dran pa dang / de dag las byung ba'i tshor 25—583

ba bde sdug btang 1stoms kyis bsdus pa rnams rang bzhin gyis ma grub par bsam pa tshor ba rjes su dran pa dang / de rnams kyis chos rang bzhin gyis spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar bsam pa chos rjes su dran pa rnams bsgom/ de'i rjes su 'od zer rnams ba spu'i bu ga nas phyogs kun du 'phros pas2/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de la yid kyis phyag bya/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ de nas/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa tham/sa cad so sor bshags//'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /zhes don dran bzhin pas brjod/ de nas sems can thams cad la byams pa dang / snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms te/ tshangs pa'i gnas bathi bsgom / de'i rjes su thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas mchod bya'i yul rnams dang snod bcud kyis 4bsdus pa rnams dang / rang gi lus kyang 5sa bon la thim par bsam/ de nas sa bon 6yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du bsams 7la/ oṃ byu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa a haṃ/ zhes rigs drug gi nga rgyal bya/ de nas paṃ las pad+ma'i 9dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las khro bo'i rdo rje gdengs pa kha dog nag po lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan par bsam de las 'od zer dbang po dang gshin rje la sogs pa'i phyogs su kun du 'phros pas bdud dang bgegs la sogs pa tshar bcad nas/ slar 'dus 1rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur par bsam/de'i nang du hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas phyi dkar la 25—58/

nang dmar ba gdengs ka gyen du phyogs pa bsgom/ de'i nang du paṃ 1las pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po'i steng du dīḥlas byung ba lcags kyu dmar po'i 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa'i dīḥyig gis mtshan pa bsam / de yongs su gyur pa las rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug yum dang bcas pa gnyis ka'ang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum pa/phyag g.yas kyi dang po lcags kyu/ gnyis pa rin po che dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gyi dang po na zhags pa dang bcas pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa na pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa / mu tig dang nor bu'i tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i cod pan can sems dpa'i skyil krung gis 2bzhugs pa/ shin tu dgyes pa'i nyams dang ldan pa bsgom/ de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drang / mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pas rang gi lus dang gnyis su med par bstem be+er yang thugs kar yi ge gsum gyi sngags bsam/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs mchod pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu rmā 4zhes dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pas dbang bsgur bar bsams 5la/ lha'i sku la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan bya/ de las skyo na sngags kyi bzlas pa ni 6thugs ka nas/ dhīḥhūṃ dzaḥzhes pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba zhal nas 'thon / yum gyi zhal du zhugs mkha' dang gsang ba'i rim pa bzhin brgyud nas thugs kar thim zhing 'khor ba la dmigs nas sems gzhan du ma 'phro bar bzlas par bya/ thun mtshams su mchod pa dang gtor ma btang zhing / gnas 25—585

skabs thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang mi 'bral bar bya/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ lnga bcu pa dang / de nyid kyi don grub ma hi mas blangs pa'i sgrub thabs las 'byung ba bzhin nyams su blang bar bya'o// //de ltar na ring por mi thogs par 'jig rten dbang phyug gi skur 'gyur ro//rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug bsgom pa'i rim pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po be+e ma la shrī'i zhal snga nas 'byung ba bzhin bris pa 'di rdzogs so// //ku la lo ka nā thā ya/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal 'dab ma brgyad byas la/ de'i dbus su mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa bshams la gzhan yang ji ltar 'byor pa'i yo byad sta gon byas nas slob dpon bdag nyid kyis rnal 'byor rnams rdzogs par bsgom ste/ sngags ci rigs par bzlas la/ de'i rjes la bum pa cho ga bzhin du lhar bskyed 2la/ mchod bstod bzlas pa rnams rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma khrus byas nas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/de nas dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /zhes pa la sogs pas gsol ba btab nas/ bu tshur jeg pa chen po zhes pa la sogs pa'i sngags kyis theg pa la spro ba bskyed nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa la sogs pa sdig pa bshags pa dang / ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /zhes pa la sogs pas rigs lnga'i khyad par gyi sdom pa sbyin pa dang / de rnams mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir/ phan yon dang / nyes dmigs dang / mna'i chu dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' mnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag /sgrub 25—586

pa'i thabs ltar slob ma lhar bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis sgu gsung thugs 1byin gyis 2brlabs ye shes pa gzhug pa dang / bum pa'i chus dbang bsgur ba rnams byas nas/ /gsang sngags 'bru gsum snyan nas brgyud/ /bka' drin gyi lan mchod pa dang / /bsnyen bkur tshul bzhin du byed du gzhug /dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /slob mas bla ma la yon phul te/tsā ru'i bza' ba la longs spyad/ lhag ma'i bar rdzogs pa dang / bsngo ba dang / bzod gsol dang / gshegs su gsol ba rnams cho ga bzhin bya'o/ /de nas las kyi rjes mi 4mngon par bsdus te/ bdag nyid spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o/ /ku la lo ka nā thā'i byin rlabs 5dang rjes gnang bya ba'i rim pa kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la shrī'i zhal snga nas bris pa rdzogs so// //sangs rgyas lnga yi rnam dag pa'i/ /ma rig gsal ba'i 6rim pa las /dbang bskur byed pa'i rim pa yis/ /ye shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes rdo rje phreng ba las gsungs pas/ ma rig pa lnga bsal nas rig pa ye shes lnga rtogs par byed pas na rig pa'i dbang ngo / /lo tsā ba blo brtan gyis bsgyur ba'o / / //25—587

༄ / /rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs/sna༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ku la lo ki shwa ra sā dha dze+e2sna/ bod skad du/rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs/ /de nas bdag gis bshad par bya/ /rigs 'jig kyedabang phyug sgrub ④pa'i thabs/ /gsang sngags rigs kyi rim pa ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las rjes su thob/ /mtshan mo tha ma'i brgyad cha lus/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid langs nas ni/ /'jam pa'i gdan la rnal 'byor pas/ /skyil krung bcas la 'dug par bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni blangs nas su/ /thod par rtog 1med sems kyis gzhag she /shes rab can gyis me rlung steme/ /dag dang khol dang 'bar bar bya/ /rnal 'byor skyes phyir phyi byedang ni/ /nang gi gzugs ni dag par bya/ /de rjes thugs kar pad+ma dang / /nyi ma'i dbus su s+thāḥbasgom bya/ /khams gsum ma lus khyab pa yi/ /'gro ba'i 'od zer rab dgrol gyis/ /bla mas byesangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon/ /spyan 25—589

drangs nas ni mchod par bya/ /de rjes rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /sems ni cung zad nam mkha'o/ /de las langs nas phyogs bcur yang / /khro bo bcu ni bsgom par bya/ /dpag tshad bye snyed )tshad du ni/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de yi dkyil du rang gi lus/ /khru bzhi po ni mnyam pa po/ /ka ba brgyad ldan sgo bzhi pa/ /thar pa yi ni grong mchog ltos/ /de dbus chos kyi pad+ma la/ /'char kha nyi ma'i steng du ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi yi ge 2las/ /mchog gi pad+ma mdzes pa skyes/ /'phros shing 'dus par gyur pa las/ /rnam pa lnga ni bsgom par bya/ /de gyur pa las bdag nyid ni/ /rigs 'jig dbang phyug khyab bdag ni/ /'char kha nyi ma brgya —yi 'od/ /zhal gcig ral pa 'chang ba po/ /cung zad mche gtsigs 5mi bzad pa/ /pad+ma gar dbang dpral bar brgyan/ /zla ba nyi ma me yi spyan/ /de yi dkyil du rang gi lus/ /khru bzhi po ni mnyam pa po/ /phyag bzhi par ni blta bar bya/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis gnas pa/ /sgeg pa'i nyams kyis yongs gang ba/ /g.yas pa mchog sbyin lcags kyu dang / /g.yon pa pad+ma zhags pa 'dzin/ /dpa' bo phyag rgya drug gis brgyan/ /pad+ma'i phreng ba'i do shal can/ /de yi thugs kar bsgom bya ba/ /dhī 6gi yi ge dmar po las/ /'phros shing 'dus par gyur pa las/ /ye shes 'khor lo gzhug par bya/ /de nas bde gshegs dngos grub kun/ /ster la dbang bakhrur mdzad par gsol/ /7rlung gi sngags kyi phreng ba'o/ /'jug pa gnas pa 'byung ba'o/ /ha cang myur bul ma yin pas/ /yi ge yi ge 'byel bar bya/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa 'bum phrag gcig /sum cu rtsa gsum pa blang bya/ /ra ni 'og tu gdan du bya/ /bzhi pa sbyar bar brtan pa la/ / thig le 9zla 25—590

tshes 'byel ba'o/ / uṣ+ṭha ṇa 1yi bzhi pa zung / /drug pa gdan du ldan pa'o/ /stong pa dbu la lce gnyis pa/ /tsheg drag gnyis ni blta bar bya/ /'di ltar yi ge don mang po/ /gnyis med ye shes kyis rtogs 'gyur/ /bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni/ /rim pa rgyas par rtogs par bya/ /rna nas rna ru brgyud pa yis//gsang ba mchog gis zhi ba yi / /brjod pas myur du grub pa thob/ /bdud sngags zlog par byed mi nus/ /dang por bsnyen pa'i cho ga bya/ /mnyam par gzhag pas khri bzlas bya/ /mi gang bsod nams dman pa la/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /zhags pa lcags kyu stag 5sham thabs/ /rtse gcig sems kyis sgom byed na/ /'gro ba gsum po 'gugs par byed/ /brtan dang g.yo ba dbang du 'gyur/ /rang gi snying gar bye brgyad langs/ /sna bug g.yas las phyir phyung ste/ / bsgrub bya'i 6sna bug g.yon par gzhug /snying ga'i blo ni dgug par bya/ /de ltar yang yang cho ga ni/ /dbang du ma gyur bar du bya/ /bsgrub bya rkang pa'i 'og tu bsam/ /khol po lta bur 'gyur ba yin / /khyab 'jug me lha dbang phyug che/ /dbang po klu dang srin po srog7 /sngags kyi rgyal po'i nus pa yis/ /skad cig nyid la dbang du 'gyur/ /de nas phyi rol mchog cho ga /mnyam par gzhag 8pa'i rnal 'byor bya/ /zha nye las byung ches dmar ba/ /gru / drug 'khor lo bri bar bya/ /de yi nang du dpa' bo bri/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sngags gzugs 'chang / /dang por smos pa'i cho ga ni/ /tsā ru sna tshogs lha bshos dang / /ba la sna tshogs ma da na//mang pos gzhon nu ma yang mchod/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro ma kun yang / /sna tshogs rnga chen pa ṭa ha/ /glu dang rol mo yid 'phrog ma/ /rnge tog sna tshogs cho 25—59/

ga yang / /rdo rje 'dzin gyis mnyes par bya/ /de nas gtor ma'i las bya ste/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug nub tu blta/ /skra grol 1gcer bu byas nas ni/ /langs te rkang pa g.yon pa brkyang / /de nas pad+ma'i phyag rgyas sbyin/ /'gro ba gsum po mnyes par 'gyur/ /'di ni sngags kyi rgyal po'o/ /thams cad dngos grub 'bras bu nye/ /oṃ yi ā ro '-i gre ka i oṃ —pañtsa a mṛ ta pa lo pra tīts+tsha kṛṇ+ḍa thum ma sat+tha kar yo sa ha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de lta bu ni u rgyan 5dpal/ /bla ma rnal 'byor 'dren dbang po/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal las/ /thob nas bdag la bshad pa mdzad/ /rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs / /slob dpon j-iṅgi bye ra bram zes mdzad pa 'jam dpal sgeg pas bsgyur ba rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/589 rtematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'gas kyi 'jis rten dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon jing gi ra bram zes mdzad pa bzhugs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dh+wa rmā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorajigs/ zi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄sgrub/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉rtogs/ 67〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7zhag7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabang / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kud/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/59༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan shes/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jigs/ ga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i rgya/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagacig 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 de nas bzlas pa rab tu bya/ / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ra/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thim la/591 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodabus ma ṣa/ ༷ sna〈〈pe 〉(nas/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabazlos/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhag5〈〈snar 〉〉ltags/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub pa'i/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sogs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhag9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉41/592 1〈〈snar 〉〉 ba/ 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 / sna〈〈snar 〉〉mi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grit+na/ phya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉lo/6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉1 gi/25—592
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (972)25wa 593

)lge46༄7/ /'phags pa spran ras gzigs dbang phyug yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs/1 ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra sabhā 2k+ṣa ra sā dha rde/bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ye shes 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bde chen ye shes sku mdog thugs rje 'bar bas rol pa'i tshul/ /shes rab mchog dang gnyis med snyoms zhugs dngos grub gzhi 4gyur cing / /mchog drug lha mo'i spyi bos zhabs btud yang 5dag dkyil 'khor chen po'i bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon po nyid rtag gus pas rab tu btud 7par bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po gdong sogs dag byas bsel zhing rab 'byam dbe+en pa yi/ /gnas khang yid dga' sna tshogs me tog chal par bkram pa 'am/ /yang na rab 'jigs 9phug dang dur khrod lha gnas chu 'gram shing gcig drung / /brtse bas sems brlan rtse gcig yid byed chos kun mkha' 25—594

'drar bsam par bya/ /de rjes snying dbus nyi ma la gnas hūṃ/ /mkha' 'dra'i mgon 1can 'od zer zab mo yis/ /'phags tshogs bla ma lhar bcas dgug nas ni/ /mchod tshogs cho ga ji bzhin mkhas pas 2spyad/ /de nas yang chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi rnam par thar pa zab mo mngon du bya ste/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma kopho haṃ/ slar ni sngon gyi smon lam dang / /snying rje chen po'i shugs kyis ni/ /mkha' la glo bur sprin bzhin du/ /sngags pas lha mchog rnam par 'phrul/ /yi ram̐ baṃ lam̐/ sngo dang dmar dang dkar dang ser/ /gzhu dbyibs rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang / /gru gsum me dpung 'bar ba nyid/ /chu gter phung po zlum po dang / /de bzhin gru bzhi gser gyi dkyil 'khor dang //de steng sna tshogs mdog gsum yig /yongs gyur ri dbang gru bzhi cha/ /de nas dkyil 'khor mchog bsgom bya/ /de'i rjes la srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ oṃ me di bhā 4badz+re bha ba bad+dhā hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pā 5ka ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na 7hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tram̐ si tram̐ / oṃ badz+ra dzā la a na lārka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ sngags 'di dag nyid kyis me ri dang /rdo rje ra ba la sogs pas rnam par bcad do/ /de dbus pad+mar 'khor lo la gnas re yig las byung nyi dkyil du/ /a dang ka sogs zla ba nyi phrag rdor sems gtso bo hūṃ bsams la/ /spro zhing basbu ba'i 'od tshogs zhu 9bas spyan ras gzigs bzhad yum bcas ni/ /chu zla'i gzugs ltar dang bas rtse gcig rtag tu yang dag mnyam gzhag bya/ /de la dpal chen zhal gsum mdzes/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing ga /spyan gsum pad+ma bye bas mdzes/ /phyag drug rnam par rol pa'o/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin 25—595

pas ni yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /gnyis pa gnyis kyis mi'i pags kyipa bshus ma thag pa bsnams pa'o/ /tha ma'i g.yas dang g.yon na mchan khung na rtse gsum dang thod pa khrag gis bkang ba dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa nyid do/ /mi thod dkar po dang lag pa'i mkhrig ma dang rdo rje dang rus pa'i phreng ba nyid dang / me tog sna tshogs pa'i chun 'phyang gis dbu rab tu brgyan to/ /de bzhin du rin po che dang rus pa dang / gdug pa can gyi 2rgyan du mas ni sku la brgyan pa'o / /zhabs g.yon brkyang bas ni dbang phyug chen po'i steng nas mnan to/ /g.yas brkyang bas ni lha mo chen mo'i brang phrag nas brdzis pa'o/ /de'i dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan dmar ser bsgyings pa nyid u dusmra 4ra'i me tog gis mtshan pa ni khyad par ro/ /de'i mdun du yum dmar mo sgeg mo lang tsho phun sum tshogs ma g.yas g.yon mda' gzhu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ mchog tu dga' bas rnam par pyos pa'o / /de nas 'khor lo rtsibs drug la5/ /rdo rje lha mo drug dgod bya/ /shar nas brtsams pa'i rim gyis 6su/ /me long la ni byad gzugs bzhin/ /phaṭa las skyes pa'i he ru ka ma sngon mo dang / /hūṃ las yongs gyur rdo rje 'jigs ma ser mo 7nyid/ /ha las rab grub 'jigs byed drag mo dmar mo dang / /de bzhin ha las rdo rje dbang byed ljang gu ma/ /s+thāḥlas rnam bltas rdo rje drag mo dud mdog nyid/ /oṃ las mngon grub rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo ste/ /'di dag cig car zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yang gzhi dang / /ḍa ma ru dang dril bu legs bsnams 'dud pa'o/ /gtso bo dang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha chen po/ 'di dag ni thams cad kyang gzhon nu mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba dang / phyogs gos can mi mgo'i phreng ba'i do shal dang / yi dwags dang nyi 25—596

ma'i gdan la rnam par gnas pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i nang na sku gsung thugs shin tu rol pa'i bdag nyid phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ dngos grub thams cad ster ba'i don du brtson pas bzhengs par bsgom par bya'o/ /de rjes/ bdag snying sa bon las 'phros 1zer gyis ye shes 'khor lo bkug nas ni/ /rang lus legs bcug tshul bzhin bcing bya gnyis med rol pas dgyes bya zhing / /lo oṃ paṃ tai khaṃ zhes bya bas khams lnga byin brlabs 27de rjes nyid/ /oṃ i hri ā+oṃ hūṃ gi yi ges phung sogs gzhug /de bzhin du hūṃ hūṃ saṃ khaṃ dang haṃ haṃ yi ge rnams kyis kyang / /skye mched yongs su sbyangs nas ni/ /cho ga ji bzhin 4go cha bgo/ /oṃ ha/ na maḥhi/swa hā snu/ bo ṣaḍa he/ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ phaṭa haṃ yab kyi go cha'o/ /oṃ baṃ haṃ oṃ hri mo tre tri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa yum gyi go cha'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ sgu gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'o / /de nas mgon po spyan drangs la/ /dbang bskur mchog gis dbang mchog nod/ /bla ma'i man ngag ji bzhin du/ /cho ga'i rim pas shes par bya /dpag med mchod pa'i lha tshogs kyis/ /mchod bya bdud rtsi myang bar 5bya /ting nge 'dzin la rab brtan pas/ /gsang sngags rgyal po bzla bar bya/ /oṃ dhīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas dag pa rtogs bya ba/ /dran dang brtson 'grus dga' ba dang / /shin tu sbyangs dang ting nge 'dzin/ /btang stoms byang chub lha rim bzhin/ /pha rol phyin drug rnam dag phyir / /rgyan drug thabs dang shes rab kyi/ /rnam dag brtan phyir yab dang yum/ /dbyer rnged phyir ni stoms par zhugs/ /bar skabs kyi nye bar sprud pa gtor ma sbyin pa ni/dngos grub nye ba'i phyir 7te/ rnal 'byer zab mo la bshad pa'i/ /man ngag gis ni mchod sbyin bya/ /gsang chen sngags dang phyag rgyar bcas/ /bla 25—597

med ting 'dzin rgya mtshos 'grub/ /oṃ a ral+li ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya ste dṛ sh+ya hoḥspyan drang ba'o/ /oṃ kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa khyu 1ta pre ta pi shā tsa un man da a 2snapa sma ra ḍā ki n+ya da ya i oṃ ba lo kṛk+ṇi snyetu ma ma sarba sernyidz+re pra 4yats+tshan+tu ya dze+e baṃ ya dze+eṣ+ṭi 1bhu dza thā pi ba tha dzi gh+ra thā/ mā ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarba ka ta 6ya/ sah+phu kha bi thradha dz+waye swā hā/ nye bar sbyin pa'o/ /zla ba gsum du 'bum phrag gsum mam gnyis sam yang na gcig /mi tshig ma 'dres brtson pas nying 'dzin brtan byas na/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bde chen 'khor lo lha mchog nyid/ /tho rangs dus tshe rmi lam mngon sum zhal ston gyur 9 //dpal spyan ras gzigs yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/594 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaphags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagap+ta/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mchog —〈〈pe 〉thame+er/ 〈〈snar 〉ra'ir/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thangs/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkatu/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra bshad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasil/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngajig595 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dog 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ripas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ripho/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8 ni/5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pra/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ñdza/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ni/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dza/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhu/596 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bogs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉gyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la'o/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dum ba/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha 'o/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ams kyis/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7kyi/597 rta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅da 'phros te/ ye shes/ 〈〈co 〉〉sabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsū/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7du/25—598

༄/ /dpal thugs rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba'i man ngag gi rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba/1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā 2ru ṇi ka a bhe ṣe ka pra ka ra ṇa u pa 4de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal thugs rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba'i man ngag gi 5rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal pad+ma'i snang ba chen po rab tu rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po 6re zhig rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gang zhig /pad+ma rab tu zab pa'i dkyil 'khor ram/ pad+ma rgyal po gang yang rung ba'i dbang dang gnang ba thob pas/ rtsa ba'i sngags la bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gsum song nas/ slob ma rjes su gzung 7bar 'dod na/gnas dbe+en zhing nyams dga' ba'i sar/ slob ma ni dad pa dang snying rje dang shes rab che ba/ 'khor ba la skyon du mi lta zhing / mang du thos pa bla ma la gus shing / theg pa chen po'i chos la je tshom med pa/ khyad par du nges pa'i don dang / spyan ras gzigs la mos shing / dbang po rno ba'i gang zag des/25—600

bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig dang / /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /pad+ma'i dbang bskur zhu bar bgyi/ /de nas bla mas gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi rtedakyil 'khor 'dir/ /mi mkhas pa ni 'ching bar 'gyur/ /mkhas pa rnams ni grol bar 'gyur/ /sems can dad can smin par byed/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /srid pa'i 'dam las 'di yis brgal/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /nga yis 'bod kyi yid gnyis spongs/ /zhes brjod cing slob ma gzung bar bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis — dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ pad+ma 4zab pa dang /pad+ma rgyal po gang gis 5byed kyang rung ste/ de la dang po 6sa brtag pa dang / sa bslang ba dang / sa sbyang bar bya ba ni/ lto 'phye'i lto ba nas brkos te/ sa bslangs nas/ gnas khang dang 'tsham 7par sa stegs gru bzhi pa byas la/ sa'i lha mo la gtor ma phul te/ sa byin gyis brlab po/ /de nas ba'i rnam lnga dang / dri bzang gi chus byugs 8la/ thig gi cho ga lag len bzhin du gdab po/ /tshon gyis bri ba ni/ tshon kha dog lnga ye shes lngar byin gyis brlabs 9la/ pad+ma zab pa'i dkyil 'khor la dbus kyi ste ba dang phyogs bzhir pad+ma 'dab bzhi dmar po la/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma dang gong ras mdzes tshon/ mu khyud la pad+ma'i phreng ba bri'o/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ lte ba dmar po la ze'u 'bru dang gong ras ci mdzes 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs bzhi dmar po mtshams bzhi dang mu khyud rnams mdzes tshon du bya'o/ /de'i rgyab tu pad+ma 'dab brgyad phyogs bzhi phyogs tshon la/ mtshams mdzes tshon 25—601

du bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol yang pad+ma 'dab ma bcu dmar po'am ser por bya ba'am/lha snam dmar po'am/ yang na khyams 1snaphyin chad spyi dang 'dra bar bris la/ rgyan dgram 2pa ni/ bla re dang / yol ba bre/ rten dgram mo / /mchod pa lnga dang / gtor ma lnga la sogs pas mtha' ma legs par bskor5/ gzhan yang dgos pa rnams gzhung bzhin bsham mo/ /bum pa gtsang ma la bgegs bskrad pa ni/ gu gul gyis bdug cing khro bo'i sngags bzlas te/ nang du bcud chu gtsang ma dang / sman dang / dri lnga dang / 'bru lnga dang / snying po lnga dang / rat+na lnga/ 'o 6ma la sogs pa blugs 7la/ dar ram/ ras kyis mgul chings dang gzungs thag btags te / 'bras bu can gyi shing lo rlon pas brgyan pa'i bum pa gnyis la rnam rgyal gyi bum pa dang las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang / dbang gi bum pa la sogs ci 9'byor bshams/ nang du lha bskyed la/ mchod pa phul nas/ dbang gi bsnyen pa bya'o/ /rnam rgyal gyi bum pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gzhag go/ /las bum gang bder dgod/ de nas rang stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / bum pa'i nang du dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bsgom /las bum nang du rta mgrin bsgom pa ni/ dhīḥlas rta mgrin dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal dbus dmar ba/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon sngo/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma dmar ba/ rta skad sgrogs pa/ phyag g.yas kha ṭī ga rtse gsum bsnams pa/ g.yon na rnge'u chung 'khrol ba/ bar ma gnyis kyis lha srin sde brgyad kyi tsit+ta'i phreng ba bsnams pa/g.yas 'og mas zhing dbyug /g.yon gyi 'og mas thod pa lcang lo can lha sasrin 25—602

sde brgyad kyi khrag gis bkang ba zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang pas bzhugs pa/ sku smad stag gi pags pa'i 1sham thabs byas pa 2 /sku stod zhing lpags kyi g.yang gzhi mnabs pa/ sbrul rigs bzhis dbu dang yan lag brgyan pa/ me dpung gi dbus su bzhugs par bsam/ sngags ni/ oṃ dhīḥha ya spyi wa pad+mān+ta kṛta 3badz+ra kro dha ha ya spyi wa hu lu hu lu sarba pā baṃ shudhe shudhe 4ye hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/ khro bo'i sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i chus gang bar bsam/ de nas slob ma rnams la/ las bum gyis 5phyir khrus byas te6/nang du btang la maṇ+ḍal phul nas gral la rim par gzhag 7go/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bcings la/ lag tu me tog bzung la gsol ba gdab po/ /de nas bdag nyid dang / dkyil 'khor dang / bum pa gsum ga mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ bsod nams kyi sprin kha dog lnga lnga las 'og phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ de'i steng du rnam par shes pa yi ge dhīḥdakar po thig le gnyis ga 9dang bcas pa 7bsgom/ de las yig 'bru kha dog sna tshogs pa sprin gyi thog tu 'phros pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po/ shar shel dkar po/ lho bai ḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga /byang in+d+ra m+bi la las grub pa/gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ ka ba dang rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rin po che'i pha gu dang / dra ba dra phyed kyis brgyan pa/ ri dwags/ gdugs/ chos 'khor dang bcas pa mtho ba/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la/ mchod pa'i lha mos bskor ba'i nang du/ pad+ma rim pa gnyis pa'i gdan gyi dbus su yi ge dīḥlas pad+ma dang 5nyi ma zla ba'i gdan kyi dbus su/ rang nyid thugs rje 25—603

chen po sku mdog dkar ba/ zhal bcu gcig pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/g.yas ljang ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng ma lkudabus ljang gu /g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar/ de'i steng ma dbus dmar ba/ g.yas dkar ba / g.yon ljang gu/ zhal de rnams ni/ kun nas zhi ba/ bzhad pa 'dzum pa/ spyan gsum gsum zhi bas gzigs pa/ de'i steng du khro bo'i zhal nag po/ mche ba gcigs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba'o/ /zhal dgu po ni/ dbu skra nag po la rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /zhal nag po'i steng na 'od dpag rnged kyi zhal dmar po mgrin pa yan chad phyung ba/spyan gsum pa/ gtsug tor dang bcas pa'o/ /phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /g.yas 'og mas mu tig gi phreng ba/g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dmar po/ g.yas gsum pas mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum pas spyi blugs/ g.yas bzhi pas chos kyi 'khor lo/ 5g.yon bzhi pas pad+ma'i mda' gzhu'o/ /sku dang yan lag thams cad la rin po ches brgyan pa'o / /yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum pa/ g.yas kyis zangs gri bsnams pa/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pas 7yab la 'khyud pa/ skra grol ba rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon yab dang sbyar nas brkyang ba/ g.yas kyis yab kyi dar sham grol ba la 'khyud pa'o/ /yab kyi phyag dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis/mchog sbyin pa'i phyag mthil la mdzes par gzigs pa'i spyan stong mnga' ba/sku'i phyag stong dang spyan stong las 'od zer kha dog sna lngas 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa khyab par bsam mo/ /mdun gyi pad+ma la rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal 25byed601

gnyis ma'i spyi bor phag zhal/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa/ mchan khung na kha ṭī ga bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas su yum chen mo ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas thugs kar rdo rje 'dzin pa/g.yon pa ut+pa la'i rtesteng na po ti bsnams pa/ 'og ma gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad byepa'o/ /rgyab phyogs su sgrol ma ljang gu/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas skyab 4sbyin/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon phyogs su yum yi ge drug ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i/ dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo spyor ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba'i steng du ka pā la re re gnas par bsam mo/ /lha mo bzhi po dar gyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i phyi'i pad+ma'i gdan la/ shar phyogs su mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis kyis 5yum mā ma tī la 'khyud pas thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas rdo rje/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba/ mā ma tī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o/ /sgo phyogs su rin chen 'byung ldan ser po 6zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa7/ dang po gnyis kyis yum sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'i rgyab tu thal mo spyor ba/ g.yas 'og ma /rin bo che/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyab phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis —kyis yum gos dkar mo me tog dkar dmar gnyis bsnams pa la 'khyud pas thal 25—605

mo sbyor ba/ g.yas 'og mas 'khor lo/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /byang phyogs su don yod grub pa ljang gu/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis yum dam tshig tesgol ma sku mdog ljang ser ut+pa la dang pad+ma bsnams pa la 'khyud pas/ thal mo sbyor ba/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas 2ut+pa la bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bsgum pa'o / /dar sham dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /yum gnyis ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan can sku mdog yab dang mthun pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis yab kyi dar sham cung zad grol ba la 'khyud par bsgom / yab kyi g.yon gyi gnyis pa ni pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir ni/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi zhal gcig phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo spyor ba/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ sku mdog ni dkar mo dang / ser mo dang / dmar mo dang / ljang gu'o/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang ba/ g.yon bskum pa'o/ /de'i phyi'i rgyab pad 'dab bcu'i gdan la/ phyogs bcu'i pad+ma rigs kyi sangs rgyas bcu po ni/ gser gyi mdog can/ chos gos dmar ser gsol ba/ phyag na pad+ma 5stong dang ldan pa re re bsnams pa/ dbu reg zhabs rjen no/ /grwa 6bzhi la lha snam gyi mtshams bzhir / byang du/ 'jam dpal dmar ser/ g.yas ral gri/ g.yon ut+pa la'i steng du po nyi bsnams pa'o/ /shar lhor phyag na rdo rje ljang gu/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon ut+pa la'o/ /lho nub tu byams pa dmar ser/ g.yas klu shing / g.yon ut+pa la'i steng na bum pa'o/ /nub byang du sgrib pa rnam par sel ba ser skya/ g.yas nor bu/ g.yon gyis ut+pa la'o/ /zhabs 25—606

gnyis bzhengs pa/ rin po che dang / dar gyis brgyan pa'o/ /shar sgor 'dod pa'i rgyal po dkar po zhal gcig pa/ g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon sdigs mdzub nyemadzad pa'o/ /lho sgor gshin rje gshed 2ser nag /zhal gcig pa/ g.yas be con/ g.yon sdigs mdzub / nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po/rta mgo ljang gu/ phyag g.yas pad+ma'i dbyug pa/ g.yon sdigs mdzub 4mdzad pa'o / /byang sgor bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang nag /zhal gcig phyag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon sdigs mdzub 5mdzad pa/ dbu skra dmar ser 'bar ba/sbrul rigs bzhis brgyan pa/ sku smad stag gi sham thabs can/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /phyi rol du lha mo me tog ma dkar mo/ bdug spos ma ser mo/ mar me ma dmar mo/ dri chab ma ljang gu/zhal zas ma ser mo/ sil snyan ma zla ba'i mdog can ma rnams kyis 6mchod par bsam mo/ /sgo khang du tshad med pa'i lha mo bzhi7/ byams pa tshad med pa'i lha mo dngul gyi me long blta 9ba/ snying rje'i lha mo ser mo gser gyi me long blta 7ba/ dga' ba'i lha mo dmar mo zangs kyi me long blta 11ba/ btang snyoms kyi lha mo sngon mo g.yu'i me long blta ba'o / /de'i phyi rol du rgyal po chen po bzhi ni/ byang phyogs su rnam thos sras ser po/ g.yas me tog u dusmra ra gtso bo la 'bul ba/ g.yon ṣ+pe'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin pa'o/ /shar phyogs su yul 'khor srung ngadakar bo/ g.yas me tog /g.yon pi wang 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs su 'phags skyes po sngon po/ g.yas me tog /g.yon ral gri 'dzin pa'o 5/ /nub phyogs su spyan mi 7bzang dmar po/ g.yas me tog /g.yon sbrul zhags 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du ye shes lnga'i 'od kha dog lnga rdo rje'i gur du bsam 25—607

mo / /'od kyi nang du yi ge drug pa'i gsung gi sgra rang bzhin gyis bsgrag ༄1par bsam mo/ /de nas thugs ka'i dhīḥlas 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros nas/'og min gyi gnas nas/ ye shes sems dpa' rang gis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba 4spyan drangs la mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya ste/ sku gsung thugs byen gyis brlab 5par bya'o/ /de nas lha thams cad gsal btab la bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ thugs ka'i dīḥl/ oṃ āḥhūṃ 7dīḥ/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ byephaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā tī9/ oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye/badz+ra waṇ+ḍi rkanī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa m+bi ye hūṃ 11phaṭa/ ha ri ni sa hūṃ skyaphaṭa swā hā/zhes pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs nas bzlas pa bya ba dang / 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa phul te/ de rnams kyi byin brlabs 1 rang gi thugs ka'i dhīḥl bsdu'o/ /bum pa'i nang du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bsams la/ de dag zhu bas bdud rtsi'i chur bsam zhing bsnyen pa bya'o/ /pad+ma zab pa byed na ni/ /sgrub thabs las byung ba bzhin du/ /bsgom zhing bzlas par bya'o/ /cho ga gzhan dag rnams ni 'dra bas thun mong du shes par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma la skyabs su 'gro ba thun mong ba byin la/ sems bskyed pa ni / sgrol ma'i rgyud nas gsungs pa/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi//spyig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung —/ /sems can rnams la phan slad du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems 25—608

bskyed la/ yang dam tshig dang sdom pa byin pa tsoni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rnam rgyal dang / /gsang sngags rgyal ba mkha' 'gro ma/ /bdag ni rtag tu skyabs su mchi//byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang po/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad tshogs/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol//bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung / /zhes khas blang ngo / /de nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bshad de nges shes bskyed pa ni / rnam snang mngon byang nas gsungs te/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen nyid / u dusmra sgo ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi sems can mnyam med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' 4byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon chad sdig pa bgyis pa gang / /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba/ /mthong bas byang bar 'gyur bas 5na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na sgos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni/ /go 'phang 5bla na sked par 'gro/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo ba//de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyu/ / snyug bsngal )kun 'byung rab tu bshad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyi8/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyi 9ni/ /bstan pa 'di 25—609

la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung la skye bzhin par/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la/ /dbang bskur ba ru skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung batsho/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams lam 'dir 'gro ba na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ / byezhes brjod/ de nas slob ma'i mgo bor pyardo rje bzung la/ khyod kyis ④pad+ma rgyal po dang /pad+ma zab pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di/ snod min pa la bstan na/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ sngon dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba dang /'di la ma dad pa'i snod la/ 'di lta bu 'di khyod kyis yang su rung rung la smra zhing brjod par mi bya'o/ /de nas ka pā la'i nang gi bdud rtsi thubyin la/ 'di ni rdo rje 6bdud rtsi'i chu/ /ma bsrungs musreg par byed pa'i dug /bsrungs na dngos grub thob pa ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chus grub po/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha/ de nas slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ spyan ras gzigs dbang rdo rje phag mo deng / /khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di gzhan la smra mi bya/ /smras na de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la de ring khyed dpa' bo dang rnal 'byer ma rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la sangs rgyas pad+ma rnam rgyas spyan ras ༄ gzigs kyi ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ yang rdo rje spyi bor gzhag9 /deng phyin chad khyod 25—610

kyi spyan ras gzigs nga yin gyisna/ gang ngas pad+ma'i rgyal po spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sgoms 7shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya'o/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par mi bya ste/ khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par che'i 4dus byas nas / dmyal bar lhung bar gyur ta re zhes brjod do/ /ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa ni/ bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgoms nas/slob ma rnams spyan ras gzigs su gsal bar bskyed la/ 'og min gye gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal yas nas/ sangs rgyas pad+ma'i rgyal po dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs la/ bdag nyid dang slob ma rnams la gzhug go/ /spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag rnams kyang dbul/ ngag tu/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi sku/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom 5pas/ /sku yi byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ dpal ldan sangs rgyas gsung 'chang ba/ /zhes tshig bsgyur la shes par bya'o/ /āḥzhes pa dang / dpal ldan sangs rgyas thugs 'chang ba/ /hūṃ zhes pa dang / oṃ āḥhūṃ 6dhīḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā tī7 / sarba burnya ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa dī ye/ badz+ra be+e ro tsa m+bi ye/ha ri ni sa/ ā be+e sha ya ā be+e sha ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bye ṣiñtsa hūṃ 9āḥzhes brjod cing ye shes pa gzhug go/ /ye shes pa zhugs pa'i rtags sems bde gsal mi rtog pa 1 la sogs pa byung ba dang / lha la dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sangs rgyas pad+ma rnam rgyas dkyil 'khor du/ /'od dpag med pa'i rgyal sras spyan ras 25—611

gzigs—/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi mchog gyur chen po yi/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ /zhes maṇ+ḍal dbul la gsol ba gdab po/ /de nas bum dbang bskur ba ni/ bdag dkyil 'khor gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang / mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang lnga spros te/ bum pa thogs nas/ slob ma'i spyi bor dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / bkra shis brjod pa dang / yid la spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / dngos su rnam rgyal bum pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzung nas/ ji ltar sangs rgyas pad+ma rnam rgyas kyi/ /'od dpag med pa'i rgyal sras spyan ras gzigs/ /chos kyi rgyal srid chen por dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni//de bzhin gshegs la khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dbang thob po/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ ①s+thāḥ/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃkhye/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā tī / oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra waṇ+ḍi chonī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa m+bi ye/ ha ri ni sa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa rmā'u/ zhes brjod de/slob ma mgon po pad+ma'i snang ba rab tu rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs te/ bskyed rim 4rgyas par bsgom 7pa la dbang sku/ bum chu yar 'khyel pa las 9'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan par bsgom6/ des lus dag pa ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa yin no/ /slob ma la mchod pa rnam 1lnga dbul lo/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang ni/ ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba lag tu bzung la/ de'i dbus su/ sangs rgyas pad+ma rnam rgyal ⑫yab yum gyi sbyor 25—612

mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs ri1par bsams la/ de'i 'od zer yi ge drug pa'i sgra dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros — pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa kyedang / bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang bsgur bar bsam zhing / 'od dpag med pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gsung gi mdzod/ /yi ge drug pa phyogs bcur chos 'khor bskor ba'i gsung / /rgyal ba'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbang thob pas/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong gsang ba'i chos kyi dbang bskur ro/ /sngags gong ma dang / sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ4/ zhes brjod do/ /des ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas/ skye ba med pa'i thugasung chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pa yin no/ /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ me long g.ya' dag pa la/ rdo rje phag mo'i gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la/ de la spyan ras gzigs kyi yum mar me las mar me chad pa bzhin du chad nas de dang gnyis su med par zhugs te༄ sna / thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi phreng ba kha dog sna lnga 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yum rnams bskul nas/ de dag rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de mthong ba tsam gyis zag med kyi bde ba ster nus pa'i lha mo me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ bdag dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs de yang / me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ me long nang gi lha mo lag pa g.yon pas gtad la/ dus gsum byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /shes rab rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /bde chen nyid du rnam sbyar bas/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs/ /shes rab nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /rnal 'byor ma dang 'bral mi bya/ /gong gi sngags dang / tsit+ta pradz+nyā sarba ta thā ga ta nā ma )a bhe 25—613

ṣiñtsa rmā3/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /da ni tshib/ dbang rin po che bskur ba na me/ bzhi pa dumi dmigs pa ④ ye shes kyi5/ 'gro ba drug gi snang ba'i yul med de/ /snang med ye shes nam mkha' dang mnyam pas/ /chos kyi sku las longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / /sprul pa'i sku ni ye shes dpag med che/ /mkha' dang mnyam la 'ubadag med don mdzad do/ /zhes brjod do/ /rjes la slob ma lhar gyur pa la mchod pa lnga 'bul / bkra shis kyi tshig rnams brjod do/ /de ni tshig dbang ngo / /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo 3cho ga bzhin du bskor bar bya'o/ /gtor ma rnams rgyas par bsngos la btang ba dang / 2 rjes kyi cho ga rnams byas la/slob dpon la me tog dbul ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos te/ dkyil 'khor mi dmigs par bya'o/ /sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod na/ nang gi sbyin sreg rtsa gsum 'dus mdor/ma las thob pa'i nyi ma byang chub kyi sems 1 me 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung gis sbar nas/gzung 1 'dzin gyi rtog pa skye ba med par bsreg pa'i me dbu ma nas snying gar phyin pas / pha las thob pa'i zla ba byang chub kyi sems dang snying gar 'dzom pas lus sems mi dmigs pa'i bde gsal chen po ni/ sbyin sreg rnams kyi mchog go zhes spyan ras gzigs kyi rgyud nas gsungs so/ /phyi'i sbyin sreg ni/ sa khru gang la mdzub 11gang bar brus/ kha khyer mdzub rkyegang phyir bskyed/ dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa 15bya/ mu khyud pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor/ /de'i nang du tsan+dan gyis zla gam du brtsigs 1 / dbang gi sreg nye5rdzas dang /dgang drugs dang / gtor ma dang de rnams g.yas g.yon dang mdun du bzhag 25—61 4

la / rgyan dang / gos dang / lta stangs rnams las dang mthun par byas te/me lha bskyed la mchod pa dang sreg rdzas dbul/ bstod pa bya'o/ /de nas me lha mer gyur pa'i dbus su/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang rung bskyed/ sreg hūṃrdzas rnams byen gyis brlabs te/ dbul ba ni rgyal po'i rim pa can nam/ rgyal po'i rim pa dang / bram ze'i rim pa med de/ gang 'thad kyis dbul lo/ /gsol ba gdab pa dang / sngags kyi 'od zer ni zhi ba dang / dbang rgyas dang / drag po rnams gang byed kyang / rtsa ba'i sngags kyi gsham snyedu las bzhi'i sngags btags pas dngos grub bsgrub pa'o/ /sbyin sreg gi rim pa'o/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi rgyud pad+ma zab pa dang / pad+ma rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i rab tu byed pa 'di/ dpal dzā /larnya ra pas mdzad pa'o/ /mnga' bdag mi tri pa'i phyag dpe las/ rgya gar phyag na'i zhal snga nas dang /bod kyi lo tsā byeb pradz+nyā tīrtis bsgyur zhing zhizhus te gtan la phab pa'o 5 //25—615

2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra phangs/ nya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa 'phrul/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)sa/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/61༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ 2〈〈pe 〉ra zhes gsungs pa la/ de yang 'jig rten 'dir sangs rgyas 'byung ba shin tu dkon te/ dper na me tog u dum wa ra dang 'dra'o/ /me tog de gang du skye na/ mtsho ma dros pa'i byang phyogs na ri rtse lnga pa ces pa yod/ de'i phyi rol na u dum wa ra'i tshal yod pa de ni nam zhig sangs rgyas dga' ldan du byon te/ yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe/ tshal de kha 'bus par 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan pa'i tshe kha phye bar 'gyur ro/ /dka' ba spyod pa'i tshe rnyid la/ sangs rgyas pa'i tshe rab tu rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /nam che'i 'du byed 'dor ba'i tshe rnyid par 'gyur ro/ /tshad ni shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam mo/ /kha dog ni sangs rgyas de rgyal rigs su 'byon na ni dkar po rab tu 'byung ngo / /bram ze'i rigs kyi nang du dkar por 'byung bar 'gyur ces gsungs so/ /gtan la dbab pa'i mdo las/ 'byung ba kun dga' bo 'di lta ste/ u dum wa ra'i me tog ni/ sangs rgyas skye ba dang dus gcig tu 'byung ste/ kha dog dang ldan zhing gsal ba/ 'od bzang ba/ dri ni dpag tshad gcig 'khor yug tu khyab par byed do/ /me tog de'i yon tan ni/ mig gi rab rib med par byed/ dran pa gsal bar byed/ nad rab tu zhi bar byed/ dri ngan pa thams cad rab tu sel bar byed pa/ dri zhim po 'byin pas sems can thams cad kyi khams dngas shing lus yang bar 'gyur bar byed do/ /'jig rten du gser gyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'byung yang / me tog de mi 'byung ngo zhes gsungs so—/ /de bas kyang gsang sngags 'byung ba dkon te/ bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byon te/sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / phyag na rdo rje sangs rgyas pa'i tshe ma yin par gsang sngags mi 'byung ngo zhes gsungs so/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog pas/ sangs rgyas stong 'byon pa dang / gsang sngags 'byung bar dkon zhes mdo sde dang rgyud sde gnyis ka nas gsungs te/ de yang de ltar sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig /gser thub/ 'od srung 'byon pas kyang rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa min pa gsang sngags ma gsungs/ shākya thub pa 'di nyid kyi bstan pa la/ ri bo po ta la'i shar phyogs su spyan ras gzigs kyi/ can pad+ma 'byung gnas la dbang bskur/ des za hor gtsug lag 'dzin gyi pho brang du/ dza lan dha ra la dbang bskur/ des che'i dngos grub thob nas lo nyis stong nyi shu rtsa lnga nas bram ze mai tri pa la dbang bskur/ des rgya gar gyi rgyal rigs badz+ra pā ṇi la rdo rje gdan byi shar phyogs su dbang bskur ro/ /des bal yul rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du bal po yi rangs pa la dbang bskur/ des bal yul yam bur ras pa badz+ra kir ti la dbang bskur/ des lo ro tshe kong gi dgon par mgos ston dbang phyug rdo rje la dbang bskrar/ des yar lungs sog kar gru gu ras pa la dbang bskur/ des karma ras pa pubye badz+ra la dbang bskur/ des pom rag snar dharma bla ma la dbang bskur / des shar phyogs spung ri'i dgon par/ bla ma mnyan ras pa la dbang bskur/ des rin po che 25—617
