1048༄khya/ /'phags pa 'dze+eg rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya lo ke shwa ra gu khya sru dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/dpal pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma rnam rgyas phyag 'tshal nas / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob byed pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gsang sgrub bshad/ /dad dang brtson 'grus snying rjer ldan / /dbang dang dam tshig ldan byas nas/ /dur khrod g.ya' ri gangs brag gam/ /nyams dga' dbe+en pa'i gnas dag tu/ /phyi rgyud pa la gtor ma gtang / /maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi dris byugs la/ /chang dang bdud rtsis chag chag gdab / /chos 'byung bsnol ma pad 'dab brgyad/ /mu khyud gru chad ldan pa dz+re / /sgo bzhi rgyan ldan bris kyang rung / /rdo rje ra ba me ris bskor/ /chos 'byung dmar po re khā dkar/ /mtshams su g.yung drung 'khyil pa bri/ /pad 25—619

'dab phyogs tshon mtshams mdzes tshon/ /gru chad ljang la sgo bzhi phyogs/ /sgo rgyan la sogs spyi dang mthun/ /dkyil 'khor dbus bum rgyan ldan du/ /chang dang bdud rtsi ril bu blugs/ /dgos pa'i cha rkyen tshang bar gzhag /thod pa chang dang bdud rtsis bkang / /bum pa'i khar bzhag dar dmar dgab/ /gre long chang gis byugs lkupa la/ /pad+ma chos 'byung sin+tu ras/ /sa bon yi ge bcas pa dgod/ /thod pa'i kha ru bzhag pa'i steng / /sman sna rin chen sna tshogs dang / /dri bzang dag dang snying po'i tshogs/ /ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi sogs / /'bru sna tshogs kyi phye ma la/ /gur gum gi wang sin+tu ra/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyar nas/ /chang gis sbrus pa'i ril bu la/ /sen+tu ra dang pad mtshal byug /mo gsar phru la 'khor lo bri/ /de la gong gi rdzas kyis byug /ril bu 'khor lo'i lte bar gzhag /dar gyis bkab la me long khar/ /bzhag ste steng du dar gdugs phub/ /sba lcag dkar po tshigs gsum pa'i/ /nang du sngags dang 'khor lo gzhag /ril bu lha grangs la sogs bcug /kha bcad mgo mjug zangs kyis dkris/ /zhing lpags lcag 'bras btags pa la/ /rin chen lnga dang dung sogs dang / /shel dang pha wang long bu btags/ /dar tshon sna lnga sngags ldan rgyan/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gzugs par bya/ /gtor ma mchod pa tshogs kyi rdzas/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i bye brag bsham/ /rkang gling thod rnga tshil chen spos/ /zhun chen mar me la sogs bya/ /bgegs la glud byin mtshams bcad la/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgom/ /dkon mchog spyan drangs phyag byas nas/ /mchod cing maṇ+ḍal dbul ba ste/ /bdun po rnam par dag pa dang / /gsol ba drag tu gdab par bya/ /de dag 25—620

sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /dngos gzhi phyi nang gsang gsum las/ /phyi ltar rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs//nang ltar lus la dgod pa dang / /gsang ba rtsa la dgod pa dang / /yang gsang de nyid sems la dgod/ /dang po bsnyen sgrub las gsum ste/ /yang gsang 'bras bu'i ngo sprod 1do/ /phyi ltar bsten pa bya ba ni/ /bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi/ /phyag rgyas bsdad la skyabs 'gro dang / /sems bskyed byas la stong pa'i ngang / /pad sdong kha gsum gyes pa'i dbus/ /nyi zla'i gdan la rang sems byāḥ/ /'od 'phros sems can sgrib pa sbyangs/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs su gyur/ /tshur 'dus sangs rgyas byin rlabs basbus/ /dhīḥl thim pas 'od du zhu/ /rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang sku/ /dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ /g.yas 'og pad+ma'i bgrang phreng dmar/ /g.yon pa ut+pal dmar po 'dzin/ /ral pa'i cod pan dar gyis mdzes/ /rin chen ze'u 'bru'i thrag ldan pa/ /spyan dmar zhal 'dzum thugs rje yis/ /sems can yongs la gzigs pa la/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsas bskor//de ltar rang nyid gtso bo ni/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'dus pa'o/ /bdag gi spyi gtsug pad zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid ni/ /'od dpag med pa'i ngo bo ste/ /skyil krung mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can / /sprul pa'i sku ru bsgoms 2snapa la/ /bka' brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin rnams—/ /gcer bu spyan gsum rus rgyan can/ /rdo rje dril bus 'khyud pa yi//25—62/

rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pas bskor/ /byin rlabs dbang bsgur byas par bsgom/ /g.yas phyogs pad sdong nyi ma'i steng / /bdud bzhi'i gdan la rta mchog sku/ /dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa ḍa ru g.yon sdigs mdzub/ /dril bur bcas pas dku la brtan/ /stag lpags dur khrod sbrul rgyan can/ /khro zhal spyan gsum mche bzhi gcigs/ /ral pa dmar ser 'khyil pa'i dbus/ /rta mgo ljang gu rta skad mtsher/ /rngog ma dmar po me ltar 'bar/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro la sogs pa/ /snang srid lha 'dre thams cad dang / /klu rnams dbang du sdud par byed/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang nas/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /'khor du dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro brgyad cu sogs/ /ha ha rtsu hūṃ phaṭa sgra sgogs/ /snang srid zil gyis gnon par bsgom/ /g.yon phyogs pad sdong chos 'byung bsgol/ /de dbus pad nyi ro yi steng / /gsang ba ye shes sgu mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum dmar/ /khro 'dzum mche gcigs spyan rtsa dmar/ /dbu skra grol zhing sgu stod khebs/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ro gdan brdzis/ /spyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /g.yas kyi dang po gri gug 'phyar/ /'og ma ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po thod khrag 'dzin/ /'og ma kha ṭī bsnams pa'o/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu brgyan zhing / /thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga yis mdzes/ /rin chen dar dpyangs brgyan par bsgom/ /me ri 'bar ba'i dbus bzhugs shing / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor/ /a ral+li dang phe sgra sgogs/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud/ /snang srid dbang du sdud par bsgom/ /'og 25—622

phyogs me dpung 'khrugs pa yi/ /'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dang / /chos skyong dam can pho nya'i tshogs/ /phyi nang srung ma ma lus rnams/ /mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i ngo bor gyur/ /gri gug thod khrag kha ṭī bsnams/ /thod pa skam rlon rus rgyan can/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyis mdzes/ /ha ri ni sa'i sgra sgrogs shing / /gdan 'og pad+ma 'degs par bsam/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /spyi bor zla steng oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par pad steng udamar po/ /snying gar nyi steng hūṃ sngon po/ /sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab/ /de nas gtso bo'i thugs ka ru//pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ /byāḥlas 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /ye shes spyan drangs mchod la bstem/ /rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' dang / /khro bo'i tshogs dang mchod pa yi/ /lha mor bcas pa spyan drangs la/ /mchod de dbang bskur gsol ba btab/ /rgyal bas dbang bskur dgongs pa mdzad/ /khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing / /mchod pa'i lha mos mchod nga ngang / /yum lngas bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /sdig sgrib dag nas spyi bo ru/ /rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas dang / /rigs lngas dbu la brgyan par bsgom/ /de ltar ji srid mi skyo'i bar/ /gsal bar bsgom pa bskyed rim yin/ /bzlas pa byed pa'i dus su ni/ /bdag dang rang bzhin gsang ba'i yum/ /spyi bor bla ma rigs bdag dang / /kun gyi thugs kar pad nyi dang / /zla ba'i gdan la trīḥyig mthar/ /sngags kyis g.yas su bskor ba las/ /'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs mchod/ /mnyes nas byin rlabs dngos grub rnams/ /bdag la thim pas sdig sgrib dag /tshogs rdzogs dbang bzhi thob par bsam//25—623

khams gsum 'gro drug sems can la/ /'od zer phog pas sgrib sbyang nas/ /phyi snod gzhal yas khang du gyur/ /nang bcud lha yi rang bzhin la/ /pho rnams spyan ras gzigs su gyur/ /mo rnams gsang ba ye shes la/ /bdud dang log 'dren rta mgrin sku/ /'od dang me dpung rab 'bar zhing / /gzugs snang lha yi rang bzhin la/ /sgra grags thams cad sngags kyi sgra/ /sems kyi dran rtog chos sku'i ngang / /de ltar bzlas pa ci rigs bya/ /rjes su phyi snod nang bcud rnams/ /rim gyis thams cad bdag la bsnyu/ /bdag kyang dhīḥnas stong pa'i bar/ /mi dmigs ma bcos spros bral ba/ /mi dmigs ci yang mi bsam par/ /chos sku'i ngang la ci gnas gzhag /dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ /thun mtshams lha yi nga rgyal dang / /spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad bya/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ dīḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ yab kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ dīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya spyi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ dzaḥ/ rta mgrin gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ gsang ba ye shes kyi snying po'o/ /ḍā ki be+e ha ri ni sa ra tsa tri ya hūṃ dzaḥ/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi yum gyi snying po'o/ /ba su sir+ghaṃ na na/ kha dhe sidhi/ sarba sedhi pha la hūṃ/ sedhi sedhi sa ma ya/ bsdus bsdus/ hūṃ hūṃ/puṣ+ṭi / wa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ hūṃ/ rat+na sernyi sa ma ya/ hri hri/ dza dza/ dbang du bsdu ba'i snying pa'o/ /de ltar phyi sgrub bsnyen pa la/ /dkyil 'khor bcu bzhi mi dgos so/ /rgyun du yi dam nar mar bya/ /ste/nang ltar 'jig rten dbang phyug gi/ /lha rnams lus la dgod pa ni/ /sngon 'gro yan lag bdun pa dang / /skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed nas/ /25—621

tshad med bzhi yis blo sbyangs te/ /stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi dang / /zla ba'i gdan la s+thāḥdamar po/ /'od 'phros tshur la 'dus pa las/ /gong ltar bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs skyil krung / /rgyan rdzogs 'ja' 1'od dkyil bzhugs pa/ /phyi sgrub ji lta ba ru gsal/ /bla ma rigs bdag bka' brgyud bcas/ /spyi bor rdo rje 'chang ltar bsgom/ /snying ni pad+ma 'dab brgyad de/ /nyi zla'i gdan la rta mgrin ni/ /dmar nag dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /g.yas pa dbang sdud phyag rgya yis/ /pad+ma'i phreng ba dmar po 'dren/ /g.yon pa at+pal dmar po yi/ /zhags par bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis/ /dku la brten nas gar stabs mdzad/ /de yi thugs kar pad+ma dang / /nyi zla'i dbus su s+thāḥl sngags/ /g.yas su 'khor bar bsgom pa'o/ /lte bar chos 'byung bsgoms pa'i steng / /pad+ma nyi ma ro steng du/ /gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /gsang gnas pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng / /rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro yab yum ste/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar/ /lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ser/ /nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar/ /byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang / /yab rnams yum dang mtshungs pa ste/ /gri gug thod khrag rgyan dang ldan/ /lte ba'i yum gyi gdan nas bteg /de nas sgu gsung thugs byin brlab/ /ye shes bstems nas dbang bskur ro/ /lte bar bde chen gtum mo'i me 'bar dmigs/ /rlung bzung dbang bsdus byang sems rin chen bzhu/ /rngubs nas me la bstems pas yeshes 'bar/ /'khor 'das gnyis med dgongs pa bskyang bar bsam/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spyan drangs rlung dang bsre/ /me la bstems la longs 25—625

sku bde chen bskyed/ /'gro drug sems can dbang bsnyus byang sems bsgom/ /snying rje bskyed dus rlung rngub me la bsnyim/ /sprul skus 'gro 'dul phreng las ci yang ston/ /dmigs med ngang nas rlung bzung cir mi dgongs/ /mkha' ltar dag pa chos sku mngon du gyur/ /sngags bzlas dus su 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyebs / /me ltar tsha la gdung ba'i tshogs 'phros pas/ /skye 'gro'i snying nas bzung ste bkug byas la/ /rig pa'i ngo bo thugs ka'i trīḥl thim/ /lus po 'od du zhu nas lte bar sdud/ /mkha' 'gro yab yum pho mo'i snying po la/ /dngos grub sdud pa'i sngags ltar bzlas pa bya/ /rjes su lha rnams thams cad rang sar zhu/ /mkha' la sprin dengs lta bur yal ba'i ngang / /ma bcos dmigs gtad med pa'i ngang nyid las/ /ma bcos blo yis mi dpyad mi bsgom par/ /gzung 'dzin blang dor yid byed med pa'i ngang / /dngos po'i rang bzhin gsal dang bde stong dang / /chags 'dzin mi bya rnam dag de rang bskyong / /rjes su thun mtshams bya ba gong ltar bya/ /nang du lus la lha dgod bsgrub pa'o/ /gsang ba rtsa la dgod pa ni/ /rim par nyams su blang bya ba/ /stan la bsam gtan phyag rgyas gnas/ /sngon 'gro yan lag bdun pa bya/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi/ /shu n+ya tā yis stong par bsgom/ /chos nyid stong par byang chub dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi dang / /zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan bsgom ste/ /nyi zla'i gdan la mngon byang chub/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /gdan steng rang rig yi ge dhīḥ//gsung yig 'bru la mngon byang chub/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /dīḥlas 25—626

pad+ma s+thāḥs mtshan pa/ /thugs kyi phyag mtshan mngon byang chub/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /pad+ma byāḥs mtshan 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba'i rgyud sbyangs lhar gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs basbus/ /sngar gyi dhīḥs mtshan pad+mar thim/ /de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ /bdag nyid lha yi skur sdogs pa/ /yongs su rdzogs las mngon byang chub/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes so//de yang bdab/ nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgu mdog dmar//g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gar gyis 'gying / /dbu skra gyen brdzes dar gyis brgyan / /rin chen dar kyis mdzes par spras/ /phyag g.yas pad phreng g.yon pad dmar/ /gsang ba ye shes yum gyis 'khyud/ /dmar mo gcer bu spyan gsum ma/ /phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag /thod pa skam rlon rus rgyan can/ /rin chen sna tshogs dar dpyangs brgyan/ /ye shes me ri'i dbus su bzhugs/ /de yi sku yi rtsa gsum dang / /'khor lo bzhi sogs gsal btab la//spyi bor bde chen 'khor lo la/ /rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /dbus su bde gshegs spyan ras gzigs/ /dkar po 'khor lo dril bu can/ /bde gshegs mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis/ /'khor lo gri gug thod khrag can/ /rus pa rin chen rgyan ldan bskor/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na/ /rtsa 'dab bcu drug dbus su ni/ /pad+ma rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ /dmar po pad+ma dril bu can/ /pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro bcu drug ni/ /pad+ma gri gug thod khrag can/ /rus pa rin chen rgyan ldan bskor/ /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo na/ /rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su ni/ /rdo rje rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ /mthing la rin chen dril bu can/ /rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro brgyad/ /rdo rje gri gug thod 25—627

khrag can/ /rus pa rin chen rgyan ldan bskor/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na/ /rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa gnyis dbus/ /rin chen rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ /ser po rin chen dril bu can/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro drug cu bzhi/ /rin chen gri gug thod khrag can/ /rus pa rin chen rgyan ldan bskor/ /gsang gnas nor bu'i 'khor lo ru/ /rtsa 'dab bzhi yi dbus su ni/ /las kyi rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ /ljang gu rgya gram dril bu can/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu bzhi/ /rgya gram gri gug thod khrag thogs/ /rus pa rin chen rgyan ldan bskor/ /de ltar 'khor lo'i lha rnams te/ /slar yang snying po rgyan gyi lha/ /yab kyi thugs kar rta mgrin dang / /spyi bor bla ma lte ba ru/ /dpa' bo sde bzhi bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin yum gyi thugs kar yang / /rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma/ /spyi bor na bza' dkar mo dang / /lte bar rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro bsgom/ /kun kyang thod pa skam zlon dang / /rin chen rus rgyan dar gyis mdzes/ /pad+ma nyi zla ro gdan can/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs / /de ltar gsal bar bsgom byas nas/ /sgu gsung thugs ldan byen rlabs te/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstem/ /dbang bskur dbang rtags dbu rgyan la/ /de nas rang gi mdoms par nas/ /yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yos/ /gsang gnas lha tshogs me 'bar te/ /'khor lo bzhi yi gtso bo rnams/ /ltos chags med pa'i me 'bar te/ /ste ba'i a la gtugs nas ni/ /me 'bar haṃ la reg pa yis/ /byang chub sems kyi rgyun bab pas/ /'khor lo bzhi gang lha tshogs rnams/ /bde ba chen por 'bar ba dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus dang / /skye 'gro sems can byams 25—628

sdang sogs/ /dus dang gnad du gang 'gro ba/ /rlung dang dbyer mred basbus la bstem/ /me 'bar nyon mongs rab bsregs nas/ /stong nyid snying rje chen po'i ngang / /gnyug ma yid la mi byed pa/ /tha mal shes pa ma bcos ngang /rang rig dri med bskyang byas la/ /rlung bzung rig pa phyogs med sbyang / /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bum pa dang / /thod pa me long 'khor lo dang / /dril bu sba lcag dag la yang / /rang nyid ji lta'i bskyed bstem bya/ /bdag dang de rnams thugs ka nas/ /'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs/ /me ltar tsha la gdung 'phros pas/ /gang dmigs la sogs skye 'gro yi/ /pho yi snying dang mo yi ni/ /gsang ba'i gnas nas bzung nas ni/ /rang dbang med par mdun du bkug /'od zer 'phros pas phog pa yis/ /de rnams 'od du zhu nas ni/ /byang sems dkar dmar rnam par gyur/ /ril bu la sogs rdzas rnams dang / /rang gi gsang bar bsdus la bstem/ /thugs ka'i dīḥl 'dus par bsam/ /byams dang snying rje drag tu bsgom/ /rlung bzung sngags bzlas gang goms bya/ /thun rjes thogs rim thun mtshams su/ /bsngo ba smon lam spyod lam bya/ /thun bzhi thun drug la sogs spyad/ /tshogs dang gtor mas thun mtshams mchod/ /bstod pas bstod cing bkra shis brjod/ /yig brgya la sogs bshags pa bya/ /rtags dang cho 'phrul mkha' 'gro'i ltas/ /dngos grub mtshan ma la sogs pa/ /bzang ngan bye brag ji ltar yang / /rmi lam bzang dang ngan la sogs/ /gang la'ang dga' dang mi dga' yi/ /mtshan mar 'dzin par mi bya'o/ /de ltar zhag bdun nyer gcig dang / /zla gsum zla drug la sogs par/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bsgrub/ /de nas 25—629

sgrub pa tshar rjes su/ /ril bu 'khor lo lus la bcang / /sidhū ra yis spyi bor byug /dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga dang / /ste ba gsang gnas dag tu byug /bum pa'i chu yis bkru btung bya/ /thod chang btung la dngos grub blang / /gtor ma la sogs sbyin sreg bya/ /bum chu gang blud dbang du 'gyur/ /sba lcag bzad zhing glad la bskor/ /'gro ba dbang du 'dus par bsgom/ /sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor zla gam khar/ /dbang gi shing dmar zla gam brtsigs/ /me sbar lha tshogs bskyed par bya/ /ye shes pa bstem mchod bstod dbul/ /sreg rdzas 'dod yon sna tshogs dang / /ril bu mar dang 'bru sna bsreg /zas nor gos dang rin po che/ /shing thog 'bru sna ji snyed 'bul/ /gsol ba gdab cing mchod bstod bya/ /rjes su ye shes sems dpa' gshegs/ /thal ba chu bo'i gzhung du dor/ /de yis snang ba dbang du 'gyur/ /rtsa la bkod pa'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /las spyor lta thur bzhed pa yin/ /yang gsang sems la bkod pa ni/ /dbe+en gnas phyi ru mi btsal te/ /lus 'di gzhal yas khang nyid yin/ /lha sku logs su mi btsal te/ /sems nyid skye 'gag med pa de/ /rigs kyi bdag po bla ma yin/ /ma rtogs nyon mongs gti mug 'di/ /rtogs grol thugs rje chen po yin/ /yid byed rtog tshogs 'phro ba de/ /rtogs pas sangs rgyas stong rtsa yin/ /zhe sdang gdug rtsub ldan pa de/ /gzhi med rtogs pas rta mgrin yin/ /'dod sems gdung ba tur tur de/ /rtsa bral rtogs pas gsang ye yin/ /nyon mongs nga rgyal rtog tshogs rnams/ /ngar 'dzin bral bas dpa' bo yin/ /phrag dog rlung ltar 25—630

'tshub pa de/ /re dogs zad pas dpa' mo yin/ /chu khams khrag dang rnam shes dag /rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /sa khams sha dang tshor ba de/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro zhes su grags/ /me khams drod dang 'du shes de/ /pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro yin/ /rlung khams dbugs 1dang 'du byed de/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro zhes su grags/ /nam mkha'i khams dang sems nyid gzugs/ /mkha' 'gro pad+ma'i dra ba'o/ /skye mched tshogs drug de yi yul/ /'dod yon mchod pa'i lha mo yin/ /dge dang mi dge'i rtogs tshogs rnams/ /dam can bka' sdod srung mar bshad/ /de ltar sems kyi ngo bo de/ /ma rtogs 'khrul pas 'khor ba ste/ /de shes rtogs pas mya ngan 'das/ /lha sgu sems kyi rang rtsal de/ /dngos por bzung bas 'khrul pa ste/ /lha yang sems nyid chos sgur gsal / /sngags ni smra brjod bral ba'i phyir/ /phyi nang rlung gi rgyu ba yang /smras tshad grag stong brjod med yin/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rig pa 'di/ /ye nas chos skur gnas pa la/ /ngo sprad de ngo shes pa yin/ /chos dbyings ye shes rtogs pa la/ /sangs rgyas zhes su grags pa'o/ /goms 'dris brtan na drod rtags 'char/ /de sbyangs chos sgu'i ngo bo la/ /gzung bar bya ba'i yul tsam med/ /drod rtags tshad dang nyams myong la/ /ma chags rang byung rtsad nas dag /rang don chos sku mngon gyur te/ /gzhan don gzugs sku lhun grub 'byung / /'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /snyan brgyud dri ma rnged pa'o / /ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //25—631

'gor kyi cho ga jes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a pa ra mi ta ā yudz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal be+e bye 2nā ma/bod skad du/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin tshe dpag mred pa'i sgu/ /ye shes lnga ldan gsung gi bdag /thugs rje'i thugs kyis rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /bla ma tshe dpag med la 'dud/ /rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud las byung ba'i / /cho ga bzang pos yongs bzung bshad/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid kun ldan zhing / /gzhan phan sgrub pa'i blo gros can/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don sgrub phyir/ /yid 'ong nyams dga'i gnas nyid du/ /lha yi rnal 'byor gsal ba dang / /gtso bo 'bum la 'khor rnams khri / /rab 'bring mtshan ma thob pa dang / /slob mas me tog dang bcas pas/ /gus pas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir/ /sa gzhi brtags shing bzung dang sbyang / /25—633

nyes pa med pa'i sa phyogs der/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gsal byas nas/ /baṃ las bskyed pa'i lha mo ser/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan lus phyed snang / /bum pa 'dzin la mchod cing bstod/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khrod ni dpang du 'gyur / /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /lag pa sa la bsnun pa yis/ /dga' ba'i mdangs ldan lha mo yis/ /khyod ni slob dpon mchog yin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor las ni rab tu snabasgrubasan/ /brjod nas sa la thim pa ltar/ /phyogs skyong gtor ma 'bul ba dang / /mthun pa'i grogs dang gsol ba gdab/ /ro bsal nyes pa spangs pa de/ /'thas par bcag cing rnam lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lnga ni khyab par byug /me yis zhi ba'i las kun gyi/ /sbyin sreg sbyangs dang sngags kyis ni/ /byen brlabs lha yi khang par bsam/ /bskyed pa'i yan lag kun rdzogs pas/ /slob dpon dkyil 'khor steng 'dug la/ /slob ma gus pas spos thogs te/ /mchod cing bstod dang gsol ba gdab/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /skyon gyis ma gos li khri ltar/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /mnyam nyid sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad ni/ /yon tan ma lus bskyed mdzad cing / /yid bzhin nor bu mtshungs ldan pa'i/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshe dpag med pa gsung gi bdag /'chi bdag ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /tshe yi dngos grub stsol ba'i sgu/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /dkyil 25—631

'khor bsnyus te rta mchog sku/ /khro zhing rab brjid nga rgyal dang / /rkang pa hūṃ las rdo rjer byas/ /mig gnyis nyi zla 'bar ba ste/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yis / /'jigs med byang shar mtshams song nas/ /dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha dang lha min bgegs tshogs nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin—/ /nga yi bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'gro bar kyis/ /gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na/ /ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshar shepa brgyar 'gas shing / /lus rnams stong du gyur nas ni/ /rnam par 'joms par gdon mi za/ /de bas khyed rnams gzhan du dengs/ /rta mchog sngags dang rdo rje 'gros/ /dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor bar bya/ /de nas khro bo'i phur pa rnams/ /tī la ya zhes btab nas kyang / /ā 2ko ṭa yis brdung bar bya/ /me da'i 1sngags kyis byen gyis brlab/ /sa yi lha dang lha tshogs rnams/ /sta gon gnas par bya ba ni/ /lha rnams rdzogs par bskyed pa dang / /mchod cing bstod de spos thogs la/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag mred / /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can / /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa dang / /slob ma rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag che ge zhes/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs nas/ /song 4nub dgyes par 'byon par 'tshal/ /de nas phyi nang mchod pas mchod/ /dkyil 'khor lhag par gnas pa'o/ /rin chen rgyu las byung ba yis/ /lto che mgrin pa ring ba dang / /mchu 'phyangs nag nog 5ra ri med/ /lha grangs mnyam pa las bum 25—635

dang / /rang rang phyag mtshan rdzogs par bya/ /ha sa de ba gser dngul dang //mu tig mu me+en byi ru gzhug /nas til gro sran muṅga 1dang / /ga pur dzā ti gur gum mchog /tsan+dan gnyis dang a ga ru/ /mar dang bu ram sbrang rtsi dang //lan tshwa rnams kyis lto ba dgang / /kha tshar ma nyams ras zung gisasnye/ /mgrin par rab tu brgyan pa dang / /kha rgyan ku sha 'bras bu can/ /sna tshogs pad+ma ras kyi steng / /yang na ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs/ /r+ghaṃ ④las bskyed pa'i gzhal yas khang / /chu skyes nyi zla'i gdan stengs su/ /lha rnams rdzogs par 5bskyed pa dang / /sngags bzlas ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /bum pa gang bar bsam pa dang / /lha rnams rang rang bstod pa bya/ /las bum rta mgrin bskyed pa dang / /sngags bzlas bar chad bsrung ba dz+wa dang / /sha lnga bdud rtsi'i gtor mas mchod/ /'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa yang / /snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa/ /skye rgas 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bo/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i 9tshul bstan pa'i/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de ni bdag la stsol / / byang chub sems/ kyang bdag la stsol/ /rta1sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum de ni bdag la stsol1 / /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /'od kyis bur byas sdig pa sbyangs/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po pa/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo 25—636

rje can/ /sangs rgyas dus gsum 'byung ba rnams/ /rdo rje gsang sngags rab bsgoms hūṃpas/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis / /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs kun/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga bya/ /tshe dpag med pa bdag la dgongs/ /ma lus bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs rnams/ /'di nyid nas bzung sangs rgyas bar/ /bla med bdag la gzigs par mdzod/ /dam tshig sdom pa bzung ba ni/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung 2bar bya/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung 4 bar bya/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung 5bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi3/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang gzung 7bar bya/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bkyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang mi /nus bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni babe+eb pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sbud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung 7bar bgye / /gnyis su med pa'i tshangs spyod dang / /rang gi dam tshig bsrung bar bgyi—/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas myur du bsgrub bya ste/ /25—637

sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su bsgral rmyebar bgyi/ /gus pas lan gsum brjod par bya/ /dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga ru/ /dri yi thig le gsum byas te/ /rta bdun chu skyes 'khor lo'i steng kye/ /thugs gsung sku yi snying pos brgyan/ /rigs kyi lha las 'od 'phros pasakye / /ye shes gnyis su med par bstem/ /chu gnyis sngon du 'gro bas mchod/ /deng nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /a shwaza dang pa la sha /u dusmra ra la sogs pa/ /bcu gnyis sor gyi tshad tsam la/ /rtse mor me tog gis brgyan nas/ /maṇ+ḍal 'dab brgyad rnam lngas byug /shar nas byedabus su dor ba ni/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa/ /steng du mchog gi dngos grub yin//phyogs su phrin las grub pa dang / /thur bltas sa 'og 'grub pa yin/ /mtshams su 'jig rten 5dngos grub po/ /de nas skyor chu sbyin pa ni/ /oṃ dhīḥ bi shud+dhā marba dharmāḥ6sarba pā pā ni tsāmya 3bi sho dha ya sarba bi ka la pān 3a pa na ya hūṃ—/ zhes pas sgo gsum dag sbyangs nas/ /sgud pa dmar po sum sgril la/ /rta mgrin sngags kyis bcing bar bya/ /ku sha gtsang ma sngas dang stan/ /ma nor seng ge'i nyal stangs bzhin/ /thub pas ting 'dzin 'grub pa ltar/ /mtshan ma gang byung brjod par bya/ /bzang na dngos grub spro ba bskyed/ /ngan na sbyin sreg 1gis ni bzlog /zab cing rgya che'i chos bshad ni/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dusmra ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni re /'ga' zhig /'byung ngam yang na mi 'byung srid/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /bla ma rdo rje can mchod la/ /25—638

nang par langs te dkyil 'khor lha/ /nam mkhar bteg ste thig gdab ste/ /bu mo gtsang ma sdom ldan gyis/ /ras bal las byung bkal ba dang / /ye shes lnga'am sgu gsung thugs/ /oṃ a byo n+ya a 1nu ga ta sarba dharmā/ brjod nas bsgril bar bya ba ni/ /pad+ma'i 2snasgod du bzhag rdonas kyang / /mi 'chi lnga yis spangs byas la/ /blo ldan ye shes bstem byas nas/ /nam mkhar ye shes dza dzas gdab/ /sgo yi bcu gnyis cha dang ldan/ /srid kyang khang pa nyis 'gyur la/ /tshangs pa'i las thig drangs pa la/ /oṃ badz+ra sru tra sa ma ye ma ti kra ma hūṃ/tshangs dang zur thig la sogs pa/ /bstan bcos mthong zhing blo ldan des/ /cha ni gang yin rnam par dbye/ /gal te nyes pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /chad na bla ma'i srog g.yo thuzhing / /dman lhag nad kyis btab par 'gyur/ /phyogs 'khrul slob ma rmongs par 'gyur/ /blo ldan nyes pa med par bya/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bcas/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas brgyan/ /nyi zla dril bu g.yer khas spras/ /pho brang chu skyes rim pa gnyis/ /mu khyud pad+ma'i phreng ba dang / /khyams dang phyi rol pad ra dang / /rdo rje me ri la sogs pa/ /rnam pa ma lus sgogs par bya/ /rin chen lnga dang 'bru phye 'am/ /pad+ma'i sgod du so sor bzhag /sa bon bris la ye shes bstem/ /sgu gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab / /sngon po ser po dkar po ljang / /dmar po 'di ni nang du 'dod/ /g.yas skor rgyun ma chad par bri/ /dbang ldan mtshams su drang ba bya/ /pad+ma'i sgod kyis steng nas bkab/ /'di ni chos dbyengs dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /tshon gye las ni yang dag brtsam/ /me tog dor la mtshan ma brtag /shar sngo lho ser nub 2bye—639

dkar po/ /byang phyogs in+d+ra m+bi la'i mdog /pad+ma lha snam dmar po'o/ /de ltar rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /khrus byas dri zhim lus byugs 1nas/ /gos bzang brgyan la lan gsum bskor/ /tshe dpag med pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /shar gyi sgo nas nang du zhugs/ /yid kyis sgo bzhi dbye bar bsam/ /oṃ badz+ra muṅgha 2ṭa/ sa ma ya pra be sha ye hūṃ/ rnam rgyal la sogs bum pa rnams/ /gnas dang go rims 4bzhin du dgod/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan phreng sogs/ /mchod pa'i rdzas kyis legs par brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams sdogs par bskyed / /ye shes bstems la mchod bstod bya/ /tshogs kyi 5'khor los tshim pa dang / /bar chad zhi phyir shar phyogs su/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba dang / /slob ma'i cho ga ji lta bar/ /slob dpon bdag nyid dbang dang ldan/ /shar gyi phyogs nas 'jug pa dang / /de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir/ /khrus byas bgegs dang sdig pa sbyang / /gdong pa ras kyis bkab nas ni/ /bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /bdag ni skal bzang rigs yin no/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi6 / /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /de nas tshig 'dis gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /tshe dpag med pa'i grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ /oṃ ā 7khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ me tog phreng ba gtad pa dang / /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal te/ /oṃ na ma ste 8hūṃ/ oṃ na ma mi hūṃ/ na mo na maḥ9hūṃ swā hā/ shar nas zhugs nas lho nas dbang / /nub nas chos bshad byas nas ni/ /phrin 25—640

las sgrub pa la sogs pa'i/ /don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pa thā na ya ād+ma r+ghaṃ1/ nit+yā ta 2yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a bye tiṣ+ṭha na swa oṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhe ṣe ka ta ād+ma 4dzā nit+yā ta 5yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhe ṣiñtsa rmā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra bar dha na ya āt+pa ram̐ nit+yā ta 7yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga tā badz+ra dharma nai pra war dha ya oṃ/ sarba ta thā ga tā 9pū dza karmā rna/ āt+pa dzā nit+yā ta 1 yā mi / sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru oṃ/ dam tshig sdom pa sbyin pa dang / /rnal 'byor du ni sems bskyed do/ /oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ud pā da yā 1mi/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag /oṃ su ra te sa ma ya hūṃ/ sed+dhi badz+ra ya thā rta su khaṃ/deng khyod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / /tshe dpag med kyi dngos grub thob/ /dngos grub gzhan dag lta ci smos/ /dkyil 'khor ma zhugs mi smra'o / /dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ /'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /gal te khyod kyis smras gyur na/ /dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje yis/ /rang gi mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur/ /tshe dpag med pa deng khyod kyi/ /snying la de ring yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub rnams/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ / badz+ra u da —ka oṃ āḥhūṃ/ deng nas brtsams nas bu khyod kyi/ /tshe dpag med pa nga yin gyis/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa na15/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas / /dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ /de nas slob ma'i gtso bo yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag la byen gyis rlobs mdzod la/ /25byed6 1

tshe dpag med pa dbab par mdzod/ /rkang mthil rlung gi dkyil 'khor dhi/ /snying gar lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ /mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ /spyi bor 1snayo las rlung dang haṃ/ /de yi spyi bor tshe dpag med/ /yab yum 'od kyi rang bzhin du2/ /gar byed sku las ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi babs nas sku la thim/ /zag med bde bas gang bar bsgom/ /oṃ byāḥhūṃ bye badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe ā 4be sha ya ā be 5sha ya a/ ste bha 'uya/ ra ra ra tsa la ya hūṃ a haḥdh+ri/zhes brjod rol mo'i sgra dang ni/ /gu gul zla mtshan thod pa ru/ /dur khrod sol ba'i me yis bsreg /bab gyur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /aḥ sngolas gsung gi bdud rtsi bsam/ /rgyu —byāḥbadz+ra/ dge dang mi dge hūṃl sogs pa/ /smṛs skrushig rdo rje can gyi rigs/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brtan par bya'o/ /tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rig 1pa'i me tog 'di dor bas/ /sngon tshe ye shes brnyes 7pa'i lha/ /gang yin de la 'bab par shog /pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho1 / bye brag dang dngos grub brtag par bya/ pra ti kṛṇ+ḍa ti oṃ rmyesatwa ma hā ba la/ slob ma'i mgo la bcing bar bya/ /tshe dpag med pa deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe tra a pa khiha ra pa ṭa lo saspyoḥ/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pas 1 rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni tshe dpag med du skye/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ /'gro don phun tshogs dngos grub kyang / /thams cad khyod la mngon du 'gyur/ /dngos grub thob cing dam tshig srungs/ /gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /rim gyis rnam par dag pa bstan/ /de nas slob ma dad ldan des/ /bla ma'i zhabs la 25—642

phyag 'tshal nas/ /yon mchog dam pa 'bul ba dang / /dbang bskur don du gsol ba gdab/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /yab yum gnyis med bde chen sku/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /lan gsum brjod nas shar phyogs su/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad khri la 'dug /rnam rgyal bum pa la sogs nas/ /chu rnams dung chos bum par bsdus / /rdo rje'i glu dang rol mo'i sgra/ /rigs lnga rig ma'i lha mo dang / /byang chub sems dpa' bkra shis brjod/ /khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bsrung ngo / /gsang gsum dam tshig las byung ba'i/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i dri ma med/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /mi bskyod rdo rje dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a bye tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ gser la sogs pa'i dbu rgyan la/ /rin 'byung bskyed cing ye shes bstem/ /dar dpyangs bcings la tshig 'di brjod/ /thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang / /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa a dzha ṣiñtsa rmā/ rin chen la sogs rdo rje la/ /snang ba mtha' yas bskyed cing bstem/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 1rdo rje'i dbang / /di ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis zung / /oṃ badz+ra a bye pa ti ste/ a bhi ṣiñtsa rmā2/ dril bu don grub bskyed byas la/ /ye shes bstems 1la tshig 'di brjod/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yi/ /'gro don mnyam med byed pa yi/ /mchod pa'i phrin las rdzogs byed pa'i/ /dril bu las kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ a bye pa ta ye a bhi ṣiñtsa rmā4/ slob ma oṃ las rnam snang bskyed/ /ye shes spyan drangs 25—613

gnyis su med/ /rdo rje ming gi dbang bsgur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang gzhom par mi nus pa'i/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab tu grags/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sgyi ṣe ka ta rmā1/ chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang / /dril bu dang ni ming gi dbang / /rig pa yi ni dbang lnga'o/ /nyon mongs lnga ni rnam dag pas/ /dbang bskur lnga ni thob pa yin/ /ma rig pa las 'das nas kyang / /ye shes lnga ni rim gyis 2 thob/ /de nas spyi bo mgrin pa dang / /snying ga lte ba gsang gnas rnams/ /'khor lo lnga yi gnas nyid du/ /rigs lnga tshe dpag med rnams kyi4/ /dbang bsgur lha rnams yab yum ste/ /'chi med byang chub sems su gyur/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga rnams gang / /byang chub sems kyi dbang bsgur ro/ /'chi med rdo rje'i lus su gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sku ru bsgom/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sedhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa ste 5dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hūṃ hūṃ/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /dpa' mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyings 6kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed7/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /mchog gi srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /mtshan ma med par 'gro ba'i don/ /gang dag bdag gis byed nus pas/ /phyir mi ldog 25—6 /4

pa dbang bsgur che/ /dpa' bo chen po bdag la stsol1/ /shar du seng ge'i khye la 'dug /steng du gdugs dkar phub nas kyang / /rnam rgyal bum pas dbang bsgur te/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas te/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya / /oṃ badz+ra a 2bhi ṣe ka ta a bhi ṣiñtsa rmān/ dril bu glegs bam lag tu gtad / /phrin las thogs pa med pa rnams/ /bu yis gzhan don bla med byos / /khyod ni rdo rje slob dpon yin/ /chos kyi 4rgyal por dbang bskur ro/ /lha yi snying po lan gsum brjod/ /me tog phreng ba spyi bor bzhag /bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis/ /bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan bdag gis sbyin lags kyis/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /sems can ma lus drang ba'i phyir/ /chags pa med pa'i bsam pa yis/ /ji ltar gdul bya sna tshogs la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /de bzhin rigs kyis gang 'dul ba/ /khyod kyi phrin las mchog yin no/ /deng nas bzung 5nas bu khyod kyi/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang bsad pa dang / /dgug dang bcing dang bsreg pa dang / /bskrad dang dbye ba la sogs pa/ /phrin las sna tshogs grub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ri lu ste/ /mi snang bcud len mkha' la spyod / /thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /de dag khyod kyis grub par bya/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib sel ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lo dhīḥ/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing 25—6 5

gsal la dri ma med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /chos rnams de ltar shes par gyis/ /hoḥyis mda' gzhu phyogs bzhir 'phangs/ /mtshan mo gnas khang dbe+en pa ru/ /bzhin bzangs mig yangs lang tshor ldan/ /lus la dri yis byugs byas te/ /rtse dang dgod pa la sogs pas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis phab ste/ /nor bu byang chub sems ltung bas/ /nya phyis dung chos la sogs su/ /drir bcas slob ma'i kha ru ni/ /mthe bo srin lag dag gis sbyin/ /a ho su khas de btung ngo / /zag med bde chen lus la rgyas/ /rdo rje de yis nyon mongs 'joms/ /mtshan ldan shes rab rang bzhin te/ /lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun du phyag rgya long / /bu yis bla med mchod par gyis/ /yol bas bar bcad snasnyoms 'jug gis/ /srub dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mi rtog ye shes skye bar 'gyur / /ltos shig ltos shig sems la ltos/ /sems nyid cir yang grub pa med / /bsal gzhag dgag sgrub gar thuyang med/ /'dis ni rang rig ye shes yin/ /bla ma sprul pa'i skur byas te/ /chos gos bzung la lung bstan bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa'i mtha' ni grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro nyid las bton/ /'di ni ngas khyod lung bstan yin/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sernyi sa ma ya 4ste bhur bhu ba swaḥshā/ khams gsum pa yi rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por brtan pa dang / /des ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ / bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /6di ring sangs rgyas sras su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /rta dang glang po ma 25—646

he dang / /bu dang chung ma la sogs dbyeg /phyag bya bla ma dam pa la/ /ma zhen sems kyis dbul bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod byas te/ /tshogs kyis rnal 'byor tshim byas nas/ / lhag mas 'byung po tshim par bya/ /1bkra shis brjod cing smon lam gdab/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 2bsngo ba dang / /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa yis/ /rdul tshon chu bo chen por dor/ /dri bzangs kyis ni thig phyis te/ /lhag chad bskang phyir sbyin sreg bya4/ /cho ga bzang po yongs bzung 'di/ /rtsa rgyud le'u 'bum pa dang / /bshad rgyud 'od zer dra ba la/ /brten nas grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad/ /de yi dge ba gang yod pa/ /rigs drug sems can ma lus pa/ /tshe dpag med pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /de yi 5'bras bu myur thob shog/ //bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzang po yongs bzung zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba bzang po dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba glan dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur zhing zhus te dag par byas so// //25—647

༄/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/hūṃ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ a pa ri mi ta ā —yurmyo na sā dha na nā ri byem/bod skad du/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs drug sems can thams cad kyi/ /tshe nyams pa la gso ba'i phyir/ /bcom ldan ye shes tshe dpag med/ /sgrub thabs yang dag bshad par bya/ /dad brtson dbang thob dam tshig ldan/ /tshe nyams pa rnams gso 'dod pas/ /dbe+en zhing nyams dga'i gnas 'dug nas/ /bsod nams tshogs kyi sngon 'gro ni/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /nam mkhar spyan drangs phyag 'tshal nas/ /mchod cing sdig pa bshags pa dang / /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom ④par bya/ /rang gi snying gar dhīḥdamar lasasnye/ /ye shes me 'bar rnam smin bsregasagye/ /sngags kyi don la stong nyid bsgom/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shudheḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā dzawa 25—654

shurnyo3stihaṃ—/ stong pa'i ngang las sems nyid ni/ /s+thāḥdamar tsheg drag thig le las—/ /dbang chen zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /spyan gsum khro gnyer ljags 'dril ba/ /steng zhal rta mgo ljang gu la/ /drag pos rta skad rab tu mtsher/ /dbyug pa'i sdigs 0mdzub me ltar 'bar/ /thugs kar pad+ma rgyas pa yis / /steng du zla ba nyi ma la/ /jiḥlas 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /e las chos 'byung yangs pa ru/ /yo las rlung dang re las me/ /baṃ las chu dang lo las sa/ /sum̐ las ri rab lhun po dang / / de steng hūṃ pyalas gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs brgyan/ /'dod yon pha gu dra phyed mdzes/ /khor yug chu skyes sna tshogs dang / /rdo rje me ri thogs pa med/ /pho brang chu skyes 'phang rim gnyis—/ /'dab ma bzhi dang brgyad pa la/ /mu khyud pad mas mdzes pa dang / /lha snam pan reg lnga dang ldan/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba las a las chu shel dkyil 'khor dang / /re las rta bdun dag tu gyur/ /steng du pad+ma byāḥyis mtshan/ /de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ /tshur 'dus dīḥl thim pa yi / /li khri lta bu'i thig le las/ /bcom ldan tshe dpag med pa ni/ /'gying bcas 'od 'khrug skyil krung bzhugs/ /phyag gnyis pad+ma rā ga yi/ /bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsis gang / /'gro rnams re skong dpag bsam shing / /bum pa'i kha rgyan thugs kar 'dzin/ /yum la 'khyud cing gnyis su med/ /baṃ las yum mchog gos dkar mo/ /li khri lta bur 'dzum zhing sgeg /g.yas pa pad+ma g.yon pa ni/ /bum pa yongs su 'dzin pa la/ /yab la gnyis med legs par 'khril/ /dar dang nor bu du mas brgyan/ /chu skyes brgyad dang lha snam ⑤ la/ /pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i gdan/ /mtshams bzhi'i sgo bzhi zla ba'i gdan//25—655

shar du rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshanasna/ /de las mi bskyod tshe dpag med/ /lho ru rin chen tī gis mtshan/ /rin chen rigs kyi tshe dpag med/ /nub tu 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan/ /rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med/ /byang du ral gri a yis mtshan/ /don yod grub pa tshe dpag med/ /shar lhor oṃ las mā ma tī/ /lho nub tī rtelas lha mo sgrol/ /nub byang lo las sangs rgyas spyan/ /byang shar tī las dam tshig sgol/ /rigs bzhi mnyam gzhag phyag rgya las/ /shel dang be+e ḍūr+ya gser dang ni/ /in+d+ra dī la'i bum pa 'dzin/ /yum lnga g.yas pa rang rtags dang / /g.yon pa bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje sems dpa' bzhi//lho ru rin chen sems dpa' bzhi/ /nub tu rnam snang sems dpa' bzhi/ /byang du las kyi sems dpa' bzhi/ /g.yas pa rang rtags 'dzin pa la/ /g.yon pas tshe yi bum pa 'dzin/ /thams cad dar dang nor bus brgyan/ /rdo rje skyil 5krung bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams bzhi la ni mchod pa yi/ /bdug spos mar me me tog ma/ /dri chab ma dang lha mo bzhi/ /sna tshogs 'od kyis bskor ba'o / /shar sgor dzaḥlas lcags kyu dkar/ /lho sgor hūṃ las zhags pa ser/ /nub sgor baṃ las lcags sgog khudamar/ /byang sgor hoḥ— las dril bu ljang / /sgo ba bzhi po de dag ni/ /'khril sdem bzhengs nas bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes pa/ /tshig 'dis spyan ni drang bar bya/ /gdod nas rang bzhin nam mkha' ltar/ /thugs rje 'ja' tshon skur ston pa'i/ /bcom ldan gsung mchog tshe dpag med/ /rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas nas/ /ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dam pa 'dir/ /'gro ba'i don phyir spyan 'dren na/ /tshe zad tshe nyams gso ba'i phyir/ /'di 25—656

nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje rin chen rnam snang dang / /las kyi rigs mchog tshe dpag med/ /yum bzhi mchod pa'i lha mo dang / /sems dpa' bcu drug sgo mar bcas/ /rang bzhin bde chen dkyil 'khor nasashe / /ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dam pa 'dir/ /tshe dang ye shes rgyas pa dang / /thugs mchog ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /'di nyid du ni spyan 'dren na/kye/ /byin kyis rlob cing gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bya/ /sku gsung thugs ni byin gyis brlab/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur nas/ /rigs bdag rnams kyis dbu brgyan te/ /mnyes par gyur la mchod pa dang / /bstod pa rgyas dang bsdus pa bya/ /de nas bying rgod rab spangs nas/ /ma yengs lha rnams gsal stong bsgom③/ /de rjes bzlas pa bya ba ni/ /lha rnams thugs ka'i bum pa ru/ /dīḥhūṃ ṭ+wā rgyu ④a las ni/ /rang rang sngags kyis bskor bar bsgom/ /oṃ dīḥrgyu ⑤badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ rgyu phyobadz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ swā hūṃ spubadz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ oṃ hūṃ byebadz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ t+parja 1badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ de rnams yab kyi snying po'i sngags so/ /yum gyi bum par paṃ oṃ tram̐ lo tai rnams las zhesngags kyis bskor/oṃ rgyu ⑪ a pa ri mi ta ā yudz+nyā na su bi ni— ta te dzo rā 8dzā ya/ yum mchog lnga yi snying po'o/ /phyogs bzhi sems dpa' bcu drug la/ /rang gi sa bon rnams la ni / /gtso bo'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsamasathu/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.a pa ri mi ta ā yurnye na su bi ni swā hā/ sgo ma bzhi'i snying po'i sngags so/ /de ltar bum pa'i sngags rnams la/ /dmigs te gsang sngags bzlas pa yis/ /yig 'bru rnams la bdud rtsi'i chu/ /babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam/ /bum nang ye 25—657

shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rang gi gnas gsum thim pa yis/ /lus ngag yid gsum nad gdon dang / /sdig sgrib dag nas dbang bzhi thob/ /'chi med dngos grub thob par bsam/ /de nas rang gis sngags bzlas pas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi/ /rang rang gsang sngags bzlas par bsgom/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer las/ /lha mo dkar mo lcags kyu thogs/ /bsam gyis mi khyab shar du 'phros/ /nad gdon zhi ba'i las byas te/ /dri za'i lag nas tshe bkug nas/ /bdag bskyod lha dang bum par bstem/ /de bzhin lho yi zhags pa mos/ /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas byas nas/ /gshin rje'i lag nas tshe bkug ste/ /gong bzhin du ni bstem par bya/ /nub kyi lcags sgrog dmar mo yis / /srid gsum ma lus dbang bsdus te/ /chu lha'i lag nas tshe bkug nasahūṃ / /bstem zhing klu gdon dag par bsam/ /byang gi dril bu dgyes mdzes bye mas/ /nad gdon log 'dren tshar bcad byenas/ /gnod sbyin lag nas tshe bkug nas/ /gong bzhin dmigs pa gsal bas bstem/ /bum pa dag la brten nas ni/ /'chi med tshe sgrub bshad pa ni/ /rnam rgyal las bum gnyis po la/ /rdzas dang kha rgyan mgul 'chings pyabacas/ /phyag mtshan bris la gdags par bya/ /maṇ+ḍal steng du legs par gzhagakyi /phyi ni bum pa'i rnam pa la/ /nang du gzhal yas khang du bsgom/ /gsang sngags rgyal po'i bzlas pa bya/ /gong bzhin bdud rtsis bum pa gang / /de yis rang gzhan thams cad kyi9/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus dag /'chi med dngos grub thob par bsam/ /las bum rta mgrin gong bzhin bskyed/ /thugs ka'i sa bon sngags kyis bskor/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ de 25—658

yis rang gzhan bar chad bsrung / /'chi me+ed bdud rtsi'i khrus bya'o/ /de ltar rang don gzhan don la/ /ma yengs bskyed rim gsal ba yis/ /ting 'dzin gcig tu sngags bzlas na/ /rtags rdzogs zla drug zhal mthong 'gyur/ /de nas rgyun du nyams su len/ /khwa ①ta'i skad kyis ma non par/ /bdag nyid gzhan dang ngag ma 'dres/ /mdun du chu skyes stong dang ldan/ /gtso bo yab yum gsal bar bsgom/ /oṃ ā yu ṣe sa ra ha ka ra ri sha ra snari hūṃ/ gsol ba btab la mchod bstod bya/ /bum pa dag la dmigs nas ni/ /sgrub byed sngags kyi rgyal po 'di/ /oṃ a ma ra ṇi dz+re wadhī 4 ye swā hā/ gsang sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ /de yis bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung nas/ /rang gi spyi gtsug thim pa yis/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag /bdud rtsis rang lus gang ba yin④/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ /tshe dpag med par gyur par bsam—/ /brtan pa'i yan lag lnga bzlas so/ /mdun bskyed byebadag la bstem pa dang / /de yi tshe tshad nyi zlar 'gyur/ /tshe nyams la sogs smos ci dgos / /gsang nas sgrub pa rab tu bsngags/ /de nas gsang sgrub bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gong dang 'dra ba la/ /lha tshogs thams cad li khri ltar//sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /bum pa thod par bcas pa 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs pa'o/ /bcu drug lon pa sku sha rgyas/ /'jam zhing nu ma 'bur ba la/ /pad+ma rdo rje rin chen dang / /'khor lo sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /g.yas pa rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon pa thod pa bdud rtsis gang / /yab la stobs shing treganyis su 'khril/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med/ /yab yum 'od zer tshogs 'khrugs shing 3/ /stoms 'jug zag med bde ba rgyas//25—659

mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhi/ /phyogs kyi lha yi snam bu la/ /shar du rdo rje khro bo dang / /lho ru rin chen khro bo dang / /nub tu pad+ma'i khro bo dang / /byang du phrin las khro bo dang / /steng 'og rnam snang khro bo gnyis/ /phyogs bzhir khro bo gnyis gnyis ni/ /rigs kyi yum dang bcas pa la/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhengs pa'o/ /thams cad g.yas pa rang rtags 'dzin/ /g.yon pa tshe yi bum pa dang / /sbrul dang rin chen sna tshogs brgyan/ /me ri 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /lha mo bzhi dang sgo ba bzhi/ /bzhengs pa khro bo'i tshul du gnas/ /'bru gsum sngags kyis ①byin gyis brlabs/ /ye shes spyan drang 4 gnyis med bstem/ /dbang bskur rigs kyis dbu brgyan pa/ /gtso bo lnga dang khro bo bcu'i/ /bum pa dag la dmigs nas ni/ /gsang sngags 'di ni bzlas par bya/ /oṃ s+thāḥhūṃ/ swā rgyu pha⑨dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.a pa ri mi ta ā yudz+nyā na ma hā sernyi ha sa ni ri ti swā hā/ de nas rang nyid bzlas pa bya/ /bum pa legs par bcas pa la/ /lha rnams gong bzhin bskyed pa dang / /rang dang lha rnams sngags bzlas pas/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum pa gang / /rjes su lha rnams zhu ba'i chus/ /rang gzhan ④ thams cad khrus bya'o/ /de yis mchog dang thun mong gi/ /dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi gtor ma 'di/ /snying po sngags kyis 'bul bar bya/ /las bzhi'i sbyin sreg spyibya ba dang / /longs spyod spel la bu thod pa mchod/ /de nas de kho na nyid sgrub/ /rang nyid mgon por gsal ba yi/ /gsang gnas chos 'byung gru gsum du/ /dhīḥdang paṃ las me 'bar bas/ /lus kyi nad rnams thams cad khengs/ /spyi bo'i haṃ brgyad zhu ba las/ /bde chen bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 25—660

'bab—/ /rtsa gsum gang bas bde ba rgyas/ /drod dang bde ba'i khyad par rnams—/ /steng 'og rlung gis mnan zhes bya/ /rta bdun ri bo rgyas 'dra nas/ /mthar thug lhun grub rnam gsum thob/ /bcu gsum sa rnams sdogs par 'gyur//tshe dpag med pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rtsa rgyud le'u 'bum pa dang / /bshad rgyud 'od zer dra ba la⑫/ /brten nas grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad/ /'chi med tshe sgrub 'di brtsams pas/ /bdag dang rigs drug sems can rnams/ /'chi med dngos grub thob gyur nas/ /tshe dpag med pa thob par shog/ //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba bzang po dang / bod kyi lo tsā snab glan dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bskur mchan/654 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〉 dpag med kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〉 dpag bzhugs so// rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tā/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ginā/rjo〈〈pe 〉ra sgoms/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stegs/ rngo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byurnyo sarba dharma swa bha/655 ①〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipho/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lkeg 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yo / thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadang du rgyu/⑤/〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rams/656 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thargyan/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉tram̐/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tram̐/ bye sna〈〈pe 〉〉tai/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rta/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar/me〈〈snar 〉ra kyil/ 'u〈〈snar 〉〉sgogs/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sprodaḥ/657 gyo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉na/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sgro / ༷〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉spom/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tram̐ bye/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbye/ ⑪ mespu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mdo/ tsu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sras hūṃ/ cha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/ ⑩ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma / che〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasam/658 ① 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ste/ zu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉glodzad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngacad/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zadangs/ rgya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazhag byu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉s+dzas/25—661

༄/ /tshe dpag tu med pa'i sprun sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ ste༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ a pa ri mi ta ā 1yu ho ma bi bye nā ma— wī/bod skad du/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i sbyin sreg gi thucho ga zhes bya ba/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin/ /sbyin sreg gis snyeni las rnams 'grub/ /las kyi mchog rab sbyin sreg go/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /dbang dang drag po mngon spyod do/ /zhi ba thab khung zlum po nyid/ /rgyas pa gru bzhi zla gam dbang / /mngon spyod zur gsum nyid du bya/ /khru gang khru do khru gang ba/ /sor mo nyi shu kha dog nag /dkar ser dmar ba nyid du bya/ /mchod rdzas yam shing drur 6ba sogs/ /sreg rdzas g.yas g.yon rim hūṃpa bzhin/ /shar du zhi ba byang du rgyas/ /dbang la nub dang drag po lho/ /re las me lha kha dog dmar/ /dbyu ༄ —/gu ril ba spyi blugs dang / /bgrang phreng 9g.yon dang g.yas su bsam/ /ral pa cod pan gsus 25byed663

khyim che/ /tshangs skud 'chang la ye shes bsnyim/ /rigs bdag rnams kyis dbu brgyan nas/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil la sogs dbul/ /dgang blugs dbul la mtshan ma brtags/ /kha dog sgra dang dbyebs dang dri/ /zla ba rgyas pa du ba med/ /nad med sdig pa ma lus zad/ /dung dang rdza rnga pi wang dang / /bde ba ma lus 'phel bar byed/ /tsan+dan ga pur a ga ru/ /dge zhing tshe ring dpal gyi gnas/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad rgyal mtshan gdugs/ /sgrub pa po rnams dge ba'i rtags/ /ngan pa de las bzlog pa'o/ /rta mgrin rgyal pos bsrung ba bya/ /de nas sreg rdzas rim gyis kyedabul/ /mar dang yam shing til dang zho/ /'bras so nas dang sran ma dang / /gro dang drur ba da ku sha rnamasang / /oṃ asna rnguye swā hā/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣu ya kyeswā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de 3swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā be+e ga ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe ye swā hā/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta bye badz+ra ye swā hā / me lha bstod cing gsol ba gdab/ /de nas me lha'i thugs ka ru/ /dkyil 'khor bskyed cing ye shes bstem/ /mchod yon zhabs bsel la sogs dbul / /khu ba la sogs zhal du mchod/ /yam shing ku sha 'od la dbularngo// /zho zan 'thor 'thung phyag tu dbul/ /khyad par drur 8/ba brgya rtsa ni/ /tshe 'phel ched du dbul bar bya/ /ā yu puṣ+ṭi ku ru oṃ/ /'o ma sbrang rtsi ka ra dang //bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i rdzas/ /slob dpon g.yon gyi mthe'u chung gis/ /slob ma'i g.yas kyi mthe'u chung gzung ⑫/ /lan gsum bskor bas lha la dbul/ /dngos grub rdzas kyi lhag ma de/ /slob ma rnams la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yu 25—664

ṣe a mṛ ta sidhi hūṃ/ zhi ba swā hā dang sbyar ba/ /rgyas pa oṃ la dbang la ho/ /drag po ma rā ⑨ya phaṭa sbyar/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod cing bstod/ /ye shes gshegs su gsol ba dang / /dam tshig bdag la bsdu 3/bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor lha ni mchod ster ro/ /me yis 'dod pa'i don grub byed/ /yam shing gzi brjid ster bar byed/ /mar gyis 'byor pa 'phel ba yin/ /til gyis snyesdig pa 'dag pa dang / /zho zan gyis ni rig pa 'phel/ /nas kyis brtson 'grus 'phel bar 'gyur/ /'bras kyis nus pa 'phel byed pa/ /so bas 'bru 'phel las yin no/ /gro dang sran mas nad kun sel/ /drur bas tshe ring nad med do/ /ku shas bar chad srung bar byed/ /'o ma sbrang rtsis dngos grub ster / /dpal 'phel ba ni bud shing ngo / /sbyin bdag bkra shis thabs yin no—/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa mchod pa'i rdzas/ /thabs dang shes rab gzar bu ste/ /bdud rtsi mar gyis tshim byed pa/ /mchod pa gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ /thog mar dbe+en pa'i gnas nyid du/ /thabs byedang mchod rdzas bshams pa ni/ /zhi ba tsan+dan dkar po'o/ /rgyas pa 'bras bu can gyi shing / /dbang la tsan+dan dmar po dang / /drag po tsher ma can la bya/ /rgya phyed dpangs khudang ldan pa dang / /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /slob dpon bdag nyid 'dug pa dang / /g.yas g.yon pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /g.yas su sreg 7rdzas rim gyes gzhag3 /g.yon du bum pa mchod rdzas bsham/ / lha yi (snarnal 'byor bskyed pa dang / /sngags kyi skyebazlas pas rab tu tshim/ /bum par rta mchog bskyed par bya/ /sngags bzlas bar chad bsrung bar bya/ /de bas bram ze rgyun bzhag 1 me / /bslangs rmyel sbar bar bya ba dang / /dang po 'jig rten me lha mchod/ /25—665

gnyis pa dkyil 'khor dgyes par tshimasna/ /gsum pa me lha gtang rag dbul/ /de nas ye shes gshegs dang dam tshig bsdu/ /me mnal thal ba chu bor dor/ /sbyin sreg las kyi 'bras 'byen 'di/ /mkha' 'gro grub pa'i rgyal mos brtsams /dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun/ /tshe dpag med pa red 4'gyur shog/ //rgya gar gyi mkhan po wa la tsan+d+ra 5bla ma dang / lo tsā ba glan dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba'o// //babyir mchan/663 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉 dpag tu ched nga/'i sbyin sreb gi cho ga bzhugs so// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tā/ —〈〈snar 〉〉 ཿ/ je〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉gi / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dur/ 7〈〈snar 〉'ams/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanabyug 9—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaphreng /664 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thugs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sreg rdzas rims kyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉durba/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉byedang / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mos ka ṣ+pe/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉bha te bhaṇ+ḍa ye/ 〈〈snar 〉zas te bhak+ṣa ye/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dz+ra pa te/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'bul/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dur/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thazung /665 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉 ra/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdu/ 〈〈snar 〉〉na/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dur/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉thab/6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pangs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sreg 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga zhag 9〈〈snar 〉〉de'i/ 〈〈pe 〉s+dzas// rka〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉monag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra be+e nga /666 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyas pa tshim pa dang / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnal/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasreg 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnyed/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phroṇ+ḍa/25byed666

༄/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs/zhu ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ a pa ri mi ta yā 1yudz+nyā na sā dha na nā ma/bod skad du/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad brtson 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod pa/ /bsod nams tshogs ni sngon song bas/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i juḥdamar las/ /ye shes me 'bar rnam smin bsregs/ /de rjes rang sems thig le dang / /s+thāḥdamar tsheg drag gyur pa las/ /rta mchog spyan gsum zhal bgrad pa/ /dbyug pa sdigs mdzub 'bar 'jigs bsgom/ /de yi thugs kar pad zla'i steng / /juḥlas bcom ldan tshe dpag med/ /mdog dmar rgyan mdzes bum pa bsnams/ /thugs kar pad zla'i steng du s+thāḥ/ /de las hūṃ kyechad 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad yongs su gyur pa las4/ /gzhal yas gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /'dab brgyad 25—668

khyams dang pad ra dang / /'dod yon pha gu dra phyed dang / /rta babs mchod rten yongs mdzes pa/ /rdo rje me ri dmar smug 'khrug /dngas shing thogs pa med pa yi/ /'od zer tshogs 'khrug bsgom par bya/ /de yang dīḥtso/ las pho brang gi/ /dbus su saṃ cig chad pa las/ /mi 'jigs brgyad du gyur par bsgom—/ /de steng paṃ a ram̐ chad pas/ /pad zla rta bdun dag tu 'gyur/ /de yi steng du dīḥlas no/ /'od 'phros don byas tshur 'dus pas/ /pad+ma dmar po 'dab lngar gyur/ /de las bcom ldan tshe dpag med/ /mdog dmar gzhon sgeg rgyan gyis mdzes/ /'gro rnams re skong dpag bsam shing / /bum pa'i kha rgyan ②thugs kar 'dzin/ /'gying bcas 'od 'khrug skyil krung bzhugs—/ /de yi g.yon du paṃ dang a/ /gyur pas zla ba'i gdan stengs su//a las yum mchog gos dkar mo/ /mtshal mdog 'gyeng bcas 'dzum zhing sgeg /thugs kar pad+ma rā ga yi/ /bum pa yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /shar du pad zla nyi ma yi/ /steng du hūṃ las rdo rjer gyur/ /de las mi bskyod tshe dpag mredaske/ /bai ḍūr sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba/ /skyil krung dang bcas bum pa 'dzin—/ /de yi g.yon du pad zla'i steng / /sa las yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan—/ /mdog dkar phyag gnyis bum pa bsnams/ /gzhon sgeg skyil krung bzhugs pa'o/ /lho ru pad+ma nyi zla'i stengasarngu/ /swa las rin 'byung tshe dpag med—/ /btso ④ma gser mdog skyil krung bzhugs/ /bum 'dzin rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /g.yon du pad zla ṭ+wā /sninyid las/ /byung 6 ba'i yum mchog mā ma khri/ /nam mkha'i mdog can 'dzum sgeg mdzes/ /bum pa bsnams shing skyil krung bzhugs/ /nub tu pad zla nyi ma yi/ /steng du rgyu 7las 'khor lor 25—669

gyur / /de las snang mdzad tshe dpag med/ /dkar zhing skyil krung bzhugs pa'o / /g.yon du pad zla oṃ las ni/ /dbyengs phyug ma ni dung gi mdog /'gying bcas rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung ngo / /byang du 1snapad zla ram̐ nyi yi/ /steng du a las rgya gram pa/ /de las don grub tshe dpag med/ /mdog ljang bum pa 3skyil krung mdzes/ /g.yon du pad+ma zla ba'i steng / /hūṃ las dam tshig sgon ma ni/ /sngo ljang sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /thugs kar bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /shar khyams zla ba'i gdan stengs su/ /hūm̐ bzhi rdo rje bzhir gyur pas/ /rdo rje rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhi/ /g.yas pa rang rtags rdo rje 'dzin/ /g.yon pa tshe yi bum pa 'dzin/ /rgyan mdzes rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /lho phyogs pad+ma zla ba'i steng / /swā pelas rin chen 'bar ba bzhi5/ /rin chen rigs kyi sems dpar gyur/ /g.yas pa rin chen g.yon pa ni / /tshe yi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin/ /btso ma gser 'dra skyil krung bzhugs/ /nub tu pad zla s+thāḥbazhi las/ /pad+ma 'dab lngar gyur pa las/ /pad+ma'i sems dpa' bzhi ru gyur/ /phyag g.yas rang rtags pad+ma bsnams/ /g.yon pa bum 'dzin rgyan spras shing / /rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /byang du gdan stengs a bzhi las/ /rdo rje rgya gram las byung ba'i/ /las kyi sems dpa' bzhi ru gyur/ /sngo ljang rgya gram bum pa bsnams/ /gzhon sgeg mdzes shing skyil krung bzhugs/ /'od zer tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /shar sgor dz+wa dzaḥdang lcags kyu las/ /lcags kyu ma ni mu tig mdog /lho sgor hūṃ las zhags pa ser/ /nub tu baṃ las lcags sgog du /༄dmar/ /byang du hoḥlas dril bu ljang / /lha mo de dag thams cad kyang / /'khril sdem gzhon sgeg rgyan 25—670

spras mdzes/ /zhal ni phyir gzigs bzhengs pa'o/ /sgo bzhir rgyal chen bzhi yang bsam/ /yang na phyi rol dag tu'o/ /gru chad bzhi la mchod pa yi/ /lha mo spyi dang mthun par bsam/ /de nas thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes pa/ /'di brjod spyan ni drang bar bya/ /gdod nas rang bzhin mkha' ltar dag /thugs rjes 'ja' tshon skur ston pa'i/ /bcom ldan gsung mchog tshe dpag med/ /rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas nas//ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dam pa 'dir/ /'gro ba'i don phyir spyan 'dren na/ /tshe zad tshe nyams bsal mdzad phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /las kyi rigs mchog tshe dpag med/ /rigs kyi yum mchog lnga dang ni/ /mchod pa'i lha mo rnam bzhi dang / /sems dpa' bcu drug sgo mar bcas/ /rang bzhin bde chen dkyil 'khor nas/ /ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dam pa 'dir/ /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa dang / /thugs mchog ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du spyan 'dren gyi/ /byen gyis brlab )phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bcing //mnyes par gyur la mchod pa dang / /bstod pa rgyas dang bsnyus pa bya/ /sgu gsung thugs ni byin gyis brlab/ /de nas bying rgod rab spangs nas/ /ma yengs lha rnams gsal bar bsgom/ /de rjes bzlas pa bya ba ni/ /lha rnams thugs ka'i bum pa'i nang / /trīḥdh+ri swā rja āḥl 2ni/ /rang rang sngags kyis bskor bar bsgom/ /oṃ dhīḥhūṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ rgyu 4badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ swā rja 5badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ rja 6badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ 7badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā/ de rnams yab kyi 8snying po'o//25—671

yum gye bum par a pa ri mi ta bsams la sngags 'dis bskor/ oṃ hūṃ rmye.a pa ri mi ta ā yudz+nyā kyen su bi nish+yi ta gyete dzo rā dzā ya swā hā/ yum mchog lnga yi snying por brjod/ /phyogs bzhi'i sems dpa' bcu drug po/ /gtso bo'i sngags rnams bskor bar bsamasagye/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.a hūṃpa ri mi ta ā yudz+nyā na pya su bi niḥswā hā/ sgo ma bzhi yi snying po'o/ /de ltar bum pa'i sngags rnams la/ /dmigs nas bzlas pa byas pa yis/ /yig 'bru rnams las spabadud rtsi'i rgyun/ /byung bas bum pa khengs par bsam/ /bum nang ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rang gi gnas gsum thim pa yis/ /lus ngag yid gsum dund gdon dang / /sdig sgrib dag nas dbang bzhi thob/ /'chi med dngos grub thob par bsam/ /de nas rang gi sngags bzlas pas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyang / /rang rang gsang sngags zlos khyapar bsam/ /rang snying sa bon shar sgo nas/ /lha mo dkar mo lcags kyu thogs/ /dpag med shar du spros pa yis/ /nad gdon zhi ba'i las byas nas/ /dri za'i lag nas tshe bkug la/ /rang dang bum par bstem par bya/ /de bzhin lho yi zhags pa bsam⑩/ /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas byas nas/ /gshin rje'i lag nas tshe bkug ste/ /gong bzhin du ni bstem par bya'o/ /nub kyi lcags sgrog skyedamar mo yis/ /srid gsum ma lus dbang bsdus te/ /chu lha'i lag nas tshe bkug la/ /bstem zhing klu gdon dag par bsam/ /byang gi dril bu dgyes mdzad mas/ /nad gdon log 'dren tshar bcad nas/ /gnod sbyin lag nas tshe bkug la/ /gong bzhin dmigs pa gsal skyabs bstem/ /shar phyogs rnam rgyal bum pa ni/ /rdzas dang mgul chings kha rgyan bcas/ /phyag mtshan bris nas gzhug par bya/ /phyi ni bum pa'i 25—672

rnam pa la/ /nang ni gzhal yas khang du bsam/ /gong bzhin bdud rtsis bum pa dgang / /de yis rang gzhan 7snathams cad kyi/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib sangs dag nas/ /'chi med dngos grub thob par bsam/ /las bum rta mgrin bskyed pa yang / /bgegs kyi steng du gzhag cipar bya/ /de yis rang gzhan zubar chad bsrung / /bdud rtsi dkar dmar khrus bya'o/ /de ltar rang don gzhan don la/ /ma yengs bskyed rim gsal po yis/ /zla ba gcig tu sngags bzlas nas/ /rtags rdzogs zla drug zhal mthong 'gyur/ /de yang rgyun du nyams len na/ /khwa da'i skad kyis ma non par/ /mdun du gtso bo yab yum bsam/ /gsol ba btab la mchod bstod bya/ /bum pa dag la dmigs nas ni/ / oṃ ā yu dhe sa ra ha ka ra re sha ra re hūṃ/4 gsang sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ /de yis bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung nas/ /rang gi spyi gtsug thim pa yis / /nad gdon sdig sgrib sangs dag nas/ /bdud rtsis rang lus khengs pa yis/ /'chi med tshe yi 5dngos grub thob/ /tshe dpag med par gyur par bsam / /brtan pa'i yan lag sngags bzlas so/ / oṃ ā yu a ma ra ṇa dz+re brnyi ye swā hā/4 de yi tshe tshad nyi zlar 'gyur/ /tshe nyams la sogs smos ci dgos / /gsang hūṃnas sgrub pa rab tu bsngags/ /de nas gsang sgrub bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gong dang 'dra ba las/ /yab lnga sku mdog 'tsher zhing dmar / /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /bum pa thod par bcas pa 'dzin / /rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs pa'o/ /yum lnga sgu mdog 'dra ba dang / /gzhon sgeg rgyan mdzes sgu sha rgyas/ /'dzum zhing nu ma 'bur ba yis/ /g.yas pa pad+ma rdo rje dang / /rin chen 'khor lo rgya gram ste/ /g.yas pa rang rtags 25—673

phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon pa thod pa bdud rtsis bkang / /yab la stobs shing skyil krung 'khril/ /yab kyi 'od zer dmar ba'i mdangs/ /yab yum 'od zer tshogs 'khrug cing / /snyoms 'jug zag med bde bas ①rgyas/ /gnyis su med pa'i spyor mtshams nas/ /byang sems dkar dmar bdud rtsi'i ri rgyun / /rang gi gnas gsum phog pa yis/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib dag /thun mong ma yin dbang bzhi thob/ /rang lus zag med bde bas gyergyas/ /ye shes lus la mgon por bskyed/ /shar kyi khyams su rdo rje'i rigs/ /khro bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /mdog dmar phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams/ /g.yon pa rā ga'i bum pa 'dzin/ /sbrul dang rin chen sna tshogs brgyan/ /me ri 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhengs pa'o/ /yum yang mdog dmar rdo rje dang / /bum pa 'dzin cing yab la 'khril/ /khro zhing cung zad sgeg par bsam/ /lho phyogs su ni rin chen rigs/ /yab yum g.yas pa rin po che/ /g.yon pa tshe yi bum pa'o/ /nub phyogs budhe'i khro bo ni//yab yum g.yas pa 'khor lo ste/ /g.yon pa tshe yi bum pa'o/ /byang phyogs phrin ④las khro bo ni/ /yab yum g.yas pa rgya gram bsnams/ /g.yon pa tshe bum ⑤'dzin pa'o/ /dbus kyi steng dang 'og tu ni/ /khro bo yab yum phyag g.yas nakhu/ /pad+ma 'dab lnga bsnams pa ste/ /g.yon pa tshe yi bum pa'o/ /phyogs bzhir khro bo gnyis gnyis bsgom/ /rgyan dang cha lugs sku mdog )rnams/ /shar phyogs bzhin du bsam par bya/ /sgo ma bzhi ni mdog dmar zhing / /zhal ni phyir gzigs khro mo'o/ /gtso bo lnga dang khrus chu yi/ /bum pa bdag la dmigs byas nas/ /gsang ba'i sngags ni bzlas par bya/ /oṃ byāḥhūṃ swā āḥ25—674

hūṃ ①dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.a pa ri mi ta ā yudz+nyā na ma ha sedhi ha sa ni ri swā hā/ de skad ma yengs bzlas pa yis/ /bum pa'i chu rgyun spyi bor phog /sdig sgrib dag nas dbang bzhi thob/ /de nas rang nyid yab yum du/ /bsams la gsang ba'i sngags brjod do/ /shar dang byang shar mtshams su ni/ /bum pa lha rnams gong 5 bzhin bsam/ /rang dang lha rnams sngags bzlas pas/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum pa khengs/ /rjes su chags rnams zhu ba'i chus/ /rang gzhan thams cad khrus bya'o/ /de yis mchog dang thun mong gi / /dngos grub thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas kho na nyid 'di bsgrub/ /rang nyid mgon por gsal ba yi/ /gsang gnas chos 'byung gru gsum du/ /s+thāḥdang re las me 'bar bas/ /khog pa'i nang rnams thams cad khengs/ /spyi bo'i haṃ brgyad zhu ba las/ /bde chen bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab/ /rtsa rnams khengs pas bde ba rgyas—/ /drod dang bde ba'i khyad par kun/ /steng 'og rlung gi gnad shes bya//rta bdun ri bong rgyas brtan ④nas/ /mthar thug khrun grub rnam gsum thob/ /bcu gsum sa rnams rdzogs par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //25—675
