bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (982)

༄/ /gnod sbyin gyi sgo dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'gor lo chen po zhes bya ba/sna ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ nī dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa ka la baṃ ma hā tsakra sā dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen ngo/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'khor lo chen po zhes bya ba/dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba kha cig sa bon gnas dang rtso'/ rkyen gyis/ /gdug pas zin cing dug dang khrag ni 'dres gyur pa/ /thabs gzhan du ma gang gis 'byed par mi nus te/ /'dab bzangs rgyal pos chu dang 'o ma 'byed pa bzhin/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dbang bskur ji srid mnyes byas pas / /des ni 'byed cing gsal bar phod pa yin pa ste/ /brgyad khyer zhabs nub 'jig dus rnge dpung nang 'dug pa/ /gdug pa'i dgrar gyur ljags 'dril nadabugs tsha mi shigs 'dzin/ /byol song rgyan ldan mche ba gcigs shing nga ro 'jigs/ /de la lus ngag yid gsum dang bas gus btud de/ /ji 25—732

srid mnyes byas dam pa'i drin gyis man ngag ri/ /rang nyams myong bas dug zin sgrub po rjes su dran/ /de la rgyal po dang rkun bo dang stag la sogs pa ya nga ba thams cad dang bral ba'i ri'am/ yid du 'ong ba'i gnas 'du 'dzi med pa gang yang rung bar rnal 'byor pas khrus byas te/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ bsams te/ de'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i gaṅgā'i 37klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas rnams dang /bla ma dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bsgul te byon par bsams la mchod pa lngas sgo yang dag par mchod la ༄ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de'i rjes la byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang 4btang stoms zhes bya ba tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i blos phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad stong zhing bdag med par bsam mo oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa a ko3 bye haṃ zhes bya bas mi g.yo bar bya'o/ /de nas gur dang ra ba la sogs pa sa bon las 5bsams te/ sa bon gyi yi ge las byung ba yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud dang bcas pa sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa dur khrod chen po'i dbus su'o / /de'i lte ba la tshangs pa dang / brgya byen gyi thog na nyi ma dang zla ba/shar dri za/ lhor thugashin rje/ nub chu lha/ byang gnod sbyin de rnams kyi steng du nyi ma'o/ /yi ge hūṃ las byung ba'i nyi zla'i thog tu ni/ sprin sgra'i yi ge yongs su gyur pa las thod pa dang khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsam mo/ /de'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs te/bstems 5nas de yongs su gyur pa las sangs rgyas gos sngon po can zhal gsum 25—733

phyag drug pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ sku mdog mthing nag spyan gsum me'i phung po 'dra ba/ smin ma dang dpral bar khro gnyer du bsdus pa/ljags 'dril 1zhing mche ba gcigs pa/ nga ro'i sgra 'byung zhing dbugs me ltar 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du badze+es pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la sogs pa la sbrul mgo brgyad kyi gdengs ka yod pa/ de'i dkyil na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum pas bzhugs pa/ gdug pa can zhal mnan nas sdigs mdzub can no/ /zhal g.yas dung dang 'dra ba g.yon pad+ma rā ga 'dra ba dbus sku dang mthun pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar rgyas pa'o/ /gsus pa yangs shing gsus pa 'khyel ba ste/phyag g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub 'chang ba/bar pa gnyis yum la 'khyud pa/ tha ma gnyis sbrul rked pa nas gzung pyazhing za ba'o / /rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ dang ldan pa'i gos sngon po stag gi ris can mnabs pa'o/ /klu rigs bzhi rgyan du byas pa ni nor rgyas dang dung skyong gis dbu la brgyan pa/ dga' bo dang nye 5dga' 'bar bas snyan cha byas pa/ pad+ma dang chu lhas lag pa brgyan pa/ stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan khar za ba can gyi ska rags byas pa ste/ de ltar bdud la sogs pa brlag pa can du bdag nyid bsgom mo/ /lha mo mdzes ldan sgu mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa gri gug gtso bo la 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa thod pa —khrag gis gang 7ba gtso bo'i zhal du stobs 8pa'o/ /de'i sbyor ba'i mtshams nas shar phyogs kyi pad+ma'i steng du thig le kha sbyor 'phros pa las thod pa dang / rdo rjer gyur te rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo bdud las rgyal 25—734

byed sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje 'phyar ba/g.yon gyi dang po rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis sdigs 1mdzub brang du bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ gos sngon po stag gi ris can mnabs pa'o/ /thod pa de yongs su gyur pa las lha mo 'od zer can sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas pa sru gris gtso bo la 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa bhan 2dha khrag gis bkang ba gtso bo'i zhal du stobs pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi pad+ma'i steng du thig le kha sbyor 'phros pas thod pa dang rdo rjer gyur te/ rdo rje de choyongs su gyur pa las khro bo rdo rje rngugazi brjid 'bar ba sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang po rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon gong ma dbyug to 'dzin pa 'og ma gnyis sdigs mdzub bsnol ma yum la 'khyud pa/ gos sngon po stag gi ris can mnabs pa'o/ /thod pa de yongs su gyur pa las lha mo mdangs can ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas na zangs gri/ g.yon na thod pa khrag gis bkang nas zhal du stob cing gtso bo la 'khyud pa'o/ /nub phyogs kyi pad+ma'i steng du thig le kha sbyor 'phros pa las thod pa dang rdo rjer gyur te/ rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las khro bo rngam pa sgra sgrogs sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang po rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon dang po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/'og ma gnyis sdigs mdzub bsnol ma yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /thod pa de yongs su gyur pa las gye/ lha mo sgra can 3ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/g.yas pa na sta re na g.yon pa thod pa gtso bo la 'khyud pa'o/ /byang phyogs su pad+ma'i steng du thig le kha sbyor 'phros pa las rdo rje dang thod par gyur te/ rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig 25—735

phyag bzhi pa phyag g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon gong ma be+e con 'dzin pa / 'og ma gnyis sdigs mdzub bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ gos sngon po stag gi ris can mnabs pa'o/ /thod pa de yongs su gyur pa las lha mo rlung 'byen ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas na 'khor lo/g.yon na thod pa gtso bo la 'khyud pa'o/ /shar gyi sgor thig le 'phros pa las/lcags kyu de yongs su gyur pa las lha mo lcags kyu ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas 1na lcags kyu thogs pa'o/ /lho'i sgor zig le 'phros pa las zhags par gyur te/ de yongs su gyur pa las lha mo zhags pa ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /nub kyi sgor thig le 'phros pa las lcags sgog tu gyur te/ de yongs su gyur pa las lha mo lcags sgog ma sgu mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis 4na lcags sgrog bsnams pa'o / /byang gi sgor thig le 'phros pa las dril bur gyur te/ de yongs su gyur pa las lha mo dril bu ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag na dril bu bsnams pa zla ba'i steng na thabs shes rab kyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ci 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing / snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis yang dag par mchod pa la sogs pa byas te/de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i 1phyag rgya bzhis dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang bcing ba la sogs pas tha mi dad par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gis 4sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ oṃ dang āḥ25—736

dang hūṃ ste dkar po dang dmar po dang mthing ga'i rim pas spyi bo dang mgrin pa dang / snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par bsgom mo/ /de nas snying ga na gnas pa'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas gaṅgā'i 1klung gi sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs te/ de dag kun gyi phyag na bum pa rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pas snyems par 'jug pa'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la dbang bskur ro/ /de nas gtso bo nas byang sgo la thug par bsgom mo/ /skyo na thun mtshams bzhir rnal 'byor pas /bsnyen pa dbul bar bya'o/ /de ltar lha ni gsal ba dang / /sa bon rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /kha sbyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor bas ni/ /bde chen rab tu gso mdzad nas/ /sdug bsngal nyon mongs 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /thig le'i rang bzhin mi shigs kyis/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag 'joms par mdzad/ /ces bya bas bsgom pa bstan nas/gtor ma btang la yang dag par mchod nas skyo bar gyur na sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i 4 klung gis gsungs pa 'di bzlas pa bya ba ste/ tar+ya thā/ sgo sgo bān nā ga a dhi pa ta ye i rda m+bi khādza ra dha ra sha rī ram̐ badz+ra pā ṇi dṛ da ya na ya sa ma ti kra ma ti ud+mā dha sum̐ bha debi shurnyi hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kra ma ya phaṭa/ kṛ tād+dhā tshoya phaṭa/ kṛ tān+ta ྅rū pa ya phaṭa/ ro ṣa rja ya phaṭa/ oṃ bi dā ra khyo ya phaṭa/ kṛ radha shā dha nā ya phaṭa/ dī lo 9ba sa nā ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta bā la ya phaṭa/ ha ra ha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ tshin+da tshin+da/ha sa ha sa/ bhin+da bhen+da/ dh+wa ra ya dh+wa ra ya/ zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas spyod lam gyis rta gnas par bya'o/ / rigs pas sarang byung sgu nyid rang gsal rtogs/ /bla ma dang 'grogs dam pa'i drin kyis 25—737

thob / /rjes su gzung phyir rang nyams myong bas brtsams/ /zla ba ltar gsal dag cing dri med des/ /'gro kun rtog pa'i dri ma rab zhi nas/ /'bras bu phyag na rdo rje dang 'drar shog /slob dpon chen po dzā ba ri pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'khor lo chen po zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta de ba pūr+ṇa ma ti dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/732 )mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉ranod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'khor lo chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ pye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kā—/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngagril/733 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉sngagaṅgā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gi gā/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltas/ ke 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag/ ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gidang /pye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ripho/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sto/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thastem/734 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngagril/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mo sa/ 〈〈co 〉monal/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉byedabu/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snyer/ 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7thod pa/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thakang /snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stob/735 1 〈〈pe 〉medag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga na/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steb/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gide/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉girdo rje/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilas/ dza〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagacan/ ri — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skad ka736 kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gigayas/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da phyag bye 〈〈snar 〉〉bya ba'i/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉sngagaṅgā klung gi/〈〈snar 〉〉gi gā klung gi/737 1 〈〈pe 〉sngagaṅgā/ 〈〈snar 〉sngag gā/ na 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpar/ snye〈〈pe 〉sngagaṅgā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gi gā/ ye〈〈pe 〉〉dha dzā pa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dh+wa rmā pa/ kye ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shā ta/ 2〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ste / 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de waṃ/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉gil ya/ 〈〈snar 〉〉la/ /1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ kyo〈〈pe 〉〉reg pas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉reg pa//25—738

༄/ /gnod sbyin gyi sgo dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes bya ba/ 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhā waṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa ka waṃ nā ma dh+wa ra ṇi sā dha na na.a mṛ ta bin+d+ra/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo sems can rnams ni sa bon gnas dang rtsol rkyen gyis/ /gdug pas zin gyur dug dang khrag ni 'dres gyur pa/ /thabs gzhan du mas dbye zhing bsal bar mi nus te/ /'dab bzang rgyal pos chu dang 'o ma 'byed pa ltar/ /gdul bya gdul 4phyir dbang bskur ji srid mnyes gyur pas/ /des ni 'byed cing gsal bar phod pa yin pa ste/ /rgya mtshor zhabs nub 'jig dus me dpung nang 'dug pa/ /gdug pa'i dgrar gyur ljags 'dril dbugs tsha mi shigs 'dzin/ /de la btud de ji srid mnyes byas man ngag bri5/ /rang nyams myong bas dug zin sgrub pa 25—740

rjes dran gzung / /rgyal po dang / rkun po dang / stag la sogs pa'i 'jigs /1pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ri bo'am/ yid du 'ong ba 'du 'dzi med pa'i gnas su byams pa dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos khrus nye bar 2byas te/stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ bsams te/ de'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i gaṅgā'i —klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas rnams dang / bla ma dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bskul nas mchod pa rnam lngas yang dag par mchod de/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de'i rjes la byams pa dang / snying rje dang /dga' ba dang / btang snyoms zhes bya ba tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la 'dris par bya'o—/ /de nas gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i blos phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad stong zhing bdag med par bsam mo/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba yi kolhahaṃ phyezhes bya bas mi g.yo bar bya'o/ /de nas paṃ las pad+ma'i lte ba la/a las zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbang po 6gnyis kyi steng du bsams te/yi ge hūṃ ring po'i sgra dang bcas pa 'od 'phros pa las khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsams te/ de'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu gaṅgā'i 7klung gi bye ma snyed 'bum phrag gi sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs la/ de'i 'od zer de nyid du thim ste/de yongs su gyur pa las/ sangs rgyas gos sngon po can/ zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ g.yas bskum pa/ sku mdog mthing nag tu 'dug pa/ spyan gsum me'i phung po 'dra ba/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa ral pa'i cod pan la/ sbrul mgo brgyad kyi cod pan yod pa/smin ma dang dpral ba'i mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus pa/ ljags 'dril zhing mche 25—741

ba gatshigs pa/ kha rlangs skyatsha zhing nga ro'i sgra 'byung ba/ de'i dkyil na sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ gdug pa zhe la mnan nas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa can no/ /lto ba yangs shing gsus pa'i smad 'khyel pa/ zhal g.yas dung dang 'dra ba/ g.yon pad+ma rā ga 'dra ba dbus sgu dang mthun pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar rgyas pa'o/ /phyag dang po khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ bar ma gnyis thal mo brdebs pa'i sgra sgogs pa/ tha ma gnyis sbrul gdug pa'i rked 2 pa nas bzung zhing mgo nas za ba'o/ /rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ dang ldan pa'o/ /gos sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang / sham thabs stag gi ris can bsnams pa'o/ /lta ba phyin ci log thams cad kyi gzhung 'joms pa'i rtags su nyi ma dang zla ba'i steng na bzhugs pa/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyi steng na rigs bzhi'i klu yis rgyan du byas pa ni dga' bo dang nye dga' 'bar bas snyan cha byas pa/ lag pa dang dpung pa pad+ma dang chu lhas brgyan pa/ stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan khar za ba'i ska rags can nor rgyas dang dung skyong gis dbu la brgyan zhing rgyan du byas pa ni ser po dang dmar po dang dkar po dang nag po ste/rin po che spyi bo'i steng du 4na yod pa'o/ /de ltar bdud la sogs pa rlog byepar byed pa can du bdag nyid rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ snying ga las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis yang dag par mchod de/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbazhis dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / tha mi dad pa'i phyir dbang du bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i dzi25—742

klung gis sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis brlab 1pa'i phyir/ oṃ dang āḥdang hūṃ mthing ga dang / dmar po dang / dkar po'i rim pas spyi bo dang /snying ga dang / mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rnam par bsam mo de nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas lag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pas dbang bskur ro/ /de nas ji srid skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar du bsgom par bya'o/ /skyo bar gyur na sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i 2klung gis rjes su gnang ba'i gzungs kyi phreng ba kho na bzlas par bya ste/ nyung du 'dod pa rnams kyis ni/ /oṃ — dze+e ba du ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi j-i da ya ma hā kro dha sā dha hūṃ phaṭa ces snying po'i sngags yi ge nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o/ /ngag gi brjod pas kyang skyo bar gyur na/oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pas gtor ma nye bar phul te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i snying pos lhag pa dang ma tshang ba dag par bya'o/ /de nas ldang bar 'dod na ye shes sems dpa' phyung ste/ yang dag par mchod la oṃ kṛ 4to ba 5zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas de'i nga rgyal gyis ldang bar bya'o//bla ma mnyes byas dang ldan snying rjer bcas/ /brtson 'grus drag ldan dran ldan brtan blo can/ /skad cig tsam yang gnyid ni log pa min/ /de bzhin gnyid las rgyal byed shes rab kyis/ /tak+ṣa ka yis zin par gyur pa yang / /zla ba drug gis nges par bzung 'gyur zlogs6/ /bla ma la gus brtse bas bdud rtsi thigs pa lhung / /bdag gis blangs te mid pas lus rgyas te/ /lus rgyas stobs kyis sgrub po rjes gzung sgrub thabs dran/ /bsod nams gang yod sgrub po'i rtog pa'i nad med shog /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes bya ba/25—743

nam gru'i rigs las byung ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon dzā ba ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po'i mkhan po de ba pūr+ṇa shā/ma ti dang / bod kyi phyelo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //brdzur mchan/74༷ 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉ngonod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ bhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sto/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rin/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kudul/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sbes/741 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipa'i 'jigs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra nye bar/ — 〈〈pe 〉sngagaṅgā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gi gā/ 4〈〈snar〉〉rnams—/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉srasad+ma ko haṃ/ stso〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da dang / ④〈〈pe 〉sngagaṅgā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gi gā/742 ༄1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wāngs/ rta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rkang / snye/〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉glonabs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7du/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da rlag 6〈〈pe 〉sngagaṅgā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gi shā/743 rte 〈〈pe 〉〉dub/ na〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dza gā/ sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sto/ nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tri/ 3〈〈pe 〉ri /〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ dzi〈〈pe 〉〉zlog744 1 〈〈snar 〉sngagarna/ 2〈〈snar 〉dkyis/25—744
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (984)25wa 745

1058༄7/ /lag na rdo rje gos sngen po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/kye sna༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ be+e dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā be+e sā dha na no snapi ka tsan+dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can kyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar nyid don dam thugs chud 'gro ba'i don du rdo rje'i sku/ /gnas mdzad mthu stobs khyad 'phags gdug pa rnams kyi dgrar gyur pa/ /rgya mtshor zhabs gzhag 4'jig dus rnge dpung dang ldan snying rjes khros/ /rtog pa'i sdug bsngal thar mdzad khyod la dngos po kun gyis 'dud/ /rtsod pa'i dus gang phrad gyur brtson 'grus chung zhing blo zhen 5pas/ /shin tu bsdus la dga' zhing ma btsal 'bras bu 'dod la gzud phyir dran/ /de la snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byer pas khrus byas te/ yid du 'ong ba'i bsam gtan gyi khang par stan bde ba la 'dug nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu gaṅgā'i ceklung gi 25—746

sangs rgyas rnams dang de'i sras rnams mdun du spyan drangs te/ mchod pa'i yo byad lngas yang dag par mchod pa/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de'i rjes su oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa kopho 3haṃ zhes brjod pa dang bcas pas stong pa nyid du bsgom mo/ /de nas paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor hūṃ dang bcas pa bsams te/ de yang ring po'i sgra dang ldan zhing 'od zer 'phro ba can no/ /de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga dang ldan pa'i sa bon las 'od 'phros te/ phyogs bcu gaṅgā'i snye/klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas spyan drangs te/ de nyid la thim nas/ de yongs su gyur pa las sangs rgyas gos sngon po can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon brkyang ba g.yas bskum pa / sku mdog mthing nag spyan me'i phung po 'dra ba/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa / 'brug sgra can gyi dbugs tsha ba/ skra gyen du badze+es pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon na sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ gos sngon po can la ltos 'gro brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ bdud la sogs pa tshar gcod pa'i tshul can du bdag nyid bsam mo/ /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyis rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ snying po bzhis tha mi dad par bya/de nas byin gyis brlab cing dbang bskur ro/ /ji srid skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar du bsgom zhing / skyo ba'i tshe sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi rjes su gnang ba'i phreng 4ba'i sngags kho na bzlas par bya'o/ /bsdus pa dag la dga' bas ni/ oṃ bhā snyi ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi dṛ da ya ma hā kro dha sā dha hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'i sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o/ /oṃ m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi dha ra ma hā kro dha sā dha hūṃ/ nye ba'i snying po dang / yang snying ste bcu bdun pa'o/ / gtong bar 5'dod pa'i 25—747

—tshe gtor ma phul la/ ye shes sems dpa' phyung ste gshegs su gsol lo/ /spyod lam thams cad du yang rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gnas par bya'o/ /kha zas gos sogs zas skom dang / /dbul ba kun zad nad med dang / /'jigs chen brgyad dang sdug bsngal sogs/ /'jigs pa med cing gang bsam pa'i / /'dod pa'i don rnams thams cad ni/ /sgrub thabs 'di las 'byung 'gyur ro/ /'gro rnams 'dod pa tha dad pas/ /de la dgongs nas bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub lam ni sna tshogs gsungs/ /rang 'dod lam ni thob bya'i phyir/ /dad pas bla ma bzang btsal te/ /ji srid bla ma mnyes byas nas / /'dod don man ngag blang bar bya/ /mnyes pas yin gyi gzhan gyis min / /bdag gis sgrub thabs mdor bsdus smras/ /smras pas zla ba ltar gsal ba'i/ /dag cing nam mkhar mi shong ba'i/ /dge ba gang gis 3snathob pa gang / /'dir bzhugs 'dod lha'i zhal mthong shog /dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs mdor bsnyus pa zhes bya ba/ nam gru'i rigs las byung ba/ dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po dzā ba ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta de wa pūr+ṇa bye ma ti dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //25—748

bsdur mchan/ 746 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa bzhugs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉phyag na rdo rje tshabazhugs so// (〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mo/ tsho 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsi dhi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉smonan/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sngagaṅgā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gi gā/747 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wa3/ ②②〈〈pe 〉sngagaṅgā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gi gā/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toraphreng / tsho'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gtor bas/748 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)/ zhu〈〈snar 〉nyago/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zur+ṇa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (985)25wa 749

1059༄ / /klu rigs bzhi'i sgub thabs zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā ga ku la tsa twa 2ri sā dha dzā nā ma/ bod skad du/ klu rigs bzhi'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje byams pas 'gro ba rnams la ma bzhin brtse bar mdzad/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro rgyal 'bar ba'i skur ston pa/ /byol song rgyan ldan bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /bzod dka' gdug pa'i nad las thar 4mdzad de la dngos po kun gyis 'dud/ /byams pas zhe sdang zhi ba dang / /drag pos nye rings gsang ba'i phyir/ /de yi sgrub thabs gzung ba'i phyir/ /bla ma'i drin gyis thob nas brtsam/ /gang zhig bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yis/ /gang zhig dbang du bsdu 'dod na/ /klu yi sgrub dang 'khrul 'khor dang / /spyor ba brtsam par bya ba yin/ /dang po gnas chen yid 'ong du/ /bsnyen pa sngon du rdzogs byas te / /klu brgyad gzugs ni 'khar gzhong gzhag6 /rang nyid lha yi skur 25—750

bsgoms narmye/ /dus gsum klu la mchod pa bya/ /rtags dang rmi lam brtags nas ni/ /de las bzlog pa'i las brtsam ste ༄ / /mtshams bcad sa yi cho ga bya//stegs bu byi dor legs byas te/ /sta gon cho ga rgyas byas la/ /de nas rdzas rnams bsag par bya/ /'bras kyi rgyu las byas pa yi/ /klu chen brgyad ni sbrul mgo can/ /dngul gzhong nang du bsag skyapar bya/ /kha dog tshon gyis bsgyur jel gzhagabye /so so lto 'phye'i gyemago bo ni/ /dgu dang bdun dang lnga dang gsum/ /skyes pa bud med mdzes pa dang / /sbrul dang sbal pa spyong mo dang / /nya dang rus sbal rkang mangs dang / /sdig pa phag dang 3mdzo rtol dre / /gzhan yang gang byung gzugs bya'o/ /de nas thig dang tshon dgye zhing / /dbus kyi lte ba zlum po la/ /gtso bo dbus su bris nas ni/ /'dab ma brgyad la klu brgyad bri / /phyi rol gyi ni 'dab ma la/ /'khor du gtogs pa so sor bri/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su/ /skyes pa bud med la sogs bri/ /mtshams su spyong mo nya sogs dgod/ /steng du sdig pa phag sogs bri'o/ /steng du 'khar gzhong klu chen brgyad/ /bar khyams kyelha yi snam bu la/ /klu dang gnyan dang sa bdag gsum/ /rim gyis mnyam par dgod par bya/ /bla rgyan 'og rgyan 'byor tshad dgram/ /'bru lnga sman lnga'i gtor ma dang / /nā kheg ge sar kaṇ+ḍa ka ri dang / /nā skyeg put+pa rgya mtsho dbu skyeb dang / /chu srin sder mo dbang po lag pa dang / /bal po'i se'u smyag shad lcug ma dang / /nī /lot+pa la 'dam bu'i rtsa ba dang / /dar tshon sna lnga ras skud dmar po dang / /li khri dmar po dang ni ga bur shel/ /pu shel tse dang ljon shing 5'dam bu tshal/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bras chan khur ba'o/ /de nas/ 'dod yon lnga yi pa25—751

'khor lo ni3 / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi hūṃ kyelas ni/ /'dab bzhi 'dab brgyad bskyed par bya/ /phuḥgulas klu brgyad klu chen te/ /'khor yang de bzhin bskyed byas nas/ /gtso bo sgrub thabs las gsungs bzhin/ /spyan drangs bstem 4pa la sogs kyis5/ /klu la sogs pa de bzhin dgug /oṃ rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil nas/ /gtsug na rin chen klu yi rje/ /nor rgyas bu dang dung skyong dang / /dga' bo dang ni 'jog po dang / /pad+ma dang ni chu lha dang / /stobs kyi rgyu dang ma dros dang / /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /gnas 'dir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal rigs dang ni bram ze'i rigs / /rje rigs dang ni gdol pa'i rigs/ /gnas 'dir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /klu bran gnyan dang sa bdag tshogs 4/ /sprul pa 'bum sde 'khor dang bcas/ /gnas 'dir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /me tog la sogs mchod pa lnga/ /'dod pa'i lha la dbul bar bya/ /gtor ma rnams kyang so sor dbul/ /nā 3ga ge sar sman gyi mchog /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /ting 'dzin 'phro 'du'i brdas bkrol te/ /klu chen brgyad la mchod pa dbul / /sngon gyi dam tshig slar dul la/ /zhe rings dug las slar dul zhig / kaṇ+ḍa ka ri nā hūṃ ga put+pa dang / /rgya mtsho dbu meb chu srin sder mo dang / /dbang bo lag pa nā hūṃskyug ge sar dang / /bal po se'u spyag shad lcug ma dang / /nī la ut+pal ki'adam bu'i nags tshal dang / /dar tshon sna lnga'i ras sgud dmar po dang / /li khri dmar po ga bur shal dang ni/ /pu shel rtse dang dung g.yas 'khyel ba dang / /shu dag dkar po snying ni zho 6sha dang / /mkhal ma zho sha stag pa'i shun pa dang / /seng ldeng dkar dmar klu sman sna 25—752

—tshogs kyis/ /klu rnams kun la rab tu mchod par bya/ /mchod pa phul nas bzlas pa bya/ /oṃ nā ga 1ha ra ha ra nā ga phu/ pra ha ra pra ha ra nā ga phu/tshin+da tshin+da nā ga phu dṛ da ya ni phu/ bhen+da bhin+da nā ga dha ma ni phu/ bi si ma ta nā ga sha rī ra ṇi phu/ bi sgo ṭa ya nā ga na ya ni phu/ nā ga be+e dā ra ṇa ya phu/nā ga kro dha na ya phu swā hā/ oṃ a nan+ta ya hūṃ dzā hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ bā su ki hūṃ rmā hūṃ swā hā / oṃ tak+ṣa ka hūṃ dzā hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma hūṃ dzā hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma hūṃ dzā hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā la hūṃ dzā hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭa hūṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ a ṇa wa ta hūṃ dzā hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ nā ga ku la tsa twa 4ri shān+ti swā hā/ oṃ nā 5ga pra ti sgo ṭa ya swā hā/ oṃ nā ga pra pañtsa bu nye ba swā hā/ oṃ ta thā ga ta dṛ da ya hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ ta thā ga ta dṛ da ya tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa/ kun la brgya brgya bzlas par bya/ /gtsug na yid bzhin nor bu can/ /mig ni gdengs pa lto 'phye'i rigs/ /klu chen brgyad po mthong ba'i dug /bzod dka'i dug rnams phyir phyung shig /lus chen mgo bo tha dad pa'i/ /zhe sdang drag po rgyas pa yi/ /rigs bzhi klu rgyal yid kyi dug /bzod dka'i dug rnams phyir phyung shig /gsher la gnas pa mdzangs pa'i rigs/ /gtsang ma phal la gnod mi byed/ /klu bran 'bum sde reg pa'i dug /bzod dka'i dug rnams phyir phyung shig /zhe rings nag po byol song rigs/ /rmig bzhi lcags las na bun 'thibs/ /gnyen chen 'bum sde kha blangs dug /bzod dka'i dug rnams phyir phyung shig /dman pa'i cha 'dzin zhe sdang can/ /bden pa mi nyan kun la gnod/ /sa bdag 'bum sde mche ba'i dug /bzod dka'i dug rnams phyir phyung shig /dregs pa zhe sdang 'bar ba yi/ /glen pa nga rgyal mthu bo che/ /'gro ba 'di la 25—753

gang gnod pa/ /bzod dka'i dug rnams phyir phyung shig /sbyor gzhan rab tu khros pa'i pho nya ni/ /sprul pa 'bum sde 'gro ba'i gnod pa skyel/ /sman dang sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis/ /bzod dka'i ⑫dug rnams phyir phyung shig /de ltar bsnyen pa sngon song bas/ /mchog tu sgrub pos dug phyung nas/ /rmi ltas rim pa so sor gsal/ /thub rtags byung na rdzas rnams ni/ /rten yod gnas su sba bar bya'o/ /gal te mi thub rtags byung nas/ /cho 'phrul drag po ston byed na/ /'khrul 'khor las kyi sbyor ba brtsam/ /bsad ṭ+wāpa'i las kyi sbyor ba ni/ /'khor lo chen po la brten nas/ /klu grub dkyil 'khor shar phyogs su/ /thabs bzlog pa yi las bya ste/ /byang du gsad pa'i las bya'o/ /srog nan nan phaṭa phaṭa/ pra re pra re dz+wa la dz+wa la phaṭa phaṭa/ shad shad shig shig phaṭa phaṭa/ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa— )/ rigs bzhi klu la mnan pa bya/ /rā dza ku le'i jem pa'am/ /yang na sgrub khang them 'og tu/ /dbyar kyi khyim gsum tha ma la/ /drug gnyis bzhi yi nyin thuphyed na/ /shin tu dam par sba bar bya/ /rgya gram 'bar bas steng nas mnan/ /ji ltar bstan pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /ri rab glang sal bskor nas ni/ /bskal pa'i mtha' ru mnan par bsam/ /mthu stobs chen po'i nga ro yis/ /phreng ba'i sngags ni rab bzlas shing / /rgya gram 'bar bas stang stabs bya/ /mos pa rang 'dod lha mnyes te/ /sgrub 6pas mngon sum snang bar mdzad/ /rtsol ba drag pos rtog pa'i nad las thar/ /yun du ma btang dz+wadad ldan ngang bsrings na/ /tak+ṣa ka yis bzung 3bar gyur pa yang / /zla ba drug gis bzlog 'gyur je tshom med/ /gang zhig rang sems dpang du btsugs nas ni/ /the tshom med par rtag tu ma brjed na/ /rtog 25—754

pa'i nad las thar cing dngos grub 'byung bar nges/ /'gro la brtse bas klu sgrub 'khrul 'khor brtsams/ /'di las bsod nams dge rtsa ci yod pa/ /gang mos rtog pa'i nad las thar gyur nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi zhal mthong shog /rin chen dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dngos grub snyug bsngal thams cad zhi bar shog /slob dpon dzā ba ri pas mdzad pa'i klu sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta de ba pūr+ṇa ṭ+wām ti dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/75༷ rmyematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉thu rigs bzhi'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gitwa/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dpal/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mthar—/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ya'i zhi/ phyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag751 ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ras/ /tū〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartsams te/ gu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rasag ḍasnye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyur/ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bye'i/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drel/ khe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorakhyams/ hūṃ/nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / ri〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnam shel dang / snye〈〈pe 〉〉lha'i/ 〈〈snar 〉dpa'i/752 sne〈〈snar 〉7ni/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsū/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉riḥ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ltem/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi—/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge gas/ 3〈〈pe 〉ra/ 〈〈snar 〉sto na/ rme 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorabul/ ḍa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kan ka ri na/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lnga/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lot+pal/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rga/753 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7nā ga khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7phu/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉r+ṇa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7twa/ ye〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7khro ta tha hūṃ phaṭa/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thongs/ de 〈〈snar 〉raka'/25—755

1༷60༄ / /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon rnams spyong zhing sel ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ yak+ṣa se nā napa ta ye bi sho dha na ha ra sā dha ༄ nā ma/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon 4rnams spyong zhing sel ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can 5la phyag 'tshal lo /sbu mdog mthing nag khros pa'i gzugs ldan shin tu 'jigs/ /gnod sbyin 'dul mdzad me 'bar rdo rje 'dzin la gus btud de/ /las dang nyon mongs las dang rkyen gyis rab thobaskul nas/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal gnod sbyin dug ni bsal phyir bri/ /lha yi bsnyen pa rab rdzogs shing / /dul la snying brtser 7 ldan pa dang / /cho ga thabs la mkhas pa dang / /dbang rdzogs nus pa ldan pas bzlog /khrus la sogs pa dang ldan pas/ /bum pa yungs kar legs par brtag /rtags byung sgrub pa rab tu brtsam/ /gnas ni yid 'ong der 'dug ste/ /bsrung dang sa chog rdzogs pa dang / /maṇ+ḍal legs par byas nas 25—757

ni / /sta gon rdzogs par byas pa dang / /dmar gtor bum pa lnga rnams dang //'bru sna sman sna rin chen dang / /khrag dang sha dang snying la sogs/ /rdzas dang sta gon rdzogs par bsags7/ /de nas thig gis gdab bya ba/ /byin rlabs sprudam tshig can gyis bya/ /dang po tshangs thig gdab pa dang / /zur dang logs dang cha chen dbye/ /sgo rgyan lha snam ①gnyis btab nas/ /de nas tshon rnams byin gyis brlab/ /dge ba 'khor lo lte bar bcas/ /lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje sngon po bri bar bya/ /'khor lo'i /④rtsibs brgyad ser po ste/ /shar du ral gri ltor dbyug pa/ /nub tu mdung ste dgra sta byang / /shar sgo 'khor lo lho nub mda'/ /nub byang gri gug byang shar tri shul shādagod/ /lha snam /phyogs skyong bcu dgod do/ /de nas rdzas rnams dgram pa ni/ /dbus su bum pa sngon po dgod/ /phyogs bzhir rigs dang bstun pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir khrag gi gtor ma gzhag /grwa rnams mchod pa sngon po bsham/ /phyogs skyong gtor ma sgo bzhir gzhag⑦ /nad pa khrus byas byang 'dug lho/ /bdag nyid lhor 'dug byang du'o/ / las kyi bum pa byang du'o/ /'u/de ltar rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang / /mchod bstod sngon du rdzogs pa dang / /sngags kyis stong nyid shebasgoms nas ni/ /de rjes sa bon hūṃ yig las/ /rdo rje ra gur sa gzhir gyur/ /de steng rja 6las gzhal yas ni/ /dur khrod 'jigs par bskyed par bya/ /de nas gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud bcas/ /dra ba dra phyed rta babs so/ /dbus su nyi ma :nyadabang po'i steng / /hūṃ las bskyed pa'i rdo rje can/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rab bskyed nas/ /re pha la gnas hūṃ mthing nag /thugs kar rab tu bsgoms pa las rtsibs 25—758

brgyad re pha brgyad steng lkudu/ /k+ṣa las bskyed pa'i gnod sbyin ni/ /sha za dang ni ral pa can/ /gdong ser dang ni seng gdong ste/ /mo bzhi mtshams su rab bsam bya/ /rab tu smug nag thushin tu dmar ba dang / /rab tu 'bar ba'i gser bsregs dung mdog go/ /'khor lo mda' dang gri gug tri shu ༄ la/ /g.yas na de rnams g.yon jethod pa'o/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i gnod sbyin mo/ /nyi ma'i dkyil na g.yas bskum bzhugs/ /bong bu sna dang rna ba 'phyang / /ral pa gyen 'greng ral gri so/ /thal ba'i mdog dang dud ka dang / /dmar nag shin tu gnag pa'o/ /ral gri dbyug pa mdung dang sgra 5sta dang / /g.yas na de rnams g.yon na thod pa'o/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i gnod sbyin ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil na brkyang bskum thubazhugs/ /ye shes spyan drangs 7mchod nas bstem par bya'o/ /yak+ṣa be+e dha ger ṇa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ yak+ṣa kro dha sā dha nā ya hūṃ phaṭa / yak+ṣa m+bi waṃ ba sa na ya hūṃ 9phaṭa/ yak+ṣa a pra ti ha ta pā la ya hūṃ rkaphaṭa/gnod sbyin ma rnams g.yon skor benas/ /'jigs byed gnod sbyin gsang sngags bzlas/ /yak+ṣa pa ra kra mā ya phaṭa/ rak+ṣa kṛ tān+ta rta ya phaṭa/ yak+ṣa bi dha na ta rū pa skyeya phaṭa/ rak+ṣa ro ṣa shā ya phaṭa/ ces pa brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas//dus gsum mchod pa rnam lngas mchod/ /bzlog dang las bcal —man ngag bzhin / /bgegs dang log 'dren las bcol bya/ /thod pa dur du nges par gzhug /bzlog na yungs kar rtags kyis brtag /mi ldog sartags su shes par bya'o/ /hūṃ zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ /mthing nag mi 'gyur thugs rje can/ /gnod sbyin gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /25—759

bdag gis 'gro la phan phyir brtsams/ /des ni 'bras bu bde thob shog /gnod sbyin gyi sgrub —4pa'i thabs nam gru'i rigs las byung ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon dzā ba ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po'i mkhan po de ba pūr+ṇa ma nyi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/757 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sngaganod sbyin gyi sde rnams sbyong zhing sel ba 'es bya ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 na/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dpon/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rigos sngon po can/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar/ ma〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thartse/758 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rlab/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉rnams/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shul/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnams/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄zhag bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilas kyi bum pa/ byang du'o// ( 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma nga / rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hūṃ/ hūṃ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnama'i/759 —1 〈〈co 〉〉stong / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thu/ je〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 na/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanagra/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamam/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉drang / ṣ+pe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉 ya/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉 ya/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mongs bskor/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnam tai tā/ tsun〈〈pe 〉〉du pā /〈〈snar 〉〉gi pā/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacol/ mu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'an/76༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sgru ba/25byed760
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (987)

༄ / /yi dwags dang sha za dang grul bum dang srul po rnams rnam par sbyong zhing sel ba'i sgrub thabs shes bya ba/kye ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kuṣ+ṭhaṇ+ḍiṭ+wā 3 dha pre ta pi shā tsa ye bi sho dha ya ha ra sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ yi dwags dang sha za dang grul bum dang srul po rnams rnam par spyong zhing sel ba'i sgrub thabs shes bya ba/ 'phags pa las na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsum pha rol phyin drug ldan/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i/ /rdo rje can la gus btud de/ /sems can rnams la phan phyir bri/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rab rdzogs pas/ /yan lag tshon snas rab bcings nas/ /lha yi rnam pa gsal bsgoms te/ /rtags ni rab tu gsal ba brtagan /brtags zin nas ni sgrub pa brtsam/ /sa yi cho ga rdzogs byas la/ /sta gon legs par sgogs nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor thig skud byin rlabs 4gdab/ /ye shes thig gdab sa thig ni/ /tshangs thig nas bzung sgo rgyan bar/ /legs shing rdzogs par gdab par bya/ /de nas tshon dgye dbus nyi dkyil/ /pad+ma 25—762

'dab brgyad ge sar bcas/ /kha dog so so gru chad ljang / /rdo rje ra ba lha snam rigs/ /mtshan ma sa bon rab tu dgod/ /shar nas brtsams te 'khor lo ral gri dang / /dgra sta rdo rje kha dog so sor bri/ /shar lho ⑫7nas bzung lcags kyu gri gug dang / /mi mgo dang ni rgyu ma'i zhags pa bri/ /mtshams su gtor ma phyogs su thod pa bkram/ /'u dbus su sku gdung ༄ —gur dang bla re bye④/ /lha snam phyogs skyong gtor ma so sor dgram/ /bum pa phyogs bzhir las snyebum shar sgor gzhaga'u /mdun du bla ma yi dam lha/ / 7spyan drangs mchod nas stong nyid bsgom/ /de nas hūṃ las sa gzhi ra ba gur du gyur pa'i rdo rje me 'od bcas//de nas rgyu srelas gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bcas shing dbang po nyi zla'i gdan/ /de steng bdag nyid gsum gyi tshul 1gyis zhal gsum phyag drug bskyed/ /mdun du hūṃ las ⑩dga' rab dbang phyug thod phreng can dang bum rna sha zan sen dgu bskyed / /thal nyu4dkar mdog dang gnag dang sngo dang shin tu gnag /g.yas na 'khor lo ral gri dgra sta rdo rje dang / /g.yon na bsdigs tshipa'i sdigs mdzub bo/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /thal bas lus byugs khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /mtshams rnams su ni me tog ma dang mdzes ldan dang ni 'od zer 'phrog — /dang mdangs 'phrog ma'o/ /g.yas na lcags kyu gri gug mi mgo rgyu ma'i zhags/ /g.yon na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba'o/ /smug nag mthing nag dmar nag ljang nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs can bdud mo bzhi'o/ /thugs ka'i re pha'i hūṃ las muspyan drangs bstem sogs rdzogs byas nas/ /gsang ba'i sngags ni rab tu bzlas/ /oṃ kuṣ+ṭhaṇa bi dha ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍon+d+ra dha san kro dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/pre ta bi sa na ya phaṭa/ pi shā tsa ha ta ba ba gluphaṭa swā hā/ kuṣ+ṭhaṇa kra mā 7ya phaṭa/25—763

—ḍon+d+ra ta na kri 1tā na ya phaṭa/ pre ta kri —tān+ta rū pa snyeya phaṭa/ pi shā tse snyero ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa bzlas te/ sngon du bsnyen pas bsgrub bya'i rtags ni rim pa drug par brtag /rtags byung bskrad pa'i las brtsam mo yi las rlung bsams steng du bskyed/ /dgug cing uts+tsha ta khruyas bskrad/ /las bcol phrin tshilas gzhan yang brtsam/ /rabs chad nag po'i thod par ni/ /gzugs/ gzhug 7bsad pas dur khrod sba/ /hūṃ me dpung 'bar ba brjid pa'i sku/ /gad rgyangs bzhad mdzad thal mo rdebs/ /rgya mtshor zhabs nub dbang po mnan//sgu gsum don ldan zhal 'dzum bzhad/ /phyag drug bdud 'dul mtshon cha 'dzin//rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal 'dud3 / /oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol nas bsdu ba'o/ /bdag gis gzhan la phan phyir brtsams/ /dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun / /bla sed byang chub thob par shog /nam gru'i rigs las byung ba'i slob dpon dzā ba ri pas mdzad pa'i bdud bzlog pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //bal po'i bla ma de ba pūr+ṇa ma ti dang / lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o / / //25—764

bsdur mchan/762 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉ston dwags dang sha za dang grul bum dang srul po rnams rnam par sbyong zhing sel ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kujuṇ+ḍidra// du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtags/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabarlab/763 tu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgo/ /rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pachod pa/ ༷ cha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 bcas/ / gi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wabre/rgya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 kyi/ 3)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag ge〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉walha// 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu/ shes〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wagyi tshul/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉walha/ las/ (1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tha/ (2〈〈snar 〉〉sdigs/ dzo 〈〈pe 〉〉'phrogs—/ rngu〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ḍodra/ ta/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ ma/764 ྅ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhu/ (〈〈snar 〉〉sla/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ḍa/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'phrin / ④〈〈snar 〉〉bzhug du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bstod/ 497〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉waslob dpon/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ sde (9 8 25wa 765

1062༄7/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/)༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra pā ṇi byā waṃ ba ra dha ra ba lo dh+wa ra ṇi bi bye nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams 'dod dang 'dod la mnyes/ /bar chod spong dang dug zhi phyir/ /thugs rje can la gus btud de/ /gtor ma'i las 'di brtsam par bya/ /dad ldan byang sems rnal 'byor pa/ /ser sna med cing gtong brtson pas/ /bza' ba bca' ba 'jib dang btung / /rin chen snod du rab tu bsham/ /hūṃ dīḥ.oṃ gyis byin brlab bya/ /bdud rtsi sha lnga ci 'byor pa/ /mtshan ldan pad+ma'i sgod du'o/ /sngo dang dmar ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis/ /de steng a las ka pā la/ /lcags kyu lnga dang sa bon lnga/ /de nas mdun gyi bar snang la/ /zla dkyil steng na yi ge hūṃ/ /de gyur rtse lnga de nyid can/ /sngo bskyod me 'bar 25—766

rdzas rnams khol/ /'od kyis zla ba rdo rje zhu/ /thim pas dngul chu lta bur ( gnas / /de yi steng du oṃ dkar po'iṭa/ /'od kyis gaṅgā'i ༄ —klung sogs bkug /bdud rtsi drangs te gnyis med bstem/ /'bru gsum sngags kyis byin brlab bya/ /de rjes mdun gyi mkha' stong la/ /paṃ las chu skyes 'dab brgyad bskyed—/ /de dbus hūṃ las 'dod lha bskyed/ /lte 'khor dag la oṃ las ni/ /phyogs bzhir ④sangs rgyas bzhi yang 1bskyed/ /'dab ma mtshams bzhir khro mo ste / /gong ras sgo ba bzhi po'o/ /dmar ba'i 6sa bon 'dab brgyad dmar/ /phuḥ7las 'dab mar klu brgyad bskyed/ /ze 'bru bcu drug sna tshogs la/ /bdud dang gnod sbyin sna tshogs bskyed/ /rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis ni/ /'phros pas sangs rgyas gaṅgā yi/ /bye snyed dkyil 'khor lha la bstem/ /klu dang gnod sbyin bdud dang ni/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla yi/ /thams cad de gsum dag la bstem/ /spyan la sogs pas dbang bskur te/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs lhar gyur/ /mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag mchod/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang mgron rnams kyi / /rang rang lce la rdo rje ni/ /hūṃ las nas tshad tsam ni bskyed/ /rtse mo dag la oṃ bsams te/ /'od 'phros drangs pas gsol bar bsamakhe/ /gnyis med ye shes thob 'gyur te/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis mchod/ /gtso bo nyid la gtso bo ste/ /'khor ni so so'i sngags rim bzhin/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta 1/ gnyis la sbyin pa gong dang 'brel/ /de nas bstod cing gsol ba gdab/ /so so yi ni sngags kyis ni/ /rang rang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ /spyod lam gye ni dus dag tu/ /rang nyid lha yi rnal 'byor bya/ /'di yis phan dang bsod 25—767

nams ci bsags pa/ /'bras bu myur zhing longs spyod rnams ni thob/ /bgegs rnams zhi dang gdug pa zhi byed shog /bde ba mchog chen bdag gis thob par shog /dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gye gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba 1nam gru'i rigs las byung ba dngos grub brnyes pa/ slob dpon chen po nabram ze'i btsun pa dzā ba ri pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma de ba pūr+ṇa ma ti dang / lo tsā ba she'u badz+ra de bas bsgyur ba las/slad kyi bdag dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bla ma la shin tu legs par zhus te/ phran bu ritsho bcos pa lags so// //bsdur mchan/766 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉rapal phyag na rdo rje bos sngon ngo/ can gyi sazungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga bzhugs/767 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge sa/ 1〈〈pe 〉sngagaṅgā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gi gā/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉ba'i / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ 6〈〈snar 〉ge 'i/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 8/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sams/ kho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉srasat+yā/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tād/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/768 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'o// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkachen po/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kus/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉than nu/25—768

1063༄7/ /rim pa drug pa zhes bya ba/dzor༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ kra ma ṣa ṭa nā ma/ bod skad du/ rim/ pa drug pa zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro rnams/ rtog 2pa'i ngor gyur rtog gnas te/ /de la rtog cing dge dang mi dger ju 'dzin / /dug dgra'i 5gseb thar chu srin kha ru ni/ /gru chad bzhin du dga' dang mi dga' ste6/ /rtag tu brtse bas 'dzin cing nga ros 'jigs/ /de la dngos po kun gyis 'dud cing 'dud/ /bka' drin thob dang rang nyams rtog de dran/ /de 'dir 'dod lha mnyes dang nges 'byung dang / /spyor ba gzhan gyis nges par 'byung ba yin/ /dang po gnyis yin gnyis pa bzhi ru snang //dang po bzlas pa 'grub dang grub pa'i rtags/ /gsang sngags 'grub pa'i rtasas/ dang mtshan ma ni/ /glegs bam du ma na 'tsher mthong lag gis len/ /rnga chen dung dang cha lang dril bu dang / /mchod pa'i sgra sgrogs du ma'i gzugs mthong ba//25—770

maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor las byed chos 'chad nyan/ /glegs bam klog cing dkyus ltar 1'dri ba smra/ /ras ris la ni bde gshegs gzugs brnyan ni/ /du ma mthong zhing rten gyi gzugs mthong ba/ /rol mo'i gzugs byed mchod rten gdugs sogs byed/ /rdo rje la sogs mtshan ma rnyed dam mthong / /me tog sna tshogs gsal bar mthong ba dang / /nyi zla'i 'od 'bab gza' skar go mthong dang / /me gtong du langs nam mkha' yang ni 'khyegs/ /jing la chu 'dren khron 2pa las ni len/ /'bras kyi myu gu bzang dang lo ma bzang / /ce naspyang la sogs thul ba gos bzangs gyon/ /rgyan cha bzang zhing mtshon cha rno ba 'dzin//de rnams byung gyur gsang sngags grub pa'i rtags/ /rnal 'byor pas gsang sngags 'grub pa'i rtags kyi rim pa ste rim pa dang po'o // //4mig la sogs pa'i dbang pos 5srid gsum mthong / /thos dang snga phyi'i skye 6dran rdzas kun lud/ /ras ris bzhad cing ro sogs 'od 'byung dri/ /myun nag me tog char 'bab 'ja' tshon snang / /tshogs na chos 'chad mun nag glegs bam dpyod/ /nam mkha' stong las sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra/ /'brug sgra glog 'gyu thog chen 'bebs pa dang / /nam mkha' stong zhing sprin sngon mthong ba dang / /de bzhin mthing nag sprin sngon nges 'gyur dang / /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor 'od ldan sa gzhi bdal/ /ras ris lugs ma la sogs bde gshegs gzugs/ /mchod cing skor ba byed dang rten la skor/ /dkyil 'khor bris nas mchod dam dbang bskur ba/ /mdzes pa'i sgod du me tog sna tshogs thu8/ /rin chen sna tshogs me tog bai ḍūr rnyed/ /shin tu skam pa'i sa 25—771

——las 1chu rdol ba/ /bdag nyid me dpung nang 'dug srog chags tshig /ting 'dzin gsal zhing yi dwags gzugs la brtson/ /dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas ni du ma mthong / /rtse gcig pa yi bsam gtan byed/ /seng ge'i khri steng gnas pa rmi/ /lha khang gnas gzhi rtsig mtshungs dang / /chu bo che dang rgya mtsho'i steng nas 'gro/ /bar snang 'phur zhing bsdigs pa'i ltos 'gro len/ /'di 'dra'i rmi lam gsang sngags grub pa'i rtags/ /rnal 'byor pas gsang sngags grub pa'i rtags kyi rim pa ste gnyis pa'o// //gnyis pa bzhi pa'i dang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ /spyor ba gzhan byung rnal 'byor nyid la 'ong / /ri gzar dag la mi thar mthar zad lhung / /ri brags 'dzul 'dod chu dong lhung ba dang / /phyugs lhas 'dam rdzab bshang gci'i nang dang ni/ /kha dog dmar dang skya ba'i chu dag la/ /rtsub dang gnag pa'i gos dang dmar ba'i gos/ /shin tu hrul po'i tshe ta'i pags —pa gyon/ /shing 4rtsi ri las lhung dogs rten me+ed 'dug /gcer bur 'dug cing lcag lcig chu nang 'gro / /gzung 'dzin yod pa'i rten sa de ru ni/ /nyin dang mtshan du rtag tu 'gro ba rmi/ /glang nag glang dmar ba nag ba dmar zhon/ /rtsub pa'i gos gyon ga 5ta la zhon pa/ /ma he ba lang khyus 'gro sogs rmi ba/ /gnag dang ba lang khyus 'gro sogs mthong dang / /rta dang ga ta mig 6zlum khyus 'gro sogs/ /be ta tshe ta khyus 'gro sogs mthong ba/ /seng ge spyang dang khye sogs mche can dri/ /bse dang bye ba sder chags rmi 'gyur ba'o/ /spyor ba gzhan gyis gnod pa 'gyur ba rnal 'byor pa la mtshan ma 'ong ba'i rim pa ste gsum pa'o// //25—772

gnyis pa'i bzhi pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /rnal 'byor stobs kyis mi thub mtshan nyid ni/ /bya dang byi ba sbrul gdug 1gnas pa'i mtsho/ /chu srin nya dang chu sogs gnas pa dang / /sdig pa sdom dang rtsangs pa rkang mangs dang / /sbrang bu mchu rings srog chags phra mo rnams/ /de rnams rmi gyur bran rnams spyor ba gnod/ /sbrul dang sbal pa sdom dang sdig pa dang / /bya sogs lus 'byar mchus 2'debs gshog sprug dang / /be ta la sogs spru rnged mdog rgod rmi/ /mi thub rtags te bud med smyo ba dang / /mi thub kun la brdeg 'gyur mdog rgod ma/ /rgyan bzangs mdzes pa'i snod du zas sogs bkang / /rtag tu rgan mor 'ong 'gyur mi thub rtags/ /ltos rdo'agros lus dkris ldan zhing mi phrel dang / /sdig dang rtsangs sogs 'byar zhing mchus 4btsugs pa/ /sbrang bu mchu rings srog chags phra mo rnams/ /khrag 'jib lus nang zhugs gyur mi thub rtags / /chu srin nya sogs chu chen 'phyo zhing 'khyu / /gnag dang dmar srog chu yis khyer ba rmi/ /de yang mi thub rtags te brtson par bzlog /dad ldan brtson pas mi 'grub gang yang rnged/ /spyor ba gzhan las byung ba'i gnod pa rnal 'byor pa'i stobs kyis mi thub pa'i rtags kyi rim pa ste bzhi pa'o// //gnyis pa bzhi pa gsum pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rnal 'byor rtsal 6gyis thub cing non pa'i rtags/ /ma he gnag sogs rjud cing rid pa dang / /dud 'gro rnams ni btags sam brtod gyur pa/ /dud 'gro dgras khyer brtod dam rkun mos khyer/ /dud 'gro 'tsho dang 'bras kyi phub ma 'chag /dud 'gro 25—773

'khor dang rdzi yis skyong ba dang / /dud 'gro yor dang 'gab jegs thub 1pa'i rtags / /dud 'gro gsad dang btsos nas za ba dang / /rang gzhan me byung dud 2'gro tshig gyur dang / /de ni nges par dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags/ /bud med rgud 4cing ngo dma' shi ba dang / /ngu zhing rgyan bzang gus pas phyag byed dang / /gnas nas gzhan 'gro thub pa'i rtags su bstan/ /sbrul la sogs pa'i srog chags du ma rnams/ /bsad dam zos sam shi'am ded gyur dang / /skem dang tshig gyur 5thub pa'i rtags yin no/ /bya dang byi ba sbrul gdug gnas mtsho skams/ /bud med zhum 6zhing ngu ba thub pa'i rtags/ /spyor ba gzhan rnal 'byor pa'i rtsal gyis non pa'i ltas kyi rim pa ste lnga pa'o// //gnyis pa bzhi pa 7bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sbyor gzhan rab tu khros par gyur pa ni/ /rang nyid mi g.yo gnas na gnas nas ni/ /sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs ni ston cing phyogs/ /'khor dang bka' yi pho nya 'gyed cing 'dug /rigs mtho'i 'dra 'bag 8bu chung rab byung gzugs/ /'ong gyur thang las skyes pa'i pho nya yin/ /de ni bzlog par bya ba'i thabs ni gzugs/ /blon po yul gye rgan rabs 'ong 9'gyur dang / /brod pa skyes pa gzhon nu bon po'i gzugs/ /sngags pa'i gzugs ni 'ong 'gyur brag skyes yin/ /de bcos bya ba'i thabs ni bstan pa yin/ /dkar dmar gnag cing shin tu mang ba yi/ /ba lang 'tsho zhing phyugs nang 'dug pa dang / /ral pa bzang po bud med smug nag dang / /g.ya' ri gangs ri las skyes pho nya yin/ /de phyir thabs ni du ma yod par gsungs/ /bud med gzhon zhing rgyan bzangs rab 25—77

byung ma/ /ma dang sru mo sring mo 1ṣ+pe ṣ+pe mo yi gzugs/ /nye du nye 'byel kyom chen bud med dang / /bu mo chung ma mtsho las skyes pa yin/ /de ni 2mnan pa'i thabs ni bya ba dang / /de rnams zhi 'gyur 'ga' zhig dbang du 'du / /dbang du 'gro ba rtog pa'i nad las thar/ /khye la sogs pa dud 'gro phal cher ni/ /sbyor ba gzhan gyi pho nya yin pas bzlog /rang gi ngo bo gtso bo'i gzugs can te/ /dud 4'gro'i gzugs ldan rgyan ldan de nyid do/ /nam mkha'i mthongs na gnas shing sprul pa yi/ /gzugs ni ma lus brjod kyis mi lang ste/ /de yang dpag tu med pa'i mtha' mi rtogs/ /de phyir bde sashegs mthu dang mtshungs pa yin/ /sbyor ba gzhan gyis bka'i pho nya bkye ba'i rim pa ste drug pa'o// //bla ma'i bka' dang lhag lhas 5gnang ba byen/ /'gro la brtse bas rtog nga/ cung zhig sbyar/ /de yi dge ba ci bsags pa/ /rtog la 6nges shing nges rtogs shog /rim pa drug pa zhes bya ba rtags gsal bar byed pa/ nam gru'i rigs las byung ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon dzā wa ri pas mdzad nga/ sdogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta napuju ma ti dang lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //
