༄༄/ /bsad pa bdud rtsi'i gso ba zhes bya ba/tso ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma ri na ma ri a mṛ 2 ta nā ma/ bod skad du / bsad pa bdud rtsi'i 4gso ba zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsad 5pa gso ba ma byas na/ /gang zhig la ni sdig pa dang / /gang zhig shin tu khros 'gyur ba/ /de phyir gso ba'i cho ga dran/ /rin chen ga'u pad+ma can/ /de mtshungs ga'u steng 'gebs bya/ /phyogs bzhi pad+ma'i steng du ni/ /'bras phye'i rgyu las byung ba yi/ /tsan+dan chus bkrus sbrus 6pa yis/ /rigs bzhi klu yi gzugs gzhag ste/ /gdong pa mtshal kyis 9byug par bya/ /btsun mo bzhi dang khye'u bzhi/ /bu mo bzhi yi gzugs kyang gzhag1 /de dag mdzes pa'i gzugs bya'o/ /pad+ma'i lte bar rin chen lnga/ /mtshams kyi pad+ma bzhi po la/ /dkar ser dmar ser bud med kyi/ /'o ma bzhi ni mtsho bzhi ste//der ni klu gzugs sna tshogs gzhagarta /ljang gu dar gyis steng dgab po/ /de 2bye—778

—nas rang lha'i sa bon las/ /'od zer lcags kyu lta bu las/ /'ga' zhig rnam smin lus bor ba/ /bar do'i sems de bkug byas te/ /dri chu yis ni sanyis ka bsang / /gzugs la bstem 1zhing 'o mar bdar/ /sna tshogs sman gyis gtor bar bya/ /de ltar dgug pa lan gsum bya/ /de ltar gso ba phyi nang gnyis/ /rang lha'i sa bon 'od 'phros pas/ /'ga' zhig sems kyi bag chags sbyangs/ /lce yi rdo rje lte bar a/ /a yi 'od zer phus btab pas/ /'ga' zhig sems kyi a la thim/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun phab sems gso'o/ /sems dang shes pa dran gsal bsam/ /'chi med bdud rtsi 'o rgyun 'dis/ /klu brgyad 'khor bcas khyed rnams kun/ /sems dang shes pa gsal gyur cig /lus dang dbang po rgyas gyur cig /drin lan dam tshig dran gyis la/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /shin tu khros pa zhi gyur cig /de ltar rim nga/sa lan gsum bar/ /de ni nang gi gso ba yin/ /de nas mngar gsum 'bras chan mar/ /gser dang khye yi 'o ma dang / /nā ga ge sar la sogs nga/'i / /gso ba'i sman ni sna tshogs bsags/ /bdud rtsi'i 'o rgyun byen brlabs te/ /de yi nyams pa rnams sos bsam/ /gso sman la sogs rim pa d+mā / /mchod cing 'di skad brjod par bya/ /hūṃ nga ni thugs rje chen po yi/ /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ /gso ba'i bdud rtsi rgyun phab nas/ /klu brgyad 'khor bcas khyed rnams kun/ /drag po'i sngags kyi gzi brjid kyis/ /bsreg dang btso ba'i sbug bsngal dang / /mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /bsgun zhing gtubs 4pa'i sdug bsngal dang / /sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs spyong / /'chi med gso ba'i 5sman tshogs kyis/ /bsregs shing btsos pa sos 25—779

gyur cig /bsnun zhing gtubs 1pa sos gyur cig /lus dang dbang po rgyas gyur cig /mthu stobs ldan zhing bde gyur shog /sdug bsngal kun las thar bar shog /byang chub sems bskyed dga' sems ldan/ /dbang po rnams kyi spyod yul du/ /mkho dgu longs spyod thams cad ni/ /'dod pa thams cad ldan gyur cig /nyams pa'i lus sogs rgyas gyur cig /yan lag thams cad bde gyur cig /klu nad thams cad sos gyur nas/ /sdug bsngal nad las thar bar shog /ngan song gsum las thar nas ni/ /tshangs pa'i tshe dang ldan gyur te / /chos spyod dbang po thul nas ni/ /phyag na rdo rje'i zhal mthong shog /'jigs pa kun las skyabs ldan shog /longs spyod chen po thob gyur cig /sngags dang sman sogs byin rlabs —kyis/ /nad dang nyer 'tshe kun sos pas/ /drin lan dam tshig dran par gyis/ /phyag na rdo rje'i bka' ma 7'da'/ /zhe sdang gdug pa zhi gyur la/ /de ring che ge mo la ni/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub zhi gyur cig / klus byas 4bcings pa grol gyur cig /legs bsams thams cad 'grub pa dang / /dar zhing rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol5/ /nā ga rā dza phuḥ6shārnyi ku ru swā hā zhes pa'i tshig /rim pas kun nas gdags par bya/ /gdengs ka'i phyag rgya bcas nas ni/ /dam tshig 'di yis bsgrag 7par bya/ /hūṃ nga ni phyag na rdo rje ste/ /klu brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa nyon/ /chos bshad bden pa mi nyan dang / /rig sngags rgyal po'i bka' bcag na/ /gso ba'i sman ni thams cad kun/ /mtshon cha'i char du gyur nas ni/ /lus kyi gnad la gzir bar byed/ /bsad 9cing bcad cing dum bur 'gyur/ /mngar gsum la sogs gtor ma yang / /dug chen ha lar gyur nas ni/ /25—780

—myos dang rmongs par gyur nas ni/ /tsha ba chen pos gzir bar byed/ /de bas dus rnams thams cad du/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu srungs/ /oṃ m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra sa ma ya nā ga rak+ṣa rak+ṣa —1hūṃ phaṭa/ de 'dra'i mchod pa gsum byas te//dkar gsum mngar gsum gtor ma ni/ /cho ga'i rim pas gtang 2bar bya/ /de ni phyi yi gso ba yin/ /nyams dga' ba yi gzhal yas khang / /'dzam gling pho brang chen po ste/ /rten yod gnas su dam du sba/ /thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gso ba'i de ni rim pa ste/ /cho ga 'di ni shin tu legs/ /bdag gis man ngag rim pa 'di/ /gang zhig 'ga' la phan phyir byas/ /zla ba lta bu gang thob des/ /'gro rnams rtog pa'i nad grol shog /bsad pa gso ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// ///ji bsdur mchan/778 —1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉ngosad pa bdud rtsi gso ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉che mṛ/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dru mri/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasad/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasad/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sgus/ kye〈〈pe 〉stanas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhag9—〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatso/ 117〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga zhag779 1〈〈snar 〉skosam/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pal/ 〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉byeng btubs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉cing gtubs—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ra/78༷ 3sna〈〈pe 〉shāng btub/ 〈〈snar 〉〉cing gtubs/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sku byad/ de〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasol/ ce〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 7〈〈pe 〉rabasgrags/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7hūṃ/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacad/781 lku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phrok+ṣa yak+ṣa/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzasad/ zi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 paṇ+ḍi ta de ba pu5 ma ti dang lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //25—781

༄khya/ /bdud rtsi 'o ma'i mchod pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ du hi a 2mṛ ta pū dza nā ma/ bod skad du/bdud rtsi 'o ma'i mchod pa zhes bya ba/ rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs dug rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bdud rtsi lta bu khyod la 'dud/ /'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /bsad pa gso ba'i thabs 'di ji/ /gser zangs la sogs snod du bsham/ /sa bon gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs4/ /rjes su gzung phyir sgu bskyed nas/ /de nas de la mchod pa 'bul/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can/ /gzung 'dzin dri ma'i skyon spangs nas/ /mnyes pas sku gsung thugs la dbul5/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sazla 6ta thā ga ta badz+ra pā ṇi dī dze+e ba ra dha ra ma hā kā ya ā 7ha ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes mchod yon dbul/ hūṃ me tog dam pa 'di dag dang / /de bzhin mdzes 25——783

—pa'i me tog rnams/ /bde gshegs thugs la dbul bar bgyi/ /chags rnged thugs rjes bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi puste pū dza 1me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hā/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bdug spos dam pa 'di/ /gtso 'khor bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ /rtog rnged thugs rjes bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hā/ mun pa'i phyogs ni 'joms byed byung / /phyogs bcu gsal ba'i mar me 'di/ /kun mkhyen ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /ye shes thugs mchog bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hā/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /rang rang thugs la dbul bar bgyi/ /kun bzang 2thugs rjes bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra gadhe pū dza rnge gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hā/ kha dog dri dang ldan pa'i mchog /bza' ba'i mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /rang rig ye shes brnyes la dbul/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi byā dze+e ba ra dha ra pū dze+e dza yan na pra ṇa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hā/ bla rnged theg pa mchog gi don ston pa/ /shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs kyis 'gro la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shog /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi byā dze+e ba ra dha ra budhe k+ṣe tra pra tsa 4li ti pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hā/ nor rgyas dang ni dung skyong dang / /dga' bo dang ni 'jog po dang / /pad+ma dang ni chu lha dang / /stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan la//bdud rtsi 'o ma'i mchod pa 'bul/ /klu yi nad las thar gyur cig /gnod 25—78 /

1066༄༅/ /klu khro bos gsad pa'i thran las zhes bya ba/ 1༄ gyi/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā ga karma kro dha ma ra na nā ma/ bod skad du/ klu khro bos gsad pa'i phrin las zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bsnyen bzlas pa'i rtags byung na/ /'ga' zhig dbang du bsdu dbo/sa pas/ /de dbang bya phyir man ngag rim/ /mgon la lus btud man ngag dran/ /dur khrod la sogs gnas dag tu/ /sngon du bsnyen pa sgogs pa yi/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi zla ba la/ /bdun dang dgu dang lnga dus la/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum khru gang tshad/ /mgo ni lho ru bstan par bya/ /sbrul dang sbal pa'i sha dang ni/ /ske tshe ju tshe khre dang nyil/ /thal ba sa dang lan tshwa dang //bu ram 'bras phye rnams las ni/ /sor brgyad tshad kyi smad 'khyil ba/ /dgu dang bdun dang lnga dang gsum/ /klu yi rgyal po'i gzugs byas te/ /mthing nag hūṃ phaṭa snying gar gzhug /gru gsum nang du mgo bo lhor/ /bstan te 25—786

gan rkyal lta bur gzhagarmye /de ltar rdzas rnams bsags nas ni/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bdag ldan pas/ /lcags kyu lnga dang sa bon lnga/ /'dod pa'i lha la dbul ba ste/ /sbrul dang sbal pa'i sha khrag sogs/ /bsgrub bya de nyid la ni sbyin—/ /rta sha la sogs sna tshogs sha /nang gi bka' srung rnams la sbyin/ /'bras chan la sogs gtor ma ni/ /phyi yi bstan srung rnams la sbyin/ /bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor bya/ /sa bon las ni sna tshogs pa'i/ /khro bo mtshon cha 'dzin pa yis/ /bsgrub bya'i cho ga dang bral nas/ /drangs te sa bon la ni bstem/ /snga ma'i sa bon nyid gyur pas/ /'gugs par byed pa'i sa bon byung / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrngunī dze+e ba ra badz+ra pā ṇi e ku sha dzaḥ.ā hūṃkar+ṣa ya che ge mo hūṃ dzaḥhūṃ phaṭa/ gsang sngags 'di ni brjod pa las/ /lcags kyu thogs pa'i lha mo ni/ /dpag tu med pa bkug par dā bsam/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbe+e waṃ ba ra badz+ra pā ṇi che ge mo pra be+e sha ya phaṭa/ gzugs brnyan kha phye bstems la gzhag 7 /sna tshogs nad kyis gzir ba dang / /lus 'dar sems ni gdung bar bsam/ /sta re la sogs mtshon gyis gzir/ /rlung nag gis g.yengs grang bas khyab/ /gcan gzan sogs kyis lus zos bsam/ /dam tshig bsrung phyir gtor ma sbyin//de nas phur bu mtshon cha thogs/ /gsad thabs gsum gyis gsad par bya/ /gnas bdun du ni phur bus gdab/ /hūṃ nga ni phyag na rdo rje ste/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dbang bskur bas/ /stobs chen phrin trelas drag po yis/ /skad cig tsam yang mi gnas phyir/ /lus kyi gnad du gzir ༄/bar gyis/ /oṃ m+bi waṃ ba ra badz+ra pā ṇi che ge mo tī li tī la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ gsang ba'i bdag por bka' srung 7phyir/ /gsang 25—787

byed—ba'i dam tshig bstan par bya/ /oṃ m+bi tshodze+e ba ra badz+ra pā — snaṇi sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/phyag na rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /phur pa'i lha dang che ge mo/ /dam tshig gnyan gyes ma 'da' bar/ /ci bsgo dathams cad mnyan par gyis/ /hūṃ nga ro stobs chen drag po'i sgra/ /gdug pa gang zhig 'da' mi byed/ /nga yi mthu stobs drag po'i sgra/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgya ru 'gems/ /khyon cig ltos 'gro thams cad kun/ /mthu stobs drag po'i bka' ma 'da'/ /oṃ m+bi dze+e ba ra badz+ra pā ṇi che ge mo ha ra ha ra/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ hrīn+da stson+da/ bhirnya bhin+ta hūṃ phaṭa/hūṃ rdo rje chen po rab 'bar tho/ /bka' las 'da' byed che ge mo/ /rdo rje chen pos snying bsregs nas/ /lus sems phra rab rdul du rlogarī /rdo rje tho ba'i gtun khung du/ /rdo rje tho bas gtams thutshobyas nas/ /lha yang thal bar rlag byed 'gyur/ /lha yi che ge mo des gsod/ /oṃ nī dze+e ba ra badz+ra pā ṇi che ge mo ha na ha na/ ha sa ha sa dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/hūṃ phaṭa/ tar+ya thā hūṃ phaṭa/ rim pas gtor ma 'di sbyin no/ /bdag med dngos pos btab cing dbul/ /nges par sod 9snanas mnan pa bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la sdang ba'i dgra/ /man ngag rim pas gsad par bya/ /thos pa mang zhing shes rab can/ /bla ma la —gus ser sna med/ /yin gyi gzhan du sbyin mi bya/ /bag med pas ni gal te byin/ /'bras bu mi 'dod sna tshogs ni//tshe 'di nyid la myong bar 'gyur/ /sdang dang gdug pas zin pa'i thabs/ /zab mo'i man ngag cung zad smras/ /de yi bsod nams ci bsags pa/ /sdang dang gdug pa 'dul bar shog/ //slob dpon dzā ba ri pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i khro bos gsad pa'i phrin las 25—788

༄khya/ /klu rigs bzhi mnan pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā ga ku la tsa ri ste bha bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ klu rigs bzhi mnan pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dbang du 'dus gyur pas/ /bskal pa bye ba'i mtha' ru yang / /ldang bar mi nus bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje can la gus btud nas / /sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ /de yi mnan pa'i cho ga bstan2 / /gser las byas pa'i mchod rten nam/ /yang na rin chen lnga las byas/ /khru gang tshad kyi —mchod rten brtsig /bum pa khog ④stong byas pa'i nang / /ku la tsa ri'i gzugs byas te/ /khong stong phyogs bzhir dgod par bya/ /de 'og phyogs bzhi'i rmang du ni/ /ku la tsa ri'i bran rnams gzhug /de nas lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /phreng ba'i sngags kyis bzlas pa las/ /sngags kyi 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /bsgrub bya bkug ste gnyis med bstem/ /yang na rang lha'i sa 25—790

bon las/ /khro bo sna tshogs spros pa yis/ /bsgrub bya bkug ste snga ma bzhin/ /mngon sum lta bur khugs par bsam/ /ku la tsa ri'i spyi steng du/ /rdo rje rgya gram me ri 'bar/ /de yi lte ba'i dkyil du ni/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal po g.yon brkyang bzhugs① / /bskal pa'i mtha' ru mnan 3par bsam/ /de nas bdud rtsi lngar bcas pa①/ /rang gi 'dod pa'i lha la dbul/ /dam la gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ /sbrul dang sbal pa'i sha dang tshil 4/ /glang dmar ba dmar la sogs pa'i/ /khrag la sogs pa rnams kyis ni/ /bsgrub bya la ni gtor ma sbyinarka/ /dbyar gyi khyim gsum tha ma yi/ /drug gnyis bzhi yi nyin 5phyed na/ /sgrub khang them rtsa'i 'og tu ni/ /shin tu dam par sba bar bya/ /phyag na rdo rje khro bo che/ /rab tu khros pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /ri rab klad la bskor nas ni//de 'og ku la tsa ri ni/ /rigs de rnams ni mnan byas kyis/ /thar ba yi ni dus med par/ /dam tshig gnyan gyis ma 'da' cig /nyes pa 'di las ma ldog cig /lus 'di rul cing myags gyur nas/ /snying ni 'gems shing zags par byed/ /tshe yi 'du byed byas nas ni/ /mnar med par ni 'gro ba yin / /byang chub sems bskyed byams pa'i sems/ /skyes pa'i tshe na gtang bar bya/ /phreng ba'i sngags ni brgya rtsa brgyad/ /shin tu khros pas bzlas par bya /mthu stobs drag po'i nga ro yis/ /stang stabs kyis kyang mnan par bya/ /ngang tshul bzang zhing shes rab can/ /bla ma la gus gtong phod pa/ /gal te rmongs pas gzhan du sbyin/ /tsha ba chen por yun ring 4gnas/ /oṃ nī dze+e ba khyar badz+ra pā ṇi sa ma ya nā ga ku la tsa ri i rmā ba lo khā hi khā lkuhi swā hā/ gtor ma sbyin pa'i sngags so/ /klu rigs bzhi'i mnan pa nam gru'i rigs las byung 25—791

༄ / /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ m+bi waṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ho ma bi bye nā ma/bod skad du/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gye sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig med par de mi 'byung / /des na de la 'jug pa dran/ /gang zhig 'dir rgyar khru gang ba/ /kun nas zlum po'i thab 2khung nang du rdo rje sor brgyad pa bkod de/ sa dkar pos byugs la tsan+dan dkar po la sogs pa'i dris kyang gtor ro/ /der rgya shug gam dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci ba btsar te/ nas dang / gro dang / 'bras dang /sran ma dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / me tog dkar po dang ldan pa'i mchod yon no/ /spos dang / mar me dang / dri chab dang / lha bshos te mchod pa'i rdzas te g.yon du'o4/ /til dang / yam shing dang / mar dang /yungs kar dang / zho dang / 'o ma dang / zas dkar gsum dang /25—793

mngar gsum dang / ku sha dang / drur hūṃb dang / nas dang / 'bras dang / gro dang / so ba dang / sran ma dang / bil ba dang /surga dang / dzā ti pha la rnams ni g.yas su gzhag ༄rdupar bya'o/ /rang lha'i rnal 'byor byas la mchod rdzas dang sreg kyerdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs te/bgegs bskrad nas bram ze'am/ tha mal pa'am/ rgyun zhags sam/'o ma can gyi me blangs te/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi dzā la dzā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ces bya bas me sbar bar bya'o/ /de nas hūṃ las thab khung bskyed pa ni/ re las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum la yi ge oṃ āḥhūṃ las 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang rdo rjer 4gyur pa las zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyi me lha mchod phyir thogs pa dkar po dang ldan pa ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun 'byung ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na rdo rje dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu dang bgrang phreng 'dzin pa can chu'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par bsgom mo/ /ye shes sems dpa' phyag rgya bzhis dgug pa la sogs pa byas te/ byen gyis brlab pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / khrus byas nas mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod do/ /mar la sogs pa'i sreg glurdzas rnams rig sngags 'dis dbul te / oṃ ma hā bhū ta dz+wa khā ya saza bhasmi ku ru saza ༄ 7bispyo hūṃ phaṭa/ che ge mo shādhi ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas zhi bar bsam mo/ /de'i rjes la me 'bar ba'i rgyur gyur pa'am de'i snying gar dpal phyag na rdo rje sgrub thabs las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du bskyed la 7ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ gnyis su med par byas la/ rang gi lha la mchod rdzas dang sreg chordzas rnams la phreng ba'i sngags la che ge mo shārnyi ku ru btags la dbul zhing zhi bar bsam mo/ /de nas dgang 25—794

drugs phul te/ sngags 'dis gshegs su gsol lo/ /oṃ kṛ to ba sazla satwarja/sernyi ma daṭ+wā ya thā nu ga gats+tsha hūṃ budha bi ṣa yo1/ pu na ra ga ma na yats+tsha zhes pa'o / /de nas yang thab rgebasangs la rdzas lhag ma rnams kyis me lha la phul te/oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol5//sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes me lha gshegs su gsol/ de nas dam tshig rang la bsnyus nas 'bras chan 6la sogs pa'i gtor ma phyogs skyong la sogs pa la 7sbyin no/ /nyung bar 'dod na bla ma'i zhal nas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin 'di la 'jug par bya'o/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga nam gru'i rigs las byung ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon dzā ba ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // bal po'i 8paṇ+ḍi ta de ba pur+ṇa 9ma ti dang / lo tsā ba 7chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur zhing zhus so/1 / //25—795

sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ byā waṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ho ma bi dhi nā ma/bod skad du/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig med par de mi 'byung / /des na de la 'jug pa brtsam/ /de la 'dir thab khung gru gsum pa mgo lhor bstan pa'i nang du/ khro bo'i rdo rje sor brgyad pa bkod de/ thal ba dang sol bas nag por byugs la dri chu dang bong bu dang rnga mo'i rtug pas byug par bya'o/ /der mgal dum mam/ tsher ma can nam/ skam po'i shing bcer te/ khrag dang / ba'i gcin dang / bdud rtsi dang / me tog nag po ni mchod yon no/ /dri mi zhim pa dang / ro kha ba dang / sngon po'i me tog go/ /bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba'i spos so/ /mar chen po'i mar me/ dri chu dang til nag po sbyar ba ni dri chab/ dri chen dang mi sha bsres pa'i lha bshos te/ de rnams g.yas su 25—797

gzhag 1par bya'o/ /dug dang / khrag dang / ske tshe dang / lan tshwa dang /nim pa dang / da du ra dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres pa'i yungs mar rnams ni dgang gzar du blugs te khrag tu byas la dbul lo/ /shing tsher ma can gye yam shing dang / mar nag dang / khrag dang / dri chen dang / dri chu dang / mi rus dang / skra dang / sor —mo dang / dug dang / ske tshe dang / lan tshwa de rnams dang / rkang rjes dang / khyim bya'i sgo nga dang /bya rog gi sha rnams dang / bong bu dang / rnga mo'i rtug pa rnams ni sreg rdzas te/ sha dang rus par bsam mo/ /de rnams ni g.yon du'o/ /rang lha'i rnal 'byor byas la rdzas byin gyis brlabs nas bgegs bskrad do/ /rdol pa'am/sme sha can nam rdo las byung ba'am/ ri'i me blangs te/ bsang zhing / oṃ/ badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā kro dha dzā la dzā la hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas me sbar riro / /me 'bar ba'i nang du re las thab khung bskyed la de'i nang du hūṃ las nyi ma'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ las 'khor lo dang / pad+ma dang / rdo rjer gyur te/de nas khro bo'i mre lha shin tu khros pa/ skra kham pa gyen du badze+es pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na rdo rje dang skyabs sbyin/ g.yon na dril bu dang dbyug pa/ re las me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor la bsams te/ ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang /bcing ba dang / dbang du byas nas der byen rlabs 5dang / dbang bskur te / khrus gsol nas zhal gdangs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas dang sreg 5rdzas rnams 'dis dbul te/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā khyu ta dzā la 7ya sarba bhasmi ༄ ku ru sarba dubye ma ma che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces pas 9gsad par bya'o/ /de nas me 25—798

'bar bas rgyur hūṃgyur pa'am/ yang na de'i snying gar dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can sgrub thabs las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par snabaskyed nas ye shes sems dpa' snga ma bzhin bstems la/ de bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa dang dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas phreng ba'i sngags la mā ra ya dang bcas pas mchod rdzas snga ma bzhin du dbul lo/ /yang dgang blugs phul te/ ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas thab bsangs te/ rdzas lhag ma rnams me lha la phul nas/ oṃ bdag dang gzhan gyi don rnams ni/ /bsgrubs te sbyin sreg bzhes nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad nas kyang / /bdag la sngags kyi dngos grub stsol/ /4zhes me lha gshegs su gsol lo/ /de'i rjes su dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te/gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /nyung bar 'dod na bla ma'i zhal nas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du 'di la 'jug par bya'o/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba nam gru'i rigs las byung ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon dzā ba ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // bal po'i thupaṇ+ḍi ta de ba pūr+ṇa 6ma ti dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //25—799

rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga jes bya ba/ 1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍal bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba rnams ni ma rig mun pas bsgribs shing rkyen gyi ri bos non pa rnams/ /gsal ba'i ye shes nub cing 'khor ba'i 'dam du byeng //de 'dra'i 'gro ba mang po yid kyis mngon sum mthong / /'gro ba de dag sa bon gnas dang rtsol rkyen gyis/ /sbug bsngal mang po spyod cing gdug 2pas zin gyur pa/ /de las thar pa'i thabs dag gzhan gyes mi nus te/ /srid 'joms sdug bsngal thal samadzad dbugs tsha mi shigs 'dzin/ /gdug pa'i nad rnams ma lus thar mdzad snying rjes khros/ /'jigs byed khro rgyal rngam pa'i gtso la dngos po kun kyis 'dud/ /de la rtag tu mos shing dang bas mngon sum 25—801

byedasnang bar mdzad/ /ji srid mnyes byas lhag pa'i lha yis gnang ba byin/ /rang nyams myong la gdug pa 'dul la dbang bsgur gces/ /de dbang bskur phyir 'khor lo chen po'i cho ga dran/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon mdun/ /slob ma snod dang ldan pa yis/ /maṇ+ḍal zlum po khru gang tshad/ /byi dor legs byas me tog dgram/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gtor ma bsham/ /snod ldan spyod lam legs byas te/ /slob dpon rjod ni dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni/ /snying po byang chub thob kyi bar/ /bla ma dam par gsol 'debs kyis/ /bdag gi bla ma mdzad du gsol/ /sems can ma brgal 1bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang / /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs phyung dang / /mya ngan mi 'da' bzla ba dang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa dang / /bla mar zhu bar khyod spro 'am/ /slob dpon gnang ba byin nas ni/ /slob mas ci 'byor pas mchod nas/ /dgos pa thams cad dri bar bya/ /lung rnams phog la bsnyen pa bya/ /thim nas sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bdun byas te/ /bar chad bsal phyir gtor ma gtang / /tshogs bsags phyir ni mchod pa bsham/ /mkha' 'gro ma la gtor ma gtang / /de nas gong ma'i maṇ+ḍal de/ /byi dor legs byas me tog dgram/ /spyod lam legs byas mchod pa dbul/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/ /sgo gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /mchod pa bla na med pas mchod/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /mtshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga/ /mi dge bcu 25—802

dang lci ba brgyad/ /kha na ma tho la sogs pa/ /'phags pa'i tshogs la so sor bshags—/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang / /'dod chags bral ba'i chos rnams dang / /tshogs kyi gzhir gyur dge 'dun la/ /dang ba'i sems kyis skyabs su mchi/ /phyogs bcu mtha' yas zhing rnams na/ /mngon par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /ring po ma lon thams cad la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs par/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba gdab1/ /'jig rten dge bcu ji snyed pa/ /nyan thos rang rgyal dge sogs bcas/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas 'gro don mdzad/ /de dag la ni yi rang ngo / /dge bcu ji snyed spyod pa dang / /basbu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang ni/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu la sogs/ /byang chub chen por bsngo 2bar bgyi//bdag gi lus 'di ji srid du/ /len pa rdo rje slob dpon dang / /'khor lo chen po'i lha tshogs dang / /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa la/ /ngag yid dang bas dbul bar bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi rang bzhin can/ /sems can kun la khyab par gnas/ /ma rtogs 'khor bar 'khyams pa rnams/ /de dag don du sems bskyed do/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas pa'i/ /bslab dang slob par gyur pa yis—/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims dang / /sdom pa'i tshul khrims ldan pa dang / /dge ba'i chos sdud tshul khrims dag /yang dag blangs te gnas bgyid do/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni/ /dus kun du ni lags thupar nos/ /sdig sgrib sbyang phyir slob ma ni/ /mang por slob ma zlos su gzhug5 /oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /ting 25—803

nge 'dzin ni gsum bsgoms te/ /mchod pa dang ni gtor ma bsham/ /sa yi bdag po rgyas par mchod/ /snang dang mi snang sa bdag la/ /sa blang ba yi gsol ba gdab/ /byin nam ma byin rtags kyis brtag /las dang sngags dang sbyin sreg dang / /mtshan ma med pas sbyar snaba'o/ /blo dang lha yis sa gzung ngo / /lto 'phye brtags la sa brko ste/ /stegs bu byi dor legs byas la//rnal 'byor lus kyi khru gang tshad/ / 'phang du 2khru gang tshad dang sbyar/ /gser ram dngul lam 'jim pa las/ /byas pa'i bum pa bcu'am drug /btsal te legs par bkrus pa dang / /dri zhim bsgo zhing dkar por bya'o/ /de nas bum pa'i nang du ni/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri thra ༄ ha ti/ /shan 4tā ka ni daṇ+ḍit+pa la dang / /tig ta'i me tog sman lngar blugs/ /'bras dang so ba sran ta ka /nas dang gro dang til dang ni/ /'bru sna bum pa'i nang du blugs5/ /gser dang dngul dang byi ru dang / /mu tig man shel rin chen lnga/ /bum pa'i nang du blugs par bya/ /bu ram sbrang rtsi lan tshwa dang / /mar dkar til gyi mar dang lnga/ /bum pa'i nang du blugs par bya'o/ /'o ma chu yis sbyangs pa yang / /bum pa'i nang du blugs la gzhag7 /de dag thams cad blugs pa la/ /gzungs kyi phreng ba bzlas par bya'o/ /kha tshar ma nyams ras yug gis/ /bum pa'i mgul pa bcings te gzhag8 /de nas stegs bu gru bzhi'i 9steng / /maṇ+ḍal zlum po lnga byas te/ /dbus kyi maṇ+ḍal mthing ga la/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang byang / /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /kha dog tshon gyis bsgyur la gzhag— /gtso bo'i bum pa dbus su gzhag11 /'khor gyi bum pa phyogs mtshams dang / /las kyi bum pa byang shar mtshams/ /bum pa mi 25—804

dmigs stong pa las/ / thig le 2dkar po baṃ du gyur/ /de gyur bdud rtsis bkang ba yi/ /rin po che yi bum par bsam/ /de yi steng du sum̐ las ni/ /rin chen sna bzhi'i ri rab bsam/ /steng du sprin sgra bsnol 2ma las/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsam par bya/ /de yi lte bar paṃ las ni/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas/ /pad+ma'i lte ba'i hūṃ 3las ni/ /gzhal yas khang ni mdzes par bsam / /de yi nang du paṃ las ni/ /chu skyes pad+ma ge sar bcas/ /dam tshig 'khor lo bskyed par bya/ /de nas ye shes 'khor lo ni/ /ting nge 'dzin gyes spyan drangs nas/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis gnyis med bstem/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab/ /spyan la sogs pas dbang bskur ro/ /mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /mchod pa lnga ni phul la gzhag4 /phreng ba'i sngags ni rtsa gcig bzlas/ /de nas bum pa'i snying po ni/ /'bum tsho gcig ni bsnyen pa dbul/ /dus dang grangs dang mtshan ma yis/ /thun mtshams sbyor ba re re la/ /gtso bo'i bsnyen pa brgya ru dbul/ /'khor la lnga bcu rim gyis dbul / /tshon sna lnga yi skud pa yis/ /gtso bo'i bum pa'i mgul nas bcing / /gzungs 5thag slob dpon lag tu gzung / /bum pa chos nyid ngang du bsam/ /sngags ni ye shes chu rgyun no/ /mchod pa gtor ma ci rigs bsham/ /mchod dang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas/ /yang dang yang du brtan por bya/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo bskyed pa ni/ /sbyor ba dang po'i ting nge 'dzin/ /stong pa nyid ni bsgom pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ting nge 'dzin/ /lha bskyed gsal bar bsgom pa'o/ /las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin/ /ye shes lha la mchod pa nas/ /dbang bskur yan chad bsgom pa'o/ /skad cig ma yi ting 25—805

—'dzin gyis/ /mig tu ma dang ṭa las ni/ /nyi ma zla ba bsam par bya'o/ /lha/ yi 1dkyil 'khor mkha' la gdeg /sngags ni bzlas shing gsal bar bsgoms/ /skad cig ma yi ting 'dzin gyes/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag gnyis pa/ /mun nag chen po'i ser sprin 'dra/ /mdog ltar 'dug pa nga ro can/ /zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba bsgom/ /rdo rje'i lta stangs —bgegs bskrad do/ /hūṃ lus ngag sems la gnas pa'i bgegs/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje'i stobs/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab spyor bas 5/ /nga yi bka' las su 'da' ba/ /sku gsung las byung dgas par bya/ /gal te dam tshig las 'das na/ /zhig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /gdon gyi rigs su gtogs pa rnams/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs/ /'di ru ma gnas gzhan du dengs/ /sum̐ bha ni yi sngags bzlas shing / /byang shar mtshams nas bskor bar bya/ /gom 4stabs brgyad pa'i gar byas telta/ /lag pa bskyod dang rkang pa bskyod/ /smin ma bskyod dang rab 6'degs dang / /cung zad ngo tsha'i zur mig dang / /brla 7rgyas stan la 'dug pa dang / /kha yi pad+ma 'dzum dang bcas / /cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'chang / /kun+da ltar dkar phreng ba dang / /skad cig ma yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /ra ba dra bar gyur pa'o/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par las/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la / /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis9/ /ji ltar bdud sde bcom pa ltar/ /de bzhin du ni bdud kyi sde/ /pham par bya ste dkyil 'khor bri/ /lha mo sa la thim par bsam/ /bdag nyid phyag na rdo rje yi / /nga rgyal can dang cha lugs bcas/ /dpral bar dri yis —thig le bya/ /25—806

mchod rdzas bkram la byen gyis brlab/ /spro ba bskyed pa'i tshigs bcad brjod/ /lha yi nga rgyal byas pa yis/ /lus pos phyogs bcu skor gyes bskor/ /spos dang dril bu lag tu thogs/ /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor 'dri/ /ding sna'adir thams cad kun gshegs shig /dngos grub 'dir ni stsal du gsol/ /stegs bu chen po'i dbus gnas te/ /yang na de na gnas par bsam/ /grub pa'i grogs mchog mkhas pa yis/ /lha mo bzhi yi ting 'dzin zhugs/ /tshul bzhin dang ni ldan pa yis/ /phyogs bzhi nas ni gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag sked pa yi dngos/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems dpa' kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs kyi 'khor los sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de yis dri yi thig le ni/ /stegs bu'i steng du dgug bya ste/ /dbus su maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa/ /phyogs mtshams rnams su zlum por bya'o/ /de yi steng du skad cig mas/ /mkha' la bteg pa'i 'khor lo rnams / /phab la gdan du dbul bar bya'o/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs la / /phyag rgya bzhi yis gnyis med bstem/ /gru gsum sngags kyis byen gyis 25—807

brlab / /spyan la sogs pas dbang bskur ro/ /mchod pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i bum pa la/ /byin gyis brlab lkul sogs pa nas/ /mchod pa yan chad rdzogs par bya'o/ /dri yi thig le re re la//rang rang bum pa dgod par bya/ /mchod pa'i rdzas rnams thams cad la/ /bsang gtor byas la dngos grub kyi/ /rdzas su gsol ba btab la gzhag /sngar gyi stegs bu yol bas gcad/ /slob dpon yol ba'i nang 'dug la/ /slob ma khrus byas spyod lam mdzes/ /dga' chen khyod la bdag ston to/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan 1pa'i/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de ni stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum de ni bdag la gsol/ /thar pa chen po'i thugrong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod lam chen po dag /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 5rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gsang sngags 'di bsgoms pas/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan ma brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen de dag de yis bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug par rtogs nas/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis//mdun du maṇ+ḍal zlum po ni/ /legs byas me tog tshom bu dgram/ /mchod pa 25—808

rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga rnams/ /bya zhing sems ni gnas par bya'o/ /slob ma mi dmigs stong pa las/ /lha yi 1nga rgyal byas pa las/ /dpral ba snying ga mgrin pa ru/ /dri yi thig le gsum bya ste/ /slob dpon thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /sku gsung thugs kyi snying po spro/ /phyag mtshan gsum du gyur pa las/ /rdo rje slob ma'i mdun logs su/ /maṇ+ḍal zlum po re re bya/ /me tog tshom bu dgram par bya/ /bsang gtor bya zhing mchod pa dbul—/ /deng nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma phog pas / /mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de nas rdo rje slob mas mdun/ /maṇ+ḍal byas te me tog dgram/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /so shing sor ni brgyad pa las/ /phreng ba'i sngags ni lan gsum bzlas/ /slob ma la ni sbyin par bya/ /kha ni phyir bltas so shing bca'/ /maṇ+ḍal phyogs su so shing dor/ /ltas kyi rim pa brtag pa dang / /spro ba bskyed pa'i tshig brjod de/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dusmra 2ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni re 'ga' —zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang zhig mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par 5nus—/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /'gro don mnyam med byed par nus/ /gzhan yang theg pa chen po yi6/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams de ring de bas na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bras bu thob/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /des na bu yis brtson par gyis/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /phreng ba'i sngags 25—809

—sam a mṛ tas/ /srung 1skud byas la btags la gzhag /yang na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa yis / /slob ma de nyid bsrung bar bya/ /grub na bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bya/ /ku sha'i gdan bting a mṛ ta'i/ /sngags bzlas byang shar mtshams su nyal/ /lha yi nga rgyal gsal ba las/ /skad cig ma yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /ma dang a yi ting 'dzin bya/ /u tiṣ+ṭha yi sngags brjod cing / /lha yi 'khor lo mkha' la gdeg /'jam la phra ba'i thig skud la/ /dri bzangs rnams kyis sbangs la gzhag /sa bon las ni 'od 'phro bsasnye/ /ye shes thig skud srun drangs la/ /gnyis su med par bstems la gzhag5 /de nas 'dod lha'i nga rgyal byas/ /thig sna 'dren pa'i slob ma ni/ /mdzes pa'i lha mor bsam par bya/ /dz+dza dz+dza dz+dza/brjod cing thig skud bsgyur/ /des kyang gsum brjod blang bar bya/ /de nas/ gnam thig ci rigs gdab/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ sngags 'di brjod cing gdab par bya/ /dang por thig chen brgyad pa la/ /cha ni bcu drug phye ste gdab/ /de nas cha chung sum cu gnyis/ /phyogs rer cha chen bcu drug pa/ /cha chen brgyad ni nang du gtang / /cha chen brgyad ni phyi ru gtang / /phyi dang nang gi cha brgyad la/ /cha phran sum cu rtsa gnyis gdab/ /tshangs pa'i thig nas bgrangs pa yis6/ /cha phran bcu drug phyogs bzhir gdab/ /phyogs re dag nas brtsis pa yis7/ /dbus kyi lte ba'i cha phran gnyis/ /pad+ma'i ze 'bru'i cha phran gcig /'dab ma brgyad la cha phran gsum/ /mu khyud nyi ma'i ze'u 8'bru la / /cha phran re re mnyam par gdab/ /bcu drug pa la cha phran bzhi/ /mu khyud cha phran gnyis su gdab/ /gru chad la ni cha phran gcig /de bas cha chen bzhir gnas te/ /sgo dang bcu gcig rdo rje la/ /cha chen gnyis ni mnyam 25—810

—par gdab/ /cha chen gcig la rta babs te/ /cha phran bzhi ru gdab par bya/ /cha chen gabyug la cha phran bzhi/ /cha phran phyed ni pad+ma'o/ /gnyis ni chos kyi 'khor lo la'o/ /cha phyed gdugs kyi yu ba ste/ /cha gcig mdzes pa'i gdugs su bya/ /rdo rje me ri ma gtogs pa'o/ /tshon sna lnga ni stong par bsam yi ge 'bru lnga byung bar bsam/ /oṃ hūṃ dhī khaṃ hūṃrta/ thugs ka yi ni sa bon las/ /'od 'phros ye shes tshon rtsi dbab/ /thim pas tshon rtsi lnga ru bsam/ /slob ma lag pa bde ba yis/ /rdul tshon gzhal yas zi bar bya/ /dbus kyi lte ba ser po la/ /ge sar 'od dang bcas pa'o/ /'khor lo rtsibs ni mthing ga'o/ /dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gtso bo'i gdan steng phyag mtshan dgod/ /'khor lo'i lte bar de bkod nas/ /rtsibs su 'khor rnams dgod pa ni/ /thod pa gri gug nag po'o/ /mu khyud zlum po mthing ga la/ /rtse gsum 'bar bas bskor bar bya/ /mu khyud zlum po mthing ga la/ /thod pa'i phreng bas bskor bar bya/ /sgo bzhi gru chad phyogs dang bstun/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /kun gyi nang rol nag por bya/ /rgyan la sogs pa spyi dang mthun / /rdo rje me ri bcas pa bri/ /phyi rol dur khrod 'jigs pas bskor/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs byas nas/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid du bsam/ /shu n+ya tā yis brtan par bya/ /de nas bdag nyid hūṃ du bsam/ /gur dang ra ba me rir bcas/ /yo dang bam̐ las rlung dang chu / /lo dang ram̐ dang e las ni/ /'byung ba lnga'i 4ni gyur pa las/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas/ /sgo bzhi rgyan dang ldan par bsam tshangs dang brgya byin dri za dang / /chu lha ku be ra yi gdan/ /dbus su nyi ma zla ba'i 25—8/ /

steng / /hūṃ dang nyi ma zla ba bsam/ /de yi bar du sa bon las/ /gtso bo yab yum sgu bskyed do/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /rang 'dod lha yi nga rgyal bya/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gsal ba dang / /dpral bar khrag gi thig le bya/ /sngags 'di brjod cing dkyil 'khor bskor2/ /lan gsum bskor 'a/ shar du 'jug /oṃ badz+ra dha rod sa byem ya swā hā/ sngags de brjod cing nying 'dzin gyis/ /gzhal yas khang ni sgo dbye'o/ /bla re rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs / /dar dpyangs dang ni yol bar bcas/ /lda ldi dar dang ras kyis bklubs / /grwa bzhir mda' bzhi me long bzhi/ /stegs bu'i zur la dgod par bya/ /zhal bsil (zil sogs mchod pa'i rdzas/ /ji ltar 'byor par 5dgram par bya/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma dang / /tshogs kyi zhal zas phyogs bzhir dgram/ /skad byug ma yi ting 'dzin dang / /bskyed tshul rgyas pa'i rim pa yis/ /'dod yon lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ /skad cig ma yis ye shes su/ /gsal bar byin gyis brlabs la gzhag7 /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis8/ /las kyi phyag rgya byin brlabs la/ /mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs byas nas/ /gnyis su med pa'i spyor ba bya/ /thugs ka yi ni sa bon las / /phyogs bcur 'od zer 'phros pa las/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas yab yum bcas/ /spyi bo'i 9gtsug tu spyan drangs la/ /tshangs pa'i khu ga'i nang nas gzhug /gsang ba'i rdo rje'i lkulam nas dbyung / /yum gyi pad+ma'i ge sar la / /sgrub pa'i thabs nas gsungs pa bzhin/ /yab yum sgo mar bcas pa bsam / /oṃ spa ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags de brjod pas rang rang gi/ /gnas su gdan la bzhugs par bsgom/ /de nas sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /phyag rgya 25—812

ye shes 'khor lo rnams/ /mdun gyi mkha' la spyan drangs te/ /bsang gtor bya zhing mchod pa dbul/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis gnyis med bstem/ /mkha' la bteg la bstem byas nas/ /nus par ldan nas byin brlabs ni/ /'bru gsum sngags kyis byen gyis brlab/ /spyan la sogs pas dbang bskur ro/ /mi bskyod dbu la brgyan par bsam/ /skad cig ma yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyi nang bstan skyong spyan drang ngo / /zhal bsil kyegadan dang sku khrus gsol/ /de nas mchod pa rnam lnga dbul/ /bshos dang zhal zas sna tshogs dbul/ /rgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs dbul/ /gong gi mchod rdzas lhag ma yis/ /phyi yi bstan skyong rgyas par mchod/ /de nas sgrub khang phyi rol du/ /'byung po'i gtor ma gtang bar bya'o/ /las kyi rim pa de rnams ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yis bya'o/ /de nas skad cig ting 'dzin gyis/ /zhal gsum phyag drug nga rgyal byas/ /nang dang gsang ba bla med dang / /dngos dang ting nge 'dzin gyis dbul/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kha spyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /'khor lo'i bdag po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yi/ /kha sbyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ /dri za'i gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /bdud las rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod ༄ —/ /thabs dang shes rab spyor ba yi / /kha spyor nyi zla'i 4 'phro 'du las/ /gshin rje'i chogadug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje gzi brjid phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yis/ /kha spyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ /chu lha'i gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rngam sgra sgogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thabs dang shes rab spyor ba yi/ /kha spyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du 25—813

las / /gnod sbyin gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje phrin las phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'byung ba lnga yi bdag nyid che/ /mdzes ldan 'od zer can dang ni/ /mdangs ldan sgra dbyangs rlung 'byin te/ /skyed byed las kun sgrub pa la1/ /'gugs shing sgrub 2pa sdom zhing 'dzin/ /mtha' rtul las rnams sgrub la bstod/ /ces bstod pa rnams kyang dbul bar bya/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma byin gyis brlab / /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes/ /bden pa des ni dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan gsal ba'i slob ma ni/ /kun gyis dri ma med mthong shog /de nas rdo rje slob ma ni/ /khrus byas spyod lam mdzes pa yis//sgrub pa'i grogs mchog mkhas pa yis4/ /sgrub khang phyi ru tshig 'di bsgrags5/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi / /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ma mthong snod dang mi ldan na/ /su la'ang ston par ma byed cig /de nas bdud rtsi lnga yi chu/ /blangs nas byin gyis brlab par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi snying po 'di/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la sbyin/ /'di ni rdo rje dam tshig chu/ /srungs shig ma bsrungs 7sreg par byed/ /bsrungs 8na dngos grub ster bar byed / /bdud rtsi 'di ni myang bar gyis/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u 9da ka ṭha ṭha zhes drud7/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /slob ma lha ru byin gyis brlab/ /sgrub pa'i grogs mchog dam pa yis/ /gdong g.yogs dar ram ras kyis bcings / /rdo rje dril bu lag tu gtad/ /rdo rje nas bzung ha ha yis/ /sngags kyi dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor/ /de nas yol ba'i nang khrid la/ /25—81

phyag 'tshal me tog dor bar bya/ /lha rnams gang la phog 1pa ste/ /slob dpon gyes ni blta bar bya/ /de nas rdzas kyi dud pa btang / /rdo rje slob dpon thugs ka nas/ /kha dog dmar po'i a bton te/ /slob ma'i snying gar gzhug par bya/ /slob mas nyams kyi bde ba bsgom/ /'phar dang ldeg pa'i rtags byung na/ /de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag bya/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje nyid/ /slob ma'i spyi bor spyan drangs la/ /yi ge hūṃ du gyur par bsam/ /de gyur rtse lnga de nyid can/ /zhu nas tshangs pa'i bu gar zhugs/ /snying gi dkyil du lha ru gyur / /oṃ m+bi waṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi tsit+ta maṇ+ḍal badz+ra sa ma ya lhan/ sngags 'di brjod la gsal bar bsam/ /mthu stobs phyag na rdo rje ni/ /khyod kyi snying du yang dag zhugs/ /rtag tu yi dam lha yin gyis/ /tshul 'di smra bar ma byed cig /gal te tshul 'di smras na 1ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /nga ni phyag na rdo rje ste/ /nga yis bsgo ba'i las nyon cig /ma mos brnyas par ma byed cig /gal te khyod kyis brnyas na ni/ /dam tshig 'dis ni sreg 4par byed/ /tsha ba chen po'i gnas su sreg /rang bzhin rnam dag bdag nyid lus / /dpa' bo dbang phyug ma yi 5gnas/ /dri med rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni blta bar gyis sna/ /gdong nas dkrol 7te 'khor lo yis/ /de bzhin nyid ni bstan par bya/ /gtso bo sgo bar bcas par bstan//de nas rdo rje slob ma yis/ /spyod lam legs par bsrungs pa yis bsam gyes mi khyab dam chos snod/ /dbang bskur dam pa mdzad du gsol/ /de nas bum pa rnams kyi chu/ /rnam rgyal las kyi bum par drugs / /chu de mi dmigs stong pa las/ /mthing ga'i mdog can hūṃ du gyur/ /de gyur rtse blolnga de 25—815

—nyid can/ /de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ /sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa ru gyur / /sa bon las ni 'od 'phros nas/ /ye shes mi bskyod spyan drangs te/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi nyaganyis med bstem/ /de la mchod pa rnam lnga dbul/ /de nyid chu ru gyur pa yis/ /slob ma la ni dbang bskur ro/ /sku gsum dam tshig las byung ba'i/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /mi bskyod par ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a 2 dar+sha shu n+ya tā a bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ mi/slob ma mi bskyod pa ru bsam/ /de la mchod pa rnam lnga dbul/ /con snyepan mi dmigs ā 5ru gyur/ /slo ༄ 7gyur rin chen sde gis )mtshan/ /de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan bsam/ /sa bon las ni 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes rin chen 'byung ldan ni/ /mdun gyi mkha' la spyan drangs te/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis gnyis med bstem/ /'bru gsum sngags kyis 8byin gyis brlab9/ /de nas mchod pa rnam lnga dbul/ /de nyid cod pan gyur pa yis/ /slob ma la ni dbang bsgur ro/ /sangs rgyas kun gye rgya'/ srid de/ /dbu rgyan rin chen bla na med/ /dbu rgyan rin chen mchog 'gro ma/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tā dz+nyā na rat+na saṃ bha hūṃ a bhe ṣispyo mi/ slob ma rin chen 'byung ldan bsam/ /de la mchod pa rnam lngas mchod/ /rdo rje mi dmigs j-i 7du gyur/ /de gyur pad+ma bye ⑩gis mtshan/ /de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med du gyur/ /sa bon las ni 'od zer 'phros/ /ye shes sems dpa' 'od dpag med/ /mdun gyi mkha' la spyan drangs te/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis gnyis med bstem/ /'bru gsum sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ /de la mchod pa rnam lnga dbul/ /de 25—816

nyid rdo rjer gyur pa yis/ /slob ma la ni dbang bskur ro/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi rdo rje'i dbang / /mi phyed rdo rje gsal ba las/ /chos rnams kun gyi sgor gyur pa/ /rdo rje chos kyi dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ pradz+nyā ā 1—be sha dz+nyā na a rnyi ṣidzi — mi / slob ma 'od dpag med du bsam/ /de la mchod pa rnam lnga dbul/ /dril bu mi dmigs khaṃ du gyur/ /de gyur ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan/ /de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ /sangs rgyas don yod grub par gyur/ /sa bon las ni 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes don yod grub pa ni/ /mdun gyi mkha' la spyan drangs te/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis gnyis med bstem/ /'bru gsum sngags kyis byen gyis brlab/ /de la mchod pa rnam lnga dbul/ /de nyid dril bur gyur pa yis / /slob ma la ni dbang bskur ro/ /thabs dang shes ldan ldan pa yis/ /'gro don mnyam thumed byed pa yisaphu/ /mchod pa'i rdzas rnams rdzogs byed pa//dril bu las kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha a nu ta na dz+nyā na pa te badz+ra a bhi ṣispyo 6 mi / de nas rdo rje dril bu gnyis/ /kha sbyar 7tshul du bsnol la sbyin/ /lag tu gtad la gsil du gzhug /slob ma don yod grub par bsam/ /de la mchod pa rnam lngas mchod/ /slob ma mi dmigs oṃ du gyur/ /de gyur 3'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan/ /de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gyur/ /sa bon las ni 'od zer 'phros/ /ye shes rnam par snang mdzad ni/ /mdun gyi mkha' la spyan drangs te/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis gnyis med bstem / /'bru gsum sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ /rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang mi chod mi shigs 9 pa'i / /rdo rje ming du rab tu grags/ /oṃ tre tsakra a mo gha dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi 25—817

ṣilnga 1snami/ slob ma rnam par snang mdzad bsam/ /de la mchod pa rnam lnga dbul / /chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang / /dril bu dang ni ming gi dbang / /rig pa yi ni dbang lnga'o/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rnam dag rgyu/ /dbang lnga yis ni thob pa yin/ /ma rig pa las 'das nas kyang / /ye shes lnga ni rim gyis 'thob / /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /lag tu spos thogs dril bu gsil/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rgyas par mchod/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ /lan gsum bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /bcom ldan bdag gis snyesnabyin rlabs kyeni/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul 4zhugs brtan par 5mdzad du gsol/ /slob ma'i lag tu me tog gtad//nyi shu rtsa gcig lan gsum bzlas/ /de nas rdo rje slob ma yis/ /lha dang slob dpon bcas pa la/ /me tog phul te tshig 'di brjod/ /bcom ldan bdag gis bzung 6lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /rdo rje lag tu blang byas te/ /ye shes rdo rjer byin brlabs nas/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 7/ /mthu stobs mnga' bdag phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu gzung she7/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ste bha ya a rnyi ṣi.ā+oṃ / mi/ sngags de brjod la slob ma yi/ /lag tu rdo rje gtad par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad pa/ /slob ma la ni bskon nas gzhagarka /zhal gsum phyag drug sgom du gzhug /rgyan dang cha lugs 'bar ba ni / /dpa' bo bu yis blang bar gyis/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /phyi rol nang na yang dag gnas/ /oṃ — dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi he he/25—818

sngags de brjod la brtan par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dbon gyis/ /thub pa chen po'i cha lugs zhugs/ /slob ma la ni chos gos bskon/ /nga ni shākya seng ge ste/ /rgyan cha phyag na rdo rje bcas/ /'di kun nga yi sprul pa ste/ /ma 'jigs 'jigs par ma byed cig /khyod ni 'khor ba'i 'jigs las thar/ /mi bskyod sangs rgyas zhing dag tu/ /rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ a bhe ṣi.ā+oṃ skyami/ sngags de brjod la bsrungs la gzhag2 /bu khyod 'khor lo'i dbang bskur gyes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin/ /phyag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs can/ /de bzhin gshegs par lung bstan no/ /khams gsum bdag po rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud kyi sde rnams bcom zin gyis/ /khyod kyis grong khyer mchog tu zhugs/ /oṃ nī dze+e d+ngha /ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sirnyi zis ma ya s+ho bha ya a bhi ṣilnga 5mi/ sngags de brjod la lung bstan no/ /slob ma spyod lam mdzes pa yis/ /mtshan ma med pa 'gro ba'i don/ /gang dag bdag gis byed nus pas/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che/ /dpa' bo chen po bdag la gsol/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mchod par bya/ /de nas seng ge'i khri bshams la/ /slob ma gzhag ste dbang bskur ro/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyes kyang / /lha rnams kyis ni sku khrus gsol/ /de bzhin lha yi bdud rtsi yis//sku khrus dam pa gsol bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣe ka a bhi ṣispyo 5mi/ dung bud rnga chen rdung 3du gzhug /po ti glegs bam lag tu gtad/ /chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ro/ /slob dpon thugs kar zla ba bsam/ /de yi steng du yig 'bru bsam/ /de gyur rtse lnga de nyid can/ /de yi lte ba'i nang du ni/ /lha yi 25—819

'khor lo bsam par bya/ /rdo rje slob ma'i snying gar yang / /zla ba hūṃ dang rdo rje bsam/ /nga tshoyi lte ba stong pa ru/ /slob dpon thugs las 'khor lo bton//slob ma'i snying gar bstems la gzhag37 /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis gnyis med bstem/ /'bru gsum sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ /spyan la sogs pas dbang bskur ro/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni shes pa yis/ /mi bya ba ni gang yang med/ /dpa' bo chen po byeng yi bkas/ /'dod yon lnga la spyad par gyis/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha swā hā/ de nas rjes su gnang ba'i dbang / /slob ma la ni bskur bar bya/ /deng nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis/ /lus dang srog la mi phongs byepar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /'gro ba'i don ni dpag med byos/ /sems can gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /rten cing 'brel pa'i chos dang ldan/ /khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /sems can don ni mtshungs med byos/ /de nas slob ma'i dbang bcu ste/ /phal cher bum pa la brten pas/ /bum pa'i dbang zhes brjod pa yin/ /phyir mi ldog dang rjes su gnang / /rdo rje slob dpon dbang yin no/ /lus ni dri ma 'khrud pa'o/ /nyon mongs pa yi sgrib pa spangasasnye/ /sa ni dang po thob par byed/ /dbang bskur rim pa bcu gnyis so/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur te/ /dang por snod ldan slob ma yis/ /tshogs dang dpa' bo'i ston mo bya/ /shes rab ma ni bcu gnyis sam/ /bcu drug nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bar/ /rgyal rigs rje'u 6rigs bram ze'i rigs/ /mig dkyus kyering zhing sha mdangs dkar/ /mnyen lcug 'khril sdem gzhon tshul can/ /lus la nu 'bur kha dri zhim/ /smra na ngag 'jam mdzes par 'gro/ /yon tan gzhan yang ldan btsal te/ /slob 25—820

dpon mdun du maṇ+ḍal ni/ /gru bzhi lham pa khru gang tshad/ /byi dor legs byas me tog dgram/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /shes rab chen po'i snod 'gyur phyir/ /dbang bskur chen po mdzad du gsol/ /gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /bdud rtsi chen po'i ro myang phyir/ /dbang bskur 'di la khyod spro'am—/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /lha mo 'di ni khyad par can—/ /yon tan mtha' yas ldan pa ste/ /gsang spyod thabs kyi sbyor ba las /gsang ba'i dbang bskur mdzad du gsol/ /de nas rdul tshon gzhal yas khang / /nang du gsang ba'i yum bzhag nas/ /de nas sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi yum/ /phang na gnas pa'i lha mo rnams/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu spyan drangs te/ /tshangs pa'i bu ga'i lam du zhugs/ / gsang ba'i pad+ma'i ge sar la/ /mdzes pa'i lha mo lnga ru bsam/ /rgyan dang cha lugs gsal bar bsgom/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu spyan drangs nas/ /tshangs pa'i bu ga'i lam zhugs nas/ /1rdo rje bum pa'i 'khor lo la/ /rgyal ba sangs rgyas lnga ru gyur//rgyan dang cha lugs gsal bar bsgom/ /mkha' gsang byen gyis brlab pa dang / /gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba bya/ /yab yum 'dzal spyor bsgom pa yis ye shes gsal ba'i byang chub sems/ /phab nas mtshan dang ldan par —blugs/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun gyis/ /dam tshig 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /khams lngayi ni ro yis gang / /bde ba chen po myang bar gyis/ /rdzas de slob ma'i lce la gzhag4 /a ho su kha skal chen po5/ /dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ /25—821

'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bsgur/ /byang chub sems ni yid 'ong bas/ /de bzhin bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /de nas shes rab ye shes dbang / /shin tu zab pa'i tshul du bskur/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chu la sogs/ /shes rab ma yi lus kun bkru/ /dzā lha/ti tsan+dan ga bur dris / /shes rab ma yi lus la byugs/ /lha mo 'di ni khyad par che/ /bde ba mtha' yas ster byed ma/ /blangs nas rnam pa thams cad du/ /bu yis bla med mchod par byis/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /bu yis ci dgar za nus sam/ /phyag rgya lnga las byung ba yi3/ /rig ma dad pas mchod nus sam/ / bshang gci ༄ khu ba rak+ta sogs/ /'di nyid du ni za nus sam/ /nga yi gsang ba'i pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba myur du skyed pa ste/ /khyod kyis rtag tu mchod nus sam / /ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams/ / lha mo'i pad+ma mchod par bgyi//de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /shes rab lag pa g.yon pa dang / /slob ma'i lag pa g.yas pa gnyis/ /dar gyis mdud pa byas la gzhagasnye /brda yi 6dkyil 'khor bris pa'i steng / /pi dar stan la sogs pa'am/ /dar gyi blo stan 'phar ma bting / /rdo rje khro bo rtag tu bskyod/ /me 'od 'bar ba bsgom par bya/ /steng gi pad+ma'i snying po bcu/ /shes pa rang gsal ngang la gzhag7 /slob ma'i lag pa g.yas pa yis/ /shes rab mkhal ma g.yon mnan nas/ /slob ma'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma kha phye ste/ /pad+ma ge sar snying po btsal/ /shes rab bum pa'i mgul chings kyis/ /slob ma'i bum pa mgul pa bcing / /bde ba kha spyor bsgom par bya'o/ /pad+ma ze 'bru rgyas pa dang / /rdo rje lag gi khrig sgo gzhug2 /gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba bya/ /rlung 25—822

la goms pas rlung la gtang / /sngags kyi rtsa sgo dgag pa dang / /sor mos bsdam /ṭ+wāzhing glod pa dang / /pad+ma'i ge sar snying po de/ /rdo rje bu gar rte7bcug la gzung / /nyams kyi stobs kyis nang du 'jen/ /bde ba gsal la mi rtog 1pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes myong / /de yi nyams dang mi 'bral bar / /cung zhig de la gnas par bya/ /de ni 4rdo rje chu 'thung 7gis/ /bsgom pa cung zhig bya ba yin/ /mi gsal ye shes ma yin na/ /rol pa'i sgra la sems gtad la/ /yang dang yang du nyams su blang / /de yis 6ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas gnyis ka ngal bar ldang / /pad+ma dang ni rdo rje nas/ /byang chub sems kyi kun+da la/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin pas/ /lce yis 7blang zhing gzhib par dābya/ /kun+da lta bu'i byang chub sems/ /rang gi sems la bstem par bya/ /gnyis med ye shes gsal bar 'gyur/ /shes rab ma yi rkang pa g.yon/ /slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas ni/ /nga dang rdo rje slob dpon dang //mched dang lcam bral 9thams cad la/ /khams gsum sems can ma lus pa/ /ma mos brnyas par ma byed cig /gzhan yang dam tshig bshad pa rnams/ /rtag tu khyod kyis bsrung ba rkagyis/ / deng nas bzung 1nas bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob par/ /sems can kun gyi don rnams ni/ /rtag tu rmi lam bzhin du gyis/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas bzhi pa tshig gi dbang / /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /mjug gi las kyi cho ga ni/ /mkha' la bteg kinas bzhugs pa yi/ /'khor lo chen po'i lha tshogs la/ /mchod pa'i yo byad 'byor tshad dbul/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyan rnams rka bsnyu/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po yis/ /bshags pa ci tsam 'grub par bya/ /mkha' 'gro 25—823

rnams la gtor mas mchod/ /tshogs dang dpa' bo'i ston mo bya/ /oṃ kṛ to ba 2la sogs pa yis2/ /ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig bsdu/ /'gro ba 'dod pa tha dad pas/ /de la dgongs nas bde gshegs kyis/ /mos pa tha dad drang ba'i phyir/ /'gro la brtse 5bas byang chub lam / /sna tshogs tha dad gsungs pa kun/ /gang zhig 'ga' la phan phyir du/ /gsal ba'i sgron mar gsungs pa ④yin/ /de la brten nas yun ring mos pa yis / /'dod lha'i zhal mthong de tshe lhag lhas gnang ba byin/ /ma smin smin byed yon tan kun 'byung ba'i/ /shes rab bzang zhing mang thos zlos sems med/ /brtson 'grus drag cing sran thub brtan blo can/ /bla ma la gus dad ldan snying rjer ldan/ /de 'dra'i slob ma bzang po btsal nas ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog tu dbang bskur ro/ /'gro la brtse bas dbang bskur cho ga sbyaralta / /yun rings bsgoms pas mi 'grub gang yang med/ /dal ba'i dge rtsa ci yod bsod nams kyis/ /sgrub po 6dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par shog /dpal phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nam gru'i rigs las byung ba'i dngos grub brnyes pa slob dpon dzā ba ri pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po'i mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta de ba pūr+ṇa ma ti dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //25—824

༄/ /maze nad kyi mtshan nyid ces bya ba/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsi ti dz+wa la lak+ṣa ṇa nā ma/ bod skad du/mdze nad kyi mtshan nyid ces bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro rnams rdul dang mun pa snying stobs kyi / /'dam la gnas te rkyen kyi ri bos non/ /de bsal shes phyir rang gi rtogs pas bri/ /dam pa'i drin thob mgon la spyi 4btud bshad/ /de la 'dir nad kyi mtshan nyid dang / bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid 5dang / de bzlog pa'i thabs so/ /de la mtshan nyid la bcu gnyis su shes par bya ste/ gal te bcu gnyis kyis ma bzlog na de 'phro bcad do / /'bad pa dang bcas 7pas tshogs bsag go/ /thabs ni 'dod pa'i sgo mnyes pas bzlog pa dang / rten cing 'byel pa'i nus pas bzlog pa'o/ /'dod pa'i lha mnyes pas bzlog pa ni sgrub thabs las shes par bya'o/ /rten cing 'byel pa'i nus pas bzlog pa ni bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /25—828

mtshan nyid rnams ni 'di lta ste/ /rus dang sha dang pags 1pa dang / /rtsa dang khrag dang nang grol dang / /bcud dang chu ste lus kyi stobs/ /lus kyi rtsa dang mdog dang dbyibs/ /reg pa chu ba chu ser dang / /klad pa lha ba lus kun la/ /zhugs pa rnam pa bco brgyad yin/ /rigs kyis ma yin gcig cig 2min / /'on kyang gcig sogs rim gyes brtag /rus pa la zhugs pa ni bzhi ste/ lus skem pa dang / gzer che ba dang / na thang nge ba dang /thig ler na'o/ /sha la zhugs pa ni lnga ste/ lus bem me 'dug pa dang /lus lci ba dang / mdog gnag pa dang / dri ngas pa snar 'ong ba dang / sha ro 'byung ba'o/ /pags pa la zhugs pa ni gnyis te/ sha 'phrig pa dang /mdog skya ba'o/ /rtsa la zhugs pa ni bcu ste/ lus dz+red ber be+er ba brtag pa ni bzlog par dka'o/ /sgyid lug pa dang / sgyid phyig phyig pa dang / tsha ba 'dzag pa snyam rīpa dang / tsha rab rab pa dang / tsha ker ker ba dang /tsha breng breng ba dang / lus la sogs pa tsha thang nge ba dang / tsha bir bir ba dang / yan lag phra shāba'o/ /khrag la zhugs pa ni bzhi ste/ sna nas skabs skabs su yang yang 'dzag pa dang / tsha ber ber ba dang / lus phyi yor yor ba dang / gdong dmar ba la stag pa'i lo ma'i bris ma ltar 'ong ngo / /nang grol la zhugs pa ni bzhi ste/ spyo snying mi bde ba dang / sgyur thib thib pa dang / snying 'dar phril phril 4dang / snying mi dga' ba ste bzlog dka'o/ /bcud la zhugs pa ni bzhi ste/ /khu ba mi 'byung ba dang / dbang po ldang mi nus pa dang / khu ba skyo ma'i mdog tu 'ong ba dang / khu ba dngas snyigs bye nas 'ong ba'o/ /chu la zhugs pa ni gsum ste/ sbubs kyi chu rgya skyegs kyi khu ba 25—829

ltar 'ong ba dang / sna'i chu rtag tu skyo mar 'dzag pa dang / mig chu rtag par 'dzag pa 1ste/ du ba dang ser bu byung ba tsam gyes myur bar 'dzag pa'o/ /lus kyi stobs la zhugs pa ni gsum ste/ lus sgyid lug pa dang / lus sgyid zhum pa dang / lus myal myal ba yin no/ /lus kyi rtsa la zhugs pa ni gnyis/ te / swa rtsi la sogs pa lus kyi dri ma bya'i pags 4pa bzhin sangs kyis 'gro'o / /mdog la zhugs pa ni gabyug ste/ lce btsod kyi mdog bzhin du song ba'o/ /dbyebs la zhugs pa ni gnyis te/ lus gnyer chung gis 7khebs pa dang / yan lag gi sor mo rnams byi ba'i mjug ma ltar song ba'o res pa la zhugs pa ni 9bzhi ste/ sna rtse rtal sogs par tsha 1 yam yam 'ong ba dang /tsha ber ber 'ong ba dang / lus brtse ba dang / g.ya' be+er 'ong ba bzhin no/ /chu ba la zhugs pa ni bzhi ste/ yan lag rengs shing na ba dang / sha 'bur ba dang / grang sing sing ba dang / tshigs rta rnams 'khor ba bzhin 1 no/ /chu ser la zhugs pa ni lnga ste/ lus za gol gol chab dang / lus za tsag tsag pa dang / lus za lcib phyib pa dang / lus la sachu rgang 'ong ba dang / chu rgang byung na yun ring por mi thogs par 'ong ngo / /lus la 'brum pa'i rjes sran chung lta bu byung na bzlog par yang sla'o/ /klad lapa la zhugs pa ni bzhi ste/mgo phying phying skrang ba dang / 'thom pa dang / bem me ba dang / skra nul nul 7'byi ba la sogs pa'o/ /lha ba la zhugs pa la ni gsum ste/ gdong pa la sogs pa tsha lam lam 'ong ba dang / gdong pa la sogs pa grang seng seng 'ong ba dang / de bzlog par be+e'o/ /lus rid 1/cing gdong thal skya'i mdog tu song ba ni bzlog par dka'o/ /lus kun la zhugs pa ni gsum ste/ tshor 25—830

——ba med par gdong pa la sogs pa'i sha 'gyur 1yin no/ /shin tu yang bzlog par dka'o/ /klu shin tu yang khro bo dag gis kyang rtags dang mi ldan par thugs kyis —kyang 'gro'o/ /bzlog par dka'o/ /rma la sogs pa 'tshor mi 'dod pa'i rtags dang mi ldan pa ni bzlog par sla'o4/ /gzhan yang yan lag phra ba dang / sbom pa dang / thung ba dang / 'khums 5pa dang / rengs pa la sogs pa la klu'i mtshan nyid du shes par bya'o/ /rtags de rnams las 'ga' 'ga' ni nad kyi gzhi las kyang shes par bya'o/ /'ga' la 6ni klu'i gdon ma yin pa las kyang 'byung bas mtshan nyid so sor shes par bya ste/ nad gzhi las byung ba'i sman la sogs pa dang / 'phrod pa'i zas kyis phan pa'o/ /gzhan gyi ni yun mi rtag pa 'phro 'chad do/ /'di 'dra'i mtshan nyid mngon du shes / /shes nas myur )ba'i brtson 'grus kyi/ /sna tshogs thabs la ma rmongs pas / /bzlog pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ /chu rgyun yun rings 'bab pas ni/ /rdo ba dag kyang dus su 'bigs/ /gdug pa'i dbang byas zhe rings yang / /le lo dang bral rtse gcig sems/ /rgyun du bsgoms na bzlog sems kyis / /gdug pa'i nad las thar par nges/ /rtsol ba can kyi som nyi bral/ /gang bsam de la mi 'grub med/ /des na 9'khor ba gces pa ni/ /phung po srog ni dang ba la/ /mngon sum nyid du mthong 'gyur gyis/ /rtsol 1 ba dor bar mi bya'o/ /'gro ba snying rje rang gis rtogs dang bka' drin gyis/ /bdag gis nad kyi mtshan nyid 'di sbyar yon tan gyes/ /'gro bas mngon du de rtogs brtson pas de bzlog bya/ /ci yod dge bas 'gro ba 'tsho dka'i nad las grol bar shog /mdze nad kyi mtshan nyid ces bya ba/ nam gru'i rigs las byung 25—831

ba—/ dngos grub brnyes pa dzā ba ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta pūrte dang / bod kyi 1lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang bos bsgyur zhing gtan la phab pa'odzu /bsdur mchan/828 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉rnamadze nad kyi mtshan nying ces bya ba bzhugs/ da 〈〈pe 〉dkyis/ da 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasal/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉00sa/ phye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshad/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉zlog 〈〈snar 〉〉zlogs/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacad/ zu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ra/829 dzo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bogs/ rngo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagacig ༄ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masags/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉stan/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 'u 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da ba/83༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipa/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgyid khum/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas rtsa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lpags / lku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lca brtsod/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉gis—/ she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gini/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpa/ ⑫ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zadas rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yo na/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉da 'ong / ⑫ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gil/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉bo'o/ glad—/ mu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dur nur/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'o/ /lus red/831 she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da ba/ 3ge〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉giyang / hūṃ/〈〈pe 〉zab ldang bar thug gis/ 〈〈snar 〉dz+ra ldang bar thugs gis/ pa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'o/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snams/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gil/ me〈〈co 〉lbāng /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉s+dzad/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dze+e/ rmye/〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thartsol/832 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉paṇ+ḍi ta de ba pur+ṇa ma ti dang / snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'o/25byed832
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (998)25wa 833

༄/ /gnod sbyin gyi snge dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can 'khor lo chen po'-i lha tshogs la bstod pa jes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa tsakra ma hā de ba ga ṇa maṇ+ḍal sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gye sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can 'khor lo chen po'i lha tshogs la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ be+eng 4lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i gtso bo ste/ /skye med ngang las longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sgu/ /yon tan ma lus rdzogs pa khyod 'a/ 'dud / /sprul pa'i sgu mchog gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /brjid pa'i sgu mnga' 5sbrul brgyad sku la brgyan/ /snang srid dbang du snyud 6pa'i mthu stobs can / /srid gsum sbug bsngal mthar mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bsgum mthing nag 'bar ba'i zhal/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar spyan ni gsum 7gsum ldan/ /phyag drug rdo rje g.yas 'chang g.yon sdigs mdzub/ /25—834

bar gnyis thal rdebs mtha' gnyis sbrul gsol 'dud/ /dpral ba'i khro gnyer smin ma g.yo zhing 'khrug1 /dbu skra kham nag gyen brdzes me stag 'phro/ /ral pa'i cod pan sbrul gyi gdengs kas brgyan/ /rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan khyod la 'dud/ /ljags 'dril 4mche gcigs nga ros 'brug sgra sgogs5/ /kha rlangs me ltar 'bar bas gdug pa bsreg6 /mche ba gcigs pas dug gsum rtsad nas 7gcod/ /khyon mongs 'joms par mdzad pa khyod la 'dud/ /'jig rten gsum sleb sku mchog shin tu brjid/ /sngon po 'chad pa'i na bza' sku la gsol/ /dus mtha'i 8me ltar 'od zer 'bar ba'i sku/ /srid gsum zil gnon khyad 'phags khyod la 'dud/ /gsus pa'i smad 'khyil stag gi sham thabs can/ /tshangs pa brgya byin nyi 9zla 'bar ba'i steng / /zhabs gnyis phrag bzhag 7yon tan rdzogs pa'i sgu/ /mtha' gnyis rtag chad sel mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /rngam pa'i sgu yis bdud rnams 'dul bar mdzad/ /brang 'gro brgyad kyis sgu brgyan klu dbang 'dul/ /brkyang bskum brjid pas gnod sbyin zil gyis gnon/ /phrin las mthar mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud / /sprul pa'i khro tshogs bye ba sgu las 'phro/ /hūṃ phaṭa sgra 'byin mtshon cha mang pos 1 'debs/ /mthing nag sku yis khams gsum cho nges 'debs/ /sprul pas skrag mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /yum mchog mdzes ldan mthing nag zhal gcig ma/ /phyag g.yas gri gu gdung dmar zhal du stobs5/ /rus pa'i phreng brgyan bskal pa'i wī'od zer 'phro/ /sprul pa grangs med khro chung 'phro la 'dud/ /dri za'i rigs 'dul khro rgyal bdud las rgyal/ /sku yi rang bzhin zhi ba'i las mdzad pa/ /dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi rdo rje 'phyar/ /rtse 25—835

gsum sdigs mdzub gti mug 'joms la 'dud/ /brkyang bskum bzhugs nas na bza' sngon po gsol/ /brang 'gro brgyad kyis sku brgyan mthu stobs can/ /gsung gi nga ros log 'dren gdug pa 'dul/ /rngam mdzad bdud las rgyal byed khyed la 'dud/ /mnyes byed yum ni lha mo 'od zer can/ /dkar mo 'dzum can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ldan/ /sru gri gtso 'khyud dung dmar yab la stobs1 / /khro chung bye 'gyed lha mo khyod la 'dud/ /gshin rje 'dul mdzad yon tan rang bzhin sku/ / rgyas pa'i phrin las mthar phyin sku mdog ser/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhis bdud 'dul rdo rje 'phyar / /dbyug to g.yon 'dzin sdigs mdzub 'khyud khyod 4'dud/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gshin rje gnon 5mdzad 'gying / /brjid sku na bza' sngon po stag ris gsol/ /rigs bzhi 6gdug pas sku brgyan yon tan rgyas/ /sprul pa'i khro 'gyed gzi brjid 'bar khyod 'dud/ /dgyes mdzad lha mo dbyangs can gser mdog zhal//zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri gtso la 'khyud/ /ban+dha khrag bkang yab kyi zhal du stobs—/ /sprul pa grangs med 'gyed mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /klu dbang 'dul mdzad gsung gi rang bzhin sgu/ /dbang gi phrin las mthar phyin sku mdog dmar/ /'gying bag zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum sa bdag gnon/ /rngam chen me ltar 'bar ba khyod la 'dud/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhis rdo rje sbrul zhags bsnams/ /sdigs mdzub 'khyud mdzad gsung gi rngam stabs 3can/ /sbrul rigs bzhis brgyan gos sngon stag ris gsol/ /klu rigs dbang snyud rngam sgra sgogs khyod 'dud/ /mnyes mdzad lha mo dmar mo mdzum trebag can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis te'u 7gtso la 'khyud/ /dung dmar stobs mdzad sprul 25—836

pa'i khro tshogs sprul/ /thabs mkhas sgra can 1yum mchog 'khyud la 'dud/ /gnod sbyin rigs 'dul phrin las rang bzhin sku/ /rtog pa'i phrin las mthar phyin sku mdog ljang / /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mchog phyag mtshan ldan/ /phrin las bzhi mdzad rdo rje be+e con 'dzin/ /sdigs mdzub gnyis mdzad yum la 'khyud khyod 'dud/ /brkyang bskum mdzad pa rigs bzhi'i sbrul gyes brgyan/ /stod g.yogs sngon po stag ris na bza' gsol/ /phrin las thams cad rdzogs mdzad mthu stobs can/ /bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad bdud rtsi 'khyel khyod 'dud / /thod gyur ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /thabs shes tshul ldan 'khor lo gtso la 'khyud4/ /snying rje'i rang bzhin bhan 5dmar yab la stobs / /sprul lnga 'gyed mdzad rlung 'byin sku la 'dud/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'ajigs ston rgyas 'debs ma/ /bdud dang mu stegs skrag 6mdzad snying nas 'dren / /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgog 7dril bu ma/ /bdud dpung 'joms mdzad sgo ma bzhi la 'dud/ /rang gi dad pa'i stobs kyis bskul gyur 8nas / /mos pa'i dbang gis bstod pa 'di byas pa'i/ /bsod nams tshogs gyur sgrib pa gnyis byang nas/ /rgyud shel ltar dag sems can don byed shog /bstod pa mos pa'i rgyud ngan tha ba btul/ /ma rig mun sel dag pa zla zer 'dra//dri med gsal ba gang thob sems can rnams/ /'khor lo chen po'i lha zhal mthong bar shog /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can 'khor lo chen po'i lha tshogs la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ nam gru'i rigs las byung ba / dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon 0dzā ba ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po de ba pūr+ṇa ma ti dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge 25—837

༄/ /rten cing 'aprel par 'byung ba'i srung ba jes bya ba/ 1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra t+ya sa mut+pad su nā ma rak+ṣa/ bod skad du / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i srung dab zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs mthu dang sems can las4/ /bsam gyis mi khyab par bshad pas/ /de bzhin rten 'byel nus pa'i mthu/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pas/ /gnod byed rnams kyi dgrar gyur pa/ /mdor bsdus bdag gis bshad par bya/ /srung byed rnam rgyal a ru ra/ /bcangs sam 5lus la brten pa yis/ /mar me'i snang bas mun sel ltar/ /phyogs su gnas par mi nus so/ /don kun 6grub byed nor bu dang / /de bzhin tshe bsring 7nor bu dang / /in+d+ra bhā la sbur long dang / /rin chen nor bu sna tshogs nor/ /gang zhig lus la 'chang byed pa/ /nor bu'i mthu ni bsam mi khyab / /nyi ma shar sar grib mi gnas/ /de bzhin gdon de mi gnas so/ /25—840

bde gshegs dgra bcom byang chub sems/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor pa yi gdung / /mchod cing bcangs pa tsam gyis ni/ /zhe sdang zhi nas mchod byed 'gyur/ /lnga brgya stong du lon pa yi/ /rmang gi sa 'am thab 1kyi sa/ /sngags btab bskus pa tsam gyis ni/ /dpag tshad bye ba brgya ru 'bros/ /dug dgra'i mkhris pa ma rul ba/ /man ngag gis ni brten byas na/ /klu yi rgyal po 'jog po yis/ /bzung 'u ba yang ni gtong bar 'gyur/ /gser chu dngul chu mu zi yi/ /bcud len la sogs sbyor bas ni/ /gdon de nye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di la ma dad rigs ma yin/ /'bras bu gsum dang j-iṅga ——ra/ /sbrang rtsi mar dang ldan pa dang / /sna tshogs pa yi sman rnams kyi4/ /nus pa brjod kyis 5mi lang bas/ /rtag tu goms par byas pas ni/ /gdon de bzlog 6par 'gyur ba yin/ /ga pur la sogs bdud rtsi lnga/ /rgyun du las la bsten 7pa yis/ /gdon de phyogs su mi nye'o/ /'di yi nus pa bsam mi khyab/ /ga pur dzā ti tsan+dan dang / /gla rtsi gur gum dri 9snalnga ni/ /rtag tu lus la brten pa yis/ /tshor ba tsam gyis bye bar 'bros/ /gu gul la sogs sbyar ba'i spos/ /bcangs sam bdugs pa tsam gyis ni/ /klad pa 'gas shing 'thoms gyur pas/ /skad cig tsam yang mi gnas so/ /gsum lnga bdun dgu lon pa yi/ /shin tu skyur ba'i spyor ba yis/ /me yi phung po'i rtse mo la/ /sbrang bu la sogs mi gnas ltar/ /shin tu 'jigs pas 'bros par 'gyur/ /spyor ba 'di ni bsngags pa yin/ /dgu gsum nyi shu lnga bcu gcig /brgya la sogs pa lon pa yinakho/ /rtsi mar gye 1 ni 'khru sman bzhin/ /mod la de ni 'byung 'gyur ro/ /zla ba'i shel las chu'abyung dang / / nyi ma'i —shel las rnge 'byung ba/ / mi rigs par loni smra 25—841

——min pas/ /de bzhin sna tshogs rten 'byel mthu/ /med pa ru ni mi smra'o/ /mthu ni mngon du 'byung bas na1/ /ma dad pa ni rigs med pas/ /de la yid ches brtan par bzung / /rten 'byel spyor ba bcu gnyis la/ /dad pas/ bla ma mnyes byas te/ /man ngag rim pa blang bar bya/ /mnyes pa yis ni gzhan du min/ /rten 'byel nus pa brjod mi lang / /rang nyid kyis mthong 'ga' tsam smras/ /'di la dge rtsa ci yod pas/ /gdug pa rnams ni srung byed sgog /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i srung ba zhes bya ba/ nam gru'i rigs las byung ba/ dngos grub brnyes pa dzā ba ri'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta de ba pūr+ṇa ma ti dang / lo tsā ba she'u badz+ra de ba'i 'gyur// //25—8//2

༄ / /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gnod sprun drag po chen po rdo rje me lce'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba/ sgo ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhā dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi yak+ṣa ma hā ru dra badz+ra asne dzi hwa tan+t+ra bṛtrī nā ma/ bod skad du/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gnod sbyin drag po chen po rdo rje 2 me lce'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba/'phags pa phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyon mongs skyon gyis ma gos rin chen be+e ḍūr+ya ltar dang zhing rab 'bar ri rab ltar brjid dang / /'gro la rig rdopas myur bar ston dang dh+ri las rab byung stong gsum skrag jepar mdzad pa nyid/ /gdod nas mi rtog zhi ba'i ngang las 5snying rje'i stobs kyis mtha' dag sbud mdzad zhe sdang chen por gsal/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun kyi gsang ba'i mdzod du rab gyur rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid de la phyag 'tshal nas//rgyud kyi rgyal po 'gro don mdzad pa nyid la phyi nang sdug bsngal zhi mdzad gsang ba zab mo'i don/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i stobs las rang byung bdag nyid rab byer 25byed844

drag po de yi bdud rtsi'i 'od zer nges par rab brnyes 1nas/ /dang po'i 2ming la lag na rdo rjes snang ba zhes byar 'jig rten kun las grags pa rab thob ste/ /bdag gis 'grel 'di rnyed dang bkur ste grags pa rlom sems phyir/ /min 'di dran dang 'gro la phan phyir rgyas pa 4bri bar bya/ /de la de kho na nyid snang ba zhes bya ba 'dis rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du bla ma'i man ngag la rag las pa rnams bshad par bya ste/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na zhes bya ba la/e waṃ ma yā'i thubashad pa ni 'og nas rig par bya'o/ /bdag ni snyud pa po nyid du rig par bya ste/ de yis de'i skad cig de nyid la thos pas na thos pa'i dus gcig na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das thams cad 'byung ba'i yum btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs te zhes bya ba la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gar mkhan nyid snga ma'i cha byad rnams yang dag par spangs te bha ga la bzhugs pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i sgras ni za ba phyodang 'joms pa nyid dang ldan par ston to/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i sgras 7ni 'byung ba bzhi'i sa bon rnams nam mkha' la yang dag par brten te gnas pa de'i sa bon gyi gzugs drag po'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs te/de nyid bud med kyi bha ga dang dbyebs mthun pas bha ga la bzhugs so/ /de las 'gro ba rnams byung bas na thams cad byung ba nyid do/ /yang na stong pa nyid las dngos po thams cad 'byung zhing de'i ngang la gnas pas bzhugs so/ /yum ni dngos po rnams bskyed pa'o/ /btsun mo ni bde ba bskyed pa'i rgyu yin te/de dang mthun par stong pa nyid la spyor bas bde ba'i 'bras bu skye'o/ /bha ga'i sgras nges pa'i rtags ston pa'am/ yang na gong ma'i sgra dang mthun par gdug pa rnams 'joms pas na bha ga'o/ /'byung ba dang yum dang btsun mo'i sgra ni 2bye—8/5

—dus rnam pa gsum la'ang 'jug ste/ dus gsum du nges pa'i don bstan pa/ la'ang sbyar ro/ /de na 1gnod sbyin la sogs pa gdug pa'i rigs thams cad dang thabs cig 2ces pa ni ci'i phyir 'dus she na/ de dag 'dul ba'i phyir nyid kyis byin gyi rlabs kyis bkug pa'o/ /de na'i sgras 4ni nyid kyi 5drung na gnas pas thabs cig 6pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das drag po'i skyil mo krung bcas nas zhes pa ni/ drag po rnams bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir zhabs kyi mthil gnyis sbyar nas tshigs gnyis bcag pas bzhugs so/ /phyag g.yas pa steng du bsgreng / g.yon pa sa la bsgreng 7nas spyan bzlog pas phyogs bcur gzigs pa ni gdug pa rnams 'dul ba'i phyir drag po'i phyag rgyar shes pa'o/ /hūṃ dang ha ni sngags su rig par bya ste snyud pa dang 'joms pa'o yang na thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid kyis 'dul bar shes par bya'o/ /sgra cher phyung ba ni lte bas yongs su bskyod pa'o/ /de nas 'khor thams cad gtso bo mi snang bas yun ring zhig tu brgyal bar gyur to zhes bya ba la gong ma'i sngags kyis brgyal ba las phyogs rmongs par gyur te de nyid kyang mi snang ba'o/ /de'i skad cig de nyid la bcom ldan 'das kyis spyi bo nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnang ba zhes bya ba ni dbu'i gtsug tor nas phyung ba la bya ste/ gnang ba ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur bar byas nas gsang ba'i bdag por gnang ba byen te bsgo ba'os/ /sngags rnam pa gsum gye bdag po zhes bya ba nas/ rgya mtshor bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar la sngags rnam pa gsum ni sgu gsung thugs kyi yi ge gsum las sngags thams cad 'byung bas de'i bdag po yin par bstan pa dang / rig 5sngags dang / gsang sngags dang /35—846

gzungs 1sngags gsum gyi bdag po yin par bstan pa'o/ /phyag brnyan zhes pa ni dang po'i tshig la 'jug pa dang 2pho nya yin par bstan pa'o/ /kha dog sngon po'i sgras ni rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs pa nyid dang / nyes pa'i skyon gyes ma gos par bstan pa'o/ /lhag ma ni go sla'o/ /nam mkha' lding gshog pa bskyod nas zhes bya ba nas/ rang gi bdag po'i lag par slar song ngo zhes bya ba'i 'bar la nam mkha' lding gi bdag po'i rgyan blang ba'i phyir rgya mtshor zhugs te / klu rnams kyi gzugs brnyan bsgyur nas sbrul gyis sku la rgyan cha bdun du brgyan pa'o/ /nam mkha' lding yang de nyid kyi byin gyi rlabs 4kyis bskyed pa ste/slar bdag po'i phyag mtshan du gnas pa'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin bye ba phrag bcu dang zhes pa nas/ mdun du snying po dang ldan pa'i skyil mo krung bcas te 'dug go zhes bya ba'i bar du go be+e 5bas 'dir ma bshad do/ /de nyid ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' la rag las par ma gyur pa'i gang zag kha cig na re gnod sbyin dngos yin par 'dod na de ni bka' la rmongs par gyur pas de ltar mi blta'o6 / /de ni lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba dang mthun par rig par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje dngos so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nam mkha' dang sa la gzigs nas bar snang du yang spyan gyis 'khor bar gzigs so zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' dang sa la gzigs pa dang bar snang du yang gzigs pa 8ni phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i gdug pa ma lus nga/ 'dul bar / bstan pa'o/ /de nas khaṃ bye saṃ zhes pa'i sngags brjod pa ni/khaṃ gi snying pos steng gi phyogs su 'dul ba'o/ /bye gyi snying pos 'og gi phyogs su 'dul bar 1 bstan pa'o/ /saṃ gi snying pos phyogs mtshams brgyad po 'dul 25—8(/7
