6〈〈snar 〉par/ 3〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tha/ 8〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉da / bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṇi ya/ nā ga me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da ko/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉25byed953

thig /gnod sprun gyi sgo dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rgya sgrub thabs/1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ti nī lādza 2ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub zuthabs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig 5rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dbus su yi ge hūṃ bsams te/ de'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang sangs rgyas la sogs snang bya ste/ mchod pa bya ba ni dkon mchog gsum zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod nas/byams pa phyedang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang stoms 6bsgom mo/ /de nas rang gi sems rig par bya ste/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma skyes pa ste/rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas bdag med pa sems kyi sprul pa tsam ste/ 'di ltar bsams nas de nyid kyi sngags brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rnam pa lnga mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje bsgom 25—955

par bya ste/ sku mdog nag po yi ge hūṃ las byung ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje 1dril bu bsnams pa/ spyan gsum pa sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ gos sngon bsnams pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ 'dod dgur bsgyur zhuba'i gzugs can/gsang sngags las ji skad brjod pa'i tshul 'dzin par bsgoms rngunas/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te yang dag par mchod nas/ dgug pa dang /4gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / rjes su mnyes par byas la/ lus ngag yid gsum 5byin gyis brlab 9pa dang / phung po dang skye mched lha'i nga rgyal byas te dbang bsgur nas/ yang mchod pa dang bstod pa dang / bdud rtsi myang 7ba la thug pa byas nas/ oṃ m+bi waṃ 5ba ra dha ra ya/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pas skyo na cung zad bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas ldang bar 9'dod na gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te bsngos la/ de nas ye shes kyi lha gshegs su gsol te/ bdag nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas spyod lam bya'o/ /de la rnam pa lngas mngon par byang chub pa bskyed pa ni chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma skyes par bsams shing brjod pas/sems tsam gyi rnam par dmigs te/ sems kyi bdag nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor a yig gi rnam pa can bsgoms la/ oṃ pra ti be sgo 6/ka ro mi zhes brjod pa nas/yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas/ oṃ bo bye tsit+ta ut+yā ⑫ dā yā mi zhes brjod pas5/ ka yig gi rnam pa can gyi zla ba bsgom ⑫mo/ /de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar ba bum pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa bsgoms te/ oṃ nyiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod par bya'o / /rkagasang sngags kyi byin gyi rlabs skye kyis bdag nyid rdo rjer gyur nas/ oṃ badz+ra āt+pa kophomehaṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /25—956

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam pa'i 'od zer bsdus pa'i sbyor ba byas pas/ ji skad du brjod pa'i dpal phyag na rdo rjer gyur par byas la/ ya thā badz+ra dha ra shā a haṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /sngon du gnas bskyed par 'dod pa rnams kyis stong pa nyid las bka'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa rab tu 'bar ba bsams te/dbus su khro bo gnod mdzes rgyal po/ rtsibs rnams la khro bo bcu rim rmebazhin bsams te/ hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod pas khro bo bcu'i 'od zer gyis gdug pa can thams cad bkug ste sku gsung thugs kyi phur pa btab pas khro bo bcu'i 'od zer gyis rmye thams cad btul zhing sbyangs te nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid du gyur par bya'o//de nas yang nam mkha' la ram̐ nyi ma byel gnas pa'i hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyis rdo rje ra ba dang sa gzhi dang dra bas bskor ba'i dkyil du khang pa brtsegs ④pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de yang kha cig ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni peri rab la thug gi bar du rim pa bzhin bskyed nas de yongs su gyur pa las khang pa brtsegs spyopa bya zhes 'dod do/ /kha cig ni ri rab kyi steng na khang pa brtsegs 7pa zhes hūṃ 'dod do/ /kha cig ni chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dkyil du bskyed par 'dod do/ /'dir ji ltar 'dod pa /—bzhin bskyed par bya'o/ /de yang /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /twa ra na bzhis mdzes par byas/ /dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa skye la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi kyesteng du rnam pa lngas mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pas sku bskyed par bya'o / /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang ba'i sngags ni dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya bas dgug pa la sogs pa temanyes pa la thug par bya'o/ /de la byin gyis brlab pa khams dang skye mched dag par bya ba ni rigs gsum dang rigs lnga'i rang 25—957

bzhin du'o/ /dbang bskur ba ni mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /mchod pa rnams ni 1 phyi rol dag gis te phyi rol gyi mchod pa rnams ni ar+gha dang me tog la sogs rang gi ming gi dang po dang / tha ma'i phyag dang bcas pas dbul bar bya'o / /bstod pa ni ming lnga'i sh+lau ka gcig na/gam/ ming bcu pa'am ming 'ubargya rtsa brgyad pa la sogs pas bstod pa bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i ④dus sku gsung thugs kyi lha dang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar gdan dang mtshan ma ji lta ba bzhin bsams te/ rang gi sa bon kyis snyematshan par byu byas la/ brten nas gsang sngags kyi phreng ba rab tu 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa spro ba dang bsnyu bar bya'o/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor hūṃ gis mtshan pa sngags kyi phreng ba can no/ /slar gshegs su gsol ba ni sa bon snying po'am de nyid gsum gyi sngags muḥzhes bya ba dang ldan pa'o/ /lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa'i man ngag rdzogs so//3 //25—958

gos sngon po can gyi grub thabs/①༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ti 1nī dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha sna/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das mthu stobs kyi bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs gdung ba sel mdzad pa'i/ /zla ba lta bu'i mthu mnga' ba'i/ /thams cad sel zhing snang bar byed/ /mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las mtha'i rtsod pa'i dus su ni/ /las ngan rtsod pa zhes shebyed pa/ /nyi ma lta bu'i 'od zer ni/ /bdag gis phan phyir bshad par bya/ /las kyi dbang gis mi mthun pa'i/ /nad la sogs pa sna tshogs 'byung / /de nyid 'joms byed mthu yi mchog /gsang sngags 'khor lo bshad par bya/ /dang por snod rnams bstan jepa'i phyir/ /slob dpon sgrub po gnyis su dbye/ /shes rab snying rje ldan pa dang / /dam tshig sdom pa 25—960

gnas pa dang / /snod rnams dbye ba'i rim shes dang / /'gro don phan sems brtson pa dang / /dbang rnams rdzogs shing man ngag thob/ /rgyud don gzhan rnams shes pa dang / /pha rol phyin pa'i don la mkhas/ /bden pa rnam gnyis gtan la 'be+ebs①/ /nyon mongs chung zhing sems rnams thul/ /lus ngag yid gsum spyod lam mkhas/ /dus dang gnas skabs dbye ba shes/ /bya dang mi bya'i rim pa dang / /gnang dang dgag pa'i rim brtson rnams/ /shes pa de ni slob dpon nyid/ /dad ldan bla ma la ni gus/ /g.yo sgyu khyemed pa'i bsam pa yis/ /rdzas dang lus srog 'bul byed dang / /yang nas 1yang du gsol 'debs pa/ /spyod lam la sogs mdzes pa yis/ /dus rim ce du ni 'khor byed pa/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas pa yinabye/ /gus pas zhabs la phyag byed pa/ /slob mar zhugs kyi shes par bya/ /phyag rgya mchog ni don du gnyer/ /mi rnams kun gyes dben pa yi/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gnas dag tu/ /yo byad rdzas rnams 'tshogs pa yis/ /dag pa ⑥la sogs sngon 'gro bas/ /yid gnyis med pa'i brtson 'grus ldan/ /gus pas man ngag bdud rtsi 'di/ /glegs bam la ⑨ni brten pa brtsamasaldu/ /nges pa'i man ngag bdud rtsi 'di/ /rna brgyud 'ongs kye te thugs la gnas/ /zhal gyi sgo ru bton nas kyang / /de bzhin sgrub pos blang bar bya/ /thabs kyi spyor ba mkhas pa yis/ /dang po dus su rdzogs pa dang / /rim bzhin lnga yi bar du blang / /de ltar blangs pa'i don shes na/ /gang 'dod pa yi don rnams 'grub/ /rgyud sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba yi/ /de lta bu yi don shes pas/ /sgrub po zhes ni 0btags pa yin⑪//sgrub pa po ni de dag kyang / /shes rab snying rje che brtson ni/ /dang po bla ma 25—961

bsten ①gyur nas/ /de nas rang nyid 'jug par 'gyur/ /yang na de tsam mi ldan yang / /yul dang dus kyis bskal gyur na/ /cha rkyen rdzogs par tshang dgos pas/ /bla ma la ni gus pa yis/ /skyob byed mthu rnams mi 'dra bas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mthu ldan pa/ /nges par shin snetu rdzogs par bya/ /de rnams dgos pa'i bstan pa ni3/ /dper na dpa' bo g.yul zhugs na/ /go rnams rdzogs par ma gyur pas/ /mtshon gyis phog ste be+er log ltar/ /de bzhin bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen yang / /ma tshang slar la ldog nyan ④yod/ /yang na mthu rnams bsam mi khyab/ /sman gyi mthu rnams ji bzhin te/ /gang la gang 'phrod las dang rkyen/ /mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya/ /de yi don rnams shes bya ba/ /bde gshegs sras po mkhas pas su/ /rgyud du bya ba brgyad ces bya / /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob byed pa'i/ /bskyed rdzogs shes pa'i gtso bo yis/ /de yi yan lag 'khor bshad pa/ /tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg gtor chen po/ /'khrul 'khor las rnams phran tshegs sogs/ /de rnams las rnams thams cad rdzogs/ /dam tshig nyams pa cher byung na/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor bzhengs gsol phyir/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga shes par bya/ /de ma nus pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas pa la/ /brten nas sdig bshags cho ga bya'o/ /dam tshig nyams pa chen po dang / /dang po dbang yang thob pa'i phyir/ /dbang mchog cho ga shes par bya/ /bar chod myur du byung ba na/ /stang stabs bgegs bskrad shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor 'chi ba'i rtags byung na/ /'chi bslu'i cho ga shes par bya/ /yid ches brod pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan shes par bya/ /de kun rtsa ba'i dam tshig 25—962

yin / /①bzlas brjod byas pas don rnams 'grub/ /bdud rtsi la sogs rdzas rnams ni/ /sgrub thabs sbyor thabs mkhas pas su/ /lus sogs las su rung bar bya/ /de ltar cha rkyen tshang ba yis/ /phyag rgya'i mchog ni don du gnyer / /dngos grub phran tshegs zhar las thu'abyung / /de ltar gdeng ldan rnal 'byor gyis/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gnas dag tu/ /tshes grangs bzang 1po shis pa la/ /chos skyong srung dum la sogs la/ /bsgo zhing bgegs rnams zhi bar byed/ /yi dam lha dang slob dpon dang / /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi spyan snga ru / /dam bca' byas te bsgrub ⑤par bya'o/ /yi ge brgya sogs cho ga yis/ /nyes pa kun ni sbyangs nas kyang / /sa gzhi legs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog legs par bkram/ /phyi nang mchod pa'i rdzas rnams kun/ /bsags te ma lus rgyan rnams dgramabu/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gyur pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i glegs bam de/ /rin chen na bza' mdzes byas la /ston pa mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /gsung gi rtags su gzhag par bya/ /'bur ram lugs sam ris su bris/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i sku mchog de/ /sku yi rtags su gzhag par bya/ /rdo rje dril sogs phyag mtshan rnams/ /lugs dang mthun pa'i mdzes pa de/ /thugs kyi rtags su gzhag par bya/ /de dag kun la don dam du/ /rab tu gnas pa med mod kyang / /yang dag kun rdzob nyid du ni/ /rgyal ba lhums zhugs ji bzhin no/ /de ltar byin rlabs ④mthu chen pa//ci byas thams cad rdzogs chen 'gyur/ /de bas brtson 'grus bskyed de bya/ /gal te rnal 'byor dbul gyur na/ /thams cad mos pa'i spyod yul nazu/ /dbul bar ma gyur ser sna yis/ /sogs ⑨par de ni mi byed par/ /chos dang 25—963

mi mthun spyod pa yinahūṃ/ /de bas gus pas brtson 'grus bya/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams kyis duni/ /bskyed dang rdzogs la brten bya ste/ /dang po bskyed pa'i tshul rnams ①ni/ /skad cig sprul dang cho ga lnga/ /gsum gyi tshul du bstan pa dang / /gnyis las 'byung byed tshul dang ni/ /gcig la 'jug pa'i tshul gyis su/ /cho ga'i rim par ④shes par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i gnyis su bstan pa la/ /thabs kyi tshul gyis 'jug pa dang / /shes rab tshul gyis 'jug pa po//thabs kyis 'jug pa'i tshul rnams ni/ /brgyad dkyil dgu yi bdag po la/ /man ngag stobs kyis 'jug pa dang / /bcu drug bzhi yi bdag dkyil la/ /sbyor phyoba'i thabs kyis 'jug pa dang / /de dang de las khyad par 'phags/ /shin tu bskor ba'i gnas dag tu/ /rim pa bzhin du 'jug pa dang / /dang po 'byung byed gnas dag tu/ /tha ma cig shos ④'byung ba la/ /mgal me'i 'khor lo bskor ba yis/ /rim sogs man ngag shes par bya/ /shin tu 'jam pa'i stan dag la/ /rnal 'byor ci bder gnas nas ni/ /snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sa bon spros pas lha rnams gsal/ /bla ma mi ⑦bskyod gzugs 'dzin pa/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la/ /dang po lus ngag gus pa yis/ /phyag 'tshal zhabs la reg par bya/ /phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod rnams/ /rim pas phul nas sdig pa bshags/ /sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas la sogs bde ba la/ /dga' ba bskyed de rjes yi rang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'gro ba'i don du gsol ba gdab/ /dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi/ /lus kyang gus par dbul bar bya/ /sems bskyed lam la gnas par bya/ /phyag rgya mchog tu 25—964

gzung ①bar bya/ /be+er yang sdom pa brtan par gzung / / tshad med bzhi yang bsgom par bya/ /①dag par byed pa'i sngags brjod pas/ /mtha' dag stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /yod pa ma yin med pa min/ /snang ba ma yin 'gag me+ed ①min/ / skye ba ma yin 'gag pa min/ / rgyade la sogs pa'i tshig rnams kyis—/ /mtshon te stong nyid gtan la dbab/ /stong nyid dngos po'i gnas tshul ni/ /gang du'ang bsam du med mod kyang / /ma rtogs log rtogs ⑤the chom can/ /de rnams bsal ba'i don ched du/ /skye med ⑥'gag med la sogs brjod/ /de las stong pa'i ngang las ni/ /'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rim brtsegs 'phros/ /de steng sum̐ las byung ba las/kye/ /ri rab chen bo bskyed par bya/ /de steng hūṃ las rdo rje ni/ /rgya gram ljang gu'i dkyil du ni/ /sa bon 'od zer las 'phros pas/ /gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu bskyed/ /ska da cig rdzus skyes tshul du ni/ /dbus kyi gtso bos khro bcu bskyed/ /hūṃ bzhi gsang sngags brjod pa yis/ /bka' bsgo bas ni sprul pa 'phros/ /gdug pa can ni ma lus bkug /rdo rje phur bu'i sngags brjod pas/ /shin tu khros pas sprul nas ni/ /brdeg pa'i sngags kyis btab nas ni/ /brdung ba'i sngags kyis brdung bar bya'o/ /me dpung tshogs kyis thal bar bsregaldu /nam mkha'i mthas klas tshun chad du/ /khro bo rnams kyi nang logs su/ /rdo rje gur dang ra ba gtams/ /rdo rje gur gyi nang logs su/ /gzhal yas khang ni mdzes par ⑨bskyed—/ /de steng pad+ma 'dab brgyad gdan/ /lte bar nyi zla'i gdan ni brtsegs—/ /gdan dang rgyan rnams kun ni rdzogs/ /mngon par byang chub cho ga yis/ /gtso bo'i sku ni bskyed par bya/ /dang po stong dang zla ba la/ /yig 25—965

—'bru la sogs cho ga rdzogs/ /rdo rje la ni byin rlabs khyebasdu/ /sngags brjod pas ni sku bskyed do/ /gtso bo sku mdog mthing nag dhini/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /mche ba gadzigs pa 'dod dgur bsgyurasne/ /sku la sbrul byi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum 'byung po 'dul/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje khro bo bsdams/ /g.yon nas ④mkha' lding rgyal po spro/ /gtso bo de ltar bskyed nas ni/ /shar gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /rnam rgyal sku mdog dmar po ste//phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje 'dzin/ /g.yon pas rjodagra sta 'dzin pa ste/ /bar ma phyag gnyis gung mo dang / /mthe bong ngos mdung gzhan rnams brkyang / /de nyid snying gar bzung nas ni/ /de 'og zhags pa ral gri bsnams/ /lho yi pad+mar mgon po ni/ /sku mdog nag bo zhal gcig pa/ /phyag kyang de bzhin gnyis pa ste/ /g.yas g.yon tsan+dan bing chen bsnams/ /nub kyi pad+mar lus ngan po/ /sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis mchod rten ṣ+pe'u le bsnams—/ /byang gi pad+mar bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig pa//phyag gnyis brang bsdol sdigs mdzub 'phyar/ /shar lho'i 'dab mar gnod spyin tsabaskyed / /sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis gri gug cang te'u bsnams/ /lho nub 'dab mar ro langs ma/ /sku mdog sngo skya zhal gcig pa / /phyag na rdo rje lcags sgog bzung / /gung mo srin lag la sogs rnams/ / dam por bkug nas yongs su bsdams/ /krumatheb mdzub bzhi rnams rab brkyang nas/ /spyi bor nges par bsnol ba rnams/ /nub byang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma / /sku mdog dmar skya zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis spyi bor sbyar nas su/ /me lce phreng ba yongs su 'dzin/ /byang shar mtshams kyi 'dab ma la/ /'jigs 25—966

byed kha dog sngo nag ma/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis pa/ /g.yas kyi dang pos ①glang po bsnams/ /g.yon gyis glang chen pags dhipa bsnams/ /de 'og dgra sta rdo rje bsnams/ /tha ma mi mgo lcags kyu bsnams/ /gru chad bzhi la lha mo bzhi/ /'od skyed ma ni sku mdog dkar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje bsnams/ /yid 'phrog ma ni sku mdog ser/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spos phor bsnams/ /kun bzang ma sku mdog dmar mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ro mchog bsnams/ /glu sgra can sku mdog sngon po①/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgra snyan gar/ /shar sgor khro mo srog gcod ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing / /phyag gnyis thod pa ④zhags pa bsnams/ /lho sgor dbugs rngub sku mdog ser/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis hom phyogazar zhags/ /nub sgor khrag 'thung sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug zhags/ /byang sgor sha za sku mdog sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rnon po zhags/ /de rnams bskyed pa'i tshul rnams kyang / /rnal 'byor spros dga'i ⑥ sems byang phyir/ /sa bon dag las ④'od 'phros pas/ /so so'i ④thugs kyi mtshan ma'i rtags/ /dang po gsungs te gsum pa dgu/ /las kyi 'khor lo myur brtson pa/ /bskyed pa'am skad drug glog 'gyu'i tshul/ /cung zhig gsal bar bltas nas ni/ /sngags kyi cho ga shes pas su/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor /zubacas pa rkyernams/ /sri zhu gus pa'i tshul gyis su/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas/ /mdun gyi mkha' la bzhugs su gsol/ /mchod yon la sogs dbul bar bya/ /gnod sbyin drag po'i sngags kyis ni/ /bgegs rnams ma lus bzlog par bya/ /rnam par rtog pa spang ba dang / /lus ngag nus pa mthu bskyed phyir/ /lha rnams 25—967

so sor bstem rmye par bya/ /yi ge rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /dag byed sku gsung cho gar ldan/ /dang por gsol 'debs cho ga yis/ /mchog rnams kun du bskul bas su/ /bde gshegs thams cad mnyes nas kyang / /lha mo glu len gar byed mas/ /bdud rtsi'i ②bum pa thogs nas kyang / /rim bzhin dbang ni bskur bar byas/ /so so'i rigs kyi lha 'dzin 'gyur/ /mchog rnams kun du bsgul bas su/ /bde gshegs thams cad mnyes nas kyang / /slob dpon mi bskyod yab yum la/ /gnyis dang gsum gyi man ngag blang / /de nas lha la mchod pa dbul/ /phyi mchod nang mchod gsang ba'i mchod/ /mchod pa tshul bzhin dbul bar bya/ /phyi ni ji bzhin gzhan dang mthun/ /nang gi 3lha yi bde bskyed pa/ /cig shos lnga ru byas pa yin/ /rtag thupa ldan pa de dag ni/ /gtso bo lnga yang byas pa ⑤yin/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yis/ /gnyis pa la sogs sbyar ba dang / /des ni dang po'i don kyang bya/ /rigs dang rtags ni ldan gyur pa'i/ /de nyid snying bo de las ⑥byung / /de dang dur khrod byung ba yinalpi/ /snang ba med pa mchog bye yin no/ /lnga dang bcu ru sbyar ba yi—/ /yid du 'ong ba dpag med mchog /de ni nang gi don bstan to/ /gu khya don ni bstan bya ba/ /grol dang phyag rgya gnyis su bstan/ /grol gyis yid kyi gzugs sprul to/ /phyag rgya rtags ldan dngos su 'jug /mi ldan byin gyis brlab ⑨par bya/ /de rnams cho ga'i yan lag ni/ /rten dang brten pa'i tshul nyid kyis/ /dang por byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /rten ni as su byen gyis brlab / /brten pa hūṃ gis byin gyis brlab/ /rten dang brten pa'i gtso bo dang / /yan lag rnams la lha rnams kyis/ /byin gyis brlab pa bstem par bya//25—968

dharma e yi nang shed du/ /gsum rtsa ma yi dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rin chen pho brang nang shed du/ /rtag pa nyid kyang bsam par bya/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi ⑫thabs shes rab/ /lnga lnga yis ni gnas su bstan/ / bskyed cing dgyed ②par byed pa nyid/ /de yi grogs 'gyur gnyis dang bzhi/ /'byed tsa/ par byed dang smrod bupar byed/ /spro bar byed dang snyud par byed/ /de nyid spro bar byed pa yi/ /bde dang shin tu bde ba ni/ /khyad par mchog tu gyur pa ni/ /gsang don mchog tu spro ba'o/ /gnyis med spro ba'i 'od zer sogs/ /de sogs cho ga rgyas par bya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu ldan pa yis/ /rdo rje glu dang ldan pas bstod/ /hūṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor pho brang mchog /sgu gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /mthun pa'i don rnams ston mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje mi 'gyur 'jigs byed pa/ /khams gsum rgyal bar byed pa'i mchog /dpal ldan nag po yon tan mchog /gsung gi sgra sgrogs rgyal po mchog /phrin ⑤las rang bzhin bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /'byung po 'jigs byed gnod sbyin mchog /dgra la rngams bupa'i za byed ma/ /rdo rje nam mkhar 'gro ba'i mchog /'jigs par ④byed pa'i sku 'chang ma/ /'od kyis gsal byed mdzes pa'i mchog /yid du 'ong ba'i yon tan ma/ /lta spyod bzang bar byed pa'i mchog /sgra dang gar gyis mnyes mdzad ma/ /rnam par rtog pa gcod pa'i mchog /'byung po zhal du rngub byed ma/ /chags pa'i mdog can khrag 'thung ma/ /sa bdag dang ni dri za'i mchog /lha yi 'khor lo tshogs rnams la/ /bstod cing gus pas phyag kyang 'tshaladu// /drag po 'jigs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bstod cing gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstod cing mchod 25—969

pa'i man ngag ni/ /nyid kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las①/ /sprul nas nyid la mchod par bya/ /'khor lo gzhan rnams kyang ni mchod/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ /dang po gtso bo bstan ①byas la/ /de nas 'khor lo rim gyis bstanakhye / /gtso bo rim gyis bstan pa dang rjo/ /'khor lo rim gyis bstan 5pa dang / /rdzogs par lta ba gnyis su bya/ /dang por dbyug tshod byed tsam la//de 'og dbyug tshod gcig butsam la/ /de 'og 'pho ba gcig tu bya/ /thun tshod rnams kyang rim gyis ④so/ /de ltar brtan par gyur nas ni/ /che bar 'dod na che bar ro/ /chung bar 'dod na chung ba nyid/ /mang por spros nas nyung bar basbu/ /nyung bar sdud ④nas mang por spro/ /kha dog ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /ldang ba yang zhing gzi brjid ldan/ /yun ring btang yang mi 'chor la/ /rlang ⑨yang ji ltar 'dod par thub/ /bdud rtsi zas kyis 'tsho bar byed/ /des su bskyed pa mthar phyin te/ /bskyed pa mthar phyin dus su miskyo/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi mdzad spyod ston/ /mdzad spyod bstan pa'i dus dag tu/ /mdzad spyod bstan pa'i las rnams bstan/ /de dus gsal zhing gsal gyur nas/ /yang nas yang du brtag par bya'o/ /man ngag zab mo don ston pa/ /gus pas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /de ru bzlog pa'i don ston yang / /mi 'jigs the tshom med pas su/ /man ngag bdud rtsi blang bar bya'o/ / gal te bskyed tse/pas skyo gyur na/ /bsgom pa ma nus las gzhan phyir/ /bzlas brjod man ngag rgyas pa rnams/ /gzhan du bstan pa mang mod kyang / /bzlas brjod man ngag bdud rtsi 'di/ /rin chen lta bu'i gang zag la/ /rna ba brgyud de 'ong ba spyo'adi/ /bstan par bya yis gus par 25—970

nyon—/ /snying ga'i 'khor lo'i man ngag la/ /sems dpa' gsum kyi '-iman ngag rdzogs/ /'od zer dkar po 'ja' tshon tshul/ /yi ge 'phro ba'i man ngag dgod—/ /'khor zhing spros pas gyen du spros/ /lce yi rdo rje rtse mo las lha yi zhal du spro bar bya/ /mchod de ②gnas ni gang 'dod nas/ /slar la 'khod pas sgrib pa sbyang / /sgra cher ma yin sgra chung min/ /yan lag ma nyams bzlas brjod byasde/ /de ni phyi yi tshul du bstan/ /nang gi bzlas brjod bstan pa ni/ /a wa dhū butī'i nang shed nas/ /kha dog lnga ldan rlung byung ste/ /de nyid rta yi tshul du bstan/ /phyir 'byung rta la oṃ ni zhon/ /nang du zhon pa phyehūṃ yin no/ /gnas par byed pa k+ṣiṃnyid yin/ /de ltar spro zhing bsnyu ba la/ /dang por bcu la bstan par bya/ /de nas nyi shu la bstan no/ /de ltar gyur pa'i rim pa'i mthar—/ /nang gi rim gyis ⑥bsnyu bar bya'o/ /snying ga'i thig le'i gnas dag la/ /'dzin par nus so mchog yin no/ /de nyid gtan la dbab na ni/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya ni/ /nyin mtshan gcig la rgyu ba yin/ /de yang gnas kyi sde tshan bsdu dze+eb ni/ /dang por bcu drug gnyis par ni/ /sum cu ru ni shes par bya/ /bcu drug bcu gnyis brgyad du bsnyu/ /bzhi dang gnyis su bsdu ba'o/ /phyir phyung sgo yis sde'abyed tshul ni/ /g.yas dang g.yon dang gnyis ka yang / /shin tu phra ba'i tshul du byed/ /me dang rlung dang sa dang ni/ /chuyi rang bzhin dmar dang sngo/ /ser dang dkar ba nyid du 'dod/ /pad+ma las dang rin chen dang / /rdo rje thabs dang shes rab ni/ /de yi nus pa de ltar snang / /dang po 'byung byed gnas dang ni/ /longs spyod chos dang sprul pa dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'dod/ /de yang bsdu na gnyis su snang / /25—971

gso bar byed pa srog 'dzin yin/ /phyi dang nang gis ①zhes kyang bya/ /'chi byed cha rnams ma nyams par/ /rnam pa gnyis su bstan pa yin/ /de ltar spyod pa la sogs rnams/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs yin pas na/ /sngon du 'gro ba shin tu gces/ /bzlas pa'i don la mi 'jug gi/ /yang na sngon du song ba yis/ /rdzogs pa'i don la 'jug par bya/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs bstan pa ni/ /rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub sems/ /de yi spros pas ma bstan yang / /basbus pa'i don ni gsung du 'dus/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo gnas dag tu / /rtsa yi 'dab ma brgyad yin te/ /de yi dbus su dhū tī gnas/ /de yi dkyil na 'od kyi ni/ /kha dog lnga ldan dkyil shes ②nas/ /thig le'i rang bzhin byang chub sems/ /bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid la ni mu stegs kyis/ /log par rtogs rngupas bdud du 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog gis ni/ /de nyid nges par rtogs ④pas su/ /dngos grub rnam nyid de las 'byung / /de bas rnal 'byor nan tan gyis/ /bla ma mnyes par byas nas kyang / /bla ma'i zhal gyi sgo nas ni/ /de nyid man ngag shes par bya/ /kha dog lnga ldan de nyid la/ /dang po brtan par bltas ⑤ nas ni/ /de nas rtags rnams byung ba dang / /thig le nyid la brtan par bya/ /de la brtan nas spro ba dang / /bsdu ba'i sbyor ba shes par bya/ /de nyid brtan par gyur pa na—/ /bde dang shin tu bde ba dang / /bde ba chen po thob par 'gyur/ /de 'og nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la/ /zhag bdun bar du gnas pa 'byung / /bdud rtsi 'dom gang lus khyab pas/ /bdud rtsi zas ⑦kyis gso bar byed/ /de 'og sgyu ma lta bu yis/ /dpe brgyad dag la bltas pas su/ /de nyid nges 25—972

par thugs su chud/ /de 'og stong pa'i man ngag la/ /man ngag stobs kyis zhugs pas su/ /de nyid kho nar nges par mthong / /de nas 'gro ba gzhan don la/ /mos pa ma yin dngos su ni/ /'jug pa'i stobs dang ldan par gyur//nyin mtshan phrugs re dag la yang / /bde gshegs mang pos lkudakyil 'khor ston//de yi man ngag don rnams ni/ /ma lus shes par 'gyur ba yin/ /de ltar gzhan don mthar phyin pas/ /rang don lhun grub phyag rgya'i mchog /skad cig gcig la shes par bya/ /phyag rgya dang ni phyag rgya'i mchog /khyad par phyag rgya mchog rnams ni/ /rim pa bzhin du 'grub pa ste/ /sras po'i ②tshul ni rdzogs nas kyang / /yab kyi don ni rdzogs pa yin/ /de ltar rdzogs pa'i man ngag ni/ /rnal 'byor grol lam pa la bstan/ /phyag rgya'i lam la 'jug tshul ni//rtags dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya ma/ /rtags dang ldan par btsal bar bya/ /de la brten nas ye shes ni/ /skye ba thabs kyi man ngag kyang / /dang por byin rlabs snel sogs bya/ /de nas man ngag thun tshod dang / /gzung ba'i thabs ni shes par bya/ /de la brten par gyur nas ni/ /dngos grub kyang ni thob par 'gyur/ /de la mngon par zhen chags na/ /mchog ni 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de yi zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /nang gi phyag rgya nyid la babe+eb④/ /de la brtan par gyur nas ⑤ni/ /de yi zhen pa bzlog blupa'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i phyag rgya gtum mo'i mchog /de nyid la ni bslab ⑦pa'i phyir/ /'khor lo la sogs rdzogs byas la/ /dang po 'byed 'dzums 'byor pa 3dīyis thabs kyi rim pa bslab par bya/ /dmar po chen po spros shes la/ /rtags rnams rim pa lnga po 'byung / /de 'og spro bsnyu'i sbyor ba yis/ /dgug dang mnan 25—973

—pa'i rim pa yang / /dang po babe+ebs nas 'di la bstan/ /de la ldog hu7par ma gyur na/ /'di ru bzlog pa'i man ngag bstan/ /de 'og lhan cig skyes ma yin/ /man ngag stobs la zhugs pa yis/ /nam mkha'i bdud rtsi 'khor 'o/ ni / /rim pa bzhin du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas rten med rnal 'byor ma//de nyid la ni 'jug par bya/ /yod dang med pa'i mtha' sogs kyi/ /rtog pa thams cad 'jig ④pa'i mchog /kun du bzang po'i don rtogs 'gyur/ /de ltar rtog 5pa'i man ngag ni/ /shes rab snying rje ldan pa dang / /bla ma la gus brtson 'grus ldan/ /g.yo sgyu med pa'i bsam pa yis/ /yid du 'ong ba'i rdzas kyi mchog /'bul bar byed pa bstan par bya/ /'di ni rin chen gang zag yin / /dang po man ngag thob bya'i phyir/ /g.yo sgyu'i bsam pa ldan pas su/ /shin tu gus pas tshul du byed/ /man ngag thob par gyur nas ni/ /bla ma la ni rgyab kyis phyogs/ /dmyal ba yi ni rgyu sogs pa/ /de ni rgyun du spong ba yin/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan nas ni/ /skabs 'dir srung 'uba'i 'khor lo ni/ /srung 3ba'i 'khor lor bstan pa yin/ /dur khrod kyi ni ras dag dul/ /'khor lo'i rim pa brtsam 1pa yin/ /de med gyur na gro ga 'am/ /shing shun dag las ⑫bya ba yin/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bris nas ni/ /dbus su snying po'i don bstan la/ /phyogs su bzhi po don ni bstan/ /mtshams ni 'grub par byed pa yin/ /'khor lo rtsibs kyi mtshams su ni/ /gang yin pa yi ming rnams ni/ /phyi rol mu khyud bzang po la/ /thabs dang shes rab yi ge dgod/ /de ltar 'khor lo brtsams nas ni/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod pa la sogs bshams⑨/ /bdag nyid rnal 'byor rdzogs byas la/ /de yang lha yis mu'akhor lo bskyed/ /25—974

ye shes lha la mchod byas la/ /gsol ba btab ste gnyis su bsre/ /de nas bsrung ba'i sngags bzlas bya/ /so so'i rtsa ba'i ⑫sngags 'di la/ /bar du ming rnams bcug nas ni/ /de nas bsrung ba'i sngags gdags bya/ /sngags rnams kyang ni bstan bya ste/ /oṃ na mo nī waṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa se nā nga/ ta ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tram̐ lokya bi dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra be+e stita li hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā tī ya hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra dzhai zhur ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bid ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma ④mo lteha ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ sa man+ta bha dri ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shap+ta gī ti spyoya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra ti sa ta mi ya hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ sho sa ga pa ye /3hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra 3ga ta pri ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma sa bhak+ṣi ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ — dze+e kyeb ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṅkaṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni drag po'i sngags bsdus pa'o/ /swā hā zhes pa ni zhi ba'i'o/ /oṃ zhes pa ni rgyas pa'i 'o/ /ho zhes pa ni dbang gi'o/ /rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pa ni bsrung ba'i 'o/ /bsrung ba'i sngags ni 'di dag la/ /bar du ming ni gzhug par bya/ /srung /3ba'i 'khor lo de dag kyang / /bzhi tshan bzhi yis bsrung ba dang / /gtso bo nyid dang bcas te bsrung / /yang na sde tshan so sor bsrung / /gtso bo gcig pus bsrung ba yin/ /yang na so sor re res kyang / /bsrung ba'i cho ga shes par bya/ /thams cad kun gyis bsrung ba yi/ /'khor lo bca' ba'i thabs bstan pa/ /dang po 'khor lo brgyad pa la/ /rim pa gnyis pa bcu gnyis dang / /de 'og rim pa bcu drug pa'o/ /mtha' ma mu khyud gnyis dang ldan/ /dang po gtso bo'i rim pas dgod/ /de 'og sde tshan gnyis pa dgod/ /tha ma 25—975

—sde tshan gnyis su bstan/ /mu khyud zlum po gnyis la ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi yi ge 'god 4/ /'khor lo rim pa mi 'dra'i gzhung / /rnam pa gsum du shes par bya/ /zhi bar bya dang dbang du bsdu/ /rgyas dang drag sogs gzhan dag kyang / /man ngag gis ni sbyor zhes bya'o/ /las bzhi yi ni 'khor lo la/ /bzlas pa khri tsho gcig gis 'grub/ /de yang bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yis/ /bsrung ba la sogs gzhan dag la/ /de ltar bzlas na mchog tu bstan/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzlas kyang / /sngags kyi nus pa mthu rnams kyis/ /bsrung dang bskyab pa — 'grub par gsungs me/ /lha yi 'khor lo 'di nyid la/ /brten na cho ga gzhan dag ni/ /thams cad kun la 'grub par gsungs/ /de ltar 'khor lo'i man ngag sogs/ /gab pa'i don dang sbas pa'i don/ /dgongs pa'i don dang dgra bzlog don/ /rnam ④brgyud 'ongs pa la brten nas/ /man ngag can gyis shes par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor bsdus pa'i don ched du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar gyur ram/ /las rnams gzhan la 'jug 'dod pas/ /bcu bdun lha yi dkyil 'khor las/ /bcu gsum dag tu bsdu ba /medang / /de la dgu ru basbu ba dang / /lnga ru yang ni bsdu bar bya/ /gnyis su basbu ba bcu drug tshogs/ /yang na rgyan cig rnal 'byor gyis/ /bcu bdun du yang shes par bya/ /de ltar bsnyen pa sngon song bas/ /phan gdags pa dang tshar bcad pa'o/ /las dang sgrub pa thams cad la/ /nges par 'jug par shes par bya'o/ /sbyor ba'i cha rkyen gzhan dag kyang / /dus skabs sbyar te shes par bya/ /de 9ltar the tshom med gyur na/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rtags ston pas/ /de la sogs pa'i las rnams ni/ /bsgrims te shes par ma byas na/ /rnal 25—976

'byor pa ni brlag par 'gyur/ /de bas mkhas pas nan tan du/ /sngags kyi lta ba spyod pa ni/ /bla ma mkhas la mnyan par gyis/ /mi mkhas tshul 'chos g.yon can gyis/ /gnyi ga brlag ste dmyal bar lhung / /mkhas pa rna brgyud thos khyapa ni/ /'di dang pha rol gnyis su yang / / bdag dang gzhan ni gnyi ga yang / / bu'abras bu bzang po nges par 'byin rjo/ /de bas bla ma mkhas pa ni//dang po nyid du btsal bar bya/ /man ngag can ni rnyed nas kyang / /tshul 'chos g.yon can phyir 'byeng na/ /ngal ba don med 'bras bu med/ /las ngan dus kyi tha ma la/ /gang zag 'dod pa'i dbang gis ni/ /lta spyod sna tshogs ston pa 'byung / /gsang sngags dngos grub ma thob par/ /sgra dang mtshan ④ ma la brten nas/ /nga rgyal 'dod pa'i dbang gyur nas/ /gsang sngags 'khor lo rtsom pa 'byung / / de nas 'ayang dag don mi rnyedasnye / /la la myu stegs dag dang bsre/ /des ni dmyal ba'i gnas su khrid/ /gsang sngags 'khor lo 'di dag la/ /de lta'i spyod pa ma byung yang / /mthu rnams je chung je chung 'byung / /nad dang mu ge la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /las ngan dus kyi tha ma la/ /slob dpon sku la bdo ba dang / /bstan pa 'jig —sogs 'byung 'gyur bas/ /de la bzod pa mi bsgom ste/ /gsang sngags 'khrul 'khor bskor bar bya /de las gzhan du byas gyur na/ /dam tshig nyams te dmyal bar 'gro/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mthu stobs can/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyis//rig 8sngags gsang sngags bdag po ru/ /dbang bsgur mnga' gsol mdzad nas ni/ /gsang sngags 'khor lo 9mtha' dag ni/ /khyod kyis bsdus la 25—977

khyod kyis bskor/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi bka' yang bsgo/ /'khor lo rgyas par bskor nas kyang / /de 'og rang gi 'khor lo ni/ /rtsod pa rgyas pa'i dus dag tu/ /bskor na las rnams 'grub pa dang / /de las gus pa mang 'gyur bas/ /de yi dus su bstan par bya/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis de skad gsung gye/ /de bzhin bdag ni rjes mthun pas/ /'di la mos pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /phyogs rnams kun gyis gsol gdab dang / /bdag rang bsod nams bsags pa'i phyir/ /'di bstan pa yi sems pa skyesarngu/ /bsgon 'grus dag pa'i sgo nas ni/ /lha rnams sgrub cing gsol gdab pas/ /gsang sngags don dang mthun pa yis/ /sems pa zuskye ba de nyid srung / /dper na nyi ma'i 'od zer ni/ /bye ba brgya phrag mang po las/ /gzi brjid khang pa'i nang du shar/ /de bzhin 'od zer phra mo gcig /bdag blo yi ni mun par snang / /snang ba de yang bdag gis ni/ /gzhan rnams kun la ④bstan par bya//man ngag 'di bkod cho ga yis/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kun/ /bsod nams 'di la brten nas ni/ /thams cad byang chub thob par shog /slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs chen po rdzogs so// //25—978

༄/ /gnod sprun gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi grub thabs/①༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na rngupa nyi — dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bye rgyud dag la/ /brten nas nang gi sgrub thabs 'di / /bdag gis dran phyir bshad par bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor yud tsam bsam/ /rang gi snying gar zla dkyil bsam/ /de yi steng du hūṃ yig bsam / /hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa las/ /phyi nang gsal nas 'od zer 'phros/ /bla ma dang ni gos sngon can/ /dkon mchog la sogs spyan drangs nas/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba gdab/ /skyabs gsol lus dbul dge rtsa bsngo/ /tshad med bzhi yang bsgom par bya/ /de nas stong pa'i ting 'dzin bsgoms༄ / /25—982

de la 'od phung tshul du bdag rang nyid/ /de yi nang na hūṃ gnas la/ /de las tso ①'phros 'khor lor gyur du/ /lte bar nyid bsams 'u hūṃ de nyid/ /de las gnod mdzes rgyal por gyur/ /de yi hūṃ gi 'phro 'du yis/ /khro bo chen po bcu ru gyur/ /hūṃ bzhi'i gsang sngags brjod pa yis/ /khro bcu'i sprul pas gdug pa bkug /sku gsung thugs kyi phur bus gdab/ /btul 'ing sbyangs nas nam mkhar gyur/ /de nas hūṃ gi 'phro 'du yis/ /rdo rje gur dang ra ba dang / /dra ba nyid du gyur pa'o/ /hūṃ gi 'phro 'dus be+er la zhu / /stong pa nyid las 'od spung ④byung / /de las nyi zla kha sbyar gyur/ /ā li kā lis nyi zla brgyan/ /dbus su a dang hūṃ sbyar te/ /kha dog dkar dmar nyid du blta/ /'od zer dkar dmar 'phro 'du las/ /zhu bas rdo rje pad+mar gyur/ /pad steng rdo rje rkang pyenub tsam/ /lte ba gnyis la snying pos bskor/ /de gnyis las ni thugs dang gsung / /gnyi gas sku bsdus byen gyis brlab/ /de nyid 'od du zhu ba las/ /rdo rje las ni khro bor gyur//pad+ma las ni khro mor gyur/ /khro bo rdo rje gos sngon can/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /mche ba gatshigs pas 'dod dgur gyur/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'khril pa'i tshul//g.yon du rdo rje khro mo ni/ /sku mdog ljang dmar zhal gcig ma/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug gtso la 'khyud/ /g.yon pa bhan 6dmar gtso la stob3/ /gnyis med 'khril pa'i tshul bsgoms srinas/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ /phyi nang bdud rtsi mchod nas bstem/ /'od zer 'phro 'du byen gyis brlab/ /de bzhin khro chung lus byen brlab/ /dbang bskur 25—983

bas ni mi bskyod 'gyur/ /de ltar bsgoms nas bzlas pa bya/ /de steng ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /mtshan ma la sogs bsgoms nas su/ /thugs kar 'khor ram yul 'khor ba/ /'od zer la ni yig hu3'bru bskyon/ /ma gsal bar du bsgom par bya/ /de ltar rab 'bring tha ma yis/ /'bum mam nyis zhe'abum sum 'bum 'grub/ /the tshom med na dngos grub 'grub/ /dam tshig nyams sam sdig che bas/ /sbyin sreg la sogs mang du bya/ /mtshan ma gsum mam nus pa brtag① /de ltar byung na sgrub ④pa brtsam/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o / /khyasgrub 6pa'i rim pa bstan pa ni/ /mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas phyin la/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum nag por bya/ /rdo rje gri gug nang du ste/ /bar du me ri gtang bar bya/ /gzhu dang dgra sta mdung dang gsum/ /me ri'i zur nas gtang bar bya/ /tshub ma dur khrod sol ba dang / /bdud rtsi bag zan gzugs brnyan bya/ /snying gar gru gsum gzugs brnyan gzhug /kha bcad sngaseng ldeng phur la btod/ /mtshan ldan ka pā la ru ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lngas dgang / /de ni gos sngon nyid la mchod/ /be+egs kyi grub gsum nang du ni/ /bdud rtsi sha lnga khrag gsum dgang / /de ni nag po'i gtor gta'o/ /rnel gre'i snod du dug gtor bsagasakye/ /phye ma gsum dang yungs kar gdab/ /slob dpon slob ma gnyis ka yang / /gos sngon gos nag rgyan cha bgo/ /rak+ṣa ⑪rus pa'i phreng ba bgrang ṅku/ /nub dang lho ru kha bltas te/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa skyetshul bzhin bsgom/ /25—984

thun mong 1sngags dang khyad par sngags/ /dgra'am 'byung po klu rnams la/ /bzlas pas gsang ba'i rim pa brtsam/1/ /snying ga'i mtshan ma la sogs gsal / /lce ni hūṃ gi rdo rjer bsgyur/ /'od zer dkar dmar 'phros pa las / /de la khro tshogs byung bas dgug /yang na mgon po bskul 1bas bsam / /khri yi bar du bzlas nas ni/ /thun bar du ni phye ma gsum/ /mgon pos las kyi gtor mar gdab/ /yungs kar gos sngon can gyis so/ /phye ma dug nag 'od zer dgang / /yungs kar khro chung nyid du spro/ /rtags byung nas ni gzugs brnyan gzhug thu /de nas sgrub 5khang them rtsa ru/ /gru gsum nag po'i brub thukhung du/ /de nyid bcug la kha bcad 7ri rab bri/ /de steng mnan zhing stang stabs bya/ /de ni mnan pa'i spyor ba'o/ /phur bus gdab cing gri gug gtub/ /de nas gru gsum gtor mar dbul/ /nag po chen po nyid la bstabasatre7/ /drag sngags bzlas pa'i gtor ma yi/ /gsang ba'i man ngag shes par bya'o/ /yang na sbyin sreg nyid kyis bya/ /de rnams gsad pa'i byer ba'o/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bskyed pa yi/ /lte bar gtso bo bskyed nas ni/ /klu chen brgyad po 'dab mar bskyed/ /rin chen snod du gtor ma bsham/ /chu gtsang sman la sogs pa dang / /khyad par klu sman sna tshogs dang / /dkar gsum mngar gsum rnams kyis bya/ /sbyang zhing byin gyis brlab kyesogs bya/ /klu la byin pas zhe sdang zhi/ /lhag ma 'khor la byin pa yis/ /gnod pa rnams ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /sngags bzlas 'od zer phog pa yis/ /gtso bo'i dam tshig rjes dran pas/ /'khor rnams zhe sdang zhi bar 'gyur/ /yang na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ /25—985

bskrad dang bcing dang dgug pa yis/ /de la sogs pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /sbyor ka chen por shes par bya/ /'khor lo ser po'i lte bar gtso/ /mdun du rgyal po bskyed par bya/ /de yi g.yas su nor lha ni/ /sku mdog dkar po 'dzum bag can/ /nor bu'i sgrom ni g.yas g.yon bsnams/ /mchod cing bstod pa gsang sngags bzlas/ /gzugs brnyan 'di la rin chen brten/ /kha dog lnga dang gser gyis mtshon/ /kha dog ser po'i bzlas thems nas/ /ci 'dod pa yi nor rnams ster/ /de ni thun mong dngos grub po/ /bdud rtsi rtsa ba lnga btsal la/ /bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor bya/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum nyid la no/ /sngags bzlas ri lu byas te bza'/ /zas dang sman ni srang la brje/ /brjes zin zhig gsum 'bras bu 'byung / /de gsum skye ba bdun pa dang / /yul 3gye cha bsres sman rnams sbyar/ /de sgrub 'od zer btul zhing sbyang / /rtags byung nas ni bza' zhing byug /de yis thun mong dngos grub 'grub/ /mchog gi yang ni grogs su 'gyur/ /mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa yang / /thugs ka yi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /rtsa rgyud 'dab ma brgyad du bsam/ /de dkyil rtsa ni rta rnga'i bye tshad/ /de yi nang du dbugs kyi lha/ /kha dog lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /de dkyil thig le byang chub sems/ /de la lta zhing bsgom pa ni/ /rtags lnga'i mthar ni stong nyid 'gyur/ /de nyid spro zhing bsdu ba dang / /dgug cing bskyil ba'i rim pa'am/ /mnan cing bzlog pa'i man ngag gis/ /rim gyis ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'thob/ /25—986

nang sgrub rim pa 'di yis ni/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can dang / /'di la brten pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /gnod sbyin kyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/9/2 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dngagro/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgom/983 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ma 〈〈co 〉ra / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅bo 'gyur/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉h+pha bsam/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadapung / khru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rked/ byu/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉than/ klu〈〈pe 〉thastobs/ 〈〈snar 〉skogibs/3〈〈snar 〉〉du sgoms/984 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ye / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mdo/ 1〈〈snar 〉〉par rtag ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rabasgrub/ skyo/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabasgrub/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagacad/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasags/ lku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngag sha ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra greng / hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/985 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉mongs/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rtsams/ kye〈〈snar 〉ngonal/ bya〈〈pe 〉ra zhug 〈〈snar 〉〉bzhugs—/ thu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgrub/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉marabrub/ spru〈〈pe 〉racad/ bye〈〈pe 〉thatab/〈〈snar 〉ra stab/ spu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/9/6 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ma ga du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodam/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zod rta'i/25—987

༄/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/nya ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 27pa ta ye m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi 1maṇ+ḍal bi bye ④nā ma/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud rnams thams cad tshar gcod pa'i/ /mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal nas/ /chags la mos par gyur pa yi/ /rnal 'byor lam pa'i don ched du/ /rgyud rnams kun dang mi 'gal ba'i / /dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad par bya/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid ldan pa yis / /sngon du bsnyen pa rdzogs byas te/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gnas dag tu/ /dri bzang tsan+dan spos kyis byugs/ /dri zhim mre tog mchod 3bkram nas/ /lho ru kha bltas rol pa'i 'dug stangs bya/ /yang na bsnyen pa zhi ba'i tshul yin pas/ /shar du kha bltas sems dpa'i skyel 25—989

krung bca'/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba yi/ /'gro la phan dang skyob pa'i phyir / /snying rje chen pos ①dmigs par bya/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i tshul bsgom bya/ /de nas bzlas brjod tshul bzhin bya/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i 'bum du bzlas/ /de las gzhan pa khri ru bzlas/ /mtshan ma rnam dugasum thob pa yis/ /yang na bsnyen sbyor goms pas ni/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya'o/ /slob ma snod dang ldan pa yis/ /dang por gsol gsum btab nas ni/ /bsnyen rdzogs gnying la gdab par bya/ /dang por sa ni brtag par bya/ /phyogs gcad 1dbyibs ldan skyon bral ba'i / /mkhas pas ci nus brtag par bya/ /maṇ+ḍal lags byas me tog dgram//lha yi gnas dang gdan du bsam/ /lha bskyed la sogs byas nas ni/ /mchod dang bstod pa tshul bzhin bya/ /dgongs shig dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa dang / /slob ma rnams la sman slad du/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi④ / /dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dri spyobar 'tshal/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum du brjod de gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas chos skyong ba'i srung ⑥ma rnams la/ /mchod dang gtor ma byin nas peni/ /bstod cing gsol ba gdab par bya/ /de nas las thams cad pa'i thab khung du sbyin sreg gis sbyar bar bya'o/ /sbyin sreg grub par ma gyur na/ /las thams cad pa'i gsang sngags chus/ /bgegs ni nye bar zhi bar bya'o/ /de nas ji ltar brtags pa'i 3dbus su/ byen rlabs kyerdo rjes khru gang brko/ /skyon rnams spangs nas sa rim rmyebacal/ /'thas par bcags la 25—990

byug par bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs 1pa'i/ /ri rab gzhal yas bskyed nas ni/ /lha bskyed la sogs rdzogs byas la/ /de nas skad cig myur du khros/ /'khor rnams kyis thuni gsol ba gdab/ /khro bo'i 5mig dang rkang sogs byin gyis brlab5/ /rdo rje dril bu gnyis bzung nas/ /stang stabs spyor ba la sogs kyis/ /bgegs rnams ma lus tshar gcad do/ /de nas sa yi lha mo la/ /mchod bstod gsol ba btab pa yis/ /dpang po phyir ni sta gon gnas/ /bdud rtsi thig le la sogs bya/ /lha rnams cho ga la sogs rdzogs/ /de nas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /bdug spos lag thogs pus btsugs la/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lopye/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis6/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni bri bar bya/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de ni gnang ba mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro don bya don gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags lha/ /'jig rten skyong dang mthu chen dang / /gang yang rdo rje'i spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgye ba yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /yo byad ci yod pas 'dri na/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs brtse bar ni dgongs su gsol/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab par dzamadzad du gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum gsol btab nas/ /ra ba dra bas mtshams bya'o/ /gser la sogs pa'i bum pa yi sa/ /lto ba che ba mgrin ring ba/ /skyon 25—991

spangs nyes pa bral ba dang / /yon tan la sogs lha grangs bstun/ /rdzas dang kha rgyan mgul chings ldan/ /mtshan ma rdzogs nas byin gyis brlab/ /rnam rgyal las kyi bum pa la/ /khyad par cho ga la sogs bya/ /de nas slob ma blo ldan la/ /slob dpon gyis ni cho ga bya/ /slob ma sgo yi drung gnas te/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de ni stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag nyid 'jug par 'tshal/ /de ltar lan gsum gsol btab nas/ /slob dpon gtso bo'i ting 'dzin zhugs/ /tshigs bcad 'di ni gsang sngags sbyin/ /bu tshur jeg pa chen po yis/ /gsang sngags tshul spyod cho ga 'di/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /rdo rje gsang sngags rab bsgom 1pa'i/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med derī/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis snyebacom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug par rtogs nas/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis 4shig /ces smras so/ / de nas/5 skyabs 'gro sdig bshags la sogs kun/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor nyid du shes par bya/ /srog chags 25—992

rnams ni gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo / /'dod pa dag kyang spyad mi bya/ / brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /2nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba yi chang ni myos par btung ma yin/ /sems can gdul bya ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /dam pa nye bar bsten nabya zhing / /rnal 'byor can du bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi las ni rnam nga/ bzhi/ /yid kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ci nus pa sgo ru rjes su bsrung / /sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /'khor ba dag kyang spang mi bya/ /rtag tu mya ngan 'da' mi bya/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /de la brnyas par mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /de ltar dam tshig phog pa dag /blo ldan khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bye/ /mdor na rtsa ba yan lag gi/ /dam tshig nyin mtshan bgrang zhing bsrung / /de nas bla mas gsungs pa yi/ /sdom pa legs par gzung dubar bya/ /tshul khrims zhes bya sogs pa ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag ni rab tu ldog par bgyi/ /de ltar sdom pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma la/ snying ga dang mgrin pa dang dpral ba gsum du rdo rje khu tshur gyis dri'i thig le gsum du bya ste/ nyi ma dang zla ba dang pad+ma gsum la thuyi ge gsum so sor bkod la/ sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab cing las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis pe)bsrung bar bya'okye/ /de nas mchod pa bya ste/ spyi bor me tog dang spos so/ /mar me dang dri ni snying gar ro/ /lha bshos mdun du'o/ /de nas tshig ni 'dis su sbyin/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa dag ⑫dang 25—993

—ldan par ni/ /dus kun du ni bde bar mnos/ /de nas tshems shing la sogs sbyin par bya/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dusmra ra'i se tog bzhin/ /brgya lam zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i chos bshad par bya'o/ /de nas thig byen gyis brlab pa la sogs pa shes par bya'o/ /de nas this skud gdab pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun pas na/ /tshon rnams byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /tshon rnams bkye ①ba'i las bya'o/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad dkyil du/ /zla ba nyi ma'i gdan stengs su/ /gtso bo bri bar bya ba yin//'dab ma brgyad la lha brgyad bri/ /gru chad bzhi la lha mo bzhi/ /sgo bzhir sgo ba bzhi bri'o/ / de nas rgyan sogs bri bar bya/ /①de 'og lhag chad bskang bya'o/ /nam mkha' 'degs par 'dod pa dang / /yang bskyed yang sdud byed pa gnyis/ /gong 1ltar mos pa 'jug pa yis/ /gtso bo sngon du 'gro ba rdzogs pa yin/ /'khor rnams sprul pa'am cho gas bskyed/ /dbus su gtso bo sku mdog sngon po ste//zhal gcig phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams/ /g.yon ni gdul bya'i skabs dang sbyar/ /shar gyi pad+mar rnam par rgyal/ /sku mdog dmar po dbu gsum pa④/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin/ /g.yon pas pedagra sta bar ma gnyis/ /gung mo mthe bo ngos mdud nas/ /gzhan rnams yongs su dpyang gyeb yin/ /de nyid snying gar bzung nas ni/ /de 'og zhags pa ral gri bsnams/ /lho yi pad+mar mgon po ni/ /sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas g.yon tsan+dan bing chen zhags pa bsnams/ /nub kyi 'dab mar lus ngan po/ /sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis mchod rten ṣ+pe le bsnams/ /byang gi 'dab mar bdud rtsi 'khyel/ /sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis 25—994

brang bsnol sdigs mdzub 'phyar/ /shar lho'i 'dab mar gnod sbyin bskyed/ /sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis gri gug cang te'u bsnams/ /lho nub pad+mar ro langs ma/ / sku mdog sngo skya zhal gcig ma/ /①phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags sgog ②bzung nas su/ /gung mo srin lag la sogs gsum po rnams//dam por bkug nas yongs su bsdam/ /mtheb mdzub bzhi rnams rab brkyang ste//spyi bor nges par bsdol ba bsnams/ /nub byang 'dab mar rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma//sku mdog dmar skya zhal gcig ma/ /phyag gnyis spyi bor sbyar nas su/ /me lce phreng ba yongs su 'dzin/ /byang shar mtshams kyi 'dab ma la/ /'jigs byed kha dog ṣ+pesngo nag la④/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis pa/ /g.yas kyi dang pos ⑤glang po bsnams/ /g.yon pas ⑥glang chen pags dze+e pa bsnams/ /de 'og dgra sta rdo rje bsnams/ /tha mas ⑤mi mgo lcags kyu bsnams/ /gru chad bzhi la lha mo bzhi/ /'od bskyed spusku mdog dkar mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis me tog bsnams/ /yid 'phrog ma sku mdog ser mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dri'i spos phor bsnams/ /kun bzang ma sku mdog dkar mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ro mchog bsnams/ /gru sgra ma sku mdog sngon mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgra snyan gar/ /shar gyi sgo ru srog gcod ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing / /phyag gnyis tho ba zhags pa bsnams/ / lho sgor dbugs rngub ma ser mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis hom gzar zhags/ /⑫nub sgor khrag 'thung ma sku mdog dmar mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug zhags—/ /byang sgor sha za ma sku mdog sngon mo/ / nyu)zhal gcig phyag gnyis non po zhags/ /de ltar gsal bar bskyed nas su/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor 25—995

spyan drangs nas/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa de nyid la/ /mchod bstod byas nas dam tshig gi/ /dkyil 'khor dag la bstem par bya/ /de nas bdag nyid shar sgo ru/ /dang po nyid nas mes po'i tshul/ /shar sgo ru ni gnas pa 'am/ /yang na phyi nas sras kyi tshul/ /de nas byin rlabs dbang bskur bya / /mchod dang bstod pa rdzogs byas la/ /sgrub pa'i bzlas brjod thim pa dang / /slob ma dkyil 'khor gzhug par bya/ /de nas yol bas bcad 1 bar du/ /las kyi chu bo dugator ba dang / /gdong g.yogs bcing ba dang / yon phul nas ni mthong ba dri/ /chu blud bka' bsgo byas nas me tog dor/ /mig dbye lha ngo de ni rim bzhin bstan/ /de nas dbang bskur rim bzhin bya/ /yab yum stoms zhugs 'od zer las / /bde gshegs 'od bskul bum par thim/ /ma 'dres pas ni 'od zhu nas/ /spyi bor chu yi dbang bskur ro/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni sbyin par bya—/ /sku gsung dam tshig las byung ba'i/ /1ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /mi bskyod pa yi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra ā dar+sha dz+nyā na a bhe ṣiñtsa zhes pas so/ /dbu rgyan man ngag shes byas la/ /'di skad do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid sgode/ /dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste/ /dbu rgyan rin chen mchog 'gro bas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo oṃ sa man+ta dz+nyā na rat+na nā ma hūṃ tiṣ+ṭha a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes pas so/ / rdo rje'i ⑤man ngag shes byas la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /mi phyed rdo rje 'od gsal ba/ /dam chos 'byung ba'i sgor gyur pa/ /rdo rje chos kyi dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ pra ta a bhi ṣe ka dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ dril bu'i man ngag shes byas la/ /thabs 25—996

dang shes rab ldan pa yis/ /'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang / /mchod pa'i las rnams rdzogs byed pas/ /rdo rje las kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ kri ta a nut+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra a nyi ṣiñtsa/ ming gi man ngag shes byas la/ /rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi g.yo bas/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab tu grags/ /oṃ pra ti sho dha dharma dh+wa tu dz+nyā na nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ de nas dam tshig gsum gyi dbang bskur bya ste/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rgyud cho ga bzhin/ /tshigs bcad rnams kyang bsgrag par bya/ /oṃ a hūṃ / de gsum man ngag 'od zer ni/ /bla ma las ni shes par bya/ de nas me long dbang bskur bya/ /gong ma bzhin du man ngag gtso/ /de nas khyad par dbang bskur ni/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor ji bzhin no/ /gos sngon sgrub pa'i dbang bskur ba rdzogs so// //rdo rje slob dpon 'dod pa yis/ /yon gyis bla ma mnyes byas la/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni gsol ba gdab/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod cing stsol ⑫/mdzad pa/ /bdag la srung hūṃba'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la spruladu/ /zhes gsol ba gdab po/ /de nas shar phyogs su dkyil 'khor chen po dang / bar du 'dom gyis chod par ni dbang gi dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin thras la de'i steng du dbang stegs kyi khri byas la ras la gdan ngupad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa seng ges mtshan pa bzhag ste/ de la gdugs la sogs pa thams cad kyis bklubs phyel/ rnam par rgyal ba dang / lha thams cad kyi bum pa dang las thams cad kyi bum pas man ngag ji lta ba bzhin dbang bskur ro//de nas rdo rje brtul zhugs dang / lung bstan pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa bye 25—997

dbugs dbyung ba dang / dung kyedang 'khor lo 1la sogs pa'i dbang byen la/de nas dkyil 'khor de nyid bstan/ /de nas yon phul la/ de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab po/ /gsang ba'i dbang bsgur ba yang 'od dang grib ma'i tshul du g.yen du bsams la/ man ngag bzhin du byang sems dbab/ /phab pas sbyin par bya ba dang / /yang na bdud rtsi rnam lnga ni/ /mtshan dang ldan pa'i snod bzhag nas / /sa bon lnga la rigs lnga ni/ /snyoms zhugs ①bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam/ /yang na dbab pa'i tshul du bya/ /yang na dngos su dbab pa dang / /yang na gnyis kas bya ba yin/ / cu gang gis rgya ni 'de rngugu sbyar/ /cha gnyis bsres pas gong bzhin no/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni gsol ba gdab/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod kyi mthus/ /bye sangs rgyas kyi ⑦ni bde ba 'grub/ /rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /rgya cher sras su bcas pa rnams/ /yun ring stong nyid sgom gdung la/ /dga' bas yid 'ong bde chen gyis ni dgyes par mdzod/ /kye 'dod chags dri med kun du bzang po'i spyod pa ste/ /dga' ba'i 'dod chags rdo rje'i dam tshig la ni phye mdzad nas/ /dga' ba rnam pa drug po spyod pas shin tu gdung ba ni/ /rab tu dgyes dbang 'dod pa'i bde ba nyid kyis 'jug par 'tshal/ /byang chub sems ni rin chen 'bar 'byung ba'i/ /ma lus rgyal ba rnams ni lus skams la/ /rnam dag rdo rje las byung ye shes chu/ /dri med rin chen sbyin byedabab dbang bskur ro/ /mnyam dang mi klumanyam 'dod chags tshul dag pas/ /pad+ma'i gnas su rdo rje gtong mdzad pa/ /sna tshogs sems dpa' sems can brlag gyur pa/ /sbyor ba gzhan pa yin pa ma thogs 25—998

bshad par gsol/ /rdo rje sems khyod dbang mchog bde bar byed pa yi/ /rdo je pad+ma dbye ba'i tshul gyis sbyor mdzad de/ /rgyal ba kun gye gzugs sku rab ston nas—/ /thams cad bde grub nyid kyis bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /de nas tshogs kyis mchod byas la/ /mtshan ldan snod nas blangs nas ni/ /rdo rje srin mtheb byin rlabs ①la/ /oṃ a mṛ ta gu khya a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes pas mgrin par gsung la dbul bar bya'o/ /slob mas kyang bdud rtsi chen por bsams kyel a ho su kha 2zhes pas btung bar bya'o/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i bstod pa yang bya'o/ /da ④ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar bya ste/ phyag rgya la brten mi 'jug la/ /man ngag 'di ni bstan pa yin/ /yid kyi lha mo gzugs mdzes la// bdud rtsi chen po ⑤man ngag sbyar bar byaspyo/ /yang na rdo rje lce thung ④gi/ /spyor ba'i man ngag bsten 3pa dang / /yang na rtsa ni gnyis po la7/ /phyag rgya/'i spyor ba bstan pa dang / /yang na rdzas rnams mthu chen kyis/ /byugs pas dga' ba skye 'gyur ro/ /slob mas yon dbul gsol ba gdab/ /mchod cing bstod pas mnyes byas la/ /'di skad tshig kyang brjod par bya/ /khams gsum las ⑫ni rnam grol zhing / /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur pa/ /'dod pa rnams kyis ma gos pa/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po rnams dang khams rnams dang / /༄ 1skye mched rnams la mi brten cing / /phyin ci log pas ⑫rnam grol zhing / /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam 'gyur zhing / /'dod pa dag gis ma gos pa/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rtog med cing kun rtog med/ /thugs ni rab tu mi gnas pa/ /bsam gyis 25—999

mi khyab pa yi thugs/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar nam mkha' gnas med cing / /spros med gos ①pa med pa ltar/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' ba'i/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo /thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin can/ /mngon par byang chub blta bar 'tshal/ /dga' mchog sgo nas bstod mdzad pa/ /lhan cig ye shes khyod phyag 'tshal/ /de nas sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ khumi/ zhes pa lan bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas so/ /de nas dbang bzhi bstan pa ni/ /gzhung lugs mi 'dra mang mod kyang / /dang po'i tshig rten man ngag ni/ /rna ba dag tu brgyud pa yin/ /tha ma lhan cig dga' ba yin/ /dang po bum pa'i dbang gis ni/ /man ngag rnams ni bstan pa yin/ /de nas gsang ba yi bstan la/ /khyad par sngags kyi don rnams bstan/ /1sngags rnams don dang bcas rnams ni/ /rna ba brgyud par bya ba ni/ /oṃ — dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pradz+nyā ti sa ta ni ya hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ sha swa gā pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ga ti dṛ byeya ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ me sa bhak+ṣa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tre lokya bi dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra be+e tā lbo ⑤hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ye hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a mri 'uta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bid pa na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma na ma ha ra nā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa man+ta bha dra 4ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shap+ta snyegī ti ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ nī dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags kyi don rnams ma shes na/ /ngag gi sgrib pa mi 'dag phyir/ /des na slob dpon rna brgyud kyi/ /man ngag 25—1000

de la nan tan bya/ /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi/ /man ngag de ni bstan par bya / /dga' ba bum pa'i don bstan la/ /mchog dga' gsang ba'i don bstan no/ /khyad par shes rab ye shes bstan/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ni / /bzhi pa kho na bstan pa yin/ /yang na bum pa'i dbang bskur nas/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan pa yin/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur nahu / /rdo rje bzlas pa bstan par bya/ /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur nas/ /sems dbe+en par ni bstan par bya/ /de nas sgyu ma la gnas pas/ /bzhi pa'i man ngag bstan par bya/ /de nas 'od gsal la brten nasahūṃ/ /zung 'jug ting 'dzin bsgom par bya/ /zung 'jug ting 'dzin mthar phyin pa/ /chos kyi sku zhes de la bya/ /de ltar bzhi pa'i rna brgyud bstan/ /dbang bskur rdzogs nas tshogs 'khor bya/ /gtor ma btang nas mkha' 'gro bskang / /sbyin sreg gis ni lhag chad bskang / /yi ge brgya pa zlos byed cing / /dkyil 'khor bskor zhing sgra rnams brdung / /ye shes gshegs nas nying 'dzin bsdu/ /rdul tshon phyags la chu la dor/ /maṇ+ḍal zhal bsil dga' ston bya/ /rnal 'byor lam pa'i don ched du/ /rgyud rnams kun dang mi 'gal ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di byas pas/ /'di byas dge ba'i rtsa ba yis/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /thams cad byang chub thob par shog /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa4// / /25—1001
