༄/ /lung bstan sbyor ba'i man ngag bzhugs/she ༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lung bstan spyor ba'i man ngag 'di/ /rgyud rnams kun las mi gsal ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis 2rgyas btab la/ /rnal 'byor blo dman don du ni/ /yang nas yang du gsol btab nas/ /yid ches brod pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /man ngag rim pa bstan pa la/ /bla ma las kyeni mnyan par gyis/ /gsang sngags sgo ni dpag med nas/ /thabs kyi rim pa mang gsungs pa/ /sems can las ni sna tshogs pas/ /so so mos pa mi mthun phyir/ /dper na sman rnams nus pa yis/ /nad rnams so sor sel ba bzhin/ /man ngag thabs rnams so sos kyang / /dug gi nad rnams 'joms par byed/ /dper na sman nus gcig gis kyang / /phrad pa tsam gyis nad 'joms pa'o/ /yang na gnyis 'joms gsum 'joms dang / /bzhi 'joms lnga 'joms la sogs dang / /mang po 25—1004

'dus nas 'joms pa dang / /de dag kun gyis ma choms pa/ /sbyor ba gzhan log 'joms pa dang / /gnyan ①pa kho nas 'joms pa dang / /sman dang sbyor ba de dag kyang / /mkhas pa yis ni 'joms par 'gyur/ /mi mkhas pas ni gnod par 'gyur/ /sman pa mkhas par gyur kyang ni/ /brtson 'grus nan tan ma byas na/ /nad rnams 'joms par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin mthun pa'i dpe rnams kyang / /mkha' 'gro ma yis 1lung bstan na/ /zhib pas 'di ru ma phye'o/ /bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis nyon mongs 'joms/ /bsgoms pa las byung dngos grub kyis/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /nying 'dzin thob par ma gyur pas/ /tshogs 'khor tshogs mchod dngos grub po/ /de ma byung na sbyin sreg gis/ /dngos grub sgrub ༄ par gsungs pa yin/ /de ma byung ba bzlas brjod do/ /de ni ma byung gtor ma bya/ /de rnams kun las snyem byung na/ /las ni phran tshegs gzhan yang bstan/ /yang na de dag thams cad kyang / /gcig 'dus gnyis 'dus gsum 'dus dang / /bzhi 'dus lnga 'dus la sogs pas/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba gsungs pa yin/ /yang na mchog 'dod pa la ni/ /thams cad rdzogs par dgos par gsungs/ /thun mong dudangos grub sgrub pa la/ /che chung gis na sngarim pas gsungs/ /sbyor ba re res kyang ni 'grub/ /gsang sngags la la'i bzhed kyis ni/ /dper na sbrul ni gshu bur zhugs/ /rtsa bar 'gro dang co tor 'gro/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor sngags pa yang / /rig 'dzin sa dang rdo rje dmyal/ /la la dag gi gzhung gis ni—/ /bar ma do nas 'gro ba'o/ /la la skye ba phyi ma la/ /la la dag gis byebazhed kyis ni/ /gnyis dang gsum pa dag la'o/ /bzhi pa'am lnga par 'dod 25—1005

pa'ang yod/ /la la skye ba bdun pa la/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob par 'dod//de ltar gzhung lugs mi 'dra ba/ /mang du gsungs pa de dag kyang / /'gal ba med de kun kyang bden/ /gsang sngags kyi ni gzhung gis kyang / /skye ba bdun las mi dma' bas/ /skye ba bdun gyi tha ma la/ /ma bsgoms kyang ni sangs rgyas sakye/ /zhes su rgyud las bstan pa yin/ /skye ba bdun zhes bya ba yang / /sngags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /sngags dang sman la sogs pa yi/ /stobs kyis lus sems las rung bsakye/ /sha dang thod pa la sogs pa//bsten cing zos pas dngos grub thob/ /de bas sngags mthu'i yon tan no/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /skye ba bdun pa 'ong srid kyang / /de ltar 'ong ba shin tu dkon/ /skye ba bdun pa zhes bya'i gnas/ /phal cher dur khrod chen po yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gnas su skye/ /rig 'dzin sa zhes bya ba yang / /gcig ni de la'ang bya ba yin/ /rig 'dzin sa la'ang gsum yod de/ /dur khrod rin chen sa dang ni/ /bar snang lha gnas lha rtan ④sa/ /mkha' spyod 'og min stug po'i sa/ /gnas ni de gsum yin par gsungs/ /skye ba bdun pa'i gang zag ni/ /lus bye dang gnas ni khyad par can/ /sngags spyod pa yi yul ‘dag tu/ /'ga' tsam byung peb dag kyang yod/ /skye ba gcig sogs gzhan pa ni / /de rnams gnas kyang de bzhin no/ /skye ba bdun pa'i gang zag ni/ /dad dang snying rje la sogs ldan/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i chos la spyod/ /mthun 'jug spyod pa kun la mkhas/ /bzo dang rig pa gnas la mkhas/ /lta ba ma nor gdeng du gyur/ /spyod pa la dor thabs la mkhas/ /man ngag mthong ba tsam gyis ni/ /the tshom med par 'jug par byed/ /man ngag bsgoms ma thag 25—1006

tu ni/ /ting 'dzin skye 'gyur rang gi ⑫ni/ /khams dang dus kyi bye brag shes/ /rgyud lus dumatshan gye man ngag la/ /thos pa tsam gyis dbu zhabs kyi/ /man ngag rnams ni khong du chud/ /bshad pa'i rgyud dang 'grel pa dang / /mngon rtogs pa yi rim pa rnams/ /ma thos pa ru shes par 'gyur/ /dper na shing 'dzer stsal pa tsam/ /rgyud lus 2man ngag mdo mdo yi/ /mkhas pa la ni brten pa ④su/ /thams cad don rnams khong chud nas/ /skabs phyed spyi don thin tu rgyas/ /dka' 'grel mngon rtogs rim pa ni/ /rtsom nus don la shin tu mkhas/ /mig ni yun ring mi 'dzum khyazhing / /yi dam lha bsgom gyedus su ni/ /skye ba bdun pa'i grib ma snang / /skye ba gnyis sogs gzhan po la/ /grib ma'i rtags kyang de bzhin no/ /bsgoms pa'i stobs kyi khyad par gyis/ /zhag bdun zla gcig zla bdun du/ /mkha' 'gro mas ni lung ston zhing / /chos bshad rtags rnams ston par mdzad/ /chos pa yi ni mdzad thuspyod kyang / /dngos su sprul nas ston pa dang / /yang sprul sum sprul la sogs su/ /sprul nas ston dang yang na ni/ /sku ni mi snang sgra yis su/ /nam mkha' las su ston pa dang / /yang na phyag mtshan la sogs la/ /sgra byung nas ni ston pa dang / /yang na rmi lam mtshan mas su/ /dus bzhi dus gsum dus gcig tu/ /yang nas yang du ston pa'o/ /ma thos pa yi man ngag rnams/ /ston mor byed na skye bdun sogs/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thob pa yi/ /rnal 'byor rig 'dzin byang chub sems/ /yang na 6dang po skyes nas ni/ /theg chen chos la mos nas kyang spu/ /man ngag bsgoms ⑩ la shin tu dga'/ /slob dpon la ni man ngag gi/ /rna brgyud ⑩gcig tsam thos pas su/ /bsgoms pas dngos grub 25—1007

—thob par 'gyur/ /de nas gong bzhin byung nas su/ /gzhan la yang ni ston par nus/ /yang na skye bdun gang zag ste/ /skyes ma thag tu yi dam lhas/ /rmi lam na ni chos bstan nas/ /man ngag de bsgoms dngos grub ni/ /phra cho/ dag ni thob nas kyang / /gzhan la chos ni ston par nus/ /de nas rim gyes gzhan yang 'byung / /yang na skye bdun gang zag de/ /rkyen ni gnyis po 'dzom shepa las/ /bsgom pa la ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /son 3gyi bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /'bad rtsol drag po ma byas par/ /thun gcig la ni sgom pa rnyed / /de nas rim gyis zhubasgoms pas su/ /zhag bdun nas ni lung ston 'byung / /de nas rim gsum gong ma bzhin/ /de nas mngon shes drug ldan nas / /phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /sngags pa'i dngos grub thams cad kun/ /skye ba 'di la phyag rgya thob/ /de ltar ma gyur rnal 'byor pa//gong ma bzhin du skye bdun du/ /len pa'i rtags ni gong bzhin 'byung / /skye ba 'di thob tshul rnams kyang / /theg chen snod du rung ba la/ /dbang bskur man ngag thob pa yis/ /dam tshig ma nyams bshags la brtson/ /bskyed rim brtan byepar gyur pas ni/ /lus kyi rnam rtog bzlog ⑤nas kyang / /rdo rje bzlas la brten nas kyang / /ngag gi rnam rtog bzlog nas ni/ /sems dben pa la brten 6par bya/ /sems kyi 'khrul rtog bzlog nas kyang / /sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin la gnas nas/ /'od gsal la ni 'jug par bya/ /de nas spros med man ngag la/ /lhun gyis grub ྅'gyur phyag rgya'i mchog /yang na bskyed rim la brten nas/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin sgrub/ /tshe la dbang sgrub rig 'dzin gyibye / /rdzogs pa'i man ngag bsgom par bya/ /des su phyag rgya'i dngos 25—1008

grub 'thob/ /yang na bskyed rim brtan pa yis/ /rdzogs pa'i man ngag gang bsgoms kyang / /zla ba drug gis phyag rgya 'thob/ /rdzogs rim nyubaskyed pa la brten nas/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rdzogs pas 5ni/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob par gsungs/ /de ni slob dpon chen po'i gzhung / /sbyor thun lta ba gdeng 'gyur gtso/ /lhan thucig sdog bya'i tshul du ni/ /byas nas je tshom mi skye 'ing / /ldog par mi 'gyur 'byung pos kyang / /tshugs par mi 'gyur 'bras bu myur/ /de ltar ma gyur rnal 'byor pas/ /man ngag nyams su lon par bya/ /man ngag bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis lung ston pas/ /lung bstan ye pa yi dus su ni/ /lta ba man ngag zab mo ni/ /bstan pa bsgoms pas phyag rgya 'thob/ /yang na rnal 'byor rim pas ni/ /blo yi rab 'bring khyad par ni/ /bag chags rkyen la sogs pa yis/ /rab 'bring dgu dang gsum dang ni/ /dbye bar bya ba'i don shes bya/ /rgyu rkyen 'dzom pa'i gang zag ni/ /skye ba 'di la lung ston pas/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur / /rkyen ni rab tu mang gyur pa'i/ /rab kyi 'bring sogs ldan pa can//bar ma do la lung bstan gyeno/ /rab kyi tha ma ldan pa ni/ /skye ba phyi ma lung ston /thuno/ /'bring gi gsum po'i rigs ldan yang / /gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi ru sbyar/ /tha ma'i rigs ldan gsum po yang / /lnga dang drug dang bdun du sbyar/ /yang na rkyen sogs ldan gyur kyang / /rgyu la sogs pa'i nus pa rnams / /drag zhan gyi ni rim pa yis/ /rkyen gyi tshul bzhin sbyor shes bya'o/ /rgyu rkyen gnyi ga 'bring sogs kyi/ /rim pa dang ni ldan pa rnams/ /gong ma gnyis dang mi mthun pas/ /gsum dang bdun du sbyar shes bya/ /gnyis ka 25—1009

zhan par gyur pa na/ /gsang sngags snod du mi rung bas/ /dbang bskur mi bya 'jug pa tsam/ /dge ba'i sa bon chung gyur kyang / /smon lam btab pa'i dad ldan de/ /gsang sngags la ni mos gyur nas/ /yang nas yang du gso'/ 'debs la/ /phyi ma'i stidabang bskur tsam byas la/ /mi zab dbyebs kyi man ngag bstan/ /de las bstan pa'i gang zag la/ /lhag ma rnams ni rim gyis bstan / /yang na rnal 'byor rim pa ni/ /yi dam lha tshogs so so ru/ /so so bag chags gzhag rjopa dang / /mos pa la sogs rim pa yis the tshom la sogs med mod kyang / /dngos grub 'grub par ma gyur na/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i 'du shes kyi/ /tha mi dad par bsgoms nas kyang / /man ngag yang yang spros 4kyang ni/ /'gal ba med de dngos grub 'grub/ /de ltar byas kyang ma byung na//sgrib pa shin tu che gsungs pas/ /sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor 5bzlas brjod dang //gtor ma la sogs cho ga yis/ /bdun nas stong gi bar du ni/ /mkhas pas ci nus rgyud brtags la/ /sna snetshogs spyig pa sbyang ba gsung / /lus kun la ni gnod pa yi/ /tsher ma'i phung pos lam rnams 'gags/ /me yi sbyor ba mkhas pa yis/ /bsregs pas thams cad med par byed/ /de nas lam ni rnyed nas ni/ /gang du phyin par 'gro bar byed/ /de bzhin sngags sogs mthun rnams kyis/ /sgrib pa la sogs bcom nas kyang / /ting nge 'dzin gye lam rnyed nas/ /dngos grub kyang ni thob par 'gyur/ /dngos grub khyad par ma thob kyang / /phra mo la sogs thob par 'gyur/ /mtshan ma'i lung ston phra mo 'byung / /gal te de ltar ma gyur par/ /tshe dbang ma thob rnal 'byor pas/ /sgrib pa rnams ni byang gyur nas/ /skye ba phyi ma la sogs su/ /dngos grub kyang 25—1010

ni thob par 'gyur/ /yang na sngags kyi mthu rnams kyisakye / /sdig sgrib rtsad nas ma chod kyang / /che long rags pa mgo bcom nas/ /gzhan dag mi skye mgo gnon zhing / /dam tshig ma nyams bshags la brtson/ /smon lam dge rtsa bsngo legs pas/ /skye ba 'di rjes gzhan dag tu/ /dus dang gnas dang slob dpon dang / /grogs dang phyag rgya man ngag sogs/ /skyes ma thag tu rnyed par 'gyur/ /de ru dam tshig ldan sogs pas/ / rim gyis du skye bdun brgyud pyanas su/ /'bad rtsol drag po ma byas par/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'gro bar gsungs—/ /de sogs lung bstan sbyor ba rnams/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi lung ston du/ /rnal 'byor mkhas pas ④shes par bya/ /'di ni blo dman don ched du—/ /cung zad bsdus te bstan pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis kyelung ston kyang / /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa/ /'jig rten 'das pa gnyis yod de/ /sa nas rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dang / /bde gshegs byin rlabs kye mkha' 'gro'o/ /mkha' 'gro de dag gnyi ga yang / /mdzes pa'i gzugs dang mi mdzes pa'i/ /gzugs ni sna tshogs sprul nas ston/ /de la 'jigs pedang mi 'jigs dang / /re dang dogs pa'i sems spangs te/ /phyag rgya brda la sogs pa yis⑤/ /ston pa'i dus su las rnams ni/ /ston par shes par ma gyur na/ /dngos grub med de nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan cher bskyed khul/ /man ngag thos pa che ba gces/ /thos pa che bar ma gyur yang / /gang sgrub rgyud skor la sogs la/ /slob dpon la ni yang nas yang / /the tshom chod par mnyan par bya/ /rgyud rnams thos par mi nus pas/ /sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bcu bdun po/ /shes par ṅghade ni ma byas na/ /dngos grub 'grub par mi 25—1011

'gyur ro/ /slob dpon la ni brten pa yis/ /ma tshang yang ni 'grub par gsungs / /'jig rten pa la gnyis yod do/ /rgyal bas bka' la btags pa yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdud ni nag po la sogs pa / /dam la ma thogs bar gyechod mkhan/ /de ltar gnyis su ma shes na/ /dngos grub thob kyang slar la 'tshorathu/ /de gnyis gzugs dang rtags sogs nga// /gong ma bzhin du ston pas na/ /de yi rim pa gong bzhin bya/ /de dag brtags pa'i grucho ga yang / /zhag gsum zhag bdun rtsa gcig tu/ /re dogs la sogs thams cad kun/ /spangs nas rnal 'byor ting 'dzin la/ /nan tan du ni brtson 'grus bya/ /tshogs 'khor la sogs yang dang yang / /byed pa'i dus su rdo rje glu/ /len cing phyag rgya sogs bstan pas/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya gsal ba dang / /mtshan ma la sogs gsal 'bar zhing / /gzugs dang sgra dang dri la sogs/ /thams cad brtan zhing mi 'gyur na/ /lha yi mtshan mar shes par bya/ /de las bzlog pa thams cad kun/ /bdud kyi rtags su shes par bya/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /mkha' 'gro'i lung du bstan pas na/ /'dir ni sgrub po'i don du bsdus/ /sgrub pa'i cha rkyen man ngag rnams/ /sgrub po nyams su len pa la/ /bstan zhing spel na bsod nams 'phel/ /nyams su mi len ser sna can/ /rdzas dang lus srog la sogs pa/ /bla ma la ni 'bul mi nus/ /de la man ngag bstan mi bya/ /de la man ngag bstan pa na/ /dngos grub nyams te sdeg pa 'phel/ /dam tshig nyams nas mkha' 'gros gsod/ /cha rkyen la sogs bcu bdun po/ /ston pa phyag na rdo rje yis/ /sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la/ /rna ba brgyud pa'i 25—1012

gdams ngag de/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la bstan/ /des ṣ+pe ro langs ma la bstan—/ /gnod sbyin phyag na rdo rje dang / /slob dpon phyag na rdo rje yis/ /brgyud pa'i gdams ngag rim pa rnams/ /nan tan gyis ni btsal khyebar bya/ /de la btsal dhib ma shes na/ /dper na yid bzhin nor bu ni/ /klu rgyal gtsug ①nas rnyed nas ni/ /'dam rdzab nang du stor ba bzhin/ /de bzhin man ngag rin chen 'di/ /lus ngag yid gsum dka' ba yi/ /sgo nas slob dpon la btsal nas/ /dam med rmongs pa'i lag shor na ④/ /dngos grub mi thob nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan bskyed de btsal/ /lung bstan pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ka'o/ /slob dpon chen po bha bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //lo tsā ba tshul khrims gzhon nus bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa5 // //bsdur mchan/1༷༷4 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7nga bstan sbyor ba'i man ngag slob dpon chen po bha bas mdzad pa bzhugs so// ke 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(4/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skal/1༷༷5 lku 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngagazhan/ tre〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉yon/ — 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasgrub/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thams/khya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/ 'u〈〈snar 〉༅mongs/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dze+e/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/1༷༷6 ṭ+wā〈〈snar 〉shed/ ṭ+wā〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zadad/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snyen/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzal/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngonas/ ṣ+pe〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thabyung / 8〈〈snar 〉tha dag1༷༷7 ①〈〈snar 〉sprodas/ ldu rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodang / 〈〈pe 〉7sa/ de〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdengs mi 'dzums/phyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgoms/ rngu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dze/ ༄ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phrong / 6〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasgom/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyud/1༷༷8 ①〈〈snar 〉zadadzoms/ lce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sko4na/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ams kyis/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ams 25—1013

༄ga /rdo rje las kyi tshogs rim par bye ba'i cho game༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra karma saṃ gha kra mot+ta ṭa bi dhiḥhūṃ/ bod skad du/ rdo rje las kyi tshogs rim par phye ba'i cho ga /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bsnams pa la dad cing gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can la ni phan pa'i phyir/ /las kyi tshogs ni bdud rtsi mtshungs/ /rgyud rnams kun las btus nas ni/ /bdag gis sgrub pa'i 1don du bshad/ /las rnams thams cad ci byed kyang / /gtor ma'i las 'di grogs su 'gyur/ /de bas gtor ma sngon la bshad/ /gtor ma'i las rnams kun la yang / /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /tshigs bcad rdzas kyi nus pa'i mthus/ /de lnga tshogs na las rnams 'grub/ /de yang ting 'dzin rgyal po'i rgyal/ /bram ze sngags kyi nus mthu can/ /rje'u rigs phyag rgya nyid dang mthun/ /tshigs bcad tha mal spyod pa 'dra/ /rdzas ni kun gyi gzhi rjerten 'gyur/ /de yang spyi dang khyad par ro/ /25—1015

spyi ni kun gyi nus hūṃmathu can/ /nus pa drag po 'byin pa yin/ /khyad par so so kun la yang / /nus pa che chung rim pa 'byung / /de yi rnal 'byor rim pa yang / /las dang po ni mos pa 'jog /dngos grub phra mo phrin byelas dbang / /ye shes phra mos phrin las rdzogs/ /ye shes can ni de nyid 'thob3/ /yang dag pas ni bya ba rdzogs/ /rnal 'byor de lnga'i rim pas kyang / /gtor ma la sogs las rnams la/ /ting 'dzin la sogs 'jug thabs lnga/ /man ngag can gyes 4shes par bya/ /de bzhin las rnams kun la yang / /man ngag can gyis sbyar bar bya'o/ /gtor ma dbul ba'i rim pa yang / /mgron gyi lha ni gnyis su bya/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa/ /'jig rten 'das la gnyis yod de/ /bde gshegs sprul dang sa la gnas/ /de dag gnyis la'ang spyi dang ni/ /so so'i khyad par shes par bya/ /'jig rten pa la gnyis yod de//spyi dang so so'i khyad par ro/ /spyi ni khams gsum sems can kun/ /khyad par chos skyong srung shām rnams/ /de la khyad par so so la/ /dpag tu med pa yod mod kyang / /dgos pa basbus pa bstan par bya/ /gtor ma'i dzas rnams bstan pa ni/ /thun mong rdzas dang khyad par rdzas/ /thun mong drug cur sbyar zhes bya/ /khyad par bdud rtsi rnam lnga dang / /dkar gsum mngar gsum la 6sogs dang / /sha sna khrag la sogs pa dang / /mgrin )gyi skabs dang sbyar bar bya/ /ting 'dzin bstan pa'i rim pa yang / /bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar bskyed bye la/ /mtshan dang ldan pa'i snod mchog tu/ /nyi zla'i gdan bsam bdud rtsi bsam/ /sa bon las bskyed klu/des su mtshan3/ /de 'og me dang rlung ni bsam/ /de yi steng du rdo rje bsam/ /de yi steng du ri bong can/ /25—1016

—yi ge oṃ gyis mtshan pa yin/ /hūṃ bskyed tsopas ni rlung byung rngu bas/ /me 'bar bdud rtsi dros ṣ+pepar 'gyur/ /oṃ gyis choye shes bdud rtsi phab/ /rdo rjes dkrug cing 'bru gsum ⑤bzlas/ /dri med dag pa'i bdud rtsir gyur/ /de ni thun mong ting 'dzin yin/ /khyad par so so'i skabs su bstan/ /thun mong gi ni sngags bstan pa/ /oṃ budhe ⑦ḍā ki nī ⑦sarba ba lo ta kha kha khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ke nī sarba ba bo ta kha kha khā hi/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī sarba ba bo ta kha kha khā hi/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī sarba ba lo ta kha kha khā hi/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki be+e sarba ba lo ta kha kha khā hi/oṃ sarba ḍā ki m+bi sarba ba bo ta kha kha khā hi/ khyad par gyi sngags bstan pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki bya ba khyer tsi/ rū khrupa kā kā gya tsi la kā la rū 1pa/ i oṃ ba lo kṛdze+e 1) tu sa ma yi rak+ṣan+tu ya dze+eṣ+ṭi sarba sedhim+bi pra yats+tshan+tutso1/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/tshigs bcad kyi ni rim pa yang / /spyi dang khyad par gnyis su bstan/ /spyi yi tshigs bcad bstan pa ni/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag klong dkyil nas/ /smon lam thugs rje'i skyedabang gis na⑫/ /mkha' 'gro mi bzad ⑫sku sprul nas/ /'jigs skyabyed 'jigs pa'i sku 'chang ma/ /sku la bsgribs 7pa mi mnga' yang /'gro ba sems can don slad du/ /bdud rtsi la sogs skugasol mdzad ma/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /bud+dhā mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ba/ /smug nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /stobs ldan drag shul sku 'chang ma/ /sku yi stobs ldan mthu chen las/ /sku yi lha mo'i sprul pa 'gyed/ /bud+dhā mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas rnams/ /yang sprul smug mo 'bum gyis bskor :5/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma/ /mthing nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /thugs mchog 'bar ba'i 25—1017

rigs ldan ma/ /mi 'gyur thugs kyi dpal be+e'u nas/ /thugs kyi lha mo sprul pa 'gyed/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas rnams/ /'khor du nag mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma/ /ser nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /yon tan rgyas pa'i rigs ldan ma/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i mdzod spu nas/ /rin chen rigs kyi sprul pa 'gyed/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas rnams/ /'khor du ser mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /dgyes pa'i tshul kyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma/ /dmar nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /gsung 1mchog 'bar ba'i rigs 37ldan ma/ /dri med gsung gi bum pa nas/ /gsung gi lha mo'i pesprul pa 'gyed/ /sgra rnams sgogs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor du dmar mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma//ljang nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /las rnams mdzad pa'i rigs ldan ma/ /phyag zhabs pad+ma'i 'khor lo las/ /las kyi lha mo'i sprul pa 'gyed/ /drag shul las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor du ljang nag 'bum gyis bskor/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /mkha' la 'gro ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /rdo rje nam mkhar —'gro ma rnams5/ /sa la 'gro ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /rdo rje sa 'og 'gro ma dang / /bar snang 'gro ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang shugs 'gro ma/ /ma mo'i tshogs dang sring mo'i tshogs/ /nag mo dbang phyug tshogs rnams kun/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa klog phreng skyenas 25—/0/8

'byung ba'i rgyud bzhin du gtong kyesna/ngo / /khyad par so so'i tshigs bcad ni/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /bya rog 27gzugs can 'jigs pa'i gzugs—/ /pad+ma la gnas khwa ④gdong ma/ /thod pa kha ṭī ga yis brgyan/ /gri gug gcod mdzad thod khrag 'thung / /phyag bzhi de bzhin rol pa mdzad/ /zhal gyi nga ros bdud rnams brgyal/ /spyan gsum smin ma'i dkyus ldan ma/ /spyan gsum 'od kyis khams gsum gsal/ /rol pa'i 'dug stangs gar dang ldan—/ /sgeg pa la sogs ro ldan pa/ /gar gyi spyod ldan mkha' 'gro ma/ /khro bo'i rgyal po stongs chen rnams/ /sbyor ldan tshul gye 5'khor gyes bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus thams cad kyang / /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo sa spyod ma/ /khye yi gdong can 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /spyan mig glog 'gyu stong mdzad ma/ /zhal gdangs pas ni khams gsum rngubakyi/ /phyag gi gar gyis dgyes par mdzad/ /sgu yi sgeg pas rol par hūṃldan/ /zhabs kyis 'byung po zil gyis 8gnon/ /drag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyes 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /sa 'og gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /gau rī nag mo chen mo ni/ /nya yi gdong can 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /spyan gsum 'od zer 'bar ba yis/ /khams gsum ma lus skrag par byed/ /zhal gyis sa 'og sems can gsol/ /phyag gi gri yis nyams rnams gtubs(/ /zhabs rnams rol pas sa 'og gnon/ /gar gye 'gying tshul la brtson pa/ /ha ha hi hi sgra sgogs ma/ /drag po'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgyes pa'i tshul kyis 7'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /phyogs skyong 11gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /thod pa 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /25—/019

rdo rje hūṃ bdag gtso bdag mdzad/ /sdigs mdzub khyerdo rje 'gyeng bag can/ /shin tu mi bzad 'jigs mdzad ma/ /spyan ni sngon po'i mdog dang ldan/ /'bar ba /sngon por rab tu khyab/ /zhabs ⑦bskum tshul gnas ma mo gnonage / /de 'khor phyogs skyong thumakha' 'gro ma/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi tshangs pa mo/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum gar la brtson/ /rngub dang skrag dang 'dzin pa'i las/ /phreng ba spyi drugs bsnams pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /sgo na gnas pa'i khyab 'jug ma/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum gar la brtson/ /rngub dang skrag dang 'dzin pa'i las/ /'khor lo pad+ma bsnams pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /nub na gnas pa'i gzhon nu ma/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum gar 'a/ brtson / /rngub dang skrag dang 'dzin pa'i las/ /rtse gsum phreng ba bsnams pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /byang na gnas pa'i gshin rje ma/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum gar la brtson/ /rngub dang skrag dang 'dzin pa'i las/ /dbyug pa mi mgo bsnams pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /me yi phyogs na gnas pa'i tsa muṇ+ḍimu/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum gar la brtson/ /rngub dang skrag dang 'dzin pa'i las/ /'khor lo seng ge bsnams pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /srin po'i phyogs na gnas pa'i tsa muṇ+ḍihūṃ/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum gar la brtson/ /rngub dang skrag dang 'dzin pa'i las/ /ral gri 9rgyal mtshan bsnams pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis sbyi'adir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /dbang 25—1020

ldan mtshams na gnas pa'i dbang ldan ma/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum gar la brtson—/ /rngub dang skrag dang 'dzin pa'i las/ /mdung thung thod pa bsnams pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /rlung gi phyogs na gnas pa'i rlung lha motsosna/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum gar la brtson—/ /rngub dang skrag dang 'dzin pa'i las/ /gos dang thod pa bsnams pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas rnams/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo thang spyod ma/ /khyu mchog rdo rje 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /de yis 1thugs las sprul pa mo/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo mthu mo che/ /ro langs ma ni za la dga'/ /gtum mo 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can/ /seng ge chen mo mchod byed ma/ /stag mo chen mo 'khyug byed ma/ /'ug gdong chen mo mun pa 'joms/ /ce 4spyang ma ni khrag tu za/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo 'khor bcas kyang / /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo gzhon nu ma/ /sku mdog ser mo 'od zer 'bar/ /'od zer phreng ba stong phrag 'phro/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi dbu rgyan can/ /mya ngan med pa'i me tog phreng / /dbu la mdzes pa'i rgyan du byas/ /zhal gsum phyag drug mthu mo che/ /sgeg cing rol dang bcas pa mo/ /gzhon nu chen mo 'khor bcas kyang / /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo lhag sdud ma/ /dur khrod brgyad kyi 5dbus gnas pa/ /bcom ldan 'khor ba sgol ba'i mchog /dar bab lo yi na tshod gnas6/ /ljang bu'i pemadog can 'gying bag can/ /gru gsum nang gi phyogs dag na/ /ye 25—1021

shes can dang mkha' 'gro ma/ /skyon ma gos pa'i gos dkar mo/ /nyon mongs 'khru byed mā ma tī/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab cing drag /mkha' 'gro chen rmo/ khyed bzhi yang / /lhag sdud rnams kyi gtso mor grags/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo lhag sdud rnams/ /dur khrod brgyad kyi phyogs dag na/ /kha ṭī ga dang mgo 'a/ sogs / /thod pa rnams kyis yongs su brgyan/ /shing gcig dang ni ldan pa nyid / /khra dang khyi dang spyang ki ①dang / /seng ge stag dang byi la dang / /bya rgod la sogs 'khor gyis bskor/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis/ /mnyes par spras pa'i gzugs 'dzin ma/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo keng rus ma/ /drag po gri gug snod thogs pa/ /gri gug gcod pa'i las mdzod cig /thod pa'i khrag ni 'thung bar byed/ /skra bshig pa la spyan gsum pa⑤/ /yi dwags zhal du rngub par byed/ /drag po mi bzad gsus pa 'phyang / /thod pa 'bar ba'i rgyan dang ldan/ /rgyu ma'i phreng bas nges par brgyan/ /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /mi yi rus pa'i phreng ldan pa'i/ /ska rags khrag gi thig le can/ /yi dwags klad pa ④tshil dang zhag /lus la byug zhupa la dgyes pa//lag 'gro chen mo'i rna cha can/ /brang 'gro'i rkang gdub 'jigs rung ba/ /kha dog dkar po 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /gzi brjid thub pa dag pa yisa'u / /shin tu mi bzad tsho)khros pas ni/ /gnod sbyin la sogs sdogs bye par byed/ /ha ha chen po'i sgra sgrogs pa/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo dud sol gdong / /de 'dra'i mkha' 'gro dpag sked dang / /sha za la sogs 'khor gyis bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus thams cad kyis/ /'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /las rnams ma lus myur du mdzod/ /khyed 25—1022

kyis 1las rnams mdzad tshul ni/ /rgyal ba shāka thub bstan pa la/ /gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bsrung ba dang / /bstan pa gnyen po bsrung ba dang / /nad rnams ma lus bzlog pa dang / /de la sogs pa'i las rnams kun/ /myur du mdzad cing srung chadu gsol/ /gzhan yang bcol ba'i las rnams ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang / /rgyal khams yongs su smod pa dang / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog dang / /gsang sngags theg chen smod pa dang / /rnal 'byor spyi yi dgrar gyur rnams/ /mkha' 'gro khyed kyis myur du sgrol/ /sha za mo ni 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dur khrod gnas pa'i shing gcig la/ /rtse mor gnas bcas kun du blta — / /gcer bu skra bshig sha za ma/ /rtag tu sha ni za bar byed/ /sha za 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs mchod pa dam pa bzhes/ /mkha' lding rgyal po gser mig can/ /gdong gcig pa la lag bzhi pa/ /kha dog dkar po'i 'od chen ldan/ /gser gyi gshog pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /nor bu be+e ḍūr+ya yi mchu④/ /rkang gzer byi ru las byung ba/ /shel ltar dkar ba'i mdog dang ldan / /skye ba'i gnas su bdud rtsis bkang / /phyag gis 5bum 'dzin phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'od zer dmar po'i tshogs kyis ni/ /mkha' lding dbang phyug 'khor bcas spros/ /gshog zur brgyab pas rgya mtsho skemasathu/ /klu rnams ma lus zas su za/ /mkha' lding rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs mchod pa dam pa bzhes/ /klu yi rgyal po gzi brjid can/ /klu chen brgyad du skus ⑦sprul pa/ /klu chen rgyal po nor rgyas bu/ /sku mdog dkar po skyon ma gos/ /shar phyogs klu rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /sbrul mgo can la phyag 25—1023

—'tshal bstod/ /klu yi rgyal po 'jog po ni/ /sku mdog ser po sbrul mgo can/ /byang phyogs klu rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /sbrul zhags bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod / /klu chen rgyal po stobs kyi rgyu/ /sgu mdog dmar po sbrul mgo can/ /nub phyogs klu rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu chen rgyal po pad+ma'i rgyal/ /sku mdog sngon po sbrul mgo can/ /sgo phyogs klu/ rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /yon tan rgyal lkul phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu chen rgyal po pad+ma che/ /sku mdog dkar ser sbrul mgo can/ /dbang ldan klu rnams/ 'dul mdzad pa/ /skyon ma gos la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu chen rgyal po dung skyong ni/ /sku mdog dkar sngo sbrul mgo can/ /shar lho'i klu rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /dug rnams 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu chen rgyal po rigs ldan ni/ /sku mdog sngon —dmar sbrul mgo can/ /lho nub klu rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /stobs po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu chen rgyal po pad+ma 'khyel / /sku mdog dmar ser sbrul mgo can/ /nub byang klu rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /nad rnams sel la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ mtha' yas dang ni nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / / dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang / /zulha mo lha mo chen mo dang / /zla ba spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /be con 'dzin dang be con che/ /snying po med dang gu 4la ti/ /dga' bo dang ni nyer dga' dang / /rgya mtsho dang ni rgya mtsho che/ /gdung ba dang ni gdung chen mo/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs bzang dang / /gzugs chen sbrul bzangs lto 'phye choche/ /smig rgyu dang ni smig rgyu che/ /klu chen brgyad zhwapo 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir 25—1024

gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /dpal ldan mgon po nag po che/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig pa/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum 'byung po 'dul//mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal lo hūṃ/ /nam mkha'i gos can mthu bo che/ /stag gi pags snyepa'i sham thabs can/ /sprul dang thod pa'i phreng bar ldan/ /mthu chen thob la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mche ba gcigs pa mi bzad pa/ /thod pa'i phreng ba bkod byepa yis/ /mgrin pa rkang pa rnam 5brgyan pa/ /mi bzad thod phreng can la bstod/ /smin ma kham pa'i smin 'khyug 6can/ /spyan gsum gyes ni rnam par spras/ /khams gsum la ni gzigs pa'i rtags/ /sku gsung thugs ldan khyod la bstod/ /dang po spyan ni nag po mtshungs/ /g.yas pa sngon por snang ba ste/ /g.yon pa dmar por shin tu mdzes/ /gsal bar mkhyen la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes spyan ni gsum po yang / /mi 'gyur phrin las chags pa'i rtags/ /nyi ma khri dang mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /'od ldan 7 khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i mthu ldan pa'i/ / phyogs bcu'i trī'agro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /shes rab ral gri rnon po yis/ /nyon mongs gcod mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rjes 9'bar ba'i tho ba yis/ /dgra bgegs thal bar zlog mdzad pa/ /rtse gsum 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyes/ /dug gsum rtsad gcod khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rgyud sbreng la ni brtson gyur pa/ /mkha' 'gro rnams ni bskul ⑫ba'i rtags/ /g.yas kyi thabs kyi phyag rnams ni/ /las rnams mdzad pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /g.yon gyi thod pas khrag bkang ba/ /dgra bgegs zhal du rngub mdzad pa/ /kha ṭī rtse gsum bsnams pa ni/ / nyon mongs gdung ba sel mdzad pa/ /gar gyi thabs kyi phyag rgya ni/ /las la sgul 3 25—1025

mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mi yi pags she7pa khrag 'dzag pa/ /steng gi phyag ni gnyis na bsnams/ /drag po'i las la rol pa'i rtags/ /drag po'i las mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /de yi bka' stod 37pho nya mo/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo mi sdug gdong / /khyod kyis drag po'i las mdzod cig /drag po'i las mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /seng gdong chen mo rtsal mo che/ /'byung po thams cad 'jigs mdzad ma/ /'byung po bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig /sgrol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo glang po'i gdong / /khyod kyi 1stobs kyis bdud rnams 'dul/ /bdud rnams ma lus khyod kyis 'dul/ /bdud 'dul chen mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo dred mo'i gdong / /rdo rje'i sngubrag kyang 'gas par byed/ /brag 'gas chen mo mthu rtsal can/ /mthu rtsal can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo sbrul gyi gdong / /gsod byed gsod byed mthu mo che/ /sman dang dug gi sbyor mkhan ma/ /spyor mkhan ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo byi la'i gdong / /mgyogs byed rtsal dang ldan pa mo/ /gang la bya ba'i don grub ma/ /don grub ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo khye yi gdong 1/ /gtsang sme med par za ba'i mchog /sha khrag dus gsum gsol mdzad ma/ /gsol mdzad ma 6la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo stag gi gdong / /dpal brtul chen mo mthu mo che/ /gsod la dga' ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /gsod bdag chen mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo khyod rnams kyang / /'khor du yang sprul 'bum gyis bskor/ /ha ha zhes pa'i sgra sgrogs shing / /rmongs 7pa rnams ni skrag byed cing / /thod pa'i nang du blugs pa'i khrag /25—1026

'thung bar byed pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /skad cig yud la sgrol bar byed/ /'khor bcas khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal ldan mgon po nag po la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'bul ba ni/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri la sogs pa 'bul gyis bzhes/ /mthun pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ /thug pa nag po'i 'o thug dang / /sbyar ba la sogs mi bzad dbul/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /zlon pa dang ni btsos pa dang / /bsregs pa'i sha yi bye brag rnams/ /mi bzad dbul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /zhag dang klad pa'i tshil rnams dang / /khrag dang glo ba la sogs pa/ /nya la sogs pa mi bzad dbul/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /rgun chang dang ni sbyar ba'i chang 1/ /'bru yi chang la sogs pa dang / /'byeng bu'i chun po mi bzad dbul/ /sgog pa'i bye brag bdun rnams dang / /sgrum khur 'bru la sogs pa dang / /zangs lcags la sogs mi bzad dbul/ /bstan pa bsrung ldeba'i las mdzod cig /gzhan yang mkha' 'gro chen mo rnams/ /spyang gdong ma dang seng gdong ma/ /glang po'i gdong dang byebyi la'i gdong / /khyi gdong ma dang stag gdong ma/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo 'khor bcas la/ /sha khrag gtor ma mi bzad dbul/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /khyed la bcol ba'i phrin 4las ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon sgod pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang / /rgyal khams yongs la gnod pa dang / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog dang / /jeg chen chos la sgod pa dang / /rnal 'byor spyi yi dgrar gyur rnams/ /ma thogs myur du bsgral snodu gsol/ /phyi nang tshul du sku sprul pa'i/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams 25—1027

ni / /so so'i phyogs kyi 'khor skyong ba/ /drag po'i las mdzad rgyal po bzhi/ /yul 'khor skyong gi rigs rnams kun/ /chang spangs pa yi gtor ma long /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin stong la mnga' mdzad pa/ /khyed kyi mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /sha chang la sogs gtor ma long / /rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po/ /grul bum stong la mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /shin tu khrag la dgyes pa'o/ /khrag gis bkang ba'i gtor ma long / /rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang / /klu rnams stong la mnga' mdzad pa/ /'o ma dag la shin tu dgyes/ /'o mas bkang ba'i gtor ma long / /rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas kyang / /'dir gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /dri za'i rgyal po zur phud can/ /spos ngad ldan pa'i rtse la gnas/ /dri rnams zhim pas nyulus la byugs/ /me tog phreng bas lus ni brgyan/ /dri za'i bu mo lus la 'khril/ /sa 'dzin la sogs glu yi ni/ /bye brag bdun gyi 3sgra rnams sgrogs/ /zas su dri rnams za bar byed/ /dri za snye'akhor dang bcas pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs tshul bzhin gtor ma bzhes/ /sha za'i rgyal po mthu bo che/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrogs / /zhal gdangs pas ni sha rnams gsol/ /sha za 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs tshul bzhin gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor chen mo 'phrog ma'i gdong / /mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs su rung / /kha nas lce 'dril mthu mo che/ /gar gyi tshul du mchod mdzad ma/ /gnod sbyin 'phrog 4ma 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs mchod pa dam pa bzhes/ /lha dang lha min rgyal po ni/ /rgyu ba dang ni cher rgyu ba/ /yi dwags rgyu ba nyi ma zla/ /dngos grub gdong dang rgyal po dang / /rta yi rgyal po zla ba'i rgyal/ /lha mo klu 25—1028

mo 'ga' 'ga' dang / /gzugs mdzes skar ma 'dus pa dang / /gza' rnams kun dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /karti ka dang dpal ldan ma/ /lha mo ri bong 'dzin pa nyid/ /lhag ma dang ni lhag ma che/ /lha yi rgyal po lha min rgyal/ / puk+ka sī lce7dang sbom chen mo/ /lha dang lha min rgyal po che/ /'khor bcas ma lus thams cad kyang / /'dir gshegs mchod pa dam pa bzhes/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po chen po ni/ /nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang / /rgyal ba 5bzang po dga' byed phur/ /phur bu che dang pad+ma'i gtsug /thung gi gtsug phud gar dang ni/ /gar chen 'bigs par byed pa dang / /gcod par byed dang gang bar byed/ /nor dang nor min shin tu nor/ /gzugs bzang rol pa rol chen po/ /dgod 4dang rtse ldan rnam par spyod/ /dpal bzangs dang ni gzugs mdzes rnams/ /bde ba chen bo'i bka' 'di yis/ /gnod sbyin gnod sbyin ma 'dir shog /gnod sbyin 'khor 4bcas ma lus kyang / /'dir gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma long / /mkha' 'gro nag mo chen mo ni/ /oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo dang ri 6ri sul phug /grong dang bzhi mdo zhing dang ni/ /khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /sems can gnod dang thang dang ni/ /khyad par du ni chu la gnas/ /nag po chen po drag chen po/ /lha sbyin mnyam du ston pa dang / /nag po gcigs dang 'jigs byed dang / /dga' las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byed mo dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed mo thudang u ma dang / /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ba dang / /mi thub gzhan kyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag mo che/ /nag mo sbom dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba che/ /drag tu sdang dang 'chang ba mo /25—1029

'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jigs byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo/ /mche ba gcigs dang thod chen ma/ /thod phreng 1phreng can kha ṭī ga /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma/ /de nyid chen mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /lus khukun rjes su grub byed ma/ /spyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya chen mo/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso///de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen te/ /rdul med rnal 'byor 'byin pa mo/ /rdo rje dbang po'i bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad kun nas 'dir spyon cigaldu /mkha' 'gro nag mo 'jigs pa'i gdong / /nag mo chen mo'i tshogs kyis bskor//dur khrod kun du rgyug mdzad ma/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong nas/ /skad cig yud la phyin mdzad ma/ / dekhrag gi dri snom mthu mo che/ /'khor bcas 'dir gshegs gtor ma long / /khyed la bcol ba'i phrin las ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig pa dang / /rgyal khams yongs su gnod pa dang / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog dang / /gsang sngags jeg chen smod pa dang / /rnal 'byer spyi yi dgrar gyur rnams/ /ma thogs myur du bsgral du gsol/ /rnal 'byor lcam dral bsrung ba dang / /rims nad yams nad bcad pa dang / /mi mthun rkyen dbang bzlog tu gsol/ /de nas gsang sngags bstan bya ste/ /sngags rnams nus pa'i mthu yis ni/ /dug rnams 'joms shing thams cad sbyang ‘6/ /sngags rnams so so'i tshigs bcad dang / /sbyar ba ru ni shes par bya/ /yang na sngags rnams phyogs gcig gtang / /tshigs bcad kyang ni phyogs gcig gtang 3/ /de ni man ngag skabs shes bya'o/ /skabs rnams de ni ma shes na/ /nus pa'i mthu ni 25—1030

nyams par 'gyur/ /yang na tshigs bcad gcig pus kyang / /gang yin don rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i tshigs bcad don ldan ni/ /sngags dang 'dra ba nyid du gsungs/ /rdo rje tshig gi khyad par gyi/ /sngags kyi lha yi yon tan gyi/ /don rnams kun ni brjod pas su/ /don dam kun rdzob las mi 'da' / /don dam kun rdzob brjod tshig tu/ /sngags mtshon byed pa'i rdo rje'i tshig /de la sngags zhes bya ba yin/ /oṃ na maḥ1shrī badz+ra ḍā ki ya tso/ oṃ ka kā gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a yan twa yan+d+ra ḍā ki bya shan rbag tra ma ho/ bra ga —/dha ma wa / i sha i oṃ ba bo thu/ bhuñdza dzi gh+ra pi pa kṛt+na thuta/ āt+pa shaṃ puṣ+ṭi ku ru/sa ma ya ma nu sma ra a hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shwa na se bhū 6tsa ri ye i oṃ ba bo/ gret+na kṛt+na/ ⑦ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e bye hi ma hā pā la bir+ya bar gra 8snam yo dza na sa hā kyesra bra lo barba pu shaṃ/ ti li ti mi gi li ⑫ma hā nyi miṅgi la bri dzha 1ta yo ma hā mi na a dhi 8pa ti ya a sam+bi hi to 8bha ban+tu/ ma ma a ba ma be ta wa sirnyi ma be+e ta ra na tu swā hā/ oṃ a ā i yī u u ṛ dzā dza shā e i khro au e /⑪aḥswā hā/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba te badz+ra hūṃ ka ra/ tri ṣ+ṭi sarba bhū ta ni stam+bha swā hā/ oṃ brad+me hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ ba sha bi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kau mā rī ya hri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya me hri 0hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ko bī rī ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍi ye hri 1spyoye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ i shābye hri hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ ma bye hri ⑩hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a ā e a a kā ro myu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya /5nut+pan+da tāta rmye oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ mā rī byi ba ra li ba dā rduskyuli bā ra hā mu khi sarba duṣ+ṭa 8 mu khaṃ/ ban+dha ban+dha 2nahūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ i oṃ ba lo 3pra tīts+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā la a ya hi a ā hi / ma hā bi ha ra ba la na barba ḍā ki nī yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa ba ri ba ro/ ad tra 25—1031

shādhi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dza swā hā/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ bak+ṣa bak+ṣa dz+dza dz+dza swā hā // //1de ltar sngags rnams bstan nas ni/ /khyad par byin rlabs 'u bstan pa ni//de nas blo dang ldan pa yis/ /gal te spyor ba gzhan dang bcas/ /tshon chen gyis ni gos dag gam/ /dar la sogs pa gon nas ni/ /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin du/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis mdzes par brgyan/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su/ /las kyi skabs dang bstun te blta/ /'dug stangs la sogs de bzhin sbyar/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa tshul bzhin bsgom/ /myur bar 'dod na rdzus skyes tshul/ /mchod bya sprul dang spyan drang ba/ /gang 'dod pa ni bya ba yin/ /gnyis kas bya bar 'dod pa'ang yod/ /thun mong byin rlabs gong bzhin no/ /khyad par byin rlabs ce bstan pa ni/ /zla ba oṃ ni bsams nas su/ /'od zer stobs kyis rnam rtog sbyong / /nyi mar a ni thubasams nas kyang / /dri ma med par bsam 'upar blta/ /gnyis ka'i hūṃ gis 'od du 'bar//has su bdud rtsi zhu bar bsam/ /yi ge ram̐ gyis mtshan ma bsregs/ /yi gis bdud rtsi dri rnged 'gyur/ /oṃ gyis gang 'dod don rnams 'grub/ /hūṃ gis sbyangs nas āḥs 8su 'bar/ /oṃ gyis rtogs par bya ba yin/ /has su gzugs bcom dhīḥyig nilku/ /ro la sogs pa bcom pa yin/ /hos su bdud rtsi 'bar bar bsam/ /yang na/ dīḥs 7su ro dang hos su dri/ /bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nyid du blta/ /ri rab rdo rjes dkrugs nas kyang / /ye shes bdud rtsi bstem pa 'am/ /hūṃ ni gcig pus sbyang zhing bsreg /ye shes kyang ni des su dbab/ /so so rtsa ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /lan gsum lan bdun brjod pas su/ /sbyang zhing byin gyis brlab pa dang / /sngags rnams so so'i 25—/031

nus mthu ni/ /rgyud rnams so sor snadag nas ni/ /'byung ba dag gis brlab pa 'am/ /sngags ni gong ma len pyazhes bya/ /so so lha yi yig 'brus kyang / /lan gsum lan bdun sbyang ba yin/ /de ltar byin rlabs man ngag rnams/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /byin rlabs 4man ngag skabs dang sbyar / /byen gyis brlabs pa'i las rnams so/ /phyag rgya bcings pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /thun mong phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /rdo rje thal mo'i tshul du ni/ /bcangs nas kha ni dbye ba dang / /rdo rje se gol gtogs la'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i gung mo bsgreng / /mthe chung mthe bos so sor bkug /mdzub mo srin lag cung zad dgug /mkha' lding dgug pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rtse gsum phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /pad+ma sa gdugs stel nas su/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang byebasgreng / /dkar po cung zad bkug pa yis/ /lha min dgug pa'i phyag rgya yinat+ya/ /zla ba snod la reg nas 7ni/ /nyi ma rdo rje khu tshur bcing / /dkar po bsgrengs snyete byin gyis brlab/ /zla ba khu tshur bstan bcings la/ /rnam shes kyang ni sa gdugs brkyang / /nyi ma lag pa legs brkyang ste/ gdengs pa'i tshul du steng du sbyar/ /phyag rgyas snod la reg nga/ra bya/ /khu tshur gnyis ni sbyar nas su/ /snying ga'i phyogs su sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis sbyangs nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /pad+ma dag ni sa gdugs sbrel/ /dkar po'i gi wang sgrog tu bya/ /de bzhin phyag rgyas byen brlab cing / /dgug pa yang ni shes par bya/ /phyag rgya'i man ngag gzhan sogs kyang / /skabs dang sbyar te shes par bya/ /gtor ma'i 25—/035

rdzas rnams so so dang / /maṇ+ḍal la sogs cho ga dang / /de la sogs pa'i man ngag rnams/ /thabs rnams thob pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /sna tshogs gtor mas rgyas par bstan/ /de dang mthun par shes par nyu gtor ma'i las sna tshogs pa'i cho ga ste dang po'o// //tshogs kyi las kyi spyor ka bstan pa ni/ /tshogs kyi bya ba'i rim pa rnams/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lor shes par bya/ /cho ga'i las rnams 'di ru bstan/ /'khor lo phyi nang gsal khyeb la/ /cho ga'i rim pa skabs dang sbyar/ /phyi mchod nang mchod gsang ba'i mchod/ /phyi mchod rim pa bstan pa ni/ /phyi la yang ni gnyis su bstan/ /mi zad dbyebs sgokyi mchod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du shes par bya/ /mtshan ldan dri med snod mchog tu/ /byang chub sems kyi dri med chu/ /dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa'i lha la dbul/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas btang /thungo / /oṃ na mo nī lasba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍal de ba ta nan tā nānaye7/ a ha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa 6sa ma ye hūṃ/ dhū 7/pa nit+yā mi hūṃ/ ā ro '-ika nit+yā mi lduhūṃ/ puste/dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gasgo/ ṣ+pe bi bye/ shasde/ dṛ talku/ na ma pa sa/spar+sha / nan nan rad na/ sarba bstu/ garnyarba kye/ badz+ra lā sre hūṃ/badz+ra mā le hūṃ/ badz+ra gī ti hūṃ/ badz+ra dṛ t+ya hūṃ/ badz+ra dhū ⑩ pe hūṃ/ badz+ra puste hūṃ / badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ hūṃ —/ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ/ re re la yang rdo rje'i glu gsum gsum brjod la/ /lha mo dpag med sprul nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa dbul/ /de nas mchod pa nyi shu ni/ /rdo rje glu ni phra mo yis/ /hūṃ 25—/036

gi glu dang sbyar bar bya/ /de nas pad kor sngon 'gro ba'i/ /sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang / /pi wang tshul gyis 'bud pa dang / /gling bu'i tshul gyis 'bud pa dang / /sil snyan tshul gyis dkrol ba dang / /brdab 1pa'i tshul gyis rdebs pa dang / /gar gyi tshul gyis yan lag bskyod/ /rlung gi 2tshul gyes g.yob pa dang / /rgyal mtshan tshul gyis bsgreng ba dang / /bla re'i tshul gyis bre ba dang / /ba dan tshul gyis sgeg pa ④dang / /cang te'u'i 5tshul gyis rdebs pa dang / /gdugs kyi tshul gyis dbub pa dang / /rnga yi tshul gyis 6 'dzum pa dang / /gar gyi tshul gyis gar byed dang / /khro bo'i tshul gyis khro ba dang / /sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang / /'gying ba'i tshul gyis 'gying ba dang / /mda' 'dren bum pa ṣ+ṭa'akhyud pa dang / /rdo rje gsor zhing phyag 'tshal ba'i/ /tshul gyis 'dud par byed pa ste/ /phyag rgya'i mchod pa nyi shu nyid//rdo rje dril bu rol bcas pa'i/ /glu yi sgra yis dga' bar bya/ /lha mo dpag sked sprul nas ni/ /ji ltar mnyes pa'i mchod pa dbul/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga po nyid/ /lha gsum gyis ni bsgrubs nas kyang / /mtshan ldan sgod mchog bkram nas kyang / /nyi ma pad+mar gzhag 4par bya/ /rdo rje srin mtheb sbyar nas kyang / /thigs pa'i gtor ma kun la dbul/ /rnal 'byor shes rab gar rnams bskor/ /yang na bzlog pas thabs kyang de/ /lan gsum mchod pas gnas gsum gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi lha gsum mnyes/ /rdo rje glu dang ldan pa yis/ /sngags ni lan gsum brjod par bya/ /so so'i 9rtsa ba'i sngags mtha' la/ /bdud rtsi'i sngags ni gdab par bya/ /de nas lcags kyu lnga po ni/ /gong ma bzhin du dbul bar bya/ /lha mo drug gi mchod pa ni/ /gzugs kyi 25—1037

rdo rje'i lha mo ni/ /gzugs brnyan bzhin du rgyas mdzad ma/ /kha dog dbyibs ldan mchod pa dbul/ /bde gshegs spyan mchog rgyas gyur cig /sgra yi rdo rje lha mo ni/ /gsung dbyangs yan lag brgyad ldan pa'i/ /sgra snyan yid 'ong mchod pa dbulahūṃ/ /bde gshegs snyan mchog rgyas gyur cig /rdo rje lha mo dri ldan ma/ /dri zhim bdug spos ngad bsung treldan/ /dri zhim yid 'ong mchod dbul bas/ /shangs kyi mchog rnams rgyas gyur cig /rdo rje lha mo ro ldan ma//ro mchog rgyas zuldan mdzes pa 'di/ /yid 'ong dpag med mchod pa 'bul/ /bde gshegs ljags ni rgyas gyur cig /rdo rje lha mo reg ldan ma/ /na bza' li 5ka mdzes pa bsnams hūṃ/ /yid 'ong dpag med mchod pa 'bul/ /bde gshegs sku rnams rgyas gyur cig /rdo rje lha mo chos ldan ma/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i chos sgogs ma/ /yid 'ong dpag med mchod pa 'bul/ /bde gshegs thugs mchog )rgyas gyur cig /sems dpa' chen bo dang po mchog /dgyes chen rnams kyi dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun gye bdag /rdo rje snyems pa bdag po'i bdag /thugs kyi 87sems dpa' ting 'dzin mchog /rdo rje'i rdo rje stobs po che/ /kun du bzang po spyod pa'i mchog /bdud kyi bdud sde 'joms pa po/ /sems dpa' kun gyi sems byang chub/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog skyes mchog /rdo rje hūṃ ste hūṃ mdzad pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug nor sbyin pa/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /'dod dang thar pa nor che ba/ /dus gsum srid gsum mchog gsum ste/ /'jig rten gsum mchog khams gsum pa/ /mi rgyu ba ni mchog tu gsol tso/ /shin tu phra dang sbom po'i tshogs / /rgyu ba rnams kyi rab mchog brnyes/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo sbyong 25—1038

mdzad pa/ /thog mtha' med cing gsal ba min/ /shes rab sbud la rnam par gnas / /thugs kyi phyag rgya stoms zhugs pa/ /de nyid rdo rje sems dpa' yi1//rdo rje khro bo khro chen po/ /'jigs pa'i me ni 'dul mdzad pa/ /gdug ༷pa'i mchog ni 'dul ba che/ /drag po'i drag mchog 'jigs byed pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub che/ /chos kyi las chen 'dzin pa po/ /dam chos las ni bzang ba'i lam/ /byang chub sems ni spyod par mdzad/ /thams cad dag tu pad+ma che/ /shes rab thabs kyi nor che ba/ /'dod chags dag pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /sna tshogs chags pa'i dbang phyug che/ /nam mkha' mtha' las brtags ④pa'i don/ /sems can kun gyi gnas chen po/ /dpal gye byong ba 'byor pa'i don/ /sems can kun gyi gnas chen po/ /dpal gyi 'byor pa 'byor pa'i rgyal/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dad pas khyed la 'dud bkyis pas/ /bdag sems rdo rje sems grub mdzod/ /rdo rje lha mo'i mchod pa dang / /te na te te hūṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang gtang ngo / /dang po 'dren pa'i tshigs bcad ni/ /'khor lo nyid dang mthun par bya/ /bstod pa la sogs rgyas par bya'o/ /tha ma 'dren pa'i tshigs bcad ni/ /dam tshig spyod pa thams cad la/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni sbyin par bya/ /ltos shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos/ /'di la je tshom byar mi rung / /khye dang bram ze gdol pa gsum/ /rang bzhin gcig pas lhan cig bza'/ /pad+ma'i gar ༄skor sngon 'gro bas/ /gzhan gyis de bzhin bzung nas kyang / /spom pos chung ngu mnan nas kyang / /lhag ma rtse gsum lta bur bya/ /nyi mar zla ba bzhag nas 25—1039

ni / /tshigs bcad 'di ni rjes su bzla/ /rin thang med pa'i dam pa'i chos//'dod chags dri bral legs 'ong cing / /gzung dang mtshan ma rnam spangs pa/ /de nyid gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rnal 'byor so so yis lku/ /nang gi 'khor lo gsal bsgoms nas/ /khrus ni rnam gsum bya bar gsungs/ /de nas rdurnal 'byor ci dgar rol/ /rdo rje sme gdung bshags pa ni/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos/ /bla ma yi dam lha dang ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa'i spyan lam du/ /sdom pa gsum la gnas pa dang / /khyad par nang gi sdom pa ni/ /bsngo zhing bgrang bar khas blangs nas/ /tshul bzhin ma gyur bshags par bgyi/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la/ / gshe zhing khyasmad pa la sogs bshags/ /bde gshegs bka' yi thuchos rnams la/ /gzhung bzhin ma gyur 'khrul pa bshags/ /rnal 'byor lam gcig spun rnams la/ /rtsod pa la sogs bgyis pa bshags/ /snying rje'i yul gyur sems can la/ /snying rje la sogs spangs pa bshags/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /byang sems phyi nang spangs pa bshags/ /rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' la/ /smad cing spangs par gyur pa bshags/ /ma smin pa yi sems can la/ /man ngag gsang ba bsgrags pa bshags/ /phung po lha 5yi dkyil 'khor la/ /smad cing spangs pa la sogs bshags/ /rang bzhin 3dag pa'i chos rnams la/ /the tshom la sogs bgyis pa bshags/ /bstan pa la gnod sems can la/ /ma bsgral byams pa bgyis pa bshags/ /chos nyid spros dang bral ba la/ /yod med mtshan mar brtags pa bshags/ /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /sems sun phyung bar byas pa bshags/ /dam tshig rnams las 7thams cad 'byung / /25—1040

ma brten bgrang bsngo ma bgyis bshags/ /bud med shes rab rang bzhin la/ / ma smin 37spangs pa la sogs bshags/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig ji snyed kun/ /tshul bzhin ma bsrungs rngo ma thog3/ /bde gshegs bka' dang ma mthun pa/ /ji snyed bgyis pa de dag kun/ /rdo rje slob dpon yi dam lha/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams dang / /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la/ /'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /rnal 'byor 1byin rlabs 4ma bgyis par/ /nan rtags 'jug pa bkyis pa bshags/ /bla ma'i man ngag ma thob par/ /nan rtags chos rnams bgyis pa bshags/ /mi zab lam gcig spun rnams la/ /rtsod pa la sogs bgyis pa bshags/ /gsang ba'i 5man ngag shes gyur kyang / /snod ldan rnams la ma bstan bshags/ /dad dang ldan pa'i sems can la/ /chos rnams log par bstan pa bshags/ /rnal 'byor la sogs mi shes par/ /sngags par nga rgyal bgyis pa bshags/ /lta ba spyod pa mi gcig pa'i/ /nyan thos lam du zhag 'das bshags/ /phyi yi chos bshad yin pa la/ /gsang ba'i chos rnams bshad pa bshags/ /mdor na yan lag dam tshig rnams/ /nyin mtshan bgrang bsngo ma bgyis dang / /bla ma mchod pa la sogs dang / /bshags pa la sogs ma bgyis rnams/ /rdo rje slob dpon yi dam lha/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha rnams dang / /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ /mtshams med mi dge bshags pa dang / /mkha' 'gro ma yi bshags pa ni/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgyud de bzhin bya/ /de la sogs pa'i cho ga rnams/ /man ngag bsdebs su shes par bya/ /tshogs kyi las kyi spyor ka ste gnyis pa'o // // thu25—10/11

sbyin sreg las kyi cho ga ni/ /spyir na sbyin sreg las rnams la/ /sems can rnam rtog ma zad hūṃpar/ /bsam gyis mi khyab gsungs mod 3kyang / /basbus na bcu drug dag tu 'dus/ /de yang bzhi ru 'dus pa na/ /bzhi po re re dag la yang / /rgyas dang bsdus dang shin tu bsdus/ /gsum gsum dag tu shes par bya/ /dang po sa yi cho ga ni/ /brtag pa la sogs rgyas pa yang / /cho ga la sogs gzhan dang mthun/ /bsdus pa'i cho ga bstan pa ni/ /lhag pa'i lha yi ting 'dzin gnas/ /sa yi bdag po rnams la ni/ /gtor ma phul bas sa rnams blang / /khro bo'i las rnams thams cad pa'i/ /phyag rgya bcas nas sngags rnams brjod/ /thugs kyi 'od zer dag gis ni/ /sa rnams sbyang zhing byin gyis brlababye sna/ /shin tu bsnyus pa'i cho ga ni/ /'od zer stobs kyi byin rlabs zukyis/ /thab khung gang 'dod byin gyis brlabathu/ /mtshan ma la sogs dga' ba dang / /rgyas par spro ba'i gang zag dang / /las dang po yi gang zag gis6/ /thab lngarnams bru ba rgyas par bstan/ /mtshan ma la sogs mi dga' la/ /thab — rnams bri 'am me tog dgram/ /rnal 'byor nus pa thob pa yis/ /rin chen snod du bya yang bzod/ /yang na de dag shes rab chung / /rgyas pa mi nus dag la bstan/ /thab 9rnams bru ba'i rim pa yang / /rgya ru ji tsam yod pa'i tshad/ /de yi phyed ni thur la bru/ /yang na sum cha bru ba 'am/ /mtho gang dag tu bru ba 'am/ /rgya ⑩ yi tshad tsam bru ba ni/ /rgyud rnams kun dang mthun par ni/ /mkhas pa yis (1ni shes par bya/ /kha khyer mu ran tshad sogs kyang / /so so'i gzhung dang mthun par bya/ /thab ⑫kyi dbyebs rnams bstan pa yang / /zhi ba la ni zlum por ro/ /rgyas pa gru bzhi'am rin chen 25—1042

dbyebs—/ /dbang la zla gam tshul du'o/ /drag bo gru gsum rnam par bstan/ /mdor na dbang dang drag po gnyis/ /go bzlog par yang shebastan pa yang / /de yis dgongs pas shes par bya/ /gzhan yang thun mong las rnams la/ /zla ba kham pa lta bu 'am/ /go cha rin chen pad+ma dang / /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs su/ /mi 'dra thab kyi dbyibs bstan pa/ /rgyud rnams kun du shes par bya / /tshe bsring la sogs las la bsngagasakhye/ /thab kyi rgya yi tshad rnams kyang //khru bzhi khru gsum khru do dang / /khru gang khru phyed sum cha'o/ /de la sogs pa'i tshad rnams kyang / /rgyud dang mthun par shes par bya/ /tshon rnams bri ba'i rim pa yang / /gzhan dang mthun te khyad par ni/ /zhi la dkar te rgyas la ser—/ /dbang la dmar po drag la gnag /las ni thams cad thab khung la//kha dog lnga tshar tshang ba 'am/ /yang na las kyi skabs dang sbyar/ /las ni thams cad pa yi dbyibs/ /a shwad lo ma lta bu dang / /pad+ma 'dab gcig lta bu 'am/ /pad+ma kha phye lta bu 'am/ /kha yi ge sar lta bu 'am/ /de sogs gzhung ni mang yod — /kyang / /rnal 'byor mos la gtso zhes bya/ /gzar bu'i ④mtshan nyid bstan pa ni—/ /yu ba chang pa lnga yi tshad/ /gzar bu'i kong 5bu sor bzhi'i tshadathu/ /mchu yang sor bzhi'i tshad du bya/ /zabs su sor gcig brko ba 'am/ /sor gnyis brko ba so so'i gzhung / /de ni rab yin 'bring ni phyed/ /tha ma de bas cung zad chung / /khung bu che chung mtshan nyid do/ /yu ba'i tshad ni mnyam zhes bya/ /rgyud gzhan dag la brten nas ni/ /slob dpon gzhan gyi thugazhung dag gis/ /yu ba yang ni che chung 'dod/ /snyoms 'jug rgyud la brten nas kyang / /yu ba sor ni nyi shu bzhi/ /khung bur rgyar ni sor bzhi la/ /zabs 25—1043

—su sor gnyis kho na ste/ /mchu yang rdo rje rtse gsum dbyibs/ /sor bzhi'i tshad du shes par bya/ /las ni thams cad gzar bu yang / /pad+ma'i dbyibs sam 'dab ma'i dbyibs/ /mchu yang pad+ma'i 'dab 'dra dang / /a shwa 1rdo rje'i rnam par ro/ /zhi ba la ni zlum po ste/ /rgyas pa la ni gru bzhi'o/ /dbang ni zla gam lta bu ste/ /drag po gru gsum rnam par bya/ /bye pad+ma khro bo rdo rje bri / /yang na/ rgyud gzhan dag la brten nas ni/ /slob dpon gzhan dag 'dod gzhung ni/ /sum cha sum cha phri bas su/ /rab 'bring gsum du 'dod pa yin/ /de ni dgang gzar mtshan nyid do/ /blugs gzar mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ /yu ba chang pa lnga yi tshad/ /khung bur rgyar ni sor gnyis la/ /zabs su sor gcig shes par bya/ /de ni rab yin 'azing ni phyed/ /tha ma cung zad chung ba'o/ /yang na slob dpon gzhan dag ni/ /mthe bo sen mo gang las ni/ /rab 'bring gsum ni dbye bar bya'o/ /de rnams so so'i mtshan ma yang / /gong ma bzhin du shes par bya/ /me lha'i mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ /pa ba ka zhes bya ba yi— / /zhi ba'i me lha sku mdog dkar/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor dag la gnas/ /rgyas pa'i me lha sku mdog ser/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor dag la gnas/ /dbang gi me lha sku mdog dmar/ /me yi dkyil 'khor dag la gnas/ /drag po'i me lha sku mdog gnag /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dag la gnas / /de dag kun kha ngamathun par ni/ /zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa ste/ /phyag g.yas dbyug pa mchod sbyin can/ /g.yon pas sriphreng ba ril ba bsnams/ /mi tra zhes pa'i rnge lha ni/ /las rnams kun la bsngags pa ste/ /mid pa ring la gzi mdangs can/ /thor tshugs ser po'i spu can lasahūṃ/ /las la rjes 25byed1014

—mthun kha dog gamahūṃ/ /dud pa lta bu'i mdog tu ste/ /phyag ni bgrang phreng ril ba ni/ /spyi blugs ༷ dag ni bsnams pa yin/ /'jig rten pa yi me lha dang / /'jig rten 'das pa'i me lha dang / /bcu gnyis bzhi ru rtsa sogs ni/ /rgyud kyi nang du shes par bya/ /'jig rten me lha'i thugs kar ni/ /'jig rten 'das pa bskyed pa dang / /'jig rten pa ni sbyangs nas kyang / /dam tshig me lha bskyed pa dang / /ye shes me lha bskyed pa dang / /'jig rten me lha'i khrong pa ru/ /dam tshig me lha bskyed nas kyang / /ye shes me lha bstem pa 'am/ /'jig rten 'das pa nyid la yang / /dam tshig bskyed dang ye shes bstem/ /sprul pa'i me lha nyid kyis kyang / /'jig rten pa dang mthun pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten pa dang mthun par bstan/ /de la sogs pa'i the tshom dang / /me nyid cho ga zin pa dang / /shar lho snyematshams su gnas pa dang / /me lha'i thugs kar bskyed pa dang / /'bar dang gshegs dang stong pa rnams/ /slob dpon man ngag nyid kyis bshad/ /dang pos sa chog rdzogs byas la/ /de nas thab thukyi cho ga bya/ /de nas rdzas rnams rim 5pa dang / /mchod yon kyi ni cho ga bstan/ /de nas shabud shing yam shing dang / /bsags dz+wadang dgram pa la sogs kun/ /gzhan dang mthun par shes par bya/ /tshes grangs dus dang 'dug stangs dang / /rgyan cha la sogs bgo ba yang / /las kyi skabs dang sbyar bar bya/ /bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar 87bskyed nas/ /me lha'i cho ga rgyas par bya/ /me yi cho ga zin nas kyang / /de nas lha yi cho ga bya/ /tha ma mreyi cho gas bsdu/ /me yi rgyas 'debs bzhi po yang / /bsam dang bcings /spudang brjod pa gsum/ /bzhi ka la ni sbyar bar bya/ /thugs kar rdo rje 25—1045

bsams nas kyang / /lag pa'i sor mo bcings nas kyang / /g.yas pa 'bar ba lta bur bya/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā khyu ta dz+wa la sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba dubye shāhūṃ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma ya ste/ ā 2hūṃ/ lce la rdo rje rtse lnga bsams la/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ zhes brjod cing bsam par bya'o/ /rdo rje rgya gram thugs kar bsams nas/ phyag mtshan med par bsam zhing /bcings pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar bsams te/phyag mtshan dang bcas shing bsams pa ni phyag rgya chen bo'o/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas gdab pa ni/ bsam pa tsam du 'dod pa'ang yod/ /thams cad tshang bar 'dod pa'ang yod/ /rgyas 'debs gcig tu 'dod pa'ang yod/ /tha dad rtog pa med pas su/ /ji ltar mos pa gtso bor bya/ /dbang bskur la yang de bzhin no/ /me lha'i bstod pa bya ba yang / /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha//bdag gzhan don grub sa la gnas/ /'dod pa thams cad sprul mdzad pa/ /'dzin byed me lha nyid la 'dud/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bskal pa'i me dpung gzi brjid 'bar/ /nyon mongs thams cad sreg pa'i mchog /ye shes me lha khyod la 'dud/ /me lha rnams kyi gtso chen po/ /'khor rnams 'dul zhing skyong mdzad pa/ /dug rnams 'joms shing mthu ldan pa/ /dug 'joms sman pa khyod la 'dud/ /me lha'i rgyal po gzi brjid can/ /'gro ba mi mthun gdul slad du/ /'dod dgur bsgyur meba'i gzugs ston pa/ /las rnams kun mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /de ni thun mong gi bstod pa'o/ /khyad par gyi bstod pa ni rgyud du shes par bya'o/ /sbyin sreg gi las kyi ④rim pa ste bzhi pa'o / / //25—1046

dang po yi ni rnal 'byor dang / /rdo rje slob dpon byed pas su/ /bdag gzhan tshogs ni bsags pa'i phyir/ /slob dpon la ni srog lus dang / /yul zhing ste bran chung mar bcas/ /sgyu ma'i sems kyis tshophul nas su/ /yang dang yang du gsol btab la/ /man ngag las kyi rim pa 'di/ /nyams su blang zhing je tshom gcadasnye/ /de nas gzhung bzhin spyad par bya/ /de ltar byas na nges par ni/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par 'gyur/ /drang ba'i don ni ma yin no/ /de ltar mi byed ser sna can/ /bdag 'dzin dam pos bzung snanas su/ /slob dpon mnyes par mi 'gyur te/ /slob dpon mnyes par ma gyur na/ /dbang dang man ngag thob mi 'gyur/ /yang na man ngag thob nas kyang / /slob dpon la ni rgyab kyis 4phyogs/ /dam tshig med par 5nyams pa ste / /rdo rje dmyal bar 'tshed par snye'agyur/ /de nas rang gi rgyud brtags la/ /skyon de yod na spang bar bya'o/ /bdag gis 'gro ba'i don du ni / /cho ga 'di brtsams dge ba yis/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams / /bla med byang chub thob par shog /rdo rje las kyi tshogs rim par phye ba'i cho ga /slob dpon bha tsubs mdzad pa sgogs so// //lo tsā ba khu ba bīr+ya bye dang / dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa lags so// //9 25—1047

ga gapha la la ba kun las rgyal/ bas bcu mnga' ba kun mtha/ / / / /sto byu༄ci 'i she 'ig sa rab 'byung gnas sbas pa zhabasag tu bsdus pa gsang ba bdag / / /

1082༄ / /gnod sbyin kyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sbyor ka chen po'i cho ga1 sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye — lālba 2ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā ga na bi dhiḥgru/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi spyor ka chen po'i cho ga /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde 4gshegs thams cad kyis/ /rig sngags gsang sngags bdag po ru/ /dbang bskur 'byung po tshar gcod pa/ /gsang sngags snyud mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /rgyud rnams ma lus kun dang ni/ /rnal 'byor pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dang ni/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud/ /rgyud rnams kun dang mi 'gal phyir/ /man ngag cung zad dran pa 'di/ /blo dman bsgrub pa'i don du ni/ /rnal 'byor cha rkyen bstan par bya/ /sbyor ba'i rim pa dpag med kyang / /sgrub pa po yi don slad 25—/055

—du / /dgos pa bsdus pa bstan pa 'di/ /sgrub po slob dpon dang bral na//spyor ba 'di rnams 1bstan par gsungs/ /de la sbyor ba rim bzhin bstan/ /dang po tshogs gnyis rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid skad cig lhar sprul la/ /snying gar zla ba'i maṇ+ḍal bsam/ /hūṃ gi 'od zer 'phros pa las/ /sgrib pa sbyangs nas phyi nang gsal/ /mdun du zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dang / /pad+ma'i gzugs brnyan gsum mam gcig /la la gzhal yas sprul par 'dod/ /de ru dkyil 'khor bsam pa dang / /bsod nams don phyir spyan drangs bstim/ /bla ma sbyang 2sogs byas nas kyang / /gzhan sogs man ngag bzhin du bya/ /phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ /mtshams med mi dge sdom nyams nas/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa kun/ /sgyu ma'i sems kyis bshags par bya/ /dbe ba kun la rjes yi rang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /rdo rje rnams la lus 'bul lo/ /bsod nams ci bsags thams cad kun/ /byang chub chen por bsngo bar bya/ /tshad med bzhi yang bsgom par bya/ /de nas phyi nang snod bcud kun/ /stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya/ /de nas nam mkha'i chos 'byung la / /yi ge cho 'phrul 'phros pa las/ /'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rim bzhin bskyed / /de yi steng du ri rab bskyed/ /de steng rdo rje rgya gram la/ /'khor lo rtsibs bcu 'bar bas mtshan/ /zla ba'i steng du gnod mdzes sprul/ /yi ge hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las/ /khro bo bcu sprul hūṃ bzhi yi/ /gsang sngags bzlas nas bka' bsgo bya/ /khro bo sprul pas bgegs rnams bkug /yang sgo byesku gsung thugs kyi ni/ /phur bu'i sngags brjod tho bas brdung / /bsregs nas nam 25—1056

mkha' nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas hūṃ gi 'phro 'du yis/ /rdo rje gur dang ra bar 'gyur / /yi ge rgyu 1gyi 'phro 'du las/ /gnod mdzes 'od du zhu nas kyang / /gzhal yas khang ni mdzes par gyurasnye/ /de steng pad+ma 'dab brgyad gdan/ /rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul las/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po la/ /yi ge ā lis mtshan par bya/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po la/ /yi ge kā lis mtshan par bya/ /hūṃ las rdo rje de nyid mtshan/ /byen rlabs —bsnyus nas 'od du zhu/ /de las sgu ni bskyed par bya/ /pad+ma dbus kyi lte ba la/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can/ /shar gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /khro bo rnam par rgyal ba bskyed/ /lho yi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /bcom ldan mgon po nag po bskyed/ /nub kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /lus ngan rgyal po bskyed par bya/ /byang gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /bdud rtsi 'khyel pa bskyed par bya/ /byang shar du ni gnod sbyin bskyed//shar sgo ru ni ro langs ma/ /lho nub rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /nub byang du ni 'jigs byed ma/ /mtshams rnams su ni lha mo bzhi/ /'od skyed ma dang yid 'phrog ma/ /kun bzang ma dang glu sgra ma/ /shar gyi sgo ru srog gcod ma/ /lho yi sgo ru dbugs rngub ma/ /nub kyi phyogs su khrag 'thung ma/ /byang gi phyogs su sha za ma/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bskyed nas kyang / /yi ge hūṃ gi 'od zer dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya'i tshigs bcad sgras/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ /mchod bstod byas nas dam tshig la/ /byen rlabs bstems 4 te dbang bskur ro/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor chen po la/ /thun bzhi thun brgyad bar dag tu/ /bsgoms sanas brtan par gyur pas na/ /las rnams gzhan nam rdzogs rim la/ /gzhug par bya ba kho na yin/ /'khor lo chen po'i sbyor 25—1057

bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mi nus pas/ /lha rnams so so kun la yang / /rgyan gcig pa la sbyor ba bstan/ /dang po gtso bo'i sbyor ba ni/ /bdag nyid skad cig lhar sprul la/ /yi ge hūṃ gi man ngag sogs/ /rim pa bzhin du shes par bya/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul ba dang / /gsol ba gdab cing skyabs su gsol/ /lus 'bul dge rtsa bsngo bar bya/ /tshad med bzhi bsgom stong nyid bsgom/ /stong pa'i ngang las yi ge hūṃ/ /de las phyag mtshan rdo rjer gyur/ /de nyid las ni sgu bskyed do/ /sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig pa/ /mche ba gcigs mdzad spyan mig bzlog /phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams mdzad nas/ /phyag g.yon nam mkha' lding ni bsnams/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum klu la shis/ /g.yas pa rdo rje bsnams 77mdzad nas/ /g.yon pa rtse gsum bsnams pa ni/ /gshin rje dag la shis par bstan/ /g.yas pa rdo rje gsor nas ni/ /g.yon pa dril bu bsgrags pa ni/ /gnod sbyin drag la shis par bstan/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs bstems/ /byin rlabs —dbang bskur byas nas kyang / /thun mtshams bzhir ni brtan par bsgom/ /gtso bo'i spyor ka ste gnyis pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das —rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skad cig lhar sprul thugs ka ru/ /nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ sogs rdzogs/ /phyag 'tshal mchod 25—1058

cing bshags par bya/ /rjes su yi rang la sogs bya/ /stong pa nyid du bsgoms nas kyang / /stong pa'i ngang las cho 'phrul du/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i rngunyi zla'i steng / /de steng hūṃ las rdo rjer gyur/ /rdo rje las ni sku bskyed do/ /khro chen 4khams gsum rnam rgyal ni/ /sku mdog dmar po dbu gsum pa/ /phyag drug dang po rdo rje'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po dgra sta'o/ /bar ma gnyis kyis 'ching byed pa/ /gung mo maze bong ngos btud nas/ /gzhan rnams yongs su brkyang ba yin/ /de nyid snying gar bzung nas ni/ /de 'og g.yas pas zhags pa bsnams—/ /g.yon pa ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /ye shes spyan drangs bstems nas kyang / /byin rlabs 1dbang bsgur byas nas ni/ /thun mtshams bzhi ru brtan par bsgoms④/ /snying ga'i man ngag gsal nas kyang / /lce ni rdo rjer byen gyis brlabs/ /bzlas brjod 'phros 'dus bsnyen pa bya/ /dus grangs mtshan ma thim ⑤pa dang / /bsgrub pa gang 'dod brtsam par bya'o/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i spyor ka ste 'ugasum pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das dpal mgon po nag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skad drug lha ru sprul nas kyang / /hūṃ gi man ngag rdzogs pa yis/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa la sogs bya/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngang nyid las/ /rin chen gdan sogs rdzogs byas la/ /yi ge hūṃ las be+e con gyur/ /de nyid las ni sku rdzogs gyur/ /dpal ldan mgon bo nag po ni/ /sku mdog nag po dud sprin 'dra/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa tsan+dan bing 7chen bsnams/ /g.yon pa zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs ni brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /ye 25—1059

shes mgon po spyan drangs bstem/ /byin rlabs 17dbang bskur la sogs bya/ /de ltar bstan nas bzlas brjod bya/ /mgon po mdun du spyan drangs nas/ /bzlas brjod la sogs sdogs byas la/ /de nas sgrub pa brtsam par bya /mgon po las kyi sbyor ka ste bzhi pa'o// //lus ngan gsung mchog sprul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skad cig lhar sprul hūṃ gis ni/ /spyan drangs la sogs rdzogs byas la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa la sogs bya/ /stong pa'i ngang las pad sogs gdan/ /yi ge hūṃ las mchod rten gyur / /de nyid las ni sgu bskyed do/ /lus ngan sku mdog ljang gu'o/ /zhal gcig phyag g.yas mchod rten bsnams/ /g.yon pa ṣ+pe'u le bsnams pa'o/ /ye shes spyan drangs bstems 2nas ni/ /byin gyis brlab rngo cing dbang bskur ro//bzlas brjod bsnyen pa rdzogs nas ni/ /de nas sgrub pa brtsam par bya'o/ /lus ngan po'i sbyor ka ste lnga pa'o// //khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skad cig lhar sprul hūṃ gis ni//spyor ba la sogs rdzogs par bya/ /de nas phyag 'tshal mchod sogs bya/ /stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i gdan/ /de steng hūṃ las rdo rje'o/ /de nyid las ni sku rdzogs gyur4/ /khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyel pa sku sngon po/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis brang du bsnol/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs bstem/ /byin gyis brlab cing dbang bskur ro/ /bsnyen pa la sogs rdzogs nas ni/ /de nas bsgrub pa brtsam par bya'o/ /25—1060

bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i spyor ka ste drug pa'o// //mkha' 'gro ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro la sogs kyang / /sprul pa dang ni rang rgyud 1kyi/ /man ngag rnams ni shes par bya/ /mdun du sprul dang bskyed pa ni/ /gtso bo'i dbang du bya ba dang / /so so rang rang dbang du'o/ /de rnams cho ga la sogs kyang / /man ngag bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /gnod sbyin kha dog dmar nag la/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa / /g.yas g.yon gri gug cang te'u bsnams27/ /ro langs ma ni sngo skya ste/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /rdo rje be+egs sgog bzung nas ni/ /gung mo srin lag la sogs gsum po hūṃrnams/ /dam por bkug pas yongs su bsdams//mtheb mdzub bzhi rnams rab brkyang ste/ /spyi bor nges par bsnol nas bsdams//rdo rje mkha' 'gro mdog ser skya/ /phyag gnyis spyi bor sbyar nas su/ /me lce'i phreng ba yongs su 'dzin/ /'jigs byed mdog ni sngo nag la/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis pa/ /g.yas kyi dang po glang po bsnams4/ /g.yon pa glang po'i pags pa bsnams/ /de 'og g.yas pa rdo rje bsnams/ /g.yon pa dgra sta bsnams pa'o/ /de 'og g.yas pa lcags kyu bsnams/ /g.yon pa mi mgo rlon pa bsnams/ /gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro de rnams kyang / /gtso bo gos sdon la bskor lhan snye/ṣ+pe'i tshul/ /dkyil 'khor tshul gyis bsgom 6thabs dang / /yang na so so re re dang / /rje khol tshul du gnas nas kyang / /las rnams kun la mngags mupa dang / /yang na sbyor thabs tshul gnas nas/ /gsang mchod 'bul zhing phyag rgya bsgrub/ /gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro ma'i spyor ka ste 25—1061

mkha' 'gro bzhin du 'dir shes bya/ /'od skyed ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgu mdog dkar mo'o/ /phyag gnyis me tog bsnams pa'o/ /yid 'phrog ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /sku mdog ser mo mdzes pa'i tshul/ /phyag gnyis dri yi spos phor 7bsnams/ /kun bzang ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /sku mdog dmar mo mdzes pa'i tshul/ /phyag gnyis zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa bsnams / /glu na sgra can ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /sku mdog sngon mo mdzes pa'i tshul/ /phyag gnyis sgra snyan byegar gyis rol/ /lha mo 'di rnams kun la yang / /dkyil 'khor las dang mchod pa'i tshul/ /gsum pa'i man ngag shes mod kyang / /khyad par mchod pa'i tshul du bstan/ /mchod pa'i lha mo'i sbyor ka ste brgyad pa'o// //sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgo ma'i cho ga la sogs kyang / /gong gi cho ga spyor shes bya'o/ /srog gcod zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /sku mdog mthing ga 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /phyag gnyis tho ba zhags pa bsnams/ /dbugs rngub ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /sku mdog ser mo 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /phyag gnyis hom gzar zhags pa bsnams5/ /khrag 'thung ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /sku mdog dmar mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phyag gnyis gri gug zhags pa bsnams/ /sha za ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /sku mdog sngon po 525—1062

'jigs pa'i tshul/ /phyag gnyis rnon 1bo zhags pa bsnams/ /khro mo 'di rnams spyad tshul yang / /dkyil 'khor las dang spyor ba'i tshul/ /khyad par gsad pa'i las la shis/ /sgo ma bzhi'i spyor ka ste dgu pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bsnams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor blo rnams rim pa yis/ /bsdus rgyas rim pa bstan par bya/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkyil 'khor la/ /dbus dang 'dab brgyad lha dgu'o/ /phyi rim keng rus 'bar bas bskor/ /gru chad bzhi la lha mo bzhi po gnas/ /sgo rnams bzhi la sgo ma bzhi/ /'di ni rnal 'byor rgyas pa'i tshad/ /rnal 'byor bsdus la mos pa yis/ /lha ni bcu gsum bsgom par bya/ /de las kyang ni bsdus 'dod na/ /lha ni dgu po bsgom par bya/ /de las kyang ni bsdus 'dod na/ /lnga dang gsum dang gnyis dang gcig /man ngag cho ga mthong bas bya/ /ma mthong bas ni dam tshig nyams/ /de dag thams cad kun la yang / /tshogs bsag trelha bskyed mkhas pas bya/ /bsdus rgyas kyi spyor ka ste bcu pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bsnams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha rnams mchod pa'i rim pa ni/ /sha chen po las byung ba yi/ /dri mchog dud pa rgyun mi gcadad+ku//bde gshegs shangs la phul gyur pa/ /sgu gsung thugs mchog mnyes gyur cig /sha chen bdug spos dbul ba'o/ /bha ga rang byung me tog 'di/ /yid 'ong nam mkha' khyab tsam du/ /bde gshegs dbu la phul ba yis/ /sku gsung 25—1063

thugs mchog mnyes gyur cig /rak+ta'i me tog dbul ba'o/ /tshil chen dur khrod ras las ni/ /ma rig mun sel sgon ma byung / /bde gshegs spyan la phul gyur pas/ /sku gsung thugs mchog mnyes gyur cig /tshil chen mar me dbul ba'o/ /mtshan dang ldan pa'i ka pā lar/ /rdo rje dri chus bkang nas su/ /bde gshegs thugs la phul gyur pas/ /sku gsung thugs mchog mnyes gyur cig /rdo rje chu yis mchod pa'o/ /mtshan dang ldan pa'i ka pā lar/ /rdo rje dri chen gtams nas su/ /bde gshegs ljags la phul gyur pas/ /sku gsung thugs mchog mnyes gyur cig /dri chen lha bshos mchod pa'o/ /sil snyan 1rol mo dpag med rnams/ /yid 'ong mdzes par sprul nas su/ /bde gshegs snyan la phul gyur pas/ /sku gsung thugs mchog mnyes gyur cig /sgra dang rol mos mchod pa'o/ /rdo rje lha mo 'od skyed bye —ma/ /rdo rje me tog bsnams nas ni/ /mdzes pa'i tshul kyis mchod phul nasnye/ /mchod pa dam pa'i tshul gyis bzhes/ /rdo rje lha mo yid 'phrog ma/ /dri yi dung phor bsnams nas su/ /gser 'od bzhad pa'i tshul gyis su/ /mchod pa dam pa 'bul chogyis bzhes/ /rdo rje lha mo kun bzang ma/ /zhal zas ro mchog bsnams nas su/ /dmar mo bzhad pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo bzhes/ /rdo rje lha mo glu sgra can/ /sgra snyan 5gar gyi rol mo yis/ /'od sngon 'phros pa'i bzhad tshul kyis/ /mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo bzhes/ /sgeg mo la sogs brgyad rnams kyang / /rgyud rnams gzhan dang mthun pas na/ /de bzhin 'dir yang dbul bar bya/ /rdo rje glu rnams mdzes pa yis/ /bstun nas lha la mchod pa 'bul/ /mchod pa'i spyor ka ste bcu gcig pa'o// //25—1064

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha rnams bstod pa'i rim pa ni/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can/ /sku mdog sngon po 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /rdo rje stobs kyis 'byung po 'dul/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod / /rnam rgyal rdo rje khro bo ni/ /dbu gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i gzugs / /sku mdog 'od dmar bgegs rnams bsreg /bdud las rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /nag po'i zhags pa 'dzin mdzad cing / /tsan+dan bing kyegis thams cad 'joms/ /mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lus ngan po ni rgyal po'i mchog /mchod pa'i rten gyes don rnams 'grub/ /ṣ+pe'u le rin chen gter brtan bsnams / /dgos 'dod skong la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khro bo bdud rtsis bdud rnams 'joms/ /phyag rgya sdigs mdzub mdzad pa yis/ /sdang mig mi 'gyur zhe la gnon/ /'od sngon po la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gnod sbyin khro bo 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'od zer can/ /gri gug 'bar bas gcod mdzad ma/ /cang te'u sgogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ro langs ma ni mthu mo che/ /sngo skya rdo rje lcags sgrog sdom/ /phyag rgya spyi bor bsnol mdzad ma/ /ro langs ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma/ /dmar skya me lce phreng ba 'dzin / /rdo rje mes ni thams cad bsreg /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /'jigs byed ma ni thams cad 'joms/ /sngo nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /phyag mtshan drug gis 'byung po 'dul/ /'jigs byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje lha mo 'od skyed snyem/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog 25—1065

dkar / /rdo rje gre tog phyag na bsnams/ /'od skyed 1ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje lha mo yid 'phrog ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser/ /dri mchog dpag gred phyag na bsnams/ /yid 'phrog ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje lha mo kun bzang 2ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar/ /zhal zas ro mchog brgya ldan bsnams/ /kun bzang ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje lha mo glu sgra can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo/ /sgra snyan 5gar gye rol pas gnas/ /glu sgra can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje khro mo srog gcod ma / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog gnag /sgrub la gnod pa'i srog gcod ma/ /tho ba zhags pa bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khro mo rdo rje dbugs rngub ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser/ /sgrub la gnod pa'i dbugs rngub ma/ /hom gzar zhags pa bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khro mo chen mo khrag 'thung ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar/ /sgrub la gnod pa'i khrag 'thung ma/ /gri gug zhags pa bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khro mo chen mo sha za ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo/ /sgrub la gnod pa'i sha za ma/ /rnon po zhags pa bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje glu ni mdzes pa yis/ /bstod pa rnams kyis lha bstod pas/ /tshogs chen dpag med sogs par 'gyur/ /bstod pa'i sbyor ka ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal te/ rdor dril byin brlabs mchod pa bstan/ /rdor dril rab gnas byas pa dang / /dang po stong dang snying rje las/ /yi ge oṃ 5hūṃ rnam gnyis phyung / /de las rdor dril bskyed 25—/066
