par bya/ /ye shes rdor dril byen brlab 1bstem/ /yang na rab gnas byas pa la / /dang po byin brlabs gsal bas chog /lag na rdo rje byin brlabs la/ /lag mthil nyi zlar byin gyis brlabs/ /lag g.yon mthe bong srin lag gis/ /rdo rje dril bu blang bar bya/ /dril bu 'og la rdo rje steng / /brla g.yon steng du gzhag trepar bya/ /lag g.yas srin lag mthe bong gis/ /rdo rje ra dbrag btsugs nas ni/ /bskor ba'i tshul gyis thugs kar blang / /rgya yi yi ge gnyis po yang / /rdor dril la ni mtshan mar bsam/ /phyag na rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /'gying bag tshul gyis bstan par bya/ /dang po g.yon du gar gsum bsgyur/ /de nas g.yas su gar gsum bsgyur/ /de nas thugs ka mgrin pa dang / /spyi bo dag tu gar gsum bsgyur/ /de nas slar la phab nas ni / /lte ba la sogs gnas brgyad du/ /rdo rje dril gnyis gsor bar bya/ /de nas dril bu babs gsum dang / /rdo rje lan gsum gsor bar bya de nas rdo rje dril thabs ni/ /brgyad kyi tshul du mchod par bya/ /dang por rdo rje dril bu gnyis/ /gsor zhing thugs kar brtan par gzung / /de nas rdo rje dril bu gnyis/ /bsnol zhing 'khyud nas mchod pa 'bul/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu gnyis/ /nu ma g.yas g.yon thad ka ru/ /rdo rje steng la dril bu 'og /bsgol zhing 'gying bag phan tshun bkyer/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu gnyis/ /gar gyi tshul du bskor nas kyang / /rdor dril lan gnyis gsor bar bya/ /dril bu thugs ka'i thad kar gsil/ /rdo rje dpung g.yon thad gsor nas/ /de nas sa la bkyer bar bya/ /slar la log cing dpung g.yon bskor/ /dril bu thugs ka'i thad gsel /del/ /rdo rje gsor nas thugs kar ni/ /thad kar 25—1067

dkrol zhing gzung bar bya/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bu gnyis/ /gar gyi tshul du bkyer ba dang / /rdo rje dang ni dril bu gnyis/ /g.yas g.yon dbang du bkyer ba dang / /de ltar rdo rje dril thabs kyis 3sna/ /rdo rje gru dang bstun nas su/ /bde gshegs rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /glu gar rtsed 'jo'i phyag rgya yis/ /'dzul lam nam mkhar 'phur bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor tshogs 'khor tshogs mchod kyi/ /spros la dga' ba'i dus su bya/ /rnal 'byor basbus pa 'dod pa yis/ /sbyor thabs tshul gyis — bzhi po bya/ /shin tu bsdus pa 'dod pa yis/ /lha rnams bstod pa bar bar du/ /rdo rje dril thabs gsor bar bya/ /yang na dril bu rgyun du la/ /rdo rje mtshams su shes par bya/ /de rnams bsam pa'i mchod pa yang / /yi ge gnyis kyi man ngag gam/ /thabs dang shes rab mchod pa 'am/ /phyag 'tshal tshul du bya ba'o / /rdo rje dril thabs kyi sbyor ka ste bcu gsum pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa ril phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag rgya'i rim pa bstan pa ni/ /g.yas kyi gung mo dag la ni/ /sor mo bzhi po btsugs nas kyang / /rtse lnga'i tshul du bya ba dang / /g.yon pa'i sor mo spro ba 'am/ /sgra sgrogs tshul du byed pa 'am/ /yang na mthe bong mthe chung gnyis/ /bkug nas gsum po ste gsum tshul/ /g.yas pa snga ma dang 'dra la/ /g.yon pa'i gung mo bkug nas su/ /mdzub mo rgyab sbyar bkug pa'o/ /sor mo rnams kyang bcings nas su/ /gung mo mthe bong ngos btud nas/ /gzhan rnams yongs su brkyang ba yis/ /lag g.yas mtheb mdzub thuzhags pa bya/ /g.yon gyi 25—1068

mtheb mdzub ral gri'i tshul/ /gnyis ka lhag ma rnams ni bcing / /g.yas kyi khru tshur bcings nas su/ /maze bong nang nas gdon par bya/ /g.yon gyi maze bong mdzub mor sbyar/ /lhag ma rnams ni bcing bar bya/ /lag gnyis rdo rje thal mo las/ /gung mo la ni mdzub mo sbyar/ /mthe bong bsgol te sbyar bar bya//yang na lag gnyis sbyar ba 'am/ /g.yon gyi sor mo spyir bsdus pa'o/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcangs nas ni/ /mdzub mo bsgreng khyeste brang du bsnol/ /g.yas kyi khu tshur bcangs nas ni/ /mdzub mo dang ni gung mo dgug /g.yon gye khu tshur bcangs te bskor/ /gung srin la sogs gsum po rnams/ /dam por bkug nas yongs su bsdam/ /mtheb mdzub bzhi rnams rab brkyang ste/ /spyi bor nges par bsnol nas gnas/ /phyag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar nas/ /me lce phreng ba yongs su 'dzin/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon 'dzin tshul dang / /g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs nas ni/ /gung mo bkug pa'i rgyab tu ni/ /mdzub mo nges par sbyar bar bya/ /mdzub mo lcags kyu'i tshul dang ni/ /g.yon gyi sor mo bsdus te bskor/ /lag gnyis mtheb mdzub sbyar nas ni/ /gsum po brkyang ste rtse mor sbyar/ /lag g.yas khu tshur bcangs nas ni/ /gung mo brkyang ste g.yon pa yi/ /khu tshur bcangs te gru mo gzugs/ /lag pa sbyar te bskongs pa dang / /sgra snyan gar gyi rol pas gnas/ /lag g.yas khu tshur tho ba'i tshul/ /g.yon pa mtheb mdzub zhags pa'i tshul/ /lag g.yas sor mo bskongs pa dang / /g.yon pa mtheb mdzub sbyar te bcangasaṭ+wā /lag g.yas gung mo srin lag gnyis/ /bkug ste gsum pa bcing bar bya /lag g.yon mtheb mdzub sbyar te bcang / /g.yas kyi gung mo mdzub mo brkyang / /25—1069

srin lag mthe'u rmyechung mthe bos mnan/ /g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub sbyar te bcang //phyag rgya'i sbyor ka ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ m+bi khāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ rīphaṭa/ oṃ tre lokya bi dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye / byā khāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ nī lādza ra dha ra ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā la ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa 1hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ nī lāsbra ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bi ta ④pa ta ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo me ha rā 5ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa man+ta bagh+ra ye 6hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shaja gīrta ye pehūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra be tā lī lduhūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra lta sta nā 9ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sha so gu pā nyu —ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra ga dha pri ya ni hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya man+ta sa pak+ṣi thuni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra be ra ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rak+ta ka ra lo ka bi sha na/ m+bi ⑩lāsbra ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇa ye rkye/ na gwa la ga ra ba ra ta ke twa byā gh+ra tsarma ṇi ba sa ni ya bha ma ko re ga ru ra ru stem ti oṃ/kro dha murte sken tre lokya tra ha ya/ rgyu 1rteme na ko pa ya sa na ru dru d+kuya nā ga ra tsa turmā 1kher bhak+ṣa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tre lokya bi dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ nī lāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍa la de ba tā dzā / put+pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/oṃ m+bi lāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍa la de ba tā dzāX rta/ dhū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ bhā lāsbra ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍa la de ba tā r+ghaṃ/ ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ m+bi lāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍa la 25—1070

phaṭa / kṛ dzotān+ta rū pā ya phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa/ ku sha ta na ut+ta —nā ya phaṭa / pre ta pabi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ yak+ṣa a pasma ra bi nā sha ka ra 4ya phaṭa/ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nī lāsbra ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi/nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sarba bigha dzā/ bi nā sha ka ra khuya phaṭa/ sarba sha hūṃ saṃ gha bi nā sha ka ra 5ya phaṭa/ khyerā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ sngags kyi sbyor ba'i rim pa yang / /bsnyen dang bsgrub pa las kyi sbyor ka'i sngags kyi rim par bya'o/ /dbye ba'i rim pa ma shes na/ /las rnams 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de brtson slob dpon la gus pas/ /ser sna g.yo sgyu rmyemed pas su/ /yon gyis bla ma mnyes byas la/ /yang yang mnyan pas man ngag ni/ /the tshom med pa shin tu gces/ /de bas man ngag can ni btsal/ /man ngag med pa'i nan rtags la/ /dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /sngags kyi sbyor ka ste bco lnga pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags rnams kyi ni btu 11ba'i mchog /byas pas the tshom sel bar 'gyur/ /phyag 'tshal mgo la brgyan par bya/ /kā li'i sde tshan bzhi pa yis rmye/ /bzhi pa dag la is su brgyan/ /kā li'i sde tshan drug pa yi/ /gsum pa dag la mas su brgyan/ /ba zhes bya ba yi ge la/ /ha zhes bya ba'i yi ge btags/ /de 'og ra yi yi ge'o/ /da la ha btags de 'og ra/ /de 'og pa dang dza la ni/ /ra btags pa ni de yi 'og /na la is su brgyan hūṃ 5phaṭa/ /yang na hūṃ gnyis sogs pa 'am/ /yi ge bcu gsum pa zhes bya/ /tsheg bar chod thupa'i dbang du byas/ /oṃ gyi yi ge dang 25—1072

por mtshan/ /yi ge na la is su brgyan/ /yi ge la la mas su brgyan/ /ba la ta ni gdags 1par bya/ /ra yi yi ge gcig pu gnas/ /da la ha ni gdags par bya/ /ra yi yi ge gcig pu gnas/ /ba dang dza ni sdebs pa la/ /yi ge ra ni gdags par bya/ /ba ni gcig pu gnas pa la/ /na la is su brgyan par bya/ /ma dang ha dang ya dang gsum/ /gdags pa med de so sor gnas / /ka la sha ni gdags par bya/ /sa la is su brgyan par bya/ /na dang pa dang ta dang gsum/ /gdags pa med de lugs su gnas/ /ya la es su brgyan par bya/ /ha la u ni btags nas su/ /zla tshes thig les brgyan par bya/ /pha ni gcig pu ta ni bzlog /yang na hūṃ gsum phaṭa kyang gsum / /hūṃ gnyis dang ni phaṭa gnyis ni/ /las gzhan drag po'i skabs dang sbyar/ /man ngag can gyes shes par bya/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa gcig ces/ /tsheg bar bcad par shes par bya/ /yang na hūṃ gnyis bsnan pa rtsa gnyis pa/ /ya yi yi ge drag po gnyis/ /bsnan pas rtsa bzhi pa zhes bya/ /de yang drag po'i skabs yin pas/ /khyad par du ni shes par bya/ /yi ge rkang grangs dbang byas na/ /de ltar ma nges rtsa drug nas/ /sum cu rtsa gcig bar du yod/ /oṃ gyi yi ge dang por mtshan/ /mtshan gyi yi ge'i steng du ni/ /ma dang ha dang tsha dang na dang ni/ /da la ha ni gdags par bya/ /ra la os su brgyan pa ni/ /sha 2dang na dang ha la u/ /zla tshes thig le ha la brgyan/ /pha dang ta log yi ge'o / /yi ge bcu gsum zhes su bya/ /yi ge drug ces bya ba ni/ /mtshan gye man ngag kho na'o/ /swā hā oṃ dang ho dang gsum/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi yi ge mtha' / /dza sogs pa yi yi ge rnams/ /'gugs pa la sogs mtha' ru 25—1073

bstan / /man ngag can gyis spyor zhes bya'o/ /yi ge hūṃ ni 'bru gcig po/ /'di yang bzlas pa'i yi ge snying po yin/ /yi ge btu ba ma shes na/ /sngags kyi mthu ni nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan bskyed de btu/ /lha rnams gzhan po'i sngags rnams kyang / /bdag gis nyubatu ba ma nus pas/ /slob dpon la ni gus bya'i phyir/ /slob dpon rna brgyud 2man ngag las/ /yi ge btu ba shes par bya/ /yi ge btu ba'i spyor ba ste bcu drug pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzlas brjod man ngag bstan par bya/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang / /bla med bzlas brjod bzhi ru bstan/ /dang po phyi yi bzlas pa ni/ /sems dpa' sum brtsegs 4tshul du bya/ /de ni kun gyi thun mong yin/ /khyad par re re'am gnyis sdebs su/ /las kyi khyad par skabs dang sbyar/ /mtshon gang nas dang rta rnga'i tshad5/ /mtshon gyi sum cha de yi phyed/ /pad+ma la sogs mtshon gyi phyed/ /rin chen smug 6po gur lta bu/ /ngang pa'i rgyu yi tshad tsam mo/ /yang na dar mo gru gsum ni/ /tsi ta'i tshad tsam nyid du 'dod/ /de lta'i gnas ni nyid du yang / /ye shes bzhugs pa'i gnas su 'dod/ /la la dag gi bzhed kyis ni/ /rang byung ⑫ nyid du yod par 'dod/ /de ni rgyu 'am nus pa'i tshul/ /la la dag gi bzhed kyis ni/ /de nyid las ni sprul pa yi/ /kun brtags de la de skad gdags / /gzhan yang gzhung lugs mi mthun pa'i/ /dang po dbang bskur dus su ni/ /dang por dkyil 'khor bcug pa'i lha dang ni/ /de nyid so so tha dad 'dod/ /thugs ka dbu steng gong 'og gnas/ /lha nyid 'jug pa'i tshul 25—1074

la yang / /'khor lo rdzogs pa'am lha de nyid/ /bdag nyid man ngag thob gzhung gis/ /lha de rkyen gyi tshul yin la/ /rang 'byung nus pa rgyu yin pas/ /gnyis med gcig tu sdebs te bsgoms1/ /de ltar je tshom bcad nas ni/ /rang gi rig pa pho brang nyid/ /shin tu gsal bar sbyangs nas ni/ /ye 2shes lha la bsnyen pa 'bul/ /dang po 'od zer spros nas ni/ /ye shes spyan drangs lha de la/ /mtshan ma la sogs gsal nas ni/ /'khor lo bzhin du dbul ba dang / /pad+ma brtsegs dang rin chen thag /de nyid thun mong shes par bya'o/ /lugs 'byung lugs bzlog 'khor lo'i tshul/ /shes rab spyor thabs mchod pa'i tshul / /mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa'o/ /lce ni rdo rje dkar por bsgyur/ /yang na sngo ljang nyid du bya/ /nyi ma shar ba bzhin du gdal/ /de ni sngon du bsnyen pa'i tshul/ /drag po bsgrub pa'i gnas skabs su/ /man ngag gong bzhin bzlog ste gsal/ /lce ni rdo rje ser po dang / /dmar po rgyas dang dbang la shis/ /mthing ga drag po'i tshul du bstan/ /'od zer 'khor lugs gong bzhin no/ /las kyi rim pa'i skabs dang sbyar/ /ba thag tsha tsha'i tshul dang ni/ /drag po kho na'i skabs dang sbyar/ /rngul chu brug pa bzhin du 'am/ /srin po ngur skad ji bzhin du/ /shin tu drag cing myur bar bzlas/ /las kyi khyad par gzhan dag la/ /spros te sbyang ba'i tshul dang ni/ /'od zer sbu gu btsugs pa dang / /me yi tshul gyis bsregs pa dang / /lcags kyu lta bus bkug pa dang / /mtshon cha char bzhin dbab pa dang / /'khor lo bzhin du bskor ba dang / /mnan pa'i tshul du bya ba dang / /mda' zam tshul du bya ba dang / /'khrul 'khor tshul du bya ba dang / /'phen sbud tshul du bya ba dang / /25—/075

dang pos bkug la gnyis pas bsreg /dang pos bkug la gnyis pas bsad/ /dang pos bkug la gnyis pas mnan/ /yang na gsum sdebs tshul gyis bya/ /bzhi sdebs lnga sdebs 1pa yang yin/ /sdebs sbyor cho ga thams cad kyang / /man ngag bzhin du shes par bya/ /de la sogs pa'i man ngag rnams/ /brgyud pa las ni shes par bya'o/ /de rnams bzlas brjod byed pa yang / /sems ni gzhan du mi g.yeng zhing / /tshig gzhan gyis ni bar mi chod/ /yi ge man ngag ma nyams par/ /sgra yi brjod tshul skabs dang sbyar/ /de la nan tan cher bskyed la/ /mtshan ma'i dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mtshan ma'i dngos grub gsum po yang / /dang po rab la gsum du bstan/ /sprul dang yang sprul sum sprul lo/ /'bring la sgra dang dri dang ni/ /'od du yang ni bstan pa yin/ /tha ma nam smad nam stod dang / /nyin mo dag dang gsum du bstan/ /de dag rtags rnams kun la yang / /gzugs ni sdug dang mi sdug dang / /dri ni zhim dang mi zhim dang / /sgra ni snyan dang mi snyan dang / /ro yang zhim dang mi zhim dang / /'od dkar 'od ser 'od dmar po/ /ljang dang nag la sogs pa yi/ /rtags la sogs pa de dag la/ /gsum dang bdun dang bco lnga dang / /nyi shu rtsa gcig zhag tu brtag /thams cad brtan zhing mi 'gyur dang / /phung po khams gsal ting 'dzin gsal/ /'od la sogs pa zhi ba'i tshul/ /de sogs rtags rnams byung ba na/ /lha yi dngos grub yin par brtag /mtshan ma la sogs mi brtan zhing / /phung po la sogs mos 4'gyur zhing / /ting 'dzin rnams ni mi gsal ba/ /'od dmar gnag cing rtsub 'gyur na/ /de la sogs pa'i rtags rnams kyang / /bdud kyi rtags su shes par bya/ /rtags 25—1076

rnams de rnams byung na yang / /don dam rang bzhin med pa la/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i sems/ /re dang dogs pa rnams spangs te/ /dga' dang mi dga'i sems mi bya/ /'jigs pa la sogs sems spangs te/ /maṇ+ḍa la me tog bcas phul nas/ /sbyin sreg 'khor lo la sogs bya/ /de ltar byas tshe mkha' 'gro mas/ /lung bstan gnas su khrid pa dang / /man ngag 'jigs pa dred pas blang / /bdud kyi ltas rnams 'byung ba ni/ /gong bzhin byas pas med par 'gyur/ /nang na mtshan ma bsnyen pa gtso/ /de 'og grangs kyi bsten par 1gtso / /dus kyi bsnyen pa tha ma'o/ /grangs kyi rab 'azang tha ma ni/ /gtso bo 'bum dang nyis 'bum dang / /sum 'bum dag tu shes par bya/ /rnam rgyal la sogs bzhi po la/ /'bum phyed 'bum dang nyis 'bum mo/ /'khor rnams lhag ma kun la ni/ /khri dang nyi khri sum khri'o/ /yang na lha rnams so so yi//sku gcig bsnyen pa byed pa na/ /rab kyi bsten pa sum 'bum mo/ /'bring gi bsnyen pa bdun 'bum mo/ /tha ma'i bsnyen pa bye ba'o/ /dus la yang ni gsum gsum yod/ /zla gcig zla gnyis zla gsum bar/ /lo phyed zla dgu lo gcig gi/ /lo gnyis dang ni lo gsum dang / /lo bzhi tha mar shes par bya/ /de ltar byas kyang ma byung na/ /dam tshig nyams pa yin pas na/ /sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor la sogs kyis/ /dam tshig nyams pa bskang nas ni/ /slar la sogs pa'i cho ga bya/ /de ltar byas kyang ma byung na/ /rnal 'byor sdig sgrib che bas na/ /sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor la sogs kyis/ /sdeg sgrib la sogs sbyangs nas ni/ /slar la sogs pa'i cho ga bya/ /de ltar byas kyang ma byung na/ /yang na bsgom pa gcig pus bya/ /yang na bzlas brjod gcig pus so/ /bsgom 25—1077

—dang bzlas pa'i dngos grub ni/ /byung snabar de ni ma gyur na/ /tshogs 'khor tshogs mchod sbyin sreg dang / /gtor ma la sogs so so la/ /man ngag cho ga thob pas na/ /dngos grub nges par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de dag thams cad kun la yang / /ze tshom can gyis mi 'grub ste/ /the tshom med nges 'grub par 'gyur / /de ltar byas kyang ma byung na/ /mtshan ma gsum mam nus pa brtag /yungs kar dag la sngags bzlas nas/ /shing ljon la sogs me tog la/ /btab nas bskams gyur rab yin no/ /chu la bzlas te gtor ba na/ /char pa la sogs 'bebs pa dang / /thal ba la ni sngags bzlas na/ /char pa la sogs gcod par 'gyur/ /de ni 'bring gi nus pa'i rtags / /yungs kar phyag mtshan la sogs pas/ /sngags bzlas gtor zhing brabs pa yis/ /gdon dang nad la sogs pa sel/ /de ni tha ma'i nus pa'i rtags/ /de ltar byas kyang ma byung na/ /lha sogs man ngag thams cad spro/ /khams dang bas chags med phyir ro/ /cho ga thams cad gong bzhin no/ /man ngag mi mthun gzhan yang sbyar/ /de ltar byas na dngos grub 'byung / /dngos grub byung bar ma gyur kyang / /sgrib pa rnams ni mgo mnan nas/ /tshogs chen khyad par bsags nas ni/ /dam tshig ma nyams rnal 'byor pas/ /skye ba phyi ma la sogs su/ /dngos grub rnams ni thob par 'gyur/ /dngos grub khyad par ma thob na/ /skye ba bdun la gdon mi za/ /nang gi bzlas brjod bstan pa ni/ /rnal 'byor lam pa rnams kyis ni/ /snying ga'i 'khor lo la sogs la/ /rang 'byung yi ge nus pa ni/ /rlung gi rta la zhon nas kyang / /snying ga'i 'khor lo la sogs bskor/ /gsang ba'i bzlas brjod man ngag ni/ /byang chub sems 25—1078

kyi man ngag gam/ /phyag rgya la brten ji bzhin no/ /mthar thug gi ni bzlas pa yang / /snang ba gsum gyi mtha' la ni/ /mi rtog ye shes stong nyid gsal/ /de ni bzlas pa'i mchog yin no/ /bzlas pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ni/ /rnal 'byor blo dman don du bstan/ /bzlas brjod kyi man ngag gi spyor ka ste bcu bdun pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs rim man ngag cung zhig bstan/ /dngos po gnas pa'i gnas lugs dang / /blos su bsam pa'i rim pa yi/ /dngos po gnas pa'i gnas lugs dag la yang / /rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub sems/ /rtsa yi gtso bo dhū tī yin/ /dhū tī nyid kyi gzhung lugs kyang / /srog rtsa nang du rgyu ba dang / /de la brtan 1par 'dod pa'o / /de la sogs pa'i gzhung lugs mang / /bdag gi gzhung gis nang du rgyu / /shin tu phra ba rta rnga tshad/ /de bas phra bar 'dod pa'ang yod/ /dbugs kyi dngas ma shin tu phra/ /'od dang ldan pa nyid la ni/ /byang chub sems ni til mar bzhin/ /de la khyab par brten pa yi/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis ni/ /la la nā dang ra sa nā/ /mdun gyi rtsa ni da da dzha2/ /de rnams tshad la sogs pa yang / /dhū tī nyid dang mthun pa'o/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo rnams la yang / /gzhung lugs mi 'dra mang du bstan/ /'khor lo gcig dang 'khor lo gnyis/ /'khor lo bzhi dang 'khor lo drug /'khor lo brgyad dang 'khor lo dgu/ /rdo rje nor bu'i cha la yang / /pho brang bzhi yi gnas rtag tu / /'khor lo mi mthun 'dod pa dang / /'khor lo mang po 'dod pa rnams/ /25—/079

in+d+ra bhū ti gzhung lugs yin/ /rlung gi gzhung lugs dag la yang / /lte ba'i lkog dang lte ba dang / /snying ga 1mgrin pa yan lag gi/ /gnas ni lnga po dag las kyang / /srog gi rlung dang gyen du rgyu/ /me dang mnyam nas thur du sel/ /kun la khyab pa'i rlung rnams ni/ /gnas lnga tha dad gtso bo yin/ /yan lag lnga dang dbang bo lnga/ /de ltar tha dad 'dod pa'ang yod/ /bdag gi gzhung gi gnas skabs kyis/ /las kyi sgo nas phye bas na/ /thams cad ngo bo gcig yin no/ /byang sems 'be+ebs pa'i gtum mo yang / /'khor lo brten 2dang mi brten pa'i/ /dregs 'dzin ma ni bcu bzhi po/ /in+d+ra bhū ti la sogs gzhung / /rang bzhin gtum mo 'dod par ni/ /mkhas pa rnams ni kun ka mthun / /byang chub sems la gnyis yod do/ /don dam dang ni kun rdzob bo//kun rdzob la yang gnyis yod de/ /snyigs mar gyur dang bcud du gyur/ /bcud du gyur la gnyis yod de/ /til mar bzhin du khyab pa dang / /'chi ba'i dus tshe 'byung ba'o/ /de la brten pa'i man ngag tshogs/ /rim pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /bsam zhing bsgom pa'i rim pa yang / /rang 'byung yi ge'i gnas tshul ni/ /yi ge hūṃ dang a dang ni/ /oṃ dang haṃ gi rnam pa bzhi/ /man ngag spyor rdzogs shes par bya/ /'khor lo rnams ni gsal byas la /lte bar kā li nyis ldab po/ /snying gar dang po sde tshan dang po brgyad/ /mgrin par 4ā li bcu drug po5/ /dung khang la ni nyis ldab po/ /gtum mo zhes bya lte ba'i sgog /sor gnyis sor bzhi sor drug tu/ /mar me bzhin du gnas pa las/ /rlung ma nyid 6ma'i stobs kyis su/ /las kyi rlung ni sngon mo bcus/ /spar nas de la gtad par bya/ /rtags brgyad byung nas shin tu spar/ /dga' 25—/080

ba la sogs rim skyes pas/ /rtags lnga'i mthar ni stong par 'gyur/ /'khor lo gcig dang 'khor lo gnyis/ /gsum la sogs pa'i man ngag ni/ /rim pa bzhin du spyor shes bya'o/ /rlung rnams g.yas dang g.yon du ni/ /gnyi gar rgyu dang dal bar rgyu/ /de la gtad pa'i rim gyis ni/ /spro bar nus na basbu bar bya'o / /rtags lnga'i mthar ni stong nyid 'gyur/ /yang na thig le'i rnam pa la//spro ba dang ni bsdu ba dang / /lnga ru blta 1dang gcig tu blta2/ /rim gyis bstan par gyur nas ni/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ka ste bco brgyad pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs bskrad pa'i cho ga bstan pa/ bgegs bskrad pa'i thabs la/ cho ga che chung gi rim pa bsgrub bya'i skabs dang sbyar te/ thabs dpag tu med par bya'o/ /de la rdzas kyis bskrad pa dang / sngags kyis 4bskrad pa dang / stang stabs kyis bskrad pa dang / phyag rgyas bskrad pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis bskrad pa dang /yang na rdzas dang sngags kyis bskrad pa dang / rdzas dang stang stabs kyis bskrad pa dang / rdzas dang phyag rgyas bskrad pa dang / rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin gyis bskrad pa dang / yang na sngags dang gnyis 'dus 5dang / stang stabs dang gnyis 'dus dang / phyag rgya dang gnyis 'dus dang / ting nge 'dzin dang gnyis 'dus dang / phyag rgya stang stabs gnyis 'dus pa dang / bzhi ka la ni sbyar bar bya/ /phyag rgya la yang de bzhin te/ /ting nge 'dzin kyang de ltar bya/ /gnyis 'dus gsum 'dus bzhi 'dus su/ /thams cad kun la sbyar bar bya/ /25—108/

yang na lnga 'dus kho nas bya/ /bgegs kyi rim pa'ang lngar shes bya/ /sne gdon phra mo kun la ni/ /spyor ka gcig pu kho nas bzlog /rgyal 'gong la sogs gdon la ni/ /spyor ba gnyis kyis bzlog par bya/ /de bas mtho ba'i bgegs gnyis la/ /gsum dang bzhi ni bya ba yin/ /bgegs ni chen po thams cad la/ /spyor ba lnga po kho nas bya/ /rdzas kyi bya thabs bstan pa ni/ /gu gul yungs kar sha chen dang / /tshil chen dang ni thal chen dang / /dur khrod sol ba grog mkhar sa/ /de la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams la/ /gzugs brnyan bca' bar bya ba 'am/ /brdeg pa'i rdzas su bya ba dang / /bdug pa'i rdzas su bya ba dang / /bsrung ba'i rdzas su bya ba ni/ /gla rtsi dang ni rma bya yi/ /rgyal mtshan klu la shis par bstan/ /yang na dur khrod chen po'i rdzas/ /rgyan cha rnams kyis byin brlabs la/ /bskon pas srung gyobar 'gyur ba yin/ /skra ni byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /bsrung bar de ni 'gyur ba yin/ /sku dang glegs bam la sogs pa/ /byen gyis brlabs nas mdun bzhag pas/ /bsrung bar de ni 'gyur ba yin/ /rdo rje dril bu 3la sogs phyag mtshan la/ /byin gyis brlabs nas lag bzhag na/ /bsrung bar de ni 'gyur ba yin/ /khyad par nag po chen po jeyi/ /sku ni byin brlabs bzhag pas su/ /bsrung bar de ni 'gyur ba yin/ /sgud sngon mdud pa bdun byas nas5/ /mgul du bcings pas bsrung bar 'gyur/ /yang na smyag shad lcug ma yis/ /byabs pas de ni tshar gcod do/ /de la sogs pa'i mthun rdzas rnams/ /thams cad kyis ni bya ba yin/ /'khor lo bcas nas lus la gdags/ /bsrung ba'i mchog ni yin par gsungs/ /sngags kyis bskrad pa bstan pa ni/ /oṃ na mo 25—1082

nī lādza ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi che ge mo hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bskrad pa'o/ /mā ra ya phaṭa gdags pa ni gsad 7pa'o/ /yang na 'khrul 'khor sbyor ba bzhin du bya'o/ /oṃ na mo byā lāsbra ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba dang spel te bya'o/ /bsgrub — bya'i ming gi mtha' la sred byed kyi yi ge dang ldan pa ni bgegs zhi bar byed pa'i sngags so/ /ming gi mtha' la bsrung ba'i sngags dang ldan pa ni bsrung ba'i sngags so/ /ming gi mtha' la dgug pa dang /dbang du bya ba'i sngags kyang shes par bya'o/ /sngon du bsnyen pa sgogs pas ni//sngags ring kho nas bya ba yin/ /khyad par du ni klu la shis/ /yang na drag po'i sngags 'di ni/ /oṃ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ro ṣa ṇa 4hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba dang spel te bya'o / /yang na rgyud bzhin btub pa dang / /mi btub pa yi rim pa ni/ /slob dpon so so'i gzhung lugs so/ /ji ltar mos pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /drag po'i 'khrul 'khor gzhan rnams kyang / /man ngag gzhan gyis spyor shes bya'o//stang stabs spyor bas tshar bcad ni/ /mnyam pa'i stang stabs la sogs pa bco brgyad kyis tshar bcad pa dang / pheg rdob skor bu la sogs pa/ /gyad 'gros rnams kyis tshar bcad pa dang / g.yas brkyang la sogs pas tshar bcad pa dang / de gsum gang yang rung bas bya'o/ /stang stabs kyi sbyor ba las shes par chobya'o/ /phyag rgya la sogs pa'i sbyor ba yang / lag stabs la sogs pa'i spyor ba la sogs pa shes par bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi thabs ni/ dang por bdag nyid phyag na rdo rje/ gtum khro 'bar ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/sbyan bgrad 6pa/ gos sngon po gsol ba/ sku che ba/ yan lag rags pa/g.yas bskum pa/ g.yon brkyang bas bgegs kyi snying gar mnan pa/ phyag 25—1083

g.yas pas rdo rje gsor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rdo rje phra mo'i mtshon cha grangs sped par brgyud mar byung nas/ spyi gtsug tu brgyab 1pas rkang pa'i mthil du 'byen pa/ hūṃ sgra dang zhags pa'i sgra bsgrags pas thams cad dngangs shing brgyal bar byed pa/ sku las khro bo dpag tu med pa byung bas/ bsgrub bya'i ba sru'i 2bu gar zhugs nas khrag 'jibs 1par byed pa/ thugs ka nas khro bo dpag tu med pa byung nas/ bsgrub bya'i snying gar gzir ba/ sgu las 4gre dpung byung nas sreg par byed pa/ zhal nas sngags kyi sgra brjod pas 'byung ngo/ thams cad brlag 5par byed pa/ de lta bu'i khro bo gcig bsgoms la/ ye shes bstem/ byen gyis brlab/ dbang bskur la nus pa'i mthu can du bya'o/ /bgegs chen po bskrad 6pa yang / cho ga phra mos mi thub ste/ dang po kho nar sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga rdzogs par byas la/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor du bskyed la/ bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa'i gtor ma gcig byin gyis brlabs 'a//bde bar gshegs pa la dbul/ mthu bskyed la gsol ba gdab/ yang gtor ma gcig la thun mong gi rdzas dang ldan pa'i steng du/ khrag sna snying sna sha sna gsum dang ldan pa'i rdzas la/ byen gyis brlabs la chos skyong ba'i srung ma la phul la/ bdag gi stong grogs mdzad par las bsgo'o/ /gtor ma cha gcis la drug cu pa ldan pa'i rdzas la byin gyis brlabs la/ 'byung po thams cad la byin la/ gnod pa ma byed par bsgo ba bya/ yang na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis bgegs zhi bar bya ste/ de ltar yang nas yang du byas pas bgegs zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar byas kyang 'gror ma btub na/ drag po'i las bya ste/dang po kho na 7bdag gi thugs ka nas khro bo'i sprul pa bkye bas/ 'byung po 25—/08/

thams cad bkug pa dang / yang na nad pa nyid la bsams te/ yi ge sum̐ 1las 'phros 'dus pa las/ ri rab tu gyur nas/ ri rab kyis nasnying gar mnan par bsam/ de ni mnan pa'i spyor ba'o/ /bgegs bsreg pa rgo/yi ge hūṃ gi 'phro 'dus/ lce nag po rdo rje sbu gu can du gyur nas/ de'i nang na tshur 'od zer me 'dra ba byung nas gang la gnod pa'i sar gtad la bgegs thams cad bsreg par bya ste/ yang na lce rdo rje sngon por bsgyur la/ 'od zer sngon po rlung 'dra bas thams cad gtor zhing bskrad par bsam mo yang na srog gi 'od zer 'phros pas/ bgegs thams cad bcom nas slar 'dus pas snying ga'i lha la mchod par bsam mo/ /yang na mdun gyi lha mchod par bsam mo//bsreg gtor bcom pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /yang na gsad pa'i spyor ba ni/ gong gi sku bskyed pa la sogs pa man ngag spyor ba yod pa rnams/ rim pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /khyad par spyor ba bstan pa ni/ /thugs kyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang //gsung gi yig 'bru spro ba dang / /sku yi sprul pa spro ba dang / /yang na thugs kyi phyag mtshan yin/ /lte 'og gnas su bstem pa dang / /gnas dgu dag tu bstem pa dang / /thams cad kun du bstem pa dang / /de ltar bstem la lus dgang ngo / /thur du bda' dang gyen du bda'/ /srog 'gro steng 'og bda' ba dang / /'byung sa gnyis nas gdon pa dang / / thams cad bcom nas gdon pa dang / / 'dod 4pa'i tshul gyis bda' ba dang / /bton nas bzhu btul bya ba dang / /de nas lha la mchod pa bya/ /de la sogs pa'i man ngag gis / /spyor ba gzhan yang shes par bya/ /de lta'i spyor ba byed pa yang / /phal dang phal gyi thun mong min/ /lus kyi rgyan cha la sogs ldan/ /ngag gi ma 25—1085

nyams yon tan ldan/ /bar chad rngul tsam ma shor bar/ /dper na rngul 1chu brug pa bzhin/ /de gsum gsal bar brjod pa yin/ /snod min pa la gsang 'gyur yin/ /dper na srin po ngur skad bzhin/ /tshig mi gsal bar don gsal ba/ /yid brtan drag tu bzla bar bya/ /de lta'i bgegs bskrad spyor ba yang / /thams cad kun la bya ba min/ /bsgom sgrub bar chad byung ba dang / /slob dpon gzhan don mdzad pa la/ /'byung pos bar chad byas pa la / /spyor ba 'di ni bya bar gsungs/ /rdo rje spun la bya ba yin/ /gzhan yang sems can gzhan po ni/ /mi dge spang byezhing dge bcu spyod/ /de la'ang bya bar gsungs pa yin/ /gnyi ga mi byed sems can la/ /sbyor ba chung ngu bya bar gsungs/ /mi dge bcu ni dang len cing / /rdo rje slob dpon la smod cing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig pa dang / /rgyal khams yongs su gnod pa dang / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog dang / /theg chen gsang sngags smod pa dang / /rnal 'byor spyi yi dgrar 'gyur la/ /sbyor ba 'di ni byar mi rung / /gal te sems can de dag kyang / /gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol bshags nas/ /sangs rgyas theg pa'i sgor 'jug cing / /yang dang yang du gsol 'debs na/ /spyor 5ba 'di ni bya bar gsungs/ /spyor ba 'di yi man ngag kyang / /rang gi srog bzhin ma btsas na/ /snod dang mi ldan la spel nas//be'u gyesbrel g.yang gar 7khrid pa bzhin/ /gcig lhung bas na gnyis ka lhung / /de bas nan tan cher gyis la/ /rin chen lta bu'i gang zag la/ /btsas ka dam bzhag byas te gtad/ /bgegs bskrad pa la sogs pa'i spyor ka ste bcu dgu pa'o// //25—1086

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bsnams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dug sngags kyi ni gtso bo ru/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba'i phyir/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i man ngag rnams / /cung zhig bsdus te bstan par bya'o1/ /dang po skad cig lhar bsams te/ /snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de steng hūṃ gi 'phro 'du yis / /mchod pa la sogs rdzogs byas nas/ /stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya//stong pa nyid kyi ngang las ni/ /paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsam/ /pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de steng hūṃ gi 'phro 'du yis/ /rdo rje'i snyegur du gyur nas kyang / /cho ga gsum mam skad cig mas/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sku bskyed la/ /don du rdo rje sems shes bya/ /rdo rje bsnams dang chos nyid kyi/ /don la sems dpa'i ye shes la/ /las su ming dang tha dad tsam/ /de nyid sku mdog dkar la 'tsher/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /rgyan rnams thams cad rdzogs ldan zhing / /rdo rje skyil krung tshul du bzhugs/ /ye shes spyan drangs snying gar bstem/ /sgu gsung thugs ni byin brlabs dbang bskur bya/ /de ltar brtan bsgoms thugs ka ru/ /zla ba pad+ma lte ba la/ /man ngag bzhin du bsgom par bya/ /de ltar gsal nas bzlas brjod bya/ /thugs 'khor gsal dang lha mchod dang / /sbyang dang bsdu ba'i tshul bzhin du/ /'bum gsum bsnyen pa bya ba dang / /dus dang grangs dang mtshan ma yi/ /bsnyen pa la sogs tshad phyin nas/ /de nas 'khor rnams so so la/ /'bum phrag re re bsnyen pa bya/ /'khor rnams bsnyen pa'i man ngag ni/ /mdun du pad+ma'i gdan bskyed de/ /skad cig klu brgyad sprul nas ni/ /spyan drangs la 25— 087

sogs rdzogs byas la/ /'od zer 'phros pas mchod mnyes la/ /don rnams gang yin grub par bsam/ /gong bzhin mtshan ma'i rtags phyin nas/ /de nas bsgrub pa brtsam par bya'o/ /lha bskyed la sogs cho ga ni/ /bsnyen pa'i dus dang mthun par bya/ /gtso bo'i bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gcig /'khor rnams khri dang stong dang ni/ /brgya yi bar du rab 'bring ngo / /dug gis zin pa'i bsgrub bya ste/ /mdun sogs bya ba rdzogs byas la/ /lus kyi yan lag brgyad po la/ /yi ge dgod sogs bya ba ni/ /mgor hūṃ sna dang rna bar yī/ /mig du hūṃ dang khar ni sum̐/ /mgrin pa zle snying khar :/ /lte bar rgyu du shes par bya'o/ /kha dog dkar po bsam par bya/ /sngags rnams de yi mthus su ni//snying ga'i dug ni bcing bar bya/ /ye shes yi ge hūṃ gis ni/ /dug 'phrog 1la sogs man ngag sbyar/ /de 'og phyi ma'i las brtsam mo/ /rin chen la sogs bum pa la/ /skyon bral yon tan ldan pa ru/ /chu dang 'o ma bsres pas dgang / /dang po bum sbyang bum bskyed la/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan stengs su/ /de steng yi ge sum̐ las ni/ /gyur pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /gdugs dkar gyis ni brgyan mdzad cing / /sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis pa/ /kha ṭī thod pa phyag na bsnams/ /sbrul gyi rgyan dang ldan pa la/ /sems dpa' yi ni skyil krung bcas/ /klu rnams mgo bo'i cha rnams ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'og bsrus nas/ /de steng rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /pad+ma yi ni 'dab ma la/ /klu chen brgyad po bsgom par bya/ /shar du nor rgyas bu dkar po/ /byang du 'jog po ser po'o/ /nub tu stobs rgyu dmar po ste/ /lhor ni pad+ma sngon po'o/ /dbang ldan du ni pad+ma che/ /dkar ser du ni bsgom par bya/ /me mtshams su/ 25—1088

ni dung skyong dkar sngo'o/ /bden bral du ni rigs ldan sngo dmar po/ /rlung mtshams 'khyel pa dmar ser po/ /de ltar klu brgyad bsam pa ni/ /mchod dang gtor ma la sogs bya/ /de dus rdo rje mkha' 'gro ru/ /dug sel ba yi dus 'di ru/ /bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor bya/ /cho ga bskyed tshul thabs dang mthun/ /rma bya'i sgro yi chun po yis1/ /mgo bo la sogs lus kun la/ /byab cing man ngag sbyor shes bya'o/ /rkang mthil bar du drangs nas ni/ /bum pa'i nang du dbo bar bya/ /lha gsal la sogs man ngag bya/ /oṃ hri tan+da ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba man ngag tu/ hūṃ gsum phaṭa gsum shes par bya/ /oṃ 2bā su ki hri tan+da ra swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa ka hri tan+da ra swā hā/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/oṃ karko ṭa hri tan+da ra swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma tri tan+da ra swā hā/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma hri tan+da ra swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā la hri tan+da ra swā hā/ oṃ ku li sha lam̐ tri tan+da ra swā hā/ oṃ hu lu ta ke li tri tan+da ra swā hā/ oṃ tri tan+da ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ 5phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ a mu ka sa nirba shi ku ru hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ba su ki dṛ tan+da 6re de ba dat+ta nirba shi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bsnyen bsgrub la sogs bya ba yang / /sngags kyi dbye ba la sogs kyang / /man ngag can gyis 7spyor shes bya/ /dug phrogs 'o ma nag por 8'gyur/ /de 'og yungs kar la sogs kyis/ /sngags bzlas pas su brdeg par bya/ /brdegs 9pa tsam gyis bsgrub bya yi/ /snying ni 'bar ba la sogs 'gyur/ /de yi snying gar yi ge hūṃ/ /bsgoms pas rnam shes bcings shing gzung / /de tsam gyis ni dbugs g.yo 'gyur/ /bdag gi sna sgo'i 'od zer gyis/ /mche bas zin pa'i sna sgor thim/ /lus bkang bas ni rkang lag 'dar/ /de nas hūṃ gi glu blang bya/ /de yang sngon du se gol gtogs / /25—sde089

gsum gyi sgra yis ldang bar 'gyur/ /langs nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro bsgom/ /yan lag thams cad bsrung bar bya'o/ /klu sman dkar gsum sna tshogs kyis/ /mchod dang gtor ma klu la shis/ /de sogs sbyor ba gzhan pa yang / /slob dpon mkhas pas spyor shes bya/ /dug gis zin pa'i gnas bstan tshopa/ /kha dang smin ma rkan dang ni/ /sna rtse sna sgo mtshan ma dang / /bshang ba mje bong gzung ba rnams/ /gso ru mi rung spang bar bya/ /rigs ldan mgo brgya gcigs pa dang / /ka ma la ni dug gi mche ba ste/ /bzhis zin pa ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /lhag ma rnams ni gsor rung bas/ /rnal 'byor snying rje dang ldan pa/ /dbang bskur man ngag ldan pa yis/ /cho ga gzhung bzhin byas pa dang / /gzhan sgrol stobs kyis bdag kyang sgrol/ /dngos grub kyang ni thob par gsungs/ /de bas brtson 'grus bskyed de bsgrub/ /mchod bstod la sogs byas nas ni/ /lha gshegs ting 'dzin bsdu bar bya/ /de 'og smon lam gdab bya ba/ /dper na sman rnams mthu yis ni/ /rdzas kyi dug ni 'joms pa bzhin/ /de bzhin klu yi dug rnams ni/ /sngags kyi mthus su 'joms par 'gyur / /rnam par rtog pa'i dug rnams ni/ /ye shes mthu yis 'joms par 'gyur/ /rdzas 5kyi mthu yi 5stobs rnams kyis/ /dug rnams ma lus zhi gyur cig /sngags kyi mthu yi stobs rnams kyis/ /dug rnams ma lus zhi gyur cig /ye shes mthu yi 7stobs rnams kyis/ /dug rnams ma lus zhi gyur cig /dug rnams zhi byed mthu yis ni/ /thams cad byang chub thob par shog /dug zhi bar byed pa'i spyor ka ste nyi shu pa'o// //25—1090

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgug pa la sogs byer ba gzhan yang bstan/ /lha bskyed sbyor ba rdzogs nas ni/ /sngags rnams so so'i mtha' la ni/ /dgug pa'i yi ge gdags par bya/ /yang nā 1ga rā dzā dza dza zhes pas/ /thun mong gi sngags su shes par bya'o/ /sngags kyi yi ge'i 'od zer gyis/ /gang 'dod gnas nas bkug nas ni/ /shing chen dag gi sdong po la/ /shing gi chol ni phyung rdunas su/ /gro ga dag la klu gzugs bri/ /'od zer 'phros pas de la bkug /de nas shing chen nang du gzhug /kha bcad tshon gyi skud pas bcing / /thal sogs 'dag pas zhal zhal bya/ /yang na pha bong la gong ma bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar mi bya bskrad pa ni/ /shing shun la sogs dag la ni/ /rlung ngam sha ba'i gzugs bris la/ /de yi steng du bsgrub bya'i gzugs/ /gang 'dod pas ni bris nas bzhag /rtsa sngags mtha' la bskrad sngags gdags/ /gang ltar 'dod pa'i sa phyogs su/ /sngags kyi 'od zer stobs kyis 'phang / /gong gi spyor bas bkug nas su/ /gru gsum nag po'i brub khung du/ /nag po'i spyor bas kha bcad la/ /ri rab gzugs bri mnan par bya'o/ /lha rnams bcu bdun stang stabs kyis/ /ji tsam 'dod par mnan par bya'o/ /gsad 5par 'dod pa'i sbyor ka yis/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs gong bzhin bca'/ /bsnyen pa la sogs rdzogs pa yis//gsang sngags la sogs shes byas la/ /mtshon cha phyag mtshan byin brlabs la/ /khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa yis/ /lus rnams gtub cing gsod par bsam/ /yang na 'khrul 'khor spyor ba bya/ /yang na sngags kyi 'od zer gyis/ /gang 'dod par ni bsreg par bya/ /yang na sbyin sreg dag gis bya/ /dam la ma 25—1091

thogs klu rnams ni/ /sgrub pa po la bar chad byed/ /dang po zhi bas gdul bar bya/ /zhi bas 'dul bar ma gyur na/ /de la drag po'i las rnams brtsam/ /dam la thogs pa'i klu rgyal ni/ /bsten 3cing bsgrubs/ na dngos grub ster/ /bde gshegs sprul pa bsgrubs na ni/ /dngos grub mchog kyang ster bar byed/ /klu rgyal de bsgrub sbyor ba yang / /sngon 'gro cho ga rdzogs nas ni/ /de nas stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i —gdan/ /de steng cho ga gsum gyis bskyed/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gang 'dod bskyed/ /gzhan dag sprul pa'ang gang 'dod pa yang yod/ /mdun du pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /cho ga gsum mam snyeskad cig sprul/ /sgu mdog dkar po sbrul zhags bsnams/ /klu rgyal de 'dra spyan drangs bstem/ /mchod bstod la sogs rdzogs byas la/ /de nas gang yin bzlas brjod bya/ /klu'i cho ga'i 4spyor ka ste nyi shu gcig pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa 5la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yis/ /'khrul 'khor rim pa brtsam par bya/ /dang po las bzhi'i rim pa ni/ /zhi ba go ro tsa na blang / /gro ga'am sgyug 6ma'i shun pa la/ /rtsa sogs dkar po ma yin spangs/ /zhi ba 'dod pa'i smyu 7gu yis/ /bsgrub bya sgrub byed 'khor lo bri/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ /brgyad dang bcu gnyis bcu drug bri/ /shes rab cho gas yang dag bri/ /yang na gcig dang gnyis su bya/ /sngags ni thams cad dgod pa dang / /gcig dang gnyis su dgod pa'o/ /yi ge re re dgod pa dang / /thams cad rdzogs par dgod 25—/092

pa'o / /shar nas brtsams te bri bar bya/ /de ma thag tu dor ba yang / /bsgrub bya'i ming dang nā 1ma dang / /bskul ba'i tshig dang bcas pa bri/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /yi ge hūṃ gi 'od zer las/ /sngon po'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas/ /mchod bstod bsnyen pa byas nas su/ /dkyil 'khor nyid la gzhug par bya/ /byin dang ldan pa'i lha nyid be+e/ /yi ge'i gzugs las 'phros pas na/ /dkar po don byed brtul zhugs can/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi dbus dkar nas/ /skud pa dkar pos 4bcing bar bya/ /me tog dkar pos thun gsum du/ /zhi ba'i sems kyis gtor bar bya/ /bdag nyid sngon po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gang 'dod bya/ /zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po la/ /de yi mdun du bsgrub bya ni/ /pad+ma zla bar gnas pa ste/ /kha dog dkar po zla ba'i mdangs/ /bsgrub bya gnas par mthong nas ni/ /bum pa dkar po'i zla ba'i mdangs/ /bdud rtsi lngas ni bkang ba yis/ /dbang bsgur ba ni bsam par bya/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa grangs med dbang / /thob nas bsgrub bya gang yin la/ /bdud rtsi spyi bor khrugs 5par bya/ /bdag nyid sngon po'i sbyor 6ba yis/ /sngags kyi 'od zer spros pa las/ /bsgrub bya'i 7mi mthun zhi bar bya/ /de nas bzlas pa brtsam par bya/ /oṃ na mo nī lāsbra ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ che ge mo zhi bar gyis shig /na ma swā hā/ dug ni zhi bar 'dod pa ni/ /gur gum dag gis 'khor lo bri/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes gcig nas/ /nag po'i gcig tu las rnams 'grub/ /de ltar rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos/ /'khor lo'i man ngag yod pa na/ /the tshom med par byas nas ni/ /sngags ni nan tan cher bskyed 25—1093

na / /nges pa kho nar 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhi ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi sbyor ka ste nyi shu gnyis pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gzhan yang rgyas pa yi/ /thams cad sngon bzhin byas nas ni/ /sngags ni thams cad dgod pa na/ /mi dgod pa ni sngon bzhin bya/ /'khor lo yang ni sngon bzhin no / /stong pa'i mtshams ni blangs nas su/ /ming dang bskul tshig swā hā spel//gzhi ni gro ga'am ras la bya/ /gur gum kha che skyes la sogs/ /gang 'dod pa yis bri bar bya/ /kham por lkuser por 3kha sbyar nas/ /skud pa ser pos bcing bar bya/ /bdag nyid rgyas pa'i lha nyid du/ /bskyed pa la sogs rdzogs par bya/ /yi ge hūṃ ni ser po yis/ /lcags kyu'i dbyibs 'dra spros nas ni/ /rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor bkug nas ni/ /sngon bzhin mchod pa la sogs bya/ /de nas 'khrul 'khor dag la bstem/ /byin dang ldan pa'i lha rnams ni/ /yi ge'i 4gzugs las 'od 'phros pas/ /ser po'i byed pa brtul zhugs can/ /mar dang sbrang rtsis snod bkang la/ /skud pa ser pos bcing bar bya/ /me tog ser pos thun gsum du/ /rgyas pa'i sems kyis gtor zhing mchod/ /bdag nyid sngon po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /cho ga gang 'dod la sogs bya/ /yi ge'i 5gzugs su mthong byas la/ /bsgrub bya'i zhwami mthun rgyas byas te/ /me tog ser po dus su mchod/ /lha yi rnal 'byor shes pa yis thams cad rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du7/ /bsgrub bya ser po mdun nabasams la/ /gser sogs bum pas dbang bskur bya/ /rgyas pa'i 25—1094

mi mthun skyon rnams ni/ /bkru zhing de nyid rgyas par bsam/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i sa bon las/ /me tog ser pos dus gsum du/ /sngags bzlas skyon rnams sbyang bar bsam/ /oṃ na mo m+bi lāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ che ge mo sna rgyas par gyis shig swā hā/ rgyas pa'i dus ni yang dag bstan/ /nya dang de bzhin rgyas pa'i nya/ /de yi dus su yang dag sbyar/ /rgyas pa'i las ni 'di dag la/ /rnal 'byor can gyis brtson par bya'o/ / rgyas pa'i 2'khrul 'khor gyi spyor ka ste nyi shu gsum pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa snyel phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas dbang gi 'khrul 'khor 'di/ /gā 5ba dmar po'i rdzas rnams la/ /'khor lo gnyis ni sngon bzhin bri/ /sngags sogs dgod pa sngon bzhin bya/ /bsnyen pa yang ni sngon bzhin bya/ /rgya skyegs tsan+dan khu ba 'am/ /srin lag khrag gis bri bar bya/ /kham phor nag po la sogs min/ /kha sbyar 6'khor lo gzhug par bya/ /sbrang rtsi mar gyis bkang nas su/ /skud pa dmar gyis bcing bar bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /'od 'phros spyan drangs sngon bzhin mchod/ /de nas 'khor lo dag la bstem/ /dbang du byed pa'i lha rnams ni/ /sngags kyi gnas su nus mthu can/ /'od zer dmar po'i sbyor ba yis/ /bsgrub bya dbang du bya bar bsam/ /me tog dmar pos dus gsum mchod/ /cho ga las bskyed rdo rje 'dzin/ /dmar po kha dog dbang du byed/ /nub phyogs ngos su kha bltas la//zla ba dmar po dag la ni/ /bsgrub bya bsam par byas nas ni/ /snying ga'i yi ge'i )'od zer gyis/ /bsgrub bya gnas nas bkug bsams la/ /khri yi 25—1095

—sngags ni bzlas par bya/ /bsgrub bya'i lus la phog gyur /hūṃsnapas/ /de yi sems ni yengs gyur nas/ /zhabs kyi drung du 'gyel bar bsam/ /skra grol ba la gos med pa/ /shin tu g.yeng ba'i bsgrub bya bsam/ /dbang du mi 'gyur gang yang med/ /oṃ nī lāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ro ṣa ṇa 3hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/che ge mo dbang du bgyis pa — sa ma ya ho/ gang dag dbang du mi 'gyur ba/ /kha ti ma yi me ni du ba med/ /sngags bzlas 'khrul 'khor la ni bsro/ /las su bya ba dus bstan pa/ /nag po'i brgyad nas brtsams nas ni/ /de bzhin nag po'i brgyad kyi bar/ /brtul zhugs can gyis dbang la sbyor/ /de bzhin dbang gi 'khrul 'khor la/ /rnal ri'abyor can gyis brtson par bya'o/ /dbang gi 'khrul 'khor gyi sbyor ka ste nyi shu bzhi pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drag po yi ni 'khrul 'khor dag /dur khrod dag gi ras ma la/ /ske tshe nim pa'i bye brag gis/ /tsha ba gsum gyi mar dang dur khrod sol/ / da du 5ra dang gtum po'i sa bon dang / /khro mdzub khrag dang tsi ta khu ba dang / /byi brun gyi ni 'jim pa 6blang //gtum byed kyi ni phru ba'i chus/ /ltogs chen sgo yi smyu gu yis/ /bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor ldan/ /gtum po khros pa'i sa bon gyis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 'khor lo bri/ /bcu yi nyi ma phyed na bri/ /sngags la sogs pa dgod pa ni/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i rnam pa ni/ /de nas stong pa'i le'u 7tshe rnams/ /ming dang bskul tshig hūṃ phaṭa ldan/ /rnal 'byor khros pa'i gzugs can gyis/ /'od zer 'phros pas lha rnams dgug /cho ga la sogs byas pa la/ /de nas 25—1096

bkug ste 'khor lor gzhug /gsod dang ldan pa'i khro bo ni/ /nus dang ldan pa'i yi ge rnams/ /gdug pa'i tshogs kyis gsad 1par bya/ /de ltar byin gyis brlab par bya/ /byi brun 'jim pa gtum byed chus/ /kham phor 2sbyar zhing dgang bar bya/ /me tog nag pos dus gsum mchod/ /bdag nyid khros pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /lho phyogs kha bltas bsgrub bya mdun/ /'brub khung la sogs man ngag rdzogs/ /gzugs brnyan mdun du bzhag nas ni/ /gsod pa'i man ngag la sogs bya/ /gnas der bdag nyid sbyor ldan pas/ /rgyal rigs thod pa'am gzhan yang rung / /nang gi 'bru dang sman dag dang / /glang rta mi khrag thod pa bkang / /bkang ste thod pa gsum sgyed 4bzhag /dur khrod dag gi 5ro shing bskul/ /khros pa'i me yis bskul bar bya/ /dur khrod ras mar bsgrub bya'i ming gzugs bri/ /steng gi thod pa 6bcug ste bzhag /thod pa kha sbub thal ba phyogs su gtor/ /'dis ni nges par gsod par 'gyur//yang na gzhan sogs spyor ba ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya/ /oṃ m+bi lāsbra ra dha ra badz+ra pā be+e ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de ba dat+ta mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ drag po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi sbyor ka ste nyi shu lnga pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bskrad pa'i 'khrul 'khor brtsam/ /dur khrod ras ma khru gang la/ /sngon 7du gsungs pa'i sdas rnams kyis/ /'khor lo'i sngags sogs sngon bzhin bri/ /stong pa'i le'u tshe blangs nas ni/ /gang ming bskul ba'i sngags dang ldan/ /bdag nyid lha yi spyor sogs ldan/ /'od zer 'phros nas spyan drangs mchod/ /gsol bstod 25—1097

byas nas bsnyen pa bya/ /khri ni thos nas 1nag po'i phyogs/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi tshes bzhi la/ /gsol ba btab ste bstod pa bya/ /them pa'am rgya gram lam du sba/ /bsgrub bya ji srid mnan pa ru/ /'thab cing 'thab pas dbye bar bsam / /gtor ma byin nas sgod cig ces/ /gsol ba mang du gdab par bya / /khros pas nub byang kha bltas te/ /sngags bzlas myur bar 'bros par 'gyur / /khyem du rtag tu 'thab 'bros pas thu/ /oṃ m+bi lāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de ba dat+ta che ge mo sgod cig dat+ta ya hūṃ phaṭa / spyor ba'i man ngag 'di yis ni/ /nges par gnas nas sgod par 'gyur / /sgod pa'i sbyor ka ste nyi shu drug pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang 'khrul 'khor spyor ka ni/ /gong du bstan pa'i rdzas rnams kyis/ /'khor lo bris nas cho ga bya/ /bzlas pa khri ni zem nas ni/ /dṛ ti ka yi shing la gdags/ /mi yi rje ngar bsgrub bya yi/ /dri chen dag gis thod pa dgang / /ming 4dang bskul ba'i sngags ldan pa/ /'bum tsho 5bzhi ni thon pa dang / /shing gi gong ma dag la gdags/ /'khor zhing 'khrug cing myos par 'gyur/ /yang na skad cig tsam gyis 'gugs/ /oṃ m+bi lālba ra dha ra ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye badz+ra pā ṇi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de ba dat+ta mā ra ya hūṃ che ge mo dzaḥ/ zhes bya ba yi sngags kyis na6/ /ji ltar 'dod pa 'di rnams 'grub/ /'gugs pa la sogs pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi spyor ka ste nyi shu bdun pa'o// //25—/098

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa ༄1la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lung bstan sbyor ba'i —man ngag ni/ /rgyud rnams kun dang mi 'gal ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis rgyas btab la/ /rnal 'byor blo dman don du ni/ /yang nas yang du gsol btab pas/ /yid ches brod pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /man ngag rim pa bstan pa la/ /bla ma las ni gsan par gyes/ /gsang sngags sgo ni dpag pred nas/ /thabs kyi rim pa mang gsungs pa/ /sems can las ni sna tshogs pas / /so so'i mos pa mi mthun phyir/ /dper na sman rnams nus pa yis /nad rnams so sor sel ba bzhin/ /man ngag thabs rnams so sos kyang / /dug gi nad rnams 'joms par byed/ /dper na sman nus gcig gis kyang / /phrad pa tsam gyis 3nad 'joms pa'o/ /yang na gnyis 'joms gsum 'joms dang / /bzhi 'joms lnga 'joms la sogs dang / /mang po 'dus nas 'joms pa dang / /de dag kun gyis ma choms pa/ /spyor ba gzhan sogs 4 'joms pa dang / /gzhan po kho nas 'joms pa dang / /sman dang spyor ba de dag kyang / /mkhas pa yis ni 'joms par 'gyur/ /mi mkhas pa yis gnod par 'gyur/ /sman pa mkhas par gyur kyang ni/ /brtson 'grus nan tan ma byas na/ /dug rnams 'joms par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin mthun pa'i dpe rnams ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis lung bstan nasathu/ /zhib pas 'di ru ma phye'o//bsgom pa'i stobs kyis nyon mongs 'joms/ /bsgoms 5pa las byung dngos grub kyis/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin thob par ma gyur pas/ /tshogs 'khor tshogs mchod dngos grub bo/ /des 7ma byung na sbyin sreg gis/ /dngos grub bsgrub par gsungs pa yin/ /des rwam byung na 25—1099

bzlas brjod do/ /des tshim byung na gtor ma'o/ /de rnams kun la ma byung na//las kyi phran 2tshegs gzhan yang bstan/ /yang na de dag thams cad kyang / /gcig 'dus gnyis 'dus gsum 'dus dang / /bzhi 'dus lnga 'dus la sogs pas / /'byung bar 'gyur bar gsungs pa yin/ /yang na mchog 'dod pa la ni/ /thams cad rdzogs par dgos par gsungs/ /thun mong dngos grub bsgrub pa la/ /che chung gi ni rim pas gsungs/ /spyor ba re res kyang ni 'grub / /gsang sngags la la'i bzhed kyis ni/ /dper na sbrul ni smyu gur zhugs / /rtsa bar 'gro dang rtse mor 'gro/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor sngags pa yang / /rig 'dzin sa dang rdo rje dmyal/ /la la dag gi 4gzhung gis ni/ /bar ma do nas 'gro ba'o/ /la la skye ba phyi ma la/ /la la dag gi bzhed kyis ni//gnyis pa gsum pa dag la'o/ /bzhi pa lnga par 'dod pa'ang yod/ /la la skye ba bdun pa la/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob par bshad/ /de ltar gzhung lugs mi 'dra ba/ /mang du gsungs pa de dag kyang / /'gal ba med de kun ka bden/ /gsang sngags kyi ni gzhung gis kyang / /skye ba bdun las mi 'da' bas/ /ma bsgoms kyang ni sangs rgyas sa/ /zhes su rgyud las gsungs pa yin/ /skye ba bdun zhes bya ba yang / /sngags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin / /sngags dang sman la sogs pa yi/ /stobs kyis lus sems las rung ba'i / /sha dang thod pa la sogs pa/ /bsten cing zos pas dngos grub thob//de bas sngags mthu'i yon tan no/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /skye ba bdun pa 'ong srid kyang / /de lta 'ong ba shin tu dkon/ /skye ba bdun pa zhes bya'i gnas / /phal cher dur khrod chen po yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gnas su skye/ /25—/100

rig 'dzin sa zhes bya ba yang / /gcig ni de la bya ba yin/ /rig 'dzin sa la gsum yod de/ /dur khrod rig 'dzin sa dang ni/ /bar snang lha gnas sa rten dang / /mkha' spyod 'og min stug po'i sa/ /gnas ni de gsum yin par gsungs/ /skye ba bdun pa'i gang zag ni/ /mi yul gnas ni khyad par can—/ /sngags spyod pa yi gnas dag tu/ /'ga' tsam 'byung ba dag kyang yod—/ /skye ba gcig pa shāl sogs gzhan2/ /de rnams gnas kyang de bzhin no/ /skye ba bdun pa'i gang zag ni/ /dad dang snying rje la sogs ldan/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i chos la sbyad/ /mthun 'jug spyod pa kun la mkhas/ /bzo dang rig pa'i gnas la mkhas/ /lta ba ma nor gdeng du gyur/ /spyod pa la dor thabs la mkhas/ /man ngag thob pa tsam gyis ni/ /je tshom med par 'jug par byed/ /man ngag bsgoms ma thag tu ni/ /ting 'dzin skyes 'gyur rang bzhin gyis/ /khams dang dus dang bye brag shes/ /rgyud lung mtshan gyi man ngag la/ /thos pa tsam gyis dbu zhabs kyi/ /man ngag rnams ni khong du chud/ /bshad pa'i rgyud dang 'grel pa dang / /mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa rnams/ /ma thob pa ru shes par 'gyur/ /dper na shing mdzer bsal ba tsam/ /rgyud lung man ngag mdo mdo snyeyi/ /mkhas pa la ni brten nas su/ /thams cad don rnams khong chud pas/ /skabs phyed shin tu spyi don rgyas/ /dka' 'grel mngon rtogs ngarim pa ni/ /rtsom nus don la shin tu mkhas/ /mig ni yun rings mi 'dzums shing swā/ /yi dam lha bsgom dus su ni/ /skye ba bdun pa'i grib ma snang / /skye ba gnyis la grib ma gnyis/ /gsum la gsum/ bzhi la bzhi / lnga la lnga/ drug la sogs pa gzhan po la/ /grib ma'i rtags kyang de 25—1101

bzhin no/ /bsgom pa'i stobs kyis khyad par ni/ /zhag bdun zla gcig zla bdun du/ /mkha' 'gro mas ni lung ston cing / /chos bshad rtags rnams ston par mdzad/ /chos ston pa yi mdzad spyod kyang / /dngos su sprul nas ston pa dang / /yang sprul sum sprul la sogs su/ /sprul nas ston dang yang na ni / /sku ni mi snang sgra yis su/ /nam mkha' las su ston pa dang / /yang na phyag mtshan la sogs la kye/ /sgra byung nas ni ston pa dang / /yang na rmi lam mtshan mas su/ /dus bzhi dus gsum dus gcig tu/ /yang nas yang du ston pa'o / /ma thos pa yi byeman ngag rnams/ /ston par byed na skye bdun sogs/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thob pa yi/ /rnal 'byor rig 'dzin byang chub sems/ /yang na dang po skyes nas ni/ /theg chen chos la mos nas kyang / /man ngag bsgom la shin tu dga'/ /slob dpon la ni man ngag gi/ /rna brgyud gcig tsam thos nas su/ /bsgoms pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas gong bzhin byung nas su/ /gzhan la yang ni ston par nus/ /yang na skye bdun gang zag de/ /skyes ma thag tu yi dam lhas/ /rmi lam la ni chos bstan nas/ /man ngag de bsgoms dngos grub ni/ /phra mo dag gis thob nas kyang / /gzhan la chos ni ston par nus/ /de nas rim gyis gzhan yang 'byung / /yang na skye bdun gang zag de/ /rkyen ni gnyis po 'dzom pa las/ /bsgom pa la ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /sngon gyi bsgoms 37pa'i stobs kyis su/ /'bad rtsol drag po ma byas par/ /thun gcig la ni bsgom pa rnyed/ /de nas rim gyis bsgoms pas su/ /zhag bdun nas ni lung ston 'byung / /de nas rim gsum gong ma bzhin/ /de nas mngon shes drug ldan nas/ /phyag rgya'i dngos 25—1102

grub thob par 'gyur/ /sngags pa'i rnal 'byor thams cad kun/ /skye ba 'di la phyag rgya thob/ /de ltar ma gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /gong ma bzhin du skye bdun du / /len pa'i rtags ni gong bzhin 'byung / /skye ba 'di thob tshul rnams kyang / /theg chen snod du rung ba las/ /dbang bsgur man ngag thob pa yis /dam tshig ma nyams bshags la brtson/ /bskyed rim brtan par 'gyur ba 1yis//lus kyi rnam rtog bzlog nas kyang / /rdo rje bzlas la brtan par bya/ /rdo rje bzlas la brtan nas kyang / /ngag gi rnam rtog bzlog nas ni/ /sems dben pa ni brtan par bya/ /sems kyi 'khrul rtog bzlog nas kyang / /sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin la gnas nas/ /'od gsal la ni 'jug par bya/ /de nas spros med man ngag las/ /lhun gyis grub 'gyur phyag rgya'i mchog /yang na bskyed rim la brten nas/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin sgrub2/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin gyis/ /rdzogs pa'i man ngag bsgom par bya/ /nges su phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'thob/ /yang na bskyed rim brtan pa yis/ /rdzogs rim man ngag gang bsgoms kyang / /zla ba drug gis phyag rgya 'thob/ /rdzogs rim bskyed pa la brten nas/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rdzogs pa yis/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob par gsungs/ /de ni slob dpon chen po'i gzhung / /spyir na lta ba gdeng gyur gtso/ /lan cig bzlog pa'i tshul du ni/ /byas na je tshom mi skye zhing / /ldog par mi 'gyur 'byung pos kyang / /tshugs par mi 'gyur 'bras bu 'byung / /de lta ma gyur rnal 'byor pas/ /man ngag nyams su lon par bya/ /man ngag bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis su/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi lung ston pas/ /lung ston pa yi dus su ni/ /lta ba man ngag zab mo ni/ /bstan pa bsgoms pas phyag rgya 25—1103

'thob / /yang na rnal 'byor rim pa ni/ /blo yi rab 'bring khyad par ni/ /bag chags rkyen la sogs pa yis/ /rab 'bring dgu dang gsum dang ni/ /dbye bar bya ba'i don shes bya/ /rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /skye ba 'di la lung ston pas/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rkyen ni rab tu ma gyur pa/ /rab kyi 'bring sogs ldan pas ni/ /bar ma do la lung ston 'gyur / /rab kyi tha ma ldan pa ni/ /skye ba phyi ma lung ston no/ /'bring gi gsum po rigs ldan yang / /gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi 1ru sbyar/ /tha ma'i rigs ldan gsum po yang / /lnga dang drug dang bdun du sbyar/ /yang na rkyen sogs ldan 'gyur yang / /rgyu la sogs pa'i nus pa rnams/ /drag zhan gyi ni nus pa yis/ /rkyen kyi tshul bzhin spyor shes bya'o/ /rgyu rkyen gnyi ga 'bying sogs kyi/ /rim pa dang ni ldan pa rnams/ /gong ma gnyis dang mi mthun pas//gsum dang bdun du spyor shes bya'o/ /gnyis ka gzhan par gyur pa ni/ /gsang sngags snod du mi rung bas/ /dbang bskur mi bya 'jug pa tsam/ /dbe ba'i sa bon chung 'gyur yang / /smon lam btab pa'i dad ldan te/ /gsang sngags las ni mos 'gyur nas/ /yang dang yang du gsol 'debs la/ /phyi yi dbang bskur tsam byas la/ /mi zab dbyings kyi man ngag bstan/ /de la bstan pa'i gang zag la/ /lhag pa rnams ni rim gyes bstan/ /yang na rnal 'byor rim pa ni/ /yi dam lha sogs so so ru/ /so sor bag chags bzhag pa dang / /mos pa la sogs rim pa yis/ /the tshom 2la sogs med mod kyi/ /dngos grub 'grub par ma gyur na/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i 'du shes kyis/ /tha mi dad par bsgoms nas kyang / /man ngag yang yang spos kyang ni/ /'gal ba sped 25—/ /04

de dngos grub 'grub/ /de ltar byas kyang ma byung na/ /sgrib pa shin tu che gsungs pas1/ /sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor bzlas brjod dang / /gtor ma la sogs cho ga yis/ /bdun nas stong gi bar du ni/ /mkhas pas ci nus rgyud brtags la/ /cho gas sdig pa byang bar gsungs/ /dper na/ lus kun la ni gnod pa yi/ /tsher ma'i phung pos lam rnams 'gags/ /me yi sbyor ba mkhas pa yis/ /bsregs pas thams cad med par byed/ /de nas lam ni bskyed nas ni/ /gang du phyin par 'gro bar byed/ /de bzhin sngags sogs mthu rnams kyis/ /sgrib pa la sogs bcom nas kyang / /ting nge 'dzin gyi lam bskyed nas/ /dngos grub kyang ni thob par 'gyur/ /dngos grub khyad par ma thob na/ /phra mo la sogs thob par 'gyur/ /mtshan ma'i lung ston phra mo 'byung / /gal te de ltar ma gyur par/ /tshe dbang ma thob rnal 'byor pas//sgrib pa rnams ni byang gyur nas/ /skye ba phyi ma la sogs su/ /dngos grub kyang no thob par 'gyur/ /yang na sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /sdig sgrib rtsad nas ma chod kyang / /che long rags pa mgo bcom nas/ /gzhan dag mi spyod mgo gnon cing / /dam tshig ma nyams bshags la brtson/ /smon lam dge ba bsngo legs pas/ /skye ba 'di brjes 4gzhan dag tu/ /dus dang gnas dang slob dpon dang / /rigs dang phyag rgya'i ltaman ngag sogs/ /skyes ma thag tu rnyed par 'gyur/ /de ru dam tshig ldan sogs pas/ /rim gyis skye bdun brgyud nas su/ /'bad rtsol drag po ma byas par/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'gro bar gsungs / /de sogs lung bstan sbyor ba rnams/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi lung ston du/ /rnal 'byor mkhas pas shes par bya'o/ /'dir ni blo dman don 25—1 05

ched du/ /cung zad basbus te bstan pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi lhalung bstan yang / /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 'das/ /'jig rten 'das la gnyis yod de/ /sa gnas rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dang / /bde gshegs byen brlabs mkha' 'gro'o/ /mkha' 'gro de dag gnyis ka yang / /mdzes pa'i gzugs dang mi mdzes pa'i/ /gzugs dang sna tshogs sprul nas ston/ /de la 'jigs dang mi 'jigs dang / /re dang dogs pa'i sems spangs te/ /phyag rgya brda la sogs pa yi/ /ston pa'i dus su lan rnams ni/ /ston par shes par ma nus na/ /dngos grub med de nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan cher bskyed de/ /man ngag thos pa che ba gces/ /thos pa che bar ma gyur kyang / /gang bsgrub rgyud skor la sogs la/ /slob dpon la ni yang nas yang / /the tshom chod par mnyan par bya/ /rgyud rnams thos par mi nus pas/ /bsgrub pa'i cha 2rkyen bcu bdun po/ /shes par de ni ma byas na/ /dngos grub 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /slob dpon bla ma la brten pas/ /ma tshang yang ni 'grub par gsungs/ /'jig rten pa la gnyis yod de/ /rgyal bas bka' la btags pa yis sna/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdud ni nag po la sogs pa/ /dam la ma thogs bar chod mkhan/ /de ltar gnyis su ma shes na / /dngos grub thob kyang be+er la 'chor/ /de gnyis gzugs dang rtags sogs kyang / /gong ma bzhin du ston pas na/ /de yi rim pa'ang gong bzhin bya / /de yang brtag pa'i cho ga yang / /zhag gsum zhag bdun rtsa gcig tu/ /re dogs la sogs thams cad kun/ /spangs nas rnal 'byor ting 'dzin la/ /nan tan du ni brtson 'grus bya/ /tshogs 'khor la sogs yang dang yang / /25—1 106

byed pa'i dus su rdo rje glu/ /byed cing phyag rgya sogs ston pas/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya gsal ba dang / /mtshan ma la sogs gsal 'bar zhing / /gzugs dang sgra dang dri la sogs/ /thams cad brten zhing mi 'gyur ba/ /lha yi mtshan mar shes par bya'oṭ+wā/ /de las bzlog pa thams cad kun/ /bdud kyi rtags su shes par bya'o/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /mkha' 'gro'i lung du bstan pas na/ /'dir ni bsgrub pa'i don du bsnyus/ /bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen man ngag rnams/ /sgrub kyepa nyams su len pa la/ /bstan cing spel na bsod nams 'phel/ /nyams su mi len ser sna can/ /rdzas dang lus srog la sogs pa / /bla ma la ni 'bul mi nus/ /de la man ngag bstan mi bya/ /de la man ngag bstan pa na/ /dngos grub nyams te spyig pa 'phel/ /dam tshig nyams te mkha' 'gros gsod/ /cha rkyen la sogs bcu bdun po/ /ston pa phyag na rdo rje yis/ /sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la/ /rna ba brgyud pa'i man ngag deg/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la bstan/ /des jeni ro langs ma la bstan/ /gnod sbyin phyag na rdo rje dang / /slob dpon phyag na rdo rje la/ /brgyud pa'i man ngag rim pa rnams/ /nan tan gyis snyeni btsa' bar bya/ /de la btsa' ba ma shes na/ /dper na yid bzhin nor bu ni/ /klu rgyal gtsug nas rnyed nas ni/ /'dam 6 rdzab nang du stor ba bzhin/ /de bzhin man ngag rin chen 'di/ /lus ngag yid gsum dka' ba yi/ /sgo nas slob dpon la btsal nas/ /dam med rmongs pa'i lag shor na/ /dngos grub mi thob nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan bskyed de btsa'/ /lung bstan pa'i spyor ka ste nyi shu brgyad pa'o// //25—1107

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas sems can rtsod ldan gyi/ /dus su rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos/ /dam tshig nyams pa mang 'byung bas/ /yo byad rdzas chung sgrub pa pos/ /nyams pa 'phel du mi gzhug phyir / /maṇ+ḍa la cho gas bskang ba ni/ /dang po rnal 'byor 'gyod sems kyis//shin tu gus pas maṇ+ḍa la bca'/ /maṇ+ḍa la bca' ba'i thabs bstan pa/ /sa gzhi shin tu mnyen pa la/ /skyon spangs yon tan ldan pa yi/ /maṇ+ḍa la lnga ni bca' bya ste/ /dang po maṇ+ḍa la dkar po bca'/ /gnyis pa sngon po dag tu bya//gsum pa mthing ga dag tu bya/ /bzhi pa ser po dag tu bya/ /lnga pa dmar po dag tu bya/ /dkar rtsi dang ni ba bla dang / /yang na rtswa 3sngon me tog gis / /gnyis pa dang ni gsum pa ni/ /mtshal la sogs pa'i rigs dang ni/ /gur gum la sogs rigs dag 4dang / /sbyar ba'i nag po'i 5rigs dag gis/ /kha dog bsgyur bar bstan pa yin/ /yang na thams cad dkar dang sngo/ /de gnyis gcig gis bya ba yin/ /bsdus rgyas mkhas pas shes par bya/ /ba yi rnam pa lnga dang ni/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga dag ni/ /dngos grub can gyi snod du gzhag6 /rin chen bum pa la sogs kyi/ /skyon spangs yon tan ldan pa yi/ /snod du thun mong khyad par rdzas/ /tsan+dan med du mi rung ngo / /kha rgyan 'bras bu can gyis 7bya/ /dang por bdag nyid rnal 'byor pas/ /tha mal 'du shes spangs nas ni/ /lha yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis/ /dang po bum pa byen gyis brlabasan / /bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags kyis gdab/ /oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ/nyi shu rtsa gcig bdun du gdab/ /gong gi bkra shis sgod kyi rdzas/ /bdud rtsi 'khyel pas btab nas kyang / /dang po bum pa'i chus su bsang / /bdud rtsi 25—1 108

'khyel pa'i sngags kyang bzlas/ /thugs ka'i a las zla ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po nyid du bsam/ /oṃ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ /bdun dang lnga dang gsum du bzlas—/ /tsan+dan las kyi bum pas bsang 1/ /yi ge du 'phros tsan+dan phog /de las 'phros pas maṇ+ḍa la gang / /oṃ rja pa spa ra ṇa hūṃ/ /zhes pas lan bdun bzlas so/ /me tog lnga dang gnyis gcig la/ /kha dog mtshan nyid shes byas la/ /yi ge paṃ las pad+ma ni/ /stong ldan brgyad ldan dag tu ni/ /gyur par bsams nas sngags bzlas dgram/ /oṃ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ /zhes gong ma bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ /de steng rgyu 4las gzhal yas khang / /lnga dang gnyis dang gcig tu bya/ /de nas thams cad kun la yang / /gsum du bya bar 'dod pa'ang yod/ /zla ba pad+ma gzhal yas khang / /gsum dang gnyis dang gcig tu yang / /rnal 'byor bsdus dang rgyas pa ni/ /nyams pa che chung go rims so/ /de nas rnal 'byor bdag nyid dang / /dam tshig nyams pa'i rnal 'byor kun/ /khrus byas gos ni bzang po gon/ /rgyan cha la sogs mdzes par byas5/ /shar ram nub tu kha bltas te/ /so so lha yi ting 'dzin bskyed/ /rdo rje dril bu byen kyis brlabs6/ /rdo rje dril bus bskul nas kyang / /tshigs bcad dag gis gsol ba btab/ /sngags kyi rgyal po mtha' la gdags/ /thugs ka'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /yi ge bzhi 'phros lha mor gyur/ /bla ma yi dam lha dang ni/ /gsang sngags bdag po dkyil 'khor lha/ /dkon mchog gsum sogs spyan drangs nas/ /bla ma sbyangs nas mi bskyod 'gyur/ /mchod yon mchod sogs rgyas par dbul/ /de yi sngon du phyag rnams bya/ /gzhan yang mchod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mchod nas bstod pa rgyas par bya'o7/ /de 25—/109

nas sngags bzlas 'od zer gyis/ /lha rnams la ni phog nas su/ /'od zer bskul nas tshur la 'dus/ /nyams pa'i lus la phog nas su/ /ba spu'i khung zhugs sdig pa bsdus/ /snying gar yi ge shaṃ ngam ni/ /'od nag tu ni gyur par bsam / /srog go 'dus kyi sna nas byung / /lha dang bdag gi bar du ni/ /pad+ma nag po'i gdan bsams la/ /sdig pa'i gzugs de de ru bzhag /de nas yi dam lha yi sngags/ /bzlas pa'i 'od zer 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /sdig pa rnams ni sbyang bar bya/ /yang na sdig pa de nyid sbyangs nas kyang / /lus kyi lhag ma sbyang ba 'am/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa yis/ /man ngag bzhin du bsgoms nas kyang / /snga ma bzhin du sbyang bar bya/ /yang na yi ge brgya pa gcig pus bya/ /yi ge brgya pa 'bum dang ni/ /rang gi snying bo 'bum gyis ni//rtsa ba nyams pa chen po skongs/ /sum cha phri bas gnyis pa skongs/ /phyed phri bas ni gsum pa skongs1/ /sum gnyis phri bas bzhi pa skongs/ /sum cha'i sum cha phri bas ni/ /lnga pa skongs te drug pa ni/ /sum gnyis phri bas skongs pa'o / /de yi phyed phyed phri bas ni/ /tha ma gsum gyis go rims 2sbyor/ /yan lag brgyad dang brgya phyed dang / /nyi shu rtsa gcig dag gis so/ /che chung rim pa dag gis ni/ /tha ma me 'am chu yi ni/ /sbyin sreg dag gis sbyin par bya / /gsang sngags bdag gam bdud rtsi 'khyel/ /rta mgrin bum pa gong bzhin bcas/ /byin brlabs la sogs byas nas ni/ /tha ma dag par bkru ba'o / /sbyin sreg khrus dang ldan pa 'am/ /yang na maṇ+ḍa la bzlas pa yi4/ /cho ga gcig pus byar yang rung / /dam tshig nyams pa bskang ba yi/ /byer ka 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /dam tshig nyams pa bskang ba'i spyor ka ste nyi shu 25—/ 110

dgu pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa 1la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang gi rim pa bstan pa ni/ /bum pa gsang ba ye shes dang / /bzhi par bstan pa de rnams la / /gnas ni yid 'ong la sogs su/ /dus la sogs pa 'dzom pa dang / /slob dpon slob ma mtshan nyid ldan/ /sngon gyi gling gzhi rjes mthun par/ /dkyil 'khor byas nas slob ma gzhug /dbang bsgur rim pa ma nor bar/ /rnam grangs rnams ni shes par bya/ /bsgur thabs man ngag shes byas la /bskur ba'i gnas kyang ma nor brtag /de ltar byas pas sgrib pa 'byang / /sa yang rim gyis non par 'gyur/ /de phyir man ngag bstan par bya/ /rtags la sogs pa'ang shes par bya/ /brda mi shes na sngags pa min/ /las dang po yis rdzas la brten/ /dgos pa shes na the tshom med/ /nus pa mthu dang ldan pas ni/ /'bras bu khyad par thob par 'gyur/ /de dag spyi dang khyad par ni/ /cho ga man ngag rgyas pa rnams/ /rgyun —'grel kun na gsal bas na/ /'di ru bdag gis mdo tsam bsdus/ /bum pa'i dbang ni rnam bzhi ste/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang / /mthar thug pa ru shes par bya/ /phyi ni phyi rgyud dag dang mthun / /nang ni nang rgyud dag dang mthun/ /yang na gnyis ka phyi ru bstan//nang gi slob dpon lus la gzhag /gsang ba yul ni nyid la sbyar/ /mthar thug slob ma mgo bo ru/ /dga' ba bskyed pa'am rdo rje'i rtsa/ /de rnams man ngag rgyas bshad pa/ /las kyi phreng bar shes par bya/ /gsang ba dbang la bzhi ru bstan/ /phyi ni bdud rtsi byin brlabs 5sbyin/ /yang na mtshan ldan 25—1111

phab nas ni/ /srin mtheb dag gis sbyin par bya/ /nang gi gsang ba pho brang nas / /lag pa'i phyag rgya bzung she—nas sbyin/ /gsang ba yum gyi mkha' nas blang / /mthar thug gsang ba'i pho brang du/ /mchog dga' skyes par shes par bya / /shes rab ye shes la yang bzhi/ /phyi ni las kyi phyag rgya ma/ /nang ni 'od kyi rig ma yin/ /gsang ba bya gdong ma la bya/ /mthar thug dregs 'dzin gtum mo yin/ /mthar thug la ni gnyis su bstan/ /rten bcas dang ni rten med do/ /rten med la yang gnyis su bstan/ /spros bcas dang ni spros med do/ /dbang gi man ngag rgyas bshad pa/ /slob dpon zhal gyi man ngag dang / /las kyi phreng bar shes par bya/ /brda —yi cho ga mdo tsam bstan/ /ka la sha a bhe ṣe ka zhes pa ni/ bum pa'i ngag brda jelus kyi brda5/ /lag pa'i sor mo bkang 6nas ni/ /rtse mo bsdus pa'i bum pa'i tshul/ /gu hra a bhi ṣe ka zhes pa/ gsang ba'i ngag brda lus kyi brda7/ /sdom pos khro mo gnon pa ni / /lag brda 'dri na shes par bya/ /pradz+nyā dz+nyā na gu khya a bhi ṣe ka zhes pa ni/shes rab ye shes ngag gi brda9/ /lus kyi brda 7ni lha sbyin brda1 / /yang na khyad par dga' ba mtshon/ /pradz+nyā dz+nyā na gu khya a dha ṣe ka zhes pa na/ bzhi pa'i ngag brda lus kyi brda1 / /lhan cig dga' ba skyes sa ru/ /mthe bo bcug nas mtshon par bya'o/ /de ltar brda rnams ma shes na/ /mkha' 'gro dngos grub ster ba na/ /brda rnams dris nas ster bar byed/ /brda rnams dri shes slar la 'chor5/ /yang na brda rnams gzhan po yang / /ma shes na ni mkha' 'gros gsod / /brda la sogs pa ma shes na/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i dus dang ni//'byung po nyams gsod gsol lab dang / /mu stegs shan 'dres 'byung ba dang //25—/ 1 12

phyag dang phyag gi lan dus su/ /brda mi shes na sngags pa min/ /dbang bskur ba yi rim pa yang / /chags lam grol lam gnyis shes bya'o/ /dbang bskur med na 'bras bu med/ /de bas dbang bskur nan tan bya/ /dbang gi spyor ka ste sum cu pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa 1la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig rnams no cung zhig bstan/ /dang po spyod pa'i dam tshig ni/ /chags lam spyod lam grol lam spyod/ /de ltar gnyis ka spyod pa la/ /dang po mchog dang rab mchog go/ /de la yang ni phyi nang ngo / /dang po phyi yi spyod dus su/ /yul dang dus kyi gnas skabs kyis/ /zhi bas 'dul dang drag pos 'dul/ /mthun 'jug spyod pa mkhas shing zab/ /zas dang gos sogs thams cad kyang / /rang dang gzhan ni gnyis ka la/ /phan sems spyod pas 'jug bya'o/ /phan sems med pa nyon mongs can/ /bdag gzhan lha dang snying rje spangs/ /'gro don mchod pa spangs pas na/ /dam tshig nyams te ngan 'gror ltung / /nang 2 spyod du ni bstan pa ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa la/ /chags pa'i lam pas 'jug par bya/ /grol ba'i lam pas byin gyis brlabs/ /de ltar byin brlabs bdud rtsi blta/ /thams cad lha bsgoms mchod byas na/ /bsod nams chen po thob par 'gyur/ /khyi phag spyod pa bzhin byas na/ /dam tshig nyams te yi dwags sa/ /chang ni bdud rtsi chen po ste/ /btung bar bya ba kho na yin / /zhes rgyud las gsungs pa ste/ mtshan dang ldan pa'i sdod mchog tu/ /rul sogs skyon rnams spangs pa yi/ /bdud rtsi ro ldan snod bkang ste/ /25—1113

bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor bya/ /a las ka pā la ni bskyed/ /zla ba dang ni de yis bskyed/ /has ni gzugs sogs rnam rtog sbyangs/ /dhīḥs 1ni ro sogs rnam rtog sbyangs/ /hoḥs ni bdud rtsi chen por bzhu/ /mje bong hūṃ las sa gzhi'i tshul/ /srin mtheb sum̐ las ri rab tshul/ /bar nas tso.oṃ 'phros bdud rtsi bkug /bdag gzhan lha ni mchod byas pas/ /bsod nams chen po thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar ma byas glang chen bzhin/ /chags shing brkam sogs pyos 'thung na/ /skye ba lnga brgyar smyon par skye/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa yang / /yang na ririgs lnga'i sbyor sogs bya/ /yang na mā ma tī yis sbyangs5 / /yang na bdud rtsi 'khyel sogs bya/ /mtshan ldan snod dang 9chos 'byung dang / /zla ba la sogs bsams byas pa—/ /mchod par bya ba'am yang na bdun/ /spyi gtsug bla ma gzhag 27byas la/ /sku gsung thugs ni gnas gsum gzhag9 /de nas 'thor zhing mchod pa yis/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis dbul bar bya/ /so so'i rtsa ba'i sngags la a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li zhes pa'am/ a mṛ ta khā hi zhes pa gang yang rung / gsum gsum kun la dbul bar bya/ /de nas rang snying lha gsal la/ /ci ran gnod pa med tsam btung / /nad la gnod par gyur kyang ni/ /thigs pa gsum ni dam tshig go/ /grol bas kyang ni mchod pa yi/ /dus su btung bar bya phyir ni/ /yul dus gnas skabs sbyar te btung / /btung ba la sogs gzhan po yang / /bdud rtsi ma byas 'thung byed pa/ /yi dwags gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa'i dus su ni/ /phyag rgya ma ni bsten pa yang / /rnal 'byor chags pa'i lam pas ni / /rtags ldan mtshan nyid la sogs ldan/ /de ltar bsten pa'i gnas 25—1 1 11

skabs ni/ /dbang bskur rnam gnyis dus dang ni/ /mchod pa'i dus dang ting 'dzin ni/ /ye shes skye ba bogs dbyung phyir/ /dam tshig tu ni bstan pa yin / /yang na bskyed rim bstan pa dang / /rlung rnams las su rung 'gyur na / /phyag rgya'i dngos grub myur 'dod phyir/ /phyag rgya la ni brten par bya/ /rnal 'byor grol ba'i lam pas ni/ /yid kyi lha mo gzugs mdzes ma/ /mchod pa'i dus su dam tshig go/ /de nas mkha' 'gro lung ston dus/ /dngos grub myur du thob 'dod na/ /mkha' 'gro'i man ngag la brten no/ /de ltar go rims ma shes na/ /dam tshig nyams te srin bur skye/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig —1pa la/ /'khrul 'khor sbyor ba shes bzhin du/ /mi rtsom pa ni dam tshig nyams—/ /mi shes gnod pa mi byed la/ /byed na yang ni dam tshig nyams/ /de sogs sbyor ba gzhan po yang / /man ngag gis ni shes par bya/ /mchog gi spyod pa'i dus su ni/ /brtul zhugs sbyon pa lkugs pa dang / /gcer bu la sogs dus skabs sbyar/ /de ltar ma shes dam tshig nyams/ /rab mchog gi ni dus dag tu/ /don dam rang bzhin med pa 'am/ /sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin la brten nas/ /rdzogs pa'i nying 'dzin dus su ni/ /spyod pa la sogs byed pa ni//dam tshig nyams te bogs chung ngo / /mthun 'jug spyod pa 'gal ba med/ /lta ba'i dam tshig bstan pa ni/ /chos rnams sems kyi 'khrul pa ste/ /sems las ma gtogs chos rnams med/ /chos su snang ba 'khrul pa'i sems/ /sems nyid de yang skye med phyir/ /yod med mtha' las 'das pa'o/ /bsam du med cing brjod du sed/ /dper na nam mkha'i ji bzhin no/ /lta spyod kyi dam tshig gi sbyor ka ste sum cu gcig pa'o// //25—11sde5

bstan par 2bya/ /sku gzugs la sogs kun la ni/ /rab tu gnas pa ma byas na / /mu stegs lha rten bcas dang 'dra'o/ /rigs dang na tshod med pa'i mi//thams cad kun gyis bkur mi byed/ /de bzhin 'dir yang sku sogs la/ /phyag la sogs pa byas gyur kyang / /bsod nams chen po thob mi 'gyur/ /bsod nams chen po thob 'dod na/ /rab gnas byas pas thob par 'gyur/ /de bas rab gnas bya ba gces/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid ldan pa yis —/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ /so so rang rang bsnyen pa bya/ /de ltar mi 'grub rnal 'byor pas/ /shāka thub bsnyen pa kun gyi ma/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bsnyen pa yis/ /gsang sngags thun mong bstan pa yin 4/ /bsnyen pa rnam gsum rdzogs byas la/ /de nas sa chog la sogs pa/ /gzhan dang mthun par rgyas par bya/ /maṇ+ḍa la byi dor legs byas la/ /rgyan dang rol mo la sogs dgram/ /lha yi sta gon rdzogs byas la/ /de nas thum pa'i sta gon bya/ /maṇ+ḍa la me tog gcal 5bkram la/ /bdag nyid lha ru bsgoms nas su/ /yungs kar nim pa lag gnyis kyis/ /blangs nas gsum gsum mer bstabs 6bya/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra 7ya/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra swā hā/ chu snyim pa bkang ba lan gsum blugs la / bla mas zan chu bsre snod thogs/ /lan gsum byabs te mer bcas rnams/ /phyi rol dag tu bskyal bar bya/ /nam mkha' lha bkang spos thogs nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha la gsol ba gdab/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes tshigs bcad la sogs bsgrag 9par bya'o/ /de nas 25—1116

—maṇ+ḍa la steng du ni/ /sku gdung la sogs gzhag 1byas la/ /slob dpon nub tu gnas nas ni/ /oṃ hūṃ baṃ a zhes brjod pas/ /ba yi rnam lnga gang yin pa/ /de ni mar chu sbyar ba dang / /dri zhim tsan+dan chu nyid dang / /'dag chal shing shun chu gsum ni/ /byin brlabs drur 2bas rim bzhin bsku/ /u dusmra ra bhang tra dang / /tsa ba le ke na dang ni/ /a shwad byang chub shing gang rnyed/ /zhib btags chu 4sbyar snod g.yas gzhag5 /de nas khrus rnams rim par bya/ /de la sogs pa'i cho ga yis/ /sgu gzugs sta gon gnas par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ /de rjes rab gnas brtsam par bya/ /khru rnams so so'i sa bon las/ /cho ga gsum sogs gang 'dod bskyed/ /ye shes lha yang so sor bstem/ /sgu gdung brtan 6par bskyed cing bstem/ /glegs bam so so'i snying po la7/ /yang na ā li kā li 'am/ /so so'i dkyil 'khor dag kyang rung / /lha khang la sogs kun la yang / /so so'i dkyil 'khor gang 'dod bya/ /yang na yi ge rgyu ni rten yin la/ /de la brten pa gang 'dod pa'o / /rdo rje dril bu dag la ni/ /hūṃ dang a yi 9sa bon las/ /dharma a badz+ra hūṃ zhes/ sngags kyis bskyed pa byas nas ni/ /phyag mtshan lha ni gang 'dod bstem/ /phyag mtshan la sogs gzhan la yang / /phyag mtshan snying po lha gsum dang / /sgrub pa po yi las dang sbyar/ /phreng ba la yang de bzhin no/ /mtshan ldan yi ge a yin no/ /rgyan dang rgyan cha la sogs pa/ /byin gyis brlab pa tsam ni bya/ /de dag thams cad kun la yang / /bskyed dang bstem pa byas nas ni/ /de nas byin rlabs dbang bsgur bya/ /de nas mchod lnga dbul bar bya/ /de 'og lā su la sogs brgyad/ /mchod pa nyi shu po yang bya/ /25—1 / 17

gos dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa/ /rin chen bkra shis sgra dang ni/ /rol mo la sogs cho ga rnams/ /rgyas par phul nas bstod pa bya/ /de nas bzlas brjod ci ran bya/ /spyan 'byed sngags la sogs pa ni/ /glog hūṃphreng rgyud du shes par bya/ /yang na phyag mtshan la sogs kyi/ /cho ga bsdus par shes par bya / /shin tu bsdus pa'i cho ga sogs/ /byin gyis (2brlabs la sogs pa tsam/ /de ltar rab gnas zin nas ni/ /bla ma mkhas pa de la ni/ /ci bdog yon rnams dbul bar bya/ /des ni bsod nams chen po thob/ /ji ltar phongs par 'gyur hūṃ yang ni/ /mchod pa'i yo byad rnams ni dbul/ /ser sna can ni dbul mi nus/ /des ni sdig 'phel bsod nams med/ /rab gnas bzang po zin nas ni/ /rab gnas bzang bor gshegs su gsol/ /rab tu gnas pa'i spyor ka ste sum cu gnyis pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa thul phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi ba bslu she ba'i man ngag ni/ /'chi rtags rnam par bstan pa dang / /'chi bslu 'ucho ga rgyas pa rnams/ /'chi bslu )chen por shes par bya/ /'dir ni bsgrub pa'i byedon du ni/ /gos sngon 'chi ba bslu /thub mchog /man ngag cung zhig bkol nas bstan / /spyir ni 'chi ba bslu tsob la/ /dge ba'i phyogs ni mtha' yas mchog/gang byas kyang ni bzlog 4 nyepar 'gyur/ /gos sngon 'chi bslu'i ⑫rim pa yang / /nad pa sems ni dag pa yis/ /gos sngon rna brgyud 6man ngag can/ /mkhas pa de ni spyan drangs la/ /gnas khang dgon par maṇ+ḍal bya/ /maṇ+ḍal byas pa'i 'og tu ni/ /rgyan rnams ma lus dgram par bya/ /nad pa la ni chos bshad la//25—1118

dang po sems ni dag par bya/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sems kyis ni/ /nor rnams ma lus thams cad dang / /rang lus srog dang bcas pa dbul/ /de ltar 'bul 1ba de la ni/ /dang po dbang bsgur rdzogs pa la/ /de nas man ngag gzhan sogs bya/ /de ltar byas 'og sos gyur 2la/ /rang 'tsho rdzas tsam be+er la sbyin/ /nor rdzas srog rnams dbul mi nus/ /ser sna can ni bzlog par dka'/ /de ltar ser sna can de la/ /dbang bskur mi bya gzhan po bya/ /cho ga'i rim pa bstan pa ni/ /rgyas par byed na bskyed rim rdzogs par bya/ /yang na bsdus dang shin tu bsdus/ /de ltar byas 'og nad pas ni/ /khrus kyi rim pa rdzogs byas la / /gos bzang byin brlabs bskon nas ni/ /shar gyi phyogs su kha bltas nas / /mdun du maṇ+ḍal lnga byas te/ /dang po phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /de nas sdig bshags la sogs bya/ /nad pa de ni mi nus na/ /mchod g.yog dag gis byed du gzhug /de nas skyabs gsol tshigs bcad brjod/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can/ /sku mchog stobs ldan khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gsung mchog sgra mchog 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs mchog ye shes ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mchog stobs chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas lus 'bul zhes ni sbyar/ /bdag la gnod pa'i nad rnams kun/ /khyod kyi mthu yis zisbyang du gsol/ /'byung po'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ /zor dang dug rnams thams cad kyang / /mthu stobs bdag pos bzlog tu 5gsol/ /bcom ldan khro chen rnam par rgyal/ /sku gsung thugs ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//dpal ldan mgon po nag po che/ /lus ngan rgyal po mthu bo che/ /khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyel/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin 'jigs chen po/ /ro langs ma ni mthu 25—1 1 /9
