—mo che/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma/ /'jigs byed ma ni mthu mo che/ /rdo rje lha mo 'od skyed lkum/ /rdo rje lha mo yid 'phrog ma/ /rdo rje lha mo kun bzang — ma/ /rdo rje lha mo klu sgra can/ /khro mo chen mo srog gcod ma/ /khro mo chen mo dbugs rngub ma/ /khro mo chen mo khrag 'thung ma/ /khro mo chen mo sha za ma//sku gsung thugs zhes bya ba la sogs par sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug /de bzlas pas ni bzlog par bya'o/ /dang po sku yi bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyes/ /lus kyi nad rnams sbyang bar bya'o/ /de nas thugs dang gsung gis spyad/ /thal chen rak+ta byang chub sems/ /sbyang sogs byin brlabs byas nas ni/ /gnas gsum dag tu mtshan cing —byug /de nas khrus kyi bum pa yis / /bkra shis tshigs bcad bton nas ni/ /nad rnams sdig sgrib bkru bar bya/ /de nas sku gsung thugs kyi sngags/ /bzlas pas bde gshegs 'od zer bstem/ /de nas nad pa'i steng phyogs su/ /bde gshegs dkyil 'khor bzhugs bsams la/ /'od zer 'phro 'du'i spyor ba yis/ /ye shes bdud rtsi snying gar gzung / /de rnams byas pas 'chi ba bzlog /'chi bzlog 4chen po bya ba ni/ /sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor dbang bskur bya/ /gtor chen la sogs gzhan yang bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas 'chi ba bzlog /rang dang gzhan ni gnyis ka la/ /man ngag stobs kyis bzlog pa na5/ /rlung dang thig le yi ge dang / /gtum mo 'khor lo la sogs ni/ /'chi bslu 6cho ga dag dang ni/ /bla ma'i man ngag brgyud pas bya'o/ /'chi ba bslu 7ba'i sbyor ka ste sum cu 8gsum pa'o// //25—/ /20

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa 1la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stang stabs rim pa cung zhig bstan/ /shar phyogs g.yas brkyang la gnas nas/ /rkang pa dang ni lag pa yis/ /rdo rje rtse gsum stang stabs bya/ /gar bsgyur de ni thabs re bya / /rkang lag mthun par bsgyur ba bzlog /sgo ru g.yon brkyang la gnas nas / /ral gri'am dbyug to 'dzin pas su/ /rkang pa lag pa gnyis kas su//sa dang bar snang gnyis ka la/ /rin chen 'bar ma bye bar bya/ /nub phyogs g.yas brkyang la gnas nas/ /'khor lo'am ral gri de bzhin bye/ /byang phyogs g.yon brkyang la gnas nas/ /rdo rje rgya gram tshul du bye/ /yang na zlum po la sogs rim/ /bsrung ba'i tshul du bya ba dang / /phyogs bzhir 'byung po bkug nas ni/ /mnan cing bsnun pa'i tshul du bya/ /gzhan yang stang stabs rgyas pa ni/ /stoms 'jug la sogs rgyud na gsal/ /mkhas pas de ru shes par bya/ /'dir ni bsgrub pa'i don du bsdus/ /stang stabs spyor ba 'di dag ni / /bgegs bskrad don du nan tan bya'o/ /stang stabs kyi spyor ka ste sum cu bzhi pa'o// //ston pa phyag na rdo rje nas/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni yan chad du/ /brgyud pa'i rim pa'i man ngag 'di/ /snying po la sogs sgrub pa'o/ /gsang ba'i slob ma rin chen bkra/ /de rtsar hūṃ gi rnal 'byor dang / /brtul chen po ni rnal 'byor la/ /lo gsum bar du snod brtags nas/ /bde ldan rin chen yang gter du/ / btsa' dka' dam bzhag byas nas gtad/ /rin chen rdzas dang srog lus kyis/ /bla ma mnyes pas man ngag thob/ /de bzhin phyi rabs rnal 'byor gyis/ /de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /phyi rabs blo dman la sogs 25—1121

༄ / /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi gtor ma'i cho ga༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pā ṇi nī khāsba 2ra dha ra ba bo ta bi byeḥ /bod skad du/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon 4can gye gtor ma'i cho ga /'phags pa phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sgrub pa 5rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /bdag gis gtor ma bshad par bya/ /phan gdags pa dang tshar gcad 6pa/ /phan pa mchog dang thun mong ngo / /gsang ba bla med mchog tu 'dod/ /phyi nang thun mong shes par bya/ /rgyas dang bsdus dang shin tu bsdus / /tshar gcad 7pa yang shes par bya/ /dgug dang bskrad dang gsad pa dang / /mnan dang bsreg par shes par bya/ /rgyun nam dus chen bzhi gsum gnyis/ /chung ngu rgyun nam chen po ni/ /bcu gnyis bzhi 'am tha ma gcig /rtsa ba lnga dang yan lag lnga/ /'bru dang shing thog sman rnams dang / /chan thug khur ba la sogs pa'i/ /rdzas rnams thams cad tshogs 9par bsags/ /25—1128

de steng 1dkar gsum klu la shis/ /khrag sna snying sna sha sna gsum/ /de sogs thun rdzas tshar gcod 3do/ /bskyed rim tshul du bya ba dang / /bla ma nas bzung bsrung byas la/ /cho ga gsum du bskyed pa 'am/ /chung ngu skad cig lhar bskyed la/ /mtshan dang ldan pa'i pad+ma ru/ /rdzas rnams kun gyis bkang nas ni/ /steng du rdo rje sngon po bsam/ /khong seng can la hūṃ gis mtshan/ /mtho gang la ni ri bong can/ /de la bcu drug bdun pas mtshan/ /rdo rje mtshan ldan bar du ni/ /sdud sbyong 'phro ba'i mthing dmar dkar/ /pad 'og ye shes lnga ldan gsum/ /gru jegasum 'og na zla gam can/ /thugs kyi mthing gnag 'phros pa las/ /rdo rje lte bskul mtha' gnyis bskyod/ /dmar po 'bar bas mtshan ldan dros/ /thugs kyis bsdus shing gsung gis sbyangs/ /sku las thu'aphros pas ri bong bskul/ /shes rab can las 6'od zer 'phros/ /de yis yab yum bskul nas ni/ /kha dog dkar pos bdud rtsi phob / /dang po skul byed 'og tu ༄ — zhu/ /khong seng can nas pad+mar babs/ /babs pa'i rting la de nyid lhung / /lan gsum bskor nas 'o ma bzhin/ /lnga pa'i dang po lnga pas mtshan/ /de yis gdan bskyed 'khor bcas dgug /dzi hūṃ 9rdo rje khong seng can/ /bdud rtsi gsol bas mnyes par bsam/ /yang na lha mo dkar mo yis/ /mtshan ldan gyis ni bkang nas mchod/ /bstod nas bshags shing las bcol lo/ /de yang rgyas dang bsnyus dang shin tu bsdus/ /de ltar byas nas gshegs su gsol/ /yang na skad byug lhar bskyed la/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ gis bdud rtsi sbyangs/ /slar yang ye shes bdud rtsi phab7/ /yud tsam sprul pas / lha yis gsol/ /yud tsam mos pas gsum ka gsol na/ /25—1 /29

shin tu bsnyus pas zas de bzhin/ /phan gdags pa'i spyor ka ste dang po'o// //dgug pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga 3ni/ /thun mong cho ga thams cad ni/ /thun mong gtor ma dang mthun no / /khyad par gtor ma bstan pa ni/ /dur khrod 'jigs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /shin tu dmar ba'i gos gyon la/ /nub kyi phyogs su kha bltas te/ /cho ga gsum gyis lhar bskyed pa'am/ /cho ga rnam lngas lhar bskyed pa/ /gang yang rung byas byin gyis brlab/ /gtor ma'i rdzas ni thun mong rdzas steng du/ /khyad par rdzas ni rak+ta sna tshogs dang / /gshog pa can gyi 4sha sna sna tshogs shis/ /byin gyis brlabs la bde gshegs mchod / /gnyis pa mkha' 'gro ma la mchod/ /gsum pa chos skyong rnams la mchod/ /bzhi pas pa5'byung po thams cad tshim par bya yang na 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis su mchod par bya'o/ /sngags ni rtsa ba'i sngags la ba bo ta 6kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes lan bdun nam 3nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags ni oṃ budhe ḍā ki nī 8/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī9/ rat+na ḍā ki nīme/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī/1/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī 7/ sa ma /ya ḍā ki m+bi—/ sarba ḍā ki m+bi/ i rda 7ba bo ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal mgon po nag po ni mkha' 'gro ma'i gtso bo yin pas/rtsa ba'i sngags la btags te dbul/ /'jig rten pa'i mgon po nag po ni phyogs skyong gi gtso bo yin pas sngags kyang gong bzhin shes par bya/ phyogs skyong gi wīsngags ni/ in+d+ra zhes bya ba las kyi tshogs dang mthun/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i sngags ni oṃ a kā —ro mu khaṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pas 25—/ 130

bya'o / /de nas bstod pa bya zhing phrin 1las bcol/ /'od zer 'phros pas thal mo brdab/ /des su thams cad bskul nas ni/ /gang la bya ba dgug par bsam/ /de 'dra lan grangs brgya nas stong / /khri nas 'bum gyis khugs nga/ra 'gyur/ / 'gugs pa'i sbyor ka ste gnyis pa'o// //bskrad pa'i gtor ma'i sbyor ka ni/ /thun mong cho ga thams cad ni/ /thun mong gtor ma dag dang mthun/ /khyad par gtor ma phal cher yang / /bskrad pa'i tshogs kyi spyor ka stethu/ /man ngag khyad par bstan pa ni/ /shing lo/'am gro ga dag la ni/ /rlung dang bsgrub bya'i gzugs bris la/ /'od zer rlung gis bskyod pa dang / /khro bo dag gis bskyod pa dang / /rlung lha dag gis 4bskyod nas ni/ /nam mkha' mtha' gtugs bskyal bar bya/ /bskrad pa'i gtor ma'i sbyor ka ste gsum pa'o// //mnan pa'ang gong ma bzhin te mthun/ /khyad par ri rab 'bum dang ni/ /rdo rje dang ni khro bo yang / /'bum du byas te 'od zer sogs/ /spyor ba gzhan dang choman ngag bzhin/ /mnan pa'i spyor ka ste bzhi 6pa'o// //gsad dz+wapa khro bos gsad sa7pa dang / /mtshon cha'i char sogs dbab pas gsad9 / /sngags dang phyag rgya rdzas sogs gzhan/ /mkhas pas man ngag bye/ra bar bya'o/ /gsad ⑫pa'i spyor ka ste lnga 3pa'o// //25—1131

bsreg pa sgu gsung thugs kyis bsreg /yang na me la sogs pa yi/ /spyor ba gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /bsreg —rmyepa'i sbyor ka ste drug pa'o// // bcing ba yi ni sbyor ba yang / /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /lu gu rgyud dang zhags pa dang / /lcags sgog la sogs sbyor ba yis/ /mkhas nga/ yis ni bcing bar bya/ /bcing ba'i 1sbyor ka ste bdun pa'o// //klu dang rgyal po gnyis las ni/ /khyad par gtor ma bstan pa ni/ /dngul dang 'khar ba shing phor dang / /sa dkar snod du bya bar shis/ /sman sna 'bru sna —snying po lnga/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum klu la shis/ /rin chen sgod ni mdzes pa ru/ /rin chen lnga dang 'bru sna lnga/ /dar zab shing thos la sogs pa/ /rgyal po nyid la shis par gsungs/ /de gnyis byin gyis brlab pa yang / /rdzas kyi steng du dīḥ'am hūṃ/ /de yi 'od kyis rdzas rnams bsreg /skyon dag nas ni bdud rtsir bsam/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pa ni/ /mchos sbyin byas pa'i lag mthil du/ /bri las dpag bsam shing lo bsam6/ /de yi yal ga'i gseb tu ni/ /si las bdud rtsi'i 7bum pa bsam/ /de yis bdud rtsi yi ni rgyun/ /lag mthil du ni babs nas kyang / /gtor ma'i nang du 'dres par bsam/ /de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum bzlas/ de nas rang bi mdun du pad+ma bzhi bsam/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis/ klu thams cad ni pad+mar bkug /'od zer 'phros pas sbyong 8sogs bya/ /thams cad 'od du zhu ba las/ /bde gshegs sku yi 9sprul pa'am/ /gsung gi rigs 25—1 /32

kyi lha ru gyur/ / lkuspyan drangs bstem zhing dbang bskur bya/ /de nas lce rdo rje rtse lnga sbu gu can du bsams la/ des drangs la gsol bar bsam/ bstabs 4pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ba khrusu ki ba lo ta khā hi zhes klu rnams kyi 6so so'i rtsa ba'i sngags la btags la dbul bar bya'o/ /gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags ni badz+ra myuḥzhes btags la gshegs su gsol/ rgyal po yang sprul pa dang las kyi rigs su bsam/ phyi ma mthun te man ngag tu shes par bya'o/ /klu dang rgyal po'i spyor ka ste brgyad pa'o// //de dag thams cad phyi yin no/ /nang gi snying ga'i lha rnams la/ /gtor ma zas rnams yin pas na/ /bdud rtsir byen gyis brlabs nas ni/ /lha la ting nge 'dzin gyis dbul/ /de ni rnal 'byor lam pa yin/ /phyag rgya phyag rgya'i man ngag bzhin/ /nang gi gtor ma'i sbyor ka ste dgu pa'o// //gsang ba'i gtor ma'i sbyor ka ni/ /lte ba pad+ma gtor ma'i snod/ /de steng 7zla ba'i steng du ni/ /byang chub sems kyi kun+da 8la/ /bdud rtsi la sogs yon tan sogs/ /gtor ma'i rdzas su bstan pa yin/ /9de 'og rlung sngon bskyod pa las/ /me 'bar bdud rtsi zhu ste phab/ /'khor lo mkha' 'gro rnams la mchod/ /rtog pa zhi ba las rnams 'grub/ /gsang ba'i gtor ma'i spyor ka ste bcu pa'o// //bla med gtor ma'i sbyor ka ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba la/ /25—1133

thams cad rdzogs pa'i man ngag tshang hūṃ/ /bla na med pa'i man ngag gi sbyor ka ste bcu gcig pa'o// //gtor ma'i man ngag sbyor ka rnams/ /man ngag rim pa bkod pa yis/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims gzhon nus bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la ba thab nga sngubaskur mchan/1128 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du khros pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gtor ma'i cho ga bzhugs so// 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 bā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skopo/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ral 'byor/ 6 sto〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacad/ 8/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsad / 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'tshogs/1129 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stengs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra cad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byengs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bru—/ 5 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga ba/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra skul byed 'od du/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 skyed/ /dzi hūṃ/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanabab/ (1〈〈pe 〉dpa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasal/113༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byer ka 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉byedag dang mthun/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thas byas la/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gita/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasum mam/ 8 〈〈pe〉〉bhu ta ṭā ki ni/ 〈〈snar 〉snga rtse 7 ki ni/ rte — 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ཿ/ 1snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gim r+ṣa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉deḥ/ mu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamaḥ.i me/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ dzo〈〈pe 〉mog 〈〈snar 〉mom ka1131 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoraphrin/ rte 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉byedagug pa'i gtor ma'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kar blta /4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉skal/ 5〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pang / 6〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉lnga/ 7 — she 〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉thasad/tso1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabazhi/1132 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steg 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga cings pa yis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga cings par bya/ /bcingasapa'i 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ja 'bru lnga/ zhi〈〈pe 〉〉snyegs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rtog 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasam ste/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉25—1134

༄7/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho gshe༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa tsakra bi dhiḥ2 / bod skad du/tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga /dpal rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs chen khyad par bsags pa dang / /dam tshig nyams pa bskang ba dang / /sgrib sbyang mchog ni thob bya'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor lugs mthun bdag gis bshad/ /tshogs ni gnyis su shes par bya'o/ /phan gdags pa dang tshar gcad sngupa'i/ /de yang 'khor lo bskor dang mchod pa brtsam/ /phan pa mchog dang thun mong ngo //dgug dang bskrad dang mnan pa dang / /gsad 5pa la sogs tshar gcad dzipa'o//de sgrub rnal 'byor bstan pa ni/ /sngags pa gcig tu rtog byed dang / /dus rnams kun du rtse gcig ldan/ /rgyud rnams kyi ni snying po shes/ /de nyid bcu ni mchog tu rig /zab cing rgya chen 3chos la mos/ /yid ni shin tu 'jam pa dang / /bsnyen bkur ldan zhing 'jigs pa med/ /nga rgyal med cing 25—/ /36

gshegs 1 la brtson/ /brda dang phyag rgya'i mchod pa yi / /lan dang sbyor ba sogs la mkhas/ /gsang thub tshod rig lus ngag gzo4/ /de la sogs pa'i cho ga mkhas/ /gu ru la sogs lha dang bstun/ /de steng 5las kyi rnal 'byor gnyis / /byan po byan mo gsol ka gsum/ /phyi mtshams nang mtshams rol mo pa/ /de ni rnal 'byor rgyas pa'i tshad/ /lha steng 6las kyi skar 7ma dang / / mtshan ma nyid ni bsdus pa'o/ /lnga pa yan chad shin tu bsdus/ /'khor lo basbus rgyas mkhas pas bya/ /mchod pa bzhi gsum gnyis su 9bya/ /de yi rim pa'ang gong bzhin du/ /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin thob/ /'khor lo gral ni dkyil 'khor tshul/ /yang na mchog 'dod pa dang thun mong ni/ /grags ma grangs kyi rim pa yis/ /mchod pa'i tshul gyis rim pas bya/ /byen gyis brlabs sam rigs mthun par/ /nyams dga' 1yid 'jug gnas dag tu / /'khor khang sum rim dang po yi/ /sgo bzhi gnyis pa sgo la gsum pa shar//de yi thun mong khyad par ni/ /dang po sa 'og phyi ma ste/ /rim gsum gyen du brtsigs pa ni/ /lus 'dod pa dang saphyi ma'i lugs/ /phan 'dogs don du bstan pa'o/ /dur khrod mtsho gling 'jigs pa'i gnas/ /'di 'dra'i rigs mthun la sogs pas1 / /tshar gcad 2don du gong bzhin bya/ /dus ni rgyun nam lo 'am zlaratsha/ /khyad par bzhi gsum gnyis dang gcig /bcu gnyis bzhi ru dam tshig go/ /de ltar ma byas mkha' 'gros gsod/ /byas na dngos grub chen po 'thob7/ /yon tan spyor ba'i rim pa dang / /sgrub po 'dod pa'i rim pa yis/ /gong gi khyad par shes par bya/ /phyi ltar ba yi rnam lngas byug /nang ni bdud rtsi rnam lngas byug /phyi ni mdzes pa'i rgyan rnams bris/ /25—1137

nang ni dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor gsang mchog nub mo 7bri/ /ngag gi brda skad thabs gsum gyis/ /rnal 'byor rnams ni bsdu bar bya/ /dbyug sngon gyis ni lus ngag brda —/ /bum pa nas bzung phyi nang gsang / /dril 4nas dbye gsal rim pas bya/ /slob dpon mdun du 'khon gcugs sbyang 5/ /las kyi sems dpa' gral la dgod/ /rgyan cha gan 6la go bgor ④gnas/ /slob dpon gyis ni byen brlabs shing / /las kyi sems mas rtags gsum gdab/ /rang gis lhag pa'i nga rgyal bya/ /gar mas maṇ+ḍal mchod pa rnams/ /rim par byas nas gsol ba gdab/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa tshul bzhin bsgom/ /so so'i lha yi nga rgyal bya/ /de ltar mi shes lhag pa'i lha/ /de ltar byas nas gtso bo'i brdas / /karma la ni bskul bar bya/ /karma 'khor ma dang bcas la/ /tshogs kyi bye brag brgya rtsa brgyad/ /'gying bag tshul gyis drang bar bya/ /tshogs kyi dbye ba bstan pa ni/ /rtsa ba lnga las rtsa lngar gyur/ /thun mong du ni brgya 3bya la / /rnal 'byor zab mo'i spyod pa peyin/ /sha yi bye brag nyi shu lnga/ /btung ba'i bye brag de bzhin no/ /sman gyi bye brag nyi shu dang / /bshos dang dkar gyi bye brag kyang / /phyed mar byas pa'i sum cu yin/ /spos kyi bye brag brgyad du bstan / /de nas bsnyus pa phyed du bstan ṇa// /shin tu bsdus pa de yi phyed/ /de ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo'o/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa'i rim pa ni/ /bcu dang lnga dang gsum du bya/ /de yi rab 'bring sgrub pa'o/ /bsod nams che chung rim pa de'o/ /tshogs de slob dpon byin gyis brlabs/ /rlung gis me sbar mtshan ldan dros/ /de nyid gsum gyi las byas la/ /bdud rtsi bab 7cing rdo rjes dkrugs/ /bdud rtsi'i tsorang bzhin 'od du zhu/ /btung ba'i byin 25—1138

rlabs la sogs kyang / /man ngag bzhin du byin brlabs la/ /bdud rtsi mchod pa phyogs bkram la/ /dang po las kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /mdun du lha bskyed spyan drangs bstem/ /dang po phyag 'tshal mchod lnga 'bul/ /de nas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul⑫/ /de 'og be+egs kyu lnga po dang / /glu dang gar gye mchod pa 'bul/ /hūṃ gi snyegru blangs mchod pa ni/ /nyi shu yang ni bya bar gsungs—/ /bstod cing rol mo'i mchod pa 'bul / /de nas rnal 'byor rnams la mchod/ /lhag ma mkha' 'gro rnams la mchod/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon po byas nas ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis ④chag chag gdab/ /me tog sngon po'i tshom bu bya snye//sa la gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /bskyed cing spyan drangs bstem byas la/ /byen gyis brlabs la mchod pa bya/ /lhag ma kha chus btab nas ni/ /sbyang dang spro ba bsdus gyebyas la/ /'khor khang phyi logs maṇ+ḍal bya/ /khrag gis byug cing ④me tog dgram/ / bshud glu brda kyeyis spyan drangs nas9/ /rnal 'byor skra bshig thal bas ⑫byug /rgyan chas gon la rtags rnams gdab/ /lha yi ting 'dzin gsal byas nas/ /rdo rje'i glu blangs rol mo brdung / /mchod cing bstod nas mthol bshags bya/ /phrin 2las bcol la gshegs su gsol/ / tshogs kyi spyor ka'i phrin ⑫las kyis/ /rnal 'byor pa yi las rnams 'grub/ /slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // ༄7/ / mezab pa don gyi cho ga rnams/ /rin chen lta bu'i gang zag la//zab phyir man ngag bkol ⑫nas bstan/ /mchog gi tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/ /thun mong cho ga thams cad ni/ /thun mong tshogs 'khor dang mthun no/ /khyad 25—1139

par cho ga bstan pa ni/ /rin chen phub 2pa dgu rim mam/ /bdun rim lnga rim sum rim ni/ /mu stegs nyan thos skye bo yisaldu/ /skrag 3 'gyur log spyod spyad byed gsum/ /de dag spang phyir gong bzhin bstan/ /rgyal rigs rje'u rigs bram ze'i rigs/ /bu mo mtshan dang ldan pa ni/ /mtshan rnams bcu po rdzogs pa dang / /shes rab che dang snying rje che/ /dad pa la sogs che ba dang / /rnal 'byor ldan pa thuphyag rgya mkhas/ /spyor thabs kun la rab tu mkhas/ /de lta'i rnal 'byor nyung yang lnga/ /mang bar gyur na rnal 'byor kyang / /bskyed de de ltar rigs 6par spyad/ /lnga gnyis zung du gnas pa las/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa mthar phyin pas/ /nang gi mchod pa brtsam par bya/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa brtsam/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa'i cho ga yis/ /dga' ba'i ye shes bcu drug ni/ /'khor lo'i tshul las lhan cig bskyed/ /ye shes 'khor lo zhes su grags/ /yang na sprul pa'i 'khor lo la/ /thig le phra mo bsam pa ni/ /rnal 'byor pha yin rtsa rnams mamu/ /rlung ni las kyi sems dpa' yin tre/ /de la sogs pa'i man ngag rnams/ /slob dpon zhal las shes par bya/ /'khor lo gsum la'ang de bzhin no/ /tshogs zhes bya ba mang po (she7yin/ /'khor lo zhes bya bskor du btub/ /mchog ces bya ba lhan cig dga'aṅku/ /de ltar mchog gi 'khor lo ni/ /yang yang sbyang zhing bsgom par bya/ /mchog gi tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i spyor ka ste gnyis pa'o// //dgug pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/ /thun mong cho ga thams cad ni/ /thun mong tshogs 'khor dang mthun no/ /khyad par cho ga bstan pa ni/ /dur 25—1140

khrod 'jigs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /shin tu dmar ba'i gos gyon nas/ /nub phyogs su ni kha bltas te/ /cho ga gsum gyis lhar bskyed nas/ /'khor bskyed pa'am 1mi bskyed pa'o/ /bskyed pa hūṃ gis bskyed pa dang / /mi bskyed skad cig sprul pa'o/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs sogs/ /byas nas bskyed rim mthar phyin nas/ /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor sprul pa la/ /cho ga la sogs rdzogs byas nas/ /dur khrod ras ma dag la ni/ /mdun du gzugs sam 'khor lo bri/ /dgug pa'i yi ge'i 'od zer gyis/ /bsgrub bya bkug nas bstem par bya/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi po de dag la/ /mchod bstod la sogs byas nas ni/ /phrin 2las bcol zhing rbad pa dang / /sngags bzlas brgya rtsa brgyad du ni/ /rab kyis bya ba 'bring gis 1ni/ /lnga brgya tha ma stong gis ni thu/ /bzhi po 5rab tu re re yang / /de bzhin gcig gis 'grub pa dang / /yang na thun bar bzhi dag tu/ /rtsa gcig lnga bcu brgya rtsa brgyad/ /de lta'i 'khor lo rtsa gcig dang / /lnga bcu brgya rtsa brgyad du ni/ /sgrub po khyad par rab 'bring gis/ /bsgrub bya gang yin khyag par 'gyur gye/ /nyi shu rtsa drug mtha' la dzani/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni bcug nas su/ /'gugs byed bsre bas 4snagazhug par bya/ /dgug pa tshogs kyi sbyor ka la/ /nyin dang mtshan du brtsam par bya/ /dgug pa tshogs kyi 9sbyor ka ste gsum pa'o// //bskrad pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/ /thun mong cho ga thams cad ni/ /phan gdags pa ni nyid dang mthun/ /khyad par 'jigs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /25—1141

lho phyogs su ni kha bltas te/ /sngon po la sogs gos gon la/ /bskyed rim tshul du bya ba dang / /cho ga gsum gyis bya ba yin/ /de nas ye shes spyan drangs nas/ /cho ga la sogs rdzogs par bya/ /mdun du dur khrod ras ma la/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /de steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan bris nas ni/ /rnal 'byor ci 'dod mdun du bsam/ /yang na gtso bo lnga'am drag po gnyis/ /las la med du mi rung ngo / /gtso bo drag po'i snalas ni bsdus/ /slob dpon gnyis po shin tu bsdus/ /dkyil 'khor gsum po sprul pa las/ /cho ga la sogs rdzogs par bya/ /tshogs kyi rdzas rnams ma lus bsagasaju sna/ /khyad par tsit+ta sna tshogs dang / /sha sna khrag sna la sogs pas/ /tshul khrims bsrung ldan nas bzung nas/ /sgo mangs can ni yan chod kyi/ /rang gi sbyor ba ma byas par/ /gzhan la nyos dang bslangs pa yis / /rdzas rnams rdo rje can gyis ni/ /rgyud las bsngags par bcom ldan gsungs / /byan pos btso bsreg byas nas ni/ /yon bdag 'khor dang bcas nas ni4/ /bskor ba bdun nam gsum byas la/ /'gying bag 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis ni/ /slob dpon la ni rdo rje'i glus/ /phyag rgya bsgyur nas drang bar bya/ /hūṃ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /gnyis med ye shes mthu ldan pas / /dbyings las ma g.yos rtogs med kyang / /sems can gdul ba'i 5don slad du/ /rdo rje can gyi sku sprul nas/ /rtse gcig ldan pa'i ting 'dzin gyis / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen 'di/ /bdag gzhan lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir5/ /byin kyis brlab 37pa mdzad du gsol/ /de nas rdo rje saslob dpon gyis/ /yi ge gsum gyi bdud rtsi yis/ /bsreg sbyangs bdud rtsi zhu nas 25—1142

kyang / /bde gshegs mchod bstod rdzogs byas nas/ /phrin 1las bcol bas khro bo yi/ /sngags bzlas pas ni bsgrub bya ste/ /'khor lo rlung gi dkyil 'khor la/ /bsgrub bya de ru bzhag nas su/ /khro bo dpag med spros pa yi/ /zhal nas rlung nag 'tshub 7ma ni/ /btang bas bsgrub bya bteg nas kyang / /nub byang mtshams kyi kyerlung lhas ni/ /khyad par de nyid bskyod nas kyang / /nam mkha'i ④mthas gtugs sa ru bskyal/ /de ltar lan gsum lha gsum gyis/ /cho ga byas te bskyal bar bya/ /bskrad yepa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i spyor ka ste bzhi pa'o / / //mnan pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/ /thun mong cho ga thams cad ni/ /phan gdags pa ni nyid dang mthun/ /khyad par cho ga bstan pa ni/ /ri bo dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /slob dpon lho phyogs kha bltas te/ /ser nag la sogs rgyan cha gon/ /cho ga la sogs rdzogs byas la/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi mdun du ni/ /dur khrod ras ma dag la ni/ /ba bla'am ldong ros khu bas sam6 /gser gyis spru ri rab bris nas kyang / /de 'og mthing shun dag gis ni/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i gzugs bris la/ /de gnyis dag gi bar du ni/ /bsgrub bya'i ming rnams bris nas kyang / /shugs ldan pa dang mgo 'chos dang / /kun du rgyug pa yan chod kyi/ /rnam 9gsum po ni thams cad kun/ /chos mthun spyod pas btsal nas kyang / /byan po de rdzogs rdzas rnams la/ /yid 'ong dpag sded bshams nas kyang / /bskor nas slob dpon la phul bas/ /cho ga la sogs rdzogs nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i cho ga yis/ /sngags bzlas 25—1143

—brgya rtsa brgyad pa gnyis/ /ting 'dzin ldan pas 1bsgrub bya ste/ /ming gi yi ge bskyed nas kyang / /yi ge gnyis po ri rab zi bye/ /rgya mtsho bskyed nas mnan par bya/ /dkyil 'khor mtha' ma'i cho ga yis/ /khang pa'i phyi rol dag tu ni/ /drag po'i 'brub khung byas nas kyang / /nag pos kha ni bcad nas kyang / /de steng las kyi rgya gram bri/ /de sogs cho ga'i spyor bas su/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mnan par bya'o/ /mnan pa'i tshogs kyi bye sbyor ka ste lnga pa'o// //gsad 4pa'i tshogs kyi spyor ka deni/ /thun mong cho ga thams cad ni/ /phan gdags pa dang mthun par bsam/ /khyad par cho ga bstan pa ni/ /dur khrod 'jigs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /slob dpon lho phyogs kha bltas te/ /gnag 6cing drag po'i ④rgyan cha gon/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi mdun du ni/ /dur khrod ras la gzugs bris la/ /phur bu gri gug mtshon cha rnams/ /khro bo'i sngags kyis byin brlabs nas/ /phur bus 3gdab cing gri gug ḍagatub/ /thun mong rdzas rnams steng du ni/ /gdong pa can ni sna tshogs kyis hūṃ/ /gsum dang ldan pa yid du 'ong / /slob dpon la ni phul nas kyang / /dang po bsgrub bya de nyid la/ /bkug nas khro bo'i mtshon cha yis/ /gsad nyu1pa'i cho ga byas nas su/ /rtsa gcig la sogs sngags kyis ni/ /de bzhin byin brlabs 8byas nas ni /// /dang po 'khor lo mchod nas kyang / /cho ga la sogs rdzogs byas la/ /slar yang bsgrub bya bkug nas ni/ /mdun bsams gsad 4 pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /cho ga rdzogs nas tha ma ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis gsad 7pa yi/ /spyor bas cho ga rdzogs par bya'o/ /gsad tshepa'i tshogs kyi 25—1 14 4

——'khor lo'i sbyor ka ste drug pa'o// // sreg pa tshogs kyi rtesbyor ka ni/ /cho ga thams cad gzhan dang mthun/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du sbyin sreg gsum/ /rnal 'byor pa ni thams cad kyis/ /sngags la sogs pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /bskor ba'i tshul du tha ma ni/ /las mkhan gyis ni bsreg par bya'o/ /de yi cho ga thams cad ni/ /sbyin sreg cho gar shes par bya'o/ /sreg pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ka ste bdun pa'o / / //bstabs sepa tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/ /cho ga thams cad gzhan dang mthun//khyad par cho ga bstan pa ni/ /rnam par bam pa ma yin pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bam chen blangs nas ni/ /ming gi yi ge bskyed nas kyang / /de nyid dkyil 'khor gsum po la/ / bstabs te yang na rjas la ni/ /bsams te byin brlabs byas nas kyang / / gar ma shedabyug sngon rta mgrin gyis/ /lan gsum lan bdun nyi shu gcig /bstabs zhepa'i tshogs ni mkhas pas so de nas phyi rol dag tu bya/ /de ltar gnyis bstabs 6gsum du bstabs7/ /slob dpon man ngag shes par bya'o/ /bstabs — pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i spyor ka ste brgyad pa'o// //thun gsum thun bzhi dag tu ni/ /nyin dang mtshan ni lan gsum du/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ka la/ /rnal 'byor can gyis brtson par bya'o/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'dod pa dang / /bar chad rnam gnyis bsal ba'i phyir/ /25—1 145
