༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ho dṛ bi byeḥri / bod skad du/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdig pa gzhil dang bsod nams 'phel/ /dgug dang dbang byed gsad hūṃpa'i sa/ /sgrub po rnams la phan btags phyir/ /bdag gis ④sbyin sreg bshad par bya/ /dang po bkra shis gnas dag tu/ /brtag sogs bsdus rgyas rnam gsum bya/ /'bring ni rang nyid gos sngon gyi/ /ting 'dzin ldan pas bka' bsgo rgyazhing / /shar du kha bltas 'byung po la/ /yid dang mthun pa'i gtor ma sbyin/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'am/ /hūṃ gis yang ni sbyang bar bya/ /rdo rje phyag rgya de bzhin shes / /snying ga'i yi ges skyon sbyangs shing / /sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang ba'o/ /de ni rgyas pa'i rtags sogs 'dod/ /'azing ni sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangasarte / /me tog tshom bu grangs mnyam pa/ /gzhung bzhin bris pa rdzogs par 'dod/ /25—11718

tha ma mdzes pa'i snod dag la/ /yig 'bru gsum gyis byen brlabs nas/ /ting 'dzin sbyang ba kho nar 'dod/ /sa skyon sbyang ba gsum shes bya/ /thab brtsigs 3rgyar ni khru gang la/ /zabs su khru phyed zlum pos bskor/ /sor bzhi gsum ni dor byas la/ /rdo rje dbus su brgyad pa'i tshad/ /thab khung dkar po rgyab tu ske ri'o/ /steng du rdo rje phyi rol 'od zer dkar/ /bud shing dkar po khru gang tshad/ /tsan+dan dkar po 'o mas spangs te bzhag /mchod sbyin shing ni mdzub gang tshad/ /'dab ma dang bcas rtse mo'i ngos/ /sngar bzhin spangs napas yam shing bya/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum mar gyi 'og /'bras chan 'bru ni sna tshogs dang / /ku sha yon chab g.yas su gzhag /me tog la sogs bsang gtor dang / /zhal bsil rnams ni g.yon du gzhag /dgang gzar dang ni blugs gzar gnyis/ /mtshan nyid rgyas par gzhan du bstan/ /yang na g.yas kyi sor mo bskum pa las/ /yi ge hūṃ gi 'od zer de yis ni/ /rdo rje can gye 'od zer bkug pa yis/ /rdul bshig 5ye shes gong bu las/ /rdo rje khro bo'i dgang gzar gyur/ /g.yon gyi mthe bos mthe chung mnan/ /gong bzhin sbyangs nas glugs gzar gyur/ /de nyid rdo rje dril ni mdun/ /de nas dkar po'i rgyan cha bgo/ /yid dang mthun pa'i gyeku sha'i steng / /sems dpa'i kruskyil krung shar du bltari — / /thab sogs tsan+dan chus gtor te/ /bud shing ma nor zlum por brtsig /de nas rtswa ni ku sha la/ /oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sarba birgyu rtenā sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ las kyi sngags kyis bsang gtor bya/ /bum sbyangs bskyed dgug bzlas pa yis/ /rtsa gcig bdun kyis cha'od zer dgang / /thab kyi kho ra khor yug la/ /ku sha'i rtse mo phyi ru bstan/ /de nas lha yi rnal 25—1149

'byor ni/ /cho ga lnga'am cho ga gsum/ /skad cig bsdus rgyas shes par bya/ /thab la sogs pa'i man ngag kyang / /las kyi tshogs su shes par bya/ /de yang slob dpon man ngag gtso/ /bram ze'i khyem mam gtsub shing meskye/ /rlung g.yab kyis sbar las kyis bsang / /sbyang zhing bskyed nas ram̐ dkar pos/ /me lha dkar po drang srong zhi ba'i tshul/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa dkar por ldan/ /phyag na 2dbyug pa bgrang phreng dang / /gudhe skyabs sbyin bsnams pa'o/ /'od 'phros sngar bzhin spyan drangs te/ /oṃ ba pa ka asna ye ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya/ma ma shādzhai ku ru swā hā/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcings te spyan drang ngo / /bgegs bskrad bsnyims te 1mchod pa dbul/ /rtsa sngags nyid la mchod sngags btags te dbul/ /oṃ ba pa ka asna ye/ che ge mo shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ zhes sreg rdzas dbul bar bya'o/ /de yi man ngag 'od zer ni/ /sum skor du ni bya ba dang / /nyis skor du ni bya ba dang / /bdag nyid rab tu shes par bya/ /bzhi skor dag dang slob ma'o/ /'od zer dkar po 'phros pa las/ /thugs dang snying ga brgyud jepa dang / /gsum sgonas ngag la brgyud pa dang / /dbu nas mgo la brgyud pa yi/ /lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang / /rtsa ba gsum 'dus bskang bar bya/ /spyi bo'i shigatsug nas brtsams nas ni/ /sdig dang srin bu zad pa'i phyir/ /dmar pos bsreg 7cing dkar pos bkru/ /sgo dgu dag nas bsnyu ba dang / /thams cad kun nas bsdu ba dang / /snying gar bsdus nas dbyung ba dang / /nyil gyis gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /sdig pa'i gzugs la de gzhug bya/ /rdzas rnams bdud rtsis mchod pas ni/ /de nas sdig pa de bsreg bya/ /yang na rdzas la bstems te 3pabasreg /nad rnams 25—1150

zhi bar byed pa ni/ /nad kyi ming nas smos nas ni/ /gong ma de bzhin bsreg 1pa 'am/ /nad kyi ming dang gzugs bris la/ /'od zer dmar pos bsregs nas ni/ /dkar pos sbyang zhing zhi bsams la/ /'byung ba'i dgra rnams de bzhin bsam/ /'byung po kun dang dgra kun yang / /'od zer bkye bas zhi bar bsam/ /gzugs dang ming bris zhi bar bya/ /sreg rdzas bdud rtsi 'od kyis mchod/ /mchod pas mnyes pas gong bzhin bskor/ /de lta min na 'og bzhin no/ /man ngag de la nan tan bya/ /mar dang dkar gsum mngar gsum dang / /yam shing dkar po zho can dang 2/ /de la sogs pa'i thun rdzas rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du dbul bar bya/ /til ni rnged du mi rung ngo / /tha ma dgang blugs mthol bshags bya/ /bstod cing phrin las bcol bar bya/ /thugs ka nyid du pho brang bca'/ /skad cig de gsal ye shes dgug /bstem la mchod pa rnam lnga bya/ /rtsa sngags mchod sngags btags te dbul/ /sreg rdzas kun kyang de bzhin bya/ /man ngag rim pa 'dir shes bya/ /slob dpon zhal nas shes par bya/ /bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig dag /brgya rtsa brgyad ni basbus rgyas pa'o/ /rtsa lnga lnga bcu brgya yis ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa zhi bar 'gyur / /sdig pa che bar gyur na 4ni/ /nyis 'gyur gsum ni brgyad brgya'o/ /shin tu che gyur stong gi bar/ /de yis ltasdig dang bsod nams ni/ /che chung rab 'bring shes par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na nges par zhi/ /tha ma dgang blugs mthol bshags bya/ /bstod cing las bcol gshegs su gsol/ /ting 'dzin bsdus nas me lhag mas/ /mchod nas sreg rdzas gong bzhin dbul/ /dgang blugs la sogs rdzogs byas la/ /ting 'dzin basbus te spyod lam bya/ /25—1 151

thun gsum sbyor ka sbyin sreg la/ /rnal 'byor can gyis brtson par bya/ /sbyin sreg gi sbyor ka slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // ༄7/ /tshorgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ /maṇ+ḍal kha dog ser po la/ /khru do khru phyed khru gang du/ /bskor te gru bzhi'am zur brgyad du/ /byas nas sor gnyis sor bzhi can/ /dbus su rin chen 'bar bas mtshan/ /bar du me ri'i kha khyer steng / /rin chen rdo rjes bskor bar bri/ /ser po'i rgyan chas bgos nas ni/ /byang phyogs ngos su kha bltas la/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i tshul bsgoms nas/ /las kyi bum pa sbyang sogs bya'o/ /'bras bu 'o ma can gyi shing / /kha dog ser po dbus kyi cha/ /thab khung dbus su brtsegs par 2bya/ /khru gang khru phyed mdzub gang du/ /dri zhim spangs pa yam shing bya/ /las kyi bum pas bsangs nas ni/ /mchod rdzas ser po la sogs rnams/ /g.yon du mar sar zho la sogs/ /me sbar snyebartag cing thab khung sbyang / /thab bskyed me lha bskyed pa ni/ /sde tshan drug pa'i gsum pa dang / /gnyis pa lnga pa'i dang ngo/ ni / /bskyed pa la ni bsngags par gsungs/ /me lha ser po zhal gcig ni//phyag bzhi zhabs sroganyis dbang chen gdanabyu/ /spyan drangs bstems te dbang bskur ro/ /mchod pa la sogs byas nas ni/ /de nas sreg rdzas rnams ni dbul / /rtsa sngags nyid la mtha' bzhi ru/ /gzar bu rin chen rdo rjes bya'o//rgyas par bstan pa zhi dang mthun/ /man ngag nyis 3skor la sogs kyang / /zhi dang mthun te khyad par ni/ /'od zer sna bug zhugs nas ni/ /snying ga dag tu phyin nas ni/ /lus kun rtsa yi rlung rnams dang / /byang chub sems ni 25—1152

gsal zhing rgyas/ /yang na 'od zer lus kun la/ /khyab pas tshe dang bsod nams dang / /stobs rnams gang 'dod rgyas par 'gyur/ /tha ma dgang blugs bstod par 1bya/ /de ni 'bar ba'i rnam pa 'am/ /thugs ka nyid du gos sngon can/ /bskyed nas spyan drangs bstem byas la/ /dbang bskur mchod pa la sogs bya/ /dgang drugs bstod nas bshags pa 2bya/ /ye shes gshegs nas ting 'dzin bsdu/ /yi ge bcu bdun mtha' bsgyur la/ /bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig tu/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas te bya/ /me lha rdzas rnams bsdus nas ni/ /cho ga la sogs gong bzhin bya/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig nas bzung nas / /stong gi bar du tshun chad du/ /sbyor ba gnyis po gang byas kyang / /ji ltar 'dod pa rgyas par 'gyur/ /thun gsum sbyin sreg sbyor ka las/ /rnal 'byor can gyis brtson par bya'o/ /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi spyor ka ste gnyis pa'o//slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // ༄7/ / snadabang gi sbyin sreg spyor ka ni/ /sa gzhi dmar ba'i thab khung du/ /bha ga lta bu'am zla gam bya/ /tshad ni rgyas pa'i chung 'bring ngo / /kha khyer mu ran gnyis dang bzhi/ /gri gug gam gzhus 4ni dbus su mtshan/ /pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad la'o/ /bud shing dmar po tsher ma'i shing / /yam shing sor ni bcu gnyis sam/ /sor brgyad tshad la dri mar bsku/ /mchod rdzas dmar po g.yas su gzhag 5 /mar la sogs pa'i sreg 6rdzas ni/ /dmar po'i ro dang dris bsgyur nas/ /g.yon du bzhag nas stan dmar po/ /rol pa'i 'dug stangs nub phyogs blta/ /dmar po la sogs rgyan chas bgo/ /25—1153

—bud shing bcer te gsang 1bar bya/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa tshul bsgoms nas/ /gre sbar la sogs cho ga bya/ /rlung gi yi ge bsngags pa yin/ /kha dog dmar po rlung la gnas/ /spyan drangs bstems te dbang bskur ro/ /mchod pa la sogs dbul ba ni/ /me lha'i sngags la mtha' bsgyur snal/ /cho ga la sogs rdzogs nas ni/ /me lha'i thugs kar lha bskyed nas/ /spyan drangs la sogs cho ga bya/ /'od zer dmar po 'phros nas ni/ /lha mnyes pas ni dgug par bsam / /yang na man ngag sbyor ba gsum/ /tha ma me yi cho ga ni/ /me lha'i sngags kyis gsum mam bdun/ /lha yi —nyi shu rtsa brgyad sngagasaje/ /bdun nam brgya yi bar du bya/ /de ltar sbyin sreg spyor ka la/ /nyin mtshan du ni brtson par bya'o/ /slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa dbang gi sbyin sreg gi sbyor ka ste gsum pa rdzogs so// // ༄7/ /gsad 5pa'i sbyin sreg spyor ka ni/ /thab khung gru gsum kha dog gnag /rdo rje gri gug nang dang steng / /bar du me ri rtse mo 'phags/ /bdud rtsi la sogs tshon rtsi byug /bud shing nag po tsher ma can/ /yam shing de mthun bcu gnyis tshad/ /mchod rdzas la sogs nag po shis/ /tshil chen mar nag la sogs pa'i/ /khyad par gdong pa can gyi sha /rgyud las byung ba'i sreg rdzas shis/ /nam phyed nyin phyed dus dag tu/ /sa gzhi mtho ba'i stan dag la / /brkyang bsgum la sogs rgyan cha rdzogs/ /bskyed rim tshul du byas nas ni/ /me sbar la sogs cho ga bya/ /me lha gang 'dod bskyed nas ni/ /ye shes spyan drangs mchod sogs dbul/ /rnal 'byor spyor ka'i man ngag ni/ /'di ni 25—1 /54

shin tu zab ces pas/ /gzu lums rtog ge dgag pa'i phyir/ /slob dpon zhal las shes par bya'o/ /lha yi cho ga sgogs nas ni/ /me lha bsams te bsang byas la1/ /rdzas rnams thams cad bsdus nas ni/ /cho ga la sogs sdogs bya'o/ /drag po las kyi sbyor ka ste bzhi pa rdzogs so// // ༄༄/ / basbus pa las kyi spyor ka ni/ /thun mong cho ga thams cad ni/ /gong ma bzhin du shes byas la/ /brko zhing bru ba ma nus pas/ /maṇ+ḍal bdud rtsis byugs nas su/ /tshon rnams kyis ni bri bar bya/ /de nas cho ga rdzogs bya'o / /shin tu bsnyus pa'i sbyor ka ni/ /maṇ+ḍal byas la rnge tog dgram/ /skad cig lhar bskyed byen brlabs la/ /bsrung ba'i cho ga byas nas ni/ /cho ga la sogs rdzogs bya'o/ /khyad par zhi ba dngul dang ni/ /khar nab dag ni shis pa ste/ /rgyas pa'i 4gser dang ra gan dang / /dbang gi 5zangs la drag po'i lcags/ /khye yi thod pa'ang bya bar gsungs/ /dbyibs rnams so sor byas pa 'am/ /yang na bsams te byas pa'o/ /de rnams rnyed par ma gyur na/ /sa ni rin chen dang 'dra bas/ /kham phor snod rnams kun la ni/ /so so'i dbyebs ni byas pa dang / /bsams te byen gyis brlabs byas la/ /cho ga la sogs rdzogs bya'o/ /sbyin sreg las kyi spyor ka rnams/ /rna bar brgyud pa'i rim pa yis/ /rgyud la gab pa'i don rnams kun/ /bdag gis sgrub pa po la bstan/ /'di 25—/ /55

1086༄7/ /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pā ṇi m+bi lālba ra dha ra ho tro bi byeḥ2/bod skad du/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga /dpal gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /man ngag rim pa dran tsam zhig /slob ma'i don du bshad par bya/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yis/ /sgrub pa yi ni dus dag tu/ /sbyin sreg dag gis gsad 1par bya/ /sa brtag bslang 4zhing sbyang ba dang / /byin gyis brlab cing bsrung ba dang / / snying po 5dag tu bya mi dgos / /maṇ+ḍal gru gsum lho phyogs bstan/ /khru gang tshad la phyed brkos nas6/ /gsum dor gsum ni kha khyer ro/ /bdud rtsi sogs tshon 7nag por bya/ /de dbus rdo rje steng yang de/ /bar du me ri rtse mo 'phags/ /bud shing gnag cing gdug pa'i shing / /thab kyi tshad las sor mtho tsam/ /yam shing de mthun bcu gnyis tshad/ /mchod rdzas nag po la sogs shis/ /sreg rdzas mar 25—/ 158

nag rus khrag sha / skye tshe shang 1tshe yungs kar dang / /de la sogs pa'i thun 2rdzas bya/ /rdzas de rnams kyis gzugs brnyan bya/ /mchod rdzas g.yas la sreg rdzas g.yon/ /byin gyis brlab cing gzhag par bya/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar gzhan dang mthun/ /yang na lag pa dag gis bya/ /de gnyis rdo rje dril bu yang / /mdun nyid du yang gzhag 4par bya/ / bzang ngan de ni bya mi dgos—/ /snyelas kyi bum pas thams cad bsang / /dus ni nam phyed nyin 6phyed bya/ /rgyan cha gon la lho phyogs blta/ /g.yon brkyang 'dug ste drag tu bzlas / /mche ba gcigs shing khro gnyer basbu/ /dang po bskyed pa sngon song nas / /me sbar brtag cing bgegs bzlog bya/ /bzang na de ni bya mi dgos/ /tha mas sbyang zhing bskyed pa dang / /cho ga gsum dang skad cig mas/ /me lha nag po khros pa bskyed/ /ye shes me lha spyan drangs bstim/ /gnyis su med par rgyas btab la/ /me lha'i sngags la mchod sngags btags te dbul/ /de nas sreg rdzas dbul bar bya/ /de dag 7dbul ba'i man ngag kyang / /khro bo dag gi cho 'phrul gyis/ /gzugs brnyan 8dgug bstim gtubs te dbul/ /yang na rdzas mchod mnyes pa las/ /'od zer khro bas rka dgug cing bsreg /man ngag de la nan tan bya/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha asne/ che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/stong rtsa brgyad nas brgya rtsa brgyad/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bar du'o/ /yang na bsod nams dag gi rim pa yis/ /brgya dang stong dang khri ru bya/ /de ltar byas pas de 11gsod cing / /khyad par du ni 'byung po gsod/ /tha ma dgang blugs bstod bya'o/ /de yi thugs kar gos sngon bskyed/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang 1 bstem/ /rgyas btab mchod pa gong bzhin dbul/ /de nas sreg rdzas 25—1/59

rim bzhin dbul/ /rtsa sngags nyid kyis dbul bar bya/ /gong gi man ngag shes par bya/ /dgang drugs phul la bstod par bya/ /phrin las bcol zhing gshegs su gsol/ /ting 'dzin bsdus te me lha bsang / /rdzas rnams thams cad bsnyus nas ni/ /me yi lha la dbul zhing bstod pa bya/ /phrin las bcol zhing gshegs su gsol/ /ting 'dzin bsdus te spyod lam bya/ /slob ma rnams kyi don ched du/ /bdag gis man ngag 'di bkod pas/ /slob dang sems can thams cad kyang / /gos sngon dngos grub thob par shog /slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1158 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉phyag na rdo rje gos sngo na ngo/ can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga bzhugs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ཿ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasad/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wāng / 5〈〈pe 〉lkeng pa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rnying pa/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+ku sogs tshon rtsis/1159 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ste tshe shangs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamathun/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—bzang ngan de ni bya mi dgos// 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+ku/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ridag 3〈〈snar 〉7na// 〈〈snar 〉ra tubs/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yodas/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉des/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉drangs/25byed1 160

༄gro/ /na dus bzhi rtsod pa rgyas dus su/ /sgrub pa po yang mang 'byung zhing / /dman la mos pa'ang mang du 'byung / /bla mar gus pa'ang dpag tu med/ /de 'dra'i sems can dpag med kyang / / bsdu na sngugasum du 'dus 'gyur te/ /sprul dang kha dog rjes 'jug pa'o/ /rjes 'jug gnyis su shes par bya'o/ /sprul la mthun 'jug sbyang ba med/ /sprul rjes 'jug gi gang zag la/ /dam tshig nyams pa mang 'byung yang / /nyams pa rnam pa gsum du 'dus/ /lus ngag yid du shes par bya/ /lus kyi dam tshig nyams pa ni/ / tsha tshas 5spyongs te tshogs spyor ltos/ /ngag gi nyams pa bzlas pas 'dag /yid kyi lha yi spyor kar ltos/ /thun mong sbyin sreg tshogs gtor rnams/ /phan 'dogs spyor kar blta bar gyis/ /nus pa chung ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /ma 6bshags maṇ+ḍal gyis sbyang bya/ /maṇ+ḍal basbu na 25—1 162

rnam gnyis te/ /yid kyis bsams dang dngos byed pa'o/ /dngos byed skyon spangs gnyen bzhi 1la/ /brgya 'am lnga bcu nyi shu lnga/ /lnga 'am bsdus pa gcig kyang bya/ /dbyibs legs mdzes pa bsham par bya/ /kha dog kun nas sngo yang rung / /dkar po mthing ga ser dmar bya/ /yang na yid dang mthun pa'ang rung / /tshad ni khru gang yan chad bya/ /tshon ni dkar rtsi yung ba dang / /sngo rtsi gur gum mtshal gyes bya/ /ba yi rnam lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /dum bu gcig par bzhag nas kyang / /dri zhim pa yi sman gyes bsgo/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang thun mong rdzas / /gser sogs kha rgyan 2lnga ldan du/ /bcug la byin brlabs tshul bzhin bya/ /rang nyid cho ga gsum gyis bskyed/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags 'dis gdab/ /oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ byin brlabs 4bkra shis rdzas dang sreg /de yis thams cad bsang bar bya/ /oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ yungs kar la gdab 'byung po bsrel5/ /rang gi snying ga'i yig 'bru las/ /'od 'phros yi ge a ru gyur/ /de 'phros tai gi yi ge las/ /sa gzhi rin chen bzhi ru gyur/ /sngags 'di btab pas bzlas par 'gyur/ /oṃ a tsan+d+ra 6maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bzlas/ oṃ rat+na tram̐ maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ / tsan+dan ga pur gla rtsi sogs/ /mdzes pa'i sgod du bzhag pa la/ /'od 'phros pas ni dhū yig thim/ /bdug pa'i mchog tu gyur par bsam/ /rnal 'byor 'byor pa chung gyur yang / /tsan+dan med du mi rung ngo / /rgyan gyi me tog lnga gsum sogs/ /gcig sogs yang na lnga grangs bstun/ /de steng paṃ las pad+ma bya/ /sngags 'dis bdag po'i rkyen bya'o/ /oṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ stong ldan 'bum ldan du gyur bsam/ /de yi steng du rgyu 9yig las/ /gzhal yas 25—/ 163

khang ni mdzes pa bsam/ /badz+ra re khā'i 1sngags ni kun la gdab/ /snying ga'i 'od kyis byen gyis brlabasan/ /mchod rdzas pad+ma mdun du bskyed/ /rgyun ni gong gi yi ge las/ /de dag thams cad rdzogs pa ni/ /nyams pa dgos pa gzhan mos 'jug /de 'og dam tshig nyams pa kun/ /lus bkru gos bzang rgyan cha bgo/ /lhar bsam rdor dril sngags byen brlab/ /sa bon yi ge 'od zer gyis / /lha mo bzhi bskyed lha spyan drangasakhu/ /gsol ba gdab la rtsa sngags gdags / /bla ma mi bskyod gyur sogs la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa thams cad bya/ /rgyud las byung ba'i bstod pa bya/ /mnyes pas 'od zer rang 'dus pas / /rang gi snying ga'i pad+ma la/ /shaṃ dang na la sdig pa basbu/ /sdom nag gzugs su gyur bsams te/ /phyir 'gro rlung gis mdun du dbyung / /sdig pa'i gzugs dbyung sngags kyis bsreg /lus ngag so so'i sdig spyong ba/ /so so'i gnas su ni bsams te/ /so so'i sdig pa 'dus nas byung / /gsod pa khro ba'am gong spyor bzhin/ /yang na lus kyi srog chags gzugs/ /ngag gi yig 'bru sems kyi 'od/ /gzugs su dbyung ste rgyud las 'byung / /yang na lha yi 'od zer gyis/ /ba sru'i bu ga kun khyab ste/ /rgyud kyi sdig pa bsregs par bsam/ /de 'og 'od zer dkar po'i rgyun/ /bdud rtsi lta bus lus khyab nas / /gsos nas mchog tu gyur par bsam/ /yang na brgya rtsa rtsa ba'i sngags / /bzlas pas gong bzhin sdig pa sbyong / /yi ge brgya pa'i dbang por bsgyur / /brgya rtsa sngags 'bum bzlas pa dang / /sum cha phyed phri rab nyams byeng / /sum gnyis 5sum cha sum cha dang / /sum gnyis phri bas 'bring gsum spyong / /de las phyed phyed phri bas ni/ /tha ma'i nyams pa rnam gsum sbyong / /25—1 16 /

sum brgya nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pas ni/ /yan lag che chung nyams pa spyong / /de 'og zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ /nus pa yod na tshogs 'khor bya/ /de 'og bum pa rnams bsams te/ /gcig tu lha mo rnams bskyed de/ /gcig tu rdor 'dzin mi baspyod pa/ /bskyed nas byin brlab 1tshul bzhin bya/ /dang po lha mos khrus byas te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas gnyis med bsam/ /mi bskyod bum pas dbang bsgur bas/ /yang na gnyis kas dbang bskur bya/ /de 'og mchod nas 'od khrus bya/ /de 'og bkra shis tshigs 2 bcad brjod/ /gong gi sbyor ba rdzogs pa kun/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i maṇ+ḍal yin / /de las gzhan du gcig kyang rung / /rdzogs la brtan pa ma thob par / /maṇ+ḍa la 'jog na mkha' 'gros gsod/ /rnal 'byor spyod lam ma zhugs par/ /gong ma'i maṇ+ḍa la de dag kun/ /yid kyis mdun du bsam byas nas / /yid kyis dbul ba yid kyis yin/ /bdud rtsi rnam lnga'i dri zhim rdzas/ /bsgu ba nang gi yin par 'dod/ /phyi ru phyi yi me tog yin/ /bla ma las brgyud maṇ+ḍa la sbyor ka 'di/ /blo zhan don du bdag gis cung zad basbus/ /'khrul par gyur na mkhas rnams bzod par mdzod/ /'di byas dge bas 4gos sngon can thob 5shog /rnal 'byor dbang gis nyes par snang / /blun po legs par bshad pa dman/ /mthong rgya chung 5na yangs pa'ang dog /rgyud dang man ngag la brten nas/ /rnyed 'dod rnams kyis 'dod 'dod spyad du med/ /ma mthong dogs 7na skal rnams med par thal/ /slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi spyor ka rdzogs so// //

rngub(sduzab zabazucazud/1162 1mtshon byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang ltar bkod/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉war༅༅// ge 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsdus nas/ na〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snats+tshas/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sre/1163 she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhi/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brgyan/ mikru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dubs/ nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsreg6〈〈pe 〉spros tsaṇ+ḍa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sdo tsan+d+ra/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pad+mar/ shemo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu/1164 41〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skaba'i/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlab/ ci 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉lha spyan drang /〈〈snar 〉〉la spyan drang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyis/1165 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dubs/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsheg su mo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsod kyis/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wacan thob/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chungs/ nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradogs/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1༷1phug)25wa 1166

1088༄7/ /las kyi rim pa mu tig phreng ba jes bya ba/ rta ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ karma kra ma nā ma mut+ta kā 2ba li/ bod skad du/ las kyi rim pa mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang rdo rje bsnams/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mthu ldan pas/ /nyon mongs gdung ba zhi byed pa/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma 4la btud nas/ /dang bas shin tu gus phyag 'tshal/ /sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /las kyi rdo rje phreng ba 'di/ /rgyud rnams ma lus sna tshogs nas//man ngag dgos pa btus te 5bshad/ /rgyal bas sngon gyi dus dag tu/ /zhal nas gsungs pa tsam gyis ni/ /sems can don grub glegs bam med/ /de ltar rtsod pa'i dus su ni/ /po ti dag la 6brten gyur pas/ /bla mas dgongs pa'i 7po ti la/ /dga' ba chen po bskyed par bya/ /de nas ma ga gang zag la//ston pa thugs rje che ldan pas/ /snyud pa rdo rje gsang bdag la/ /brgyud pa 25—1 167

rim gyis 'ongs pa 'di/ /bka' dang mi 'gal mthun pa ru/ /bka' yi don nyid dpyis phyin par/ /man ngag rim pa bstan pa la/ /dga' ba chen po bskyed par gyis/ /man ngag 'di ltar ston pa ni/ /slob dpon mkhas pa yang dag ldan/ /dus gsum bde gshegs dang mtshungs pa/ /shin tu drin 1che gus pas bstod/ /sems can mun khang 'khyams pa la/ /mar me bstan pas lam rnyed bzhin/ /'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can la/ /man ngag rin chen 'di bstan pas/ /phyag rgya mchog gi lam rnyed 'gyur/ /de bas shin tu drin che bas/ /yul zhing ste phran bcas pa dang / /rin chen la sogs nor rdzas dang / /bu dang chung ma bran 'khor bcas/ /srog lus man chad 2phul gyur kyang / /bla ma'i sku drin 'khor —mi 'gyur/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis / /bla ma mnyes par mi byed na/ /man ngag thob kyang ltung bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rgyud ni sna tshogs las/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i don slad du/ /mthu yi spyor ba'i man ngag rnams/ /dgos pa bsdus te bstan par bya/ /de lta'i bla ma rin chen la/ /gong ma bzhin du shes par bya/ /man ngag bstan pa'i slob ma la/ /rnam pa bzhi ru shes byas la/ /phyi ltar nang ltar gsang ba ltar/ /de kho na nyid bzhi ru bstan/ /phyi ltar bstan pa'i slob ma yang / /dang po dkyil 'khor bcug nas ni/ /bum pa'i dbang bskur rdzogs byas la /mi zad dbyings kyi chos rnams bshad/ /des su rtogs pa'i rim pa ni/ /thun mong dam tshig nyams blangs la/ /nyams na bshags la brtson par bya/ /nyams pa chen po byung ba na/ /bshags nas rim par 5bskyar bar bya/ /de ni slob dpon nyid las 6blang / /gzhan gyi skabs dang sbyor shes bya/ /khrus la 25—1168

sogs pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /nyams su blangs te spyad par bya/ /de yi rnal 'byor mos pa ni/ / mas mtha' lkuthun tshod chung ngu gcig /nyin zhag 'das na nyams par 'gyur/ /dang por bskyed rim bsgom pa ni/ /rim gyis sam ni cig car bye du/ /bskyed pa brtan —par gyur pa'i tshad/ /thun tshod chen po brtan snyepa dang / /kha dog spros par shes pa dang / /lus ngag yid gsum skyon rnams ni/ /rim gyis bri bar gyur pa dang / /khyad par lus kyi skyon bri'o//lus kyi mdog bzang lus stoms dang / /yun rings 5btang yang mi tshor na/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa brtan pa'i tshe6/ /de nas gsang dbang bskur nas ni/ /nang ltar bstan nas rim gyis bsgom/ /de ltar phyi yi gang zag ni/ /de nas mar la 'gro ba dkon/ /skye ba 'di rjes phyi ma ru/ /rten dang dbang po khyad par 'gyur/ /de ni rim gyis 'bras bu thob/ /nang ltar bshad pa'i slob ma ni//phyi ltar thun mong sngon du 'gro/ /nang ltar man ngag khyad 7par bstan/ /de nas rlung dang gtum mo dang / /yig 'bru thig le rnams la bslab/ /de yang gsang dbang bsgur nas ni/ /rlung dang yig 'bru bsgom par bya/ /de la brtan byepar gyur nas ni/ /snang ba gsum la rim gyis bslab / /de nas tshe ni nam 'phos khunas/ /gong ma rnams la rim gyis bslabarta / /gsang ba ltar ni bstan pa yis/ /slob ma de la gong ma gnyis/ /thun mong du ni sngon du 'gro / /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur nas/ /gnyis po la ni zhugs nas su//man ngag stobs zhugs ting 'dzin gyis/ /bde ba ye shes rim skyes nas/ /snang ba mched par gyur pas su/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma ji bzhin pa/ /thugs su chud pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /lhan cig dga' ba la zhugs pas/ /spros med 'od 25—1169

gsal de bzhin thob/ /de nas rim gyis mthar thug sa/ /thob par de ni ma gyur kyang / /tshe dbang bsgrub pas thob pa 'am/ /yang na rdzas dang man ngag dang / /thabs kyi spyor ba la sogs kyis/ /phung po bzhu btul byas nas su/ /gser 'gyur rtsi bzhin gyur nas kyang / /de nas rim gyis 'gro ba'am/ /yang na 'chi bar gyur na ni/ /byang chub sems kyi man ngag blang / /de ltar mi 'dod man ngag blangs1/ /skye ba phyi ma dag tu ni/ /mthar thug pa ni thob par 'gyur / /de yang / tshe dbang bsgrub pa'i man ngag ni/ /tshe dbang bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /dam tshig ldan zhing yon tan ldan/ /skyon spangs dbang thob man ngag thob/ /rgyud kyi don mkhas cha rkyen tshang / /dam can mkha' 'gro bsten pa yis/ /lung bstan phra mo thob nas kyang / /tshe srog nyams pa 'tsho bar byed/ /de yang / tshe yi rang bzhin gnas dang ni/ /ming zhes bya ba'i rnam grangs ni/ /de yi tshe yi rang bzhin ni/ /'od zer kha dog lnga dkyil na/ /thig le byang chub sems zhes bya/ /dkar la 'tsher zhing sgrum la 'gril/ /de yang che chung rab 'bring gsum/ /sran ma yungs 'bru shin tu phra/ /mu stegs dag gis de la 'khrul/ /rtag pa mi 'gyur gcig pur 'dzin/ /de ni dam pa'i don du 'dod/ /'jig rten pa yi skad du ni/ /bla dang tshe zhes kyang ni zer / /bdag cag rnal 'byor pa yi gzhung / /de ni kun rdzob sgyu mar 'dod/ /dam pa'i don du rang bzhin rnged/ /gnas ni tsit+ta'i dkyil na gnas/ /de yang rtsa brgyad dkyil na gnas/ /shin tu rtogs dka' dhū tī'i nang / /de nyid dbye na rnam gsum ste/ /de la brten pa'ang rnam pa gsum/ /gcig ni 'chi ba'i dus tshe 'byung / /gcig ni lus kun khyab par gnas/ /de la gzhan dag 25—1 /70

gnyis su 'dod/ /khyad par gnas dang las kun byed/ /kha cig khyad byed de kun la/ /lud cing zag pa thur 1du 'bab/ /gzhan ni kun du khyab cing rgyu/ /de la'ang las kyi 'phen shugs kyis/ /mang po la ni rgyu ru 'dod/ /srog dang dbang po che zhes pa/ /ming gi rnam grangs nyid du 'dod/ /de yang rlung dang rtsa 2dang ni/ /byang chub sems su byas pas na/ /tha dad nyid du 'dod pa'ang yod/ /shes pa bsdus dang ma bsnyus pa/ /gnas skabs don gyes 'jug pa yin/ /tshe bsgrub pa'i cho ga ni/ rang gi snying gar 'od kyi gzhal yas khang / /de yi dkyil na a dkar gnyis/ /phra 'dus zla ba kha spyor gyur//de nas hūṃ gnyis 'phro 'du las/ /rdo rjer gyur pas steng 'og mnan/ /tshe rnams 'phrog pa'i 'byung po de/ /drag po spyor ba la sogs kyis/ /sngags brjod phyag rgya bcas nas su/ /bcom zhing brlag nas med par byas/ /lha mo'i sprul pas tshe rnams dgug5 /sngags brjod phyag rgyas bkug nas kyang / /bsrung zhing ye shes che 97yang dbab/ /dbab pa'i phyag rgya bcing ba ni/ /rdo rje sor mo nang bsnol te/ /mthe bong gnyis kyi nang du dbebadz+wa/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūṃ/ ā kyebe sha ya ā ā/ lus la mar rim pebazhin du bstem/ /khyad par snying gi dkyil du bstem⑩/ /baṃ yig dmar po 'phros pa las/ /man ngag la sogs sbyor bas bcing / /basbu zhing gzung ba'i man ngag ni/ /shes rab la sogs thabs kyis bstan/ /tshe yi yon tan la sogs ni/ /rgyud la sogs las nyu1shes par bya/ /tshe dang dum bu rnam smin gsum/ /de gsum thabs sogs mthun pa yang / /gcig la gcig bstan thumadung khyem 'dra/ /yi ge gsum gyi man ngag kyang / /gnas gsum dag tu bcing ba yin/ /spyor ba la sogs 25—1171

bcing bar bya/ /de ni tshe sgrub man ngag go/ /byang sems blang ba'i man ngag kyang / /de yang rnal 'byor spyod pa yi/ /mkhas pas 'chi rtags shes nas ni/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i snod nang du/ /blangs nas mtshal chen dang sbyar nas/ /spyor ba'i stobs kyi 1shangs su 'phang / /rnam shes rlung la zhon pa derī/ /dang po rten dang bral tsam na/ /sngags bzlas 'od zer stobs kyis su/ /snying ga nyid du bcing bar bya/ /de nas snga ma'i rten la gzhug /sbyor ba la sogs gzhan yang myur bar bya/ /gzhan yang gsang ba spyod pa ni/ /mdzad pa'i dus ni rnam gsum ste/ /dang po bdud rtsi spyod pa la/ /mos pas 'jug dang dngos la 'jug /mos pas 'jug pa gzhan dang mthun/ /dngos su 'jug pa'i thabs bstan pa/ /bdud rtsi rtsa ba lnga btsal la/ /rang gi lus las btsal bar bya/ /btsal nas bsgrub 4pa'i ri lu de/ /tshad du phyin nas bza' bar bya/ /bza' ba dang po rim gyis bslab5/ /zas dang rjes zin rting nyid la / /zhag gsum na ni ci ran bza'/ /btung ba'ang de bzhin de rting la/ /zhag lnga na ni bza' bar bya/ /de nas zla phyed zla gcig go/ /de rnams bar gyi 'tsho ba ni/ /nang gi bdud rtsi slar bsdams la/ /bza' zhing btung ba nyid du bya/ /de rnams bag la zha nas ni/ /bar bar gong bzhin bza' bar bya/ /yang na rim bzhin de bzhin ldab/ /de nas nang gi rgyun bzlog gis/ /rim bzhin lus rnams gso bar bya/ /lus ni shin tu rgyas gyur na/ /ting 'dzin bogs ni skye bar 'gyur/ /man ngag stobs kyis zhugs pa yis/ /mi rtog ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /yang na bogs ni dbyung ba'i thabs/ /nang gi gso thabs spo ba dang / /phyi yi gso thabs spo ba dang / /lus la rdzas rnams byugs 25—1 172

pa yis/ /ting 'dzin bogs rnams skye bar 'gyur/ /thabs des skye bar ma gyur na/ /man ngag bsgom pas spo bar bya/ /des kyang skye bar ma gyur na/ /gnas la sogs pa spo bar bya/ /sgos kyang skye bar ma gyur na/ /'byung po'i gnod pa yod pa yin/ /'byung po bsal ba'i thabs rnams bya/ /'byung po bsal kyang ma byung na/ /sngon gyi bag chags mthug pas ni1/ /de nyid sbyang ba'i cho ga bya/ /des kyang skye bar ma gyur na/ /tha mi dad pa'i 'du shes kyis/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs spos pa yis/ /ting nge 'dzin ni skye bar 'gyur/ /des kyang skye bar ma gyur na/ /slob dpon man ngag nyams pa yin/ /slob dpon dam tshig nyams pas kyang / /man ngag mthu ni chung bar byed/ /ye shes skye ba'i gnas rnams ni/ /slob dpon dam tshig nyams sogs la/ /dam tshig la sogs nongs trepa dang / /rang gi man ngag nyams pa dang / /dam tshig nyams pa'i the tshom zos/ /lta spyod nyams su ma lon dang / /dus dang rtags sogs ma shes dang / /man ngag bsgom rim ma shes dang / /sbyang ba la sogs ma shes dang / /sems 'dzin phra mo yod srid kyang / /ye shes skye bar mi 'gyur ro//de rnams skyon spangs yon tan ldan/ /de ni ye shes ma skyes kyang / /tshogs chen khyad par bsags nas su/ /skye ba phyi mar ye shes kyi/ /nges pa don yin thogs med do/ /mtshan nyid la sogs gzhan dag tu/ /snga ma las kyi 'phel shugs kyis/ /ma nges pa dag bstan pa de/ /sngags kyi nus mthu khyad par gyis/ /las kyi 'phen pa bcom nas kyang / /skye ba phyi mar nges pa'i don—/ /phyi mar rkyen sogs thams cad kun/ /nges pa kho nar 'dzom par 'gyur—/ /de ru rkyen rnams gzhan 'gyur na/ /dge bar bsngo ba legs 25—1173

'gyur bar/ /ma 'tsham 1skye ba bdun la nges/ /de bas gsang sngags mthu rnams ni/ /dug gis sman 'gyur ji bzhin no/ /de bas gsang sngags mthu rnams kyis/ /lan ni nye bar 'bras bu myur/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa ni/ /de bas mthu chung bskal pa gsum/ /nyan thos de bas mthu chung bas/ /bskal pa bzhi ni 'gor ba yin/ /de dag kun la rab 'bring gsum/ /ring dang myur dang shin tu myur/ /gsang sngags la la'i gzhung dang rgo/ /slob dpon la la'i gzhung gis ni/ /bcud kyis gilen gyi man ngag gis/ /lus sems las su rung gyur nas/ /man ngag stobs kyis 7ye shes skye/ /des ni phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob/ /phyag rgya mchog ni 'dod pa na/ /tshe la dbang sgyur bsgrubs 6nas ni/ /man ngag bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /phyag rgya mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /slob dpon la la'i gzhung gis ni/ /bskyed rim brtan 7par gyur pa dang / /bcud kyis 8len gyi man ngag bsgrub/ /des ni tshe la dbang sgyur 'grub/ /tshe dbang thob pa des kyang ni/ /phyag rgya phyag rgya mchog gnyis thob/ /bcud kyis —len gyi man ngag kyang / /mkha' 'gro'i rgyud du shes par gyis/ /phyag rgya mchog gi man ngag cung zhig tsam/ /rnyed par bya ba'i lus kyi phreng ba thabs kyi rim pa bkod pa'o/ /gzhan yang / bstan pa bsrung ba'i don slad du/ /las kyi phreng ba gzhan yang bstan/ /bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar bskyed la/ /mdun du mgon po nag po ni/ /sku gsung thugs las byung ba yi/ /hūṃ de nyid las bskyed pa ni/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa de/ /mdog gnag 'od 'bar 25—1174

chen po ni/ /gri gug thod pa lag na 'dzin/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i do shal byas//mche ba gatshigs mdzad 'jigs byed pa/ /bong thung lus gnag gzi brjid che//kha nas khrag ni 'bab pa'o/ /de la bzlas pa'i man ngag ni/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+re 1na swā hā/ bzlas pa yi ni man ngag kyang / /rten dang brten pa'i gnas tshul des/ /gru gsum gzhal yas sgo gcig pa/ /de yi bdag po rigs dang bstun/ /'phro 'du bya ba'i tshul rnams kyang / /'khor lo tsha tsha gdab pa'i tshul/ /lce yang rigs dang bstun pa yin/ /ngag gi bzlas pa byed tshul yang / /nyi ma shar dang ru chu brug /de yi bzlas pa'i grangs rnams kyang / /sum 'bum drug 'bum sa ya ru/ /bzlas pa byas pas mtshan ma rnyedaju / /des su 'byung bar ma gyur na/ /sbyang ba byas te bzla bar bya/ /sngags kyi nus pa che chung dang / /mos pa yi ni khyad par dang / /bag chags che chung khyad par gyis/ /rdo rje drag po'i rgyud rnams las/ /sngags kyi spyor ba gzhan dag gis/ /bsnyen dang gsad pa'i las rnams bya/ /lha yi spyor ba spo ba yang / /de bzhin du ni shes par bya/ /gnas la sogs pa'i spyor ba ni/ /gzhan pa dag kyang 4spo bar bya/ /lha rnams so so spo ba yang / /zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa dang / /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa dang / /zhal bzhi phyag ni brgyad pa dang / /phyag mtshan rnams kyang 'gyur ba dang / /sku mdog la sogs 'gyur ba rnams/ /so so'i rgyud dang bstun pa yin/ /sngags la sogs pa'i spyor ba yang / /de bzhin du ni shes par bya/ /khyad par las rnams so so'i sngags/ /oṃ ma hā kā lā ya/ ya ti pra ti dz+nyā sma ra si ta di rda/ ma ma ru shā/kha kha khā hi khā hi5/ ma ra ma ra/ kṛhā kṛt+ta/ ban+dha ban+dha6/ ha na ha na/25—1 175

da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na mi ke na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ bha ga bānarmye/ oṃ bi lo ba hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gh+ra swā hā/ gsang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ hūṃbye /mngon spyod kyi'o/ /oṃ j-i 1swā hā/ dbye ba'o/ /oṃ khaṃ swā hā/ bskrad pa'o/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ dgug pa'o/ /oṃ a swā hā/ dbang gi'o/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/rengs byed kyi'o/ /sngags 'di dag thams cad yi ge 'bum bzlas pas 'grub par byed do/ /mgon po'i las ni thun mong pa'i las so/ /sbyin sreg dag gis gsad 4pa ni/ /gru gsum nag po'i thab khung du/ /shin tu drag po'i me lha bsam/ /sbyang zhing byin kyis brlab pa dang / /bsdus rgyas myur ba'i rim pa rnams/ /man ngag la sogs shin tu gab/ /mchod pa dbul ba'i rim pa ni//tsha ba'i mar dang tsher ma can/ /til nag po dang dug chus byug /oṃ ma hā kā la ming 'di zhes bya ba sha tūn mā ra ya 5hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad dbul bar bya'o/ /mngon par bsgrub pa'i las drag shul shi ba'i ro bzung la/ de ni yang ni gtub par bya/ /stong par byin brlabs yi ge las/ /bsgrub bya ci 'dra de la bsam/ /lcags kyus snying drang rlung gis bteg /rnam par shes pa de la bstem/ /rdo rje phur bus de la brdeg /bsad nas me la sbyin sreg bya/ /me yi lha la brgya rtsa brgyad/ /ming nas smos pa de la dbul/ /lha la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /dbul bar dgra yi 7ming de gzhug /'bum la brgyad kyis bstabs la dbul/ /de ni dur khrod gdon rnams kyis/ /'du zhing de nyid za bar bsam/ /de yang bsod nams rab 'bring gis/ /bcu gnyis phyed dang de yi phyed/ /'chi bar de ni gdon mi za/ / bsreg pas gsad pa'i las rim mo// //25—/ /76

gzhan yang ting 'dzin rim pa yis/ /gsad dzopa rab tu brtsam 3par bya//'di ni bsam pa tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas nyid kyang nges par 'jig /ma hā kā la'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gdug pa khro bo'i sems kyis ni/ /de yi lte ba'i rtsa ba la/ /rnal 'byor can gyis lag pa gcad / /ming gi yi ge dang po las /gsad zibya mdun du bsam par bya/ /rnam shes de la bcug nas ni/ /kha sbyar nang nas gnas mthong nas/ /de phyung srog dang dbral mthong nas/ /ro ni dum bu stong du gtub/ /bza' snye 'am yang na gtor ma bya/ /de ma thag tu spyi gtsug bsam/ /khrag sgyugs 'dar zhing mgo skyes kyang / /kha ni thur du bub par bsam/ /sum 9rtse me yi gzugs can ni/ /bshang 7lam zhugs nas snying gar ni/ /je tshom med cing brtan byegyur na/ /nges par 'dzin par 'gyur ba yin / /ting nge 'dzin gyis gsad (pa'i rim pa'o// //gzhan yang rab tu bshad par bya/ /thod pa ma chag 1 ma gas la/ /ma hā kā la'i snying po bri/ /bzlas pa'i yungs kar de ru blugs/ /dgra yi 4 1sgo khar sbas na 1rtani/ /nor dang bcas pa zla drug gis / /brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /gang yin pa yi rigs rgyud kyi/ /thod pa de nyid blangs nas ni//cig shos kyi ni khrag gis brithu/ /sngags ni nag po nyid kyis bya/ /yang na ma hā kā la dang / /nag po nyid kyis bsres nas bya/ /ma hā kā las byed pa na/ /ming spel ba ni tshogs rgyur bcad/ /yang na gling bcad 'khor lo bcad/ /gro ga'am dur khrod ras ma la/ /gzugs dang ming ni bris pa gzhug /de steng de 25—1177

gshed gzugs rnams gzhug /smin par byed pas kha bcad nas/ /de steng gzhan gyis dgag 1par bya/ /gnag dang dkar bas rgya gram bcing /nag po yod pa'i sar sbas na/ /gdon mi za bar brlag par 'gyur/ /de ni thabs kyis gsad pa'i rim pa'o// //gzhan yang gsad 4pa'i rim pa ni/ /gru gsum nag po'i snod nang du/ /khrag sna snying sna sbyar ba yi/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas rnams kyis dgang / /dur khrod ras ma dag la ni/ /de yi ming dang gzugs bris la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni gtor mar dbul/ /nag po'i rten ni yod pa'i sar/ /bstabs 37pa'i tshul gyis rbad par bya/ /de ltar byas pa'i gtor ma ni/ /brgya nas stong gi bar du ni / /oṃ ma hā kā la sgoshā sa na u pa ha 3ri khaṃ e ṣa a pabye mā sakā lo ya mi ti tad rat+na tra / ya/ a pa ka ri khaṃ ya di ⑫pra ti dz+nyā sma ra se ta di rda/ duṣ+ṭi rte satwa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ bad+dhā ban+dha/ ha na ha na / da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags kyis gsad ཿpar bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'khor los gsad mupa ni/ /bde gshegs sprul pa'i nag po ni//shin tu 'jigs pa'i sgu 'chang ba/ /bskyed pa la sogs rdzogs byas la/ /tshes grangs shis pa nyid la ni/ /'khor lo legs par bca' bar bya/ /'khor lo bca' ba'i lugs rnams ni/ /dur khrod ras ma dag la ni/ /'jig rten mgon po'i gzugs bris la/ /lto bar 'khor lo bca' bar bya/ /rtsibs ni 25—1 /78

bcu gnyis brgyad du bya/ /le tshe re re bor len bya/ /ming dang drag sngags spel te bri/ /sngon du cho ga rdzogs byas la/ /'khor lo bsgrub 1dang bsgrub bya gnyis / /bskyed cing dgug pa'i las byas te/ /mchod pa la sogs rdzogs bya'o / /de nas gsad —pa'i las rnams bya/ /nyi ma bzhis bskor thim par byed / /sngags ni khri dang bzhi khrir bzlas/ /de nas bcing ba'i sbyor ba bya/ /dur khrod nag po'i gnas dag tu/ /gru gsum nag po'i gting brus la/ /gting brus sbas te mnan par bya/ /des su ma byung bskyar bar bya/ /oṃ ma hā kā la sha tūn mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa ming dang spel bar bya/ /'khor los gsad 4pa'i rim pa'o// //gnod sbyin gyis ni gsad 5pa'i thabs/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gnas pa'i / /cho ga thams cad rdzogs byas la/ /mdun du gru gsum dkyil 'khor la—/ /gnod sbyin drag po bskyed par bya/ /de nyid nus pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /spyor ba gzhan yang shes par bya/ /drag po'i 9gsang sngags bzlas pa yis/ /gang yang mi 'du rang dbang med/ /lcags kyi tsha tsha gdab pa bzhin/ /'phros pas thams cad brlag par byed/ /sum 'bum drug 'bum dgu 'bum du/ /bzlas pas don rnams grub par byed/ /tshad du phyin 7pa'i dus su ni/ /shin tu dag cing bos pas su/ /rang dbang med par las rnams byed/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la yak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ dzaḥmā ra ya/ sha tūn —mā ra ya/ sngags kyi man ngag bsgyur shes bya/ /sbyin sreg ting 'dzin thabs dang ni/ /gtor ma 'khrul 'khor gsad tsul sogs/ /thabs kyis zin pa'i sbyor shes bya/ /gnod sbyin 25—1179

gyes gsad 1pa'i rim pa'o// //ro langs mas ni gsad 2pa'i thabs/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gnas pas / /dur khrod chen po'i dkyil dag tu/ /ro langs ma ni bskyed byas la/ /rang bzhin ma yang spyan drangs te/ /de gnyis cho ga rdzogs byas te/ /bsnyen pa tshad du phyin pa na/ /dur khrod ro yi thod pa ru/ /khrag thun rdzas la sogs pa la/ /drag po'i thun sngags bzla bar 1bya/ /khri yi bar du bzla bar ④bya/ /de nas gang yin sa ru brdeg5 /de ltar lan gsum byas pa yisabyu/ /gang yin de ni brlag par 'gyur/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i gnas dag tu/ /nag po'i nang du 'khrul 'khor mnan/ /nag po'i nang du gtor mas dgang / /cig shos nang du bcas pa yis/ /nag po nyid la gtad par bya/ /tsha ba'i rdzas kyis bsreg par bya/ /de ltar spyor ba'i man ngag rnams/ /mkhas pas bsgrims te ma byas na/ /rang nyid la ni gnod par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra be+e tā lī 7hūṃ phaṭa/ sha tūn mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sngags kyi man ngag sbyor shes bya/ /ro langs mas gsad ra9pa'i rim pa'o// //mkha' 'gro ma yis gsad ḍipa'i thabs/ /chu ngogs thibs po'i /keganas dag tu/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni bsgrub par bya/ /zhing chen gyi ni gdan bting la/ /drag po rol pa'i 'dug stangs bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma sku mdun gzhag 3la/ /zhing gi rgyus te pa thugs kar gzung / /drag tu bzlas pa'i stobs kyis su/ /sbyor ba gang 'dod 'grub par byed/ /khyad par spyor ba bstanapa ni/ /gnag 25—1180

cing thibs po'i 2nang dag tu/ /gru gsum nag po brus nas kyang / /gzugs brnyan bca' ba'i thabs byas te/ /de ru gsad 37pa la sogs bya/ /yang na 'bab chu'i ngogs bye dag tu/ /sba zhing mnan pa'i thabs bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā tī hūṃ phaṭa/ sha tūn ༄mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lo hūṃ lo ste bha 5nan/ sngags kyi sdeb 6ni ma shes na/ /sbyor ba 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /mkha' 'gro mas gsad thupa'i rim pa'o// //'jigs byed ma yis gsad 8pa'i thabs/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /drag cing gtum pa'i chas gos gon/ /dang por bsnyen sbyor tshang bas su/ /nag po 'gro mgyogs sgyur dka' thudang / /bdag po sme brtsegs thod nang du/ /de rnams rigs mthun rdzas bsags te/ /chu gsum la sogs rdzas rnams la/ /sngags kyi sbyor ba btab pas ni/ /nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra bye ra wā sbyi ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sha tūn 11mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ drag po'i sbyor ba mkhas pa yis/ /'byung po thurnams ni brlag par 'gyur/ /sbyor ba gzhan yang sbyor shes bya/ /'jigs byed mas gsad 7pa'i rim pa'o //khro mo chen mo srog gcod ma yis gsad pa yi/ /man ngag thabs kyi rim pa bstan/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yis/ /yi ge i yi gdan stengs su/ /bsgrub bya de ru bzhag nas ni/ /bzlas pa drag tu byas nas wīsu/ /srog gcod pa ⑩ni bsgul bar bya/ /khri yi sngags kyis dgug par bya/ /khri yi sngags kyis 25—1181

gsad 1par bya/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gnas pas/ /srog gcod ma ni mdun du bskyed/ /grub pa mo yang spyan drangs te/ /mthu bskyed la sogs byas nas ni/ /sgu dang gsung dang thugs rnams las/ /drag po'i brgyud pa'i mthu rnams ni/ /mda' zam btags pa'i tshul du byung / /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga nas / /char bzhin du ni 'bab par 'gyur/ /oṃ pra ti ta na hūṃ phaṭa/ sha tūn 2mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sngags kyi spyor ba gzhan dang mthun/ /drag po'i las rnams gzhan po yang / /man ngag stobs kyis sbyor shes bya'o/ /srog gcod mas gsad pa'i rim pa'o 4 dbugs rngub mas gsad 5pa'i rim pa ni/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gnas nas/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rdzogs byas nas/ /drag po'i las kyi sbyor ba ni//gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas dag tu/ /'jigs pa'i rgyan cha gon nas ni/ /bram ze'am rgyal rigs nag po'i phyogs/ /mthun pa'i rdzas ni btsal nas kyang / /gru gsum steng du rten bcas nas/ /nag po 'bar ba'i spyor ba brtsam/ /drag po'i rdzas la sngags bzlas te/ /bdun dang nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /zla ba gcig gi bar du bsgrub/ /de nas 'khor lo ldan pa 'am/ /shugs dang ldan pa'i spyor ba yis/ /shin tu myur bar 'phang bar bya/ /de nyid bskor ba'i tshul du 'am/ /ri mo'i tshul du byas pa yis/ /ting 'dzin spyor ba'ang de bzhin bsam / /oṃ shā 6sa gā pa ye hūṃ che ge mo sha tūn 7mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ yang na drag po'i 'brub khung du/ /tsher ma can gyi shing bkang ste/ /re las drag po'i me dpung bsam/ /gro ga 'am ni shing shun la/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni bris nas 25—/182

kyang / /khri 'am 'bum du bzlas nas ni/ /bsgrub bya bkug nas bstem par bya//drag po yi ni sngags kyis bsreganya /'chi bar 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /spyor ba la sogs gzhan po yang / /man ngag can gyis spyor shes bya'o/ /shā 2sa gā pas gsad pa'i las kyi rim pa'o 4rak+ta'i las kyi phreng ba yis/ /gsad 5pa'i las 'di brtsam par bya/ /dmar zhing chags pa'i rang bzhin can/ /khog pa'i rten ni btsal bar bya/ /'od ma'i gzhu ni lta bu yi6/ /dkyil du de nyid bzhag nas kyang / /dus la de ni bab pa yi7/ /smin byed dang po rgyug pa dang / /mdongs dang ldan pa'i mtshal chen gnyis/ /bsres la sngags ni gdab par bya/ /dus tshod gsum du bsgrubs nas kyang / /bsgrub bya'i 'og tu sbas na ni/ /gang 'dod pa yi don rnams 'grub/ /yang na 'od ma lta bu'i dkyil/ /'dab brgyad dang ni ldan pa la / /kha mthing la sogs mes 9sbar la/ /dbang byed sngags ni bzlas pas su/ /nges pa kho nar khugs par 'gyur/ /oṃ rak+ta pri ya ni hūṃ che ge mo ba shi 7ku ru hūṃ/spyor ba la sogs gzhan po yang / /man ngag stobs kyis phye bar yang 1 /rak+ta pri ya 5nis gsad 15pa'i las kyi rim pa'o ཿoṃ sa bag tris gsad sapa ni/ /sngon du 'gro ba rdzogs byas la/ /sha zan de ni stong dag gi/ /rten la sogs pa rdzogs byas la/ /wībug pa can gye sgod nang du/ /rdo rje'i —mchu ni sbyar nas kyang / /rlung gi shugs kyis 1 sngags 'di 'phang / /de yi spyor ba ma zhig par/ /gang la bya ba de ru brdeg /des 25—1 /83

ni grong rnams 'khrug cing 'gas/ /'di yi sbyin sreg gtor ma dang / /thabs dang 'khrul 'khor dag gis ni/ /gsad lkupa'i man ngag sbyor shes bya/ /oṃ rmā 2sa bag tri che ge mo sha tūn byemā ra ya phaṭa/ oṃ sa bag tris gsad ④pa'i las kyi rim pa'o 5gzhan yang rdzas kyis gsad 6pa ni/ / da du 7ra dang 'ol ma se/ /'gu phaṭa tai dang khu bar sbyar/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i spyor ba yis/ /mi la blud na thru bar 'gyur/ /gsol ba 'debs na gso bar bya/ /khu ba la sogs rnams kyis ni / /lus la byugs shing khong du blud/ /des 9ni nges par thar bar 'gyur/ /gsad r+ṣapa'i sbyor ba'i las rnams kyang / /sangs rgyas la sogs bstan pa ni/ /'jig 1pa la sogs nges pa dang / /ru dra nag por gyur pa la/ /sbyor ba 'di ni bya bar gsungs/ /de las gzhan du byas pa na/ /rang nyid nyams te dmyal bar ltung / /de yi spyor ba byed pa yang / /tshad med sngon du 'gro byas la/ /man ngag the tshom med par ni/ /byas na gdon mi za bar 'grub/ /de yang bsgral bya'i yul de la/ /lus ngag yid gsum zhi bas ni//tshul dang mthun pa'i bden pa bdar/ /lan gsum byas kyang ma nyan na/ /ltung bar mi 'gyur bya bar gsungs/ /bsad pa las kyi saphreng ba'o// //bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sku gsung thugs kyi mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drag po sku yi spyor ba dang / /gsung dang thugs kyi sbyor ba dang / /las ni gzhan sogs spyor ba dang / /rdzogs pa mthar thug sbyor ba 25—1 181

rnams / /rim pa bzhin du bstan par bya/ /nag po 'jigs pa'i cha lugs 'chang / /zhal gcig gam ni gnyis pa 'am/ /zhal gsum pa 'am phyag drug pa/ /gang 'dod pa ni bskyed par bya/ /des su bsnyen pa rdzogs byas la/ /ro bsregs thal ba'i 'jim pa la/ /nag po'i gzugs brnyan byas pa 1la/ /de nyid sbyin sogs bskyed byas la/ /sngags bzlas pa yi stobs kyis su/ /shin tu 'dar zhing 'gul bar 'gyur/ /gtor ma la sogs byin nas kyang / /bstod cing gsol ba btab pas su/ /dgra rnams nges par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /drag po'i gru gsum thab khung du/ /gdug pa can gyi me sbar nas2/ /mar nag tsha ba gsum dang ni/ /sha khrag gsum gyi rdzas bsregs la/ /bsgrub bya bkug ste de la bstem/ /drag po'i sngags ni bzlas nas kyang / /rdzas rnams me yi nang gtor bas/ /nges pa kho nar 'jig par 'gyur/ /thabs dang ting 'dzin 'khor lo dang / /gtor ma la sogs spyor ba yis/ /gsad pa'i man ngag sbyor ba ni/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 4spyor shes byas5/ /de nas gsung gi nag po yi/ /spyor ba bstan pa gang yang mthun/ /thugs kyi nag po'i spyor ba yang / /gzhan du brgal te bstan pa na/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 6spyor shes bya'o / /gsum ka la yang bzhi bzhir bstan/ /dper na rgyal po blon po dang / /las byed 'khor dang mi mthun phyogs/ /de bzhin bde gshegs sprul pa dang / /sa nas rig pa 'dzin pa dang / /dam can dam la gnas pa dang / /des su gdul bar bya ba bzhin77/ /de bzhin mkhas pas shes par bya'o/ /de rnams skya gsung thugs kyi don/ /bsdus pa bstan pa'i rim pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyis gsad 8pa'i las kyi rim pa'o / 25—1185

las kyi rim pa gzhan bstan par bya ste/ /grong khyer dkrug 1pa'i cho ga ni/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gnas pas/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rdzogs byas te/ /nag po chen po lnga brtsal la/ /sngags kyi 'khor lo'i phreng ba bri/ /mthun pa'i rdzas kyis dgang bar bya/ /sngags bzlas pas na 4don rnams 'grub/ /oṃ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha swā hā/ sngags ni khri tsho re re bzlas/ /nag po 'bar ba kha bcad do/ /grong gi 5dkyil dang phyogs bzhi ru/ /rked 6nub tsam du brkos nas su/ /de dag sa gter sba bar bya/ /thod pa la sogs snod nang du/ /mthun pa'i rdzas ni bsag par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dgra 7sngags bzlas/ /de yang grong khyer gseb du bskyal/ /bdun bdun bar ni bcad byas la/ /de ltar byas na grong khyer 'khrug /grong khyer dkrug 8pa'i las kyi rim pa'o // ///char ni dbab pa'i rim pa yang / /dang por bsnyen sbyor goms pa yis/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar bskyed la/ /rdzas rnams bsags pa'i thabs dag ni/ /yi ge gnyis kyis sbyang byas la/ /klu yi rgyal po mtha' yas kyi/ /gzugs brnyan byas la kham phor rkadu/ /bzhag nas bdud rtsi sogs kyis dgang / /ba nag 'o mas bkang nas ni/ /gzhon nu nag mos bkal pa yi/ /sgud pa yis ni bcing bar bya/ /rlung lha'i phyogs su rdzing bu bya/ /klu yi rgyal po de ru bzhag /de yi 'gram du dkyil 'khor bya/ /sol ba rus pa sdong ros dang / /so phag lo ma rus phye la/ /nag po dkar po ser po dang / /dmar po ljang gu'i sa tshon bya/ /dur khrod srad bus thig gdab bo/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum 25—/ /86

byas nas ni/ /de yi dbus su mtha' yas bzhag /mgon po'i bdag po chen po bzhi/ /rgyud 1bzhi dang ni bstun nas kyang / /gang mos mgon pos gnan 2par bya/ /bdud rtsi me tog nag po dang / /'du byed khu ba glang po'i chang / /blugs dang mchod pa dbul bar bya/ /rang gis rnal 'byor rnam pa 4yis/ /bzlas pa'i man ngag shes byas te/ /sngags bzlas pas ni char dbab pa'o/ /gal te mi 'bab de yi tshe/ /klu yi mgo ni 'gas par 'gyur/ /sprin dbral ba yi thabs rnams ni/ /dur khrod ras la nyer 'dug nas/ /sngags bzlas pas ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ ār+yathra shā na thra 5yā ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags las 6 'od zer 'phros pa yi7/ /sprin pa bsdus shing sprin dral bas/ /gseb nas char ni 'bab par bsam/ /char dbab pa'i sngags bzlas pa/ oṃ gh+ra ru ghu ru/ ghu che ghu che/8 ma sha ma sha gha ṭa gha ṭa/ sgo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ a nan+ta k+ko bha ka rā 9ya nā gā bye pa ta ye te he ru ru ka sa p+ta pā tā la ga tā khon nā gā kar+ṣa ya bar+ṣa ya gadz+dza ya gadz+dza ya/ tadz+dza ya tadz+dza ya phuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥ11/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ des ni char rnams mi 'bab na/ /sngags bzlog nas bzlas pas char 'bab bo/ /des char mi 'bab na mgo 'gas par 'gyur ro// sa//char sogs bzlog pa'i cho ga ni/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gnas pas/ /spyon du bsnyen pa rdzogs byas la/ /dur khrod sol ba'i rdzas dag la/ /sngags de bzlas shing btab pas su/ /de nas nam mkhar gtor bar bya/ /de ltar byas pas bzlog par 'gyur/ /des ni bzlog par ma gyur na/ /gnas ni dben par gnas byas te/ /bdag nyid legs par bsrung byas la/ /bdag 25—/ 187

—gi lus ni mer bsgoms te/ /gzhan nas kyang ni me byung nas/ /'jig rten thams cad mes gang bsam/ /sngags kyi 'od zer las me byung / /char pa la sogs bsregs par bsam/ /des kyang bzlog par ma gyur na/ /glog phreng gi ni sbyor ba las/ /ji ltar 'byung zhing bzlog par bya'o/ /des ni nges par bzlog par 'gyur/ /char dang ser ba la sogs pa bzlog pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor pa 1la sogs pa ni/ /dus la bab nas 'chi 'gyur na/ /phung po bsreg par bya ba ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pas su/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rdzogs byas te/ /lha yi gnang rngo ba thob par 3bya/ /lha yi gnang 4thob ma gyur na/ /sems ni las su rung bar bya/ /sems 'dzin nus par ma gyur na/ /dus dang grangs kyi 5bsnyen pa ni/ /mos dang ldan pas rdzogs byas la / /de nas brtsam par bya ba yin/ /de yang thun mong sngon song nas/ /phyis ni bsnyen 6pa gso don du/ /bsdu na lnga dang gsum du bya/ /dang po 'chi rtags brtag par bya/ /bdag nyid phyag na rdo rjer bskyed/ /skad cig tsam mos thugs kar ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ /yi ge hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis / /bla ma la sogs spyan drangs la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul ba dang / /gsol ba gdab cing skyabs su 'gro//lus dbul dge rtsa bsngo bar bya/ /tshad med bzhi dang stong nyid bsgom3/ /stong pa'i ngang las cho ga ni/ /rnam pa lngas bskyed bde gshegs tshul/ /cho ga gsum bskyed sems dpa'i tshul/ /de yang myur bar bskyed 'dod na/ /stong 25—1188

pa'i ngang las sa bon byung / /de nyid 'phros pas sku bskyed 1do/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ut+pal mdog /mche ba gcigs pa sgeg dang bcas/ /rdo rje gsor zhing sdogs /byemadzub 'chang / /'od kyi sprul pa'i dkyil na gnas/ /pad+ma stong ldan 'dab dkyil na/ /nyi zla'i gdan la zhabs kyis brten / /ye shes kyi ni mthu bskyed zicing / /byin gyis brlabs 5pa la sogs bya/ /sku de nyid ni brten par bsgom/ /gshin rje srog gcod de la yang / /bden pa'i tshig gis bka' bsgo bya/ /de dag 'ongs gyepar gyur nas kyang / /gtor ma yang ni gtang ⑦bar bya/ /de nas rnam shes 'pho ba'i phyir/ /man ngag stobs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /rna ba'i drung du sngags 'di bzlas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rdo rje bsam—/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba snyete/ sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ṣ+pe rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya arta te samyahūṃ budha ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ bh+ya ma bh+ya pi ni/ byo ma byu 97pa ya/sarba bya pi ni shi pa ya hri/ brarma mā ta hrim/ babh+yo dang ya te/ hūṃ ru dra skrudang yi te/ k+ṣu ru /1drak+ṣa ra pi sarba ni hūṃ ru drak+ṣa ra pi sarba ni hūṃ ru 1 dre sa ru pe/tri na da/ āt+pa ke/ hūṃ bin+d+ra sha re re/ o shag tri saṃ shag tri sam sha tri sa yo dza ni/ ma byo ma yo dza ni/ zhesgo ṣa ta kai ba bye ba de h+ma bibye na ma/ khru hūṃ hūṃ 7tso hūṃ khye khye na/ oṃ oṃ yī u/ byo ma bya pi ni po sha ṭa/ de nas gsang sngags 'di yis ni/ /mi bskyod gnas ni nyams dga' ba/ /dga' dang 'chi ba rnam spangs par/ /rnam par shes pa byung nas 'gro/ /de yi tshangs pa'i sgo nas ni/ /rnam shes myur du 'byung ⑫bar 'gyur/ /bzhin ni rab tu 'dzum byed cing / /ro ni ngo mtshar phyag rgyar ldan/ /de lta bu yi sems can de la ni/ /bar ma do yi gnas dag tu/ /'od kyi phreng ba'i 'khor lo yis/ /mi bskyod pa dang tha mi 25—1189

dad / /'od kyis bzung 1nas 'khor lo yi2/ /cha lugs 'dzin pa nyid du lta//de yi sdig pa basbus nas kyang / /khog pa'i rten la bsdu bar —bya/ /ga phur 4gur kum la sogs pa'i/ /spos kyi chu yis bkru bar bya/ /dri ma med pa'i ras la ni/ /byin gyis brlabs nas g.yogs par bya/ /rol mo'i cha byad dang ldan pas / /dur khrod dgon pa'i gnas su bskyal/ /de nas ro ni bsreg bya ste5//sa dang sta gon cho ga dang / /slob dpon las dang dkyil 'khor bsgrub/ /de nas ro ni bsreg par bya/ /yang na sta gon byas rting la/ /bsreg par bya ba nyid du bya/ /sa ni brtag dang bslang 9ba dang / /sbyang dang byin gyis brlabs pa dang / /gzung dang bsrung ba nyid du bya/ /de rnams zhib tu bya ba yang / /dkyil 'khor spyi rgyud gzhan dang mthun/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal steng du ni/ /thig le byas te tshom bu dgram/ /lha bskyed pa'am lha sprul pa/ /ye shes spyan drangs gnyis su bsre / /byin brlabs dbang bskur byas nas ni/ /phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod dang / /rdo rje glu dang gar sogs kyis/ /mchod cing bstod pa rgyas par bya/ /gsol ba btab ste snyan gsan dbab/ /de nas sbyin sreg dag gis sbyang / /bum pa byen gyis brlab pa yang / /bya dang mi bya gnyis su bstan/ /byed na cho ga gzhan dang mthun/ /slob ma sta gon gnas pa yang //gshin dang gson ni gnyis su bstan/ /mi bskyod gnas na gnas pa der/ /dbang bsgur byed na 'dir bkug la/ /sta gon yang ni rgyas par bya/ /sta gon byed pa'i tshul rnams kyang / /gson la byed pa ji bzhin bya/ /dbang bskur de ni mi byed na/ /sta gon de yang mi bya ste/ /mi bskyod gnas su bzhag nas ni/ /byin brlabs byas te smon lam gdab/ /ro de nyid ni byin brlabs 25—1190

la / /sreg khang thur la khru do 'am/ /khru gang rko ba che chung tshad/ /rgyar yang gru bzhi khru do 'am/ /mu ran sor brgyad bcu drug tshad/ /kha dog dkar po zlum zhing 'khyel/ /dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ /phyi rol bri dang mi bri dang / /'bri bar 1rgyan rnams gzhan dang mthun/ /rgyan rnams thams cad sdogs par dgram/ /shing rnams dri dang ldan pa dang / /'jag ma ku sha la sogs kyis/ /thab khung 'og tu gding bar bya/ /phung po shar du kha bstan te/ /tsog 2pur bcas te gzhag par bya/ /shing rnams mchod rten dbyibs su brtsig /phyi ni mchod rten dbyibs 'dra la/ /kha dog dkar por byas nas kyang / /skar khung bzhi ni gtod par bya/ /mchod rdzas la sogs bkram nas kyang / /bdag nyid bskyed pa rdzogs byas la/ /pho brang byen gyis brlabs nas kyang / /me lha rgyal po bskyed par bya/ /ye shes me lha spyan drangs la/ /bgegs bstsal 4mchod cing bstod pa bya/ /ye shes dgug cing bstems 5byas la / /rgyas gdab dam tshig bsgo ba dang / /dbang bsgur byas nas mchod par bya/ /bstod pa la sogs rdzogs nas kyang / /me lha shar lhor bzhugs pa 'am / /yang na thugs kar pho brang bca'/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs bstem/ /byin brlabs la sogs rdzogs byas la/ /phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod bya/ /de nas rtsa ba'i sngags la ni/ /sdig pa zhi byed sngags bzlas la/ /bar du ming ni gzhug par bya/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig brgya ru bzlas / /mchod rdzas g.yon du bkram nas kyang / /sreg rdzas g.yas su dgram par bya/ /mar dang yam shing zho dang ni/ /mngar gsum 'bras chan la sogs pa/ /rim pa bzhin du dbul bar bya/ /tha mar dgang blugs phul 25—1 /9/

nas ni/ /mchod cing bstod de gsol ba gdab/ /badz+ra muḥyi mtha' can gyis//gshegs su gsol te dam tshig bsdu/ /tha ma me yi lha la ni/ /cho ga gong bzhin basbus te byatsho/ /ye shes me lha gshegs nas ni/ /dam tshig me lha bsdu bar bya/ /de ltar rten dang sdig bshags la/ /brten po byegong bzhin bkug nas ni/ /pho brang gnyis su bca' byas nas/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gnas pas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga ji bzhin par/ /dkyil 'khor bcug la dbang bskur bya/ /de nas smon lam gdab par bya/ /mi bskyod pa yi gnas dag tu/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng bzhag ste/ /rlung gi 'khor lo'i shugs kyis 'phang / /de ltar byed pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /man ngag lag len goms pa yis/ /sbyangs nas bde 'gror nges par skye/ /rim gyis byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /ngan song gsum na 'khyams —na yang / /sngags la sogs pa'i mthu rnams kyis/ /dus de ru ni shin tu bde/ /de nas myur du thar bar byed/ /gzhan yang dur khrod rus pa ni/ /lo brgya'am lo stong lon pa la/ /bsreg pa la sogs byas pa na / /sbug bsngal las ni thar bar 'gyur/ /rus pa med na ming sogs la/ /cho ga byas na thar bar 'gyur/ /nyams su ma lon cho ga 'khrugs/ /rang nyid dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /de bas mkhas pas bsgrims te bya'o/ /phung po rten dang bcas pa yi/ /bsreg pa las kyi rim pa i thi 'urdzogs pa'i man ngag bstan pa ni/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms la/ /lte ba snying ga mgrin pa dang / /mgo bo yi ni gnas dag tu/ /sprul pa chos kyi sgu dang ni/ /longs spyod bde chen gnas zhes bya/ /lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi la//25—1192

gsal byed yi ge nyis ldab dgod/ /snying gar sde tshan mang po brgyad/ /mgrin par ā li bcu drug dgod/ /dud khang gi ni gnas dag tu/ /ā li gnyis ni bzlas par bya/ /bde chen gyi ni gnas dag tu/ /a wa sgru tī 37dbus su rgyug /la la nā dang ra sa nā/ /g.yas dang g.yon du rgyug pa yin/ /de rnams nang na rdo rje rlung 1/ /phra mo dag ni gnas pa yin/ /de la rten gyi byang chub sems/ /nyi ma'i zer bzhin khyab par gnas/ /bde chen tshangs pa'i mthongs shekhung nas/ /rdo rje nor bu mthar thug par/ /shin tu khyab par rgyas pa yin/ /gtum mo sbar ba'i stobs kyis ni/ /de nyid gsal ba thurgyas pa dang / /byang chub sems kyang shin tu gsal/ /de la brten pa'i byang chub sems/ /mi 'gyur stobs 'dzin sa legs la/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i gnas dag tu/ /dga' ba skyes pa bum pa'i dbang / /'bras bu yang ni bstan pa yin/ /la la dag gi snebazhed kyis ni/ /rtsa dang rlung dang brten pa la/ /bshad tshul bzhi yis bum pa'i dbang / /dngos su dga' ba'i don la yang / /dga' bde bzhi yi don tshang bas—/ /bum pa'i dbang bzhi de la sbyar/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo la//rtsa rlung rten dang brten pa la/ /shes pa'i dbang ni tshul bzhin bshad/ /de ni mchog dga' skye ba'i sa/ /mchog dga' nyid dang dga' bzhi tshang / /gsang ba'i dbang bzhi de la sbyar/ /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la/ /khyad par dga' ba bskyed pa'i sa/ /rlung sogs shes rab ye shes dbang / /khyad par dga' ba de la yang / /dga' bzhi skyed pa'i tsurim pa la/ /shes rab ye shes don shes bya/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la/ /lhan cig skyes pa dga' ba'i sa//mthar thug bzhi yi dbang 'di yin/ /de yi gzhung lugs gnyis po yang /25—1193

man ngag rim par sbyar bar bya/ /bzhi pa de la'ang gnyis su bstan/ /rten bcas dang ni rten gred do/ /rten bcas la yang gnyis su bstan/ /spros bcas dang ni spros med do/ /rten bcas gtum mo nyid la brten/ /spros bcas kun du bzang mo'i mkha'/ /rnam dag klong dkyil bstan pa'i phyir/ /ye shes thabs kyis mtshon byed ni/ /man ngag spros te bstan pas su/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag rtogs par 'gyur/ /spros med man ngag bstan pa ni/ /gong gi man ngag de dag kun/ /'di yis rtogs pa spang bya yin/ /dngos po gnas pa'i gnas lugs ni/ /rang gi byang chub sems nyid ni/ /dkar po la sogs ma yin zhing / /mtshon byed kun gyis mtshon du med/ /shes brjod kun las 'das pas na/ /gang du yang ni bsam du med/ /yengs 3su yang ni rdul tsam med/ /chos rnams ye nas skye med la/ /skye ba med ces sgro mi 'dogs/ /chos su snang ba 'khrul pa'i sems/ /sems nyid ye nas skye med la/ /skye ba med ces sgo mi 'dogs/ /blun po gang zhig mi shes pas/ /dper na nam mkha' 'di med ces/ /sgro 'dogs 'byes pas rtogs mi 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor mkhas pa rnams kyis su/ /skye ba med la sogs pa ru/ /ye snanyid nas su sgro mi 'dogs/ /de lta bu yi don nyid la/ /the tshom med par gtan la dbab / /de nas rnal 'byor gdeng gyur pas/ /bsam med yengs med tsam du ni/ /bsgom pas man ngag rtogs par 'gyur/ /de ltar rtogs pas 4rdzogs rim kyi5/ /dbang gi man ngag mthar thug yin/ /rab tu gnas pa'i rdzogs rim yang 6/ /rnal 'byor mkhas pas spyor shes bya'o/ /mi mkhas pas ni dug tu 'gyur/ /de yang dus skabs bzhi ru ni/ /rim pa bzhin du rtogs 25—1194

par bya'o/ /dang po bya ba'i dus dag ni/ /sngon du 'gro ba rdzogs byas la/ /nam mkhar gnas pa de dag la/ /sngon gyi bzhin du gsol ba gdab/ /cho ga yan lag sdogs byas nas1/ /dag pa la sogs byas pa la/ /dang po de la nus pa gzhug /nus mthu bskyed pa'i cho ga ni/ /byas nas de la tshogs bsag go / /de nas dus ni gnyis pa ru/ /phra mo 'thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /snying ga'i pho brang gnas dag tu/ /de dang de ni tha mi dad/ /de nyid la ni de nyid kyis/ /de nyid du ni cung zhig tu/ /de yi de yi thabs kyis su/ /de lta de ltar rdzogs par bya/ /dus ni gsum pa dag la ni/ /ye shes thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'khor lo rten gyi gnas dag tu/ /de nyid de ltar gnas pa na/ /de nyid la ni de nyid do/ /de nyid thabs kyi spyor bas su/ /de de man ngag rdzogs par thob/ /dus ni bzhi pa dag la yang / / rnam rgyud stobs kyi spyod yul yin/ /de ltar rab gnas rdzogs rim bya/ /rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa ba ru/ /dga' ba skyes pa bum pa'i dbang / /gsang ba'i pho brang gnas dag tu/ /mchog dga' skyes pa gsang ba'i dbang / /khyad par dga' ba'i gnas dag tu/ /khyad par dga' ba skyes pa ni/ /shes rab ye shes dbang nyid do/ /rin chen pho brang gnas dag tu/ /lhan cig dga' ba skyes pa ni/ /dbang ni bzhi par shes par bya/ /de la rdzogs rim las kyi rim/ /phreng ba lta bur brgyud de 'ongs / /de dag drag po'i las sogs rnams/ /rin chen phreng ba ltar brgyud 4'di/ /srog lus rdzas rnams 'bul byed pa'i/ /rin chen lta bu'i gang zag la/ /btsa' dka' 5dam bzhag byas te gtad/ /de ltar mi byed rmongs pas su/ /dam med rmongs pa'i lag shor na/ /dus min shi nas dmyal 25—1 /95

bar ltung / /de nas nan tan bskyed de btsa'/ /bdag gis sems can gdon pa'i phyir/ /man ngag rin chen 'di byas pas/ /bdag dang 'gro ba'i sems can rnams/ /phyag rgya mchog ni thob par shog /las kyi rim pa mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gye mkhan po rdo rje slob dpon bīr+ya gu pa sru rmyetra'i zhal snga nas bye /dang / lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing zhus te/ dur khrod nags tshal du brgyud pa'i slob dpon la shin tu gsang zhing zhus pa'i don 'bab/bsha rus// //bsdur mchan/1167 3mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉las kyi rim pa myu nyib phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7 ti/ lga ༄ —〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉dpal/ pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pad+mo—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatud de/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzanang ba'i/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyud/1168 1〈〈pe 〉tsās/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅da/ zu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadar/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/1169 1〈〈pe 〉〉tha ma/ 〈〈snar 〉glo tha/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉car/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra stan/ lnga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṭhang / thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thastan pa'i tshad/ pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7la/ ldu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉phros bstan / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabarlab/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don ma 'phros/ 1rta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rlab/ — — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu/117༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wāng / 3sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tī/1171 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zur/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / —〈〈pe 〉〉gi'adod/ ④〈〈pe 〉skoraphros/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thakus6〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉stanabab/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mtsho/ /〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mos a lus la til mar/ ṅka〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thastan/ h+pha 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sten/25byed1196
