༄ / /phyag na rdo rje lce dbab kyi 'grel pa mu tig gi phreng ba bzhugs/she ༄gro/ /phyag na rdo rje lce dbab 2kyi 'grel pa mu tig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba / dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang la bye bsnyen pa'i rim pa ni//maṇ+ḍal 'dom —gang gru bzhi pa/ /ba yi rnam lngas byi dor bya/ /dbus su lnga ldan sbrul dgu 5dgod/ /mdun du bum pa bzed zhal dang / /mchod pa rnam lnga bcas par dgod/ /'khar sogs snod ni mdzes pa ru/ /'o ma dang bcas sman rnams kyis/ /bkang ste mdun du bzhag pa'o/ /zhes pa ni/ 'o ma'i nang du klu sman sna tshogs pa blugs la gzhag 6pa'o/ /de steng gzhag dze+epa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /rdzas gong du bsags pa de rnams la bya'o/ /rdzas de rnams gang la dbul bar bstan pa'i phyir/ shin tu gsal byed gdan stengs su/ /lnga ldan mtha' yas sprul dgu pa/ /zhes bya ba ni mdun du rgya mtsho chen po bsams pa'i nang du/ phuḥ las klu mtha' yas sku mdog ser po/ phyag gnyis thugs 25byed1200

kar thal mo sbyar ba/ dbu la sbrul mgo dgu yod pa/ sbrul 'khyel pa lnga'i steng na bzhugs par bsam mo/ /hūṃ las phyag na rdo rje chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du dkrongs kyis tshobaskyed do/ /sku mdog mthing ga /dbu skra thor tshugs gcig tu bcings pa/ zhal 5bgrad pa mche ba gadzigs pa/ spyan bzlog pa/ zas su sbrul za ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par bsams la bye/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang /dgug gzhug bcing 4bstem/ de la mchod pa'i yan lag dang / mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod bstod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum gyes 5gnas gsum byin gyis brlabasagye—/ de nas klu la mchod pa'i phyir/ rtsi sman mchod cing mdun gnas pa'o zhes 'byung ste/ gong du bskyed pa'i klu la ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug bcing bstems thul mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod do/ /de nas sngags brjod cing 'o ma dang bcas rtsi sman gyis mchod do/ /klu'i nad dang gdug rtsub thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig ces brjod cing bstod do/ /de nas sngags 'di bdun 'bum du bzlas so/ /oṃ badz+ra nyi ma sa bla na klad pa dz+wa/ku na zhi/ tsit+ta ku li rgo/ tsi tra mu tra bzlog byer/ dus bzhi'i mchod pa rgyun du bya'o/ /klu yi gtor ma dus bzhir btang / mtha' ma rtags byung ba dang / las kyi mtha' brtul bar bya ba'i phyir/ bdag rnal 'byor pa sdang mig tu blta zhing / zhes pa ni/ bdag phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal du gnas la/mdun du gru gsum mthing nag brus la/ dar phye la sogs pa'i rdzas la liṅga byas la / ming rus gro ga'am shing shun la bris la gzhug 1go/ /de sbal pa nag po dang lto sbyar la tshon skud kyis dkris la gru gsum du gzhug go/ /de'i bla dgug 25—1201

par bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ yang lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la gong gi liṅga la bstem mo zhes pa ni go sla'o/ /sngags ni oṃ badz+ra nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥzhes pas dgug pa'o/ /de nas dgra bgegs bsgral ba bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ seng ldeng gi phur pas gdab cing brub 1par bya zhes pa ni/ lag tu nyungs 2kar blangs la/ nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la che ge mo mā ra ya rbad ces bzlas shing / gru gsum du nyungs 4kar brab bo/ /seng sdeng gi phur pas dril zhing / nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la/ oṃ badz+ra shī li tī la 5ya/ che ge mo mā ra ya 6sarba bisprun baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces phur pas gdab bo/ /rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad la/ de nas thal mo brdab cing nad dang gdon bgegs thams cad brlag par bsam mo zhes pa ni/ thal mo brdab cing gdon bgegs stong phrag brgyad cu/ sku la bsdo /snaba'i dgra thams cad dang / rnam par shes pa dbang du bsdus shing lus rdul phran du zlogs shig ⑫ces brjod do/ /de nas las kyi mtha' brtul 1 bar bya ba'i phyir/ bsreg mnan bskyar ba 4nyams dang sbyar / /zhes 'byung ste/ thab khung rnying pa'am sar par gdug pa can gyi shing la rnge btang la/ sbyin sreg bya ba dang / mnan pa bskyar ba k+ṣakun man ngag bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i rim pa bstan pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin — 5la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstod pa ni/lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /rig sngags gsang sngags kun gyi bdag po ste/ /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu chen rgyal bo mtha' yas ni//25—/202

sku mdog ljang gu sna tshogs mdog /phyag gnyis thal sbyar rin chen 'dzin/ /sbrul mgo dgu yi 3btsun mo yis/ / /mgul nas 'khyud pa'i 'khor bcas la /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bdud rtsi zil dngar sman gyis namachod/ /klu yi gdug rtsub zhi gyur cig /oṃ nā ga badz+ra puste hūṃ/ oṃ nā ge badz+ra dhū 4pe hūṃ/oṃ nā ga badz+ra ā lo ke s+thāḥ 5/ oṃ nā ga badz+ra gadhe shaṃ/ oṃ nā ga badz+ra ṣ+pe bi dre 6hūṃ/oṃ nā ga badz+ra bo dha ka re hūṃ/ bstod pa dang mchod pa'i rim pa'o 7bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ser ba dbab par 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa cig byas la/ de'i steng du lnga ldan mtha' yas sbrul rmergyu ba'i gzugs dang / bzed zhal dang / mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang /dug rdzas sna tshogs dang / yungs kar la sogs pa'i rdzas dang / dri mi zhim pa sna tshogs bsag go/ /rabs chad kyi thod pa mtshan ngan cig gi nang du/tshil dang / khyi nag dang / bong shebu nag po dang / rta nag po dang / de rnams kyi khrag blugs so7/ /thod pa'i phyi rol du yang bsku'o 1/ /tshil chen dang / khrag phyed phyed dong chung du yang blugs la/ zor thun gyi rdzas su gzhag go / /thod pa'i nang du ser ba byung ba'i chu yang blugs so/ /thod pa de yugs sa mo'i dor rtas dril la maṇ+ḍal gyi byang shar du gru gsum gyi steng du gzhag 1 —go / /'gram du seng sdeng gi phur pa cig kyang gzhug go/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje bskyed la mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang / sngags bzlas pa kun bsnyen pa ltar bya'o/ /de nas las la spyor ka ni/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/sngags 'di bdun 'bum bzlas shing / thod pa dong chung du ser rta'i nang du 25—/203

yungs kar la sogs pa'i thun brdeg go/ /nyi ma sa bla na ser ba phob/ klad pa nan ser ba phob/ ku na zhi ser ba phob/ tsit+ta ku li nan 1ser ba phob /tsi tra mu tra ser ba phob/ bzlog byer ser ba phob/ nā ga tril hril ser ba phob / nā ga phrom ser ba phob/ nā ga phob ser ba phob ces bzlas so/ /sngags de rnams yi ger bris pa thod par gzhug go/ /de nas skabs skabs su gtor ma gtong 3ngo / /de nas thod pa khyer la yul gyi chu mig gam/ lha tho'i rtsar song la gser skyems gtang —/ lha 'dre la dmod ④btsugs la thod pa gzhag 5go/ /'gram du phyag na rdo rjer byen gyis brlabs la gzugs so/ /de nas dong chung gi khrag dum ka yang gtor ro/ /de nas dong chung gi khrag la khrag dum ka yang bsnan la/ gong bzhin zor sgrub 'uzhag lnga'am drug tu bya'o/ /de nas rtag tu sngas su bcug la thun brdeg go/ /de nas dgra'i yul du phyin la/zhing thog dang ser rta'i thog tu zor 'phang ngo / /thun brdeg go/ /yul 'dir sngags bzlas shing ser ba phob bya'o/ /ser ba dbab pa'i rim pa'o //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ser ba bsrung bar 'dod na maṇ+ḍal mchod pa gong bzhin du byas nas/ thal chen dang / ske tshe dang / phur pa rnams bsags 7la/ lag na rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs la/nyi ma sa bla'i rting la badz+ra pra be+e sha ya phaṭa/ sa 'di srungs /zhe shig byer ya zhes 'bum tsam bzlas so/ /skabs su gtor ma gtang ngo / /thal chen dang ske tshe ras kyi khung du phur la phur pa'i ske la gdags so/ /phur pa khyer la yul phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du lha ma srin sde brgyad la phur pa btab par dmigs la tho 9 25—1204

gzugs so/ /de nas ser ba byung na/ ser ba 'ong ba'i phyogs su thal chen dang ske tshe 'phang zhing sngags 37bzlas/ g.yas g.yon du mdzub ris byas la bsrung ngo / /des kyang ma thub na/ rang gi lag pa g.yas g.yon du/ bsrung ba'i zhing yul bsams la/ thal mo kha sbub ste/ ser ba pha ri la 'phangs thupar bsam mo/ /sngags ni ③nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la/ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭa/sa 'di srungs rngushig byer ya bya'o/ /des ser ba thub par 'gyur ro/ /ser ba bsrung ba'i rim pa'o skyebacom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /char dbab par 'dod na/ klu'i rten sa chu mig gi bgab 5ni dma' bar sbra phub dz+wal maṇ+ḍal bya/phyag na rdo rje dang lnga ldan sbrul dgu pa mchod pa dang / bstod pa byas la gzungs gdon/ klu mchod bya'o/ /chu gtor gtang 8/ de nas mdun du gru gsum brus la/ bag phye las peklu'i gzugs byas la gzhug go/ /de nas bdag nyid phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal byas la/ seng ldeng gi phur pa thogs la 7 /nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la/ nā ga hril hril/ nā ga phrom phrom/ nā ga phob/char pa phob ces mang du bzlas so/ /klu'i spyi bor phur pa btab la char pa phob ces bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma gtang tsho/ de nas dong sas bkab la char pa ⑩ phob ces bya'o/ /dus dus bslang zhes bya ba ni/ zhag re lon zhing chu mig la yar yar 3rtesbra phub la maṇ+ḍal dang / de ltar nub re re zhing re re bya'oskru/ /zhag bdun pa la chu mig gi thog tu sbra phub la maṇ+ḍal dang mchod bstod la sogs pa gong bzhin du byas la/ klu'i gzugs la sngags bzlas la phur pa gdab mubo/ /25—1205

zhag bdun du bya'o/ /char dbab pa'i rim pa'o 1—bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu bzlog par 'dod na / maṇ+ḍal bya ba dang / bskyed pa dang / mchod pa dang / bstod pa kun gong bzhin du byas la/ mdun du dong gru gsum brus la/ dong gi nang du bag phye las 2klu'i gzugs byas la gzhug go/ /rdzas ni tshil chen dang / gla rtsi dang / tshon sgud sna lnga las sngags mdud byas pa dang / seng sdeng gi phur pa dang / de rnams la lhar bskyed pa dang / mchod bstod byas la sngags 'di bzlas so/ /nyi ma sa bla na klad pa rna/ ku na zhi tsit+ta ku li ā+oṃ/ tsi tra mu tra bzlog byer/ nā ga shig nā ga byer/ nā ga 8/ nā ga mgo rna/ nā ga ha 4na ha na/ nā 5ga ha na ha na mā ra ya rbad rna zhes grangs mang du bzlas la/tshil chen na sar bsku/ gla rtsi lus kun du bsku/ sngags mdud lus la gdags / mdun du dong gru gsum brus la/ bag phye las klu'i gzugs byas te bcug la/ de la bdag la gnod pa'i klu dgug gzhug bya/ bdag nyid phyag na rdo rjer bskyed la phur pa dril zhing sngags bzlas la/ seng ldeng gi phur pa klu la gdab bo/ /de nas klu'i gzugs de'i thod par bcug la/ lha khang gi jem pa'i 'og tu mnan no/ /dus thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal du byas la bzlas pa bya'o/ /bsrung ba'i cho ga bla na med pa'i dis 6ci 'dra ba yang thub bo/ /klu bzlog pa'i rim pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa bdag gnod pa 25—1206

bzlog par 'dod na bsnyen pa gong bzhin du bya1/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa kun byas la/ mdun du dong gru gsum brus la nang du bag phye las sa bdag gi gzugs byas la/ tshon skud kyis ske nas btags la gzhug /rdzas la tshil chen dang / tshon 4sgud sna lnga las sngags mdud byas la/ gla rtsi dang / seng sdeng gi phur pa la sngags 'di bdun 'bum bzlas/ skabs su gtor ma gtang 5/nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la/ sa dom nag po sod/ sa dom nag po sod/dzi sa dom nag po nan/ sa dom nag po nan zhes bzlas la/ tshil chen na sar bsku/ sngags mdud lus la gdags la/ gla rtsis lus kun du 7bkru/ seng sdeng gi phur pa la sngags 'di bdun 'bum bzlas la/ sa bdag gi snying gar gdab/ sa bdag thod par bcug la mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan/ dus thams cad du gong bzhin du bya'o/ /sa bdag bzlog pa'i rim pa'o 9bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud dang ma mo dang /btsan dang 'byung po phal pa'i 7gnod pa bzlog par 'dod na/ sngon du bsnyen pa byas la/ yang maṇ+ḍal dang / lha bskyed pa dang / mchod pa dang /bstod pa kun byas la/ mdun du dong gru gsum brus la/ ngar zan las 'byung po'i gzugs byas la/ tshon sgud kyis ske nas btags la nang du gzhug go/ /gnod pa'i 'byung po de la dgug gzhug byas la/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal du gnas te/ phur pa dang yungs kar la sngags 'di bzlas la/ 'byung po la yungs kar gyi thun brdeg /nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la phyu ga tsi phaṭa/ tsi ga phyu phaṭa / lce ba ti phaṭa ces nus tshad bzlas la/ 'byung po'i gzugs thod 25—1207

par bcug la/ mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan no/ /skrang 'bur byung ba la yang gdab bo/ /bdud dang ma mo dang btsan dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i rim pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun du bsrung ba 'di khyad par du rgyal po la bya'o⑨/ /bsnyen pa gong du byas la/ maṇ+ḍal dang / lha bskyed pa dang / mchod bstod byas la/ mdun du dong gru gsum du/ ngar zan las rgyal po'i gzugs byas la bcug la tshon skud kyis byeske nas gdags so/ /de nas phur pa dang / nyungs kar dang / nyungs nag dang / ske tshe dang /thal chen la sngags 'di bzlas pa mang du bya'o/ /skra spyi bor bcings la nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la/ e pa ka ra tse/ di nā ga bar ma pa la se to thuye zhes bzlas la/ gzugs la yungs kar la sogs pa'i thun brdeg go/ /snying gar phur pa btab pa thod par bcug la/ ce 3ti'i 'og tu mnan no/ /rgyal po bzlog pa'i rim pa'o// //bcol ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun du srung bar byed na / bca' gzhi gong dang 'dra/ skra spyi bor bcings la/ sngags 'di bzlas / nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la/ e pa ka ra tse/ di nā ga bar ma/ pa la se to 6ye/ shig byer nan/ go nan/ ha na ha na mā ra ya rbad nan zhes mang du bzlas la/ thun dang mnan pa kun gong bzhin bya'o/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i rim pa'o je25—/208

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gong pos gnod na 'di ltar bya ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa byas la/ mdun du dong gru gsum brus la/dong gi nang du ngar zan lnga bcug la tshon skud kyis ske nas btags la gzhag 1go//gang gnod pa'i 'gong po bris la lus la gzhug /de nas maṇ+ḍal byas la lha bskyed pa 2snadang / mchod bstod byas la sngags bzlas so/ /nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la/ mgo bye 3ste sa ste nan zhes mang du bzlas la thun brdeg go/ /phur pa btab la thod par gzhug /rab gnas byas pa'i mchod rten 'og tu mnan no/ /phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang stang stabs kyis mtshams bcad do/ /'gong po thams cad bzlog pa'i rim pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun du bsrung ba zhes bya ba/ sngags pa gzhan gyi sbod gtong gye bsrung bar 'dod na/ sngon du bsnyen pa byas la/ de nas maṇ+ḍal bya ba dang / bzed zhal dang / mchod pa bsham pa dang / maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du mchod rten nag po khong stong brtsigs pa'i nang du kho'i gzugs bag zan las byas la/ ming rus bcug la gzhag go/ /bum pa'i nang du phyag na rdo rje bag zan las spyabyas la gzhug go/ /rdo rjes de'i lus 'gems par bsam mo/ /mchod rten gyi 'og tu 'udong gru gsum brus la/de'i nang du yang kho'i gzugs dang / ming rus bcug la/ sbrul dang sbal pa gnyis kyi lto bar bcug la/ klu lnga ldan sbrul dgu pas za bar bsam mo/ de thod par bcug la gru gsum du gzhug /lan cig gzhung bzhin du mnan par 25—1209

bya'o / /bdag rang phyag na rdo rjer bsams la/ phur pa 'dril zhing sngags bzlas pas/ kho'i srung 1ma bdag gi bka' nyan cing las byed par bsam mo /bdag gis rbad pas kho rang gi srog gcod par bsam mo/ /de nas thun rdzas dang phur pa rnams bsags la/ lha bskyed pa dang / mchod bstod dang /sngags ni 2nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la/ bar ma ma hā āḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes 'grub tshad bzlas/ bskor ba phyin ci log tu bya/ thun brdeg /mnan zor gye mtha' brtul 4lo/ /sbod gtong 5thams cad bzlog pa'i rim pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdun du 'brub khung gru gsum du/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi liṅga gzhug /dgra yi liṅga rkang rjes dang / /dri ma phyi sa gcin las 6bya'o/ /rabs chad thod par bcug nas ni/ /thod pa yugs sa'i zhabs mas 7dril/ /de yang re ba'i steng du gzhag /'gram du dug rdzas sna tshogs dang / /drag po'i rdzas rnams bzhag nas ni/ /skabs su dug thun rdzas thun brdeg /de yi 'gram du maṇ+ḍal te/ /bzed zhal mchod pa rnam lnga bsham/ /bdag nyid phyag na rdo rje dang / /lnga ldan bskyed cing spyan drangs dang / /mchod dang bstod dang gsol ba gdab/ /de nas sngags kyi bzlas brjod ni/ /nyi ma sa bla 8 /klad pa dzha/ ku na zhi tsit+ta ku li dzha / tsi tra myu tra bzlog byer/ thum ril rbad che ge mo mā ra ya dzaḥrbad rna1 / 'bum mam sum 'bum bzlas la/ skabs skabs su ag tshe ba na mar thun brdeg go/ /de ltar byas nas thod pa khyer la/lam rgya gram mam/ mchod rten dang / dur khrod dam/ gong gsum mam/25—/210

chu mig gam/ la btsas sam/ chu gling la mnan pa gzhung 1bzhin du bya'o/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi liṅga bca' ba'i rim pa'o //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra gsad pa'i rim pa ni dang por bdag rnal 'byor pa'i mdun du mdzub gang ba'i 'brub khung gru gsum brus te/ dur khrod kyi sol bas nag por byug go/ /de'i nang du dgra bo'i rkang rjes kyi sa dang / bag phye las liṅga byas la/ ming byang bcug nal gru gsum du gzhug /de'i khar g.yam pa sngon po cig la/ /yung ba ser pos ri rab dang / rdo rje rgya gram gyi gzugs bris la/ kha bcad la gzhag go / /'gram du bzed zhal dang mchod pa rnam lnga bshams la/ bdag nyid phyag na rdo rje dang / mdun du lnga ldan bskyed cing spyan drangs/ mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang / gsol ba gdab/ gu gul dag gis lha dang dbral / thun gyi rdzas rnams bsags nas ni/ drag po'i sngags ni bzlas brjod bya'o/ /nyi ma sa bla ā+oṃ5/ klad pa rgo ku na zhi/ tsit+ta ku li ā+oṃ6/tsi tra mu tra bzlog byer/ thum ril rbad che ge mo mā ra ya dzaḥrbad rgo 7zhes 'bum bzlas/ de nas liṅga'i 8mgo bcad la/ /mgo dang liṅga sar pa gnyis / /rabs chad 9snathod pa'i nang du gzhug /mnan pa sgrub pa tshul bzhin bya/ /lha 'dre gnas pa'i sa ru gzhug /liṅga'i lus dang gsar pa gnyis / /ral gris gtubs la drag po'i rdzas dang gdug pa can gyi shing la sbyin sreg tshul bzhin du bya'o/ /dgra la bya ba'i rim pa'o// //

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyin sreg byed na sla nga'am thab khung rnying 1pa ru/ /brgya 'am yang na lnga bzhi gcig /bskyar zhing las la sbyar 2bar bya/ /gdug pa'i rdzas ni sna tshogs dang / /mar nag tshil chen ske tshe dang / /til dang ming byang spel te bsreg /me lha bskyed la sbyin sreg dbul/ /sngags ni nyi ma sa bla na'i rting la che ge mo rak+ṣa shārnyi ku ru mā ra ya rbad ces pas/ dug sna tshogs dang / dri mi zhim pa sna tshogs dang /drag po'i rdzas sna tshogs dang / mar nag la sogs pas 4sbyin sreg bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin dgra bgegs gang yin par mos par byas la/ rdzas re dang sngags re bstun zhing sbyin sreg bya'o phyag na rdo rje dang / lnga ldan bskyed pa dang /spyan drangs pa dang / mchod pa dang / bstod pa byas la/ de nas me lha bskyed la sbyin sreg bya'o/ /drag po dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi rim pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gru gsum nyis 'gyur dz+res la nang thal ba 'jam pos byug /kha rtsang 5dmar gyis bskor/ nyi ma sa bla na la sogs pa la 'di gdags so/ /shig byer nan/ mgo nan/ ha na ha na mā ra ya rbad nan/ sbal pa'am/ sbrul lta bu'i rjes byung na 'gong po yin/bong bu'i rjes byung na 'gong po yin/ um pa'i bshags pa 'dra ba byung na rgyal po yin/ shing lo lta bu'i rjes sam ral pa bsnyigs 6pa lta bu'i rjes byung na bdud yin/ mda' mang po bzhag pa 'dra ba'i rjes byung na btsan yin/phug ron gyi bya bra'i 7rjes 'dra ba'am/ lcags thag dz+rel ba'i rjes byung na ma mo yin / de rnams gang byung ba dang las la sbyar ro/ /rdo rje lce dbab kyi 'grel pa mu nyig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rim pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po rgyal bu sprin gyi 25—1212
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1016)25wa /215

༄/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje lce dbab kyi gsang ba'i yang bgol gyi grub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga bān dzi hūṃ be sha man+t+ra z-i da yo2/ badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha dzā nā ma/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje lce dbab kyi gsang ba'i yang bkol gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar dgus ni/ /ri bong 'dzin la gar gyis bzhugs/ /rig 4sngags gsang sngags kun gyi gtso/ /rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de nas bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /ji ltar rim pas sgrub pa'i thabs/ /bdag ni bla ma'i rjes dran pas/ /de yi sgrub thabs cho ga bshad/ /dang por rnal 'byor snod ldan gyis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bsgrub 5'dod pas/ /dur khrod dben pa'i gnas phyogs su/ /ro gsum med pa'i sa la ni/ /maṇ+ḍal 6dkyil 'khor legs byas la/ /gre tog sngon pos mdzes byas la/ /mdun du rten la sogs 25—1216

pa dgram/ /phyi yi mchod pa rnam lnga dang / /nang gi bdud rtsi gtor mar bcas / /sha chang zas kyi longs spyod bsham/ /rnal 'byor gnas bcas shes rab can/ /khrus bya nye reg 'thor 'thung bsang gtor bya'o/ /bde ba'i stan la rab 'dug nas/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i skyil krung bca'/ /yan lag bdun dang ldan pa yis/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bar bya/ /de nas rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i sa bon gyis/ bla ma dang gos sngon can/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs la/ sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag gis/ gdan dbul ba dang / phyag btsal 1snab dang / nye reg dang / 'thor 'thung bsang gtor dbul ba dang / mchod pa la sogs te yan lag bdun pa bya'o/ /bla ma dang ni gos sngon can/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pa sna tshogs pa dang / me tog la sogs pa phul la/ sems can thams cad snyug bsngal las bskyab pa'i phyir/ bdag gis sdig pa ma lus par ni bshags par bgyi/ de nas bla ma dang ni gos sngon can/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang ni/ slob dang mi slob la sogs sems can rnams kyi don du/ bsod nams kun la rjes yi rang / /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song zhing / /byang chub tu ni de dag bsngo/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang / /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa dang /byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms so/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi khubasgom par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba 1āt+pa kopho 4haṃ—/ de'i mtshan nyid bral bas stong / rgyu med pas na mtshan ma med/ /25—1217

rang bzhin gyis na dngos po rnams/ /smon pa dang bral bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas stong pa'i rang bzhin las/ /'od kyi phung por bdag rang nyid/ /de nas e dang yi ram̐ baṃ lo sum̐ hūṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gru gsum pa dang /gzhu'i dbyibs dang / gru gsum pa dang / zlum po dang / gru bzhi dang /nag po dang / sngo skya dang / dmar po dang / sngon po dang / ser po bsam par bya'o/ /'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gong nas gong du bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du sum̐ gyi yi ge las byung ba'i zur bzhi rin po che'i rang bzhin can/rwa brgyad kyis 1nye bar mdzes pa'i steng du/ oṃ me dī m+bi badzī byebha ba badz+ra brnya hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra pā kā ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūṃ yo 4hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā zhen hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ / oṃ badz+ra 6sa ra dzā 7la tram̐ saṃ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dzā — —la a na lārka hūṃ ram̐ sh+yihūṃ sngags / de rnams kyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs drug mngon du gyur to/ /de'i nang du hūṃ 7dang / tsa dang paṃ dang a nyid do/ /de sna steng zla ba rdo rje bsam / /de yi lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan/ /hūṃ sngon 'od zer lngar ldan pa/ /rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig pa/ /rab tu khros pas brkyang bskum ste/ /bcu drug lo lon sha tshugs can/ /spyan gsum me ltar 'bar ba la/ /shin tu khros pa'i lta stangs can/ /bsnun pa'i tshul gyis legs bzung zhing / /dril bu sdigs temadzub thugs kar bsgreng / /stod g.yogs na bza' sngon po la/ /smad g.yogs stag gi sham thabs can/ /nyi ma'i 'od can zla ba'i mdangs/ /ha ha'i 'o dod chen po yis/ /log 'dren la sogs skrag par mdzad/ /'jigs byed khro bo'i bdag por ni/ /bdag nyid rnam par bsgom par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni sku'i mtshan nyid do/ /zas su 25—1218

sbrul za ba dang 4nyergyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sa bon bkod la/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang bar bya'o/ /bzhugs su gsol ba dang / phyag btsal zhing bstod pa dang mchod pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra trī 1tri ha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ ar+ghas zhal bsil ziba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pu྾ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ me tog dbul ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū ༄pa pū dza me gha 6sa mu dra dzaspa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/bdug spos shangs su'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dī pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/mar me spyan la'o/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ dri thugs kar ro/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe bi bye pū dza me gha 8sa mu dra 9spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/zhal zas zhal du'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shap+ta pū dza me gha 1 sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/sil snyan snyan du'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs/ dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang /bcing ba dang / dbang du bya'o/ /yang lus dang ngag dang sems byin gyes brlab par bya'o/ /mgo bo dang sgog ma dang / snying gar pad+ma dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po ji lta bar bkod la/dkar po dang sngon bo la sogs pa bsam mo/ /de nas spyi bo dang / mgrin pa dang / snying gar pad+ma dang / zla ba la sogs pa/ rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du dmigs la/ gsang sngags bzlas par bya ba ni 'di yin te/ nyi ma sa bla na klad pa rna/ ku na zhi/ tsit+ta ku li rna/ tsi tra mu tra yak+ṣa tra bzlog byer / gsal por dmigs la bzlas pa bya/ skyo ba'am dub par gyur na/gsang sngags yid kyis zhebazlas par bya ste/ sngags kyi skyon spangs te/ mi gsal ba la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa spang bar bya'o/ /bzlas pas skyo na ye 25—1219

shes kyi 'khor lo bton la/ mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang / bzod gsol bya/ de nas oṃ la hūṃ/ sa ma ya muḥ(sa/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ de nas mi dmigs par bsgom rtesnapar bya'o/ /ldang bar 'dod na/ yi ge brgya pa'i sngags brjod la/ ldang bar bya'o/ /phyag na rdo rje lce dbab kyi sgrub thabs/ gsang ba'i yang bkol gyi cho ga bkod pa yi /bdag gis 4sgrub thabs 'di bkod pas/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi5 / /byang chub tu ni de dag bsngo/ /rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //slad 6kyi bla ma dza yā ka 7ra dang / mar pa lo tsās bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1216 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉g.yo/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje lce dbab kyi gsang ba'i yang bkol gyi sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so/ / 37〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wān nī waṃ ba ra dha ra badz+re haṃ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉rigs/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la sgrub/6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'am/1217 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatshal/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhir/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkapho/1218 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉s+dza/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de ṇi badzi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra hūṃ baṃ—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dha/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkabadz+ra/ 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dzā/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ram̐—/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de'i/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbag1219 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ridang / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatshal/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lar+ghaṃ gi zhal dbul/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byu/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉ghā/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tra/ 〈〈pe 〉sngag 〈〈snar 〉〉rtswa/9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tra/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉ghā/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tra/ 'a〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbye/25byed1220

122༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉paḥmu/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ wu/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(pes/ pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyan/'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉klad/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa kā/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grots+tshas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1༷17)25wa 1221

༄gro/ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ badz+ra badz+ra hūṃ thā/ rdo rje lce dbab pa'i sngags ni/ nyi ma sa bla na/ klad pa rna/ ku na zhi/ tsit+ta ku li oṃ/ tsi tra mu tra yak+ṣa 2tra bzlog byer/ nā ga shig /nā ga byer/ nā ga rna/ nā ga mgo lda/ nā ga ha na ha na mā ra ya rbad rgo/ tshil chen dang / tshon skud rnam lnga la sngags mdud byas pa dang / gla rtsi dang seng sdeng gi phur pa la sngags bzlas la bsrung ngo / /sa dom nag po sod/ sa dom nag po sod/ sa dom nag po nan/ sa dom nag po nan/ zhes gong bzhin no/ /ser ba srung na/thal chen dang / ske tshe dang / rtsang dang / tho 4dang / mdzub ris kyis bsrung ngo / /sngags 'di gdags so/ /sa 'di srungs shig byer ya bya'o/ /phyu ga tsi phaṭa/ tsi ga phyu phaṭa/5 lce ba ti phaṭa/ bye ril rbad/ che ge mo mā ra ya rbad rgo/ nā ga hril tril/ nā ga phrom/ nā ga phob/ phur pa dang 25—sde222

tshil chen dang / khye dang bong 1bu dang rta rnams kun nag po'i khrag dang /thod pa mtshan ngan cig dang / dor rta dang / chu 2dngos dang / de rnams la bya'o/ /liṅga dang / gzugs la brten la bya'o/ /char pa 'bebs na/rten sa ru sbra phub la gzungs gdon/ sngags gong ma bzlas/ klu mchod dang /chab gtor bya/ dus dus su bslang / zhag bdun bya'o/ /'dis kyang bsrung / eḥb gaḥr tshe 'di na ba gaḥbar ma/ pa laḥs ta ye/ mgo ste sa ste / bar ma hā aḥ4hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci mang du bzlas so/ /rang phyag na rdo rje bsgom peshes na rab/ ma shes na rang tam/ mang du bzlas na gang yang rung ba thub bo/ /phyag na rdo rje klu 'dul ba'i drag sngags bsgom du med pa'o/ /the tshom yid 6gnyis rkyen gyi rgyu bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa zab mo rdzogs so / / //de yang bya ba'i dus ni/ sngags kyi nus pa bskyed/ nyams rtags byung ba dang / las mtha' bsdus te/ mnan pa la sogs gzhan dang mthun/sbyin sreg gi rim pa la/ rdzas ni zhi rgyas gzhan dang mthun/ /gdug pa'i rdzas ni sna tshogs dang / /mar nag 7tshil chen ske tshe dang / /til dang ming byang spel te bsreg /sla nga'am thab khung rnying pa ru/ /brgya 'am yang na lnga bzhi gcig /bskyar zhing las la sbyar ba dang / /sngags kyi mthar ni rak+ṣa shārnyi gdags par bya/ /spyan drangs mchod dang bstod pa ni/ /gzhan yang dkyus las shes par bya/ /nyam chung snod med je tshom rang 'phung 'gyur/ /nyams ldan ma yengs 7bsgrubs byas nas/ /bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la gtugs / /a ti/ gu he/ zhar la 'di yang mchod pa ste/ /'khar 25—1223

sogs 1snod ni mdzes pa ru/ /'o ma dang bcas sman rnams kyis/ /bkang ste mdun du bzhag pa'o/ /de steng bzhag pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /shin tu gsal byed gdan stengs su/ /lnga ldan mtha' yas sbrul dgu pa/ /rtsi sman mchod cing mdun gnas pa'o/ /bsreg mnan bskyal ba nyams dang sbyar/ /bdag rnal 'byor pa sdang mig gis lta zhing / yungs kar gyis brab pa'o/ /gru gsum du brub bo3// /de nas sngags gdab bo/ /de nas thal mo brdab cing nad dang gdon bgegs thams cad brlag par bsam mo/ /yang yang lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas te gong gi mi la bstem mo/ /de nas phur pa gdab cing brub par bya'o/ / a ti e'i tshogs kyi rim pa la / dang po bdag rnal 'byor pa'i mdun du mdzub gang ba'i brub chokhung gru gsum brus te/ de'i nang du ming byang bu la bris la gzhag /de'i kha ru g.yam pa sngon po byug la yung ba ser pos ri rab dang 9rdo rje rgya gram gyi gzugs bris la bzhag3 /ma grub byas na ltas 8ngan 'byung / /kun la yod na ngo mtshar chung / /lce dbab pa'i bya thabs sdogs so// //25—1224

rngubasduzab mchan/1222 (1)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ tshoge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sta'ik+ṣa/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wanā ga shig ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsang dang / mtho/ (ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi tsi ga phyu phaṭa/1223 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bung / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉chus/ 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rton/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gas/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ ༷'u7〈〈pe 〉〉tsom yi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tshom yi/ tshe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag na 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyus—/ (7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉mas/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pangs/ ciXte/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thug /1224 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sor/ 2)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya'o/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wa.a ti/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis rim pa dang / 37〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉torabrub/ chi'u/〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/dang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzhag sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bltas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1༷18)25wa 1225

༄ / /rten 'brel gyi mthus bsrung ba/she ༄ gyi/ /rten 'byel kyi mthus bsrung ba'i thabs ni/ rma bya'i mkhyes pa dang / ka ra bsre la bsgu/ sa'i bdud rtsi lo lnga brgya lon pa yan chod bsgu'o / /spos gu gul nag po dang / gla rtsi dang / mu zi dang / ldong ros dang / dri chen dang cha mnyam du sbyar te/ sbrang rtsis sbrus te dud pa btang ngo / /sman kyi nus pa ni 'bras bu gsum dang / bus pa byeskyes ma thag pa'i rang 'byung dang bsres te/ dri chus sbrus pa'i ri lu khar gzhag — go/ /sman gyi 4mchog gis bsrung ba ni/ a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba bcangs pas bsrung ba'o/ /sa bdag gi nad thub bo// //nyi ma sa bla na la sogs pa la 'di gdags so/ /shig byer nan/ mgo nan / ha na ha na mā ra ya rbad nan/ zhes bzlas shing bsrung zheb bya'o/ /rten 'brel gyi 6mthus bsrung ba rdzogs so// //25—1226

༄ / /lag na rdo rje lce dbab kyi sngon 'gro'i lag len rnal 'byer spyod lam brgyad pa bzhugs/—1༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo / /rnal 'byor pa rnams rgyun du bya ba'i cho ga ni/ thun mong gi spyod lam brgyad kyis bstan te/ khrus dang / mchod pa'i rnal 'byor dang / zas dang / skom dang / gtor ma dang / sgom pa bzlas brjod kyi spyod lam brgyad do/ /dang po khrus kyi 3rnal 'byor ni/ /rang nyid bskyed pa'i rim bsgoms te/ /rin chen bum pa mdzes pa ru/ /chu gtsang srog chags rnged pa dang / /tsan+dan la sogs dris su dgang / /bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyis/ /bum pa sbyangs te rja gyis bskyed/ /de ru lha bskyed ye shes bstem/ /mchod byas sngags ni bzlas nas su/ /grangs zini thim nas 'od du zhu/ /rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi5/ /yi ge paṃ bsgom pad+mar gyur/ /de nyid nam mkha'i steng phyogs bsam/ /de steng sangs rgyas spyan la sogs/ /rdzus skyes bum pa 25—1228

thogs pa bsam/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor lha mo yang / /bdud rtsi bum pa thogs nas su/ /bkra shis rdo rje glu len cing / /bdud rtsi dkar po dri med kyis / /rang gi spyi bor blugs par bsam/ /dri med dag nas mi bskyod 'gyur / /de ni dus chen khyad par du/ /rgyun du 'grub na bsod nams che/ /de ni khrus kyi rnal 'byor rgyas pa'o/ /de las tshobasdus pa 'dod pa la/ /rang nyid stong pa'i ngang las ni/ /sa bon las ni lhar bskyed de/ /khrus kyi bum pa dag la yang / /sngags btab sbyangs te bdud rtsir gyur/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor lha la phog /lha mo bum pa thogs pa yis/ /bdud rtsi'i rnguchu blugs sgrib pa dag /de las shin tu basbus pa ni/ /skad cig rdzus skyes lha ru bsam/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros /chu la phog pas bdud rtsir gyur/ /lha mo bum pa thogs pa yis/ /khrus byas dri ma dag par 'gyur/ /de dag kun gyi sngon du ni/ /sems bskyed pa dang ldan byas te/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kun/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis khrus ni 'di bya'o/ /mthar smon pa yi byang chub sems / /phyag rgya'i mchog tu bsngo bar bya'o/ /de rnams sngags dang phyag rgya ni / /oṃ badz+ra sta na bye hūṃ phaṭa/ phyag rgya rdo rje khu tshur gnyis/ /mthe bong bsgreng kruste spyi bor bzhag /yang na rgyud gzhan so so yi/ /sngags dang phyag rgya dag gis bya/ /dbang bskur khrus dang ldan pa yin5/ /de nas mchod pa'i rnal 'byor bstan/ /sa gzhi skyon spangs yon tan ldan//ba yi rnam lngar ldan pa yis/ /maṇ+ḍal yid 'ong mdzes par bya6/ /tshad ldan 25—1229

dbyibs ldan de la ni/ /dang por dri ldan chu yis ni/ /byugs tshe nyi zla'i gdan du bsam/ /de steng me tog 'grems pa'i tshe/ /pad+ma dag tu gyur par bsam / /de gsum sngags dang brjod par bya/ /mchod pa dri med bshams nas kyang / /rang nyid cho gas lhar bskyed de/ /rang gi thugs kyi sa bon las1 / /'od 'phros thugs ka'i lha yang gsal/ /pad+ma'i steng du gzugs brnyan shar/ /de nas sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /ting 'dzin ldan pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes lha ni spyan drangs te/ /gzugs brnyan nyid la bstem par bya/ /yang na 'od zer 'phros pas su/ /bla ma spyan drangs sgrib pa sbyang / /mi bskyod gyur nas dbu la bzhugs/ /dang po phyag ni btsal bya ste/ /de nas mchod pa rgyas par dbul/ /de yang dang po bla ma la/ /de nas dkyil 'khor lha la dbul/ /mchod pa dbul ba'i dbul sa yang / /dang po me tog gdan bsam ste2/ /zhabs gnyis la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nas zhal bsil gdong dang phyag /'thor 'thung zhal gyi nang du dbul/ /nye reg thugs kar byug par bya/ /yon ni zhabs kyi drung du dbul/ /sku khrus dbu la dbul bar bya / /bdug spos shangs la dbul bar bya/ /me tog dbu la dbul bar bya/ /lha bshos ljags la dbul bar bya/ /sil snyan snyan la dbul bar bya/ /rin chen mdzod spur dbul bar bya/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa/ /sgu nyid la ni dbul bar bya/ /de ni phyi yi mchod pa'o / /nang gi mchod pa 'di lta ste/ /sgeg mo la sogs lha mo rnams/ /sprul la mchod pa dbul bar bya//gsang ba'i mchod pa bdud rtsi yis/ /lha rnams dgyes pa bskyed par bsam/ /de 'og rtsa ba'i ltung ba rnams/ /rang gi blo la bgrang bsngo bya/ /nyes pa gang 25—1230

byung de la ni/ /ched du gtad de bshags pa bya/ /dang por bsam pa gtsor byas te/ /tshig gis kyang ni bshags pa bya/ /de 'og yi ge brgya pas sbyangs/ /de nas 'jig rten 'das pa dang / /'jig rten pa yi dge ba la/ /dga' ba bskyed de rjes yi rang / /de 'og bla ma dkyil 'khor dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' la/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba gdab/ /de nas chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /bskor bar 3yang ni gsol ba gdab/ /de nas bla ma sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dag la yang / /skyabs su mchi zhing lus kyang dbul/ /de 'og sdom pa gzung rngabar bya/ /rol mo sil snyan ldan pa yis / /rdo rje sngags ni mgur bcas nas/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bdun gsum gyes / /lha rnams la ni bskor bar ༄ snabya/ /de 'og mchod sogs dge ba rnams/ /byang chub chen por bsngo bar bya/ /ye shes gshegs nas ting 'dzin bsru/ /de nas ci bder don gzhan bya/ /de ni mchod pa rgyas pa'i tshad/ /de las 4basbus pa 'dod pa rnams/ /maṇ+ḍal dngos sam yid kyis ltabasam/ /rang nyid stong pa'i ngang las ni/ /sa bon las ni lhar bskyed de/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ /rdzas rnams dngos su ma 'byor yang / /sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis/ /mchod pa rnam lnga gsang mchod tsam/ /yid kyis bshags pa la sogs bya/ /shin tu bsdus pa 'dod pa la/ /rang nyid skad cig lhar bsams te/ /bla ma yi dam lha la sogs/ /rdzus skyes tshul du mdun du bsam/ /bsam pas bdud rtsi mchod pa dang / /sdig pa bshags dang dge rtsa bsngo/ /'di ni shin tu bsdus pa'o/ /25—1231

zas kyi rnal 'byor bstan pa ni/ /rang nyid cho gas lhar bskyed la/ /lte ba'i 'og tu rlung bsams te/ /de steng 'byung ba me bsam mo/ /rlung gi me lces snying gar slebs/ /snying ga'i dkyil 'khor lha 51gsal te/ /'od kyi khang pa'i nang na 'bar/ /lce ni hūṃ las rdo rjer bsam/ /yar rkan 3snapaṃ las pad+ma bsam / /de nyid thabs dang shes rab ldan/ /yang na kha ni dgang gzar bsam / /lag pa blugs gzar nyid du bsam/ /zas rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /snod ni a las ka pā la/ /rdzas ni bdud rtsi'i yi ge yis/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga ru bsam/ /de 'og re dang yi las ni/ /me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gru gsum zla gam ba dan can/ /thod pa'i nang gi yi ge gsum/ /mu tig bstar la brgyus pa bzhin/ /de steng rdo rje'i 5lte ba la/ /yi ge hūṃ gis mtshan par bsam/ /de steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /yi ge oṃ gyis mtshan par 6bsam/ /yi ge hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /ba dan bskyod pas rlung byung ste/ /rlung gis dz+wame sbar bdud rtsi bzhu/ /hūṃ gis bsdus shing us 5su zhu/ /oṃ gyis kha dog dkar por bsgyur/ /slar yang gyen du spros pas su/ /steng gi oṃ bsgul 'od zer 'phros/ /rang bzhin lha yi mdzod spur phog /gnyis med rol pas byang sems phab/ /dang por oṃ phog zla ba zhu/ /dam tshig dang 'dres rdo rje phab/ /cha gnyis gcig 'dres rdo rjer zhu/ /bdud rtsi dri med dkar po des/ /snying ga'i lha la mchod byas te/ /sbyin sreg tshul du bza' bar bya/ /zas kyi rnal 'byor rgyas pa'o/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsams te/ /snying gar lha yi rnal 'byor bsam/ /zas rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /pad+ma mdzes pa'i snod dag tu/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga bsams te/ /lag pa g.yon 25—1232

pa'i zla steng nas/ /oṃ las 'od 'phros bdud rtsi bsregs/ /g.yas kyi nyi ma'i steng nas ni/ /āḥlas bye'od 'phros bdud rtsi spel/ /gnyis ka las ni hūṃ 'phros te/ /bdud rtsi rnams ni 'od du 'bar/ /ho las 'od 'phros bdud rtsi zhu2sna / /de nas thugs ka'i lha mchod do/ /de ni bsdus pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /skad cig rdzus skyes rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag dang thugs ka'i lha gnyis gsal/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /zas la sogs pa bdud rtsir bzhu/ /slar yang ye shes bdud rtsi 'bab/ /cha gnyis 'dres pa'i bdud rtsi de/ /thugs ka'i lha la mchod par bya/ /shin tu bsnyus pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /btung ba'i rnal 'byor bstan pa ni/ /rang nyid bskyed pa la sogs ni/ /zas kyi rnal 'byor nyid dang mthun/ /btung ba byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /snod ni a las ka pā la/ /byin gyis brlabs nas de nang du/ /byang chub sems kyi sa bon bsam/ /thugs ka'i yi ge'i sa bon las/ /ha 'phros pas ni rnam rtog sbyangs/ /s+thāḥs byeni 'od 'bar ro rnams sbyangs/ /hos ni dri med bdud rtsir bzhu/ /lag pa g.yon gyi mthe bong 6ni/ /hūṃ gis sa gzhi byen gyis brlabs / /srin lag gsum las ri rab tu/ /byen gyis brlabs pa'i bang rim las/ /yi ge oṃ las thu'od 'phros te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i smin mtshams phog /yab yum gnyis med spyor ba las/ /byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi bab/ /yang na yum chen mā ma tī/ /bdud rtsi thogs pa dpag med byung / /dam tshig bdud rtsi'i nang du byo/ /cha gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa yi/ /bdud rtsi ri rab dag gis bsrubs/ /ri rab nyid kyang 'od du zhu/ /bdud 25—1233

rtsi dri med dkar po des/ /thugs ka'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams la/ /sbyin sreg tshul lam mchod pa yi/ /tshul gyis 'thungs pas bde ba bskyed par 'gyur ba 'am//yang na bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ /phyi rol maṇ+ḍal snod steng du/ /chos 'byung gru gsum bri bar bya/ /me tog tshom bu dgod par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor ting 'dzin gyis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ /pad+ma'i steng du bzhugs bsams la/ /so so'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /bdud rtsi'i 'thor 'thung mchod pa dbul/ /thabs dang shes rab dang ldan pas/ /rdo rje'i glu ni phra mo yis/ /lan gsum sgu gsung thugs la mchod/ /de nas thugs ka'i dkyil 'khor mchod/ /de ni rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /bsnyus dang shin tu bsdus pa gnyis/ /zas kyi rnal 'byor nyid dang mthun/ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor bstan pa ni/ /rang nyid bskyed rim tshul bsgoms la / /gtor ma byin kyis brlab pa ni/ /zas kyi rnal 'byor nyid dang mthun//mchod par bya ba'i mgron rnams ni/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa/ /mdun du paṃ las pad+mar bskyed/ /'dab brgyad steng du dur khrod brgyad/ /dbus kyi lte bar e las ni/ /dar mo da ya'i 1chos 'byung bsam / /de nas 'jig rten 'das par bskyed/ /phyi rol dur khrod brgyad la ni/ /'jig rten pa yi 'khor rnams bskyed/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor rnam gnyis kyang / /spyan drangs dam tshig dag la bstem/ /so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /gtor ma bstabs shing phrin las bcol/ /sil snyan rdo rje mgur glur ldan/ /mchod cing bstod nas gshegs su gsol/ /ting 'dzin bsdus te dge rtsa bsngo/ /25— 23

de ni rnal 'byor rgyas pa'o/ /bsnyus pa stong nyid ngang las ni/ /sa bon las ni lhar bskyed de/ /gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /zas kyi rnal 'byor 'adz+reng dang mthun/ /shin tu basbus pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /skad cig rdzus skyes lhar bskyed la/ /gtor ma so so'i sa bon gyis/ /sbyang ba byas te gong dang mthun / /de rnams gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas spyod lam rnal 'byor ni/ /nang par langs pa'i tshe na ni/ /bdag rang yi dam lhar bsams te/ /'gro ba pho rnams thams cad ni/ /bde gshegs sprul pa nyid du blta1/ /'gro ba mo rnams thams cad ni/ /bde gshegs yul kyi lha mor blta/ /sdod kyi 'jig rten 'di dag kun/ /lha yi gzhal yas nyid du blta/ /thams cad sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du/ /thabs dang shes rab rol pas spyod/ /nyon mongs drag po langs tsam na/ /gang dang gang 'dul gnyen por bsten/ /'gro ba sems can don bya snyam/ /'dug na byang chub snying por 'jug /nub mo nyal ba'i tshe na ni/ /chos nyid stong pa'i ngang las nyal/ /dge ba'i bsam pas nyal bar bya'o/ /bsdus pa'i spyod lam bya ba ni / /dang po nang par langs tshe dang 2/ /nyin mo thun mtshams bzhi rnams dang / /nub mo nyal ba'i dus dag tu/ /rnal 'byor pa nyid gong bzhin bya/ /shin tu bsnyus pa'i spyod lam ni/ /dang por nang par langs dus dang / /nub mo nyal ba'i dus dag tu/ /spyod lam gong bzhin dran par bya/ /rnal 'byor de rnams kun la yang / /sngon du byang chub sems bskyed cing / /tha ma dge ba byang chub bsngo/ /de ltar rgyun du byas pa yi/ /dge ba'i mthu yi byin 25—1235

rlabs kyis/ /phyag rgya mchog gi grogs 'gyur zhing / /thun mong dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis ma thob kyang / /lha dang mi yi rigs skye zhing / /bsod nams lhun grub thob par 'gyur/ /bsgom dang bzlas pa'i bsdus rgyas ni/ /rgyud hūṃdang sgrub thabs la sogs su / /bla ma'i zhal gyi man ngag gis/ /shes par byas te nyams su blang / /sgom pa bstan pa'i rim pa yang / /bla ma 'chad pa'i rgyud —shes pas/ /slob ma nyid kyis shes par bya/ /rin chen lta bu'i gang zag la/ /rdzogs pa'i man ngag rim pa bstan / /de las gzhan pa'i slob ma la/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i man ngag bstan/ /de la bstan nas phyi dus su/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan du rung / /de las gzhan pa kha cig la/ /zab mo'i 4don rnams mi bstan par/ /mi zad dbyings kyi chos rnams bstan/ /de rnams gsum gyi 'bras bu ni/ /skye ba 'di la cho'abyung ba dang / /skye ba bdun la 'byung ba'o/ /'jig rten gsum gyi las kyis ni/ /thun mong dngos grub kho na 'grub/ /dper na ston gyi me tog bzhin/ /'bras bu dag la spro bskyed la / /brtson 'grus chen po'i go cha gyon/ /le lo spangs shing nyin mtshan du/ /rnal 'byor dag ni chags 6mi bya/ /stom 7las le los chags gyur nas/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa na/ /rtsa ba'i rab 'bring tha ma la/ /tha mas nyams pa'i char 'gyur bas/ /nyams pa sbyang zhing slar gso —ba/ /bla ma mchod pa'i dus su ni/ /yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga yis/ /sbyangs pas slar ni sor chud 'gyur/ /'di dang mi ldan sngags pa ni/ /glang chen myos 'dra ji bzhin no/ /'di dang ldan pa'i sngags pa ni/ /seng phrug seng ge'i gdung 'tshob 'dra/ /de la nan tan cher 25—1236

༄7/ /gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgub thabs bzhugs/ 1༄gro/ /gsang ba'i bdag po 2lag na rdo rje gos sngon 7can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can bsgrub 4par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas / dang por khrus byas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed par bya'o/ /rang gi snying gar nyi ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i sa bon gyis 1gos sngon po can dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa spyan drangs te/ sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod do/ /de nas 'di skad du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs so 'tshal la/ bdag lus ngag yid kyi khusgo nas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /mchod pa bla na med pa 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi char dag pa'i sems kyis sprul zhing mchis na/ thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes su gsol/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas 7 dug gsum gyi 25—/239

dbang gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa rmyernams so sor bshags shing slan chad kyang sdom par bgyid do/ /bde bar gshegs pa gang dag bskul ba'i sa la bzhugs pa rnams la/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byebaskul bar bgyi'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa gang dag mya ngan las 'da' bar byebazhed pa rnams la 'khor ba ji srid par mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gyegasol ba 'debs so/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi thuthugs byang chub 'utu sems bskyed cing dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du thugs bskyed pa bzhin/bdag gis kyang sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang bdag gis 'phags pa rnams la lus phul te/ sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /de nas rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i dngos po thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam par bya'o/ /de'i ngang las yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zla ba dang nyi ma'o/ /de'i steng du hūṃ sngon po las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i gos sngon can gyi gzugs su gyur par bya'o/ /de nas yungs kar phyogs su gtor bar bya zhing / oṃ āḥ bibyān+ta kṛta ṣ+ṭahūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing dubaskrad par bya'o/ /lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas te/ sa bon las 'od zer spros te spyan drang bar bya'o//gzungs kyi mjug la/ oṃ na maḥX/sa ma ya maṇ+ḍal ma de/ ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya/pra be+e sha ya pra be sha ya/ ā ba lo kā ya ā ba lo kā ⑩ya hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba btags te spyan drang bar bya'o/ /de nas de la mchod pa dbul bar bya'o/ /s+thā kyiti ha zhes pas ar+gha 4yi'o/ /oṃ mebadz+ra pu྾ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes pas me tog dbu la dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū ṣepa pū dza me gha 25—1240

shes kyi lha gshegs su gsol/de nas thams cad mi dmigs par — bsgom par bya'o/ /④yi ge brgya pa'i gsang sngags brjod par bya'o/ /bla ma la gus pa dang / shes rab dang / snying rje dang ldan zhing /
