༄ / /rdo rje sde bo gtum po lha lnga pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga—1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsaṇ+ḍa rībadz+ra kro dha de ba pañtsa nā — ma maṇ+ḍal bi byeḥthu / bod skad du/ rdo rje hūṃkhro bo gtum po lha lnga pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum po khros pas zhe sdang 'joms/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /rdo rje 'chang la rab btud nas/ /de yi dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad/ /dur khrod la sogs gnas chen du/ /gza' snyeskar dus tshes bzang po la/ /bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /sa brtag pa dang bslang 7ba dang / /me tog sngon po lnga dor zhing / /byen dang ma byin ltas kyang brtag /phan tshun mang nyung ut+pal kha/ /oṃ badz+ra pā byeṇi puju pū dza hūṃ/ sngags der bskyar tsuzhing med dang mtshungs/ /btso ma gser mdog rin chen la/ /rngan pa byen la brko ⑫bar bya/ /sa sbyang ba dang bsrung bya ste/ /dri yi thig le me tog khar/ /dam 25—1245

tshig lha mo bskyed byas la/ /ye shes lha mo dgug gzhug bstem/ /sa yi cho ga rdzogs byas la / /1de nas lha yi sta gon ni/ /maṇ+ḍal yid 'ong dri med khar/ /dri yi thig le gre tog lnga/ /oṃ hūṃ ṭ+wā dīḥ2khaṃ dag las/ /dam tshig 'khor lo bskyed byas te//ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ /mchod gtor bstod pas mnyes byas la /bdug pa lag thogs pus btsugs te/ /dril bu'i sgra sgrogs lnga ldan hūṃ/ /de nas gsol ba gdab bya ba/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mchog /rig sngags rgyal po dge ba'i mgon/ /gzungs sngags gsang sngags kun gyi gtso/ /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag nyid 'dri bar 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams mnyes par mchod phyir du/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid gus pa la/ /de yi gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro don byas don gsol/ /byang chub sems dang gsang sngags lha4/ /'jig rten skyong dang mthu chen dang / /yang dag rdo rje'i spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sems can bstan la dga' rnams la/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/ /rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /yo byad ci 'byor bas bri 5na/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab pa mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum gsol btab nas/ /ra ba dra bas mtshams bcad do/ /hūṃ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ /nga ni bcom ldan gtum po yin/ /nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na/ /rdo rje khro bos mgo 'gems so/ /ma 'dug song 25—/2/6

shig log 'dren tshogs/ /oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛt+ta hūṃ/ kṛrje napa ya kṛ1 pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya 4ho/ bha ga bān 5badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ/ ār+ya te tsar ti na hūṃ phaṭa/6de nas bum pa'i sta gon ni/ /gser la sogs pa'i bum pa ni/ /lho ba 7che la mgrin pa ring / /skyon la sogs pa dang bral bas/ /las kyi bum pa ma gtogs pa/ /yon tan ldan pas lha grangs bstun/ /nas dang gro dang so ba 'bras—/ /til dang lan tshwa bu ram dang / /mar dang sbrang rtsi rnam pa lnga/ /gser dngul zangs lcags mu tig dang / / byā gh+ra sing ha ha sa de ba dang / / kaṇ+ḍa ka ri 9ni dra sman lnga dang / /dri chen dri chu dmar zil mdangs/ /mi rta khye bya glang po'i 7sha /dmar ser 'o ma gzhon nu'i chus/ /phyed mtho tsam du dgang bar bya/ /kha tshar ma nyams ras kyis bcings/ /'bras bu can gyis 11 kha brgyan te/ /dris bdug maṇ+ḍal khar bzhag la/ /mi dmigs rgyu baṃ bdud rtsi yi/ /rgya mtsho'i dbus su ri rab che/ /sprin sgra bsgol bas sna tshogs sgra/ /bhe bar hūṃ 1 las gzhal yas khang —/ /baṃ las chu skyes dam tshig bskyed/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis gnyis med bstem/ /sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab/ /spyan la sogs pas dbang bsgur ro/ /mchod dang gtor mas bstod byas la/ /gzungs thag ldan pas bsten pa 'bum/ /de nas slob ma'i sta gon ni/ /rdo rje slob ma khrus byas la/ /slob ma sgo yi drung gnas nas/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa po/ /slob dngo/na khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de ni stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems ni stsal 25—12 7

du gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum ni stsal du gsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de ltar 1lan gsum gsol btab nas/ /slob dpon gtso bo'i ting 'dzin zhugs/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni gsang sngags sbyin/ /bu tshur zeg pa chen po yi / /gsang sngags tshul spyod cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /rdo rje gsang sngags rab bsgoms pas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med bskyed/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom//'jig rten rjes 'jug par rtogs nas/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de nas skyabs 'gro sdig bshags bya/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /mnyam nyid thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngor gnas pas/ /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams la/ /bdag yid dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gis ༄ thog mtha' rnged pa nas/ /sdig pa bgyis pa ma lus kun/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi / /spyan sngar da ltar 5mthol zhing bshags/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po dang / /gsang sngags kun bdag rdo rje can/ /de rigs 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor kun/ /dge ba mdzad la rjes yi rang / /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje 25—1248

ni / /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /gsang sngags bdag por dbang bskur la/ /gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /skyon bral mthu ldan khyed rnams la/ /skye rga na 'chi mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i don du sku sprul la/ /mthun 'jug mya ngan mi 'da' gsol/ /bdag gis dge ba ci bsags kun/ /gcig tu bsdus te bsdoms 1—nas su/ /bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /sems can kun gyi don du bsngo/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang / /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje nyid/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i mchog /kun nas dang bas dgongs su gsol / /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas su bzung nas su / /byang chub snying por gnas kyi bar/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /'gro ba sems can thams cad la/ /pha ma srun dang ming sring sems/ /bu pho bu mo'i sems bskyed de/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung bgyi/ /srid pa chags pa zhi la sgol/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa btang / /tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa bsrung / /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa spyad/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin par gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par phyin/ /pha rol phyin pa 'di drug po/ /mthar gyis bslab 4dang mthar gyis spyod5/ /mthar gyis bsgrub la nan tan bya/ /de nas sdom pa dpog bya ba/ /srog chags rnams ni gsad 6mi bya/ /ma byin pa yang blang 7mi bya / /'dod pa dag ni spyad mi bya/ /brdzun pa dag kyang yang mi smra/ /nyes 25—1249

pa kun gyi rtsa ba yin1/ /chang ni myos par btung ma yin/ /sems can gdul bya ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /dam pa nye bar mnyes 2byas shing / /rnal 'byor can la bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus pa yis rjes su bsrung / /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /jeg pa dman la 1dor mi bya/ /'khor ba dag kyang yong mi spang / /rtag tu mya ngan 'da' mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /de la brnyas par mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma bgom par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la gus bka' mi 'da'/ /stong nyid snying rje rab bsgom zhing / /mdor 4na rtsa ba yan lag gi/ /dam tshig nyin mtshan grangs kyis bsrung / /de nas bla mas gsungs pa yi/ /sdom pa legs par bsrung bar bya/ /tshul khrims zhes bya sogs pa nas/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /ji srid snying po byang chub bar / /bdag ni rab tu sdom par bgyid/ /de nas slob ma'i gnas gsum du / /rdo rje khu tshur dri yi 5chus/ /thig le nyi zla pad stengs su/ /yi ge gsum gyi spyor ba las/ /sku gsung thugs kyis 6byen gyes brlabs / /las kyi chu yis gtor zhing bsrung / /oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūṃ phaṭa/ mchod pa lnga yis legs mchod de/ /spyi bor me tog spos byin la/ /mar me dri ni snying gar ro/ /dril bu dkrol zhing bshos gtsang mdun/ /de nas tshigs bcad sngags 'dis sbyin / /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par//mchod pa kun dang ldan pa yi/ /dus kun du ni bde legs shog /oṃ pañtsa liṅga a bye ṣispyo 8mi/ de nas so shing sbyin par bya/ /'o ma can gyi shing dag la//25—/250

sor brgyad dang ni bcu gnyis pa/ /me tog can ni dor bar bya/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dus+thā 1ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya 2lam na ni 'byung 'gyur ram/ /zhes pa la sogs chos bshad bya/ /oṃ tra ki ste ba dhī 5shud+dhā sarba dharmā swa byā ba badz+ra āt+pa ko3haṃ4/ de nas srung 5sgud sngon po yis/ /mdud pa lnga ldan byin brlabs can/ /dpung pa g.yas g.yon dag tu bcing / /ku sha stan gding mtshan ma gdab/ /ngan na phur bu'i sbyin sreg bya/ /bzang na mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma btang / /de nas thig ni gdab bya ba/ /ma dang tai gi ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la bteg /gzhon nus srad bu bkal ba la/ /kha dog dkar po'i thig gdab ste/ /mdzes pa'i snod du bcug nas kyang / /las kyis bsang 7zhing lhar bskyed la/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs mchod/ /nyis 'gyur tshad la srad bu bstem/ /rang nyid rdor 'dzin ltar sprul nas/ /byen gyis brlab dang bsrung ba'i 8phyir/ /bde gshegs mchod phyir nam mkhar gdab / /sgo dbye gsal phyir sa thig gdab/ /tshangs thig gdab ste bgegs bskrad do/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ slob dpon shar bltas slob ma nub/ /dza gsum brjod la lag tu gtad/ /dang po nub ste de nas ni/ /lho byang gdab ste de nas shar/ /nub byang lho nas mtshams bzhir thig /rim pa bzhin du gdab par bya/ /cha bzhi cha brgyad rim bzhin du/ /dbye ba la sogs shes nga/ra bya/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas/ / khyams 'dod 9pa dang mi 'dod pa/ /de dag thams cad shes par gyis/ /sngags 'dis thig ni gdab par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma/25—/25/

dmar ser smin ma sma ra khro/ /kham nag gyen badze+es tsosnadabu yi skra/ /zla tshes mche dkar ljags glog 'khyug /lto 'gros brgyan cing stag sham can/ /yum dang gnyis med thugs las 'khyud/ /sprul pa gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms / /bgegs chen bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /drag po me dpung dbus na 'phro/ /bcom ldan thugs kyi sprul pa las/ /rigs bzhi gtum po rang nyid do/ /shar du rdo rje gtum po ni/ /bdud las rgyal byed dri za'i gdan / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgu mdog dkar/ /spyan gsum mche gcigs zhabs bgrad pa/ /skra badze+es lto 'gro stag gis brgyan/ /g.yas pa rdo rje bsnun pa'i tshul/ /g.yon pa sdigs ri 7mdzub rab tu gdengs/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i rnam pa can/ /thugs la rdo rje'i khyung sprul lo/ /lho ru rin chen gtum po ni/ /gzi brjid 'bar ba gshin rje'i gdan/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser/ /spyan gsum zhabs bgrad mche ba can/ /skra badze+es lto 'gro stag gis brgyan/ /g.yas pa rdo rje bsnun pa'i tshul/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub rab tu gdengs4/ /me ri 'bar ba'i rnam pa can/ /thugs las rin chen khyung sprul lo/ /nub tu pad+ma gtum po ni/ /rngam pa'i sgra sgogs klu dbang gdan / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar/ /spyan gsum mche gagrubs zhabs bgrad pa/ /skra brdzes 3lto 'gro stag gis brgyan/ /g.yas pa rdo rje bsgrun pa'i tshul/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub rab tu gdengs3/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i rnam pa can/ /thugs las pad+ma'i khyung sprul lo/ /byang du las kyi gtum po ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gnod sbyin gdan/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo/ /spyan gsum zhabs bgrad 8mche ba can/ /skra 25—1252

badze+es lto 'gro stag gis brgyan/ /g.yas pa rdo rje bsgrun pa'i tshul/ /g.yon pa sdigs 1mdzub rab tu gdengs nya/ /me ri 'bar ba'i rnam pa can/ /thugs las las kyi khyung sprul lo/ /de ltar dam tshig bskyed byas la/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs /1 phyag rgya bzhi/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags/ /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol/ /dge ba byu bsags thams cad kun/ /byang chub thob phyir bdag gis bsngocho/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis gnyis med bstem/ /'bru gsum sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ /spyan la sogs pas dbang bskur ro/ /de nas slob ma khrus byas la/ /yol bas bar bcad gdong g.yogs bcings—/ /sngags 'di yis ni phyag byed gzhug /oṃ badz+ra na ma mi hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra na ma ste kluhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra na mo na ma /hūṃ/ bde ba 'dod pa su zhig yin/ /bla mas don ni bri kyebar bya/ /skal 7ldan bde chen bdag cag lags/ /slob mas lan ni gdab par bya/ /de nas bla mas bde ba'i glu/ /dgyes pas blang bar bya ba 'di/ /oṃ a nut+ta radhe 1pū dza me gha uṅga te spa ra ṇa i oṃ mug ga na khaṃ swa hā/ de nas slob mas gsol gdab pa/ /ston pa khyod la bdag dga'o/ /bla ma dam pa khudagongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen por mutshul bstan pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la gsolamu/ /de nyid dam tshig bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum ni bdag la stsol/ /lus dang longs spyod 'di bzhis 7la/ /dbang bsgur dam pa mdzad du gsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal de yi lan ni sbyin bya ba/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po'i snod/ /gsang sngags spyod 25—1253

pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /tshul chen khyod kyis shes par gyis1/ /dkyil 'khor dam par dbang bsgur gyis/ /bu yi blo gros brtan par byos/ /de nas yang ni sdig pa bshags/ /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba gdab/ /byang chub sems bskyed lus phul la4/ /sdom pa phog ste gzung du gzhug /bslab pa yi ni tshul khrims dang / /dge ba chos sdud tshul khyems dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum / / de nas bzung ste gzung 5bar bya/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu 6phyag rgya dag /yang dag nyid du gzung 7bar bgyi/ / slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ / rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin ni 9 dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i jeg pa gsum/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po yi7/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung 1 bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /de nas rdo rje'i lam khrid la/ /tshigs bcad sngags 'dis dam chu blud/ /bye bor bcom ldan bskyed byas la/ /bdud rtsi'i chu ni blud par bya/ /'thungs shig rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu/ /dam las 'das na dmyal bar bsreg /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'byung / /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis grub / /oṃ badz+ra satā 1 hūṃ/las kyi chu yis bgegs bskrad de/ /phreng bas mgul nas bcing bar bya /oṃ badzod ཿka hūṃ/ rdo rje thugs kar bzung byas nas/ /dam tshig khro bo'i nga rgyal gyes / /tshigs bcad sngags 'di brjod par bya/ /de ring phan chad khyod 2bye—/251

—kyis ni/ /phyag na rdo rje nga yin pas/ /nga yi bka' nyan gsung sdod pas/ /khyod kyis byas na dngos grub 'byung / /ma byas rdo rje dmyal bar ltung / /de phyir bka' nyan gsung sdod cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas rdo rje spyi bor gzhag1 /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po 'di'i/ /de nyid ma mthong mi rnams mdun / /dus kun du ni ma smra zhig /ma smras dngos grub myur ba yin/ /smras na khro bos mgo 'gems so/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas sngags 'dis yol ba bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra pra tīts+tsha ho/ lan gsum brjod la mthong ngam dri/ /dbang thob phyir na yon kyang 'bul/ /sngags 'dis me tog dkyil 'khor dor/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga te puju pū 4dza hūṃ/ sngags 'dis slob ma'i mgo la gdags/ /oṃ rat+na me la a bye ṣispyo 5mi/ bla ma rdo rje slob dbon gyis/ /lha yi 'khor lo bskul byas la/ /slob ma'i snying gar gzhug par bya/ /oṃ maṇ+ḍal de ba ba tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ /tshigs bcad sngags 'dis gdong g.yogs bkrol6 //ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /ma rig ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /de bzhin de ring bu khyod kyi/ /ma rig ldongs pa'i mun pa bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ye shes khro bo'i nying 'dzin gyis/ /lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas dgrol bar bya /de rnams las kyi bla mas bya/ /lha ngo bstan la dbang bsgur ro/ /ji ltar dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje sems dpas 9dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral slad du/ /bde gshegs bum pa'i dbang mchog stsol/ /de skad gsol ba gdab par bya/ /yab yum snyoms zhugs 'od zer las/ /bde gshegs 'od bskul bum par thim/ /cha 'dres 'od zhu bdud rtsi de/ /spyi bo chu yi dbang bskur ro/ /mi bskyod pa yi 1spro basbu yis/ /tshigs bcad 25—1255

sngags 'dis bum pa sbyin/ /hūṃ sku gsum rirte—dam tshig las byung ba'i/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /mi bskyod pa yi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra ā dar+sha shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na/ a bhi ṣidzi — mi/ rin chen 'byung ldan spro bsdu yis/ /tshigs bcad sngags 'dis cod pan sbyin/ /ṭ+wā 4sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid do/ /dbu rgyan rin chen bla na med/ /dbu rgyan rin chen mchog 'gro ba/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā 5tā dz+nyā na rat+na ma hūṃ ta ya a bhi ṣilnga 6mi/ 'od dpag med kyi spro bsdu 7yis/ /tshigs bcad sngags 'dis rdo rje sbyin/ /dīḥkyesangs rgyas kun gye rdo rje'i 9 dbang / /mi phyed rdo rje gsal ba las/ /chos rnams kun gyi sgor gyur pa/ /rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ pradz+nyā ā be sha ya sa man+ta dz+nyā na pa ṣ+pe badz+ra a bhe ṣi.ā+oṃ mi/ don rnams grub pa'i spro bsdu yis/ /tshigs 3bcad sngags 'dis dril bu sbyin/ /hūṃ skruthabs dang shes rab ldan pa yi / /'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang / /mchod pa'i las rnams rdzogs byed pa/ /dril bu las kyi dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ kri ta a nuṣ+ṭha 2na dz+nyā na pa ṣ+pe badz+ra a bhe ṣispyo 5mi/ rnam snang mdzad kyi spro bsdu yis/ /tshigs bcad sngags 'dis ming sbyin no/ /oṃ rdo rje'i ming du dbang bsgur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang mi chod wīmi shigs par/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab sgogs 7shig /oṃ pa ri 1nasho dha dharma dz+nyā na nā ma dz+nyā na a bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ — mi/ chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /me long gi ni gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rang gi lha ni shes par byis/ /oṃ 166hūṃ/ me long dag gi dbang yin no/ /rdo rje brtul zhugs dbang bskur ba/ /phreng ba chen po ske la skon / /'od zer 'phro 25—/256

'dus byin brlabs la/ /tshigs bcad sngags 'dis sbyin par bya/ /ma skyes rdo rje gsang ba'i thugs/ /'gag med rtashes rab dril bu'i gsung / /gnyis med ye shes chos kyi 2sgu/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa 'chang / /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu 'chang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ a ā/ i spyi/ ur sprur/ u ā u ā al āl/ be sha na ya na gre bha be shud+dhā ni swā hā/ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas lung bstan dbang bsgur ni/ /yon gyis bla ma mnyes byas la/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni gsol ba gdab/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod cing gsol mdzad pa/ /bdag la gdung ba'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /bu 4de seng ge'i khrir bzhag la/ /rdo rje dril bu lag byin te/ /'od zer spro bsdu ting 'dzin bya/ /de nas tshigs bcad sngags 'dis sbyin/ /bu tshur rdo rje'i slob dpon gyis5/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo bskor/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las/ /'gro ba'i don du khyod kyis bskor/ /oṃ haṃ k+ṣa dharma tsa kra pra parta 6ka swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta dharma 7tsa kra a ste ṣilnga ṣ+pemi/de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ni/ /stegs bu bdud rtsi lnga yis byug /pi parta 'am zhing gi khar/ /mtshan ldan rig ma'i bha ga la/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du rol/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lī ḍani rab sbar bas/ /e waṃ zla ba haṃ las 'dzag /spro bsdu byang chub sems de sbyin/ /bu yis mgon la 'di skad gsol/ /rgyal ba thams cad rol pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chu bo rgyun bab 11ste/ /nyon mongs sdog pa sbyangs pa bzhin/ /bdag la byang chub sems dpa' 1 stsol/ /bye ba phrag 25—1257

byed —snye—brgyas gaṅgā'i 1klung / /ji sted mgon po thams cad kyi/ /gnyis med sbyor ba'i bdud rtsi rgyun/ /mgon po bdag gi gsung la gsol/ /tshigs bcad sngags 'dis bu la sbyin/ /yab yum stoms zhugs bde ba'i rgyun/ /gnyis med sems kyi ros gang ba/ /thabs dang shes rab bdud rtsi'i mchog /bu yi ngag la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ a mṛ ta gu hra a bhe ṣispyo nami/ mgrin par gsung la sbyin par bya/ /des kyang a ho su khas 4btung / /de nas shes rab ye shes dbang / /maṇ+ḍal dris byugs dri med khar/ /bdud rtsi dkar dmar zig le gdab/ /steng du stag gi sham thabs khar/ /mtshan ldan rig 5ma khrus byas gzhag6 /gnas lnga ru ni lha lnga dgod/ /spyan drangs bstim zhing mchod bstod bya/ /de nas slob mas gsol ba gdab/ /phyogs dus bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pas 'grub/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral slad du/ /gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol/ /mgon pos kyang ni lan sbyin pa/ /bu tshur shog cig rigs kyi bu/ /gang la dga' ba'i dngos grub ni/ /shes rab ma la brten pas grub— / /rtag tu shes rab don 'dod pas/ /thabs la skrag par mi bya zhing / /pad+ma'i steng du lce yis reg /dri chen dri chu bza' bar bya/ /khu ba dkar dmar bdud rtsi mchog/lce yi dbus su brtan par bzung / /dka' thub med cing brtul zhugs che/ /'di dang ldan na 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas slob ma'i mig phye ste/ /yum gye gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor blta/ /rtag tu gcer bu'i tshul gyis ni/ /rdo rje dril bu kha phye nas/ /mthong ba'i blos ni gsol ba gdab/ /rmad byung btsun mo'i bha ga mchog /ye shes thams cad bskyed pa'i gnas/ /ma smin ma grol ba yi 25—/2bye8

sar / /ye shes dam pa bskyed du gsol/ /shes rab yum gyi bha ga la/ /slob ma dpa' bo'i tshul du rol/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba yis/ /ā li kā li gnyis med las/ /brkyang mas ro ma mnan pa bstan/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le ni/ /gtum 1mos ri bong can haṃ 'dzag /dkyil drangs 2bzlog dang dgram zhing bstim/ /dga' bzhi gnyug ma nyams su myong / /shes rab gsal ba'i ngang la gnas/ /tshigs bcad sngags 'dis byen gyis brlab/ /hūṃ thabs dang shes rab gnyis gred pas/ /ye shes chen po mchog gi lam/ /srid dang zhi las rab grol napa'i/ /bde ba chen po bde ba'i mchog /yum la brten pa'i bde ba 'dis/ /bu la byen brlabs dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣispyo 4mi/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs chen po/ /bde ba chen po zab mo'i chos/ /dngos grub dam pa bdag gis blang / /oṃ dz+nyā na sedhi hūṃ/ de yi dngos grub dam pa blang / /bzhi pa chos nyid mngon rtogs dbang / /lhan cig skyes pa bdud rtsi'i ro//mtshon du yod pa ma yin te/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das las 5grol/ /de nas bkra shis smon lam gdab/ /sngags 'dis bzod pa gsol bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa two no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ rnyo — mre bha ba/ su tostso me bha ba8/ a nu rasto me bha ba/ su postso me bha ba9/sarba sid+dhim+bi pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa ske tsidzhai gre yo ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga bān / sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa badzī bha ba / ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ / bum pa'i lha dang dkyil 'khor lha/ /spyan drangs nam mkhar gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig 'khor lo rang la bsru/ /de nas spyod lam rnam 25—/259

bzhi ni/ /'gro ba'i don du dge ba spyad/ /gnyis po mi 'bral nga rgyal ldan/ /'di brtsams pa yis 1dge ba gang / /zla ba rgyas pa dri med bzhin/ / 'gro ba dug can thams cad ni/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar skye bar shog /phyag na rdo rje gtum po lha lnga pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'phags pa klu sgrub ༄ kyi zhal snga nas mjard pa rdzogs so// //1bsdur mchan/1245 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phrog na rdo rje gtum po lha lnga pa'i dkyil chog bzhugs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsaṇ+ḍa/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉don/ d+ngha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkardo rje/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaza'/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 nga / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamar/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da sko/1246 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tram̐/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dag las/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snga/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngadri/1247 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mdzag 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanaṇ+ḍa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pan/6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // 7〈〈pe 〉〉da/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byu kri seng kri ha se/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi ka ra / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ 1 13〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bye/ wī〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drag1248 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ zi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(4sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/1249 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdoms/ rte〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gitu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rlab/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbyed/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasad/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ra yang slang / byesna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉yong /125༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganyer/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / 4〈〈pe 〉skorador/ tha〈〈pe 〉〉yis/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rlab/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṣeñtsa/1251 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dum ba/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tri/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉pa badz+ra ad+ma ko haṃ/〈〈snar 〉〉pa badz+ra ata ma ko haṃ/ de〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasrung / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cing / 7〈〈snar 〉sngagasang /25byed/260

10〈〈pe 〉〉ded+dhi me/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bed+dhi me/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dharmā/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉na/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉badzi bha wa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masaḥ/1260 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ston/ na〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyab/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba yis/ /gos sngon go 'phang myur thob shog /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1022)

༄rgya/ /phyag na rdo rje'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pā ṇi mānābye ba2/ bod skad du/phyag na rdo rje'i lam yan lag brgyad pa/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo / /rigs lnga khro bo rigs gcig pas/ /gnyis po dbyer rnged rnam bzhi 'dras / /bcom ldan de btud sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gtum po khros pa'i gzhung bzhin bya/ /de la dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su gdong la sogs pa dag par byas te dri chu'i chag chag btab la/ rnal 'byor pa dbang thob pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste rang gi snying gar hūṃ sngon po bsam/ de'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang lha dang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams thugs bskul te bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang / /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod yon lnga dang rin chen bdun/ /bkra shis rdzas 25—/263

brgyad 'khor 1yug bcas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams/ /bla na yod med mchod par bzhes/ /bdag gis thog mtha' med pa nas/ /sdig pa bgyis pa ma lus kun/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /spyan sngar da lta mthol zhing bshags/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po dang / /gsang sngags kun bdag rdo rje can/ /de rigs 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor kun/ /dge ba mdzad la rjes yi rang //bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /byen gyi rlabs 2kyis dbang bskur la/ /gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor bar bsgul / /skyon bral mthu ldan khyed rnams la/ /skye rga na 'chi mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i don du sgu sprul la / /mthun 'jug mya ngan mi 'da' gsol/ /bdag gis dge ba ci bsags kun/ /gcig tu bsnyus te bsdoms nas su/ /bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /sems can kun gyi don du bsngo/ /de nas byams pa dang snying rje dang / dga' ba dang btang stoms bsgom mo/ /de nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te/ oṃ sarba dharmā swa bhā ba āt+tha ko3haṃ 4 zhes brjod pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom mo/ /de nas rang gi snying gar a las byung ba'i zla dkyil du hūṃ bsam mo/ /de'i 'od kyis don byas/ bar chad bsal/ mchod pa phul/ byin rlabs basbus sa bon la thim pas khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga par bltas te/ de'i lte ba can gyi yang de ltar byas/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa sku mdog mthing ga /g.yas rdo rje bsnun pa'i tshul/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar bkan pa/ lto 'gros brgyan cing stag sham gsol ba/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ skra brdzes 5shing sma ra ser ba/ zhabs gyad kyi 'dor stabs 625—1264

su bgrad pa/ thugs las rigs bzhi yum dang 'khyud1/ /seng ge stag dang ce spyang phag /sprul pa'i khro chung bsam mi khyab/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i bdag nyid bsam / /de rjes hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes spyan drangs mchod sogs bya/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas btab la/ /sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab/ /spyan la sogs pas dbang bskur la/ /spro bsdu mi skyo'i bar du bsgom/ /de nas ting 'dzin gsum dang ma bral bar bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa4/ gzungs sam rigs lnga'i snying po gang yang 'dra'o/ /de nas gtor ma gtang 5/ bstod pa bya/ yi ge brgya pa bklag /ye shes pa gshegs/dam tshig pa bsdu/ spyod lam bzhi dge ba'i chos su spyad par bya'o/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ /sa bon ram̐ du 'bar ba yis/ /kha spyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ /thabs dang shes rab spyor ba yis/ /bde ba chen po gso mdzad pa/ /thig le'i rang bzhin mi shigs kyis/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag 'joms par mdzad/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /gtor ma las rab kun gyi mchog /las rnams kun gyi sngon du 'gro/ /yo ram̐ shaṃ dag sa bon las/ /rlung dang me dang thod pa'i sgyed/ /a las thod pa'i gzhal yas su/ /shu 6dang bi mu ma ra las / /na dang go dang ku da ha/ /mi 'chi lnga dang rab gsal lnga/ /steng du sa bon dgod bya ba/ /oṃ dang hūṃ dang ṭ+wā 7lo khaṃ/ /lo rmā paṃ tsā 8baṃ dag las/ /yab yum snyoms 'jug bdud rtsi'i chur/ /dpa' bo gsum gyis byen brlabs la//brjod pas dkar dmar dngul chu'i mdog /ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs la / /rdo rje khong gseng ye shes ljags9/ /hūṃ mdzad sngags 'dis gsol 25—/265

bar bsam/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa 1ye ma hā ba bo i rda/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ khā hi khā hi/ muñdza 2ho sa ma ye swā hā/ de nas sman gyi mchod pa ni/ a mṛ ta pū dza ho / rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ rak+ta pi pa ta yo/ tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ ga ṇa pū dza ho4/ de nas lhag ma bsngo 5bya ba/ /sngags 'di brjod pas thim par bsam/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+pan+da 7twata/ oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā / zhes pa'i sngags kyis 'byung po thams cad la gtor ma gtang ngo / / de nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyis gnang ba'i lha/ /mche ba gcigs shing me mdag spyan/ /me lce'i dbugs la 'jigs pa'i ngar/ /phyag zhabs nor rgyas bu yis brgyan/ /nag po gdol ba'i se ral kha/ /dga' bo nye dgas snyan cha mdzad / /sbrul gdug 'bar bas phyag zhabs brgyan/ /sku yi bzhin dang gzi brjid rgyas/ /khro gnyer smin ma dpral bar basbus/ /ya sos ma mchu drag tu mnan / /gshin rje'i cha byed / 'jigs byed sgu/ /glog ltar 'khyug pa'i ljags 'dril zhing / /gsus pa che zhing sgrul za ba/ /lag pa brdabs pa'i sgra yis ni/ /khams gsum rnams ni 'jigs par byed/ /sma ra ser po gyen du 'khyel / /khro gnyer smin ma me lcer 'khyug /kham nag ral pa gyen du brdzes/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje bsnams/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub log 'dren gzir//sku la me 'bar srid gsum 'dul/ /'dab bzangs rgyal pos ska rags mdzad/ /dpag tshad brgyad khye rgya mtsho'i zabs/ /zhabs kyi pus mor phyin mdzad nas/ /dbang po nyi ma phrag la khur/ / ā li'i gad rgyangs chen po yisas/ /kun du dgod cing 'khrug par byed/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi gad rgyangs kyis/ /ha ha bzhad cing drag shul che/ /klu rnams 'dul bar byed la bstod/ /25—/266

de nas sngags kyi bye brag ni/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ m+bi dze+e 1ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi 2hūṃ badz+ra ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha 4pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa man+ta ka ra ma rak+ṣa tsit+ta badz+ra nā ga sa man+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ rigs lnga gtum pa'i drag sngags te/ /rim pa yis ni shes par bya/ /tar+ya thā nas bha ga bān5/ /ra dz+nyā pa yi 6bar du ni / /gtum po khros pa'i rgyud bzhin no/ /de dag gdags pa'i drag sngags ni / /sbyor bas yang dag bstan par bya/ /oṃ ha yak+ṣa sod rdo rje ṇa ri thā rbad/dzā 7bu re rbad/ sum̐ rig sum̐ rig mā ra ya shig /sog tshig nan rbad/ lus rul nā ga mā ra ya phaṭa/ re ram̐ dza la dza la/ shig shig mā ra ya/ rdul bun rbad sod/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba dubyen krig nan/ e hur sum̐ dza 9mā ra ya rbad/nā ga tsit+ta mā ra ya rbad/ yak+ṣa tsit+ta mā ra ya rbad/ ru kre tsit+ta mā ra ya rbad/ra dzā tsit+ta mā ra ya rbad/ rak+ṣa tsit+ta mā ra ya rbad/ tsa ra tsit+ta mā ra ya rbad/haṃ shaṃ tsit+ta mā ra ya rbad/ ba ra sa tu tsit+ta mā ra ya rbad/ mus mun tsit+ta mā ra ya rbad/ ru kri tsit+ta mā ra ya 1 rbad/ nyi ma sa bla nan/ klad pa nananyu1/ tsi tra ku li nan12/ ku na shig /tsi tra myu tra bzlog byer/ nā ga shig /nā 1 —ga glog nā ga ngagho la nan5/ che ge tsit+ta mā wīr ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gdug pa rnam gsum gsad 7bya ba/ /thog mar she dang rtso la sbyar/ /dregs pa bcu ni 'dul byed pa/ /gong ltar mthun dang bar pa gzung / /bsrung zhing zlog 8par byed pa ni/ /'gres kyis tha mar shes par bya/ /gzhan yang sngags kyi sbyor ba ni/ /'di ltar rab tu bstan par bya/ /oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa ya / tsa la tsa la swā hā/ ser ba bcad pa'o/ /thal chen dang yungs kar gyis bya'o/ /oṃ e shong thi to/25—1267

hu lu hu lu/ dza la rnyi 1ho/ hu lu hu lu/ yang tri'i ba thi to/ hu lu hu lu / tad tre ba pra ti ga dza tu/ hu lu hu lu swā hā/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di 'thab pa dang / rnam par rtsod pa thams cad la bzlas pas zhi bar byed do/ /oṃ mo tsa ni mo tsa ya4/ mo k+ṣa ni mo k+ṣa ya/ dz+rerbam 5ba ra de swā hā/ chu la btab ste 6gtor na bcings pa las rnam par grol lo/ /oṃ ta ri ni ta ra ya7 / mo tsa ni mo tsa ya9/ mo k+ṣa ni mo k+ṣa ya7/ badz+ra baṃ ba ra de swā hā/ til mar la mngon par bsngags te/ skye ba'i sgo la bskus na sbrum ma bde bar btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re/ mo k+ṣa yā badz+re paṃ swā hā/ gur gum gyis gro ga la gang gi ming smos pa'i sngags mngon par bris la/ spra tshil gyis gtums 1 te dri zhim pos bkang ba'i chu'i bum par blugs te/ me tog dri zhim pa la dus gsum du mchod pa byas na/ 'thab rtsod thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ a ma ra ṇi dz+re baṭī 1 ye swā hā/ sngags 'di legs par bzlas na las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ khyad par du 'brum bu la sogs pa la chu la btab nas 'thungs na 'brum bu thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di lan cig bzlas pas sdig pa thams cad sreg par byed do/ /'byung po la sogs pa'i gdon la yungs kar la bsngags te gtor bas 'byer ro/ /byes pa gsar du btsa' ba la skam pa la rdo rgyus kyis bris te sgo gong du btags na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /oṃ dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra ngaye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi sabha dā ya swā hā/ oṃ puṇ+ḍi wībha dru ya 7swā hā/oṃ dā na dā 1 ya swā hā/ oṃ be+e shra ba shā ya swā hā/ oṃ ki li ma li ni swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ṣ+pe swā hā/ oṃ mu khed+dhā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa len+d+ra ya swā hā/ rdza bha la la 25—/268

gnod sbyin chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nor bsgrub pa'o// //de nas rab gnas bshad par bya/ /gza' skar dus tshes bzang po la/ /bkra shis bum pa mtshan ldan du/ /'dag chal la sogs chu brgyad la/ /stong rtsa brgyad du gzungs brjod do/ /khrus khang 1gser dang mu tig can/ /rin chen sil ma srung 2bar bkru/ /ji ltar bltams pa'i tshigs bcad brjod/ /lugs ma bkru zhing me long la/ /po nyi lha khang bkru bya'o/ /khrus byed na bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dgrol lo/ /sran phye dang 'bras yos dang til mar la sogs pa la ku sha'i pir gyis 4khrus bya zhing sngags 'di brjod—/ na mo sarba ta thā ga ta dur+ṇa 5du pa pa kra sta ye 6swā hā zhes brjod do/ /de nas ras kha tshar ma nyams pas dril phyis bya zhing sngags de brjod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po spyan drangs la bdag gis dkyil 'khor bsgrub 7ste/bdag nyid dkyil 'khor mchod pa rdzogs pa'i rjes la rab gnas kyi lha rnams shin tu gsal bar byas te/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo bar snang du bsdus te spyan drangs la gnyis su sked par bstems la/ dbang bskur rgyas btab la mchod pa shin tu rgyas par bya'o/ /de yang gser gyi thur mas spyan dbye ba'i sngags ni 'di'o / /oṃ tsak+ṣu dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya swā hā/ snyan dbye ba ni oṃ kar+ṇa 7ye swā hā / shangs dbye ba ni ba.oṃ na ga gadhe swā hā/ zhal dbye ba ni oṃ mu kha ye swā hā / na bza' 1 gsol ba ni oṃ ba tsan tsa li ka ye swā hā/ dung gi so mangs dang gser gyi spu gris rab tu byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba bya'o/ /puste 1 glegs bam rnams ni rdo rje chos dang yum chen mor byin gyis brlab bo/ /25—1269

mchod rten ni rnam par snang mdzad du byin gyis brlab bo/ /rdo rje dang dril bu la sogs pa ni rang rang gi phyag mtshan du byin gyes brlab bo1/ /gtsug lag khang la sogs pa de dag thams cad la ye shes sems dpa' bcug la rgyas btab cing byen gyis brlabs te dbang bskur la mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod la bkra shis chen por mnga' gsol lo // // ༄7/ / de nas bdun tshigs byed par 'dod na/ bsnyen pa sngon du song bas gson po'i bsrung ba byas te/ rus bu'am mtshan byang la sogs pa'i dri ma sbyangs te/ 'dod lha'i 4thugs rjes gshin po ngan song gsum nas drang zhing / gshin po'i shes pa a thung gnas pa de mtshan byang la bstems tezhi /drag po'i sbyin sreg gis gshed phral la/ dug sbyang zhing 'gro drug nas drangs te/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di gsum 'jig rten dug yin te/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje nyid/ / dkon mchog bden pas dug mi mnga'/ /6dkon mchog bden pas dug bcom mo/ /dug ka shādzhai 7ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing 'gro drug nas drangs la dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur te/ me mar gyis lam bstan la bde ba can gyi zhing khams su gnas spar ro // // 9 ༄7/ /1 de nas sbyin sreg bshad par bya/ /zhi ba dkar zhing zlum pa la//ku sha 'o ma can gyes bsreg /'bras chan dkar gsum mngar gsum dbul/ /ta 1la n+ya gro dha yis bsreg /gru bzhi rin chen mdzes pas spras/ /sman sadang 25—1270

rin chen sna lnga dbul/ /dbang la dmar zhing zla gam la/ /tsan+dan dmar dang seng sdeng shing / /khru gang tshad la pad+ma'i dbyibs/ / drur ba shing thog 1la sogs dbul/ /drag po mthing nag gru gsum la/ /chu shing tsher ma can gyis bsreg /rdo rje lcags kyus spras pa la/ /dug dang khrag dang drag pos dbul/ /me lha'i cho ga rdzogs byas la/ /de yi gzhal yas drag po ru/ /bcom ldan cho ga legs pa yis/ /sbyin sreg sngags ni 'di ltar ro/ /oṃ asna ye dz+wa la re/sarba sha bye/ shādzhai ku ru 4swā hā/ zhi ba'i'o5/ /puṣ+ṭi ku ru 6swā hā/ rgyas pa'i'o—/ /ba shaṃ ku ru 3swā hā/ dbang gi'o/ /mā ra ya ku ru 8hūṃ phaṭa/drag po'i'o/ /na mabyaṇ+ḍa 9/badz+ra pā ṇa 7ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā tso1pa ta ye/ sarba sha hūṃ 15zhes pa phrin las bzhi'i sngags gdags pa ni phyag na rdo rje'i'o —// // ༄7/ /7de nas gdon bshad par bya/ dbyibs legs mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal gsum/ /bdag dang nad pa'i bar du bya/ /dang po gzungs sakyi bum pa la/ /gnyis pa smyug shad lcug mas byabawī/ /gsum pa ba su rigs drug dgod / /'khar gzhong sman gyis bkang ba ni/ /lcug ma'i gdan de nad rnams gdab/ /mā lteg yu lu zhes brjod la/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar dag gis dbul/ /zhi ba chu yi sbyin sreg go/ /gu gul dud pas bdug pa dang / /bra ma'i lcag gis brab pa dang / /khyung dang mthu chen bsdigs 1 shing brab/ /mdongs kyis 5 dud khung lta bur byab / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bskyon byas la/ /gdon de dpag tshad brgyad khrir 'phang / /gdon rigs nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ /sman yang rtsa lngas nad rnams 'joms 1/ /mthong ba'i dug dang reg pa'i dug /25—1271

kha rlangs 1dug dang bsam 2pa'i dug /myos pa'i dug dang dug mtsho lnga/ /gtum po khros pa'i rgyud bzhin du/ /rten cing 'byel pa'i rdzas rnams dang / /ye shes lha yi sngags kyis dgrol/ /mdze rigs sum brgya drug cu las/ /bsdu na bco brgyad shin tu brgyad4/ /rtsa dang chu dang dbang po dngas/ /skra dang rus pa sen mo sru/ /dug dang rkyen dang rigs dang gdon/ /mngal dang srin bu chu dang ltas/ /dang po brtag pa gces 5pa yin/ /gnyis pa gso thabs bstan par bya/ /brtag pa brgyad la gso thabs gnyis/ /sman dang lha ru shes par bya/ /lha ni sngon 6du song ba yis/ /sman ni rten cing 'byel pa'i rdzas/ /bcangs pa tsam gyes bsrung ba'i mchog /rtsa bshal rtsub bshal rna 7bshal sogs / / rngabs ru'i thabs sbyor dag dang ni/ /gtar dang me thur la sogs pas / /rig 9pas dpyad la kun nas dgrol/ /mdze rigs brgyad la gso thabs brgyad/ / brtag thabs brgyad la man ngag brgyad/ /bla ma'i ngag gis brgyan par bya/ /dug la sman kyis gso bar bya/ /rkyen la rten cing 'byel pa'i thabs / /rigs la rin chen gter gyis gzer/ /gdon la byab bsrungs lha yi sngags/ /mngal dang srin la rtsa bshal lo/ /chu la gtar dang de bzhin te/ /las la dge ba'i stobs kyis gso/ /lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo dag las/ /bdag nyid 'phags pas lung bstan pas/ /brtsam par mi 'os ma yin te/ /yan lag brgyad du de bshad do/ /rgyud kyi dgongs pa yan lag brgyad/ /lhag chad rgyal po bka' las 'gal/ /zab mo sgrub thabs 'di bris pas/ /'dir 'jug gsang bdag 'grub par shog /phyag na rdo rje'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa klu sgrub sakyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //25—/272

༄/ /gnod sbyin gyi sgo dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can dang bya byung gi sgrub thabs/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ti m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa sā dha ā+oṃ—/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can dang / bya khyung gi sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud dang ni/ /gser mig 'khyel pa'i rgyud dag la / /brten nas nang gi sgrub thabs 'di/ /bdag gis dran phyir bshad par bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor yud tsam bsam/ /rang gi snying gar zla dkyil bsam/ /de yi steng du hūṃ yig bsam/ /hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa yis4 / /phyi nang gsal nas 'od zer 'phros4/ /bla ma dang ni gos sngon can//dkon mchog la sogs spyan drangs nas/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol/ /skyabs 'gro bros dbul dge rtsa bsngo / /tshad med bzhi yang bsgom par bya/ /de nas stong pa'i ting 'dzin 25—1275

bsgom / /de na 1'od dpung tshul du bdag /de yi nang du hūṃ gnas pa/ /de las dzaḥ'aphros 'khor lor gyur/ /lte bar nyi bsam hūṃ de nyid/ /de nas gnod mdzes rgyal por gyur/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las/ /khro bo chen po bcu ru gyur/ /hūṃ bzhi'i 2gsang sngags brjod pa yis/ /khro chu'i sprul pas gdug pa bkug /sgu gsung thugs kyi phur pa btab4/ /btul zhing sbyangs nas nam mkhar gyur/ /de nas hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las/ /rdo rje'i gur dang ra ba dang / /dra ba nyid du gyur pa'o/ /hūṃ gi 'phro 'dus 5slar la zhu/ /stong pa nyid las 'od dpung byung / /de las nyi zla kha sbyar gyur/ /ā li kā li nyi 6zlas brgyan/ /dbus su aḥdang hūṃ sbyar te/ /kha dog dkar dmar nyid du gyur/ /'od zer dkar dmar 'phro 'du las/ /zhu bas rdo rje pad+mar gyur/ /pad lter rdo rje rked nub tsam/ /lte ba gnyis la snying pos bskor/ /de nyid ཿ ngo bo thugs dang gsung / /gnyis kas sku gsung byin gyis brlab/ /de nyid 'od du zhu ba las/ /rdo rje las ni khro bor gyur/ /pad+ma las ni khro mor gyur/ /khro bo rdo rje gos sngon ni/ /sgu mdog mthing nag zhal gcig pa8/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dmar/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyil/ /phyag rgya drug dang yang dag ldan/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'khyel ba'i tshul/ /mdun du rdo rje phag mo ni/ /sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig ma/ /g.yas pa rdo rje gri gug bsnams/ /g.yon pa bhan dha dmar gyis bkang / /gcer bu spyan gsum dbu skra badze+es / /phyag rgya drug dang yang dag ldan/ /gdan du rdo rje rgya gram bsam/ /oṃ hūṃ ṭ+wā dhīḥ.aḥ/e waṃ mā ya/ hūṃ swa da dhīḥ.āḥrta dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ oṃ āḥ—hūṃ sa ma ya ste/ oṃ 25—1276

āḥ1hūṃ sa ma ya dzaḥ/ oṃ āX2hūṃ sa ma ya āḥ/ budhe ga ru ḍa oṃ/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa 4hūṃ/ rat+na ga ru ḍa hūṃ༄/ pad+ma ga ru ḍa dhīḥ6/ karma ga ru ḍa aḥ7/e puju ga ru shadacho/ waṃ dhū sgo pa ga ru shad / mā 65 'od ke ga ru shad / ya gan+dha ga ru ḍa1 / ga ru ḍa sbyiyak+ṣa/ ga ru ḍa 15ya ma/ ga ru ḍa —hu lu/ ga ru ḍa stson+da / dzaḥg ru ḍa1na/ hūṃ ga ru ḍa1// baṃ ga ru ḍa / hoḥg ru ḍa /yab kyi go cha'o/ /oṃ baṃ/ haṃ oṃ/ hri 5na.oṃ/ hro hri/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/yum kyi go cha'o/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ /phyi nang bdud rtsi bcas pas mchod/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbacas pas bcing / /bdud rtsi bum pas dbang bsgur bas rigs kyi gtso bos dbu brgyan bsam/ de ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'o thig le ge sar bcas pa'i dbus/ /ā li kā li yang dag ldan/ /de yi dbus na gnas pa'i lha/ /dar dkar phra ba'i skud pa tsam/ /de las bsam gyes mi khyab bsam/ /bsam gyis mi khyab de bsams nas 5/ /de las 6 gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'gyur/ /dang po rnal 'byor lung gis brgyan/ /de nas chos kyi dbyings su thim/ /phag mo'i de kho na nyid ni/ /phag zhal don dam dngos po med/ /kun rdzogs khro zhal mtshon pa la/ /bya ni gsal ba'i thabs yin te/ /khyung ni gsal ba dngos med yin/ /ga ni gang du mi gnas te / /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba nyid/ /bya ni gzugs sgu rnam gnyis te/ /khyung ni rang bzhin 'od gsal bas/ /gdod nas dag pas nam mkha' bzhin/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ mā ra ya 25—/277

mā ra ya/ sgo ṭa ya sgo ṭa yasna/ badz+ra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa be ga hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥr tse pre tsi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki m+bi sdehūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ dar ma shaṃ ga 1ki ni da ri/ dar ma he sha dhu dhu ra/ rat+na te shaṃ ka ri/ dar ma nyi sha tsa ka ra/ dar ma te sha sa ma ya/ spu 3ta ya spu ta ya/ te pa te pa kha kha re / te pa te pa tsa ka ri/ te pa te pa mun du 6ri/ te pa te pa brngurnyo 7ta ra / te pa te pa sa mu sa muñdza 8—/ tsa kha mun dur khye badz+ra tsa na ran dza dzaḥbadz+ra tsa mun+dha ra dzaḥbadz+ra kha mun+dha ra dzaḥ/ te sha mun dur dz+wa/ dzu ru dzu ru re/ dzu ru dzu ru mun badz+ra/ dzaḥhūṃ rdo rje ka chen bskyod/ rdo rje drag po bskyod / rdo rje mtha' yas bskyod/ rdo rje mthar thug bskyod/ kha dza ra dza mun dur —nye pad+ma ran kha dza ra dza mun dur 1 nye kha dza ra dza mun du ra ra sa muñdza/ oṃ ḍā ki m+bi 1 dzaḥspyan drangs pa'i sngags so / /shā1oṃ kā ya bāka tsit+ta/ i rda ba bo bhuñdza khudza ka la phube+e dhū pa mā mus/ se sa kha na di/ te ka ka to/ oṃ a mṛ lata pa ti dzaḥka sa ka ru/ pū dza khā hi pube+e / ā lo ke/ gadhe/ ṣ+pe ber+ya/ ka sa ka 1 snaru pū dza khā hi nā ga pu a bye pa ti/ ka sa ka ru pū dza khā nyi/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ a kā hūṃ/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā 8rde/ār+ya nut+pan+da twata 9oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gtor ma bstabs pa'i sngags so/ /ka ka rak+ṣa/ hūṃ hūṃ stso bye dzaḥdzaḥ/ kha kha te sha rak+ṣa/ hūṃ hūṃ stso bh+yo dzaḥ/kha kha kha tsa ba rak+ṣa/ hūṃ hūṃ stso bh+yo dzaḥ/ kha kha kha tsa kha rak+ṣa/ hūṃ hūṃ stso bh+yo dzaḥ/kha kha kha mu du rak+ṣa/ hūṃ hūṃ bh+yo bh+yo dzaḥ/ kha kha kha/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ na1gdon phyag rgyas dgug 2 pa'i sngags so / / ka ka rak+ṣa sa ma ya/ sru ta ya/ spu dha ra/ tsa ga rak+ṣa sa ma ya du 25—1278

ta ya sad ṭ+wāta ra/ mu du rak+ṣa sa ma ya/ spu ta ya spu ta ra/ gdon gshed ma dang 'bral 4ba'i sngags so / /zhe hūṃ hril hril dim dim kun phob phob shar shar di ri di ri rbad/ kha rja rja thumahūṃ/ dza re dza re bh+yo ha sa ha sa/ te pa te pa/ tri ta ha tri ta ha/tri khug tri khug /tshal pa tshal pa/ srog tshig nan rbad/ lus rdul mā ra ya rbad / re re dza la dza la/ shig shig rdul bun rbad sod/ nā ga sarba ga ru ḍa khā mu hi/ spyi dril ba'i sngags so / /8 oṃ na mo busgye /sheya/ tī li mi li tsan+ta nā ga ban+dha ya swā hā/ phur pa'i sngags so/ /ra li hur hur thum sbyibh+yo dha sha hur thum 11bh+yo/ ma ma shi bh+yo/ sarba ga ru ser 8ba la bh+yo/ ser ba bzlog pa'i sngags so / /rka oṃ be+e ra be+e ra badz+ra dha ri ye swā hā/ rims nad bsrung ba'i sngags so/ /hūṃ di ri di ri ga ru ḍa bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ/ e a ri li hri —bye/ 'khor gyi klu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags so/ /hūṃ dzu ti ting ting teg teg ho ho/ hūṃ sto 5bh+yo/ gtad 'don pa'i sngags so/ /tri nai mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ 'byung po sgod pa'i sngags so/ /bdag gis sgrub thabs 'di brtsams pas/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /'di la brten pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /phyag rgya chen po thob par shog /rdo rje skor gyi nang sgrub yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ phyag na rdo rje wīzhal mngon sum du gzigs pa slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //25—/279

༄/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/7༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī 2badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang ba'i bdag po bsgrub par 'dod pas/dang por chos thams cad stong par bsam/ de nas snying rje chen po bskyed/de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dkyil du hūṃ mthing nag 'bar ba bsam/hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las rdo rje mthing nag 'bar ba hūṃ gis mtshan pa bsam oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje gtum po shin tu khros pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ sku mdog mthing nag /spyan gsum pa/ 'jigs su rung ba 4sbrul dang rgyan thugyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rgya gram gyi 5tho ba 'phyar ba/ g.yon mi rus kyi phur pa 'dril ba cig tu bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ 25—1282

hūṃ hūṃ byāḥ.aḥ she7zhes go bgo'o/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' mdun du bsam/bdun rnam dag bya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs rang la bstem/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa 2ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ sum 'bum nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bzlas so/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'di cung zad bzlas pas sdig pa thams cad sreg 1par byed do/ /thams cad srung thu bar byed do/ /gnod pa'i log 'dren thams cad med par byed do/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sum hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ba lo i rda kṛhā kṛṇ+ḍa6/ khā hi khā nyi/ juñdza hoḥrak+ta pi pa to/ sa ma ye swā hā/ de bsnyen pa byed pa'i dus su rgyun du gtor ma gtong ba'i sngags so / / dz+wade nas drag po'i las bya bar 'dod pas/ dang por dkyil 'khor ji tsam dran pa cig bya/ rdo rje rgya gram bri/ ra 8kun nag por bya/ re khā 1tshil dang thal chen bsres pas bri/ de'i dbus su e gru gsum zabs su mdzub gang ba cig brus nyupe la/ nang ro bsregs pa'i thal bas byug /gru gsum de'i phyi rol dmar por bya/ de ni dkyil 'khor bya ba'i thabs so /de nas liṅga /nyabaca' ba'i thabs ni/ spra tshil las liṅga 7sor bzhi pa byas la de'i snying gar shog bu la dmar chen gyis rdo rje rgya gram bris la/ bsgrub bya rang gi rten dang bral bar bsam/ gru gsum de'i dbus su ming bris la gzhug /de nas gru gsum nang du bcug la/ ske nas skud pa sngon dmar gyis btags la/de'i sna la mi'i 0rje ngar gyi phur pa sor bzhi pa cig btags la/ 'jigs lku byed chen por mnga' gsol te/ sngags nam phyed dam nyi ma phyed na brdeg go/ /phyi rol du 'gro ba la sogs pa byed na liṅga las mephur pa mi dbyung bar mubatab la gzhag 7go/ /maṇ+ḍal dbus su lha'i gdan du byas la/ sum 'bum du bzlas la gdab/ de'i dus su gtor ma dang mchod pa dus drug tu dbul lo/ /25—1283

de 'debs tsa lkun rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngo nag /zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ sbrul gyes brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can / bsgrub bya'i steng na 'dug pa/ phyag na phur bu dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa cig tu bsgom zhing sngags bzlas la brdeg go/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa snyem hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ che ge mo shi ri tī la ye ta hūṃ phaṭa/ a mu ka rdu/ste bha ya/ hri ste bha ya tī la ye ta hūṃ phaṭa ces bzlas la brdeg go/ /de ltar drag po'i las byed pa'i dus su gtor ma gtong choba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ma ma sarba sha byes/ a mu ka ma tsa ye ta pra ya rmā 6sa dzi bo/ bu ga ru dhi jer thra yo bhak+ṣe na ba lo i rda kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ khā hi khā nyi bhuñdza hoḥ kye/ rak+ta pi pa to/ār+ya pra tsa kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ khā hi khā hi/ rak+ta pi pa to/ a ti kra mā ⑩ti sa ma ye swā hā/ phur bu'i las rdzogs nas mtshon rnon pos liṅga hūṃlngastod smad du gtubs la/smad lha'i zhal du sbyin sreg bya/ stod ming byang dang bcas par rtemanan pa bya/las kyi dus su rdo rje rgya gram gnyis kyi bar du gzugs brnyan de bcug la thod pa'i nang du skud pa sngon dmar gyis dkri'o/ /skud pa lag pa g.yon pas bzung 1 la / las kyi dus su gzugs brnyan la gnas lngar phur pas gdab/ de nas slar bcug la sngon dmar gyis dkris la skyelam rgya gram du sba'o/ /de'i steng du phye dang sre mog gis rgya gram bris la gzhag thugo/ /las 'gor na bskyar stsol bya'o/ /spra tshil las tshiliṅga sor bzhi pa byas la/ bsgrub bya'i ming dang bcas par bcug la tsher mas de'i kha la btsugs na/ phyir rgol ba'i kha tshums par 'gyur ro / /lcags kyi phur bu dang mi'i rje ngar la ming nas smos te/ yan lag gang dang gang la btab pa de rengs par 'gyur ro/ /mtsho lkugs par sbas na ngag 25—1284

rengs par 'gyur ro/ /sgo rtsar sbas na 'byer bar 'gyur ro/ /ral gri la bsngags tshosnanas g.yul du zhugs na rgyal bar byed do/ /khros pas snying gar bsgrun na 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /me'i dur du sbas na rims kyis dzo7'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /rabs chad kyi thod pa la ming dang sngags bris nas rabs chad kyi dur du sbas na rabs chad par 'gyur ro/ /mngon par bsngags la dur khrod kyi thal ba'i steng du bzhag na 'byer bar byed do/ /khye nag po'i thod pa la sngags dang ming bcas pa 4bris nas klu'i gnas su sbas na mdzes zin 5par 'gyur ro/ /dbang ma thob cing man ngag med/ /tshad dang mi ldan 'di mi bya/ /'di la nyes pa yod pas na/ /shin tu gsang zhing spel mi bya/ /slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gsang ba thugs kyi phur gcig ma'o// //6 bsdur mchan/1282 byesnamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa bzhugs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉phyag na rdo rje'i pa bzhugs so// bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7) — bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rin/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i rgyan/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ridang rgyan/spe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7rgya gram gyi/1283 hu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tram̐ hriḥ.ā / —7〈〈snar 〉〉tsan+d+ra/ ༄ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasreg 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasrung /bye〈〈snar 〉〉tsaṇ+ḍa/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉yodasna dzasna/ 〈〈snar 〉tsāṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi/ 7sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rwa/9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag skye〈〈snar 〉〉gras/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ṅka/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pra tshil la/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thama'i/ rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thajig khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'aṅka la/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabyug par/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhag1284 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rga/ — 〈〈snar 〉〉tsaṇ+ḍa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+ku hūṃ phaṭa/ mu ga je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang /snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tram̐/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ti/ rme〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thag k+ṣe/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉25—1285
