༄ / /rig sngags bcad pa dang mnan pa'i cho gahūṃ ༄gro/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa trem hā ro ṣa ṇa ngh+ru ma gho mi sha hūṃ/ che ge mo shi re tī jel ye ta hūṃ phaṭa/ shi ram̐ ste 5bha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ka ti mu la ye ta hūṃ phaṭa/ka ti mu kha hūṃ 3bha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ s+thā 7ta ste bha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ pa ta tī la ye ta hūṃ phaṭa / mchog phur gyis gnas lngar gdab bo/ /stong gsum snod kyi sems can rnams/ /khro bo gtum pa'i 9sku ru bsgom/ /'gro drug bcud kyi 'jig rten dag /bcom ldan gtum por bsam par bya/ /de la bsam rgyud ni/rlung rdo rje rgya gram nas srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du stong gi phyi mtha' dag rdo rje gtum po rdul 1 snyed kyi sku'i rang bzhin du bsams te5/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la zhabs g.yo zhing brdabs pas stong gsum gyi stong chen po sa 'jig rten ltekhams kyi tshad 7tsam zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dar ba dang / sku'i ba spu'i bu ga nas nyi ma stong gi 'od gzi brjid can gyi me'i 'od zer 'phro ba dang /25byed1287

ljags kyi rdo rje las bzlas pa'i sngags kyi 'od zer rim pa gsum 'phros stong gsum gyi stong rdo rje phra mo'i 'od zer gyis 'gengs pa dang / klu brgyad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pas gdug 1 pa du ba'i 'od kyis klu phra mo dang sa bdag rnams bsregs 2pa dang / thugs kyi rdo rje las khro bo du ma 'phros pas/ bskal pa chen po'i rlung bzhin du bgegs kun du 'thor ba dang / phyag gis rdo rje gsor bas gong 4du gnod par sems pa de'i sa phyogs su/ rdo rje chen po 'od zer skyogs 'phen pa bzhin du yang dang yang bsnun par bsam/ de nas bzlas pa ma zin bar du hūṃ 'brug gi sgra lta bu rgyun du gdon5/ bsnun pa'i 'khor lo zangs lcags kyi phye ma dang / yungs kar ske 6tshe dug chus brab bo / / yang rnam pa gcig la/ snying ga'i hūṃ las 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad phyag na rdo rjer gyur te/ 'jim pa mi dmigs pa las phyag na rdo rjer gyur/sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ shog bu la gnod pa'i gdon lo ste bha 9nan shāṅgi ste bha ā+oṃ ku ru rna hūṃ phaṭa sāts+tsha de mchod rten nag po 'od 'bar ba mthong ba tsam gyis skrag par byed pa/ bum pa'i nang du phyag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mtshon cha thogs pa bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis gzhan gyi srung ma'i rigs 1rtarnams bkug nas mthu med par bsam zhing / gtum po'i zhabs 'og nas mi 'chor bar bsam/ de nas mchod pa dang bden pa'i byin rlabs ཿbrjod pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de lta bu 'bum btab na/ drang srong dmod pa yang bzlog 1 par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags bcad pa dang mnan pa'i cho ga'o// //25—1288

sreg mdor bsdus pa/ 1 ༄go/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sbyin sreg mdor bsdus pa/ bkra shis pa'i gnas su me thab zlum po dkar po byas la/ tsan+dan nam 'o ma can gyi shing dkar po la zlum por brtsigs te/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/dang la nabadun rnam dag bya/ de nas me tog dkar pos dus gsum du mchod cing / 'bras chan dang mar gyi sbyin sreg bya/ brgya rtsa brgyad byas nas gang la dmigs pa de zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ dpal 'phel ba'i gnas su me thab gru bzhi ser po byas la/ shing ser po gru bzhi zhibartsigs te/me tog ser pos dus gsum du mchod cing / rin po che lnga dang 'bru sna lnga'i sbyin sreg byas na/ gang la dmigs pa de rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /puṣ+ṭi ku ru 6swā hā / rgyas pa lta bu'i gnas su ni/ /me thab zla gam dmar po brtsigs7/ /seng ldeng dmar po'i zla gam brtsigs la/ me tog dmar pos dus gsum du 25—1290

mchod cing / me tog dang sman gyi :sbyin sreg byas na/ gang la dmigs pa de nyid dbang du 'gyur ro/ /dzaḥdzaḥho/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su me thab gru gsum mthing nag brtsigs/ shing nag po tsher ma can gru gsum brtsigs la / me tog sngon pos dus gsum du mchod cing / dug sna sha chen tshil chen 3 yungs kar ske tshe/ bgegs kyi liṅga la brgya rtsa brgyad du bsregs na/ gzas snye pa po tshangs pa'i tshe dang ldan pa yang 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/go rims zudang po maṇ+ḍal bya/ de nas lha mchod/ de nas spyan drangs5/ de nas bdun rnam dag bya/ de nas me lha'i sbyin sreg bya/ de nas thab khung mi dmigs par bya/ de nas me lha rang gnas su gsol/ slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //hūṃ bde gshegs gtso bo gtum po dang / /lha rnams phyogs su 'khor ba rnams / /bdag dang sems can rgyud sbyang phyir/ /skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e bye nyi bha ga bān 6/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ho/ sa ma ya snyi sa ma ya dzaḥbadz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ yi ge brgya pas spyi khrus dbul / oṃ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yo haṃ zhes pas zhal bsil dbul/ oṃ pra bā ra saṭ+wā ra ā dī tso dzid swā hā/ zhes zhabs bsel dbul/ oṃ ka ma khā ya na swā hā/ zhes pas me tog phul la gdan dbul/ gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni / /dran pa tsam kyis 'joms mdzad cing / /bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa / /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na / /bcom ldan rdo rje gtum po ni/ /yon tan thams cad sku la rdzogs/ /25—1291

skyon med sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid stong pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs la mkhas phyir sna tshogs skur ston pa/ /rgyal sras khyung gi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /yid kyis ci nus dmigs pa'i mchod 'bul na/ /kun du bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po ltar/ /sku gsung 1 thugs la mnyes pa'i mchog gyur cig /bdag gis thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas/ /sdig pa ma lus bgyes pa rnams/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /spyan sngar so sor sdig bshags so/ /shes rab snying rjer ldan pa'i byang chub sems/ /dus gsum rgyal bas ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin//de yi rjes su bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub sems de nam yang mi gtong 4ngo / /bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang ni/ /gsang sngags kun bdag rdo rje 'chang / /rigs 'dzin pa yi rnal 'byor rnams/ /dge ba mdzad la rjes pyayi rang / /bcom ldan rdo rje gtum po dang / /'khor dang bcas la lus 'bul na6 / /bzhes nas bdag la rjes mthun par/ /dngos grub rnams ni stsal du gsol / /dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /da lta dge ba gang spyad pa/ /bdag dang sems can don slad du/ /byang chub tu ni bsngo bar bgyi//phyag rdor bdun rnam 7dag go / /8 gser mes ma tshig pa/ g.yu mig ma phug pa/ mu tig /rin po che mdung len/ gur gum gyis bris pa'i rten 'byel gyi snying po/ rma bya'i mdongs/bya khyung gi snying po khro gser gyis bris pa/ gla rtsi/ ga pur/ mu zi/ btsan dug/gu gul/ tsan+dan go shiste/ sman gi wang —// bya rgod kyi tshil bu/ spre'u'i pags pa la gtum/ sgri // //25—1292

bsdur mchan/129༷ lhamatshan byang 'di 〈〈sde bstan dpo/ra chag 〉〉ltar bkod/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ ri )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rin/④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ye/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉grwa bzhir/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ye/ ༅〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltal/1291 lha/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)sa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi chen/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzlas/ do④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rim/⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drang / ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bon/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba ra san ra a did/ risre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsho'i la ye/1292 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagasum/ ldu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyan/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ /④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btang / 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rinas/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉rnams/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // she7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gor shir sha /sman 'gi(5 43/ tshu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skrags pa la ba/ngem/ ༷1/bsdur 'bras re'u mig/khyetshad/ (1rkya211)25wa 1293

༄go/ / klu gtor rgyas pa ni/2 rin bo che'i snod mdzes pa'i nang du 'bru sna tshogs dang / klu sman sna tshogs dang / zan la sogs pa'i phung po stsal la/ zan la sogs pa'i phung po la baṃ las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i sgod / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du baṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/de'i steng du dīḥ4las 'od 'phros pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang 'o ma'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar zhing ro mchog brgyad dang ldan pa dri zhim pa bsam/ oṃ las sman gye sdong po stong gsum gang ba/ swa las ut+pal gyi nags tshal me tog gi tshal chags pa bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam/ tai las dpag bsam gye shing 'o ma dang bum pa dpag tu med pa 'bab pa bskyed la/ bdag lha'i rnal 'byor du gnas pa'i snying ga'i yi ge las 'od 'phros pas/ klu rigs thams cad sbrul mgo bdun pa la sogs pa'am/ klu rigs sa bdag tu 5bsam/ 'od zer lcags kyu dang 25—1294

zhags pa lta bus/ gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa nam mkha' dang sa gzhi thams cad nas bkug la/ de'i lce la rdo rje bsam/ 7snade'i steng du hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'od zer gyi sbu gus 'thungs/ gnyis su med pa'i sems dang ldan par bsam/ mchod pa lnga dang ldan pa la/ oṃ ba ta li ma hā ba ta li/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ4snasnyan gsan dbab pa'o/ /oṃ bhu a bye pa ti ma hā pad+ma/mā le mṛ dzaḥ ā kaste naya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ oṃ ba ru ṇa nā ga de ba tā4/ oṃ ā kar+ṣa ya 5dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ oṃ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ ma hā nā ga hoḥb ti sarba phuḥphuḥ/sa ma ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ6/ me tog dbul/ oṃ bhak+ṣa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha dzaḥhūṃ swā hā/'o ma la sogs dbul/ oṃ ba ru ṇa nā ga de ba tā ye 7swā hā/ oṃ nā ga sarba phuḥphuḥ a nan+ta kā ya swā hā/ oṃ phuḥphuḥ tak+ṣu ya swā hā/ oṃ phuḥphuḥb su ki ye swā hā/ oṃ phuḥphuḥkarko ṭa kā ya keswā hā/ oṃ phuḥ phuḥpad+mā ya muswā hā/ oṃ phuḥ phuḥm hā pad+mā ya 7swā hā/ oṃ phuḥphuḥshaṃ kha pā lā ya 2swā hā/ oṃ phuḥphuḥhu lu kā ya jeswā hā/ oṃ phuḥphuḥla.a nan+ta shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dza a nad+dhā ya swā hā/ oṃ nā ga shaṃ kha pā 'di ya 8swā hā/ oṃ nā ga sarba pū dza me gha sa ma ye swā hā/oṃ nā ga sarba i rda ba lo kṛhā kṛhā sa ma ye swā hā/ nā ga hu lu kā ya 19swā hā/oṃ nā ga ba su ki ye swā hā/ tak+ṣu 2 ya swā hā/ ba ta li swā hā/ u pa nan+da swā hā/ wa ru rja ya 2naswā hā/ oṃ bi rū pak+ṣa shā ya swā hā/ oṃ nā ga le nā ga le swā hā/ oṃ nā ga ke she phud ya te nā ma ka pra marda nā ya 2 swā hā/ oṃ bhū a dhi 25pa ti ma hā pad+ma mā spyole mṛ dza/ i rda ba lo kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa pa ya swā hā/ oṃ bhū a bye pa nyi ma hā pa ra/ ma hā pad+ma ma lo mṛ dza/ ma hā pū dza 9sa ma ya swā hā/sa bdag mchod pa/ klu shi sa bstan pa ni / badz+ra pā ṇi nā ga shādze+e ku ru swā 25—1295

hā / stong bzlas na sa bdag klu gnyan kha 'ching bar kye'agyur ro/ /zab che chung blta/ zab che na gzugs sna tshogs bya ba bar bar du sha dang nya sha dang /chu mig nas chu blangs la ba dmar ser kyi 'o mas bya/ chung na gtor mas chogabya khyung sa ma ya tan+t+ra'i rgyud las btus pa/ lo tsā ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba'i klu gtor rgyas pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1294 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉giklu gtor rgyas pa ni/ ——〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartsal/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hriḥ/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gitu/1295 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkade las rdo rjer bsam/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkaḥ/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉oṃ dzaḥ.āk+ṣar+ṣa/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giya/ 6〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta ye ta ye/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉 nan+ta ka ‘ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tak+ṣa ye/ —〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉mdoye/ 7〈〈pe 〉sngag bo/ 〈〈snar 〉dka bo/lo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa pad+ma ye/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga ma ha pad+ma ye/ khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba phu shaṃ ka pa li/wī〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa phu hu lu ke/ nya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga phu/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas nasto/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nā ga shaṃ ka pa la/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ke/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giye/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tak+ṣa/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ru nan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du pak+ṣa ṇa ye/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnam dha na ye/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byu a ti/ spyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnam/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dab/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bhu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dzā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pra ni/1296 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉ngas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ribar rdo 〈〈co 〉〉giser/ pari〈〈pe 〉〉la/ lots+tsha/ 〈〈snar 〉tha/lo:: / 25byed1296

༄khya/ /khro bo rdo rje gtum po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa kro dha sā dha na nā ma/ bod skad du / khro bo rdo rje gtum po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po sgrub pa po dkon mchog gsum la dang bas2/ byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la mchod par bya'o/ /de nas stong pa nyid du bsams la/ pad+ma dang / nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las yang dag par byung ba'i rdo rje gtum po sgu mdog nag po/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa / phyag g.yas pas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje zhun ma bsnams pa/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ g.yas bskum pa/spyan gsum me'i mdog 'dra ba/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba/ bskal pa'i me'i nang na bzhugs pa/ sgu las khro chung dang khyung mang po 'phro ba cig gsal bar bskyed la/ snying gar hūṃ la sngags 'dis bskor 25ge/298

la bzlas so/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ skyo na sngags hūṃ la bsdu'o/ /de nas gdon gzhom par 'dod na/ rdo rje de khyung nag po phyag gnyis kyis sbrul mgo nas za ba/ gshog napa gdengs pa mchu sder rdo rje 'bar bar bsam/g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub thur du bsdams pa las me 'bar bar bsams 4la/sngags 'di bzlas par bya'o/ /hūṃ phaṭa ṣa ṇa ro ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra ga ru ṇa de ba jen phyung / sa ga nā ga snying la gzir5/ thum ril rbad drag po gsum dang ldan par bzlas so/ /de nas gdon gsad / par 'dod na/ rang gi rmi lam du ci byung ba thams cad bsreg cing sngags 'di bzlas so/ /oṃ nā ga tsaṇ+ḍa tshal pa urta ke / nā ga tsit+ta shat+ta tshal pa sna/ nā ga tri sa ya ti/ bispyo ta/ nā ga kro dha bi da rā dza ya/ shi shi/ nan nan/ dul dul rbud rbud thum ril dzaḥdzaḥ /lan gsum gyis thub par 'gyur ro/ /tha ma mnan par bya'o/ /gtum chung khra thogs ma'i sgrub thabs rgyal po zla ba'i snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// // lo tsā / ba sgeg pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //25—/299

bsdur mchan/1298 3mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rdo rje gtum po'i sgrub thabs dpal zla ba snying pos mdzad pa bzhugs/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dad pas/1299 she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉negyi/ ge〈〈snar 〉〉shog ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsam skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazer/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsad/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gsaḥ/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thog ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo://bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (1༷29)25wa 1300

༄ / /rdo rje khrung gi sgrub thabs/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa sā dha na/ bod skad du/rdo rje khyung gi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba byas la/ rang nyid rdo rje khyung kha dog nag po lag pa gnyis kyis sbrul za ba/ gshog pa dang sgo la sogs pa gnam lcags kyi ral gri me 'bar ba/ mig khro chu khol ba lta bu/ sku che ba cig tu bsams te2/ oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā nā ga mā ra ya sod sod/ nā ga mā ra ya thum ril rbad rbad hūṃ phaṭa/ rtag tu bzlas la ma yengs pas bsgrub par bya'o/ /'di ni las thams cad pa'i sngags te/ gang la yang bum par chu drugs la khyung bskyed la bzlas pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ de nas yungs kar blugs la khrus bya'o/ /nad gang na bar yang byug par bya'o/ /bya'i sha mi bza'/ sgo nga mi bza'/bya la mi brdeg /rtag tu lhar bsgom par bya'o/ /rdo rje khyung gi sgrub pa'i man 25—1301

༄/ /rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzang po mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal bo bye bā sa dza ka bha dra nā 2ma / bod skad du/ rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzang po mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo /gsang nab bstan pa'i rgyud dang ni/ /bla ma'i gdams pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /cho ga bzang po mdor basbus 'di/ /rang dga' nyes pa dor te bri/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid kun ldan zhing / /rgyud kyi dbang thob dam tshig brtan/ /gzhan phan bsgrub la dga' ba la/ /gzhan dag gus pas gsol 'debs sam/ /yang na rang bzhin bsgrub don du/ /nus pa dris la tshig gis sbyin/ /dur khrod la sogs dben pa'i gnas/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gsal byas la/ /gtso bo 'bum la 'khor rnams dza/ /rab 'bring mtshan ma thob par bya/ /de nas bla gos legs bgos nas/ /snyim pa me tog gis bkang ste/ /gus pas gsol 25—— /303

ba gdab par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bya khyeba'i phyir/ /dur khrod dbe+en pa rdo leb dang / /sngon byas yid 'ong la sogs su/ /lto 'phye'i sbyor bas brko bar bya/ /brtag cing sbyang dang bsrung bar bya/ /nyes pa med pa'i sa gzhi der//rdo rje 'dzin par gsol ba dang / /baṃ las skyes pa'i lha mo ser/ /mdzes pa rgyan ldan lus phyed snang / /bum pa 'dzin la sdemachod bstod de / /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang rnam thar ni/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /lag pa sa la brdabs pa las/ /dga' ba'i mdangs ldan lha mo yang / /khyod ni slob dpon mchog yin gyi / /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las gyis zhes/ /zer zhing sa la thim par 'gyur/ /ro bsal 5nyes pa spangs pa ste/ /'thas par bcag cing rnam lnga dang / / dbugs 'byung gis ni byug gyepar bya/ /yang na me yi las kyis sbyang / /stong pa'i sngags kyis byin brlabs te/ /rim pas lha yi khang par bsam/ /me tog steng du rdo rje bzhag /bla mas khrus byas rdo rje 'chang / /bskyed pa'i yan lag kun rdzogs pas/ /shar bltas dkyil 'khor steng 'dug la/ /tshad med bzhi yis gzhan don bsgrub/ /rnam rgyal la sogs bskyed pa yi/ /slob ma gus pas spos thogs la/ /mchod la tshig 'di brjod par bya/ /hūṃ byams pa chen po rdo rje 'dzin / /zhe sdang dag pas me long ye shes gsal/ /gtum po gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus gnas/ /chos kun bdag dang bral 25—1304

ba'i mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs su gsol/ /de bzhin lho phyogs la sogs nas/ /hūṃ snying rje chen po rdo rje 'dzin/ /nga rgyal dag pa mnyam nyid ye shes mchog /gtum po gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan rnams yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /mtshan min thams cad spangs pa ste/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs su gsol / /hūṃ dga' ba chen po rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags dag pa so sor rtog /gtum po gdug pa kun 'dul ba/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo//zhi ba mchog gi chos chen po/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam spyod pa1/ /kun du 2 bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs su gsol/ /hūṃ btang snyoms chen po rdo rje 'dzin/ /gti mug rnam dag nan tan ye shes mchog /gtum po gdug pa kun 'dul ba/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo / /sems can kun gyi srog chen po/ /rang bzhin rnam dag dri ma med/ /kun du bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs su gsol/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /khro zhing brjid pa'i sgur byas te/ /rkang pa hūṃ las rdo rje jebasam/ /mig gnyis nyi zla 'bar ba ste/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yis/ /'jigs spangs byang shar mtshams song la/ /rang gis bstod cing nga rgyal gyis/ /hūṃ dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha tshogs 5bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /nga yi bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'gro bar gyis/ /gal te khyed rnams mi 'gro na/ /ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing / /lus rnams stong du gyur nas ni/ /rnam par 'joms par gdon mi za/ /de 25—/305

bas khyed rnams gzhan du dengs/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sarba bispyon 1uts+tsha ta ya phaṭa/ ces pas bgegs rnams bskrad par bya/ /gar stabs kyis ni bskor ba dang / /dang por phyin la 'di skad brjod/ /gang dag mi 'gro bgegs yod na/ /lus ngag yid kyi nus pa rnams/ /gzhom phyir khro bo'i phur bus gdab/ /shī la 2ya zhes btab nas kyang / / ā ko ṭa yas brdung bar bya / /me ri la sogs sngags kyis bsrung / /gtso bo'i gdon ni gru bzhi ste/ /'khor lo dri chus zlum por bya/ /kha dog mthun pa'i me tog dgram/ /sa yi cho ga rdzogs pa dang / /lha ni lhag par gnas par bya/ /rang sar lha rnams rdzogs pa dang / /mchod bstod me tog spos thogs la/ /hūṃ dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi sras po rdo rje 'chang / /dpa' bo rdo rje bde mas 'khyud/ /'khor gyi khro bo ma lus kun/ /kun nas bdag la dgongs nas kyang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa dang / /slob ma rnams la phan pa'i phyir / /rdo rje can bdag che ge zhes/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs su gsol / /rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /song 4ni dgyes pas byon par mdzod / /gzhan yang gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba ma lus dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed rnams/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chos skyong rnams/ /gang dag rdo rje'i spyan ldan pa/ /rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil 'khor mchog /deng bdag 5'dri bar gyur pa la/ /bdag dang skal ldan slob ma rnams/ /byin gyis brlab phyir bsrung 6bar mdzod/ /bum pa lhag par gnas 'dod pas/ /rin chen 'byung khungs las byung ba/ /dri ma med cing lto ba che/ /mgrin phra mchu 'phyang dri zhim chus/ /dkar zhal byas 25—/306

nas mtshan ma dgod/ /rnam rgyal phyag mtshan rdzogs par bri/ /bskrad 1cing chu dang byang sems dang / / byā gh+ra sing ha 2dbyig pa dang / /ut+pal gzhan gyes mi thub pa/ /ha sa de ba gser dngul dang / /mu tig mu men bye 4ru gzhug /nas 5til gro sran muṅga dang / /ga pur dzā nyi gur gum mchog /tsan+dan gnyis dang a ga ru/ /mar dang bu ram sbrang rtsi dang / /lan tshwa rnams kyis lto ba dgang / /gos kyis mgrin pa bkab pa dang / /tsu 6ta la sogs 'bras bu can/ /yang na me tog yod pas brgyan/ /me tog ldan pa'i ra stegs 7sam/ /ku sha'i gdan la rang sar bzhugs/ /bum pa rgyu las gzhal yas khang / /chu skyes nyi zla'i gdan bcas pa/ /rnam rgyal lha rnams tshogs nga/ra bskyed/ /gzhan du sa bon gang yin pas/ /cho ga ma lus rdzogs par bskyed / /hūṃ khro bo gtum po gdug pa 'dul/ /rang bzhin ye shes lnga yi 11dngos / /rnam dag dri med sku 'chang ba/ /'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo//bde gshegs sgu la gnyis med 'khyud/ /stong pa nyid kyi bde ster ma/ /dmar ljang gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /dpa' mo bde ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs dang phrin las kyi/ /gtso bo khro chen 'jigs pa che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i sgu/ /phyogs kyi khro bo phyag 'tshal lo/ /mar me bdug spos dri chab ma/ /zhal zas kyis ni tshim byed pa/ /mchod pa'i lha mo dgos 'dod 'byung / /mtshams su bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /be+egs kyu zhags pa be+egs sgog ma/ /dgyes pa'i dril bu sgog 1 mdzad ma/ /khro mo dbang phyug chen mo rnams/ /sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstod cing srad bu dang ldan pas/ /phrin las sbyar zhing bzlas par bya/ /gtor mas mchod cing gsol ba btab / /25—1307

—slob ma lhag par gnas pa yang / /bsrung zhing mdzes pa'i me tog thogs/ /khrus byas gtsang ma'i gos ldan zhing / /dga' ba'i sems kyis gsol ba gdab/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems mchog bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug par mdzod/ /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /'od kyis phur byas sdig pa sbyang / /rjes su gzung bas spro ba ni/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /tshul chen snod ni khyod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdo rje mi phyed mthu yis ni/ /mnyam pa gred pa'i ye shes mchog /de bas kun mkhyen thob 'dod pas/ /bu yis blo gros 'di 1gyis shig /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mchod cing / /rtsa ba yan lag nyes pa spongs/ /ma bsgral 1'khor ba'i sems can la/ /snying rje chen po rab bskyed nas/ /bsgral zhing grol ba'i lam la bkod/ /bde bar dbugs ni dbyung bar gyis/ /slob ma'i tshogs kyis sdig bshags la/ /dge bsnyen la sogs rim pas sbyin/ /gang yin bslab pa bstan pa dang / /slob ma lhar byas jeyang na ni/ /gnas gsum lhar bcas rtags btab la/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po dang / /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /'khor bcas ma lus thams cad kyang / /bdag la dgongs nas gzigs su gsol/ /bdag gis thog ma rnged pa nas/ /sdig pa bgyis pa ma lus kun/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /spyan sngar da lta 7mthol zhing bshags/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po 25—1308

dang / /sangs rgyas kun bdag rdo rje can/ /de rigs 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor rnams / /dge ba mdzad la rjes yi rang / /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /gsang sngags bdag pos dbang bskur la/ /gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /mthu ldan skyon med khyed rnams la/ /skye rgas tun 'chi mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa / /mthun 'jug mya ngan mi 'da' gsol/ /don dam rang bzhin mtshan ma med/ /mtshan mar mi rtog chos sku la/ /bde gshegs mtshan dpe'i skur snang 5ba/ /rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /dus gsum mgon po thugs rje can//byams pa'i thugs las ma g.yos kyang / /dgongs rngupa'i dbang gis khro sprul la/ /gsang sngags lha tshogs kun skyabs mchi/ / de sgrub zides mtshon gsung gi chos/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad drag po'i tshogs/ /chos kyi rang bzhin dri ma med/ /chos kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi/ /sna tshogs skur 5sprul don mchog bsgrub/ /rin chen skyabs mchog dge 'dun dang / /'phags pa gos sngon byang chub sems/ /dge 'dun mchog la skyabs su mchi/ /bla ma dus gsum mgon po dang / /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /'khor dang bcas la lus 'bul bas/ /bzhes nas bdag la rjes brtse bas/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol6/ /dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /tshogs gnyis las byung dge ba rnams/ /'khor ba'i sems can ma lus don/ /byang chub chen por bsngo bar bya/ /byang chub tu yang sems bskyed la/ /sngags kyi dam tshig sbyin par bya/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon dze+e du 'gro ba yis/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang / /bcom ldan rdo rje gtum po dang / /dkon mchog gsum dang bstan dga' kun/ /bdag la dgongs 25—1309

nas gzigs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges gnas pa / /tshul khrims rnam gsum sdom pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sbud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims 1rnams/ /so sor bdag gis gzung bar bya/ /bla na rnged pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yin par rgyal bas bsgrags/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang / /skyon bral rdo rje chen po'i rigs/ /thugs rjes 'byel pa'i slob dpon ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya/ /dri ma med pa'i dam tshig chos/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin par bya/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la//phyi nang gsang ba rbeg pa gsum/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya/ /las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig ni/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /sdom pa ma lus thams cad kun/ /de bzhin nyid du so sor gzung 2/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bgyi / /ma bsgral ba ni bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba ni bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs phyung bgyi/ /sems can dngos grub che la dgod/ /dkyil 'khor me tog sngon por 4bcas/ /rdo rje 'chang la dbul bar bya/ /bdud rtsi rnam lnga gtor ma'i tshogs / /rnam pa kun du bsten par bya/ /thabs kyis 5bsgral ba'i dam tshika 25—/3/0

ni / /snying rje las byung bsgral bar bya/ /lan gsum bar du dam bcas pa1/ /rigs kyi lha las 'od 'phros pas/ /rang rang ye shes yig bzhis bstem/ /rdo rje khu tshur dri yi chus/ /mas rim bzhin du brtan par bya/ /de rjes mchod pa spro bar bya/ /a shwat+tha dang pa la sha /u dusmra ra la sogs pa'i/ /sor bcu gnyis sam 4yang na brgyad/ /rtse mo me tog mdzes pas brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor 'dab brgyad rnam lngas byug /shar bltas dbus su sos bzung nas/ /pad+ma'i 5phyag rgyas dor byas te/ /khyod ni dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir/ /zhugs pa'i dngos grub brtag pa'i phyir/ /rnam shes dag pa'i so shing 'di/ / sos bzung nas 6ni dbus su dor/ /bdag dang bla ma steng bltas nas/ /mchog gi dngos grub dam pa yin/ /phyogs su phyin las so so ste/ /mtshams su 'jig rten dngos grub 'byung / /thur bltas sa 'og grub pa yin/ /sa la ma lhung mkha' spyod do/ /bdud rtsi byin brlabs thod par drugs/ /rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje'i chu/ /'thungs shig dam tshig byin gyis brlabs/ /gal te dam tshig 'das pa na/ /dmyal bar nges par sreg par byed/ /oṃ dhīḥ8bi shud+dhā dharmā sarba pā paṃ ni:/ / sho dha ya bi kālbān 7a pa na ya hūṃ 1 hūṃ/ lan gsum skyor chus ngag dag byas/ /lha dang rjes mthun sgud pa la/ /sngags btab g.yas dang phrin las g.yon/ /khro bo gtum po'i byin rlabs 5dang / /gsang sngags nus pa bla na med/ /skal ldan bar chad med par bsrung / /su yang gnod pa ma byed cig /ku sha gtsang ma byin brlabs te/ /bzhin bzangs tshur nyon dkyil 'khor du/ /'jug pa'i rtags rnams brtag pa'i phyir/ /ku sha'i rtswa 'di sngas 5dang stan/ /thub pas ting 'dzin grub ltar shog /ma nor 25—/31 1

seng ge bzhin nyal nas/ /mtshan ma ji ltar byung ba ltar/ /bla ma'i mdun du brjod par bya/ /bzang na dngos grub spro ba bskyed/ /gal te ngan na bskrad dang bsrung / /me yi las kyis bzlog par bya/ /gzhan yang dge ba'i las kun shis/ /bla mas rdo rje can khyod la/ /nang par langs te dkyil 'khor pa/ /nam mkhar bteg la thig gdab ste/ /bu mo gtsang zhing sdom ldan gyes/ /bkal ba ras bal las byung ba/ /ye shes lnga ni gcig bsdus pa'am/ /yang na sku gsung thugs kyang rung / /oṃ a byo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmā spa ra spa 1ra a nu ga ta sarba dharmā t+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭi sarba dharmāḥ— / zhes brjod pas ni ri snabasgril bar bya/ /pad+ma'i snod du bzhag nas kyang / /mi 'chi lnga yis spangs thubyas la/ /blo ldan ye shes bstem byas la/ /nam mkhar ye shes dza dzas 4gdab/ /sgo yi 5bcu gnyis cha dang ldan/ /srid kyang khang pa nyis 7'gyur la/ /tshangs pa'i las thig drang byas nas/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tram̐ mā /ti kra ma hūṃ/ tshangs dang zur thig la sogs pa/ /bstan bcos mthong zhing blo ldan des/ /cha ni gang yin rnam par dbye/ /gal te nyes pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /chad na bla ma'i srog g.yo zhing / /dman 9lhag nad kyis btab par 'gyur/ /phyogs 'khrul slob ma rmongs par 'gyur/ /blo ldan nyes pa rnged par bya/ /gru bzhi sgo dang rta babs bcas/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas brgyan/ /nyi zla dril bu g.yer khas spras/ /pad+ma khyams dang rdo rje'i phreng / /dur khrod me ri la sogs pa/ /rnam pa ma lus rdzogs par bya/ /rin chen rnam lnga 'bru phye 1— dang / /'byung khungs las byung rnam pa lnga/ /pad+mar so sor gzhag byas telo/ /sngags kyis btab pa yig 'bru bsam / /ye shes bstems 4 la yig gsum gyis/ /byin gyis brlabs te 25—/312

mthing ga blangs/ /dbang ldan mtshams su drang bya ste/ /'di ni chos dbyengs dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni sgol byed pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa gnas—/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /de bzhin ljang gu —1drang byas la / /'di ni so sor rtog pa dag /dmar po mnyam nyid ye shes te/ /ser po bya ba grub pa la/ /dkar po me long ye shes dag /me tog dor la mtshan ma brtag /thams cad g.yas skor snyem nor bar/ /sbom phra kyechad pa med par bri//nyes pa 'byung ba'i rim pa ni/ /tshon mi mnyam zhing yo dang dma'④/ /dngos grub nyams par 'gyur ba yin/ /yon pos rtsod la gdung bar 'gyur/ /sbom na nad 'byung gal te phra/ /nor nyams chad par gyur pas na/ /'chi 'gyur phyogs nyams phur bus 'debs/ /shar dkar lho ser nub phyogs dmar/ /byang phyogs in+d+ra m+bi la'i mdog /lte ba mthon mthing 'khyil par bya /mtshams sogs cho gas brtag 1/pa dang / /dur khrod rnams ni rim pas bri/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor lhar bsgrub pa/ /yol bas bcad pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /khrus byas dri yis lus byugs te/ /gos bzang gis brgyan lan gsum bskor/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /nga rgyal byas te hūṃ sgogs pas/ /shar byu sgo nas nang du zhugs/ /sgo bzhi yang ni dbye bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra uṅgha ṭa sa ma yā be sha ya hūṃ/ bum par rang gnas 'dug byas te/ /mchod pa'i rdzas kyis legs brgyan nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams rdzogs par bskyed/ /ye shes bstems 9 la mchod par bya/ /bstod cing glu dang ldan pa yis/ /tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod par bya/ /de nas lhag pa'i lha yang bsdu/ /bzlas pa'i rim pa bzhin du brjod/ /shar du zhi ba'i me las bya/ /de nas shar gyi dbang stegs la7 /25—1313

slob ma'i cho ga ji lta bar/ /slob dpon dbang dang ldan par bya/ /me tog thogs la tshig 'di brjod/ /hūṃ thugs kyi sras po rdo rje 'dzin/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad gtum po yis/ /slob ma smin par bya ba'i phyir/ /bdag la dbang bsgur sbyin par mdzod/ /de ltar rim pa rdzogs pa dang / /de nas slob ma gzhug par bya/ /yol ba'i phyir gnas rim pa bzhin/ /khrus byas sngags 'dis dag par bsam/ /kā ya bāka tsit+ta sarba pā paṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ de nas lhar byas gnas gsum du/ /oṃ badz+ra ban+dha traṭa kā ya bāka tsit+ta/ zhes pas spyig pa dral byas la/ /rang rang yi ge tshobasam par bya/ /bgegs bskrad sdig pa gzhom pa dang / /bla mas rang gi sa bon gyis/ /slob ma'i sdig pa sbyang bar bya/ /oṃ kā ya shudhe sarba dharmā kā ya shusgopho haṃ/ oṃ bāka shudha sarba dharmā 4 bāka shuzlopho5haṃ/ oṃ tsit+ta shudha sarba dharmā tsit+ta shusgo3nihaṃ/ rnam dag lha yi ngo bor bya/ /gdong pa ras kyis bkab nas ni/ /bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo khro bor bcas pa yis/ /lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni skal bzangs 7rigs yin te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod la dga'/ /phrin las ma lus khyod la rdzogs/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par mdzod/ /slob mas yon phul sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ ā 8khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ rang rang gnas su bzhag nas kyang / /bgegs kyi bar chad bsal (bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor la ni bskor byas te/ /shar gyi phyogs nas sgo phye la/ /lha dang sangs rgyas rnams bskul te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs tekyis/ /bdud bzhi rnam par dag bcom nas/ /sngags 'dis phyag gsum brkyang la bya/ /25—131(

oṃ na ma ste 1hūṃ/ oṃ na ma mi hūṃ/ na mo na ma hūṃ swā hā/ de nas thal sbyar shar phyogs nas oṃ tre lokya bi dza ya/ pū dzo pas+thā ri nā ya/ āt+pa rmā nit+yā 4ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta akhro bh+ya/ a p+ta ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha 3swa me/ mi bskyod thubargya byin steng du gsal/ /oṃ ma hā kā la pū dzo pas+thā 7nā ya/ āt+pa ā+oṃ nit+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na saṃ bha ba/ a dzha ṣiñtsa a bye tiṣ+ṭha swa oṃ/ lho yi phyogs nas phyag byas te/ /dpral 9bar sku ni khyab 'jug mnan/ /nub nas gsung gi dbang phyug gzhom/ /i a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ pū dzo pas+thā / 7nā ya/āt+pa rmā nit+yā 11ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma dha ri/ a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha zheswa saṃ / oṃ ār+ya dze+e bha la pū dzo pas+thā kinā ya/ āt+pa r+ghaṃ nit+yā —ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha sibyeje/ a bhi ṣiñtsa a bye tiṣ+ṭha wīswa baṃ/ nub byang rim pas phyag bya'o/ /las kyi bum pas khrus byas te/ /sdom pa ma lus pa yang sbyin/ /byin gyis brlab —phyir ye shes kyang / /bla ma la ni gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag la byen gyis brlab 18mdzod la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bla na med/ /bdag la da lta bskyed du gsol/ /sdig bral spos kyis bdug byas nas/ /'gying bcas rdo rje dril 'dzin pas/ /sangs rgyas ma lus lhag pa'i lhar/ /bsnyus la gnyis med bde ba che/ /zag med bde bas yan lag khyab/ /hūṃ 'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje gtum po sems dpa' che/ /ye shes rdo rje bla med 'di/ /da lta nyid du 'bab par shog /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ ā be+e sha ya ste bhā ya/ sna rā rā rā rā/ tsa lā ya/a hūṃ ma hā sgo ༄ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ā — be sha ya/ a a a a a/ zhes bzlas gang la babs gyur kyang / oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ a byespyo te sa ma ya / /25—1315

sngags kyis brtan byas lce la a/ /dge mi dge yi lung bstan bya/ /me tog rdo rje dang bcas pa/ /spyi bor bzhag la 'di skad brjod/ /hūṃ rdo rje gtum po deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs pa ni/ /gal te tshul 'di gzhan smras na/ /de ma thag tu dral 1te gshegs/ /bdud rtsi lngas bkang ka — byepā lar/ /sngags btab rdo rje dang bcas sbyin/ /hūṃ 'di ni khyod kyi rdo rje'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub rnams/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ badzod ka ṭha byehūṃ/ shar du 'dug la snye 'di skad brjod/ /de 6nas brtsams te khyed rnams kyiṣ+pe/ /rdo rje gtum po nga yin gyi/ /khyed kyis nga la brnyas pa na/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas/ /dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ /phyogs bzhi nas ni dngos grub brtag /mdzes pa'i me tog lha la dor/ /gsang ba bla med me tog 'di/ /pho brang dkyil 'khor lha mchog la/ /las dang rjes mthun brtse ba yis/ /rigs dang mthun par 'bab par shog /pra tīts+tsha thuho badz+ra/ lha yi stod kyedang rked pa dang / /smad dang nye ring gtso 'khor gyi/ /bye brag dngos grub rtags ⑩yin no/ /de nas bla mas me tog blangs/ /slob ma'i mgor bcings sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ dharma kuṇ+ḍa 1 a bhe ṣiñtsa/ lha bstem rigs kyi ming yang gzung / /sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /ma rig ling tog bsal thub ltar/ /de bzhin khyod kyi mig dbye ste/ /ye shes mig gis she rtamathong bar shog /badz+ra tsak+ṣu pa 5tra lo hri—/ gdong g.yogs bshus la 'di skad brjod/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /mthong na dad pa rab tu skye/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su gyur / /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te/ /dngos grub ma lus snod du 25—1316

'gyur / /rigs kyi rnam par dag pa bstan/ /de nas slob ma dad ldan pas//bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ /yon mchog bla med phul nas kyang / /dbang bskur ba yi gsol ba gdab/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod cing gsol mdzad pa/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab 2pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag sprul thu/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni slob dpon mchog bgyid do/ /lan gsum brjod nas shar phyogs su/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad khri la 'dug /rnam rgyal bum pa la sogs pas/ /chu rnams thod pa'am bum par bsdus/ /rdo rje'i glu dang dril bur ldan/ /rigs lnga rig pa'i lha mor ldan/ /bag chags ma lus dag byas te/ /sku gsum dam tshig las byung ba'i/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /lha yi bdud rtsi rnam dag 'dis/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ā dar+sha dz+nyā na a rnyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ chu yi dbang bskur dam pa 'dis/ /sgrib pa rnam pa gsum bral nas/ /mi bskyod rnam dag ye shes 'thob/ /mi bskyod rdo rje dngos grub shog /lugs ma'am thang ga 'bur bris pa'i/ /gser sogs dbu rgyan 4rin 'byung bsam/ /dbu rgyan byerin chen dam pa 'dis/ /sems can tshim par byed pa'i mchog /yid bzhin bsam pa 'grub byed pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mad+dhā 6dz+nyā na hūṃ tiṣ+ṭha a rnyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ dbu rgyan dbang bskur dam pa 'dis/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas bde bar gshegs/ /bdag gi mgo la brgyan 3gyur te/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dngos grub shog /rin chen la sogs rdo rje la/ /snang ba mtha' yas bcug byas la/ /lag tu gtad la tshig 'di brjod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /mi phyed rnam dag 'od gsal stong / /dam chos 25—1317

'byung ba'i sgor gyur pa/ /rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra pra nyi be sha ya ri1dz+nyā na a bhe ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur dam pa 'dis/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bdag gi rgyud la kyeskyed gyur te/ /snang ba mtha' yas dngos grub shog /dril bur don yod grub pa bcug /lag pa g.yon gtad tshig 'di brjod/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yis/ /'gro don mnyam pa med byed pa/ /'dod pa'i phrin las rdzogs byed cing / /dril bu las kyi dbang bskur ro༄ —/ /oṃ a dhiṣ+ṭha na a nuṣ+ṭha na sirnyi dz+nyā na nga.a dzha ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ dril bu'i dbang bskur dam pa 'dis/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /gsung gi dngos grub bdag gyur te/ /don yod grub pa'i dngos grub shog /rnam snang bskyed la mtshog 5ma'i steng / /'khor lo thogs pa'i ming sgogs te/ /rdo rje ming gi dbang bsgur bas/ /byang chub thob pa'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang gzhom par mi nus pas/ /rdo rje'i treming du rab tu grags/ /oṃ pra ti sho dha dharma dh+wa 7tu dz+nyā na nā ma a bhi ṣidzi pemi hūṃ/ ming gi dbang bskur dam pa 'dis//stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya ru/ /sprul pas 'gro rnams chos ston cing / /rnam par snang mdzad dngos grub shog /rigs lnga yum gyis ma rig lnga/ /rnam dag ye shes lnga spyor bas/ /rig pa'i dbang du rgyud pas bstan/ /shar du seng ge'i khri la 'dug /steng du gdugs dkar phub 1— nas kyang / /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur te/ /slob dpon rang bzhin 'od dpag mchog /skal ba chen po bdag la gsol/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi dbang bsgur ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas dpag med do/ /brtul rtazhugs bla na med pa de/ /ji ltar 'dul bzhin bdag la gsol/ /de 25—1318

nas rnam rgyal bum pa blangs/ / steng 'og gyobazhag la tshig 'dis sbyin/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas kun kyis byin pa yis2sna/ /phrin las thogs pa med pa rnams/ /bu yis gzhan don bla med byos/ /khyod ni rdo rje slob dpon yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sras yin no/ /zhes bya dung dang rol mo dbul/ /lung bstan bya phyir bla ma yis/ /sprul pa'i sgur bcas dga' dang bcas/ /chos gos bzung la 'di skad brjod/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa'i mtha' ni grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro nyid las bton/ /kye rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa che ge mo bye zhes/ sirnyi badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa te 4thā ga ta 3sa ma ya ste 6bhur bhu ba swaḥdza/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ma lus pas/ /khyod la lung bstan byas pa 'di / /gsang sngags rdo rje'i mthu yin pas/ /dad pas 'di la spro bar gyis/ /de nas rdo rje brtul zhugs sbyin/ /rdo rje lag tu legs byin la/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na bsnams/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya 9 tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa ste rkudha ra ya mi hi hi hūṃ/ de nas dril bu sbyin byas te/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyisakye—/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro ba/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sedhe ghaṇ+ḍa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa hūṃ dha ra ya 1 mi hi hi hūṃ/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /mi shes rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi yang mi shes pa'i/ /ma rig ling thog ⑩bsal bar bya/ /sman ldan gser gyi thur ma yis/ /ye shes dag par 25—1319

mig 'byed do/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe hūṃtra a pa ha ra pa tra lo thu/thi/ de nas me long g.ya' dag bstan/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu stezu/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /brjod du med cing gzung du med/ /rgyu dang las las thams cad 'byung / /de nas rdo rje me long phyar/ /rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la gnas/ /zhes bya ho yis mda' gzhu sbyin/ /bskyod la phyogs bzhir bdud la 'phangs④ / /de nas hūṃ las skyes pa yiphya / /'khor lo rkang pa'i bar bcug la/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /skyob pa rnams kyis 6/'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ /kun du dri med 3sdig dang bral/ /de nas dung byin bus nas kyang / /chos kyi dung ni bla na med/ /som nyi trīyid gnyis mi bya zhing / /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa'i tshul gyi mchog /'jig rten 'dir ni rab tu sgrogs/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan btags drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di kun kyang / /khyod la thurjes su srung ⑫bar byed/ /de nas rigs lngar bsam byas la/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /sems can ma lus drang ba'i phyir/ /chags pa med pa'i bsam pa yis/ /ji ltar gdul bya sna tshogs pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyisatso/ /de bzhin rigs kyis gang 'dul ba/ /khyod kyi phrin las mchog yin no/ /de nas slar yang rdo rje 'dzin / /gsal bar byas te tshig 'di brjod/ /deng skrunas bzung nas rigs kyi bus/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang gsad popa dang / /dgug dang bcing dang bsreg —pa dang / /bskrad dang g.yo sab la sogs pa'i/ /phrin las sna 25—1320

tshogs bsgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil 17lham de bzhin ri lu ste/ /thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /de dag khyod kyis bsgrub par gyis/ /ma lus gnang ba sbyin par bya/ /bde bar dbugs dbyung rnams kyang sbyin/ /khyad par bkra shis dbang rnams kyang 1/ /rim pa bzhin du sgogs par bya/ /gal te gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba/ /bzhin bzangs mig yangs lang tshor ldan/ /lus la dri yis byugs byas te/ /rtse ④dang dgod pas g.yo byas la/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis phab ste/ /nor bu byang chub sems be+eng pebs/ /bde gshegs khya ba mtheb srin gyis/ /drir 6bcas slob ma'i kha ru dbab)/ /a ho su khas de 8btung ngo / /rdo rje ro tsu yis nyon mongs 'joms / /mtshan ldan bde ba bskyed pa de/ /yol bas bar bcad stoms 'jug brtsam/ /bsrub dang srubs tipa'i spyor ba yis/ /sgra yi rgyun med longs spyod kyi/ /rlabs 1kyi rgyun ni chad pa las/ /lhan cig skyes pa ye shes kyang / /rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dran par bya/ /skad cig de dang ma bral na/ /mi rtog 1— /ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /de nyid brjod du med pa la/ /brjod me+ed tshig gi dbang du bshad/ /gal te de la mi rtog pas/ /bzhi pa dbang du rgyud du bstan / /dkyil 'khor rnam lnga'i dbang bskur nas/ /tshogs dang mchod pa rgya chen bya/ /slob ma dad ldan mchog des kyang / /rta dang glang po ma he dang / /bu dang chung ma srog dang dbyig /ci yod phyag byas ma zhen pas/ /bla ma mnyes phyir dbul bar bya/ /bla mas slob ma dam pa'i mgor/ /bkra shis brjod cing gdugs phub r+ṣapas/ /slob ma mchod pa rdzas thogs nas/ /drin len 5dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor/ /smon lam gdab cing dge ba bsngo/ /25—1321

tho rangs tshon bsdus bum par drugs7/ /chu'am ri'am nags phug sba/ /dri bzangs kyis ni thig phyis la/ /sa der zhi ba'i me las bya/ /yang na phongs pa tshim pa dang / / tsi te'i las la brtson par bya/ /ji ltar rgyud las gsal gyur cing / /bla ma'i man ngag thob gyur kyang / /cung zad spros phyir bdag nyid spro bar byas/ /'on kyang nyes tshogs ci mchis bshags par bya bzang po mdor bsdus cho ga mchog /gzhan phyir bkod pa'i dge ba yis/ /rigs drug gtum po'i lam zhugs nas/ /myur du de yi 'bras thob shog /rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzang po mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba bzang po dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba glan chung dar ma tshul khyems kyis bsgyur ba'o// //

༄khya/ /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngen po can zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rnam par bshad pa/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ nī dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā naṇi ār+ya nā ma tan+t+ra ṭī kā/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rnam par bshad pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden pa gnyis la rab gnas shing / /thabs dang shes rab zung 'byel pa'i/ /mgon po sgrib pa kun spangs yon tan ma bros kun gyi bdag po de/ /shes rab thabs kyis mya ngan mtha' spangs nas/ /snying rje chen pos sems can mun 'thibs pa/ /mun ma mthong sgom rtsa ba nyon mongs zhi mdzad pa/ /gsang sngags snyud mdzad mi g.yo bcom ldan 'das/ /thugs rje bsnyel ba dred la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis gsal bar byas pa de rnams byas pa ma yin tshig don skyon dang ldan/ /de nas 4'dir ni gsang ba don las dga' ba skyes/ /tshig gi skyon bral man ngag nyams dang ldan/ /shākya'i rigs 25—/326

kyi man ngag don ldan rgyas par bstan pa las/ /shes rab dmigs ma phyed pas bshad zin bstan pa dag /de dag sman 'gyur ri1 'dir ni gsal bar byas/ /des ni nyi zla dag dang mthun pa'i dam chos 5'di/ /thugs rje nye bar bsdos pa yis/ /snying rje ldan pa'i sems kyis su/ /rtsa rgyud 4man ngag bshad par bya/ /rtsa rgyud 5rang bzhin don rnams la/ /sde tshan lnga lnga nyi shu lnga/ /ya 6sha mtha' bcas rtsa ba ldan/ /thabs dang shes rab yi ge gnyis ldan gsum du 'dus/ /brjod bya 7rtogs byed tshig gi don/ /rtsa ba bshad dang tshig gi don phyir ma/ /phyi ma mchog dang ma log bzhi ru ston/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ /'og min chos dbyings pho brang du/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po ni 'dir sangs rgyas/ /ma lus pa yi stobs kyis su/ /sku de rnam pa gsum gyi don/ /thob byed rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi lam/ /dngos byed 'bras bu'i lam yin te/ /rgyu ni tshig de 9dran sogs pa'i/ /phyir 1 zhing dro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /nyon mongs ma skyatshig zhi rtse mo'o/ /phyir mi ldog dang 'jig rten mthar stobs lnga/ /dbang po lnga yi rang bzhin no/ /byang chub yan lag bdun po ni/ /mthong lam skad cig bcu drug go/ /sa dang bsgom lam mthar phyin 'bras bu'o/ /dngos byed lam ni 'bras bu sngags/ /byen gyis brlabs pas 1 sngags mthu yon tan no/ /lam ma bgrod pas 'bras bu med/ /dper na gru gzings thubaskyod pa yis/ /rin chen mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /brjod bya ston pa'i tshig gis kyang / /'bras bu bden pa myur du 'byin/ /des na sngags ni gsang sngags lam/ /lam ma bgrod par gsal byed 'gyur/ /des na brjod bya'i rnyikhyad kyi nus pa yin no/ /'di skad la sogs pa bshad pa mdzes 25—/327

par 1bya ba'i phyir/ rgyud 'di par brjod bya 2dang / dgos pa dang /'byel pa dang / mchog gi dgos pa bstan par bya ste/ brjod bya dngos po gred pa'i tshig ni bstan kyang rtogs pa sngon du gtong ba rnams 'jug par mi 'gyur te/ dung la dkar po spyi ni 'jug gi 7bye brag la 'khrul pa bzhin no/ /des na skyon yod pa'i phyir chos kyi 4rjes su 'brang ba rnams mi 'jug go/ /des na byis pa dang smyon pa dang mchog yin zhing gzhan la sogs pa ni dgos pa gred snyam pa'am/ 'di nyid kyi ma yin snyam pas mi 'jug ste/ tshig dang don thams cad kyi 'byel pa dang / brjod bya dang / dgos pa dang / dgos pa'i 5yang dgos pa rnams gtan la phab pa sngon du byas nas mchod pas na/'di nyid 'byel pa la sogs pa yang brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin du 'byel pa dang brjod pa bshad par cis te mi bya/ sbyon pa'i tshig bzhin du mi 'byel pa'am / mo gsham 6la sogs pa la don med par 'dod pa'i zhen pas tshig chad par 'gyur bas ma ning gi gzugs la zhen pa'i 'dod pa rnams ci nas kyang tshig chad par 'gyur zhes brtags nas 'jug par mi 'gyur ba nyid do/ /de bas na 'jug pa'i yan lag gi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir te/ thog ma nyid du dgos pa brjod par bya'o/ /de gang las shes par bya ba'i phyir/ dgos pa dang 'byel pa brjod par bya ba yang bstan to/ /de nas dgos pa'i dgos pa la sogs pa bstan to/ /brjod bya ji lta bu snyam pa la/ 'di ltar lam dang 'bras bu brjod bya'i 'bras bur rtog ces bya'o/ /brjod bya ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes so/ /de yang sgras drangs nas blo la dngos su snang bas dngos kyi brjod bya zhes pa 7nas snang ba zhen pa'i brjod byas/ sgra drangs pa'i tshig gi 25—/328

don 'dis brjod bya rtogs pas brjod bya mtshon par byed pa'i tshig la yang brjod bya 'di'i don zhes 'byel par bya ste/ 'di ltar lam la brten 1snapas 'bras bu thob ste/ de ni de dang 'gal ba'i chos spong bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te de ltar yin du zad mod/ de nyid bstan pa ci phyir snyam nas des na 'dir sgra'i tshogs la ma brten 2par nam yang rtogs pa mi 'byung ngo / /ci'i phyir gal te byung na ni thams cad gzhung gi tshogs la sogs pa la mi ltos par 'gyur na ni don med do/ /gal te yod na thams cad skye ba'am/ rkyen med pa rtogs pa thar par gyur pa las/ rgyu rnged 'bras bu skye bar rigs pa med do / /nam mkha'i me tog bzhin no/ /des na rgyu la rang bzhin du bye brag gyur pa med 5pa las 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi ma ltar 6na yang 'ba' zhig pa rnams la ni 'ba' zhig rang las gzhan nus pa'i phyir mi 'byung ngo / /'bras bu yan lag rgyu la ma tshang bar byung na ni/ dus thams cad du 'bras bu 'byung ste/ de ni med pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na gzhung gi tshogs med na brjod bya'i rtogs pa mi 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du gzhung thabs yin pa dang gzhung yang brjod bya'i don rtogs pa thabs dang thabs las 'byung ba'i 'byel pa'o/ /de bas na gzhung gi tshogs 'di brjod bya shugs kyis 7rtogs bya yin la/ dgos pa ni thabs las 'byung ba yin la/ nyid kyis 'byel te de dag 8rang nyid kyis 9'byel pa'o/ /de'i phyir gzhung bstan pas blang 7dor ni dgos pa yin no/ /des cir 'gyur zhe na/ rang gi don phun sum tshogs par 'gyur te/ lam gyi rim pas tshogs lam dang drod la sogs par 1'byung ngo / /tshu rol gyi ye shes dang mthong sgom la sogs pas 'byel zhes te de ni mthar phyin pa yang bzung ste/ rigs kyi bu 25—1329

rnams dgos pa'o / /1de ni me dang du ba bzhin du de dang de las 'byung ba'i 'byel pa ste/ thabs dang thabs las 'byung ba'i tshul gyis 'byel pa'o/ /des na nyon mongs pa dang shes bya rtsa nas byang ba ni rang don no/ /'byel pa la yang de nyid do/ /sa bon dang bcas pa ston pa ni rang don phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /des na dgos pa'i dgos pa yang / /gzhan la brten gzhan mu stegs dang / /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / phyag rgya chen pos gzhan mthar phyin pa la sogs pa ni/ dgos pa'i dgos pa'o/ /des na chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams la ni/ rgyud 'di brjod bya'i 'byel pa dang / dgos pa'i dgos pa bstan to/ /de nas brjod bya dang 'byel pa dang /dgos pa dang 'bras bu dgos pa'i dgos pa la sogs pa bzhi nges par bstan to//gang zag dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams ni/ srid pa'i mtsho nges par bzung nas / sangs rgyas kyi bka' nges par 'jug pa'i phyir bstan mi dgos so/ /de ltar brjod bya dang dgos pa brjod nas/ yan lag bstan pa ni gzhung don to4 / /de la 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes pa la sogs pa smos te/ snyud pa po'i tshig tu smos te/ 'di skad smras pa thos zhes sbyar ro/ /'di'i tshe 'dis 5thos/ gzhan gyi tshe gzhan gyis thos par bstan to/ /thos pa ni bdag kho nas thos te/ gzhan dang 'byel pa med de/ de ni gzhan thos pa'o//'di ni ri rab rtse rtsa rgyud nyi khri sum stong kha nas thos pa'o/ /des ni thos par dka' ba dang / thos pa mang ba la sogs pa yang yongs su bzung ngo / /gzhan ni bā rā ṇa sīr 7bden pa bzhi la sogs pa ste/ gzhan nye ba 8'khor dang / shā ri'i bu la sogs pa'i blogatso 'khor tha dad pa'i phyir ro/ /'di skad 25—1330

bdag gis thos ni rgyal ba mar me mdzad dang / shākya thub pa dang / gtso bo rdo rje 'chang dang / rnam rgyal la sogs pas las 1thos pa ste sngon dang da lta la sogs pa dang 2/ bar du yang thos pa ste/ gtso bo dang /'khor tha mi dad par bstan to/ /tha mi dad na rang gi tshig dang 'gal lo/ /gcig pa yin pa'i phyir snyam pa la/ gcig kyang mi sto 4ste/ kun rdzob tu snang ba thams cad kyang 'khrul pa mi bden pa sgyu ma yin pas don ni stong pa nyid kho na'o zhes rgyud las gsungs pa yin no/ /tha dad kyang mi 'gal te 5bde bar gshegs pa la skyon gnyis med de/ thams cad zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa khams dang skye mched bral bas dus thams cad bdag dang bdag gis stong pa nyid du 6med/zla ba dang chu bzhin no/ /de bas khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba ni/ phyag na rdo rje nyid dang 7rang bzhin gcig pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gdul bya ni/ snang bas snang zhes bstan te me long rkyen gyes gzugs rang las 9gnyis su snang ba'o/ /de bzhin du sems bskyed pa'i smon lam dang snying rje chen pos sems can gzhug pa'i ched du ston pa dang / 'khor dang ldan pa dang lam dang dri za'i gzugs dang / phung po dang skye mched bcu gnyis dang / khams dang rnam par byang ba'i 'bras bu dang / nyon mongs pa dang /mang du bstan pa rnams ni/ sems can gzhug pa'i ched yin pas thos zhes bya/gzhan nas theg pa bstan pa sems can gzhug pa'i ched du lags/ jeg pa mred cing 'bras bu med/ /ces gsungs so/ /des na phyag na rdo rje la khams gsum rnam par rgyal bas 1thos pa ste/ gtso 'khor tha mi dad par bstan to/ /gcig pa'i phyir thos pa dang 'gal snyam pa la/ mi 'gal te/ bcom ldan 25—1331

'das rdo rje 'chang phyag na rdo rjer snang la/ de yang khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba ru snang ngo / /'o na de dngos su snang ngam mi snang ba yin/ sprul pa yin nam ma sprul pa yin/ snang zhing sprul pa yin na sangs rgyas ma yin te/ dngos po tha dad du snang zhing shes pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das ni log pa'i shes pa dang ste/ sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang khyad rkamed do/ /de'i phyir de ni sangs rgyas su blta bar mi bya'o/ /sprul pa ma yin na snang bar mi rigs so/ /ci'i phyir/ rgyu med 'bras bu snang ba'i phyir/ /ri bong rwa sogs snang bar rigs/ /zhes 4bya'o/ /bden te log pa'i shes pa dang ldan na de gnyis 'byung gi/ de med pa'i phyir de mi 'byung ngo / /dngos su sprul yang mi sto 5'dul ba'i dus la bab pa'i phyir/ de'i rang bzhin der snang ba'o/ /ma sprul yang rang nyid de'i tshe des 'dul 6la rnam par rgyal bar snang ba'o/ /de nas bka' la bar med pa'i phyir rang gis thos pa dang yang sdud pa pos thos zhes bya'o/ /'dir sems can gdul byas ma rtogs 3par ston pa dang snyud pa po tha dad du bya ba med do/ /smon lam dang thugs rje dpag tu med pa'i 'gro don 'byung ba'i phyir thos zhes sbyar ro/ /des na skyon de gnyis mi 'byung ste/ de ni skyon thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /dus kyang de ste de'i tshe 9 thos/ gzhan gyi tshe gzhan thos pa ste dus kyang de'i tshe zhes bstan to/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa ni e waṃ mā ya 1 zhes 'byung bas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'byung ba lnga rigs 11dang ye shes lnga dang sgra dang skye mched dang /khams bco brgyad dang / g.yo ba dang / mi g.yo ba dang / rtsa lnga dang dbang dang dga' ba la sogs pa la shes par bya'o/ /de dag bstan pa'i yan 25—/332

lag ni/ /phyi nang mthar thug rnam pa gsum/ /ci bzhin min dang ji bzhin sgra//dgongs pas bshad dang dgongs pa min/ /drang ba'i don dang nges pa'i don/ /phyi ni mi bzad dbyings dang sbyar/ /nang ni rtsa rlung byang chub sems/ /rtsa lnga gtum mo'i 1man ngag go/ /mthar thug mthong lam ye shes te/ /dpe ye shes gnyis med phyag rgya chen po'i lam bcu gnyis ni dngos po bral ba des na bral ba'i shes pa'o/ /gzhan yang phung po lnga dang / tshogs drug dang / skye mched bcu gnyis dang / khams dang / bag chags rnams son/ /de ni/ brda min skye bo thal ba'i tshig /dgos pa ma yin zhes su bya/ /shu kra su tra ma nu ha ra dang / /tan+t+ra yan+t+ra man+t+ra'o/ /byang sems kyis 4sems can phal pa rnams thugs rje zag bcas thams cad skyob pa'o/ /sngags dang shes pa ma lus yongs su 'dzin rgyud ni/ /'khor ba brgyud 5de chos nyid byang chub sems/ /'di yang gnas pa ma lus stong pas 'dzin par byed/ /lung las 'di lta ste/ ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur bas/ /sems can ma lus gsad 6par bya/ /ma byin len dang brdzun smra dang / /de lta de ltar sems can don/ /'dod chags la sogs spang bas spyad/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyu yi phyir/ /sems can thams cad bsad na 7yang / /de la sdig pas 8mi gos so/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /sangs rgyas kun la spyor ba yis/ /gzhan gyi nor rnams phrog na yang / /de la sdig pas 9mi gos so/ /'dod chags lta bu'i —bde ba med/ /de ni rgyal ba rnams la phul/ /sems can don du gzhan bud med/ /bsten 1rtapas bsod nams thob par 'gyur/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyu yi phyir/ /mi dge bcu 25—1333

sogs spyad pa yang / /bsod nams rnam 1mang 'phel zhes gsungs/ /stoms par 'jug pa nas bzung ba/ /pha dang ma ni gsad par bya/ /rgyal po ngan pa bkur mi bya/ /bram ze'i grong khyer gzhom par bya/ /des kyang grong 1bar gsungs pa ste/ /dgos 4pa bshad pa zhes ni bya/ /drang ba'i don ni theg pa gsum dang dgu 5ru bstan pa'o/ /yod pas nyan thos rang rgyal rnams ni smos/ /phra rab rdzas su 'dod pa nyan thos rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ni byis pa'i rang bzhin no/ /rnged par zhen cing chags par 'dod pa'i byes pa ste/ /jeg pa dman pa log pa'i shes pa ste/ /de kho 6de la de yi jeg bstan pa7/ /zhes rgyud las gsungs so/ /yang dag don dang ldan gyur pa/ /stong nyid rang bzhin lhug pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dngos/ /blang dor med pa thar pa'i lam/ /lung las kyang / byang chub sems dpa' 8chen po sbyin pa ni bcing ba'o/ /tshul khrims nas ye shes kyi bar du ni bcing ba'o/ /bde ba dang / stong pa dang / rig pa dang / bdag med pa ni bcing ba'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na bdag thams cad bral ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas bral ba'i chos la yang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo bslab par mi bya'o/ /des na mu stegs pa 9la sogs pa'i bdag lta dang / byis pa rnams kyi yod pa'i shes pa rnams ni gzhom pa be+e'o/ /bdag med dang / rig stong la sogs pa phyogs bral gyi bdag rnams ni gzhom par 1 dka' ba yin pa'i phyir 'khor ba las mi thar ba bstan to/ /des na 'dod pa lam du byas pa'i bcing ba'o/ /bya ba med pa thob pa med pa ni nges pa'i don zhes bya'o/ /de skad gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ /de ni dus phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /gnod sbyin thams cad yongs su rgyu/ /shin 25—/33

tu dben pa shin tu yongs dag pa/ /zhes pas gnas phun sum tshogs pa bstan pa yin te/ gnod sbyin thams cad yongs su rgyu ba ni ri rab 1rtse mo ste/ de na ni gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po dang / nor bu bzang po dang lngas 2rtsen la sogs pa ste/ gnod sbyin gos sngon can kyi 'khor du bstan te/ de na ni gnod sbyin ma rungs pa gzhan yang yod pa ste/ de rnams yod pa ni gnod sbyin thams cad yongs su rgyu ba zhes bya'o/ /shin tu dben pa ni stug po bkod pa'i gnas te/ 'di yang dpe shel gsal ba'i nang du chud pa'i dkyil 'khor 1 gsal ba ni/ gzhal yas khang 'dug pa ni ma lus pa'i lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyan dang ldan 4zhes bya'o/ /de na ye shes chen po ston pa bzhugs te/ 'khor dang chos la sogs pa gcig tu bzhugs te me dang tsha ba bzhin no/ /rang bzhin gcig par shes par bya'o/ /des na gnas 5gsum mo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can zhes bya ba/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis las kyi khro bo'i 6dbang bskur ba zhes bya bar gnas gsum du ston pa gsum tha mi dad par bstan to/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje zhes bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin ma rungs pa de rnams kyi gtso bo sprul sku lag na rdo rjes 'dul bar bstan to/ /de la ni sbrul gye rgyan ni/nyid las tha mi dad pa'i 'khor gye 7gnod sbyin rnams ston pa'i gzi brjid kyis/ nye ba'i 4'khor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sprul pa'i sbrul gyi rgyan btab 9ces bya bar bstan to/ /stag gi sham thabs dang gos sngon po bla gos rnams ni/gnod sbyin byed pa'i stobs kyis skyabs kyi 'od la phul zhes bya'o/ /dus gsum bde gshegs zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje sa bcu la 25—1335

——gnas pa'i tshe/ pad+ma stong dang ldan pa'i dbus su bzhag ste/ dus gsum 1sangs rgyas thams cad kyi /thugs kyi stong pa nyid kyi rdo rje phyung nas phyag na rdo rje —thugs kyi bdag por sdud pa por dbang bskur zhing bka' gnang nas/ las thams cad bting 4phan chad kyis zhes pa'o/ /mche ba gdags pa/ yid khros pa lta bu/ mig me mdag gi phung po 'dra ba/ dbugs me ltar 'bar ba/'jigs pa'i nga ro can zhes pa ltal mche ba gcigs pas 6ni log par rtog pa'i bdud rnams za zhing 'joms pa'o/ /yid khros pas ni don snying rje chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ kun rdzob tu khro bo'i cha byad do/ /mig me mdag gi phung po ni/las gnyis la 'jug /rang smin pa'i las dang bltas pa tsam gyis 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /dbugs me lce ltar 'bar ba ni/ smin ma dang sgra tsam gyis 'dul bar bstan to/ /'jigs pa'i nga ro ni ngag gi skyon bzhi dang bral zhing yid kyi zug rngu 'don zhing / hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pas 'khor rnams skrag / pa'o / /lag pa dang rkang pa klu nor rgyas kyis brgyan pa/ klu nag po se ral khar thogs pa/ klu nag po dang nye dga' bos snyan cha brgyan pa zhes pa ni/lag pa la 1 sbrul nag po dang ser pos brgyan par shes par bya'o/ /rkang pa la sprul nag pos brgyan pa'i ska rags dmar po kibyas pa'o/ /se ral kha ni klu khengs po'i rigs kyis ga 2shar byas pa'o/ /klu dga' bo dang nye 7dga' bo'i ming yin la/ de dang 'dra ba'i sbrul dkar pos snyan cha brgyan par bstan to/ /sbrul 'bar ba rin po che'i cod pan thogs pa/ sbrul gdug slopa 'bar ba za zhes pa la/ sbrul 'bar ba rin po che'i cod pan thogs pa ni/ dbu la nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /'bar ba ni nag po la sogs pa'i kha dog 25—/336

—bzhin1 / sbrul rin po che dang ldan pas dbu la brgyan par bstan to/ /gdug pa za ba ni zhal du sbrul nag po gsol bar bstan to/ /des kyang gtso bo 2'dod chags rnam par dag pa dang / tshul khrims nyams pa'i skyon dang bral zhing / phyi rol gyi klu'i rigs drug 'dul ba'i rtags su bstan/ bzhin rgyas pa/ smin ma dpral bar basbus pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ gshin rje'i cha byad can zhes bya ba 4ni/ bzhin rgyas pa 5ni stong pa nyid kyi don rgyas pas 6gdong gi 'phel ba ste/ lha la sogs pa gdul bya 'dul bar bstan to/ /ya sos ma mchu mnan pa ni/ ya sos ma mchu'i steng du phyin pa ste/ bye brag tu srin po 'dul ba'i rtags so/ /smin ma dpral bar bsdus pa ni/ khro gnyer gsum dpral bar 'dug pa sgu gsum dang ldan pa'i rtags/ gshin rje'i cha byad can ni khro bo mi'u thung gi gzugs 'dra ba'o/ /des ni gshin rje'i rigs 'dul ba'o/ /lce glog 9ltar 'gyu ba/ sbrul za ba/ gsus pa che ba/ lag pa brdabs pa'i sgras 'jigs par byed pa zhes bya ba ni/ lce glog ltar 'gyu ba ni / sprul pa glog pas myur ba'o/ /sbrul za ba ni sbrul klu'i nad ngan 'dra bas 'dod chags kyi gdung ba sel ba'o/ /gsus pa che ba ni gsus khyem che ba ste / stong pa nyid kyang bstan to/ /lag pa brdabs pa ni gtso bo lag pa rdo rje dang ldan pas ma rungs pa 5'jigs par byed pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po 'dab bzangs ska rags su bcings pa/ a la la zhes sgrogs sapar byed pa zhes pa la/'dab bzangs ni sbrul dmar po'i ska rags su bcings pa/ a la la ni de 'dra'i 7rgyan cha la ngo mtshar ba'o/ /de sgrogs pa ni sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /rgya mtsho'i zabs su dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong yod pa rkang pa'i pus mor phyin pa/25—/337

dbang po dang nyi ma phrag tshohūṃpa la khur zhes pa la/ rgya mtsho la dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pas phyag na rdo rje'i pus mo nub pa/ sku byin po la nyis 'bum drug khri yod pa zhes pa ste/ sprul pa'i sku'i bong tshad bstan to/ /dbang po dang nyi ma ni thabs shes rab kyi ste/ nang gtso bo bzhugs zhes pa la/ yang na gtso bo'i phrag pa la nyi zla rgyu ba ste zhes pa'i tshad do/ /la la na re lha'i dbang po'i phrag pa la nyi zla rgyu ste/ de'i steng na phyag na rdo rje bzhugs zhes pa ste/ lha 'dul ba'o//klu thams cad rlag par byed pa/ gad rgyangs chen po dgod pas kun du 'khrugs 1par byed pa zhes pa la/ klu'i rigs kyi bdag po chol sogs pa brlag pa'i phyir5/ ha ha zhes bya ba'i sgra drangs pa'i phyir ro/ /gad rgyangs ni ha sa de 6ba ta'i sgra bsgrags pas klu thams cad sngangs 3shing brgyal te sha rus khro bo'i zhal du stobs zhes pa'o/ /klu thams cad 'ching bar byed pa/ 'byung po thams cad 'gugs shing zhi bar mdzad pa zhes bya ba la/ 'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan la sogs pa 'gugs shing bcing ba ste/ lcags kyu'i spyor bas bkug nas/ dkar gsum dang mngar gsum dang ldan pa'i gtor ma sbyin 9 zhes pa'o/ /klu thams cad ces pa ni/ bcing ba ni gcod mi nus te/gzhan gshin rje dang 'byung po spyi yang yongs su bzung ba ste/ spyor ba thams cad gcod par mdzad pa/ sbyor ba thams cad zlog ⑫par mdzad pa/ sbyor ba thams cad gnon 11par mdzad pa/ yon tan ma lus pa'i bdag po de zhes pa la spyor ba ni phyi'i drug dang / khrag dang sngags kyis byas pa'i gnod pa ste/gzhan gyis byas pa'i rig sngags tshur 1—/mi tshugs par bzlog pa'o/ /sbyor ba bzlog pa ni rang bsrung ba dang pha rol rang la bzlog pa'o/ /sbyor ba gnon ⑫pa 25—1338

ni phar la bzlog pa'i 'khor lo thod pa mi mthun pas gnon zhes pa'o/ /tshig de gsum yang zab pa'i phyir bla ma'i man ngag la rag las par bya ba'i phyir bshad par mi bya'o/ /yon tan ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang /stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /byams pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /des kyang gnas khyad par can na ston pa yon tan dang ldan pa bzhugs par ༄1bstan to/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / gnod sbyin mthu bo che thams cad ces pas 'khor phun sum tshogs par bstan te/ rang gi 'khor ni sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje dang lha dang mi dang mi ma yin pa 37la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang rigs lnga'i khro bo dang lha mo dang / sgo ma la sogs pa'i nang nas khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal langs te/ 'di skad gsol zhes 'og dang 'byel to/ /bar du gcod pa'i phyir gnod sbyin smos te gang ba bzang po dang / nor bu bzang po dang / lngas 1rtsen la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad do/ /gnod sbyin mthu bo che thams cad dang zhes pa la mthu ni rang gi 'khor rnams thams cad la 'dul sems can thams cad la shing gi yol gos chu 'thor ba'o/ /gnod sbyin drag po thams cad ni sha zlon pa rjen par za ba'o/ /de ngani lha min dang lha dang gnod sbyin ma rungs pa 5'dul ba yang shes par bya'o/ /lha thams cad dang /klu thams cad dang / dri za thams cad dang / lha ma yin thams cad dang zhes pa lha ni brgyad de/ lha dang / lha'i dbang po dang / lha min bdag /ma hā de ba dang / khyab 'jug chen po dang / u ma de ba/ kun du rgyug /'chi med dbang po'o/ /klu yang dga' bo la sogs pa brgyad de/ de yang 25—1339

'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /dri za ni zur phud lnga pa'o/ /lha ma yin ni thags 1bzangs ris 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /nam mkha' lding thams cad dang /mi 'am ci thams cad dang / lto 'phye chen po thams cad dang / 'byung po dang zhes pa la/ nam mkha' lding ni gser mig can 'khor dang kyibacas pa'o /mi 'am ci ni ljon pa rta mgo can la sogs pa ri rab kyi khong gseng na gnas pa'o / /lto 'phye ni lto 'phye nyid de/ mi'i lus po la sbrul gyi mgo bo la sogs pa'o / /'byung po ni dbang ldan la sogs pa brgyad do/ /yi dwags dang brjed 5byed la sogs pa dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te zhes bya ba la yi dwags ni kha nas me 'bar la sogs pa'o/ /brjed byed ni byol song gi rgyal po ri rab la gnas pa rnams so/ /thabs cig ni bskor ba'o/ /'di ltar nyi ma dang zla ba dang skar ma'i tshogs lta bu bzhugs so zhes pa la nyi zla dang 'dra ba ni bden pa gnyis dang thabs shes rab dang lam gnyis 7la sogs pa'o/ /skar ma dang 'dra ba ni lam de dag gi yan lag gi tshogs dang thabs cig tu 3skar ma lta bu bzhugs zhes pa ste/ gnas der 9ston pa de 'khor 7rnams dang lhan cig tu chos gsung ngo zhes bstan/ de ni chos phun sum tshogs pa yang yongs su bstan to/ /de'i chos yang zhes pa mi snang bar gyur gyi bar la dngos su bstan/ston pa dang chos kyi byin rlabs yin pa'i phyir de ma gsungs so/ /de nas 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can la 'khor thams cad kyis gsol ba zhes pa la/ de nas ni chos de lta bu la ston pa bzhugs te zhes pa'o/ /'phags pa ni sgrib pa rnam pa gnyis spangs pa'o/ /gong ma dang khyad par gyi don de ni sprul sgu lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can no/ /de la 'khor thams cad kyi nang nas 25—1310

khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba langs nas bla gos sngon po gsol te/ /gos sngon po can khrod ci zhes te/ khyod kyi bya ba'i las dang ngo bo ji lta bu lags/bde gshegs kun gyi sprul pa yin nam/ sangs rgyas kun gye sprul pa'i ngo bo khyod yin nam/ gal te sgu gsung thugs kyi 1bdag bor bsdus pa yin nam/phrin las thams cad kyi bdag por dbang bskur ba yin nam/ bdag khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba dang 'khor rnams kyis bya ba/ las bskyed rdzogs grogs dang las kyi tshogs la sogs pa ston pa'i bstan pa sangs rgyas thams cad gcig gi ngo bo las kyi bya rgyud ji lta bu lags/ bdag cag gis bka' nyan gyi khyod kyi sku gsung thugs drag por bstan pa ni/ lam nye ba ste 'khor ba las myur du sgol snyezhes pa'o/ /de bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams ston pas gsungs pa nyan to 5zhes pa'i don to/ /le'u gang la ming de yod pa la de skad ces bya ste/ gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa lnga yod pas/ de la dang po gleng gzhi'i le'u zhes bya'o / /lag na rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste le'u dang po'i bshad pa'okhu// //de ltar gleng gzhi bstan kyang bskyed rdzogs kyi 7don ma bstan na 'grub par mi 'gyur bas da ni ༄ le'u gnyis pa bstan to / / tsusnades na lag na rdo rjes rdo rje drag po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ 'di skad gsungs so zhes pa la/ de nas zhes bya ba la / de nas kyi sgra ni —gleng gzhi song ba'i rting de nas/ bar cis kyang ma chod par lag na rdo rje'i ston pa sgu gsung thugs drag po'i chos gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs 11te 25—/341

'di skad gsungs zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /phyag rgya gsang sngags thugs sbyor la/ /khro bo'i 1rgyal po bsam par bya/ /khro bo rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /byin rlabs 2ya mtshan sna tshogs ldan/ /zhes bya ba la/ bla ma gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i rim pa/ phyag rgya ni srung ba dang bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes dngos sam gzhal yas khang bskyed pa la sogs pa'o/ /gsang sngags ni gzhal yas khang gi nang du seng ge dang pad+ma la sogs pa'i steng du/ snying rje'i 4stobs kyis 5ngo bo hūṃ du byung ba'o/ /thugs sbyar 6ni yig 'bru las phyag mtshan du gyur pa ste/las gnyis byas pa'o/ /de las —sku rdzogs pa ni/ khro bo'i rgyal po ste rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo'o/ /khro bo'i ming ni gos sngon can/ /de mthong na ni khro bo gzhan / /thams cad kyis ni lag cha 'chor/ /zhes gsungs pa ste/ ri rab tu gnod sbyin 'dul ba'i dus su'o/ /de rnams kyi rgyal po yin pa'i phyir rgyal po'o/ /khro bo rdo rje'i 9ting 'dzin ni/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bsdus pa dang /bsreg —pa dang sbyangs pa ste/ sku gsum gyi 5 1lhar bskyed pa'o/ /byin rlabs 1 ni lhag pa'i ye shes bstem pa dang / rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur te 1 sangs rgyas lngas ཿgtso bo la dbang rtags su brgyan pa'o/ /bla ma'i rigs lha'i 5rang bzhin / āḥ—hūṃ dkar dmar gyi ngo bo/ gu khya a r+bha ṣiñtsa zhes pas lce la bzhag nas gsung dbyangs yan lag brgyad cu dang ldan te / a ho su kha zhes btung bar bya'o/ /des sngags bzlas pa dang 'byel to/ /ya mtshan sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i dngos grub thob pa'o/ /yang man ngag rgya chen po dang sbyar te bshad de/ phyag rgya ni gzhal yas khang dang gtso bo bskyed pa bstan te/de yang tshogs bsags 1sgopa dang / tshad med pa bsgom pa dang / oṃ ma hā shu 25—13 2

n+ya tā rmyedz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kopho 3haṃ zhes pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te/de nas bsrung ba bzhi dang pad+ma yang hūṃ gi cho 'phrul kyis bskyed par bya'o/ /gsang sngags ni stong pa nyid do/ /de'i byin rlabs kyis yo re baṃ lam̐ sum̐ rgyu las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / gzhal yas khang sgo bzhi pa dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa phyi'i 2rgyan dang nang gi rgyan gyis mdzes pa bskyed do/ /de'i dbus su gdan gyis mtshan pa ste/ gzhal yas khang de yang rin po che lnga yis brtsigs pa lha'i snam bu dang bcas pa'o/ /der hūṃ gi cho 'phrul gyis 5cho ga gsung gi ༄ —snagatso bor yab yum rdzogs par bskyed pa'o/ /de yang yum la ni bskyed pa med/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du rdzogs zhes pa'o/ /gsang sngags ni yab yum gyi/ e waṃ byen gyis brlabs te yab yum snyoms par zhugs te/des rigs lnga yab yum bskul te thig le dkar dmar gzhal yas khang gi nang du gsang sngags kyi ngo bo thig le dang yig 'bru bsam pa'o/ /thugs ni de las phyag mtshan du gyur pa'o/ /khro bo'i thurgyal po ni de las sku rdzogs pa'o/ /khro bo rdo rje ting pesna'adzin ni/ gsang ba nas lha rnams spro ba bstan te/ oṃ badz+ra rngo dha be+e waṃ ba ra dha ra hūṃ/ oṃ budhe (kro dha m+bi dze+e ba ra tsodha ra hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na kro dha be+e dze+e ba ra dha ra hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha nī dze+e ba ra dha ra hūṃ/ oṃ karma kro dha m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra hūṃ / oṃ tre lokya bi dza ye hūṃ/ oṃ ma hā kā la ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ/ oṃ bi rū zwa 11ka ye hūṃ / oṃ bai shra ba ṇa 7ye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra lā gye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā le ṭ+wā 1// oṃ badz+ra gri ti dhīḥ6/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ ti aḥ5/ oṃ badz+ra dhū 7pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pu྾ ṭ+wā7 /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrī— 5/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe aḥ19/ oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghar+bhe hoḥ / oṃ budha ḍā ki a dī hūṃ/ oṃ 25—/3 3

badz+ra ḍā ki a dī 1hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki a dī hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki a trī rtehūṃ/ oṃ karmā 4ḍā ki a dī 5hūṃ/ yang na kro bye shwa ri hūṃ zhes sbyar bar bya'o zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis khro bo rnams mkha' nas bton te/ dbus kyi khro bo rang sor song nas / gzhan yang / rang rang rigs kyi kha dog la/ /stag dang gos sngon sham thabs can/ /rang rang rigs kyis 6dbu rgyan byas pa'o/ /khro bo rdo rje ting nge 'dzin gyis zhes pa la/ shar du sangs rgyas gos sngon can/ /lho ru rin chen gos sngon can/ /nub tu pad+ma gos sngon can/ /byang du las kyi gos sngon can/ /sangs rgyas spyan la khro bo zhal/ /phyag mtshan rnams ni kun kyang g.yas na rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / rgya gram bsnams pa la g.yon pas 7dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /rnam rgyal ni sku mdog dmar po 'khor lo dang dbyug pa bsnams pa'o/ /mgon po yang sgu mdog nag po dud ka la phyag na rin po che dang / tsan+dan bsnams pa/ 'phags skyes —po yang sku mdog sngon po la phyag na mchod rten dang pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /rnam thos sras kyang sku mdog ser po la/ phyag na mchod rten dang ṣ+pe'u bye 1le bsnams pa'o/ /lha mo dang sgo ba yang rang rang logi sgu mdog dang phyag mtshan bsnams pa'o/ /de rnams la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa ni /yig 'bru'am / phyag mtshan nam skus —byen gyes brlab ces pa'o/ /byin rlabs 'ini ye shes sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs te/ bgegs bskrad pa dang mchod yon dang mchod pa dang bstod pa bya ste/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas / /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can/ /'od zer stobs kyis klu rnams 'dul / /mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas gos 25—13 /1

sngon can/ /sku mdog dkar po skyon ma gos/ /'khor lo dril bu phyag na bsnams / /me long ye shes khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bcom ldan rin chen gos sngon can/ /sku mdog ser po don rnams rgyas/ /rin chen dril bu phyag na bsnams—/ /mnyam nyid ye shes khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bcom ldan pad+ma gos sngon can / /sku mdog dmar po chags par ldan/ /chu skyes dril bu phyag na bsnams / /kun rtog ye shes khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bcom ldan las kyi gos sngon can/ /sku mdog ljang gu phrin las rgyas/ /rgya gram dril bu phyag na bsnams//bya grub ye shes khyod phyag 'tshal/ /khyams kyi cha la gnas pa ni/ /khams gsum rgyal dang mgon po gnag / 'phags skyes snepo dang rnam thos sras/ /sprul pa sku yi tshul bstan pa/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dkar mo sgeg dang rin chen ser/ /pi wang ma ni dmar mo ste/ /dṛ bye ti ljang gu gar rnams bsgyur/ /stong pa'i don gyis tshim mdzad pa/ /mchod pa'i lha mo khyod phyag 'tshal ge/ /shar lho lha mo bdug pa ste/ /lho nub mthing ga me tog ma/ /nub byang dmar mo gsal byed ma/ /byang shar ljang gu dri chab ma/ /pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs mdzad cing / /'dod pa'i don grub phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog sadril/ /bdud bzhi ma lus tshar gcod cing / /phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pa/ /sgo ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma/ /smug nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma/ /mthing nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma/ /ser nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma/ /dmar nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /las kyi 25—1345

mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma/ /ljang nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /stong pa bzhi yi rang bzhin can/ /sprul pa'i sku yi tshul ston pa/ /phyag na cang te'u 1kha ṭī bsnams/ /mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod la sngags bzhis gnyis su med par bstem mo/ /dbang yang snga ma bzhin du blang ba ste / gong du bstan pa 'dir mi bshad do/ /des gtor ma dang bstod pa thun gyi bar du byas te/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rin po che'i pho brang du sems pa sum brtsegs gsal bar byas te/ grangs kyi bye bsnyen pa bskyal rnyizhes pa ste/mtshan ma dang dus kyang yongs su shes shing gzung ngo / /thun gyi rnal 'byor gyi 4spyod pa'i skabs su lam gyi sems bskyed kyang bsgom zhing bzlas so/ /swā hā hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod cing yongs su smin par bya'o/ /smon lam dge rtsa bsngo legs pas tshe 'di la nad dang sdug bsngal byang ste/ thun mong kun thugye dngos grub 'byung / /zhes bla ma rnams gsung ngo / /de ni ya mtshan sna tshogs ldan/ /zhes pa'o/ /las rnams grub la the tshom med/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po ste/ /gsad 5rmongs sna tshogs nges par grub7/ /de nyid nges 'grub gdon mi za/ /zhes pa la gong du bstan pa bzhin bsgrubs na/ las sna tshogs zhi ba dang rgyas pa 'grub par the tshom mi za ste/ rtsa ba na gsal bas ma bris so/ /des na dkyil 'khor de la gtso bo'i dbang du byas te/ lha gcig dang / gnyis dang /gsum du sgrub pa dang / lha bcu dang / bco brgyad nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang /rtsa drug sum cu lnga'i dkyil 'khor lnga dang ni/ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang drug tu 'gyur/ rang dang gzhan gye dkyil 'khor du bla ma mkhas pa rnams kyis bstan to/ /de dag bstan pa kun la yang / /tshogs bsags byebasrung 25—1346

dang lha bskyed pa/ /cho ga'i spyor ba mkhas pas 1bya/ /zhes pa ste/ bla ma'i man ngag la rag las pa'o/ /yang shi ba la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ phyag rgya gsang sngags gsungs te/ rgyas par ro bsreg cho ga nas shes par bya'o/ /'dir dang por ro la khrus byas 3bgegs bskrad/ gos dang rgyan bzang po btags nas/ rgyun 'chags dang sdom pa bzung chob yang gnyen 'dun nam pha mas bya ste/ ro la bsrung ba dang bsnyen pa bya ste/ phyi rol du sa chog rgyas bsnyus gang rung bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi mtha' yas par bya ste/ thig gi cho gas thig gdab ste/ dbus dang tshangs thig btab la thig chen dang cha chen dang cha bran legs par ༄btab la/ sa tshon byin gyis brlabs la/ dkyil 'khor sgo gnyis rtsig 5pa rgyan dang bcas pa bri zhes pa'o/ /lung las/ shi 5la phan gdags don ched du/ /sa chog rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor brtsam/ /sgo gnyis rdzogs nas rgyan rnams mdzes/ /mchod dang gtor ma yongs su btang / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas mchod pa'i yo byad gtor ma cha gnyis la sogs pa rdzogs la/ dkyil 'khor dbus su thab brtsigs la/ ro shing rta'i 'khor los dz+waspyan drangs te/ rnga dang dung dang ༷pi wang chen po dang bcas pa'i sil snyan 97dang rol mos sna drangs te/ dbang gi bum pas khrus byed cing / /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /gshin ⑩ la phan gdags don ched du/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs 4 nyemadzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta be+e waṃ ba ra dha ra nyurwashurnyaḥshusgopho nahaṃ zhes brjod do/ /bsreg khang la bskor ba byas te ro bsreg khang du bzhag la/ rang sems bskyed pa dang sdom pa gzung ba dang lhag pa'i lha'i —ting nge 'dzin bsgoms la/ bde bar 25—1347
