bdag nyid drag po'i sngags bzlas pa1/ /sngags kyi sprul pa sna tshogs spros/ /sprul pa drag po'i khro tshogs kyis/ /'o dod 'debs shing thal mo brdebs/ /drag po'i mtshon cha'i thog phab pas/ /dus mtha' med cing drag shul che/ /de tshe 'di yi lha 'bros 'gyur/ /mnan la ri rab chen po byas/ /sems ni ri rab dran pas gnon/ /ngag ni ri rab smra bas gnon/ /lus ni ri rab g.yo 'gul gnon/ /phyag na rdo rje be con can gyi 2rgyud phyi ma las rtog pa dang po rdzogs so// //de nas yang dag nges pa'i don ni rab bshad pa/ /dpal ldan gos sngon gsang ba'i bdag po khro bo'i sku/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi sdud pa por ni rab grags kyang / /'khor gyi klu rnams ma lus 'dul phyir ston pa mdzad/ /de dag ji srid don la ni / /yang dag gsang bdag gos sngon can/ /rnal 'byor don la rab gnas nas/ /bla med 'khor lo'i don gsungs pa/ /kye ho sgrol ba byed pa can4/ /chags pa rab tu bde ba che/ /ma lus 'khor dang mya ngan 'das / /rtag chad gnyis stong 5bde ba che/ /yang dag bla na med pa'i k+kong //thams cad stong du cha gcig ste/ /mi gnas ma bral 'dus ma byas/ /bla med gos sngon mtshan nyid do/ /gsung dang bsnyus pa'i rgyud rnams la/ /grangs las 'das shing brjod du rnged/ /mdor bsnyus rnam pa bzhi ru bstan/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud dang brtag pa'i rgyud/ /bshad pa'i rgyud dang phyi rgyud 6ma/ /ston pa nyid kyis rgyud 'di yang / /gdul bya'i dbang du gsungs pa ste/ /klu 'dul dbang du gos sngon can/ /ma mo 'dul phyir ro langs rgyud/ /gshin rje 25—1 180

'dul phyir gcer bu'i rgyud/ /bdud chen 'dul phyir gying chen rgyud/ /gza' chen 'dul phyir thugs ga/sang rgyud/ /mkha' 'gro 'dul phyir khyung chen rgyud / /rgyal po 'dul phyir 'jigs byed rgyud/ /dgra bo 'dul phyir gnod byed rgyud/ /gnod sbyin 'dul phyir 'chi bdag rgyud/ /gdul bya dgu yi dbang du ni/ /ston pa dgu yis rgyud dgu gsungs/ /ston pa dgu yang gcig yin te/ /gcig nyid bde gshegs sprul pa'o/ /phyag na rdo rje be con can 1gye rgyud phyi ma las rtog pa gnyis pa rdzogs so// //'di skad bstan pa'i dus gcig na/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten khams / /gang gā'i klung gi bye snyed na/ /sprul pa'i rgyud dang ji snyed de/ /shin tu khro ba gdug cing gtum/ /ji lta ba yis 2thogs med sku/ /dbang bskur gsang ba'i bdag po yin/ /ji ltar khro bo'i dbang bskur ba/ /dbang thob phyag na rdo rje yin/ /mthu dang gzi brjid khyad par 'phags/ /ji ltar zhi ba'i skur bstan kyang / /thams cad zhi ba'i bdag nyid che/ /dkar po rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ /byang chub mang pos 'khor du bskor/ /ji ltar rgyas pa'i skur bstan yang / /thams cad rgyas pa'i bdag nyid che/ /ser la sdang ba'i rin chen bdag /gshin rje'i 4tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /de ltar dbang gi skur bstan kyang / /thams cad dbang gi bdag nyid che/ /dmar nag 5pad+ma'i kha dog thogs/ /klu tshogs mang pos 'khor du bskor/ /ji ltar drag po'i skur bstan kyang / /thams cad drag po'i bdag nyid che/ /sngo nag rdo rje dbyug to 'phyar/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor du bskor/ /gsang ba'i 25—1181

bdag po gos sngon yang / /rim par mngon par byang chub pas/ /bla med byang chub chen po brnyes/ /yang dag thogs med 'gro don byed/ /'khor lo thar lam rnam dag nas/ /yang dag gsang ba'i thig le las/ /as brgyan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de steng yi ge hūṃ nag bsam/ /hūṃ de kun gyis byen brlabs pas/ /rdo rje nag po hūṃ 'bar ldan/ /rdo rje kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /sku gnyis grub pa'i bdag nyid che/ /mngon par khro bo'i bzlas pa bya/ /dpral ba mgrin pa mig gnyis dang / /rna ba lus la sogs pa ru/ /phyag na rdo rje sa snying po/ /nam mkha'i snying po spyan ras gzigs/ /ming gi yi ge dang por bskyed/ /bde 1gshegs gsang bar byin brlabs pas/ /skye mched lha rnams 'bros par 'gyur/ /spyi bo snying ga mgrin pa dang / /lte ba gsang ba gnas lnga ru/ /mi bskyod rnam snang rin po che/ /snang ba mtha' yas don yod grub/ /ming gi yi ge dang por bskyed/ /byin brlabs rigs lnga khros par bskyed/ /mig gnyis phyi rol me dpung nang 2/ /gos sngon khros pa mtshon gang babyed/ /de ni 'byung po 'dul ba'i mchog /snying nang gsang bdag gos sngon can/ /rdo rje 4dbyug to thogs pa sngo/ /de yi snying nang rdo rje gnag /zla ba'i gdan la bsam par bya/ /de dbus hūṃ las sngags kyis bskor / /de yi 'od kyis bsgul nas ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa 6spyan drangs nas/ /mdun na gnas la 7gsol gdab cing / /de yis bdag nyid byen brlabs 'gyur/ /de nas gsang sngags bzlas brjod bya/ /myur du nyen las thar ba dang / /thugs rjes rmi lam lung ston 'gyur/ /ma lus dbang du bsdu bas 'grub/ /phyag na rdo rje be con can 9gyi rgyud phyi ma las rtog pa gsum 25—/ /82

pa rdzogs so// //'di skad bshad pa'i dus gcig na/ /drag po 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su/ /dpal ldan gos sngon dkyil 'khor ldan/ /dbus na dpal ldan gos sngon ldan/ /sngon po rdo rje dbyug to bsnams/ /g.yas phyogs hūṃ las dpal ldan mgon1/ /nag po gri gug thod pa thogs/ /mche gcigs mgo phreng do shal byas/ /mdun du hūṃ las khams gsum rgyal/ /dmar gnag thod dbyug sdigs mdzub 2thogs//mche gcigs stag gi sham thabs can/ /g.yon du be+e las rnam thos sras/ /ljang ser be con zhags pa bsnams4/ /ha ha 'byin cing drag por bcas/ /rgyab tu na las mig mi bzang / /sngo gnag ral gri sbrul zhags bsnams/ /mche ba gadzigs shing shin tu 'jigs/ /'khor lo'i 5rtsibs kyi phyi mchan na / /spos dang rnge tog mar me dri/ /ji bzhin phyogs su dgod par bya/ /sgeg mo phreng dang dbyangs can gar/ /nang gi mtshams la dgod par bya/ /oṃ na mo bud+dhā dharma saṃ bhe bh+yaḥ/ i rda pu྾/ dhū pe/ gadhe/ ā lo ke/ ba bo ta pū dza ste gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ na mo nī lālba ra dha ra badz+ra / pā ṇi/ i do pu྾/ dhū pe/ gabye/ ā lo ke/ ba lo ta pū dza me gha —hūṃ/ oṃ na mo ma hā kā la hūṃ/ i rda pu྾/ dhū pe/ gabye/ ā lo ke hūṃ/ oṃ na maḥtre lokya bi dza ya hūṃ/ i rda/ oṃ na mo bi rū pak+ṣa ye hūṃ/ i rda/ oṃ na mo bi rū shwe ka ye hūṃ/ i rda/ e bye hi ma hā bo bye satwa ming dang ldan/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥmathar ldan pa/ /lcags kyu'i spyor ba rab tu bya/ /phyag na rdo rje be con can gyi rgyud phyi ma las rtog pa bzhi pa rdzogs so// //25—1 483

'di skad bshad pa'i dus gcig na/ /rdo rje gdan gyi rtse mo la /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus te/ /drag po rtog pa chen po 'di/ /rdo rje sgeg mo'i rtog par gsungs/ /gsang sngags bskul ba'i mtha' dang ldan/ /rtsa sngags dag la ming ldan pa/ /las sngags mtha' ma bsgyur mthar ldan/ /de yis las kun byed pa'i mchog /phyag na rdo rje khro bo'i sku/ /de nyid gzhan min bdag nyid sku/ /de ldan drag po'i thog chen 'bebs/ /gsang sngags ting 'dzin rab ldan na/ /phebs par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /ha na ha na badz+ra / m+bi lāsba ra ma hā yak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ brnya hūṃ/hu lu hu lu phaṭa/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ stson+da stson+da badz+ra/ bhin+da dzhan+da badz+ra/ sgo ṭa sgo ṭa badz+ra/ dzahā kṛṇ+ḍa badz+ra/ ta thā ya ta thā ya badz+ra/ ha sa ya na ha sa ya na badz+ra / bri hūṃ a na ya 1badz+ra/ tsakra tsakra badz+ra/ dza la pa ya badz+ra m+bi lālba ra ma hā yak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ lce dang dbang po khro bo dang / /'od 'phros thog chen dbab par bya/ /khams gsum myur du sgol bar 'gyur/ /e ma gsang sngags ngo mtshar che/ /phyag na rdo rje be con can gyi rgyud phyi ma las rtog pa lnga pa rdzogs so// //'di skad bshad pa'i dus gcig na/ /lha mo ro langs dkyil 'khor du/ /lha mo'i tshogs dang ldan 4cig tu/ /lha mo rnams kyis legs bstod pa/ /klu rnams 'dul ba'i mthu stobs can/ /dpal ldan gos sngon phyag 'tshal bstod/ /drag shul sgu ni khros pa'i chas5/ /klu rnams 'dul ba'i rtags 'chang zhing / /25—1 /81

khams gsum gdug pa kun sgol 1zhing / /klu rnams 'dul mdzad gos sngon khyod phyag 'tshal/ /e ma brjod 'das drag shul gsung / /gad rgyangs dgod cing 'od zer 'khyug /klu tshogs 'dul ba'i gsung 'chang ba/ /sna tshogs drag po gsum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /e ma mi dmigs 2dmigs pa che/ /rnam par dag las rab grub pas/ /ma lus dmigs med phra mo'i bdag /'od 'byung thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /e ma mi 'byung 'byung ba che/ /mtshan dang dpe byad khyad par 'phags/ /yon tan sna tshogs brjod las 'das//bla rnged gos sngon khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thogs pa me+ed pa'i sku brnyes nas//zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams kun/ /sgu gsung thugs kyis thogs med 'grub/ /thogs med gos sngon phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ bskyed nag po mgon po ste/ /gri gug phyag na snod thogs shing / /snang ba dpal mgon thugs su sgol/ /'khor lo'i mnga' bdag phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag na rdo rje be con can 4gyi rgyud phyi ma las rtog pa bsdus pa rdzogs so// //rgyud kyi rgyal po rdo rje be con gos sngon 5can gyi rgyud/ /gu ya rū pa'i zhal snga nas ni legs bsgyur bas/ /mkha' 'gro'i gling nas dum bu brgyad du legs drus pa/ /de yi bshad rgyud 'bum phras phyed dang sum 6stong las ni phyung ba yin/ /rtog pa drug pa'i rgyud rdzogs so// //— 25—/485

〈〈snar 〉〉khopo/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanasum/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉'di bris dge ba'i mthu nus kyis/ /skye dang skye bar byang chub bar/ /mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal te/ /gos sngon go 'phang myur thob shog /bkra shis dang bde legs kyis khyab par gyur cig/ //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1 ༷35)25wa / 487

1109༄7/ /de kho na nyid sgon ma zhes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tatwa pra dī paṃ nā ma badz+ra pā ṇi sarba pūr+ṇa nalo kā ra4/ bod skad du/ de kho na nyid sgron ma zhes bya ba/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs thams cad rdzogs pa'i rgyan/ /dpal ldan gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdug bsngal ma lus sel mdzad 5cing / /'dod pa thams cad 6'grub mdzad pa'i/ /zla ba lta bur mthu mnga' ba/ /bde ba'i dngos po 'byung mdzad pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu mthu mnga' ba/ /rdo rje can la rab btud de//sgrub pa'i lam mchog sgron ma 'di/ /gsang ba'i rgyud dang man ngag rim pa'i don / /rtsod ldan sbug bsngal zhi mdzad klu sgrub 7nyid kyis bshad/ /gang zhig gis ni legs pa'i 8gsungs tshig don skyon / ldan/ /de byas lam ni tshig sgogs lam ma gsal/ /des na gang zhig sdug bsngal spong 'dod de la thabs rnams med gyur pa/ /bde ba thob pa'i thabs ni de la 'dir ni gsal bar byas/ /25—/ 88

'di las byung ba gzhan na yod med de/ /gsang ba'i lam la dga' ba skyes/ /des na gsang ba 'di bstan 'di la gus par gyis/ /dbang dang lta spyod dam tshig ldan/ /snying rje che zhing rigs rnams bzang / /dus su 'doms shing zhing yang dag /thos pa che zhing klong du gyur/ /sgang bu dma' zhing brtson 'grus ldan / /'di ni rdo rje 'chang du gsungs/ /snying rje che brtson sgang bu dma'1//dam tshig la gnas gsang la mos/ /yang dang yang du gsol ba 'debs/ /dus ring 'khor byed byang chub sems/ /rnal 'byor snod can gang zhig gis/ /ri bo zlum mam chu bo'i 'gram/ /mngon sum grags pas ma smad cing / /yid 'ong yon tan ldan gnas su/ /yo byad rjes rnams tshogs pa yis sems bskyed par ni yang dag bya/ /dang por srung 4ba rab tu bya/ /stong pa nyid las lhar gsal te/ /byin brlabs 5gdug pa can rnams la/ /gzhan du 'gro ba'i bka' yang bsgo/ /mi 'gro ba yi bgegs rnams la/ /rdo rje 'khor lo thogs kyis gsad6/ /de rjes thugs ka'i 'od zer las/ /sna tshogs rdo rje khang pa dang / /'khor lo mtshon cha me la sogs/ /de bzhin khang pa me dang thog /tsha tsha 'khrug pa'i rnam par 7bsam/ /de bzhin khams gsum rgyal la sogs / /khro bo de spros 'byung po bkug /ral gris btub 8cing phur bus gdab / /'byung po btul nas khang pa bsgom/ /yang na rang gi gnas dag tu / /bcing gtub byas nas bgegs rnams bzlog /de nas khro bo'i khang pa bsgom/ /'di gsungs gang gis las rnams 'grub/ /phyis ni bgegs rnams gso bar bya/ /dang por mtshams kyi man ngag go/ /de nas tshogs rnams rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /nyi zla'i gdan bsam bla ma dgug /sems bskyed 25—/ 89

rdo rje 'chang chen sku/ /byin brlabs mchog tu bskyed pa la/ /phyag 'tshal 1ba dang mchod pa dang / /rang la ngan brjod sdig pa bshags/ /sdom pa bzung dang lus kyang dbul/ /dge rtsa bsngo byas smon lam gdab/ /phyis ni bde gshegs mchod par bya/ /hūṃ gi 'od las snang ba kun/ /srid pa ma lus lhar gsal te/ /'od kyis dpal ldan ye shes tshogs/ /bsod nams 'dod phyir spyan drang 4bstem/ /gdan la bzhugs par gsol ba gdab/ /phyag 'tshal spos dang me tog dang / /mar me dri chab la sogs pa5/ /dngos dang yid kyis mchod pa rnams/ /ci nus par ni dbul bar bya/ /de 'og sdig pa bshags pa dang / /sdom pa ma lus bzung 6ba yang / /bla med dkon mchog gsum po dang / /'phags pa gos sngon byang chub sems/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po yis7/ /yang dag byang chub nges mdzad pa'i/ /rnam gsum tshul khrims bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sbud pa 8dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /sems bskyed skyabs 'gro ma lus kun/ /deng nas ma nyams yongs su gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i 9rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba jeg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni so sor gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog thams cad la/ /sdom pa ma lus ldan pa khoni/ /yang dag ma lus gzung 25—1 /90

bar bgyi/ /sems can snyug bsngal las sgrol bgye/ /srid pa'i mtsho ru bying ba yis1 / /ma brgal ba ni bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba ni bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung bgyi/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /bdud rtsi rnam lnga gtor ma dang / /dkyil 'khor me tog sngon por byas/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu/ /gos sngon can la dbul bar bkyi/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha rnams la/ /skad cig tsam yang 'bral mi bya/ /chang gis srid pa bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /chang ni bdag gis spang bar bgyi/ /shes rab stong pa nyid la yang / /rnam pa kun du smad mi bgye/ /sems can bde ba'i yid mi dkrug /ces pa dngos sam yid kyis blangs / /yi rang ba dang bsgul ba dang / /gsol gdab rang gi lus dbul zhing / /bdag la sprul pa'i tshogs 4rnams kyis//sems can kun gyi don bya dang / /phyi ma'i 5dus kyi smon lam gdab/ /dge byas byang chub bsngo ba dang / /sems can don byas 6bsam pa bskyed/ /sems bskyed lam ni rab tu bsgom/ /tshad med bzhi po yongs su bsgom/ /sems bskyed rab tu brtan par 'gyur/ /ye shes tshogs kyi man ngag kyang / /dang por rang bzhin med pa la/ /gcig dang du mar ma grub pas/ /de la mos par byed pa dang / /hūṃ gi 'od kyis zhu 'gyur te/ /phyi nang rang bzhin med pa ste/ /yul ni gang la'ang mi bca' ste/ /rten yang gang la'ang gtad pa med/ /de yi ngang la gnas pa las/ /mchog gi rgyu ru nges par gsungs/ /de la gang 7gi byang chub sems/ /yi ram̐ baṃ lo las kyang dang 9/ /sum̐ dang rgyu 7las byung ba yi/ /rlung me chu yi dkyil 'khor dang / /sa gzhi ri rab steng dag tu / /gzhal yas khang pa bskyed pa yang / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /'og 25—/ /91

tu pad+ma bzhi yis brgyan/ /nang gi gru chad bar khyams dang / /dra ba dra phyed pha gu dang / /dril bu dar dpyangs la sogs dang / /phyi dang nang gi rgyan mdzes shing / /dur khrod brgyad dang yang dag ldan/ /dbus su seng ge pad+ma dang / /nyi zla gdan la sogs pas brgyan/ /de las 1hūṃ byung rdo rje 'bar/ /de las dpal ldan gos sngon sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing / /sangs rgyas lnga yis dbu brgyan cing / /dbu la sbrul dang rin chen mdzes/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen du bskyod/ /gnas lnga sku lnga'i mtshan ma can/ /spyan gsum me yi mdog 'dra zhing / /shangs dbugs 'thor byed rlung nag 'tshub/ /mche ba gcigs shing brjid pa'i zhal/ /ljags ni glog bzhin myur 'dril 4ba/ /zhal nas sbrul nag gsol ba'i tshul/ /sbrul nag se ral kha ru byas/ /sbrul bzhis rkang lag ska rags byas/ /gsus pa che zhing mkhrang 5bag can/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum 'byung po 'dul/ /sku stod gos sngon na bza' gsol6/ /sgu smad stag gi sham thabs can/ /rdo rje khros ma sku la 'khril/ /sku mdog ljang dmar chags pa sel/ /g.yon gyi gnyis gred 'khril 7nas ni/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spyan drangs te/ /bgegs bskrad bstod mnyes byas nas ni7/ /e ma dpal ldan gos sngon can/ /gsang 'dzin rigs kyi bdag po yis/ /thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyis/ /bdag nyid bde 1 gshegs skur byin brlabs —/ /zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa yang / /sgu gsung thugs kyi yi ge yis/ /mi sbug 'od dang yi ge'i ཿgzugs/ /lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa rnams/ /basbus te bsregs shing sbyangs pa las sku gsung thugs kyi lha ru gsal/ /sngon nas gnas pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /25—/ /92

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bstem pas 1bya/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /bum pa la sogs dbang rnams blang / /don dam bde ba chen po dang / /grub pa phyogs bral tshul du gnas/ /de la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /a la la la la ho/ a la la la shu kra su kha ho/ bde ba chen po mchog ni nyams dga' na/ /bcom ldan gsang mchog thugs rje'i 2bdag nyid kyis/ /ma rig srid pa'i mtsho las brgal ba'i phyir/ /khro bo'i skur ston sprul sgu dgod du gsol / /zhes bskul lo/ / don dam bde —ba'i sku bzhengs te/ /chags dang grol ba'i tshul du gnyis/ /chags pa'i spyor ba'i tshul ston pa/ /rang gi hūṃ las phyed pad dang / /zla ba nyi ma'i steng du 'phros/ /cho ga gsum las don byed grub/ /e waṃ byen brlabs bde ba yis/ /lha mos gsol 'debs cho ga yis / /dga' zhing spyod pas bha ga ru/ /ye shes thig le dkar dmar 'dres//spyod pa byas pas lha yi sgu/ /sum cu'am ni nyi shu lnga/ /chags pa'i tshul du bskyed par bya/ /de la gtso bo'i sngags kyis gdon/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha m+bi lāsba ra dha ra hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra m+bi lālba ra dha ra hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na kro dha dī lāsba ra dha ra hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha dī lālba ra dha ra hūṃ/ oṃ karma kro dha m+bi lālba ra dha ra hūṃ/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kro dhe shwa ri nī lāsba ra dha ra hūṃ/ oṃ kro dha tre lokya be+e dza ya hūṃ/oṃ ma hā kā lā 5sarnyi hūṃ/ oṃ bi rū bhā ka ye hūṃ/ oṃ be+e rū pak+ṣa 7ye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra lā sre hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā le ṭ+wā/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti dīḥ / oṃ badz+ra dṛ t+ya aḥ/oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pu྾ ṭ+wā/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke trīḥ / oṃ badz+ra gadz+nya āmaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gharnye hoḥzhes pas lha rnams las la gzhag— /so sor spro zhing gdug pa 25——1 93

sel / /gtso bo dbus kyi ngo bo la/ /gzhan rnams rang gi go ru gnas/ /shar du sangs rgyas gos sngon can/ /zhal dang sku mdog dkar po la/ /phyag na 'khor lo dril bu bsnams/ /bde byed gsang ba yis ni 'khril/ /sbrul dkar pos ni rnam par brgyan/ /lho ru rin chen gos sngon can/ /zhal dang sku mdog ser la 'phro/ /zhi ba mo dang gnyis med 'khril/ /rin chen dril bu phyag na bsnams/ /sbrul ser pos ni yongs su brgyan/ /nub tu gos sngon snang mtha' yas/ /zhal dang sgu mdog dmar la 'khrug /chu skyes rtog bral 'khyel ba las/ /pad+ma dril bu lag na bsnams/ /byang du las kyi gos sngon can/ /zhal dang sgu mdog ljang gu la/ /stong nyid rdo rje 'khril ba'i tshul/ /ral gri dang ni dril bu bsnams/ /dmangs 1rigs sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan/ /cha gnyis 'dzin tshul bde gshegs spyan/ /dbu la sangs rgyas bzhi yis brgyan/ /kun kyang gtso bo'i sham thabs la/ /dar dang rin chen chas kyis brgyan/ /nang gi grwa la bskyed pa ni/ /dkar mo sgeg dang rin chen ser/ /pi wang ma ni dmar mo ste/ /dṛ 2t+ya ljang gu gar gyi tshul/ /me long la sogs phyag mtshan 'dzin / /sngags kyi bdag po gzhan rnams kyang / /so sor gnas su bskyed pas ni/ /khams gsum rgyal dang mgon po gnag /lus ngan po dang rnam thos sras/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams pa ni/ /dbyug to dri dang rin chen dang / /mchod rten nges par gzung ba la/ /g.yon ni gtso rtags phyag rgya 'dzin / /shar sgo la sogs mtshams su yang / /spos dang me tog mar me dri/ /dar gyi chas kyis yongs su gnas/ /sgos dang sogs pa nges par gnas/ /sgo bzhi sgo srung 4bzhi po yang / /rang gi rigs kyi tshul du 'dzin/ /de ru 25—/ /94

dkyil 'khor gsal gyur nas/ /'od kyis phyogs bcu'i 1sangs rgyas rnams/ /spyan drangs bgegs bskrad mchog 2mnyes nas/ /gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa 'am/ /yang na gsum 'dus sbyor ba 'am/ /gong gis gsol ba btab pa yis/ /bstem zhing lha mos dbang bskur nas/ /dbu la gtso bo rigs kyis brgyan/ /rags dang phra ba'i rnam pa yis/ /dmigs dang gsal 4 bar gyur nas ni/ /dbang bskur rab gnas gtor ma sogs/ /rnal 'byor yongs su rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsgrub pa bya bar yongs su gsungs/ /zhes pa de ni rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi mubu mos sbyor ba rgyas par bstan pa'i dam tshig chen po'o / /6rgyas la dad par ma gyur pa'i/ /sbyor 7ba bsdus par gsungs pa yang / /sems sbyangs lus ngag yid kyi las/ /bgegs bsal bsrung ba'i khang pa dbub/ /nang du bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod dang bshegs 8byas nas/ /yi rang bskul gsol dge rtsa bsngo/ /yang dag byang chub yid la bzhag /'byung ba gzhal yas rim gyis bskyed/ /gdan gsum cho ga gsum las ni/ /gtso bo sku sogs 'khor bzhi yang / /rang rang yum dang bcas pa bskyed/ /khro bo lha mo la sogs kun/ /bzhi bzhir gtso bo la bskor ba/ /rang rang rigs kyi dngos grub ster/ /bcu las mang ba'i lha rnams kun/ /bsnyus pa'i skabs su spang ba yin/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs nas/ /mchod cing bstem nas dbang bskur nas/ /dmigs dang bsal bar rab tu bya/ /de la de yi cho ga bya/ /zhes pa ni/ sbyor ba bsdus pa'i man ngag go/ /gzhan yang sbyor ba shin tu bsnyus/ /man ngag nyams myong bstan par bya/ /dang por gzhan gyi don bya dang / /rang nyid bla med 'bras 25—1495

thob dang / /'khor 'dam 'don pa'i bsam pa bskyed/ /stong pa'i ngang las cig car gyis/ /bsrung dang gzhal yas gtso bor bcas/ /cig car bskyed de gsal ba dang / /ye shes 'khor lo myur du gzhug /yang na srung ba la sogs pa/ /rim gyis skyes de lhar snabaskyed la/ /ye shes bstem dang dbang bsdus blang / /gnyis med 'gyur nas sems gzung bya/ /de la sngags dang gtor ma dang / /tshogs dang sāts+tsha la sogs pa/ /des na de yi spyor ba bya/ /spyor ba rgyas bsdus gsum po 'di/ /gang zag dbang du rgyal bas gsungs/ / de la zhi gnas sems gzung ba/ /dang po bla ma mchod sogs bstan/ /de nas 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang / /yig 'bru phyag mtshan sku sogs bstan/ /gtso bo gsol bar gyur nas ni/ /dbang po rab 'bring bye brag gis/ /dus gcig pa 'am rim gyis bstan/ /bsnyim dang dbang bsgur byin brlabs 4kyis//shin tu gsal bar 5bstan pa yin/ /yang na dus kyi bye brag gis/ /bla ma mchod pa la sogs la/ /rjes dran gsal dang skad cig mas/ /gsal dang skad cig bcu dang brgyas / /stong dang thun phyed thun gcig pa/ /thun mtshams med par bsgom par bya/ /de la nan tan cher bskyed pas/ /bying dang rgod par gyur pa na/ /rtog pa spang zhing nyon mongs dgra/ /rgyu 'bras bcas par rab spangs nas/ /dul nas sems gzung man ngag kyang / /dbang po gang dang gang gis 7rtsa/ /skye mched 'phros par gyur pa na/ /ba thag 8/rang gi byang chub sems/ /thig le de la blo gtad pas/ /ba dag rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /snang ba ma lus rab zhi bas/ /de nas bying bar gyur pa na/ /gzugs khams gnas su spro ba dang / /khams gsum ma lus gsal ba dang / /25—1496

sems ni phyi dang nang du gzhug /'og tu bstem dang steng du spro/ /yang na shes pa glod la bsgom1/ /yang na gtso bo 'khor rnams la/ /gang dang gang ni gsal 'gyur ba/ /de la dmigs la bsgom par bya/ /phyag mtshan gsal na phyag la dmigs/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan la sogs pa/ /ma gsal bar du bskyed la bsgom/ /gtso 'khor gzhal yas ma lus pa/ /thams cad dmigs shing gsal bar bsgom/ /thams cad gsal bar ma gyur na/ /sdig pa shin tu che ba yis/ /sdig pa zhi dang bsod nams spel / /sbyin sreg tshogs dang gtor ma dang / /sāts+tsha maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa/ /sdig pa bshags shing bsgom par bya / /res gsal res mi gsal byung na/ /bar du gcod pa'i gegs yin pas / /lha la mchod cing gsol ba gdab/ /des kyang gsal bar 'gyur ba yin / /des kyang gsal bar ma gyur na/ /drag po'i 4sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor dang / /gtor mas bzlog cing drag sngags dang / /mnan cing gzir ba'i las su gsungs/ /srung ba byas shing skyabs 'gro bya/ /phyag ni gsal na phyag la dmigs/ /phyag ni gsal bar ma gyur na/ /phyag mtshan 'od kyis gsal bar bya/ /spyan ni gsal na de bzhin no/ /spyan ni gsal bar ma gyur na / /khrag gi zham bus spyan rnams gsal/ /bkrag dang ri mo ldan par gsal—/ /zhal mdog gsal bar ma gyur na/ /stong gsum 'od kyis gang ba la / /zhal la bsnyus te bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin thams cad rags gsal na / /phra mo mi gsal gyur kyang bla/ /gang du gang gis ma gsal na/ /zas dang skom dang gnas dag la/ /'du ba bcom 5pas gsal bar 'gyur/ /zhi gnas ting 'dzin gsal ba yis/ /mngon shes thun mong dngos grub kun/ /25—1497

ma lus dag la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de phyir ting 'dzin nus pa yang byang chub thob par 'di yis byed/ /bla ma sangs rgyas gsungs pa yis1/ /de ni sems gzung man ngag go/ /phyag rgya lha yi dkyil 'khor la/ /brten ke dang bogs dbyung rab tu gsungs/ /dkar po ser po ljang la sogs/ /re re gsum dang lnga 'dus pa/ /gsal zhing gsal bar gyur pa dang / /de la ri rab nyil 'bru bar/ /dbyebs la bogs dbyung kha dog bzhin/ /stong gsum gang dang gcig tu 'dus/ /sku la bogs dbyung rab tu gsungs/ /de ltar sku la bogs phyin pas/ /gsung ldan thugs la bslab bya ste/ /kha dog dbyibs dang grangs de bzhin/ /de ltar spyor ba bstan pa yang / /gang zag rigs ni rnam gnyis te/ /mchog dang dman dang gang zag go/ /ji ltar rkyen dbang gyur pa la/ /kun brtags blos bdag rkyen byas pa/ /mi 'gyur rang bzhin 'gyur ba'o/ /zas dang skom la sogs pa las/ /ji ltar bsam gtan 'phel byed pa/ /'di ni zas la sogs pa yis/ /'du ba la brten bogs dbyung 'gyur / /de ltar bsgoms pa'i man ngag gis/ /bsgom pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i sku yis su/ /las rnams ma lus grub par byed/ /khams gsum ma lus shes pa dang / /dal 'byor mi lus thob byed pa/ /lha yi sgu las 'byung zhes gsungs4/ /phyi nang dag par byed pa yisnye/ /lha bsgoms sems la khyad par yang / /rin po che yi gang zag gis/ /dang po dbang rnams thob bya zhing / /dam tshig ma nyams bshags la brtson/ /zhi gnas sems pa khyad par can/ /srid pa gsum gyi gnas skabs su/ /bag chags ngan pa 'jug mi 'gyur/ /phyi dang nang kun lha dang rten/ /khyad par can gyi 25—1( 98

bag chags kyis/ /kun 'byung rgyu yi 1bden pa spangs/ /de ma byung ba'i de yang med/ /des na zhi gnas gces par gsungs/ /tshul khrims nyon mongs spong ba yang / /spang bya spong byed tshul du 'jug /rtogs pas rtog pa sel ba yang / /thabs med pas su sel mi 'gyur/ /rtog pa spang zhing rtog pa len/ /rtogs pas rtog pa gcig nyid pas/ /dal 'byor myur du thob pa dka'/ /gtan mi thob pa ma yin te/ /dal 'byor lam la 'jug par byed/ /des na sngags mthu yon tan yang / /gzhal yas khang dang lha ru snang / /mi dge sdug bsngal sa bon bral/ /de la sogs pa'i sa bon med/ /dal 'byor myur du 'byin pa yang / /sems dpa' lha yi ngo bo yis/ /log pa'i rgyu bral 'bras bu myong / /de nas ngan song 'gro mi 'gyur/ / de nas 4lha dang sngags rnams kyis / /kun 'byung rtsa nas spong bar byed/ /zhi gnas rnam par dag 'dod pas / /rtsa ba'i sngags la rab brtson bya/ /lha dang zhi gnas 'byel pa yis5 /brtson 'grus go ni rnam par bgo/ /brtson 'grus pha rol 'gro bar byed/ /dper na gru gzings 6bskyod pa yis/ /rgya mtsho'i pha rol 'gro bar byed/ /gru gzings 7skya ba bral ba yis/ /pha rol 'gro ba bskyod mi nus/ /de bzhin 'dir yang zhi gnas dang / /skye ba brtson 'grus bral ba yisan/ /srid pa'i mtsho las rgal mi nus/ /rnam rtog las skyes srid pa 'di/ /srid pa'i mtho mnga' rang bzhin te/ /zhi dang mtshon 9chas las byung ba'i/ /bar ma chod par bde 'gro yis7/ /'bras bu myur du 'byen par byed/ /shes rab stobs ldan myur thob nas/ /stong nyid don la reg par byed/ /bsod nams las byung dge ba yang / /dad ldan smon lam btab pa yis/ /smon lam dge ba'i 25—/499

gzings thag gis/ /pha ma yul dang grogs dang rkyen/ /de ru myur du skye ba 'byung / /de ru sdom gsum ldan gyur nas/ /shes rab gnyis las byung ba yis / /bde ba mchog la reg par 'gyur/ /smon lam nus pa 'phel bar —1byed/ /smon lam ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal 'dren/ /smon lam gyis byas dge ba yang / /'bras bu bzang po 'byin par byed/ /rang bzhin 'phags dang bla ma dang / /shin tu bla ma dam pa yis/ /des bsngos gang 'dod 'bras bu 'byin/ /yang na de min yul dag tu/ /sdom gsum ldan pas 'bras bu 'byen/ /de yang rgyu rkyen las gnyis 'dzom/ /ma 'dzom pas ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rgyu rkyen nus pa 'dzom pa yis/ /gong gi 'bras bu 'bring sogs 'gyur/ /kun 'byung las bskyed rnam rtog gis/ /ngan song gnas su 'khrid par byed/ /de ltar nges par gsungs pa na/ /dge ba'i rtog pa shin tu gces/ /de med par ni de mi 'byung / /des ni thams cad skyed par byed/ /des na 'khor ba sgol ba yis / /srid pa bde ba shin tu gces/ /de bzhin gsang sngags nus pa yis/ /'khor lo bskor ba'i spyor ba bzhin/ /'bras bu mchog la myur du reg /theg pa 'og mar brten pa yis/ /bskal pa mang por sdod mi 'gyur/ /bskal pa skye ba gcig gis 'byin4/ /'di ni gsang sngags thabs kyi lam/ /zhi gnas lhag pa bsgom pa yang / /tshogs dang gtor ma dge ba'i stobs/ /nus dang sbyar bas ci nus bya/ /dbang bskur man ngag myur bar spyad/ /de la sogs pa'i lam rnams kyis5/ /'bras bu myur du 'byen par 'gyur/ /zhi gnas lha yi skur bsgom pa'i6/ /dam tshig chen po ston pa ste le'u dang po'o// //25—/500

nas las tshogs gsang sngags bri/ /don dam brda 1dang dmigs dang brjod/ /'dis su srid mtsho skems par byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /dmigs dang brjod pa dang por bstan/ /2thun mong dang ni khyad par ro/ /gtso bo gzhal yas 'khor bcas dmigs/ /sems dpa' sum brtsegs la sogs pa'i/ /phra ba'i rtog pa gsal ba dang / /yid kyang shin tu ma yengs par/ /skyen dang bul dang yan lag nyams/ /sgra che ba dang sgra chung ba/ /gsang sngags tshig la sgra zhugs dang / /dmigs pa ma rdzogs 'joms pa dang / /the tshom za zhing nyes pa byung / /sgra rnams spangs la shin tu bzlas/ /shin tu mos shing brtson 'grus kyis/ /dang po mtshan ma thob bya'i phyir/ /thig le sngags dang 'od zer las4 / /'od zer dkar pos bag chags dang / /gdug rtsub ma lus zhi bar byed/ /snying nang brtson 'dra'i bzlas pa'o/ /'od zer dkar dmar 'phro 'du yis/ /nye bsnyen man ngag rab tu gsungs/ /gtso dang 'khor gyi bzlas pa yang / /mes su bsreg cing rnam par sbyong / /tshogs pa gtso 'khor bcas 5pa yang / /me gnyis chags 6pas nyon mongs bsreg /rang nyid ye shes lus su snang / /sgrub pa chen po'i 7tshul du bzlas/ /mgal rnge phreng bas kun la khyab/ /grangs ni rnal 'byor bye brag gis/ /sum 'bum drug dang bcu gnyis sogs/ /mtshan ma mthong ba myur du 'byung / /des kyang ma grub pa rnams la/ /bsnyen sgrub man ngag tshul du spogs/ /des ni mtshan ma mthong ba gsungs/ /rtags rnams byung bar ma gyur na/ /sdog sgrib shin tu che bas 25 — /bye0/

—na1 / /rgyud sbyong bzlas pa bar 'dir gsungs/ /lus ngag yid kyi rnam smin las / /sdig 'gyur dbyung dang bsreg dang bkru/ /mi snyug yig 'bru 'od kyi gzugs / /hūṃ dang re dang haṃ rnams la/ /ming gi yi ge rab bskul te/ /mgal me phreng ba nyi ma yis/ /rgyud rnams yongs su sbyangs par 4gsungs/ /spogs te bsten sogs gong bzhin bskyal/ /des ni mtshan ma'i rtags phyin 'gyur / /the tshom med pa shin tu gces/ /mtshan ma 'dod pa'i bzlas pa'o/ /khyad par bzlas pa'i man ngag yang / /bar du gcod pa'i 'byung bo la/ /bdag 'od dkyil 'khor lha la 'phros/ /'gugs shing dbang du sdud par byed/ /de la khro bo mang spros te/ /ral gri mtshon dang thog 'bebs dang / / gcad gtubs 5gzir ba'i sha khrag rnams/ /ma lus sha khrag mdun du bstabasadzi/ /ha ha ru lu sgra sgogs shing / /bstabs pa'i dus kyi bzlas pa'o/ /rang srung phyi la bzlog pa ba/nga / /khro tshogs 'khor lo thogs pa yis/ /snying dang klad pa 'khor lo 7bskor/ /bzlog pa dus kyi bzlas pa'o/ /rnga mo can gyi khro tshogs kyis / /phyogs su bzung 8nas 'phen par byed/ /bskrad nas tshar gcod don du gsungs/ /'od zer dkar po'i 9tshogs byung nas/ /lha la sogs pa'i sdig pa spyong / /tshur 'dus rang gi sdig pa spyong / /zhi ba'i man ngag rab tu gsungs/ /'od 'phros gang zhig gang gi stobs/ /ma lus basbus nas rang gi stobs/ /gzi brjid rang 'byung tshe yid gsos/ /bkrag dang gzi mdangs rab tu rgyas/ /'di ni rgyas pa'i man ngag go/ /ming gi sngags bzlas ting 'dzin ldan/ /'od zer kha dog rnam lnga 'phros/ /spos sogs lha mo rnams kyis gang / /gang la phul na don grub pa/ /mchod par 'dod pa'i bzlas pa'o//25—/502

rin chen tshogs bkang mchod pa yang / /gong ma bzhin du rab tu gsungs/ /'od zer dmar nag 'phros pa las/ /spyi bo gtsug 1gnas rnams su gzir2/ /'od zer snyegazhan gyis gsos 'debs pa/ /rengs par byed pa'i bzlas pa'o/ /dmigs pa don gyis 4bzlas pa yang / /rtsa rlung bde ba byang chub sems/ /yid la brten pa'i man ngag gam/ /rang gi hūṃ las 5'od byung nas/ /bdag zhu der 'dus bde thob pa/ /rdo rje tshig gis gsol 'debs shing / /dmigs pa stong nyid gsal ba ste/ /gsang ba dus kyi bzlas pa'o/ /rnam dag don la rab dmigs shing / /mi rtog snga phyi rgyu 'bras su/ /skyed par byed pa stong nyid gsal / /rdo rje tshig dang rab ldan pa/ /'di ni don dam bla med sngags/ /gsang sngags brjod pa ma lus pa/ /'di ru cung zhig bstan par bya/ /oṃ na mo be+e khāsbra ra dha rā ya/ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ badz+ra kro dha m+bi lāsba ra dha ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra kro dhe shwa ri mu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra 6ti sha ya de ba rā dza mu khaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba de ba mā 7ra ya/ stson+da stson+da hūṃ phaṭa/ sgyin+da bhin+da hūṃ phaṭa/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭa/ su ru su ru hūṃ phaṭa / mu ru mu ru hūṃ phaṭa/ nā sha ya nā sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ kṛ1 pa ya kṛd+dhā pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ha sa ya na ha sa ya na hūṃ phaṭa/ tī li tī li a mu ka mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de ba rā dza ba li ba li/ kṛhā kṛṇ+ḍa/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā 9rde ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ ldihūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shādzhai ku ru swā hā/puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ ba shaṃ ku ru ma ṇi dīḥ hūṃ/ mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ stam+bha ya/stam+bha ya/ nā ga rā dza/ nā ga rā dza1 / rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bi dh+wabe+e ཿya/ he bha 25—/503

ga bān ku ru ku ru/ ba shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a pasmra ra bi nā sha ka rā ya hūṃ/ sarba pre ta bi nā sha ka rā ya hūṃ/ oṃ shudhe shudhe bi sho dha ni bi sho dha ni/sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la sarba pā paṃ da ha ni dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭa/ha pa oṃ sa khri/ oṃ kṛt+ta kṛṇ+ḍa sarba sha hūṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nā ga bi tan nā ga rak+ṣa rak+ṣa yak+ṣa/ karma go ru pa ra bi tan/zhes pa'i tshig gis/ bsnyen pa la daspyor sham bu'i 4sngags/ /gcig tu byas la yongs su bzlas/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu yongs bskyed la/ /gsang sngags skyon rnams rab spangs nas/ /'dis ni 'bras bu 'byin pa las/ /las rnams gzhan gyis thob pa min/ /zhes pa ni/ sngags kyi man ngag gi le'u gnyis pa'o// //tshogs rnams khyad par 'dod pa yis/ /tshogs bsags nges pa 'di ru bstan / /'jig rten rdzas rnams ma lus pa'i/ /kun tshogs rang gis ma nyams bsham/ /rnal 'byor lha grangs bstun 5pa 'am/ /yang na rnal 'byor mang yang rung / /'tsham 6pa dang ni mchod pa dang / /de gnyis med du mi rung ngo / /rgyas pa'i tshogs 'khor dus su'o/ /sngon 'gros cho ga la sogs sgogs / /maṇ+ḍal lnga 'am bcu sogs la/ /me tog dang ni mchod pa dgram/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bri ba 'am/ /slob dpon rgyal pos sems dpa' bskul//phyi rol rnal 'byor nang du bsdu/ /de tshe rgyal pos mtshams rnams bcad/ /dge slong nub la dge tshul byang / /sngags pa lho la yon bdag dang / /rdzas rnams shar du bsag par bya/ /phyogs kyi dngos grub thob par gsungs/ /25—150(

rang rang nang du maṇ+ḍal bya/ /rgyal pos mtshams byas tshogs rnams bsag /bskyed de med pa las byung ba'i/ /rgyal pos bzhin ni thob bya ste/ /bde ba la gnas nyid dag las/ /lha mo bzhis gsol skur ldang ste/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas nas rgyal po len/ /so sor snagadan dang gsal ba las/ /bdag gis 'jug pa ji bzhin du/ /'khor rnams dam pa don la 'jug /mchod pa sgom dang sngon du sdogs/ /las dang bdag por 'byel pa yis/ /sgra dang ldan pas tshogs can dang ri / /dam tshig ldan pas byen gyis brlab/ /las kyis bsang ba'i cho ga yang / /yi re a las rlung me thod/ /nang du dam rdzas bcu ru dmigs / /yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /yang ni ye shes bdud rtsi phab / /bla ma rang dang lha mchod la/ /cho ga yan lag rdzogs pa dang / /lhag ma gcig tu bsdu bya ste/ /kha chus bran la mkha' 'gro bskang / /gsang ba'i don dang 'byel pa'i tshogs/ /tshes grangs bzang po shis pa la/ /nam phyed dus su bya bar gsungs/ /grogs kyi tshogs la nges pa med/ /zhi rgyas tshogs la sogs pa yang / /sngags kyi man ngag bzhin du gsungs/ /'di la rtag tu gnas pa yang / /bar chad sel cing dngos grub myur/ /'di yis 'byung gi gzhan gyis min/ /rgyal po la sogs pas tshogs bsag pa'i man ngag go / /4de ma nus pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'byor pa chung zhing bsam gtan ldan / /tshogs kyi mchod pa bstan pa yang / /rdzas ni lnga 'am bcu yi bar/ /khrob dpon gcig dang gnyis dang gsum/ /skyed de khyab byed bu mo yang / /rim gyis 'di ru bya ba yin/ /drang dang byin gyis brlabs byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor gcig pa'i bar du mchod/ /bzhi pa'i bar yang gsungs pa yin/ /25—1505

slob dpon nus pa bye brag gis/ /las ni gong dang 'og tu sbyar/ /mi rtsom 'di yis sdig pa sbyong / /'dis kyang las kun 'grub par gsungs/ /'bras bu gang 'dod nges par 'byin/ /tshogs kyi man ngag bstan pa ste le'u gsum pa'o / / //de nas rigs kyi bu'am bu mo/ /bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu myur du smin par 'dod / /sbyin sreg las la brtson par bya'o/ /sa chog la sogs gzhan bzhin te/ /sa yi rigs bzhin thab khung bzhi/ /zlum po gru bzhi zla gam e/ /thab khung dbyibs kyi mtshan nyid do/ /dkar ser dmar dang nag po snasnayang / /thab kyi kha dog nyid du gsungs/ /bru dang bri ba gang yin pa/ /sor gsum bzhi gnyis gsum yang dor/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma bri/ /thab la mtshan par rab tu bya/ /de yang rgyud las/ zhi la dkar po'i 2shing rnams te/ /rgyas la ser shing las rnams bya/ /dbang la seng ldeng shing bsregs te/ /drag po tsher ma nag po'i shing / /gzhan ni tsan+dan shing gis bya/ /zhes gsungs pas / rang rang gi thab tu rang dang bsdebs pa'i shing / zlum po la sogs bcer 4bar gsungs so/ /las mang po'i thab ni rin po che 'bar ba'am/bha ga lta bu'i dbyibs la kha dog sna tshogs par bya bar gsungs so/ /shing yang de nyid do/ /gzar bu rdo rje bzhi yi dbyibs/ /rdo rje rin chen chu srin gyi/ /rin chen las byas gzar bu brgyan/ /byin brlabs 5so so dbyibs dang ldan/ /mchod rdzas g.yas la sreg rdzas g.yon/ /mi dmigs tram̐ las 6rin chen snod/ /so so de nyid rgyas pa las/ /ha ho dī 7yis bdud rtsi sbyang 8/ /sku gsung 25—1506

thugs kyis 1byen gyis brlabs / /rang rdzogs rang gi sa bon las/ /'od 'phros mi dmigs hūṃ du gyur/ /de las me yi khang pa ni/ /rang gi gong ma'i —dbyibs dang ldan/ /me lha bskyed pa'i rim pa yang / /rja las gru bzhi'i de nyid 4gsum/ /so so'i 5kha dog dbyibs dang ldan/ /me zhu re las ye shes me//pad steng re bcas yi ge bzhi/ /so so'i 6me lha kha dog bzhi/ /so so'i rigs kyis dbu brgyan 7byas/ /zhi ba'i me lha bab pa ka /sgu mdog dkar po chu la gnas / /gro dha mi tra ma he tra/ /ma ta zhes pa la sogs pa/ /so so'i 9rigs kyi kha dog la/ /sna tshogs pa ru yang dag gnas/ /zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa la / /g.yas kyi dang pos 'dzin pa ni/ /dbyug pa bgrang phreng ral gri dang //lcags kyu nges par bsnams pa'o/ /gzhan yang phyag mtshan so sor 'dzin/ /ye shes spyan drangs dbang bskur zhing / /rgyan dang rgyas gdab 'thor 'thung rdzogs / /snying gar phyogs skyong bcu po rdzogs/ /so so pū 1rtadza rgyas pa la/ /dang po mchod pas mchod bya ste/ /gtso bo dang po man ngag kyang / /shing gi 'od ni skyed byed pa/ /mar gyis 'od 'phros kun la khyab/ /dkar gsum spyi yi sdig pa sel/ /bu ram lus la gnyis po yis/ /'og ma gnyis po so sor 'byin / /'bras dang 'bru yi chan dag gis/ /gong ma gnyis po so sor 'byen / /nas thug 'o ma'i thug pa yis/ /rnam smin re re gnas su bsreg /til gyis snying gi nad rnams 'byen/ /yang na til gyis sgo dgu 'byin/ /tha ma mar gyis bkru bar byed/ /rjas de ser por byas pa la/ /dmar ser zhi yis kun la khyab/ /dkar gnyis kyis ni gzi byen bskyed/ /mngar gsum phul bas gsal bar snang / /'bru dang 'bras kyi spyor ba yis/ /ye shes 25—/507

bcud rnams spyi bor sbud/ /nas dang 'o ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /'jig rten bcud rnams kun du sdud/ /tha ma drur 1ba'i bsang gtor gyis/ /tsā ru btso zhing dngos grub len/ /mar gyi dgang blugs gsum po yis/ /rgyas par byed pa man ngag sogs/ /bdag 2gi sbyor ba byed pa la/ /ba lang sha dang til la sogs / /dmar po sbyor ba phul ba yis/ /steng gi 'khor lo rab tu 'phros / /myur du 'gugs shing dbang du bsdus/ /gsad 4pa las gzhan tha ma yang /dang po khrag gis 'od du 'phro/ /de bzhin sha yis khro bar byed/ /rus pas steng gi 'khor lo 'phro/ /bdud rtsi'i ye'od 'phros sprul pa 'gyed/ /'bru nag sprul pas drag tu bsreg /dug rnams rdzas kyis 'gugs shing bsreg /yungs kar phye ma gsum po yis/ /'byung po ma lus thun gyis bsreg /tha ma mar nag srung zhing bsreg /me yi cho ga rdzogs pa dang / /snying gar bkod pa lha rnams la/ /so so de nyid rgyas pa las/ /gong du mchod pa bdun 'gyur rdzogs / /basbu dang gshegs su gsol byas nas/ /bzod gsol me yi sbyor ba yang / /gcig tu bsdus te dbul bar bya/ /bstod cing phrin las dngos grub blang / /nyis skor sum skor la sogs pa/ /gang gi man ngag don dang ldan / /tshe dang rigs sel rgyas pa'o/ /bsrung ba zhi ba cha la gdags/ /dgug pa dbang gi cha yin te/ /drag po las gzhan tha ma cha/ /dngos grub bzhi dang 'byel pa yi/ /'di yis 'grub pa ma gtogs pa/ /gang zhig gzhan gyis 'grub ma yin/ /des na man ngag nan tan gces/ /sbyin sreg bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //25—/508

las rnams ma lus 'jug pa la/ /kun gyi kha skong gtor ma shis/ /gtor ma las rab kun gyi mchog /las kun la ni yongs su bsngags/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gtor ma yongs su bstan to/ /phyi nang rdzas rnams ma lus ldan / /ma nyams rdzas kyis yongs su gang / /lhag 'gyur 'od zer kun du 'phros—/ /ram̐ gyis bsregs te yam̐ gis bus/ /khaṃ gis bkrus te dag pa las/ /yo re rten dang nyi zla bcas/ /sku gsung thugs dang rdo rje bcas/ /yo ram̐ dbab pa'i hūṃsbyor ba yis/ /ye shes bdud rtsi gnyis med 'dres/ /de dang gsang sngags 'dis kyang dgug /oṃ a ral+li 2ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya dṛ byu hoḥzhes zuganyis med bsre/ yi ge gsum gyis byin kyis brlabs/ /gdan gsum dang ldan ye shes tshogs/ /gnyis dang bzhi yi bar du mchod/ /rang gi rtsa ba'i sngags la ni/ /kha kha khā hi khā his dbul/ /grangs ni nyi shu rtsa gcig gam / /brgya 'am stong gi sbyor bas 'grub/ /bshags shing bstod pa dngos grub blang / /smon lam btab la gtor ma dgye/ /lan chags chu bo'i thugazhung la'am—/ /yang na ri rab rtse la bskyal/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i 5gtor ma yang / /rang rang cho ga byas pas 'grub/ /rdzas ma tshogs dang bsam gtan bral / /sngon bya med cing go rims )bral/ /'di ni bar chad spyor ba ste/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis spang bar bya/ /phyi yi gtor ma rgya chen yang / /sha chang spangs pa rdzas rnams tshogs/ /byin gyis brlab cing spyan drangs la/ /so so rang gi khyad par yang / /sngags dang tshigs bcad yongs su bsgrags/ /za ba rgyun gye gtor ma yang / /chags pa nyams pa tshig dang bral/ /mchod cing srid mtsho yongs bsgral ba/ /sems kyis yongs su zin pa dang / /rang gsal 25—1509

snying ga'i lha rnams bkod3/ /ye shes 'khor lo gnyis med bstem/ /zas ni sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /yo ram̐ spyor bas byen gyis brlab/ /yang na sku gsung thugs kyis so/ /byin gyis brlab la dbul bar bya/ /lce ni rdo rjer bsams la dbul—/ /lag pa lha dang lha mo 'am/ /gzar bu rdo rjer bsams la dbul/ /zos pas mnyes shing bldad pa bzhi / /rgyas dang phrin las la sogs kun/ /gong du bstan pa bzhin du bya/ /btung ba la sogs gzhan pa yang / /bdud rtsir byebyin brlabs gong bzhin mchod/ /chang sogs longs spyod byed pa yang / /nad sel btung ba bye sab yin/ /ci ran sman gyi tshod tsam mo/ /bdud rtsir byen brlabs ma 'thungs nas6/ /chags shing skom sogs 'thung byed pa/ /skye ba lnga brgyar smyon par skye/ /nad sel yongs su spang bar bya/ /dug lnga'i grogs su 'gro ba ni/ /'thung zhing spyad par bya ba min/ /'grol 7bas mchod pa'i dus su nga nga / /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub brten/ /thigs gsum lce la bzhag pa yang / /kā ya bāk+ka ketsit+ta hūṃ zhes brjod la reg par bya'o/ /zas sogs bdud rtsi thams cad kyang / /lag na rdo rjer dbul ba dang / /yang na lha mos dbul ba'o/ /rdo rje lce 'thung las byed pa/ /nang gi gtor ma bstan pa yin/ /'di ni rnal 'byor mchog yin no/ /sna tshogs stong pa ye shes dang / /dran med mtha' spongs spros bral ba/ /bla med gtor ma zhes ni gsungs / /gang zhig gtor ma'i spyor ba la/ /mi brten dngos grub sbyar rtab spangs / /zhes gsungs so/ /gtor ma'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //bsam gtan dag la ma mos shing / /mchod pa dag la mos gyur par / /25—1510

de yi gang zag gzung bar bya/ /dngos sam yid kyi mchod pa las/ /dang po dngos po mchod pa bstan/ /spos dang me tog mar me dri/ /bshos gtsang la sogs sbyor ba yang / /thams cad ma spyad snod du blugs/ /las kyi chu yis sbyar 1byas nas/ /bsangs te skyon rnams bsal ba las2/ /snod rnams tram̐ las rin chen snod/ /yon chab zhu ste yi ge a/ /de las yon chab dpag med gyur / /āḥnayis rtog sbyangs oṃ gyis 'bar/ /mchod pa gzhan yang de bzhin du/ /byin gyis brlab par bya ba yin/ /de ma nus pa'i gang zag gis/ /gsang sngags 'bru gsum byen gyis brlab/ /'di ni spyi rgyud man ngag go/ /yang na rgyud 'di man ngag yang / /yon chab la sogs man ngag yang / /ha ho dhī 4yis sbyang byas te/ /yon chab zhu bas yi ge āḥ5/ /de nas stong gsum yon chab bsdus/ /be+er la lha mo me tog ma/ /de yi 'od las me tog tshogs/ /bsnyen pa'i skabs su kha dog lnga/ /ldan par byas te mchod pa'o/ /mchod pa gzhan yang de bzhin byas6/ /yang na ming gi dang po la/ /hūṃ zhes pa yis byen kyis brlab/ /byin gyis brlabs la mchod pa yang / /seng ge glang po pad sogs la/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spyan drangs te/ /mdun du gsal bar bsam byas la/ /rin chen me tog mdun du gtor/ /rin chen la sogs gdan gyi mchod pa'i rim pa'o / /9yon chab thogs pa lha mo'i tshogs/ /dpag tu med pa mdun du sprul/ /rdo rje glu dang ldan pa yis/ /dang po lha mo sprul byas te/ /gnyis pa nam mkhar 7bzhugs pa gsal/ /gsum pa nam mkha'i rdo rje'i 1tshig /bzhi pa so so'i gnas su dbul/ /ā ha ra yi sngags bzlas pas/ /yon chab kyis ni phyag zhabs bkru/ /spos me shangs la me tog 25—1511

dbu7 / /de la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ /ming dang rang gi sngags rjes la/ /so so'i gnas su dbul bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang 'dod yon lha mo ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sngags rjes la/ /ta rngusha ra ti sngags bzlas pas/ /dkar mo gzugs ni spyan la thim/ /pad+ma ra ti sngags las byung //dmar mo sgra ni snyan la thim/ /karma ra nyi sngags las byung / /ljang gu dri ni shangs la thim/ /rat+na ra ti sngags las byung / /ser mo ro ni ljags la thim/ /badz+ra ra ti sngags las byung / /mthing ga reg bya lus la thim/ /shin tu 'akying bcas gyis 4mchod do/ /badz+ra gro dhī shwa ri brjod/ /sngags las mthing ka byang chub sems/ /bi shwa kro dhī shwa ri yis/ /ljags 5las dkar mo dri chen no/ /rat+na kro dhī sngags las ni/ /ser mo sha chen zhes su gsungs/ /pad+ma kro dhī sngags las ni/ /dmar mo khrag gi thod pa ste/ /karma kro 6dhī shwa ri'o/ /sngags las lja/nga gu dri chu'o/ /lha mo 'di dag thams cad kyang / /thal ba'i mtshan mas lus byugs shing / /dar dang zhing chen dril bu thogs/ /g.yas pa thod pa'i snod nang du/ /bdud rtsi so sor bkang nas su/ /rdo rje tshig gis ljags la dbul/ /gsang ba'i pū dza bstan pa yang / /badz+ra kro dhī gu khya yis/ /mthing ga byang chub sems yang gsal/ /dkar dmar ser dang ljang gu yis/ /gnas lnga phyi dang gnas lnga yi/ /nang du yang dag bstan pa yin/ /gnas gcig byang sems gsal zhing rgyas/ /'di ni rang 'byung bcom ldan 'das/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo mnyes pa yin/ /sgeg dang khro bo la sogs pa/ /rin chen sna bdun dag dang yang / /mchod pa nyi shu dbul bar bya/ /bdag dang lha mo gang gis dbul/ /yi ge oṃ kyis mgo brgyan cing / /rdo rje glu yis brten byas 25—/5sde2

te / /lha mo bskyed pas skyed snapar byed/ /rang gi gtso 'am gang byed pa'i/ /ming gi sngags kyis mgo drangs te/ /rdo rje lha mo'i sngags rjes la/ /pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes pas dbul bar bya'o/ /yang na badz+ra oṃ gnyis la/ /pū dza yang ni gnyis dang ldan/ /so so'i ming gi ring po la /mjug tu hūṃ zhes bya ba yin/ /tshogs rnams bsags pa'i man ngag la/ /las kyi sems dang 'khor gyi sku/ /mchod pa'i lha dang yum gyis su/ /bdag nyid mnyes par byed pa yin/ /gtso bo gzhan mchod mnyes pa yang / /dkyil 'khor gnyis dang gsum mnyes pa'o/ /rdzas dang bsam gtan phyag rgya sngags/ /rdo rje glu dang gnyis 'dus dang / /gsum 'dus la sogs mchod pa bya/ /dngos dang yid ni re re 'am/ /gnyis kas mchod par bya ba'o/ /srid pa'i mtsho las rgal ba dang / /thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /mchod pa byas pas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /des na bsgon 'grus bzang po yis/ /mchod pa rgyun du gsal ba gsungs/ /gzhan yang gsang sngags lam sgrub pa/ /rnal 'byor bla med sbyor ba yis/ /gsang sngags 'bras bu bsgrub par bya/ /bar chod bgegs sel dngos grub myur/ /rtsod ldan dbul phongs 5dus su ni/ /des na 'byung ba'i sku mthun bstan/ /don dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyes/ /mdzes pa maṇ+ḍal rin chen rgyan/ /de la bsgrub par 'dod pa yis/ /rin chen lngas mtshan sa brkos te/ /bdag las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa skyon dag pa brko bar bya/ /rin chen sna lnga rang bzhin te/ /srog chags med pa sa dang chu / /gnyis med bsres pa 'od du zhu/ /'khor lo pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan/ /yi ge gsum las legs grub pa'i/ /sku gsum 7lha ru gsal ba la/ /ye shes spyan 25—1513

drangs mchod nas bstem/ /gnyis med 'gyur te—la mchod phul te/ /'od dang sngags kyis bskul gyur te/ /'od zhu byang chub thig le 'am/ /yang na 'od kyi gong bur gyur2/ /byang chub tshon ga byegyi sgrum yang bsku/ / kong bu 5byin gyis brlab pa yang / /'od zhu me las nam mkha' ste/ /bcang ba kong h+phubu phra mo nyid / /rlung gis nam mkha' stong la guthim/ /brdabs shing gnyis med sngags sgra spyor/ /phyung bas bde gshegs ring bsrel 33ni/ /rin chen bzhi las legs phyung ba/ /bang 3snarim bzhi gnyis zur bzhi pa/ /dbu gsum lnga dang dgu sogs te/ /'od zer lnga dang ldan pa la/ /bzhag pas gdan steng /don byed 'gyur/ /stong las sdong mebu yum yin te/ /thig le lag pa yab tu gyur / /rlung gi stobs kyis bha gar zhugs/ /gnyis med dpal ldan sku mchog yin/ /bzhugs pas gdan steng 1bye don byed 'gyur/ /yang na nam mkha' stong pa las/ /brdabs dang sngags sgras lha mo bskul/ /nam mkha'i dbyings nas sku byung bzhugs/ /de dag gi ske5ni sngags gsungs pa/ /oṃ na ma ste yadhī sarba ta thā ga ta dṛ ngad ya/ gasgo dz+wa la z-i da ya/ dharma dh+wa tu snyegabye saṃ ha ra/ ā yuḥslosaṃ sho dha ya/ uṣ+ṭi 7ṣa bi ma le/ bi shudhi swā hā/ lha yi sku ru sgrub pa la/ /gsang sngags oṃ na mo nī lāsba ra zhes pa dang spel bar bya'o/ /rab tu gnas pa bsnyus pa yang / /ye shes spyan drangs mchod bstod nas/ /rang rang ngo bor gnas pa las/ /gnyis med bstems nyu la dbang bskur la/ /mchod bstod ma lus rdzogs par bya/ /phyag 'tshal yid kyis mchod byas la/ /rkang pa brgyud mar long btags la/ /mgrin pa'i sel snyan bskul nas ni/ /'od las rin chen pad+ma'i gdan/ /sdog sbyong don byas bsam pa bskyed/ /25—1514

bskor 1ba bya zhing smon lam gdab/ /khyad par ting 'dzin spros 2'dod na/ /sdog pa dbyung 1dang sreg pa yi/ /dz+wa la re dang gri 4ha dza/ /shusgo35haṃ gi sham bu 'am/ /phrin las bzhi yi sngags dang 'od/ /rang rang rigs kyis yongs su bstan/ /'byung ba mchod rten dag la mi brten pa/ /dngos grub sbyor ba kun spangs sdug bsngal dag dang phrad/ /sngon gyi bram ze blo gros mchog /tshe 'di nad med dngos grub kun dang ldan/ /shi dus dal 'byor lung bstan la/ /brten nas bla med thob kun gyis/ /lung bstan yin par bla ma gsungs7/ /mchod rten phra rab rdul du ma brlags 8par/ /mi de ngan song gsum du nam yang 'gro ma yin/ /mtshams med lnga byas 'bum tsho gcig gis byang 9/ /gong ma'i yon tan de bzhin 'phel bar gsungs/ /bar chod kun sel 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /mchod pa dang tshogs bsags 7pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de ltar tshogs rnams sogs pa la/ /bdud 'byung man ngag bstan par bya'o / /bdud ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /las kyi bag chags smin pa dang / /'phral gyi bar du gcod kipa'o/ /de la yang ni phyi dang nang / /phyi ni dad ldan gang zag la/ /pha ma mkhan po gnyen bshes tshogs/ /zhi bas log pa'i lam la 'dzud/ /tshogs drug ro la chags 'gyur zhing / /gzugs ni dkar dmar la sogs pa/ /gsal 'gyur mi gnas bdud kyi rtags/ /snyan dang mi snyan nying 'dzin nyams/ /bdud kyi rtags su bstan pa yin/ /nying nge 'dzin la bzhag pa'i tshe/ /rang bzhin med dris smad pa dang / /mang ba'i rigs la nyung ba ston/ /che ba'i rigs la chung ba ston/ /de las bzlog par shes pa 25—1515

dang / /dkar mo'i 1rigs la gzhan sogs ston/ /zab pa'i rigs la mi zab ston/ /mi zab pa la zab pa ston/ /grol ba'i rigs la chags lam dang //chags pa la yang bzlog pa ston/ /mtshan bcas la yang mtshan med rdzogs/ /dngos su sangs rgyas sprul pa rnams/ /gser dang g.yu yis spras pa la/ /zegs par lam rnams non no dang / /bstan bcos mtha' dag brtson 4zer dang / /sems can byang chub lam la yang / /dgod cing ma lus don rnams kyis / /de la sogs pa'i gdams 5ngag ster/ /'di ni phyi yi bdud du gsungs / /nang gi bdud kyi sbyor ba yang / /bsam gtan ting 'dzin dus la sogs/ /'du ba bskyed dang bsam pa bsgyur/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa rnams/ /med bzhin bskyed dang bsam log dang / /dam pa dag la ma mos shing / /rtag tu bsam la ma mos shing / /tha mal pa la chags pa dang //khro dang 'khon 'dzin 'chab pa dang / /phrag dog ser sna la sogs pa/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i 6nyon mongs rnams/ /bsam gtan ngang la skye 'gyur dang / /log pa'i shes pa bsam dgu rgyu/ /shin tu gdug rtsub drag po skyed7/ /sngon gyi 'bras bus rkyen bslang zhing / /rtag tu mig rtsa rgod pa dang / /de bzhin 'phyar dang g.yem pa dang / /zhum pa dang ni g.yem pa dang / /'jig rten log chos bla ma spong / /'di yang bdud kyis bslus pa yin/ /bsam gtan 'phro la mi gsal zhing / /nyams mi dga' zhing log la dad/ /zas dang skom la snga rol bas/ /chags par gyur pas 9de dag dang / /kun rdzob spyod la dga' ba dang / /phyag rgya rang gi rigs la brten/ /de las 7nyon mongs skye ba dang / /chags shing nus pa phrogs pa dang / /tshogs drug skye mched rnams 25—/516

su sbyar/ /log pa'i bla ma bsten pa dang / /yang dag bla ma dor ba dang / /sdog pa'i grogs po bsten pa dang / /bsam gtan mi mos log chos mos /'jig rten rdzas sogs chos rnams 'tshod1/ /'di yang bdud kyi rtags su gsungasabye —/ /sngar gyi chos 'dor gzhan dag 'dod/ /thar pa bde 'dod tshul yang 'chos/ /kha smra dbugs rgod mig rtsa grung / /thar pa yin zhes sna tshogs smra/ /'di yang bdud kyi rtags su gsungs4/ /bdud kyi brtag pa ma 5 shes na/ /'bras bu med de bdud kyis bslu/ /de la sogs pa'i trespyor ba rnams / /bsam mi khyab ste gzhan las shes/ /'di ru brtag pa mdo tsam byas / /mkhas pa rnams kyis mngon 7du dpyod/ /ces gsungs so/ /bdud brtag pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //yang dag rtags kyi man ngag kyang / /dngos dang nyams dang rmi lam gsum / /sngags grub gdon thub nad thon rtags/ /gsum dang drug tu bston chopa yin/ /yang dag don gyi bla ma la/ /sems bskyed dbang bsgur yang yang brtsam9/ /dam tshig mi brjed 7nan tan byed/ /rang rang rigs kyi chos rnams brten/ /khyad par sbyin pa tshogs sog cing / /dge ba'i grogs rnams bsten par byed/ /srid pa'i mtsho las rgal ba'i phyir/ /rgyu bcas dge la shin tu mos/ /gzhan la bskul zhing nyams sogs ldan/ /'di yang dngos kyi rtags yin no/ /me tog sngon po 'thu ba dang / /glegs bam dag la spyod pa dang / /chos kyi bgro ba byed pa dang / /gzhan gyis mchod dang gzhan la mchod / /stong gsum thams cad mthong ba dang / /nyi zla'i steng na 'dug pa 25—15/7

dang / /thod du bcings shing shar dang phrad/ /'khor lo klad la bskor ba dang / /mchod rten rtse la 'dzeg pa dang / /rags shing bkrag 1pa'i rgyan rnams thogs/ /gos sngon lus la gyon pa dang / /gos sngon sku gzugs mthong ba dang / /bde 2gshegs khang par phyin pa dang / /yid bde ting 'dzin gsal ba dang / /mi gtsang me yis bsreg pa dang / /khrag sogs lus las 'thon pa dang / /nang khrol bten 4cing chu gtsang shol/ /lus skrangs rnag sogs mang bo 'byung / /ngan sgyugs byung zhing bdud rtsi'i 5chu/ /'o ma dang 'dres 'khrud pa dang / /sha mdog sngo 'gyur bdud rtsi spyod/ /lus la mi gtsang gzugs byung na/ /me nang 6bsreg cing dri ma 'khru/ /rtag tu gcer bur 'dug pa dang / /rang la mtshon brgyab 7ral gris gtub / /stong nyid stong pa mthong ba dang / /bsams pas rmi lam ci yang med/ /mthong lam skyes shing lus dang bral/ /dngos kyi nyams la brten pa dang 9/ /dbang dang srung ba byed pa dang / /sems can dman la tshad med 'byung / /yang dag don la brod pa skyed / /sems can bdag dang 'dra bar sems/ /'khor bas skyo la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /sngon pas nga rgyal nyon mongs chung / /zab pa'i don la chog mi shes/ /dngos po rdzas la chags pa med/ /mig yang yun ring mi 'dzums shing 4/ /'jig rten gleng mo 'chol bar smra/ /mngon shes phra mo ston nus shing / /sems can sdug bsngal sel bar nus/ /gser sogs rin chen 'dod mi skyesatshi/ /rkang lag bcad kyang yid 7mi 'khrug /rtag tu sbyin pa gtong bar byed/ /ldang ba yang zhing zo mdog bde/ /'byung ba bzhi yi dgras mi tshugs/ /byang chub sems dpa' skye bdun no/ /gsang la dad cing yid 25—/518

ches so/ /rang gi lhag pa'i bla ma la/ /ci yod rin chen tshogs bkang dbul/ /bla ma rigs dang mthun pa nilku/ /mthong na dga' zhing man ngag la/ /the tshom med cing yid ches 'byung / /de yang lam zin gang zag go/ /gzhan yang grub pa'i rtags bye bstan pa/ /dang po bde ri —gshegs sku gzugs la/ /bde 4gshegs sku gzugs mthong ba dang / /'gul dang bzhad dang sgra 'byung dang / /'od dang du ba 'byung ba yang / /'di yang yang dag rtags rnams so/ /yon chab la sogs mchod pa la/ /rang gis byin brlabs 'bras bu 'byen/ /snang dang 'od dang sgra 'byung ba/ /'di yang yang dag rtags rnams so/ /sbyin sreg dngos grub tshol ba na/ /me bus sangs rgyas rab yin te/ /de las sgra byung 'bring du bshad/ /ma 5ni bdag gi dbang 'gyur zhing / /las dang mthun pa 'byung ba'o/ /gtor ma'i sbyor ba la brten pa/ /khol dang 'od sgra bskams pa dang / /gang dmigs la byin de dbang 'gyur6/ /rab 'bring tha ma go rims 7bzhin—/ /dung dang dril bu la sogs pa/ /ma bsgrags sgra rnams 'byung ba dang / /'jug pa nang rtags ye shes kyi/ /thams cad shes shing smra ba dang / /'gul dang shes pa brtag pa dang / /rab 'bring tha ma go rims 9bzhin/ /gzhan yang dkar dmar 'od gyur pa/ /gsal ba sgyu mar bsgom pa dang / /mi gsal gshegs pas gsal 'gyur ba/ /'di yang rab kyi rtags su gsungs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rtags rnams la/ /rab 'bring gong gi stobs su gsungs/ /mdzes pa lha mo bde ster dang / /gang zhig nam mkha' stong las bsgral/ /sdig spong dge la 'dzud pa dang / /bstan pa dam pa ston 'gyur na/ /yang dag rtags su 'di yang gsungs/ /nam mkha' lha mos dbang bskur dang / /25—1519

byang chub sems kyi chu 'bab dang / /mchod pa sna tshogs ster ba dang / /gzhan yang rtags kyi spyor ba ni/ /'ja' tshon dang ni sprin sngon dang / /nyi zlas stong khams gang ba dang / /de gseb nang na 'dug pa dang / /sbrul tshang rul zhing mtsho rnams bskams/ /tsan+dan tshal dang nor bu'i 1tshal/ /sman gyi sdong po gur kum spang ri dang / /sngon gyi ljon shing sdug bsngal sel byed cing / /'dir ni rtag tu rang 'dug zhing khang chen po dang / /mchod rten sku gzugs dag dang ni/ /bum pa sngon po rdo rje dang / /rtag tu thod zlon nyams sogs mdun du 'byung / /'di yang dam pa'i rtags yin no/ /khrag dang mchi ma dngos su 'byung / /yi dwags dbang du sdud nus dang / /yi dwags zil gyis mnan pa'i tshe/ /mnan 'gyur skad ngan tser sgra 'don/ /'o dod 4khyas 'debs byed pa rnams/ /'di yang gsang sngags grub pa'i rtags/ /gzhan yang bsam gtan byed dus su/ /dam chos dngos su brdar ma gdags5/ /phyis ni rjes su drin zhing 6shes/ /ma thos nges pa ston pa dang / /sems can srid dman gang 'khyams pa/ /snying rjes zin cing de don byed/ /tshul khrims ldan zhing gsang sngags mos/ /jeg pa thun mong gcig tu shes/ /nang du mu stegs chos rnams la/ /ma gshe rang rgyud zhi zhing des/ /sgyu ma rang bzhin med par shes/ /'di yang yang dag dam pa'i rtags/ /de la sogs pa dpag tu med/ /'byung bar 'gyur te gzhan las shes/ /de rnams gong du bstan pa'i skyed 7par byed/ /srid mtsho rgal byed srid pa'o/ /rtogs 8pas bskyed pa srid pa 'khor/ /zad par byed pa'i las rnams ni/ /mi rtag 'chi ba la sogs pa/ /srid pas 'jigs shing mi rtag pa/ /yud tsam las grub lo dang zla//25—/520

rtag par sems pa byis sems yin/ /thang cig yud tsam mi sdod pas/ /gsang ba'i bde ba myur bar bya/ /dam tshig dam 1pa sa gzhi yis/ /nan tan bskyed la bsrung zhing btsa'/ /de 'du bde ba spyod pa yang / /dal 'byor mi yis spyad pa ste/ /bsod nams las byung mi lus 'di/ /sa dug 2rim pa gsum pa ru/ /chu thigs 'byung bar shin tu dkon/ /dkon pa'i dus 'di thob pa la/ /mi rnams rgya mtsho'i gling du phyin/ /nor bu rin chen mi len pa / /bya ba la sogs g.yengs pa ni/ /skyes bu glen pa bdud kyis bslus/ /mi lus thob dka' rin chen 'di/ /thob nas yal bar 'dor ba yang / /skyes bu mi mkhas 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /des na brgal 4dka' 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /'di 'dra'i snyug bsngal zad mi shes/ /snga phyi dus su byung ba yis/ /rang nyes khrel zhing nyes 5pa brjod/ /tshe 'di'i bde ba thob dus su/ /thang cig yud tsam mi sdod par / /srid mtsho 'khor ba'i nang du rgyug /mi sdod rgyug pa'i bar 'di ru/ /rang gsos drag pos don bskyed de/ /dbang po ma nyams lus 'di yis/ /bsam gtan sngags bzlas brtson pa dang / /rang gzhan 'phags dang bla ma dang / /shin tu bla ma dam pa rnams/ /mchod cing gsol 'debs dge ba la/ /tshul khrims dam tshig ma nyams par/ /bla ma dkon mchog mi mos spang / /tshogs dang gtor ma ci nus bya/ /gal te dge 'dun 'dun pa dang / /dbul ba'i sems can ma lus pa/ /mchod cing sbyin pa mang du dgye/ /phyi 6mar gyur pa'i smon lam yang / /gtsang mar rgya cher gdab par gsungs/ /sgon lam las byung dge ba yang / /nam mkha' nam mkha' mtha' dang mtshungs/ /zad 7mi shes pa'i 'bras bu 'byung / /yang na 'byung ba de yi las/ /shin tu 25—/52/

bzhugs pas las rnams 'grub/ /kun rdzob la brten don dam dang / /thabs la ma brten shes rab dang / /srid pa'i bde ba ma brten par/ /thar pa mya ngan 'das pa med/ /des na gsang sngags nus pa yis/ /mi bslu 'bras bu 'byung ba ru/ /nges par gtso 1ru gzung bar gsungs/ /yang dag rtags dang rgyu'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //bdud kyi rtags rnams bzlog pa dang / /srid pa'i mtsho las rgal 2 'dod pas/ /dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /dam tshig sdom pa gtsang ba yis/ /nyes pa med cing bar chod med / /bdud rnams bzlog pa'i gtso ru gsungs/ /dang po gsang sngags sgor zhugs nas/ /lta ba spyod pa zung du 'byel / /gsang sngags las kyi gtso ru gsungs/ /lta ba gtan la ma phebs pas / /dngos grub 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas/ /bdud kyi bar chod bsal ba dang / /dngos grub myur bar 'dod pa yis/ /lta ba nyams su lon par bya//lta ba gnyis med yang dag log /dngos po rnams dang mi mthun pa/ /bsam mi khyab ste gnyis su 'dus/ /rtag pa dang ni chad pa'o/ /yang dag pa yang gnyis su gsungs/ /shes rab snying rje che chung dang / /chung ba 'di ru mi smra ste/ /shes rab che ba gnyis su gsungs/ /gsang sngags pha rol phyin pa'o/ /de don gtan la dbab pa ni/ /don dam pa dang kun rdzob po/ /yang na bden gcig 'dod pa dang / /khas len kun dang bral ba ni/ /rnam gcod 5med cing yongs gcod med/ /kun rdzob gnyis te dman dang mchog /dman pa gnyis te/ log pa dang ni yang dag go/ /log pa gnyis te smig rgyu dang / /25—1522

gong du gsungs pa'i grub mtha'o/ /shes rab ngan pa'i rtog pa'o/ /ma brtags gcig pu nyams dga' ba/ /skye dang 'jig pa'i chos tshul can/ /don byed nus pa snang ba la/ /de ni yang dag yin par gsungs/ /mchog ni dngos po 'di rnams kun/ /gzhal yas khang dang lha mo dang / /sems kyi rang bzhin sgyu mas mtshon/ /sems kyi snang ba bag chags tshogs/ /srid pa bla mar shes par gsungs/ /bla ma la brten bag chags tshogs/ /ngan song gsum las rgal 1bar gsungs/ /don dam pa yang rnam pa gnyis/ /phyogs snga 'dod pa rtog pa dang / /rang gi rtog pa gnyis su gsungs/ /phyogs snga rtog pa ngan pa rnams/ /yang dag don la skye ba med/ /med pa grub par 'dod par snang / /de tshe skye ba med grub na/ /med dang grub pa 'gal ba yis/ /phan tshun spangs pa mi gnas pas/ /med pa grub pa rigs ma yin/ /grub po zhe na rtogs 4par 'gyur/ /gal te skye med grub na ni/ /de ni chos tshul grub par 'dod/ /'gal skyon 5gnas par 'gyur ma yin/ /chos tshul grub pa rtog yin phyir/ /bsgoms kyang mi rtog thob pa med/ /dper na me 6shi tsha ba 'bar ba bzhin/ /yang / stong pa 7don dam ma lus pa/ /chos nyid rang bzhin mtshan ma zhi/ /mi 'gyur phyir na rtag pa yin/ /de la/ rtag pa yod na mi rtag yang / /chos tshul phye bas grub pas na/ /mi rtog ma yin rtogs par 'gyur/ /stong nyid mu stegs bdag yod du/ /rtag pa gcig pa grub par 'gyur / /kha cig rang bzhin med pa la/ /med las chos tshul rigs snang 'dod / /de bzhin sems kyis sems brtags pas/ /med par gyur kyang snang zhe na/ /mi rigs rgya mtsho mi dpog bzhin/ /mi dmigs gyur yang 9snang 25—/523

zhe na/ /de ni yid rtog dpyod pa ste/ /long bas zla ba'i gzugs dpog bzhin//kha cig dngos por 'dzin pa de/ /da ltar 1yod pa'i phyis med par/ /'dzin to de yi gzhung lugs la/ /phyis ni rtog pas med par 'dzin/ /yod pas med pa grub 'gyur na/ /mi rigs thug pa med par 'gyur/ /mi rigs rgyu 'bras 'dus byas bzhin/ /la la don dam gnas tshul la/ /rang bzhin med pa'i shes pa la/ /de dngos rang bzhin med par 'dod/ /zla phyed dngos la yod par 'dod/ /dper na byas pa mi rtag pa/ /ma byas rtag par shes par 'gyur / /de la sogs pa dpag tu med/ /rang gi 'dod pa'i ngo bo yang / /lung dang rigs pas shes pa yi/ /rnam grangs don la yongs 'das pa'i/ /khas len bral bas yongs su 'dod/ /dmigs sogs sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor can/ /lha mo shes rab stong pa yis/ /srid dngos bla ma stong par grol/ /dngos por snang ba 'di rnams kun/ /gcig dang du mar ma grub pas/ /shes rab kyis dpyad rang bzhin med/ /dngos por snang ba 'di rnams kun/ /smig rgyu chu zla bzhin du snang / /rigs pas grub pa'i shes pa la/ /chos can snang bar ngas ma mthong / /nges par 4brtags na rigs pa la/ /chos can chos tshul grub ma yin/ /gang yang ma grub gyur pa de/ /bla med don rnyed ces su gsungs/ /don de dngos po gnas tshul ni/ /ming med tshig med yi ge med//rtag med chad pa yod ma yin/ /de ltar yod par ma grub pas/ /med pa ma grub de yi phyir/ /de yi mtha' dang dbus ma grub/ /de ltar ma grub de shes na/ /phyag rgya chen por spyor zhes bya/ /de bzhin lung rigs du ma yi/ /rdo rje gzegs ma rten 'brel sogs/ /nges par brtags na grub pa min/ /zhib pa 25—/52

'di ru ma spros so/ /gsang sngags phyag rgya chen po yi/ /rang bzhin mi gnas spros bral yang / /thabs dang shes rab snang stong dang / /rigs 1dang bde la sogs pa yang / /rigs pas ci yang grub pa min/ /don dam rang bzhin gnas tshul yang / /rab tu mi gnas rang bzhin te/ /mi gnas pa yi ngo bor 'dod / /bden gnyis gcig gi ngo bo yang / /don dam spros bral stong nyid bsgom / /kun rdzob sgyu mas bsod nams bsag /de ltar rtogs pa'i man ngag kyang / /bla med bla med las byung gi/ /pha rol dbu ma pa la min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i gang zag la/ /lam la bar chod bdud med de/ /gang byas 'bras bu rnyed par 'gyur/ /lta bas man ngag rtogs pa ste/ /rigs pa bar chod myur du zhi/ /bar chod rang gi sems las byung / /des na shes rab mig tu gsungs/ /lta ba gtan la dbab pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //bdud rtsi lnga la spyod pa dang / /rig ma ye shes skye tshul gyis/ /gsang bas bzlog par bya ba ni/ /gsang ba'i spyod pas bzlog pa'o/ /cho ga bcu yis bshags pa dang / /yi dam lha la lus dbul zhing / /gsol ba 'debs shing skyabs su 'gro/ /cho gas dbang du sdud pa'o/ /bdag las byung ba'i khro tshogs dang / /lus las mtshon cha'i char 'bebs dang / /de dang drag po spyor sngags dang / /mi 'da' gsang ba'i sngags zlos pa/ /bdag 'od dbyebs las byung ba yi/ /thog 'be+ebs spyor ba rtsom pa dang / /me dang chu yi 'khor lo dang / /man ngag stobs kyis bzlog pa'o/ /yungs kar dang ni 25—1525

yungs nag dang / /skye tshe shang 1tshe gu gul dang / /dug 'bras brab cing rdzas kyis bsrung / /rdzas kyis bzlog pa'i man ngag go/ /mdun gyi snying du sems dpa' bskyed —/ /'od 'phros ye shes me 'bar ba4/ /'di yang man ngag stobs kyis bzlog /gang yang dmigs pa'i mgrin pa ru/ /a bsams de dang spyi bo ru/ /rtsa las 'khor lo bskor 5ba yang / /sngags dang ting 'dzin spyor ba ste/ /'di ni bsam gtan bzlog pa'o/ /rdo rje rtse gsum phyag rgya dang //dam tshig rdo rje sdigs mdzub kyis/ /rgya gram ral gri la sogs pa/ /phyag rgya bzlog par gsungs pa yin/ /dngos dang nyams la sogs pa ru/ /bkra shis 'khor lo dga' zhing sogs/ /chags par gyur pa rul myags dang / /dum bu lang ling rnam par bsam/ /shin tu khro bar 'gyur ba la/ /byams pa bsgom zhing dngos po btsal/ /snying rje la sogs skye bar 'gyur/ /gti mug la sogs chos rnams dbye/ /de bzhin mi dge gnyen po ru/ /dge ba ma lus bsam pa yin / /gzhan yang log pa'i don bstan na/ /bdag la chos dang chos can rnams / /rang bzhin med dang sgyu ma dang / /stong dang zhi ba sems kyi dang 7//cho 'phrul yin par shes pa yis/ /brda dang phyag rgya la sogs pa/ /don dang sbyar la sbyin par bya/ /thabs kyis ston na shes rab la/ /shes rab thabs la sogs par 9sbyar/ /glen pa'i lan yang myur du sbyin/ /bdud rnams spyor ba ma lus pa/ /nying 'dzin gsal zhing brtson 'grus drag /bdud rnams bzlog pa'i mchog tu gsungs/ /bar du gcod pa ma zlogs na/ /dngos grub med cing phyal bar gtong / /des na bzlog pa shin tu gces/ /bdud bzlog pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //25—1526

sbyor ba 'di yi man ngag bstan/ /gnas ni yid 'ong la sogs su/ /bsnyen pa rnam gsum rdzogs pa dang / /zhi ba la sogs so so yi/ /gang ltar 'dod pa'i sku bskyed pa/ /bsdu ba la sogs rdzogs pa yis/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas la sogs—/ /tshogs dang gtor ma bsngo zhing basbu/ /des kyang 'dul bar 'gyur ba yin/ /yang na de yi sbyor ba la/ /rkang pa g.yas pa ral gri la/ /g.yon pa lcags kyu'i kye7sbyor ba yis/ /khro bo mi g.yo bsgom bya ste/ /g.yon pas bkug cing g.yas pas gtub/ /ral gris 7gsang sngags bzlas pa dang / /gdab pa yang ni de bzhin 5no/ /yang na gzir ba'i cho ga ni/ /nad pa'am ni gzugs dag la/ /dmigs pas legs par bkug byas nas/ /rkang pa g.yas pa ri rab la/ /rgya gram 'bar bas mtshan pa'o/ /rgyal chen phyogs skyong gong dang 'og /bang rim rnams la nges par bsam/ /pus mo chu srin rgyal mtshan te/ /mkha' lding rgyal po rab tu khros/ /gnas lnga las dang sbyor ba yis /g.yon pa lcags kyu'i 5sbyor ba yis/ /bkug pa la sogs sbyor ba yis/ /snying gar mnan gyur drag sngags dang / /'byung po khrag tu 'thon 'gyur te/ /ma mo mkha' 'gros 'thung bar byed/ /mi bzod smre sngags 'don pa dang / /lus las bral zhing 'bros par 'gyur/ /yang na snying nang re las me/ /'bar zhing shin tu 'bar ba yis/ /gnod sems gtor zhing 'bros par 'gyur/ /phyogs skyong gang dang 'dul ba yidz+wa/ /gong ma 'am ni khro bo bcus/ /gzir zhing rang la srung bar dābyed/ /lha chen po yang 'dar zhing 'bros/ /bar chad 25—1527

byed pa gzhan yang sel/ /'bros par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /mdangs la rgol ba'i gdug pa yang / /khyad par klu yi sbyor ba ste/ /rigs bzhi la sogs klu rnams la/ /gzir ba mkha' lding lnga po ste/ /dgongs dang bka' brgyud 1gzhan rnams dang / /'dir yang 'os pa 3rab tu bsten/ /yang snying pad+ma 'bar ba tsam/ /dus grangs la sogs bskyar —ba yang / /ha pa la sogs ga 4ru ḍas/ /shin tu grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /lnga la lnga ni legs gnas te/ /lnga po yi ni spyor bas 'dzin/ /pus mo dpung pa nu 'jing thudrug /thogs med 'khor lo rab tu bsam/ /byin rlabs 4nus dang ldan pa yis/ /rdo rjes brdeg cing lcags kyus 'dzin/ /sbyor ba 'di ni dam pa'o/ /gang yang rung bar 'dod pa yis/ /klu gnyen bde gshegs skur gnas te/ /g.yas pa rtse lnga thogs med lnga/ /rang gi sa bon 'og tu gnas/ /g.yon pa rtsa las byung ba ste//sum̐ las rin chen rdo steng du/ /khro las byung ba sna lnga bsam/ /'od zer gyis ni legs bkug ste/ /lus dang ba spu'i /thumatshams rnams su/ /nus dang ldan par byas pa la/ /bdag 'od bu ga dgu sogs zhugs/ /lte ba 'khor lo bskor 8byas te/ /g.yas kyi rdo rje spar byas te/ /g.yon pas len par byed cing 'don/ /g.yon sbyor la sogs man ngag kyang / /mdangs rgol nad la shin tu bsngags/ /yang na me gnyis sreg 9par byed/ /yang na 'khor lo brgyad 'bar bas/ /gnas brgyad du ni bsam byas te/ /bsregs pa rlung khogis gtor byas terngu / /bkrus pa byang chub thig le las/ /dpal ldan skur gyur byin gyis brlab/ /dbang thob sku yi gsang sngags bzlas/ /yang na zangs sogs dmar po'i snod/ /gzugs byas yongs su bskor ba las7/ /25—1528

bdud rtsi gso zhing mchod pa las/ /de nas rang gi gnas su bskyal/ /des kyang dul bar 'gyur ba yin/ /khyad par can gyis bdag dang gzhan/ /gdul thabs gnyis phyir bsal tshothabs gnyis/ /myur du gnod sel nus pa yin / /de bas 'di ni thabs kyi mchog /sbyor ba gzhan la yod pa min/ /bar chod kyi bgegs bzlog pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //mi rgod la sogs ma rungs pas/ /gtses shing chos la gnod byed pa / /gnad la bor ba'i dam tshig ni/ /dur khrod mkha' 'gro 'du gnas su/ /drag po gru gsum dug gis bri/ /rkang rjes gos sogs bag zan dang / /bsres te mi rgod gzugs byas la/ /de yi snying gar ming kyirus gzhug /tsha ba bskyed pa'i sbyor ba bya/ /de la tshon skud rnam lngas 4bcing / /rabs chad thod par gzhug pa yin/ /rang bskyed rang gi cho ga rdzogs/ /bde gshegs mchod mu dang chos skyong sbyin/ /de yang dṛ 5las gzugs su gyur/ /bdag las sprul pa'i khro tshogs kyis/ /dpag tu med pas 'jig rten bkang / /gzung nas khrid par byed pa la/ /rdo rje 'gugs pa'i gsang sngags bzlas/ /khro bo mang po sprul pa khros/ /gang gis dngos po gzung ba yis/ /gnyis med bstem la las kyis mnan/ /thogs lnga la sogs myos su gzhug /ye shes 'go ba'i lha rnams kyis/ /gshegs shing srog rtsa bram ze'i 7gzugs/ /gdug pa'i khro mo sbyar mas bdug — /khros pa'i stabs kyis khrag 'byin cing / /rang gis ro la za bar byed/ /bdag dang ye shes khro bo yis/ /sprul pa thogs 6lngas 'byed par byed/ /phyi ma gsum gyis gsad pa dang / /zeg chen sbyor ba'i las bya yi/ /25—1529

dkyil 'khor kun gyi gsang sngags kyis/ /gsad 1cing mnan pa'i las rnams bya / /yang na gsad rtepa'i dam pa ni/ /lcags dang rigs mthun gyur pa la/ /khro bo de dang mthun byas la/ /dkyil 'khor gsum dang 'byel pa yi①/ /phur bu kho nas gsad 4pa yi/ /ki li'i snyesngags brjod gdab par bya/ /ral gri tho ba gri rnams kyis/ /gtub cing gsad thudang rdzas rnams ni/ /yungs kar yungs nag phye ma gsum/ /bdug jepa'i 'bru rnams ma lus las/ /khro chung gdug pas brab nas 'brub/ /drag sngags bzlas shing thun rnams brdeg /bsnun cing gtub pa'i rdzas dang gzugs/ /mnan sreg gsad ༄ —dang 'phang ba dang / /yang dang yang du dgug pa dang / /thugs rjes 1bag chags sbyang ba'o/ /gzugs can gdul ba'i las rnams bstan/ /mdze can rabs r+shachad thod pa ru/ /'khor lo gzhung dang mthun pa la/ /dug dang pyos pa'i chu sbyar te/ /sbrul nag sbyor ba mdze can khrag gis byas nya/ /de la dgug pa sngon 'gro bas/ /lus nang nang nas lcags sbrang mang / /lus nang sbrul nag sbyor nas ni⑩/ /be+egs sdig srin bu la sogs pas/ /ba spu'i snyabu gar sbyor byas na/ /de ni mdze yis 'chi ba yin/ /de bzhin 'khor lo nag po'i wīsteng / /gang yin sgos su gsal byas nasas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab phung las bu/ /stong gsum sbrul nag dgug cing bstem/ /sbrul las lcags sbrang gzi lngam yis/ /ba spu'i ⑫bu ga nas zhugs pas/ /me yis bsregs pa 'byung ba yi/ /'di yang thabs kyi dam pa yin / /byang du bltas pa'i chu mig tu/ /thod pa dum bu drug yod par/ /gang yin ming rus sbags te gzhug /sbrul nag sa srin la sogs bstem/ /yang yang bkug la mnan pa yis/ /zhag bdun kyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /25—/530

'di ni gsad byepa'i dam pa'o/ /yang na ma mo'i 5sbyor ba yang / /bud med thod pa lcang lo nang / /dri rgod snying la rab bsams te/ /bdud rtsi lnga byas liṅga la/ /lnga pa la sogs phral byas na/ /snying nang ma mo'i —sbyor ba yis/ /khar blugs gyur na myos nas 'chi/ /thod pa glad 5pa 'khor lo bskor5 / /dug dang myos pa dug khrag dang / /lug dang glang gi khrag dag gis/ /sbyo byed spyor ba rab byas shing / / mkhar ba'i 6thun yang rab tu brdeg /ma ma rak+ṣa kha thun tra ma hi hri ti ru lu ru lu bh+yo/ zhes bod cing rbad par bya'o/ /dgug pa sngon du song ba la/ /mdun du ma mo khrag 'jib pas/ /phur bus spyi bor gdab byas na/ /rkang pa khrag 'thung 'jib pa yis/ /de ltar byas pas skya slam 'gyur/ /yang na spyi tshags gyur pa la/ /mdun du skyi thutshags rdo rje brdeg/yang ni kha dog nag po la/ /mgon bo me yi phreng ba bskul/ /sum skor 'od kyi phreng ba yis/ /rdo rje spyi bor zhugs gyur nas/ /'od zer snying nag sreg par byed / /thig le dag kyang 'joms pa yin/ /yang na 'od zer nag po yang / /lte ba'i 'khor lo bskul byas te/ /me 'bar stobs kyis sreg pa dang / /spyi bor khu ba bkug nas ni/ /rkang pa me nang sreg par byed/ /yang na za byed la 9ru sreg /yang na rdo rje yi ge gsal/ /spyi nas gsang ba rdo rje rgyab/ /bshang ba'i yi ge bshig ⑫pa yin/ /yang na snying gar re las me/ /me nang me yis sreg pa dang / /dbang phyug la sogs bdud chen rnams/ /tshe yi tshad kyang 'jig par 'gyur/ /spyor ba 'di ni byas tsam gyis/ /gang ltar 'dod pa myur du grub 1/ /yang na dbang phyug mthu chen gyimu/ /rig pa 'di yi spyor ba yis5 / /nag po tshes gcig zla ba ngal/ /dmigs pa chu yi 'od zer la/ /25—1531

sbyor ba 'di ni byas tsam gyis/ /dug dang me yi sbyor ba yis/ /rtag tu 'chi bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /gang yang myur du 'grub pa yin/ /sbyor ba 'di yi man ngag kyang / /bla ma'i srog la gnod pa dang / /dkon mchog bstan pa bsgrub 1pa dang / /rang srog gcod par byed pa la/ /spyor ba 'di ni bya ba las / /gzhan la byas na dam tshig nyams/ /bar chod bsal ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //dngos grub khyad par 'dod pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rtags rnams la//rab gnas byas pa thob par 'gyur/ /des na rab gnas cho ga la/ /yid dang mthun pa'i gnas dag tu/ /dang po bsnyen pa skyel ba yis/ /gtso bo 'bum la 'khor rnams khye/ /yo byad sogs la bskyal ba yin/ /lha dang bum pa la sogs pa/ /sta gon lhag par gnas par 5byas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rtags rnams la/ /dang la rdubagegs bsal byur phud la/ /phur bu sbyin sreg chang phud gtor/ /me la phul zhing bskor byas nas/ /thal ba'i sbyin sreg phyi ru bskyal/ /dbang stegs dag la khrus rnams byas5/ /dang po dri chu dang sbyar ba'i6/ /mngar gsum a ka ru la sogs/ /me long sbyin nam drur 3bas bkru / /lhag gnas slob ma cho ga rdzogs/ /dkyil 'khor bris la yongs su bsgrub / /dang po dbang bskur rab gnas la/ /slob ma bcug hūṃste dbang bsgur bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rtags rnams la/ /rang rang sku gsum lhar bskyed de/ /byen gyis brlab cing dbang bskur ni/ /me long bzhin du /chu dbang bskur/ /des na de la dbang rnams rdzogs/ /rang gi sngags sam 25—1532

gzhan rnams ni/ /badz+ra satwa zhes pa yis/ /gang gi stobs kyis gong du gnas/ /yang na spu 1rnams so so la/ /rang gi bdag po gtso 'am gang bskyed la/ /dbang bskur la sogs gong bzhin bya/ /lha khang sgom pa'i rten yin pas/ /ye shes byin brlab gong bzhin bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phreng ba rnams/ /ye shes rdo rje dri ④phreng rnams/ /ā li kā li ye shes dang / /byin gyis brlab pa tsam yang bya / /de nas mchod bstod la sogs pa/ /rgyas par byas la dkyil 'khor bsdu / /rdul tshon chu bo'i 5gzhung la dbo/ /de ltar slob dpon de la yang / /ci 'byor pa yi yon rnams dbul/ /dga' ston bya zhing smon lam gdab/ /des ni bsod nams chen po thob/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rtags rnams la/ /rab tu gnas pa ma byas na/ /mu stegs lha rten dang 'dra bas/ /des na rab gnas bya ba gces/ /rab tu gnas pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de la de yi sbyor ba yis/ /phyi dang nang gi khrus bstan pa/ /rdzas rnams tshogs pa'i bum pa la/ /lhag pas bum pa sbyang byas te/ /pad+ma bzhi ste 6gos sngon bskyed/ /bskyed de cho ga rdzogs gyur nas/ /dag par byed pa'i sngags rnams kyis/ /ye shes chu bor byin brlabs te/ /nam mkha'i 7lha mos snod thogs nas/ /lha mos rgyun phab chu bo yis/ /gang la bkrus pa tsam gyis na/ /'thor bas dag par byed pa dang / /dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba yin/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor rnams kyis ni/ / des na khrus la brtson par bya'o/ /rdo rje khrus kyi le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //25—1533

de las dngos grub mchog 'dod pa/ /rnam grangs don ni rab brten la/ /thabs kyi lam ni rab tu bstan/ /dang por mtshan bcas mtshan med la/ /nor bu 'phel bar byed pa yin/ /rten gyi man ngag cung zhig yang / /gang zhig spyi bo khang pa ru/ /bdun cu gnyis sam drug cu bzhi/ /sum cu gnyis dang brgyad dang bzhi/ /mkha' 'gro rtsa grangs bzhin du'o/ /kun brtags rtog pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /ā li gnyis dang kā li gcig /brgya sgodang 'byung bzhi yang dag ldan/ /de ltas de las ye shes 'bar/ /steng dang 'og tu rgyu tshul ni/ /dbang po 'gag par byed pa yin/ /yang na tshangs nas smin mtshams bar/ /rtsa lnga kha phye sbyong ba yis/ /skye mched yul rnams sbyong ba'o/ /snang ba mtha' yas gnas dag tu/ /bzhi bcu 'am ni sum cu gnyis/ /bcu drug brgyad du snang ba la/ /'byung bzhi ā li bcu drug ni/ /g.yas dang g.yon du 'khor bar gnas/ /dbus kyi oṃ ni dpa' bo'i 2bdag /dbang gi dga' bzhi skyed pa dang / /yang na bde chen kha 'byed cing / /'byung 'jug 'di la gnas pa yis/ /bde ba chen po 'grub par 'gyur/ /snying gar brgyad dang 1bcu drug bzhi/ /dbus su dhū 4tī g.yas g.yon du/ /la la nā snyedang ra sa nā'o/ /ā le kā li thabs shes rab/ /byang chub thig les nyon mongs shing //'byung ba bzhi dang yi ge yi/ /dang po brgyad pos yongs bskor ba6/ /thig le las byung 'byung ba bskul/ /thig le ye shes la brten zhenas/ /dbang gi dga' bzhi'i tshul du bskyed / /'byung ba dang ni 'jug pa dang / /gnas pa stong pa bdag nyid de/ /gang zhig 'di la rtog gnas na/ /rnal 'byor bde ba myong bar byed/ /yang na 9snying ga nas spro tiba'i/ /rtsa lnga khrag dang chu dang 25—1534
