yang / /byang chub sems kyi thig le las/ /mdung dang ral gri nges pa 1la/ /mgrin pa pad+ma kha 'byed pas/ /phyogs su gzhol zhing slob pa yin/ /kha phye thig le 'gro 'ong dag /'byung dang 'jug pa 'dir bslabs pas/ /rnal 'byor bde ba myong bar byed/ /re re 'am ni lnga lnga bar/ /rnal 'byor slob ma bde ba'i lam/ /lte ba sprul pa dpa' bo bdag /brgyad dang nyi shu sbyor ba yis//ka li phyed bcas bcu bzhi brgyad/ /a nas dga' 4bo rlung stobs kyis/ /rtsa lnga snying gar slob pa dang / /dpa' bo 'gegs par byed pa yin/ /kha cig slob pa'i dus dag tu/ /bzhi ni so sor slob pa ste/ /bzhi ni gcig tu slob pa'o / /nyi ma rdo rje rlung gis gsor/ /la la yi ge thig ler 'dod/ /gcig ni sdud par bslabs pa yis/ /stong pa me las rnam rtog sreg /dbang gi dag pa dam pa'o/ /bde ba chen po thob par byed/ /gang yang sbyong ba 'di dag ni/ /nyi ma me ni lte bar 'bar/ /yi ge thig les yang dag gsos/ /dbang gi dga' bzhi dag pa yis/ /dbyings la thug nas mar la byung / /'og gi badz+re 'khor lo la/ /dbab dang bzlog dang 'grub pa yang / /'khor lo bzhi yi dbang du gsungs/ /rigs gzhan chags pa'i gang zag gis/ /rigs gzhan pho nya'i 4sbyor ba bya/ /gang tshe rang gi rigs mthun nam/ /la las skyes pa'i bu mo dang / /ye shes bu mo sprul pa dang / /g.yon gyi yum dang snying ga la/ /byin gyis brlabs dang gnyis med sbyor/ /rtag tu dam pa bde ba dang / /'di yi spyor bar dga' ba rnams/ /rim gyis phyag rgya'i 5dngos grub 'grub/ /'byung ba'i bu mos sbyor byas shing / /dbab dang bzlog pa'i man ngag gis/ /rtse la phyin nas nub byang 'gyur/ /tha ma las kyis 6dus 25—1535

byed——rnams su/ /rked 1pa tha kus bkyig pa dang / /dbus dang lus kyi bzlog pa yin / /thabs ni kun nas rdzogs pa ru/ /ri lu phreng bas mgul nas thogs / /sprul gyi zhags pa'i spyor ba yis/ /kun nas 'phros pas dngos grub 'byung / /gang nas rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /rtag tu bde ba ster bar byed/ /ye shes bogs dang dbang bskur gnyis/ /gzhan gyi las su ma gsungs te/ /de nas de spangs dngos grub 'byung / /zhes pa'o/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi sgom pa yis/ /'dod pa rdo rje bzhin du 'grub/ /zhing khams gang dang gang yang rung / /sprul pa byen brlabs phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /'di yi spyor ba dag 'gyur na/ /zhing khams gtsang mar skye bar 'gyur/ / man ngag ngan song 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i rdzogs rim gyi le'u bstan pa ste bco lnga pa'o// //yang na 'khor lo spyor spangs pas/ /bcu drug brgyad dang bzhi yi dang / /dbus su byang chub thig le bsgom/ /stong nyid yongs chod bral ba la/ /sgom med goms par bya ba'i yul/ /gnas dang mi g.yo bde ba dang / /rtog bral rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /tha snyad ma grub bde chen dang / /thig le nyams len shes pa yis/ /srid rtse sna gsum mthar phyin nas/ /mthong lam byang chub myur du 'byung / /de las srid gsum bgrod pa yang / /skye ba rmi lam bar do ru//thig le mi rtog stong nyid yang / /thig le ye shes de dang las/ /rnal 'byor bde ba chen po yang / /ma lus cig shos 4mtha' dang bral/ /srid gsum rang bzhin 'phro 5ba yang / /'bras bu stong nyid 'byin pa ste/ /'di ni rnam shes 25—1bye36

'pho 'jug go/ /zhes lung las gsungs so/ /mtshan med kyi man ngag bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //gang zhig 'di la rab bcom napas/ /zla ba drug gam bcu gnyis na/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 2rab tu thob/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sprul pa'i byin rlabs sna tshogs pas/ /rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma/ /pho nya tshogs 'khor thams cad kyis/ /rtag tu byin brlabs /bde ba ster/ /bdud dang gnod sbyin lha klu'i 4tshogs/ /ma lus gnod pa zhi bar 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal nad la sogs pa rnams/ /ma lus myur du thar 5bar 'gyur/ /thun mong dngos grub ma lus 'grub/ /gzhan don ma lus lhun gyis grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /gang yang gsang ba'i man ngag 'di/ /dam tshig sdom pa nyams pa dang / /gsang sngags phrag khyer 'tshong ba dang / /bla ma mi gus le lo can / /dbyar gye tsan+dan lta bu ste/ /mkhas pa brten pa mi brten par/ /glegs bam mthong bas khengs pa la/ /tsan+dan sprul gyi shun pa 'dra/ /gsang ba'i don dang phyi lam bsre/ /la la log pa'i chos dang bsre/ /gang zhig ster bar gyur pa ste6/ /tsha grang ngan song sdug bsngal myong / /mkha' 'gro byad ma srin po dang / /ro langs la sogs kun gyis gsod/ /gsang ba 'di yi don rnams dang / /rang srog gces dang nor bu dang / /dri mchog ga bur bzhin du btsa'7/ /gal te btsa' 8ba ma shes na/ /seng ge'i 9'o ma snod nang du/ /khrugs pa ji bzhin 'bras bu med/ /gsang ba 'di yis brlag 7par 'gyur/ /gang gi don las log pa'i snod dang ldan pa la/ /gsang ba 'di yi man ngag yang / /rang gi rang don len pa bzhin/ /de la ma lus sbyin par bya/ /nor 25—1537

la bltas te gsang don bcad/ /gsang ba srid pa'i rgyu la byin/ /ma mos btsongs pas dngos grub yal/ /seng ge'i 'o mas snod 'jig bzhin/ /srid tsho 1ngan song gsum du 'khor/ /'bras bu tsha grang sdug bsngal myong / /des na bu dang 'dra bar sbyin/ /des ni 'bras bu bde ba 'byung / /gzhan gyi shugs 'byung ma lags 'di la dga' ba skyes/ /khams gsum sems can srid mtsho dag las rgal phyir dang / /rdo rje be con gsang ba'i don — la sogs pa ma lus pa / /rang nyid mos dang gsang jethabs rnams/ /rdzogs par kun la bstan phyir bris/ /rnyed pa la sogs grags phyir min/ /man ngag bla ma dang 'dra lam 'di bstan/ /lag na rdo rje'i rgyud 5la sogs pa khum nyams bya ba'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i don rnams thabs kyi yan lag tu/ /man ngag rgyas par bstan pa'i tshogs rnams dang 7/ /las kyi bag chags 8ngan pas ma grol yod srid cing / /tshig dang don la nyes pa yod srid pas9/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa dang / /bla ma mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /sems can lam gnyis ma lus bsgral ba dang / /bdag dang sems can thams cad kun/ /rags dang phra ba'i rtog pa yongs zhi nas/ /sdom gsum lam gyis srid pa yongs rgal 7nas/ /tshul khyems gtsang mas gsang ba'i don rnams zhugs/ /phyag rgya chen po don nyid rab mthong zhing / /de ma mthong ba'i ma lus sems can rnams/ /sdug bsngal skyed pa'i kun 'byung rtsad gcod cing / /g.yan pa mdze 'bras nad rnams rab tu zhi ba dang / /sbug bsngal rgya mtsho rab tu skams pa dang / /gos sngon dngos grub myur thob cing / /zhing mchog gtsang mar skye bar shog /de kho na nyid sgon ma zhes bya ba'i rgyan/ bla ma'i man ngag rgyud ma chad pa/ de kho 25—1538

na nyid nyi zla snang ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub 1 thabs chen po dge slong klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / lo tsā 2ba glang dpal gyi seng ges bsgyur ro / / slad kyis kyang paṇ+ḍi tas 4rgya gar phyogs 5nas sgra rang 'gyur du bsgyur ro/ /bi la thubadz+ra las bla ma sman btsun khros pa la gnang / des dngos la gcadapar ba 'babakabag skrag// //7bsdur mchan/1488 3mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke kho na nyid sgon ma dge slong klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa bzhugs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da sa na ta/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sras/ri〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7a ti/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7mdzad/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rithams cad/ dz+wa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grub/ na〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da lam/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉byedang / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrog1489 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masang brtson 'grus dga'/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shed/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rdzas/ rnyi〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra srung / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rlabs/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sad/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpa/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatub/ /sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/149༷ snasna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatsal/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thader/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drangs—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazung / — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉( / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsdu ba/ 9 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dpad+ma/ rka〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/1491 lku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sted/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da la/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lha/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnam/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dang / kho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shaṃ/1492 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snga/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngagril/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorakhrang / 6〈〈pe 〉rnamad gos sngon sham thabs can/ 〈〈snar 〉〉stod gos sngon stod g.yogs can/7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorakhris/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacu/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da mchod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gini/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ste / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra der/ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sgobs/ —〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dge/25byed1539

༄za/ /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga thams cad jogs pa zhes bya ba/rte༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya badz+ra pā ṇi nī lāsba ra dha ra sarba maṇ+ḍal bi dhe nā ma a ti/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gye cho ga thams cad rdzogs pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad stong pa chen po'i mchog /mnga' brnyes phyag na rdo rje la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal te/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bdag gis bshad/ /rkyen thub sa non yan lag rdzogs/ /ting 'dzin dbang thob gzugs bzang zhing / /log pa'i lam spangs mang pos bkur/ /de sogs yon tan kun ldan pas/ /yid dang mthun pa'i dben pa 'am/ /yang na nyams dga' bkra shis gnas/ /ri zlum dag gam chu bo'i 'gram/ /byin che yon tan lnga gnas su/ /stegs bu sdon po mdzes pa la/ /me tog sngon po gcal bkram ste— / /steng du gos sngon 25—1545

sku gzugs gzhag1 /yan lag ye shes bskyed ldan pas/ /mchod pa'i cho ga sngon btang nas/ /phyi nang dgug dang ba༄stems 2la gnas/ /sngags kyi bsnyen pa 'bum sogs bya/ /yang na mtshan ma gsum thob pas/ /bsgrub pa'i cho ga brtsam par bya/ /rab tu brtags pa'i sa gzhi la/ /zlum la mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal brtsig /steng du dpal ldan dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /spyan drang byin brlabs dbang bskur nas/ /phyi nang mchod pa ci 'byor dbul/ /stong pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas phyogs skyong srung gem dgug /oṃ in+d+ra ye hūṃ dzaḥ / agha ye hūṃ dzaḥ/ ya mā ya hūṃ dzaḥ5/ ṣ+pedṛ t+yā ya hūṃ dzaḥ6/ ba ru shā ya ke hūṃ dzaḥ/ ba ya be+e 8hūṃ dzaḥ/ ku be rā ya 9hūṃ dzaḥ/ yī shwa nā ya hūṃ dzaḥ/te ta a bye pa ta ye hūṃ dzaḥ/ srur+ya tsad+dhā ya hūṃ dzaḥ11/ de skad ces brjod la spyan drang ngo / /de nas sangs rgyas thams cad dgug /phyogs skyong la sogs byin gyis brlab/ /gtor ma tshul bzhin byin brlabs te.e/ /ci bder phyogs skyong tshogs la dbul/ /de nas las rnams bcol bar bya/ /lha dbang me lha gshin rje dang / /bden bral chu lha rlung gi lha/ /gnod sbyin dbang ldan nyi zla dang / /bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /rdo rje spyan dang snyan mnga' ba/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i don ldan pa/ /mngon shes can gyis mchod pa bzhes / /sa phyogs dge ba'i gnas 'di ru/ /bdag gi dge ba'i grogs po mdzod / /bdag gis bzod pa de yis ni/ /mi bslu /dam tshig dgongs mdzad la/ /rtags dang mtshan ma bstan du gsol/ /zhes las bcol lo/ /lag pa sa la reg pa yis/ /sa yi lha mo dbus su bton/ /de la byin brlabs mchod pa bya/ /dngos su las bcol tshig 'di bsgo'o/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas 25—1546

—thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par las/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la / /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar byas rte dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes brjod pas gnang ba byin nas thim par bsam mo /sa bslang ba'o 3 legs par byen pa'i gnas ched du/ /sa bdag legs par blta byas la//zla bzhir dbang du phyogs bzhir blta/ /de yi lto ba'i dbus nas bru/ /ro la sogs pa'i skyon rnams bsal/ /mar gyi mdog dang 'dres par gyur/rte7/ /mchog tu gyur pas blang bar bya/ /sa brtag pa'o / / /sa gzhi bzang pos bkang rīdus su/ /dag par byed pa'i gsang sngags bzlas / /stegs bu khru ni bcu drug gam/ /bcu 'am lnga ru legs byas te/ /shin tu 'thas yepar bcag par bya/ /mthon dman med par gyur pa dang / /bdud rtsi lnga 'am ba yi lnga/ /dri dang sman gyis legs par byug / bdag bskyed 6gsang sngags bzlas pa yis/ /rtsa ba'i yi ges grub par bya/ /sa sbyang ba'o 3 de nas sa las 'od byung ste/ /yo las rgya gram rlung du gyur/ /de steng baṃ las chu dkyil 'khor/ /gser gyi sa gzhi lo las bskyed/ /de steng sum̐ las ri rab bskyed/ /rin chen sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ /de la lag pa brdeg par 25—1547

—bya / /de yis 7gsang sngags 'di dag bzlas/ /oṃ me dī nī badzī bha ba pyaban+dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas 1'od dang ldan byas pyate/ /'od kyis stong gsum thams cad gsal/ /sa gzhi byin gyis brlab pa'o / /gyedeng nas brtsams te gos sngon can/ /phyag rgya che dang ldan gyur pas/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yang dag ldan/ /pad+ma la sogs dbus bting nas/ /de yi steng du 'dug par bya/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su/ /mchod pa lnga'am nyi shu brgyad/ /bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spyan drangs te/ /bstem pas bkrag dang gzi byin bskyed/ /mngal nas 7skyes pa'i tshul can nam/ /sna bug sngags kyi 'od zer las/ /yang na nyi zer tshul can kyis/ /'khor rnams gsal bar gyur pa las ye shes bde gshegs spyan drangs bstem/ /de nas gsol ba 3ni/ gsang bdag dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyir/ /bdag ni sa chen bzung klubar byed/ /phyogs bcu'i sbyisangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gsol ba gdab pa'o / /skyadabang thob gyur nas gsang sngags bzlas/ /sku yi 'od kyis gsang sngags rgyal/ /reg pas bdud dang srin po 'bros/ /bsam gtan de las ma yengs pas/ /sngags kyi phreng bas bzlas pa bya/ /zhes pa ni sa gzung ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas phyogs bzhir rnal 'byor bzhi/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs bsam / /shar nas gtso la mchod pa phul/ /gsol ba 'di yang gdab par bya//25—1548

rdo rje rigs mchog dpal ldan gos sngon can/ /dpal ldan dkyil 'khor chen po bri rmyeba'i phyir/ /mnyam pa'i ngang las 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs la/ /zhe sdang rigs kyi bgegs rnams bzlog tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab par bya'o//lho nas gtso la mchod pa phul/ /gsol ba 'di dag gdab par bya/ /oṃ rin chen rigs mchog dpal ldan gos sngon can/ /dpal ldan rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir/ /mnyam pa'i ngang las 'bar ba'i skur 2bzhengs la/ /nga rgyal rigs kyi bgegs rnams bzlog tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab par bya'o / /nub nas gtso la mchod phul la/ /gsol ba 'di dag 1gdab par bya4 /oṃ pad+ma'i khrurigs mchog dpal ldan gos sngon can/ /pad+ma'i — rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir/ /mnyam pa'i ngang las 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs la/ /'dod chags rigs kyi bgegs rnams bzlog tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /byang nas gtso la mchod pa dbul/ /gsol ba 'di dag gdab par bya7 / /oṃ las kyi rigs mchog dpal ldan gos sngon can/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir/ /mnyam pa'i ngang las 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs la/ /phrag dog rigs kyi bgegs rnams bzlog tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab par bya'o / /de nas phyogs bzhi'i 3khro bo bzhis/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la gsol ba gdab / /mnyes pa'i tshogs kyang ci nus byasashe7/ /des ni bgegs rnams 'byer bar 'gyur/ /zhe'o/ /de ni gtso bo bslang ba'i cho ga'o/ /deng 6nas brtsams te gos sngon can/ /shin tu khro bo'i gzugs su langs//mig gnyis nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor du/ /re dang a gnyis bsam par bya/ /rkang 25—1549

par ljang gu yig lkuhūṃ las/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'od ldan bsam/ /mig dang rna ba'i nang du yang / /khro bo'i tshogs ni bsam par bya/ /nga rgyal chen po bskyed nas ni/ /rdo rje dril bu bskor bya zhing / /rkang pa rdo rje'i ༷ stabs ldan pas/ /phyogs mtshams su ni blta bya ste/ /hūṃ zhes 'jigs pa'i sgra sgrogs bsam/ /ha ha'i 1gad mo chen po dgod/ /nga rgyal bskyed pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i ④dril bu dkur brten nas/ /g.yas pas 5rdo rje gsor byas te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mdun bsams te/ /bka' bsgo ḍathubaden pa brdar bar bya/ /gang dag sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i/ lha'i tshogs dang / klu'i tshogs dang / gnod sbyin gyi tshogs dang / lto 'phye'i tshogs la sogs pa thams cad ma gnas par spyo dengs shig /hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan gos sngon can/ /sangs rgyas kun kyis gnang ba ste/ /lha dang klu dang lha ma yin/ /brjed byed la sogs bgegs kyi tshogs/ /gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /gal te dam tshig las 'das na/ /stobs chen khro bo gos sngon gyis/ /klad pa 'gas par gdon mi za/ /phaṭa na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta badz+ra dz+nyā 1/ na mo m+bi lāsba ra hūṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gardza gardza/ spo sbyiṭa ya spo rta1ṭa ya/ sarba bispyon bi nā ya kā dzā1 / ma hā ga ṇa pa ti dz+re bad+dhārnya 3naka rā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bgegs bskrad pa'o/ /dpal ldan gos sngon snying po las/ /yi ge lnga yi spyor ba yis/ /mtshon cha lnga yis thog phab pas / /gdug pa thams cad brgyal bar 'gyur/ /thog 'bab pa'o/ /de nas rkang pa rdo rje'i 4stabs/ /lag pa mugar stabs bskor ba yis/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs nas brtsams te/ /rdo rje bskor ba lan gsum mam/ /yang na ji 25—1550

ltar nus pa yis/ /bsrung ba khro bo'i 1khang par bsam/ /sa bsrung ba'o/ /deng nas brtsams te dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lha yi sta gon bya bar gsungs/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi thig le yis/ /thig le lha yi gnas su ni/ /gdan du bsams la dbab par bya/ /de steng hūṃ las phyag mtshan gyur/ /de las so sor skur rdzogs te/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlab par bya/ /de la phyi nang mchod pa dbul—/ /bstod pa dag kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas gsol ba gdab par bya//bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can/ /rig 7 sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gi snying rje'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon po bri bar 'dod pa ste/ /slob ma rnams la phan phyir dang / /khyed la mchod pa'i don du yang / /de la bcom ldan gus bdag la/ /byin brlabs gnang ba 4mdzad par 'os/ /dgongs shig snyebacom ldan gos sngon can/ /rdo rje 'chang chen sprul pa'o/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'dul ba'i bdag /gsang sngags rig thusngags kun gyi lha/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bdag ni slob ma rnams kyi phyir/ /dpal ldan gos sngon dkyil 'khor za/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa rnams/ /thugs rjes nye bar gzung du gsol/ /bdag la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs/ /'byung po sha za gnod sbyin dang / /gang dag gnod sbyin sems ldan pa/ /thams cad bdag la bsrung du gsol/ /thun mong dngos grub thams cad dang / /de bzhin mchog tu gyur pa dang / /thugs rje chen pos dgongs mdzad la/ /bdag la myur du stsal du gsol/ /de skad ces gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gye lha sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /25—1551

deng nas brtsams lkute gos sngon gyi3/ /rin chen dngul gyi bum pa 'am//yang na dkar po khams sogs la/ /nag po dang ni ra ri med/ /de lta bu yi bum pa la/ /pad+ma brgyad dang geldan pa yi/ /dbus su so so'i snying po 'am /yang na so so'i phyag mtshan dgod/ /de nyid 'od du zhu ba las/ /dkar po yi ni yi ge pa/ /de las bum pa'i gzhal yas khang / /nang du pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan / /lto che mgrin pa ring ba dang / /mchu ni kang thuka'i dbyibs can la//dbus su so so'i snying po bsam/ /de nas phyag mtshan sku rdzogs 'gyur/ /mi dmigs dbyengs nas sangs rgyas bskul/ /gnyis med gyur la mchod pa dbul//gong ma'i gsol ba gdab par bya/ /de nas sman lnga 'bru lnga dang / /rin chen lnga dang snying po lnga/ /thun mong bum pa'i rdzas su blugs/ /rnam rgyal bum par lha tshogs bskyed/ /btung ba snum po dag dang ni/ /mi 'chi lngas kyang dgang bar bya/ /las kyi bum par gyekhams gsum rgyal/ /'od zhu de yis las kun byed—/ /sngags ni so so'i snying po'o/ /de nas bum pa thams cad kun/ /dpag bsam shing dang 'bras bu can/ /yon tan ldan pas kha brgyan nas/ /de ni ma nyams ras dag la/ /kha dog lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /rnam rgyal bum pa bca' 4bar bya/ /gzhan ma kha dog re re'o/ /shar du 'dab ma brgyad pa yi/ /maṇ+ḍal byas te de ru bzhag /bum pa sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /de nas slob ma brtag 3pa'i cho ga bya ste/ chags dang grol ba'i gang zag ni / /lhag par gnas pa gcig tu gyur/ /dang por phyi nang khrus byas te/ /25—1552

dri zhim phyugs 1la gos bzang brgyan/ /de nas dkyil 'khor phyi rim dgod/ /slob dpon la ni gsol ba gdab/ /ston pa khyod la bdag dga'o/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol / /de nyid dam tshig bdag la sprulathu/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol༄/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /lan stsal pa/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi//gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshig 'di ni/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /tshul chen khyod kyis shes par gyis/ /she'o/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa dang /rjes su yi rang ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa dang / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang /lus dbul ba ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sdom pa bog 6la 'dzin du gzhug /bslab pa yi ni tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung 4bar bya/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu snaphyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung 9 bar bgye/ /slob dpon dag kyang bkur bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi7/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i / /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dam pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /yang dag nyid du gzung 1 bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung 5bar bgyi/ /sems 25—1553

can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung 1/ /zhes sdom pa gzung 2snango / /de nas slob ma'i yang 'phros/ /phyag rgya che dang ldan gyur 4nas / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas rnams su/ /dri yi thig le re re gdab//lha rnams kyi ni gdan du bsam/ /spyi gtsug bde gshegs gos sngon can/ /mgrin par pad+ma'i gos sngon can/ /snying gar thugs kyi gos sngon can 1/ /lte bar rin chen gos sngon can/ /gsang bar las kyi gos sngon can9/ /dpung pa la sogs rkang lag bzhi/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs brtag /de nas spos dang me tog dang / /mar me dri dang rnam lnga dbul/ /dri yi chu la bdud rtsi 'am/ /khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba bskyed/ /bcu gcig 'od zhu dag pa'i chus/ /ngag gi nyes pa sbyang bar bya'o/ /bdud rtsi'i 7chu yang blud par bya/ /de nas srung 8snaskud byen brlabs te/ /dag pa'i chu gtor 'od zhu bas / /khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba bskyed/ /bkug nas 'od du zhu ba las / /'bar ba'i 'od lnga ldan par bya'o/ /de la mdud pa drug byas te/ /mdud pa re la lha re bstem/ /rdo rje de nyid sngags kyis grub/ /dpung pa g.yon par gdags bya'o 9/ /de nas so shing byen brlabs te/ /u dus+thā ra pa sha'i shing / /ma yo ma gas 'bus ma zos/ /sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad du bya'o / /'od zhu bskyed pa gong bzhin te/ /shar du kha bltas 1mi smra bar/ /bca' dang bru ba'i cho ga bya/ /bsam pas byang chub sems bskyed de/ /rtags ni gsum du shes par bya/ /dang po 'jug pa'i rtags bstan te/ /bor bas slob dpon la bltas na/ /de ni 'jug tu rung bar bshad/ /gal te rang la bltas gyur na / /de ni phyir yang dor bar bya/ /gnyis pa bgegs kyi rtags rnams ltas/ /25—1557

—gsum pa dngos grub grub rtags ni/ /sor mo'am ni bor ba'i tshe/ /steng du lus na mchog 'grub 'gyur/ /shar du yang ni de bzhin te/ /mtshams dang byang du kha bltas na/ /zhi ba la sogs dngos grub 'gyur/ /de nas ngag gi nyes pa sbyang / /de nas ku sha byin brlabs te/ /khams gsum rgyal po'i 1khro bo dang / /las kyi gos sngon phyag rgya sngags/ /de yis 2byin brlabs sngas dang stan/ /de steng seng ge'i stabs kyis nyal/ /spro ba bskyed 4pa'i cho ga bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang mthun 'gyur ba'i/ /u dus+thā ra'i me tog ni/ /'byung 'gyur yang na mi 'byung srid/ /skye ba 'di yis thob pa yis/ /'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa'i chos/ /'byung 'gyur yang na mi 'byung srid/ /gsang sngags don 'di thob pa yis/ /dga' ba thams cad mthar phyin te/ /las 'phro dang ni thugs rjes 'byung / /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ /thogs pa med pa'i sku brnyes pa/ /'di yi 5tshul gyis mngon par bsgrub/ /sems can skal ba ngan pa yis/ /de yi 6ming yang thos mi 'gyur/ /spyad 7par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos / /sang gi nyin mo khyed rnams kun/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po mthong ba yis/ /bla med mchog la reg par 'gyur/ /zhes spro ba bskyed pa'i chos gzhan yang bshad par bya'o/ /nang par sngar ni blo can langs/ /rmi lam ci mthong dri bar bya/ /gos sngon sku gzugs mthong ba dang / /ri bo'i steng du 'dug pa dang / /mchod rten skas la 'dzeg pa dang / /me tog steng na 'dug pa dang / /chos kyi bgro gleng byed pa dang / /glegs bam dag la spyod pa dang / /gzhan gyi dbang bskur dkyil 'khor mthong / /de dang gzhan yang bzang 'gyur dang / /yi rang tshig brjod gal te rtags/ /mi gsal ba ru gyur pa na/ /25—/555

nyams pa rnams ni bskang bar bya/ /gal te bar chod rtags byung na/ /drag po'i sbyin sreg bya ba dang / /drag po'i tshogs dang 'khor los bzlog /gong ma'i rtags dang ldan gyur pas/ /thig gdab pa yi cho ga bya/ /thig skud kha dog lnga ldan la/ /yi ge lngas ni byen brlabs te/ /de las rigs 1 lnga'i sgu ru gyur/ /ye shes rigs lnga bkug cing bstem/ /'od zhu thig sgud sna lngar grub/ /yang na ye shes byang chub sems/ /kha dog lnga dang ldan par dgug/des ni nam mkha'i thig gdab bo/ /sa yi thig kyang 'di lta ste/ /dang po tshangs pa'i thig gnyis gdab/ /de bzhin 'khor lo rnam brgyad dang / /gru chad khyams dang sgo bzhi dang / /rta babs la sogs so sor dbye/ /de nas nang du phur bu gdab/ /mtha' skor 27dag ni gnyis su bskor/ /nang gi snam bu'i nang du ni/ /cha chung gcig la skor gnyis bskor/ /dbus su bskor ba gcig dang ldan/ /de nas rdul tshon brtsam par bya/ /dbus su mthing ga shar du dkar / /lho yi pad+ma 'dab ma ser/ /nub kyi pad+ma 'dab ma dmar/ /byang gi pad+ma ljang gur bya/ /mtshams ni mthing gar 1yang dag ldan/ /'khor lo'i 4 mdog kyang de bzhin no/ /dbus su rdo rje dgod pa ste/ /shar du 'khor lo dgod par bya/ /lhor ni rin chen 'bar ba dgod/ /nub tu pad+ma dmar po ste//byang du sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /yum ni so sor 'khril ba'o/ /mtshams rnams su ni khams gsum rgyal/ /mgon po 'phags skyes rnam thos sras/ /so so'i phyag mtshan dgod par bya/ /gru chad dang ni lha mo mtshan/ /kha dog ljang gu'i snyetshon gyis bya/ /khyams kyi shar ni dkar por bya/ /sgo ser nub ni rnam par dmar/ /25—1556

byang gi khyams ni ljang gu'o/ /khyams te ji bzhin sgo de bzhin/ /shar gyi sgor ni lcags kyu ste/ /lhor ni zhags pa nub be+egs sgog /byang gi sgor ni dril bug gong 17/ /sgo khyud phyi rol la sogs pa2/ /khyams dang pha gu dra ba dang //dra ba phyed pas rnam par brgyan/ /rta babs bzhi yang de bzhin te/ /twa ra ṇa bzhi yis kyang brgyan/ /ri mo'i cho ga rdzogs gyur nas/ /dam tshig 'khor lo rdzogs par byedaspya / /ye shes 'khor lo bkug nas bstem/ /de nas mchod pa'i cho ga brtsam/ /badz+ra dhū pa sngags las byung / /dkar mo spos kyis shangs la dbul/ /badz+ra pu྾'i dzasngags las byung / /mthing ga me tog sku la gtor/ /badz+ra ā lo ke sngags las byung / /dmar mo mar mes dkyil 'khor gsal/ /badz+ra gadhe sngags las byung / /ljang gu dri chab phyag zhabs bsil/ /de la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /ci 'byor thams cad dbul bar bya/ /dang por sems bskyed phyag 'tshal nas/ /skyabs gsol sdom pa gzung 8bar bya/ /dbang bzhi'i (dkyil 'khor lha las 6 blang / /yang na nam mkha'i dbyings su blang / /thos dang bsam pas bdag nyid 'jug pa'o / /khude nas slob ma gzhug par bya/ /phyi rol khrus kyi cho ga bya/ /bum par gyur dang rdzas rnams dgram/ /ci 'byor yon rnams dbul bar bya/ /sems bskyed sdom pa la sogs sngon bzhin bya/ /sdom pa legs par 'dzin pa la/ /bka' bsgo dam tshig bdud rtsi blud/ /yid 'ong rnal 'byor chen po khyod/ / 25—1557

gos sngon dkyil 'khor chen por chud/ /nga yis khyod la dngos grub 'byung / /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis zlob/ /ces pa ni spro ba bskyed pa'o/ /gsang mchog gos sngon dkyil 'khor 'di/ /sems can dad pa med pa dang / /gang yang log chos spyod pa dang / /mnar med ngan song rgyud can dang / /rna bar ming yang bsgrag tshomi bya/ /zhes pa ni gdams ngag go/ /gal te de la smras gyur na/ /dam can chad pas bcad nas ni/ /tshe yi 'du byed 'di bkum 2nas / /mnar med dmyal bar myur du dengs/ /gos sngon chen pos mod la spong / /zhes pa 'di ni skyon bstan pa'o/ /de nas snying nang sems dpa' bskyed / /bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba 'am/ /yang na dri yi chu blud de/ /'thung zhig rdo rje 'bar ba'i chu/ /dam las 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ ma hā pañtsa a mri 4ta/ kha kha zhes pa ni mna' bsgags 5pa'o/ /de ring phan chad bu khyod kyis6/ /gsang chen rdo rje nga yin gyis/ /nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /gal te brnyas par gyur na ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes pa min/ /tshe yi 'du byed 'di bkum 7nas/ /dmyal bar skye bar gdon mi za/ /zhes pa ni man ngag go/ /de nas rdo rje slob ma yis/ /slob dpon la ni gsol ba gdab/ /chos dbyings byin rlabs las byung ba'i/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /de ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /zhes so//de nas slob ma mtha' yas la/ /re dang bcas pa'i yi ge bsam/ /bskyod nas drod bsgul 9chu la phog /bskol bas sa yi dkyil 'khor zhu/ /lus nang me yis bsreg byas nas/ /7sdig pa tshig par gyur pa dang / /bde gshegs 25—1558

byang chub sems phab ste/ /snying ngam lus nang 'khyel par bsam/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang chen bsgom/ /me tog dkyil 'khor lha la dbul/ /pra tīts+tsha ho zhes brjod—/ /de nas phreng ba mgo la bcing / /oṃ ma hā ba la badz+ra/ a bhe ṣi.ā+oṃ mi zhe'o/ /rmad byung 1snagasang ba'i rnge tog 'di/ /gang la babs pa rigs kyi lha//las 'phro thugs rjes 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gtso bo'i thugs sogs mchog dngos grub / /dbus dang nye na dngos grub nye/ /ring na dngos grub ster —bar 'gyur—/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ni dbab pa'i cho ga dang me tog go/ /dpal ldan chen po gos sngon can/ /khyod kyi thumig dbye brtson par mdzod/ /tsagru pra be sha ya phaṭa/ brtab sapa'i lta bas blta byas te/ /dkar po mthong na zhi ba 'grub / /ser po mthong na rgyas pa 'grub/ /dmar po mthong na dbang gi las / /nag pos drag po'i las 'grub 'gyur/ /khyod kyi mig gis ji ltar mthong / /zhes tsadri bar bya'o/ /deng nas brtsams te dpal ldan che/ /khyab nas brtsams te dkyil 'khor bstan / /dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i 'og tu ni/ /yon phul gsol ba gdab par bya/ /ji ltar dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje sems dpas dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral slad du/ /bde gshegs bum pa'i dbang mchog stsol/ /zhes pa ni gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje rgyal po yis / /bum pa'i chu ni bsdus byas te/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo dag /rol mo'i 3/sgra dang bcas pa yis/ /spyi gtsug dag tu dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ gsang ba gsum las legs byung ba'i/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /dri med rdo 25—1559

rje chu dbang gis/ /mi bskyod dngos grub thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā dar+sha a r+bha ṣi.ā+oṃ 1mi/ chu'i dbang ngo / /oṃ sangs rgyas byen rlabs las byung ba'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'bar ba che/ /dam pa thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas / /rin chen grub pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na badz+ra a bhi ṣidzi gimi/ zhes pa ni dbu rgyan gyi dbang ngo / /oṃ ye shes lnga yi rtags 'chang ba/ /thugs mchog rdo rje bla med pa'izhisna/ /dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa yi/ /snang ba mtha' yas dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa man+ta a nyi ṣispyo 67mi/ zhes pa ni rdo rje'i dbang ngo / /oṃ chos sku sgyu ma'i sgra sgogs shing / /stong pa'i don las sad par byed/ /bla med dril bu'i dbang bskur bas / /don yod grub pa'i dngos grub shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kri tā nubye a bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ 7mi/ zhes pa ni dril bu'i dbang ngo / /kye rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskur bas/ /cis 8 kyang mi tshugs mi shigs pa'i/ /byang chub chen po thob pa dang / /rnam par snang mdzad dngos grub shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī sa ma ya dz+nyā 9 ta nā ma a bhe ṣidzi rkami/ zhes pa ni ming gi dbang ngo / /chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /me long gi ni gzugs brnyan bzhin / /rang byung lha ni shes par gyis/ /zhes pa ni me long ngo / /lung las / dang po gsol ba gdab pa ste/ /gsan nas ye shes 'khor lo gzhug /sdig pa dag par chus bkrus te/ /so so'i dbang rdzas lag tu sbyin/ /bron mongs lnga yi dri ma bkru/ /dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dgod/ /ce'o/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa 'am/ /rdo rje'i dbang gis mngon sangs rgyas/ /ye shes lnga dang rdo rje 'di/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bcang bar gyis/ /zhes pa 25—/560

thugs kyi dam tshig go/ /gsung rnams sgra brnyan lta bu ste/ /rtog pa med pas sna tshogs sgra/ /brjod bral dpag gis mi lang ba'i/ /dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis zung 3/ /zhes pa ni gsung gi dam tshig go/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med sgra/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i ngo bo 'di/ /'khyud pa'i phyag rgya'i dam tshig ste/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /zhes pa ni sku'i dam tshig go/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin la gnas / /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i 1brtul zhugs brtan / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye hūṃ ta ye hūṃ ha ha ha hi/ zhes pa 'di ni rdo rje'i chobartul zhugs so/ /chags dang grol ba'i gang zag gis/ /thun mong dkyil 'khor cho ga yin/ /gang zag rnam pa gnyis po de/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ru zhugs tsam gyis/ /dngos grub gnyis dang 'brel bar byed/ /klu dang 'byung pos zin pa la/ /dang po cho ga sngon song nas/ /smre 6ba'i rdzas kyis dbral bar bya/ /de nas bral 7ba gso ba dang / /nad pa chu yis bkru bar bya/ /de ltar byas nas dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa tsam gyis myur du thar/ /rims dang 'brum bu la sogs pa/ /gtor ma'i 'khor lo sngon song bas/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ru zhugs gyur na/ /myur du nyen las thar bar 'gyur/ /bud med dag kyang bu 'dod na/ /dang po cho ga sngon song nas/ /khrus kyis dag nas gos bzang bgo//dkyil 'khor 'di ru zhugs pa yis/ /bus pa'i gdon rnams 9bzlog pa dang //bus pa dbyung bar gdon mi za/ /yi dwags bkol ba'i cho ga yang / /lha la 25—1561

sogs pa bkug gyur nas/ /sdom pa legs par bzung nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ru zhugs gyur nas/ /bdag gis 1bcol ba thams cad byed/ /thogs pa med pa'i rdo rje bzhin/ /ro yi las rnams byed 'dod pas/ /blang dang bsrung ba sngon song nas/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ru bcug gyur na/ /log chos drug dang ldan pa yang / /gtsang ba'i gnas su nye bar 'gro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la/ /dag pa'i cho ga sngon song nas/ /byin brlabs dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /dbang bskur mchod pa phul gyur na/ /shin tu bkra shis don ldan te/ /bsgur zhing bstem pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /yon tan 'byung ba 'byung ba'i gnas/ /chags lam pa dang grol lam pa/ /mdzi dang rims kyis zin pa dang / /bud med dang ni yi dwags bkol/ /ro dang sku gzugs lhag par gnas/ /brgyad po dkyil 'khor 'di yis byed/ /de phyir dkyil 'khor cho ga brgyad/ /gcig par basbu ba'i cho ga'o// //de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur te/ /de yang bdud rtsi lnga yis byugs4/ /stegs bu'i steng du 5slob dpon dang / /phyag rgya ma ni stoms par zhugs/ /slob mas de la gsol ba gdab/ /oṃ rgyal ba thams cad rol pa yis 6/ /sangs rgyas chu yi rgyun phab ste/ /nyon mongs rtog pa sbyangs pa bzhin/ /bdag la byang chub sems dbang gsol/ /ji ltar rgyal ba'i dbu skabs pa/ /byang chub sems kyis bskus pa bzhin/ /bdag la byang chub sems khrus gsol/ /zhes pa ni gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /de nas blo ldan slob dpon dang / /slob ma gnyis gred spyor byas pa'i/ /byang chub sems su gang gsungs pa/ /yum gyi bha 25—/562

gar blang bar bya/ /dper na bung ba me tog bzhin/ /yang na gsang ba'i rdo rje sker/ /sgom pos dbang po gnyis mnan te/ /slob ma'i kha ru dbab par bya//dper na ma la bu bzhin no/ /yang na slob ma gang yin pa/ /gdugs la sogs dang ldan byas nas/ /gsang chen bde ba'i rgyu mchog ste/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan byas nas/ /bkra shis bstod pas bstod pa dang / /slob ma'i lce la 1sbyin par bya/ /de nas slob ma chen po des/ /byang chub bdud rtsi lces blangs nas / /snying gar 'dod pa bsten par bya/ /bde ba de la brten gyur nas/ /lte ba'i dbus su bsam par bya/ /slob mas kyang ni 'di skad brjod/ /'chi bar gyur pa rab slong zhing / /rtog pa'i dra ba sel mdzad pa/ /e ma mchog gi bdud rtsi che/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad sel zhing / /bla med byang chub mchog la reg /bdud rtsi mnga' bdag khyod la bstod/ /gsang chen dbyengs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcud ldan bdud rtsi khyod la bstod/ /ces pa ni gsang ba'i dbang ngo / / snade nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur te/ maṇ+ḍal dri zhim legs byugs te/ /mchog tu dkar dmar thig le gdab/ /steng du mtshan ldan bud sked bzhag /gnas rnams su ni lha tshogs dgod/ /dbyings nas bsnyim pa'i cho ga bya/ /de nas slob mas gsol ba gdab/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pas 'grub/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral slad du/ /gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol/ /zhes pa ni gsol ba gdab pa'o / /bu tshur shog cig rigs kyi bu/ /gang ltar dga' ba'i dngos 25—1563

grub ni/ /shes rab ma la brten nas 'grub/ /rtag tu shes rab don 'dod pas / /pad+ma'i steng gi k+ṣelce yis reg /dri chen dri chu bza' bar bya tha dad rtog pa gyur mi bya/ /khu ba dkar dmar rnam pa gnyis/ /lce yi dbus su brtan par gzung zhe / /dka' thub med cing brtul zhugs che/ /'di dang ldan pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni sdom pa dbog pa'o/ /de nas slob ma chen po des/ /rang gi bsam pa'i blo brtags pa/ /ji ltar sdom pa gzung bar bya/ /sdom pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma de/ /dmigs med yul 3gyi dkyil 'khor blta7/ /rtag tu gcer bu'i tshul can gyis/ /rdo rje dril bu kha phye la/ /mthong ba'i slob ma gsol ba gdab/ /rmad byung shābatsun mo'i bha ga rtemachog /ye shes thams cad bskyed pa'i gnas/ /ma smin ma grol grol ba'i sar ye shes dam pa bskyed du gsol/ /zhes pa ni gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /de nas bde ba'i stan bting la/ /seng ge'i stabs kyis nyal ba yis/ /lag pa steng 'og bsnol nas ni/ /mchog dga' ba yi gtam dang ldan/ /gnas dgu ru ni sen mo gdab/ /zur gyis smeg dang kha spad tsostsogs/ /chags pa bskyod 1 pa'i cho ga bya/ /yum gyi bya rgod rtse mo mchog /dbang po'i lag pas blang bar bya/ /pad+ma kha byer gyur pa dang / /gnyis su med par sbyar gyur te/ /bskyod pa dal gyis bskyod par bya/ /bskyod pa'i rlung gis me nyunabaskul de/ /bde chen byang chub sems phab ste/ /so so'i gnas su 'od tshan gzung 8/ /rdo rje skye ru phyin pa dang / /yi ge 'od kyis bur 'gyur te/ /oṃ khyod kyi stobs kyis thams cad 'dus / /log pa'i man ngag der bsam mo/ /ma bzlog pa ni ste yis blang / /gal te bzlog par gyur pa na/ /rtog pa thams cad nub par 'gyur/ /de las 25—1564

langs te de bzhin bsam/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /1de nas lung bstan par bya ste/ /khams gsum 'gro rnams thams cad la//chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /srid pa'i gzeb las sgrol bar 'gyur/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gtan bcad nas/ /bla med byang chub mchog la reg /de ring phan chad bu khrod ni/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo yin/ /zhes pa ni lung bstan pa dang dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad la/ /'khor lo bskor bas mya ngan 'das/ /ces pa dang / dung dang ral gri pad+mo dang / /rdo rje la sogs pa 'di ni rjes su gnang ba'o/ /de nas slob ma dam pa des/ /rin chen gser dngul byi 2ru dang / /dung dang mu tig ku mu ta/ /ba lang rta dang glang po che/ /yul dang bu smad la sogs pa/ /mdor na rang las gces pa'i rdzas/ /thams cad bla ma de la dbul / /bla ma dam par gyur pa la/ /rang srog gis kyang mnyes byed na/ /gzhan pa'i rdzas lta smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa ni yon dbul ba'o /de nas dam tshig dbog bya ste/ /gsang dang don dam yang dag la/ /thob par gyur pa'i slob ma yis/ /dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu bsrung / /25—1565

yang dag rdo rje slob dpon la/ /mi dge log pa spyod 'dod na/ /de ni dbang gis 1tshig nas ltung / /thun mong khyad par mched dang yum/ /de la ngan sems gzung 2mi bya/ /slob dpon rdo rje mched gyur la/ /rang gi srog kyang phan gdags na/ /sgrib pa kun byang tshogs rdzogs nas/ /bar chod thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ /de min dbang gis tshig nas ltung / /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /dge slong khrims la lhag 4par gnas/ /sdom pa thams cad lhag par bsrung / /'di ni rnal 'byor sa gzhi 'dra/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rdzas rnams la/ /rtog pa thams cad spang bar bya/ /gzhan yang dam tshig mtha' yas pa/ /thams cad 'bad de bsrung bar bya/ /dam tshig dngos grub kun gye mchog /dam tshig dngos grub kun gye bdag /dam tshig gis ni 'byung po 'dul / /dam tshig rtog pa'i dra ba gcod/ /gang dag dam tshig mi ldan pa/ /dbang gis tshig nas mnar med par/ /sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar du gnas/ /zhes pa ni dam tshig dbog pa'o/ /deng 5nas brtsams te bkra shis kyi/ /smon lam rjes su gdab par bya/ /bum pa'i lha dang dkyil 'khor lha/ /spyan dang 6nam mkhar gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor rang la bsnyu/ /dkyil 'khor phyags la chu bor dbo/ /sgod rnams dag par bkru bar bya/ /rang nyid mi dmigs dbyings su bsdu/ /de la las kyi lhar bsgyur la/ /bzod gsol lus srung cho ga bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga 'di/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i don la rmongs/ /yang dag don dang mi ldan zhing / /'dod pa log pa'i lam zhugs dang / /25—/566

dka' thub pa dang rtog pa can/ /de la zur tsam bstan mi bya/ /gal te de la bstan gyur na/ /tshe yi 'du byed des bkum 1nas/ /dmyal bar bskal pa stong du gnas/ /bdag 'dra'i ma rig rmongs pa yis/ /sgrub 2pa'i thabs 'di brtsams par mi 'os kyang / /sems can bdag pas dman phyir bdag gis brtsams/ /'di las 4bdag gis byang chub ci thob pa/ /des ni sems can gos sngon grub 5par shog /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad kun/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar skye bar shog /dbang gi 6'bras bu smin gyur cig /sems can las dang skal ldan nas/ /rdo rje 'chang chen zhal mthong shog /de yi rbeg pa'i don rtogs te/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ /thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /sems can 'gro don byed par shog /dpal ldan 7gos sngon can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon nā gārdzu nas mdzad pa sgogs so// //25—/567
