༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ marja lo kā ra sā dha rna / bod skad du/sngags kyi rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das thugs kyi rang bzhin phyag na rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags rnams bdag po dpal ldan rdo rje can//sgu gsum rang bzhin yon tan kun gye mdzod/ /nyon mongs gdung ba rtsad nas zhi mdzad cing / /dus gsum sangs rgyas rang bzhin gos sngon can/ /gsang ba'i bdag la dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /myur du grub par 'dod pa yi/ /de nyid sngags ni bshad par bya/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ /sngags la gtso cher byed pa yi/ /rigs bzang don dang ldan pa yis/ /yid dang mthun pa'i gnas dag tu/ /sngags kyi mi mthun kun spangs nas/ /snyan 4pa'i gnas su legs 'dug ste/ /sems sbyang lhag pa'i lhar gyur te/ /bsrung dang tshogs bsag stong par bsgom/ /de nas 5rang gi sems nyid ni/ /yi ge hūṃ 25—157/

gi rnam pa las1/ /rgyu 'phros gzhal yas khang par gyur/ /de steng hūṃ las cho ga gsum/ /de las dpal ldan gtum po'i gzugs/ /g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa//g.yon pas bya khyung nges par bsnams/ /sku mdog sngon po dpa' bo'i chas /g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum gdug pas brgyan/ /ye shes bstem dang byin brlabs nas/ /dbang bskur 'bras bu lnga dang ldan/ /de rjes sngags kyi bzlas pa bya/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi rnam pa yis/ /rags pa dang ni phra ba yi4/ /shin tu phra ba'i rnam pa ste/ /sems dpa' sum brtsegs gzhal yas khang / /gsal bar byed pa de nyid de/ /rnal 'byor tshul gyis yongs su bsgrub/ /'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang dang / /gnyi mug nga rgyal phrag dog dang / /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dang / /sngags kyi dus su spang bar bya/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /de bzhin reg 5bya la sogs dang / /g.yeng bar gyur pa ma lus pa/ /sngags kyi dus su spang bar bya/ /sgra che ba dang sgra chung dang / /skyen pa dang ni bul ba dang / /mi gsal yan lag nyams pa dang / /gsang sngags bar du sgra zhugs dang / /dmigs pa ma rdzogs 'jog pa dang / /sngags kyi dus su spang bar bya/ /rjes kyi rnal 'byor ma lus par/ /dus dang grangs dang mtshan ma dang / /ro dang dbang bsgur la sogs pa/ /sems dpa' sum brtsegs gsal ba yis/ /rang nyid thig le'i ngo bo yi5 'od zer la ni yig 'bru zhon/ /'od dkar zhi ba'i tshul du bzlas/ /yang na 'od 'phros sku gsum gyi/ /rang bzhin tshur 'dus gdug rtsub spyong / /yang na dmigs pa med pa las7/ /'phro dang 'du bas trībyed pa yin/ /'od zer dkar dmar 'phro 'du yis/ /rnam smin la sogs bsreg cing sbyong 9 / /25—1572

'khor dang nye 'khor sum 'khor sogs/ /mtshan ma 'dod pa rnam pa lnga/ /gong du bsnyen pa'i don du gsungs/ /sum 'bum bdun dang bcu gnyis so/ /'di yang grangs kyi tshad du gsungs/ /de yi grogs 'gyur bzlas pa ni/ /sdig pa dbyung dang sreg rtepa dang / /bkru ba'i don la dmigs pa ste/ /rags dang phra ba'i dbang dag tu/ /drug dang dgu ru shes par bya/ /sdig pa dbyung ba la sogs kyang / /mi drug gzugs dang de bzhin du/ / yig gzugs dang ni 'od kyi gzugs/ /de dag dbyung gtor bsreg cing bkru/ /dmigs pa gsar rnying bye brag gis/ /mgal me phreng ba nyi ma'o4/ /sngags kyi dngos grub 'dod dus su/ /tshogs dang gtor ma sāsgo dang / /klog 'don dge ba skyong 5la sogs/ /'di yang grogs su 'gro ba yin/ /rjes kyi rnal 'byor tshul dang ldan/ /bsnyen sgrub chen po la sogs pas6/ /yongs su bsgrub pas dngos grub 'byung / /sku gsum ngo bo'i 7tshul la ni/ /'od sgra sku dang 'gul dang sdeb/ /khol dang gang dmigs de dbang 'gyur/ /'di yang sgrub pa'i rtags su gsungs/ /gos sngon lus la gnas pa dang / /dung 'bud pa dang chos rnams ston/ /stong gsum ma lus mthong ba dang / /dbang bskur khrag sogs lus las 9'thon/ /me tog sngon bo nyi zla shar/ /rmi lam dag tu byung ba na/ /'di yang grub pa'i rtags su gsungs/ /de dag bzlas pa'i sngags gsungs pa/ /oṃ na mo m+bi lāsbra ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rā dza ma hā ga ru ḍa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ bzlas lugs man ngag shes par bya'o/ /mig gi mngon shes bsgrub pa ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa la/ /ye shes 'phro 'dus byen rlabs sdud/ /bsnyen pa skyol bas de bzhin bya/ / rna ba dang ni rtadabang po 25—1573

gzhan / /gong ma 1de bzhin spyor shes bya'o/ /gang zhig phrin 2las rnam bzhi las / /dang po zhi ba gsungs pa ni / /kha dog dkar po 'phro 'du yis/ /rang gi sdig dang bag chags dang / /gzhan gyi gdug —rtsub zhi bar byed/ /tshe ring rigs rgyud longs spyod rnams/ /rgyas par 'dod pa 'od zer ser /bde gshegs 'od bsgul rang lus kyi/ /rang bzhin tshe rnams rgyas par byed/ /dkar dmar khu ba'i 'phro 'du yis/ /'jig rten rigs rgyud rgyas par byed/ /nor dang rdzas ni rgyas 'dod pas/ /rin chen bcud kyi 5tshul du bsgrub/ /kha dog dmar po sbyar ba yis/ /dmigs pa ma lus dbang du sbud/ /tshar gcad dus kyi spyor ba ni/ /'khor lo 'od zer skur gyur te/ /dgug cing tho ba la sogs pas/ /drag po'i mtshon cha thog phab pas/ /spyi bo gtsug gnas rnams su ni/ /phung po gzhig pa'i spyor ba bya/ /sa bon 'joms dang 'byed byed pas//'grub par 'gyur bar gsungs pa yin/ /de la sogs pa'i sbyor ba rnams/ /mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya/ /de rnams sngags kyi mtha' la ni/ /nad dang sbug bsngal thams cad las/ /thar bar gyur cig hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa sgrub pa'i snying por gsungs/ /'di ni kun gyi man ngag go/ /mkhas pa tshig la mi ltos par/ /gzu lums rngo la gzhal gang zag gis/ /bskal par bsgrubs kyang 'bras bu med/ /de bas mkhas pa rab tu gces/ /'di brtsams pa yi dge ba yis/ /rags dang phra ba'i rtog pa dang / /nad kyi zug rngu zhi ba dang / /sngags kyis nyon mongs kun spangs nas/ /gos sngon dngos grub thob par shog /sngags kyi rgyan nā gārdzu nas mdzad pa sdogs so// //25—/57

1571 nyuma'6da byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sngags kyi rgyan gyi sgrub thabs nā gārdzu nas mdzad pa bzhugs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsa/ ji〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dben/ 75)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/1572 17〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bo/ ji〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉re / tsho'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyanas/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyor/1573 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsreg 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan ge gzugs dang / — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dbyug ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te ba'o/ nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyob/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bo/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanangos kyi/ te〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉'du/ dzo 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sna dang rna ba/1574 (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toraphrin/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ /dang po bzhi par 'dod pa yis/ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdog sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcad/ 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyams/bsdur 'bras re'u mig— rgyud/ (1༷38)25wa 1575

1112༄ / /rab tu gnas pa'i rgyan/sna ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra tiṣ+ṭha 2a lo kā ra/ bod skad du/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyan/ rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dang / /zla ba lta bu'i mthu mnga' ba'i/ /sel cing snang bar byed pa yi/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje can la 'dud/ /tshogs sogs 4nus pa tshogs byung bas/ /rab tu gnas pa bshad par bya/ /sngags pa yon tan kun ldan pas/ /bkra shis pa yi gnas dag tu/ /bsnyen pa rnam gsum rdzogs pa yis / /lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga bya/ /mnga' dbul ba dang mchod pa brtsam / /sngags kyis gnas pa'i don du ni/ /rgyas par rab gnas chen por blta/ /'di ru cung zhig bsdus nas bstan/ /dang por rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bri/ /'dom do pa'am 'dom gang ba/ /gru bzhi 'thas 5par byas pa la//thig ni legs par yongs btab la/ /sa tshon byin gyis brlab bya la/ /tshon 25—1576

rnams dgye ba'i rim pa ni/ /dbus kyi pho brang mthing ga la/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad mdzes par btang / /shar gyi cha ni dkar po la/ /lho yi cha ni ser po ste//nub kyi cha ni dmar por snang / /byang gi don yod grub pa ljang / /mthing ga dkar dang ser dang dmar/ /ljang gu rnams su gsungs pa ni/ /pañtsa re khā'i rtsig pa'o/ /sgo gnyis mtshams dang twa ra ṇa/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pa dang / /rgyan rnams kyis ni rnam par spras/ /tha ma srung ba phreng bas brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni shar ngos su/ /dbang stegs steng du mdzes pa'i gdan/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rtags 1mchog bzhag /chu gsum 'dus 2pas khrus rnams bya/ /mchod pa'i yo byad rdzogs pa la/ /bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / /me tog rnams kyis yongs su klubs/ /de nas rang gi bsam pa rdzogs so / /lhag pa'i ting 'dzin gsal bar shes/ /dbang bsgur ba la rab tu gnas/ /gsung ni dīḥlas byung ba'i rigs/ /thugs ni mi bskyod rdo rje sems/ /sku ni rtag pa'i rang bzhin no/ / tsha tsha jemachod rten la sogs pa/ /sangs de zhu nas lce las ni/ /ye shes tsha tsha 5mchod rten gyi/ /'byung ba'i rgyu ru rnam par snang / /lha khang 'bru yi rten las su/ /gong gi stobs kyis gang 6'gyur ba/ /rang gi snang ba 'byung ba yin/ /slob dpon rab tu 'gying 7bcas pas/ /rdo rje dril bu ldan pa yis/ /bde gshegs nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bstod rgyas par bya/ /de nas phyag rgya bzhi ldan pas/ /rtags gsum dag la gzhag par bya/ /des ni mchod pa rgyas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gas/nga ba'i lha la dbul/ /rin chen sna bdun lha mo brgyad/ /ma lus bstod cing bzod par gsol/ /gsang sngags rgyal po'i mtha' la ni/ /'bru gsum 25—1577

yi ge btags pas ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad nas stong rtsa brgyad/ /bzlas pa 'od zer gzhung bzhin bstem/ /zhu bas sgu gsung thugs kyi rtags/ /rang rang rnams la gsal zhing rgyas/ /de la mchod pa sna tshogs kyang / /dkon mchog skyabs chen rnams dang yang / /ma lus lus pa med pa la/ /yang dag pa ru rab tu bsngags/ /gtor ma gnyis kyis gtsang rigs snadang / /bgegs dang rigs drug ma lus pa/ /gtor ma chen po sbyin du mchod/ /bskor ba bya zhing smon lam gdab/ /rab gnas basbus pa'i cho ga ni/ /be+e dze+e badz+ra mtha' bsgyur la/ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na mo dze+e ghā ya/ a dadhe/ dha ra ni/ tar+ya thā/ ā kar+ṣa ṇi/ swa bha 4ba sarba dharmā/ nis sarba/ is ma thi/ pi pa sha na/ bi ma la su pa ri dharmā karti 5ka na/ ba la niṣ+ka6/ ya tha ma le/ tsa le tsa le tsa le/ hu lu hu lu/ bi shad de/ man+t+ra man+t+ras 7swā hā/ stong dang brgya yi bzlas pa yis sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo ru/ /byin gyis brlabs pa tsam ni bya/ /yang na tre yang de / zhes pa'i sngags kyis bya/ de ltar slob dpon de la ni/ /ci yod rang gi nor rnams dbul/ /de nas rab gnas brtan pa yis/ /mgron rnams dgye zhing smon lam gdab/ /shi ba phyi yi cho ga yang / /khrus byas rdul tshon gong bzhin bri/ /spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /mchod cing ye shes me nas bsang / /sbyang zhing ro ni sreg rdzas su/ /me lha nyid la dbul bar bya/ /gtor ma cha gnyis cho ga yis/ /bsngo zhing smon lam gdab par bya/ /thig basbus sa tshon chu la dbo/ /'di brtsams pa yang ḍadage ba yis/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /nad dang sdug bsngal rtsad nas chod7/ /zhing khams gtsang mar skye bar shog /dge slong nā gārdzu nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// / /25—/578

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba bo ta a 2lo kā ra/ bod skad du/gtor ma'i rgyan bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun gyi grogs 'grol las kyi mchog /bkra shis bar chod sel mdzad pa/ /gtor ma'i las ni bdag gis bshad/ /phyi nang gtor ma rgya chen 'di/ /rgyas par gtor ma chen po bstan/ /basbus pa la sogs man ngag 'di/ /sgrub pa po yi don du bsdus/ /thams cad ldan pa'i gtor ma la/ /hūṃ gi 'od zer 'phros par yis/ /re gyes bsregs te yo gis bus/ /khaṃ gis bkrus te dag pa las/ /stong pa'i ngang las yi las rlung / /ma dang brten pa'i dngos po dang / /a las bde skyong nang du ni/ /baṃ las bdud rtsi'i 4chu rgyun 'byung / /de dbus thabs dang shes rab 'bar/ /gtor ma'i rdzas ni yig 'bru bcu/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon dang / /rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcas/ /thabs dang 25—/580

shes rab yi ges mtshan/ /hūṃ gi 'od kyis rlung sngon bskyod/ /'bar dang khol bas yab yum bzhi/ /sku gsung thugs kyis basbus shing sbyangs/ /spros pas ye shes bdud rtsi 'bebs/ /oṃ a rakhra kyihoḥ/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ bde gshegs bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas/ /oṃ āḥ hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags lan bdun kyis 1brlab/ /gdan gsum ldan pa'i rin chen mdzes/ /hūṃ las 'od zer dzaḥ'aphros nas/ /rigs drug bkug ste 'od du zhu/ /yig 'bru lnga las rigs lnga yi/ /bde gshegs klu gnyan mkha' 'gro rnams/ /bskyed cing ma lus dbang bskur nas/ /bla ma mi bskyod gzugs 'dzin rnams/ /bde 4'tsham rim par bzhugs pa rnams/ /de la phyag 'tshal mchod byas na/ /rang gi rtsa ba'i sngags la ni/ /gsum dang bdun dang nyi shu gcig /i rda ba lo kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes pa'i sngags la btags la dbul lo/ /ma ma sarba sha rja 5a mu ka ma hi man tsi me te sa ma 5ba bu shaṃ ru rnyi ra pre )yo bhak+ṣa ba bo i rda kṛṇ+ḍa kha kha khā nyi khā hi rak+ta pi pa ti/ a 7ti kra swa ma ye swā hā/ gsang ba'i sngags des kyang mgron ma lus pa la dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma rde/ār+ya rtenut+pan+da tāta/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rigs drug ma lus kun la byin/ /de nas bstod pa dang / bshags pa dang / phrin las bcol zhing smon lam gdab / /spyi yi gtor ma rgya che yang / /sman lnga 'bru lnga rin chen lnga/ /'bras sgrum khur ba la sogs la/ /thams cad ma spyad snod du blugs—/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas 1nyebyin gyis brlab/ /paṃ las pad+ma dkar po ste/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyogs skyong rigs drug 'khor dang bcas/ /spyan drangs rke1gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ibye ya hūṃ dzaḥ/ asna ye hūṃ 25—1581

dzaḥ / ya ma ye hūṃ dzaḥ/ ṣ+perje 2ta ye hūṃ dzaḥ/ ba ru shā ya nahūṃ dzaḥ/ bā ya be hūṃ dzaḥ/ ku be+e rā ya thuhūṃ dzaḥ/ yī sha nā ya 5hūṃ dzaḥ/ te ta a bye pa ta ye hūṃ dzaḥ/ srur+ya tsad+dhā 4ya hūṃ dzaḥ/ spyan drangs ba bo 7yongs su dbul/ /bstod dang dngos grub blang ba dang / /tha ma tshigs bcad bsngos byas nas/ /smon lam sdogs par gdab par bya'o/ /gtor ma'i man ngag gzhung don 'di/ /sgrub pa po yi don du bris/ /tshig dang don gyi nges pa rnams/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa dang / /mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol/ /sngon byang med dang go rims 7bral/ /'di ni bar chod spyor ba ste/ /de nas/ bar chod spyor ba yongs spangs nas/ /dngos grub klu mo mkha' 'gros 'byung / /bdag gis 'di brtsams bsod nams kyis/ /rags dang phra ba'i rtog pa kun spangs nas/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kun/ /gsang chen lam la rab gnas nas/ /gos sngon dngos grub thob par shog /gtor ma'i rgyan gyi man ngag dge slong klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //25—/582

bsdur mchan/158༷ skyematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sngagator ma'i brgyan bzhugs / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tā/ ri —rdzo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtse/1581 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉tor li/ (rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snam/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 byin gyis/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bden—/ cige〈〈pe 〉〉mi sarba shad lha// 〈〈snar 〉〉mi sarba shad tshug/ sgo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa sa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ti ri phra/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stamang / khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dharmā tsā/ at+yā/ cha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉blug 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya/ mi〈〈snar 〉〉dung / skyon〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉min+d+ra ye/1582 〉〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dza rna ri/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṇa ye/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ye/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ring ye/skye〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan ye/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsan+d+ra/ she〈〈co 〉stan/ 3tho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zag 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bya/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rem/bsdur 'azas re'u migargyud/ (1༷40) wa 25wa 1583

1114༄ / /dam tshig gi rgyan/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ma yā lo kā ra/ bod skad du/ dam tshig gi rgyam// phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig med dang 'chal bar gtong / /som nyi la sogs bsal ba'i phyir/ /dam tshig rnams ni mdor basbus nas/ /gsang ba'i 2bdag la 'dud de bshad/ /sngags pas srung ba'i dam tshig ni/ /dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /nya 'am stong gi dus dag tu / /yan lag brgyad pa nyer gnas te/ /lo gcig pa 'am zla gcig bya / /de nas ji srid sems bskyed de/ /babe+eb pa lnga po legs bzung 4nas/ /lo gcig zla gcig bar dag tu/ /sdom pa brtan por 5gzung bar bya/ /de nas dge tshul dge slong gi6/ /bslab pa la ni legs gnas te/ /mi gtong lo 'am zla ba 'am/ /sdom pa nyams pa blang bar bya/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la/ /gang zhig gis ni legs gnas na/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dus kun du//25—/58 /

srog gi phyir yang mi gtong hūṃngo / /gang zhig gis ni 3de goms 'gyur/ /gang tshe gong ma'i bslab gnas pasabye/ /de tshe 'og ma'i ming dang bral/ /dang po sbyin pa bslab bya ste/ /dngos po bcu gnyis yang dag ldan/ /bzod dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan dang / /shes rab gsum ste gsum du bstanathu/ /gzhan kyi mya ngan sangs la sogs/ /sems can don 'gyur thams cad kun/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong zhengo / /sdom pa lo 'am zla ba ru/ /brtan nas sngags kyi dam tshig blang / /spyi dang khyad par gnyis su shes/ /dang po dag bye ni bshad bya ste/ /dang por slob dpon mnyes par bya/ /yi dam spong len mi bya ste/ /lus dang ngag yid sku gsung thugs/ /phyag rgya che la rab tu gnas/ /dam pa rnams ni smad mi bya/ /gsang ba'i don yang bstan mi bya/ /rtags chen sku yang mi bstan te/ /bzlas dang sems nyams bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phreng ba dag /skad cig tsam yang spang mi bya/ /grogs bo'i sems ni dkrug mi bya/ /khyad par grogs la smos ci dgos/ /tshogs dang gtor ma sbyin sreg bya/ /maṇ+ḍal tsha tsha klul sogs pa/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong zungo / /chos kyi spyod pa gzhan rnams kyang / /spang bar 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /sha chen khrag dang khu ba dang / /dri chen dang ni dri chu dang / /blang dang spang bar bya ba min/ /rtsa ba byang chub sems mi btang / /chos la smod pa spang bar bya /dad ldan bsam pa sun mi dbyung / /bud med rnams ni smad 1mi bya/ /spang dang blang bar bya ba min/ /bgrod min la ni bgrod pa min/ /spong ba mi spong gyur pa dang / /blang bya mi lan hūṃspang bar bya/ /dug lnga spong ba spang bar bya/ /blang ba yang ni spang ba min/ / dug lnga ma spangs par spyad bya/ /nyu1dam pa ma 25—1585

yin bsten mi bya/ /'du 'dzi'i 1nang du 'jug mi bya/ /dgongs pa can gyi ga'i rnams kun/ /bla ma med par bsten mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs sbyor ba yis / /gzhan la phan 'dogs byed pa rnams/ /cho ga rdzogs par bya bar bya 'jug kyang lhag chad 'gyur ba yi/ /dus ma yin pa'i spyod pa spang / /dus kyang gzhan dang mi mthun spang / /grogs su 'gyur na smod pa spang / /rtag tu mi dang spyod pa bstun/ /dang po dka' thub bsten pa ste/ /tha ma'i dus su spang bar bya/ /chang sogs nyes par gyur pa spang / /thabs ldan dngos grub spyor 4bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /bslab pa 'di la brten 5pas 'grub/ /bslab pa dag la mi gnas par/ /rtag tu bya ba rnams la 'jug /skyes bu de ni bdud kyis bslus / /gang zhig bzod pa mi bsten pa'i/ /rnal 'byor 'bras bu mi 'dod 'du/ /dgra sogs nyes pa ci byas pa/ /rang gi zhe sdang khros rbad pas/ /nyes na zhe sdang khro bar rigs/ /dgra rnams gzhan du bros phyir min/ /de phyir de la nyes pa med/ /bzod na dge rtsa kun gyi mchog /nga rgyal la sogs nyon mongs kun/ /bskyed pa don med spang don can/ /de phyir khyon mongs spang bar bya/ /khyad par thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /gos sngon po dang rak+ka dang 6//rus pa'i phreng ba blang bar bya/ /dus kun du ni rang lha 7mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma mnyes pa bya/ /rtag tu rang lha'i bsten par 9bya/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung / /rtag tu sngags kyi spyod pa bsten—/ /rtag tu chos kyi dam pa blang / /rtag tu khrus kyi cho ga bya/ /srog gcod pa yi sems can pas/ /kun du rgyug par byed pa bla/ /de bas mkhas pas dus kun du/ /srog gcod tsho bye—— /bye86

pa ni spang bar bya1/ /grong khyer 'jug dang gtor ma gtang / /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo / /dam tshig rtag tu srung byed pa'i/ /rnal 'byor de la dngos grub 'byung / /dam tshig rnams ni rdo rje che/ /dam tshig gdug pa zil gyis non/ /dam tshig thub dka' gdug pa 'joms/ /de bas mkhas pas dus kun du/ /dngos grub 'grub 'gyur dam tshig bsten/ /gang dag dam tshig med cing spyor ba kun spang ba/ /rtag tu dngos grub spyor spangs sdug bsngal thams cad bskyed/ /'gro ba'i 4sdug bsngal sel mdzad sangs rgyas rdo rje can/ /rtag tu thub byed sdom gnas rtag tu bde ba'i mchog /bla med lam mchog gsang chen de nyid spang 5/ /mi gnas dngos grub med cing tsha grang sdug bsngal myong / /don nor smra ba nyams shing slob dpon bka' sogs bcag /spyi nas bla med blang 6zhing mkha' 'gros snying 'dren na/ /gnod byed me dbal rtag tu dgra bzhin spang / /yid bzhin nor bu rang gi srog bzhin blang / /srung dang blang sogs bca' thabs mkhas pas bya/ /des ni rtag tu bde ldan sdug bsngal spang / /bdag gis thabs 'di brtsams par mi rigs kyang / /babe+eb pa gnas phyir nor bu len byed brtsams/ /'di las bdag gis bsod nams ci thob pa/ /des ni thams cad bde bar gnas par shog /dam tshig gi rgyan rdzogs so// //spyir sdom pa la/ bsnyen gnas sdom pa nya stong ngam tshes 8brgyad gang rung la blang ngo / /dge bsnyen sdom pa la/ dbye na sna 'ga' srung ba'i dge bsnyen rtsa ba lnga nas 'ga' srung ba'o / /tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen ni/ /rtsa ba las 'dod chags rang gi bud gred min pa spangs pa'o/ /yongs su rdzogs 25—1587

pa'i dge bsnyen la lugs gnyis te/ rtsa ba lnga ka srung ba'o 1/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen la/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa nas phyi dro'i kha zas kyi bar du bya ba nas/ khyem pa'i rtags spang ba de gnyis min pa bcu'o/ /dge tshul gyi sdom pa la bcu gsum mo/ /dge slong la khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum mo/ /byang chub sems kyi sdom pa la nyi shu tham pa/ sngags kyi dam tshig la rang gi dam tshig dang sngags pa'i gnyis so/ /de tsho yod tshad yar ldan du brtsi sngags kyi sdom pa'i khog tu brtsi gsungs bye// //bskur mchan/1584 hūṃ/mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉skadam tshig gi brgyan bzhugs—/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ ldu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'izung / skye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉par—/ ce 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang /1585 she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang / 2/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉than/ ṅku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasten/( khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang / kye〈〈pe 〉thadag 〈〈snar 〉rang / ④/〈〈pe 〉ra ts+tsha/ 〈'ar 〉༄ts+tsha/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btang / rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpang / rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lpen/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsa ba dam tshig yan lag spyad pa nyams na bshegs/ /rdo rje slob dpon las phan yon nyes dmigs/ /bzod pa la sogs bsgom pa/1586 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoradzi/ khru〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tha min/ /ma rdzogs par ni spang bar bya/ / ge〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bstan / je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbyeng / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasten/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lo drwak+ṣa/ lju〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skal/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ra/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lha bsnyen pa/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasten/1587 ky-i〈〈pe 〉ribya/ ke hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang / ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄/ thu/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha de nyid gsang /hūṃ〈〈snar 〉ṅka/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartsam/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lce/ kye〈〈snar 〉rdza/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srun pa'o/1588 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wān pa'o/ bye 〈(pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngosung /25—1588

༄༅/ /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya — lālba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha na no 2pi ka /bod skad du/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gye sgrub thabs / dpal ldan gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba sems can mun 'thoms na pa'i/ /kun nas dkris pa'i nyon mongs kun/ /sgon rnges gsal 4phyir sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin la 5gus btud de/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag ni/ /klu yi byang chub nyid kyis rim/ /bzhin bshad rigs rnams 'os su grub pa yi/ /sngags pa yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /yid 'ong bkra shis bde gnas su/ /bla med rgyu ru rag gnas la/ /snying gar nyi la 6hūṃ bzhag ste/ /byin brlabs bltas te — bka' bsgo la/ /'od kyis bgegs la thog rnams dbab/ / rgyu gyi tshig dang yang dag ldan/ /hūṃ las 'od zer ha 'phros pas/ /rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri dang / /me yi khang pa yongs 25—— /590

su dbub/ /badz+ra tsakra ha na dang / /dz+wa la ram̐ yang yongs su brjod/ /g.yas pa'i ram̐ dang g.yon pa'i a/ /snying rjes bgegs gsos byer bar 'gyur/ /rgyud 'os gyur nas rang byung gi/ /de 'od las byung nyi dkyil du/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas bcas spyan drang / /bla ma mi bskyod gzugs 'dzin la/ /phyag 'tshal phyi nang bzhi yis mchod/ /sdig pa bshags nas sdom pa gzung / /yi rang bskul dang gsol ba gdab/ /bsngo dang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de/ /tshad med bzhi po yongs su bskyed/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i rnam pa kun/ /thams cad yongs su dag pa las/ /rang byung 1sngags bskyed 'byung ba yi / /gzhal yas lam ldan rab tu bcas/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /ka ba brgyad dang rin chen mdzes/ /dra ba dra phyed pha gu dang / /dar dpyangs rta babs rnams dang ldan/ /seng ge 'khor lo nyi zla'i gdan/ /de steng hūṃ las rdo rjer gyurasngu/ /de las dpal ldan gnyis kyi bdag /nyon mongs kun sel gtum po'i gzugs / /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu la brgyan/ /mthing ga gos sngon sgu la gsol/ /rdo rje dril bu lag na thogs/ /thun mong las dang rjes mthun no/ /mchog kyang thogs pa med par ro/ /sbrul bzhis lus la rnam par brgyan/ /spyan dmar mche gcigs sbrul nag za/ /rin chen dpa' bo'i chas 5kyis brgyan//brkyang bskum khro bo brjid pa'i zhal/ /gsus khyem che zhing 'jigs pa can/ /de gsal mdun du ye shes dgug /bgegs bsal mchod dang gtor mas mnyes / /e ma ho dpal ldan gos sngon can/ /lus kyi rtog pa bsal ba'i phyir / /ye shes thugs rje chen po'i dang / /bdag lus ye shes sgur byin zlobs / /zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas sgu gsung thugs gnas su/ /25—/bye9/

yig 'bru gsum las 'od byung nas/ /mi sdug yig 'bru 'od kyi gzugs/ /bsdus shing bsregs te sbyangs pa las/ /ye shes gsum ni gnas su bzhag /ye shes rigs lngas byin gyis brlabasazi1/ /dbang bskur mi bskyod rigs lngas brgyan / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu hra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis/ ngag yongs su dag par byas te/ gsang sngags bzlas so/ /gsal ba rnam gnyis rags dang phra/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi rnam pa la/ /gsal bar byed pa de nyid do/ /rgyud rnams sbyangs pa'i bzlas pa ni/ /rags pa dang ni phra ba'o/ /rags pa gnyis te ba thag dang / /ba thag med de gnyis ka la/ /mgal me phreng ba nyi ma'i tshul/ /phra yang gsum du 'byung ba ni/ /hūṃ bskul bsreg pa ram̐ yin te/ /lte bar bkru ba spyi bo a/ /mtshan ma 'dod pa'i bzlas pa la/ /rnam pa lngar 'dis ma byas pa/ /'od zer dkar dmar 'phro 'du dang / /ba thag gzings dang dmigs pa med/ /snying gar bskor ro mtshan ma 'byung / /ram̐ dang hūṃ las me byung bas/ /ye shes lus su gsal bar snang / /grub rtags thon pa'i rtags gsum las/ /'od sgra sku ston sgyu ma dang / /tshogs dang gtor mas bzlog par bya/ /de rjes sangs rgyas lung ston 'byung / /grogs ni khrus dang sreg dang tshe/ /bdud rtsi klog 'don maṇ+ḍal dang / /tshogs dang sbyin sreg gsad 3pa dang / / tsha tsha 4gtor ma la sogs pa/ /'di yang grogs su 'gro ba yin/ /de nas gser la sogs pa 'grub/ /mchog 'dod pa yi sems can gyis/ /thabs dang shes rab 'khor lo bzhi/ /snying nas spyor ba gsum gyi rtsa / /yi ge thig les yang dag mtshan/ /dbus su thabs dang shes rab 'bar / /dbu ma dbyings nas sprul pa ru/ /ye shes gsal bar 5dbyings 25—1592

la thug /de tshe mi gnas bsam dang bral/ /'gro ba'i tshe dbang gang gi rtsa/ /kha phye ba yi nang nas thig le bsam/ /ba thag phug nas thig le la/ /thim mo de la blo gtad pas/ /mtha' 'das rang bzhin med pa'o/ /'jug pa ba thag bzhi po yang / /srid gsum 'joms pa'i rang bzhin te/ /stong pa ba thag bzhi por thim/ /dbang po thig le med pa la/ /dbu ma chen po'i dbyings nyid du/ /ye shes phra mo las kyis spros/ /'byung 'jug phra ba'i ba thag ni/ /skor bdun 'ong dang 'gro ba 'grub/ /rtags lnga la bzla phyag rgya yi/ /ye shes chen po thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni gang zag snod can la/ /gang zag tshul 'chos g.yo can rnams/ /gsang sngags phrag khyer ngan song rgyu/ /de la sbyin par mi bya'o/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i gang zag la/ /dngos grub klu mo mkha' 'gros ster/ /brgyud pa'i rim pa man ngag 'di bkod pas/ /tshig dang don la nyes pa yang yod srid/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa dang / /mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /khengs pa rnyed pa bkur ster rmyel sogs min/ /phyi rabs rtsod pa'i dus su sems can dngos grub 'byung / /'di brtsams pa yi bsod nams kyis/ /khams gsum sems can ma lus kun/ /rags dang phra ba'i rtog pa kun spangs nas/ /yongs su dag pa'i sa thob shog /dge slong klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //25—1593

1116༄ / /sngags pa rgyan gyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba/1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ man+d+ra a lo kā ra nā ma ṭī kā/ bod skad du/sngags pa rgyan gyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus mtha' rtsod pa rgyas dus su/ /nyi zla lta bu'i mthu mnga' zhing / /thams cad sel cing snang ba yi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dang / /rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i man ngag brtson pa yi/ /nyi mas mun pa sel ba bzhin/ /tshig sgrib 4snang bar byed pa yi/ /rtsa ba'i 'grel du gsungs pa yin/ de la myur du nas 5bshad pa'i bar du ma bkral lo/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ /sngags la 7gtso cher byed pa yi/ /rigs bzang don dang ldan pa yis/ /zhes pa la/ gang zhig rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang bis 'og tu sngags bzlas par 'brel to/ /sngags la gtso bor ni zhi gnas dang lhag mthong ma yin te/ sngags kha nas bzlas par 'byel to/ /25—/595

rigs bzang don ldan ni rin po che'i rigs la dbang la sogs pa bzhi dang ldan pa'o / /yid dang mthun pa'i gnas dag tu/ /sngags kyi mi mthun kun spangs nas/ /bsnyen pa'i gnas su legs 'dug ste/ /yid dang mthun pa'i gnas ni/ rang sde nyams dga' ba'i yul lo/ /sngags kyi mi mthun zhes pa ni dge ba dang sdig byed ma nag rmyel sogs pa'o/ /bsnyen pa'i gnas ni byang ris skyob pa gel sogs pa/ snyan pa phyun sum tshogs pa'o/ /der tshes bzhi la 'dug ces 'og ma dang 'byel to/ /sems sbyang lhag pa'i lhar gyur te/ /bsrung dang tshogs bsag bhustong par bsgom/ /zhes pa la/ sems sbyang lhag pa'i lha ni sems ni smon 'jug ste/ theg pa chen por sems bskyed pa'o/ /'jug pa'i rim pa yang stong pa nyid las rang lhag pa'i lhar hūṃ gis bskyed par 'byel te rang gis so/ /bsrung ba ni bka' bsgo zhing bskrad pa dang ma song ba la bsad pa'i thog dbab cing rdo rje la sogs pa'i bsrung ba'i gzhi bsgom par 'byel to/ /de ni ngag dang lus kyi las su gsungs te/ mthar phyin par byed pa'o / /tshogs bsag ④ces pa ni bsod nams kyi yan lag bcu ste/ rten dang ba'i ngo bos bshags par 'byel to/ /stong pa ⑤ni ye shes kyi yan lag ste/med cing mi dmigs pa ste phyi nang ngo / /de las rang gi sems nyid ni yi ge hūṃ gi rnam pa las/ rgyu ⑥'phros gzhal yas khang par gyur/ /zhes pa la stong pa de'i ngang las sems nyid hūṃ byung ste/ de las gzhal yas khang gi rgyu klurnam par bskyed pa'o/ /yang na ni rang gi sgrub thabs las byung ba bzhin bskyed par gsungs so/ /de steng hūṃ las cho ga gsum/ /dpal ldan gtum po'i gzugs su snang / /zhes pa la/ gdan lnga dang ldan pa'i thog tu hūṃ las cho dza 25—1596

gsum gyis 1gtum po ni mi'u khyethung gi gzugs bskyed par gsungs so/ /g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /g.yon pas ①bya khyung nges par bsnams/ / sku mdog byasngon po dpa' bo'i chas/ /zhes pa la/ g.yas pa'i phyag na ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ rigs lnga yang yongs su gzung ngo / /g.yon na bya khyung bsnams pa ste/ klu'i gdon drug 'dul bar byed pa'o/ /sku mdog sngon po na bza' sngon po ste/ /rang gi ngo bo phyir byung ba des 'dul ba'o/ /dpa' bo'i chas ni rak+ta so ris tshom bu dang / /stag la sogs pa brgyad du gsungs⑤ / /zhes lung las 'byung ba ste/ dpa' bo'i chas brgyad do/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum 'gying bag can/ /zhes pa la zhabs g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum pa ni/ sems can 'dul ba dang ⑥ rang la skyon med par yongs su gzung ngo / /'gying bag ni rang gi stobs nye bar ston pa ste/ nyam nga med pa'i ⑦lha yongs su gsal bar bsgom par gsungs so/ /ye shes bstem dang byen brlabs nas/ /dbang bskur 'bras bu lnga dang ldan/ /zhes pa ni hūṃ las ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ bgegs nye bar zhi bar bya ste rang gi lus ngag yid gsum 3la/ yi ge gsum gsal bar bya ste/ bstem pa dang dbang bskur ba ni chu dang dbu rgyan dang rdo rje dril bu'i kyedabang dang lngas/ kun gzhi dang nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa dang sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas pa ni ye shes lnga dang 'bras bu rigs lnga dang ⑩ldan par gsungs so/ /de yang lung las/ bdag nyid gsal bar gyur pa ni/ /ye shes byen brlab ⑪dbang bskur nas/ /sngags bzlas pa la yongs su 'jug /'bras bu yongs su 'byin pa yis/ /rdo rje'i 8sngags kyi bzlas pa bya/ /bdag dang gzhan pa'i rnam pa yis/ /rags 25—1597

pa dang ni phra ba yis/ /zhes pa la/ rdo rjes ni bsgom pa'i rjes la bzlas pa bya ste / de min par ni ma yin no/ /bdag gsal ba dang gzhan gsal ba dang /gtso bo gsal ba ni bdag khyab byed min —1pas gtso bo la bdag ces bya ba'i sgra 'jug pas de skad gsungs so/ /de ni gzhal yas khang dang dur khrod mi ro 'a/ sogs pa gsal ba'o/ /rags pa ni rnam pa ci gsal ba phra ba dri zhespyan dang smin ma dang / zhag gi zo ris la sogs pa yongs su gzung ngo / /shin tu phra ba'i rnam pa ste/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs 4gzhal yas khang / /gsal bar byed pa de nyid de/ /rnal 'byor tshul gyis yongs su sgrub/ /ces pa la/ shin tu phra ba ni rin po che nang gi ye shes dang rdo rje dang hūṃ gi rnam par gsungs so/ /de yang ye shes pa'i ngo bo gsum du gsungs te brtsegs 5mar 'dug pas brtsegs 6ma'o/ /gzhal yas khang rags pa gsal ba ste/ gong gi don gyis yongs su sasal bas 'dir ma bris so/ /rnal 'byor ni rang gi zhi gnas kyi lha gsal ba ste/ blta bar bya ba'i ngo bo'i rigs pas zin pa ni/ thun bzhi'i tshul du byed pa ni chen po'i 7rnal 'byor/ de yang stong pa nyid la zhugs rnal 'byor8 / /zhes gsungs so/ /'dod chags zhe sdang ni zhes pa nas spang bar bya ba'i bar la/ drug rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa 'dod chags la sogs pa drug dang /khro ba la sogs pa nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams sngags pas 9spangs te/ de dang 'byar ba'i sngags ni dngos grub mi 'byung bar gsungs so/ / de nas de bskyed pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis ka spang bar gsungs te/ kun ka'i rgyu ru 'gro ba ni chang ngo / /des na chang ni nyon mongs pa'i rtsa bar gsungs so/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /de bzhin reg bya la sogs pa/ /g.yeng 25—/598

bar gyur pa ma lus pa/ /sngags kyi dus su spang bar bya/ /zhes pa la sgrub pa pos 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po g.yeng ba'i rgyu yin pas des 1de ni yongs su spang bar gsungs te dgra yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sgra chen po dang sgra chung dang / /skyen pa dang ni bul ba dang / /mi gsal yan lag nyams pa dang / /gsang sngags bar du sgra zhugs dang / /dmigs pa ma rdzogs 'jog 4pa dang / /sngags kyi dus su spang bar bya/ /zhes bya ba la sgra che ba ni/ nam mkha'i 5sgra ste gsang ba'i man ngag nyams pa'o/ /chung ba ni sngags kyi brjod pa nyams pa ste spang ba'o/ /skyen pa dang bul ba ni sgra dma' zhing nyams pa sogs skyon 6du ma las 7nus pa 'byung ba'i rgyu ni rgyu gcig las ma yin te/ sgra mi gsal zhing yi ge mthu nyams pa dang bar du mi tshig gis ma chod par bya ste mi tshig gis bar chod pa ni sngags ma yin te/ mthu med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de rnams skyon yin pas spang bar gsungs so/ /de rtsa ba'i rgyud las / sgra che 'byung po'i bar chod 'byung / /sgra chung nus pa chung bar 'gyur/ /skyen 'gyur lus kyi phrad pa nyams / /bul 'gyur sngags kyi grongs ma skyol9/ /mi gsal yan lag nyams pa yis/ /bzlas pa'i mthu rnams gred par 'gyur/ /gsang sngags zhugs na gdug pa'i bar chod 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /dmigs pa ma sgogs 'jog —pa dang / /sngags kyi dus su spang bar bya/ /rjes kyi rnal 'byor ma lus par/ /zhes pa la dmigs pa ma rdzogs par rta/ dam bcas pa'i grangs las 'das pa'o/ /de ma rdzogs par ni bzlas pa bya ba ste mi bya ba ni spang bar gsungs so/ /rjes kyi rnal 'byor ni thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyis phyag btsal ba la sogs pa yongs su byas pa 'gro 'dug nyal ba'i spyod lam gyis bsgrub 2 25—/599

—par gsungs so/ /dus dang grangs dang mtshan ma dang rmye/ /ro dang dbang bskur la sogs pa/ /zhes bya ba la/ dus ni lo'am zla ba'i bar du'o/ /grangs ni/ nyis ṭu'abum sum 'bum bcu la grusogs/ /nyi shu rtsa ba'i grangs su'o / /bsnyen pa nye bsnyen bsgrub pa dang / /bsgrub gepa chen po'i tshul du bsgrub / /ces gsungs so/ /ro dang dbang bskur ni shi ba'i 3ro la dang po bgegs bskrad khrus byas rgyan gdags te rgyun chags dang rtsa ma lus par bya ste/sngags zlos shing rnal 'byor pa rnam pa gsum bsgrub pa la ro lha'i ngo bor bskyed la zhag bdun gyi nang par sreg khang me'i gzhal yas khang du mchod par 'byel to/ /de ni ro'i cho ga'o/ /dbang gi bsnyen pa ni gong du mtshan ma thob pas gtso bor 'bum dang 'khor rnams khri ru gsungs so/ /sems dpa' sum brtsegs gsal ba yis/ /rang nyid thig le'i ngo bo yis/ /'od zer la ni yig 'bru zhon / /'od dkar zhi ba'i tshul du thubazlas/ /zhes pa la sems dpa' sum brtsegs spuni sku dang gsung dang thugs gsal ba las/ rang nyid hūṃ gi thig le las sngags dang 'od gsal ba ni 'od zer la yig 'bru zhon nas snying gar mgal me bzhin bskor ba'o/ /de las 'od zer nyi ma'i tshul gyis 'od de yang dkar pos sdeg pa 'khrud pa'o/ /de ni 'od dkar pos zhi bar bya bar ( rtegasung /yang ni 'od 'phros ⑫sku gsum kyi/ /rang bzhin tshur 'dus gdug ⑫rtsub sbyong / /zhes pa la yang ni gong ma btags pa yin te/ 'od 'phros nas ye shes 'khor lo'i gnas gsum 'od zer kyis sku gsum ⑫ mnyes nas tshur la 'dus pas gnod pa'i gdug sems dang rang gi bag chags la sogs pa sbyong ba'o/ /yang na dmigs pa med pa las/ /'phro dang 'du bas byed pa yin/ /zhes pa la 25—1600

dmigs pa ni dngos po'o/ /dngos po la med par ye shes pa las 3'od 'phros nas / tshul 2byen dang 'od zer dang sku'i rnam par gsungs te man ngag go/ /'od zer dkar dmar 'phro 'du yis/ /rnam smin la sogs bsreg cing sbyong / /zhes pa la rang gi thig le las 1'od phar 'phros pas mnyes te dkar dmar 'dus pas ni bsreg cing spyong ba'i las so/ /rnam par smin pa dang nus thumathu la sogs pa sbyong zhing bsreg pa'o/ /des ni zhi ba dang drag por gsungs te/5mi smra ba'i ngo bos bzlas par 'ugasungs so/ /'khor dang nye 'khor sum 'khor 3sogs / /mtshan ma 'dod pa rnam pa lnga/ /zhes bya ba la/ rang nyid 'khor la mos na 'khor gang yang rung ba bskyed la bzlas par gsungs so/ /lnga po de ni gong du bsnyen pa'i bzlas par 9gsungs so/ /sum 'bum zhes pa nas tshad kyi bar la gcig la sogs pa 'bum dang / nyis 'bum ni grangs kyi bzlas par gsungs te/ rtsa ba na gsal bas ma bris so/ /de yi grogs 'gyur bzlas pa ni//sdog pa dbyung rtadang bsreg pa ni/ /bkru ba'i don la dmigs pa ste/ /rags dang phra ba'i dbang dag tu/ /drug dang dgu ru shes par bya/ /zhes pa la/bsnyen pa'i grogs bye1lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa dbyung ba dang bsreg pa dang bkru ba ste/ gdon mupa ni snying ga dang lte bar bsreg pa dang / spyi bo nas nga bkru bar gsungs so/ /rags pa'i dbang du drug gis sabakru ba ma yin te dngos po 'don pa dang bsreg pa ni rags par gsungs pa 1spyobakru ba'i cha dang 'brel ngabs dgu ru gsungs so/ /sdig pa dbyung ba 5la sogs kyang / /mi drug gzugs dang 1 de bzhin du/ /yi ge'i gzugs dang 'od kyi gzugs/ /de dag dbyung —gtor bsreg cing bkru/ /zhes pa la/ spyig pa ni lus ngag 25—1601

yid kyi las sam rnam par smin pa'i sgrib pa'o/ /lus ni sdom mam sdig lkupa'i gzugs so/ /ngag gi kai ngam snadu'o/ /yid ni 'od dpung nag por gsungs so / /de yang snying las u sa ta ya mtha' can gyis —/gdon pa dang / lte ba'i 4haṃ las me 'bar nas dzā 1la ram̐ gyi sngags kyis bsreg par — gsungs so/ /bkru ba ni a las spyi bo nas 7chu 'bebs pas shu to'i sngags kyis bkru'o/ /hūṃ dang haṃ dang a yis ni/ /gdon dang bsreg dang bkru ba ni/ /ma lus las rnams 'grub par gsungs/ /dmigs pa gsar rnying ༄ snabye brag gis/ /mgal me phreng ba nyi ma'o/ /zhes pa la/ dmigs pa gsar pa ni rnal 'byor pa thog mar mgal me la brten par gsungs pa ni phreng ba dang nyi ma'o97/ /mchog gis 7ni gsum tshang ba la bzlas par gsungs so/ /sngags kyi dngos grub nas grogs su 'gro ba'i bar la rtsa ba na gsal bas ma bris so/ /rjes kyi hūṃrnal 'byor tshul dang ldan/ /bsnyen sgrub muchen po la sogs pas1— / /yongs su bsgrubs pas dngos grub 'byung / /zhes pa ni/ rjes kyi rnal 'byor ni kispyod lam kyi rim pa'i dus su patsha tsha la sogs pa yongs su bya'o/ /de nas bsnyen pa dang / nye bsnyen dang / sgrub pa chen po la sogs pas yongs su bsgrub bo/ /de bsgrub 7na dngos grub yongs su 'byung bar gsungs so/ /sku gsum 7zhes pas1shā 'di yang sgrub pa'i rtags su gsungs/ /zhes pa'i bar du dngos dang rmi lam na grub rtags bstan pa yin pas brjod pa med de gsal bar ma smras so/ /de dag bzlas pa nas shes par bya ba'i bar du bzlas pa'i dngos te bzlas pa'i sngags su gsungs so/ /mig gi mngon shes bsgrub pa ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa la//ye shes 'phro 'dus 5 (byen rlabs sdud/ / bsnyen pa skyol bas de bzhin bya/ /25—1602

zhes pa la/ da ni khyad par gyi bzlas pa gsungs te/ mig gi mngon shes 'dod pas/ rang la sgu gsung thugs kyi yi ge bkod la/ ye shes pa'i 'od zer 'phros shing tshur 'dus pas mig gi 1sgrib pa dag pas sha'i spyan dang ldan par gsungs shing — / mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa skyol bas 'grub par gsungs so//rna ba dang ni dbang po gzhan/ /gong ma de bzhin spyor shes bya'o/ /zhes pa la/rna ba la sogs pa 4gzhan rnams la ni/ sku gsum mam āḥdang hūṃ gis 'phros pa dang 'dus pas/ de'i dngos por dag par byas te/ snang ba dag par bsgrub par gsungs so/ /gang zhig phrin las rnam bzhi las/ /dang 5po zhi ba gsungs pa ni/ /zhi ba ni zhi ba'i ste dgra bgegs zhi bar 'dod pa'o/ /kha dog dkar po'i 'phro 'du yis/ /rang gi sdeg dang 6bag chags dang / /gzhan gyi gdug rtsub zhi bar byed/ /ces pa la/ kha dog dkar po 'phros pas rang gi sdig pa'i dngos po dang / kun nas dkris pa'i bag chags zhi ba dang /gzugs dang sgra med khams kyi gnod byed kyi dbal dang gdug rtsub zhi bar song zhes gsungs so/ /tshe dang rigs rgyud longs spyod rnamasadz+wa/ /rgyas par 'dod pa 'od zer ser/ /zhes pa ni de la des tshe ring ba dang / rang gi rigs rgyud dar ba dang / longs spyod ni lha'i longs spyod dang ldan par 'dod pa rnams kyis 'od dang lha dang ser po'i 'phro 'du la brten te/ rang gi snying po la puṣ+ṭi ku ru oṃ zhes pa gdags so/ /bde gshegs 'od bskul rang lus kyi/ /rang bzhin tshe r+sharnams rgyas par byed/ /ces pa/ rang gi 'od rin chen gos sngon can la 'phros te/ des hūṃ gi dngos po gsal bar sbyangs pa ni nyi ma dang zla ba'i bar du ā li dang ldan pas 7gsungs so/ /dkar dmar khu ba'i 'phro 'du 25—1603

yis / /'jig rten rigs rgyud rgyas par byed/ /ces pa las/ rang dang ldan pa'i 'od ye shes 'khor lo la phog pas thig le ā li dang kā li'i ngo bor spyan drangs pa'i ngo bo des 7snade la srung ba dang 'brel te/ las des bu la sogs pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /nor dang rdzas ni rgyas 'dod pas/ /rin chen bcud kyi tshul du sgrub/ /ces pa la/ nor dang rdzas rgyas nas bde bar gshegs pa mchod par 'dod pas/ re gyis thubadud rtsi ster ba bum pa kha rgyan dang ldan pa'i nang du/ rgyal po bskyed la mchod pas mchod de/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ye sa ma ya ba shaṃ ku ru hoḥ/ zhes pa dang 'byel pa ni sgrub pa'o/ /bya grub ye shes ngo bo ste/ /rin chen mchod rten ṣ+pe'u — le bsnams/ /sgrub pyapa'i dgos 'dod 5skong mdzad ma/ /rnam thos nor ster hūṃkhyod la bstod/ /ces pa dang 'brel to/ /de'i nor ni sum cha gsum du spyod par gsungs so/ /kha dog dmar po'i dz+wa'od zer gyis/ /dmigs pa ma lus dbang du sdud/ /ces pa la/'od zer dmar po kha dog dmar po lha la phog pas gang dmigs pa ni lha dang klu dang srin po la sogs pa dbang du sdud de de yang ba shaṃ ru—ku ru hoḥzhes pa dang 'byel to/ /tshar gcod thudus kyi sbyor ba ni/ /'khor lo 'od zer skur gyur rka te / /bkug cing tho ba la sogs pas/ /zhes pa la/ gru gsum dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor du liṅga'i 11gzugs bcug la ye shes kyi 'khor lo las 3'od zer dmar po 'phros pa'i 'od las lcags kyu thogs pa mang po 'phros nas rang dbang med par bkug ste thim pa ni bsdigs 5pa ste/ sngags bzhis bstems nga la tho ba dang / ral gri la sogs pas phab nas med par byas pa'o/ /drag po'i mtshon cha 5thog phab pas/ /spyi bo gtsug gnas rnams su ni/ /phung po 25—1604

gzhig pa'i spyor ba bya/ /zhes pa la/ lus ngag drag po dang bcas pa'i khro bos mtshon cha'i ) thog 'bebs pa'o/ /spyi 2gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil du/phur pa brgyab cing de'i phung po lnga la sogs pa 'jig par 'gyur te de ni phung po bshig pa'o/ /sa bon 'joms dang 'byed byed pas/ /1'grub par 'gyur bar gsungs pa yin/ /zhes pa la sa bon 'joms pa ni byang sems bskam pa ste/ram̐ las me 'bar ba dang phur pa yang brdeg par gsungs so/ /'byed pa yang lha dang dbral 4ba ste/ dong du gu gul sbyar ma bdug cing / ban+ta ku ru shag shag ār+ya a tsa la shag shag ces pas sngags kyis 'byed par gsungs so/ /de la sogs pa'i spyor ba rnams/ /5mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya/ /zhes pas 6 bsreg pa dang mnan pa dang 'phangs pa la sogs pa 7mkhas pas shes par bya'o/ /de rnams sngags kyi mtha' la ni/ /zhes pa nas/ man ngag go bar byas 9la sham bu'i sngags gsad 1 pa dang srung ba la sogs pa bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /mkhas pa'i tshig ces pa ni ma bris so/ /bdag gis 1 gzhan don rgyas pa ni/ /bris pas ma legs nyen thusrid pas/ /bla ma mkhas pa de la bzod par gsol/ /klu mo mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs — pa dang / /sems can bdag pas dman la phan par bya phyir dang / /rang mos shugs kyis gzhung 'di brtsams/ /'di brtsams pa yi dge ba yis/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kun/ /sngags kyi mi mthun zad gyur nas/ /yongs su dag pa'i sa job shog /sngags kyi rgyan gyi 'grel pa mchog rab —kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma dam pa'i man ngag snyan nas snyan du thob pa rdzogs so// //25—1605

1117༄ / /dam tshig rgyan gyi rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba/rte༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ma ya ā 2lo kā ra nā ma ṭī kā/ bod skad du/ dam tshig rgyan gyi rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba/ ston ka'i zla ba dri med 'od/ /ma skyes rdo rje ye shes nyid/ /rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo sa gzhi dang ni yongs bskyed la/ /'bras bu 'byen pa'i nus pa'o/ /ting 'dzin rgyu dang rab spyor ba'i/ /bdag po grogs la sogs pa yis / /'di yang 'bras bu 'byin pa'i grogs/ /rten med 'bras bu 'byin 'dod pa/ /mi 'byung sa bon mes bsregs bzhin/ /de —na 'di yi don 'di bri/ /zhes pa'o/ / de nas / 5 dam tshig med dang 'tshal bar gtong / /som nyi la sogs bsal ba'i phyir/ /dam tshig rnams ni mdor bsdus nas/ /gsang ba'i bdag btud de ni bshad/ /ces pa ni rtsa ba'i don bshad pa'i don dgongs so/ /de la dam tshig med pa spyoni bsgom pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / sbyin sreg la 25—1608

sogs pa rnams 'bras bu med de sa bon me'am chu la gtor ba bzhin no/ /som nyi bsal ba ni/ blang ba dang / srung ba dang bcos pa ni spyi dang khyad par ro//dam tshig mdor bsdus pa ni/ nyan thos sdom pa dang / jeg pa chen po'i don byed pa dang / gsang sngags so/ /gsang ba'i bdag la btud de bshad/ / ces pa ni 1bkra shis pa'i yan lag ste/ mchod pa'i tshul gyis nyon mongs zil gyes mnan na bar chad mi 'byung ste/ de nas bshad ces pas 'og ma dang 'brel to/ /sngags pas bsrung ba'i dam tshig ni / /zhes pa ni/ sngags pa rgo rin po che'i rigs kyi gang zag la dbang bskur ba'o/ /yid skyob cing 'dzin pas na de'i don yod pas na sngags pas so/ /srung ba ni sdom pa bsrung 5zhes pa'o / /dam tshig ni gong ma'i don las mi 'da' zhes pa'i don to/ /nyan thos dang theg pa chen po dang gsang sngags kyi don las 'das na/ mnar med 6skye bas don bsrung zhes bya ba ste/ sngags pa rnams so/ /dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /nya 'am stong gi dus dag tu/ /yan lag brgyad pa nyer gnas te/ /lo gcig pa 'am zla gcig bya/ /7zhes pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag gcig pu 'khor ba las bsgral lo/ /zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa thar pa thob par bya/ zhes pa nyan thos kyi sems bskyed do/ /nya'am steng ni zhes pa la/ sdom pa dang ldan pa'i dge slong gcig la/ phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas/ zla ba 'ong ngo cog gi nya'am stong la/ de dang 'brel pa'i sdom pa blang / /zhes pa'o/ /yan lag brgyad ces pa ni/ srog gcod gzhan gyi nor 'phrog dang / /mi tshangs spyod brdzun bcos pa'i chang / /glu gar rol mo rgyan byug pa/ /mal stan che dang kha zas spong / /'di ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims so/ /25—1609

yang na sdom pa gsum dang 1ldan pa'i bla ma la/ phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ bla mas / srog chags rnams ni gsad grumi bya/ /zhes pas sdom pa byin te/ lo gcig zla gcig bar du bsrung / /zhes pa gong ma bzhi dang 'byel lothu/ /de nas ji srid sems bskyed 5de/ /bslab pa lnga po legs gzung ste/ /lo gcig zla gcig bar dag tu/ /sdom pa brtan por gzung hūṃbar bya/ /zhes pa la/de nas ji srid sems bskyed ces pa la/ smon 'jug gnyis kyis dge bsnyen du sems bskyed/ dge slong ngam bla ma rnams kyi mdun du/ phyag sngon du 'gro bas / dge bsnyen gyi las kyis/ de'i sdom pa blangs te/ tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen ni/ yan lag brgyad po ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung ba'o/ /sna 'ga' srung ba phal chen no/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang myos pa'i khu ba dang / bslab pa lnga po legs par bsrung bar gsungs pa/ de yang lo dang zla ba'i bar du sdom pa gong ma de brtan por 7gzung zhe'o/ /de nas dge tshul dge slong gi/ /bslab pa la ni legs gnas nas/ /mi gtong lo 'am zla ba 'am/ /sdom pa nyams pa blang bar bya/ /zhes pa la/ de nas dge tshul gyis mkhan po dang btsun pa la/ bar chad kyi chos yongs su bsal zhing / dkon mchog la phyag dag gis spong ba bcu 'khor dang bcas pas blang zhing bsrung zhes pa'i don to / /dge slong gis btsun pa gsum gyi mdun du khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum blangs pa dang / bsrung ba dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas/ rang 1snagi bslab pa legs par bsrung / /zhes pa'o/ /de nas sngags kyi dam tshig gi khoched du/ mi gtong 1bar lo'am zla ba'i bar du sdom pa nyams pa blang zhing bshags zhes so/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa lamu/ /gang zhig gis ni legs 1 35—/6/0

gnas na bye/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dus kun du/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong 2ngo / /zhes pa ni/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni/ 'du byed shes pa ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa'o/ /bag chags la sems bslen pas brtan par byas te/rten gyi gang zag gi sdom pa cholegs par gnas par byas te/ mkhas pa ni blang ba dang bsrung ba dang / bca' 3ba shes pas bca' 4zhes pa'o/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong 3ste/ phung po srog dang bral yang rang gi sdom pa mi gtong 8 ba'o / /gang zhig gis ni de goms 'gyur/ /gang 9tshe gong ma'i babe+eb gnas pas / /de tshe 'og ma'i ming dang bral/ /zhes pa la/ gang zhig gis ni de goms 'gyur ni/ rten gyi gang zag des bsnyen gnas dang / dge bsnyen dang so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la/ dang por rim par ⑫/goms par bya/ /zhes pa'o / /gang tshe gong ma'i bslab gnas na/ /'og ma'i ming dang bral ba 11ni/ /spang ba chen po chen po la gnas na/ /chung ngu'i spang bya ni/ sor med de gong ma sakhyab bya la don khyad par gnas pa ste/ 'og ma'i don gong ma la 'bras bu'i tshul du khyab ces pa ni/ rtsa dang rgyud 1nadang lo ma dang 'bras bu dang sa bon gyes khyab ces pa'o/ /gong ma gtso bo yin pa'i phyir yang 'og —ma'i ming dang bral zhes pa'o/ /dang po sbyin pa bslab bya ste/ /dngos po bcu gnyis yang dag ldan/ /zhes pa thuni/ sems can don byed tshul khrims ston pa yin te/bla ma'am dkon mchog gi mdun du/ bkra shis pas sems can don byed tshul du sems bskyed nas/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po yis/ /yang dag byang chub nges mdzad pa'i/ /cho gas sdom pa blang ba ni/ /pha rol phyin drug tshul du spyad / /ces pa'i tshig dang 'brel to/ /sbyin pa la dngos po bcu gnyis ni/25—/61 /

chos kyi sbyin pa la don bshad pa dang / smyu gu dang snag tsha dang lkupo ti bzhi'o/ /zang zing la nor dang dbyig dang zas dang gos te gnyis pa'o/ /skyabs kyi spyin pa la/ srog dang lam 'phrang dang 'jigs skyabs/ byams pa dang bzhi ste bcu gnyis so/ /tshul khrims la ni rnam dgu ste— sna/ /bzod dang brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan dang / /shes rab gsum ste gsum du bstan —/ /zhes pa'i don la / sdom pa dang dge ba don byed de/ de yang lus ngag yid gsum spangs pa dang 'byel teri/ bzod pa ni chos zab mo la sems pa'i bzod pa dang /sdug bsngal dang du len pa dang / gnod pa byas pa 1la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa'o / /brtson 'grus ni go cha dang sbyor ba dang mthar phyin pa gsum mo/ /bsam gtan ni nyes pa spong ba dang / dbang 'byor pa dang / rnam par gnas pa gsum mo/ /shes rab ni thos pa bsam pa bsgom pa'othu/ /gzhan gye mya ngan sangs la sogs7/ /sems can don 'gyur thams cad kun/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong sdongo / /zhes pa la/ gzhan gyi mya ngan las las thungan pa bsags pa'i sdig pa'i gang zag rnams te/ dang po ⑩brtson 'grus dang shes rab dang snying rje dang ldan zhing —sna sngar gyi las ngan pa sel cing thar pa dang bde bar grol lo zhes bya'o/ /sems can srog gi phyir yang mi gtong 1—ni/ sems/ can don dang 'byel pa srog gi skyabs la sogs pa/ rang gi srog dang mubasdo zhes pa'o/ /sdom pa de lo'am zla ba'i bar du/ brtan nas sngags kyi dam tshis blang / /zhes pa lamu/ sdom pa de rnams rim pas len pa ni gang zag spros bcas la dga' ba'i don du gsungs pa'o/ /theg pa chen po'i rigs can 'a/ ni / sdom pa gsum gdan thog tu blang / /zhes pa'o/ /sngags kyi dam tshis 25—1612

blang ba ni/ /bla ma sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa las rmyedabang blang zhing / dbang bzhi dang 'byel pa'i dam tshig gsum pa'o/ /spyi dang khyad par gnyis su shes ni/spyi 2gsang sngags phyi nang gi dam tshig dang / khyad par gsang ba'i bdag po'i dam tshig go/ /dang po dag ni bshad bya ni/ sngags spyi'i dam tshig go/ /dang po slob dpon mnyes par bya/ /yi dam spang 1len mi bya ste/ /lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs/ /phyag rgya che la rab tu gnas/ /zhes pa la / dang po dbang gi dus su bla ma yo byad dang spyod pas mnyes par bya ba'o/ /dbang thob par bya ste/ phyis de bzhin du bla ma dang dam pa rnams la/ rang gis ④lus ngag yid kyi nyes pa med cing mos par bya/ zhes pa dang 5nyes pa che chung gi tshogs dang / gtor ma brgyad 6dang 'bum la sogs pas bshags pa bya'o / /yi dam spong len mi bya ni/ /shes pas gong ma'i lha spangs na/ /rtsa ba chad de ngan song 'gro/ /zhes pa ni de ni mnar med pa'o/ /shul gyi don la lha snga ma'i 'bras bu yod pa bstems te 7gnyis med byas rmena'am/ gnyis snang sked par gcig gi ngo bo byung na ma spangs pa'o/ /lus ngag yid phyag rgya chen po ni / lus lha dang ngag gi byerdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / sems phyag rgya chen po dang mi 'byel pa snaste mi dge ba bcu med pa ni phyag rgya chen po la rab tu gnas zhes bya'o/ /dam pa rnams ni smad mi bya/ /gsang ba'i don yang bstan mi bya/ /rtags chen sku yang mi bstan te/ /bzlas dang sems nyams bstan mi bya/ /zhes pa la/ dam pa rnams ni bla ma dam pa'am sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i bla ma dam pa ste/ de la smad na sangs rgyas la mnyes pa mi bgyis pa ste/ chos med pa'i yul du skye zhes pa'o/ /gsang ba'i don ni gsang sngags kyi don dang / dbang 25—1613

gnyis pa gsum pa'i man ngag rnams dang / rdo rje'i srun ma yin pa la mi bstan pa ste/ bstan na sngags kyi dngos grub yal/ /zhes pa'o/ /rtags chen su yang mi bstan te/ /rang gi lhag pa'i sku'i rtags rnams phyi pa la mi bstan te/bstan na lhag pa'i lha'i dngos grub mi 'byung ba'o/ /bzlas na sems nyams mi bstan na/ /rang gi rdo rje spun min pa la bzlas pa'i spyod pa dang / man ngag dang don rnams bstan na/ de'i de nyid mi 'byung zhes pa'o/ /nyams dang dngos dang rmi lam dang 'byel pa'i sems nyams mi bstan te/ de'i dngos grub yal zhes pa'i don dang 'byel to/ /bla ma dang rdo rje spun la ma yin te/ rang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni rtsa ba'i dam tshig bstan pa yin pa'i phyir gong gi ton to/ /rdo rje dril bu phreng 4ba dag /skad cig tsam yang spang mi bya/ /grogs po'i sems ni dkrug mi bya/ /khyad par grogs la smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa la/ rdo rje dril bu rtag tu bcang ste mchod rdzas yin pa dang 'byel pa'i don yid la bya ba'i phyir ro/ /phreng ba ni bla ma dang lha dang lam khyad par can phreng zhing yid la bya zhes pa'i don to/ /skad cig kyang ma brjed par yid la bya'o/ /grogs po'i sems ni rdo rje'i srun de dbang dang / dam tshig yongs su gzung ngo //sems can gnas gcig tu skyes pa yang nye ba'i spun yin pas gnod pa mi bya zhes pa'o / /khyad par grogs ni dbang dang man ngag gcig pa dang / grol bas mi bya zhing mnyes pa'o/ /yang na dbang gsum pa'i rten te/ de nyid du khrid pa'i 5grogs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /grogs ni srid pa bar do skyob pa dang / gnas pa gsum du 'grogs pa'i phyir grogs so/ /bsrung ba'i phyir bsrung ba'o/ /tshogs dang gtor ma sbyin sreg dang / /maṇ+ḍal tsha tsha la sogs pa/ /srog gi 25—/6/

phyir yang mi gtong rmyengo / /tshogs dang gtor ma dang tsha tsha 2la sogs pa rnams/lus la me 'bar bas myur bar bya ste/ dus rkyen gyis 'das na bsgrub pa'i skal ba dang mi ldan pas myur bar bya zhes pa'i don ston ༷ to/ /de ni rtsa ba dang yan lag nyams na bskang ba yin te/ nyes pa'i rim pa bdun dang nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / brgya rtsa brgyad stong dang khri drug 'bum gyis nyes pa'i rim pa dang sbyar nas 'dag ces pa'o/ /chos kyi spyod pa gzhan rna.oṃs kyang spang bar 'gyur ba smos ci dgos ni/ 1ga 'don dang nyan 4pa bskyab pa ste/ thar pa'i lam dang dge ba'i stobs 'byin pa'i phyir te5/ mi spang bar spyad pa dang 'byel to/ /sha chen khrag dang khu ba dang / /dri chen dang ni dri chu dang 6/ /blang dang spang bar bya ba min/ /rtsa ba byang chub sems mi gtong 7/ /zhes pa la/ sha chen khyag dang khu ba la dri chen dang dri chu la drod kyi nus pa med par/ skye bo phal pa'i mdun du spyad pa ma yin te/ khye phag dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /spang na nyan thos dang 'dra bas spang ba ma yin no/ /gsang sngags spang ba dang blang ba'i lam min te de ni rtog pa yin pas/ 'di ni bde ba'i lam yin te/ rtog med ces pa'i don to/ /rtsa ba byang chub sems mi gtong reni kun rdzob dang don dam ste / dge ba'i 'bras bu'i rtsa ba ma lus pa'i rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems yin pas spangs na ngan song du 'gro zhes pa'o/ /chos la smod pa'ang spang bar bya/ /dad ldan bsam pa sun mi dbyung / /bud med rnams la smad mi bya/ /spang dang blang bar bya ba min/ /zhes pa la/ chos dang smod pa rang dang gzhan kyi grub pa'i mtha' ste/ smad cing spangs na rnam par snang mdzad ring ba'i rgyu'o/ /dad ldan bsam pa sun mi dbyung ni theg pa che chung gi rigs can te/ chung ngu 25—1615

—ni chen por 'gal te sun ma phyung ba'o/ /gzhan ni lam gnyis ngan song sun 'byen pa ni de ni rgyu la 'jug pa ste/ rgyu 'bras sun 'byin pa'o/ /bud med ni bud med de chags bcas rnams dbang gsum pa'i dus rin po che'i rigs kyi gang zag rnams la mi smad ces pa'o/ /ye shes ngos 'dzin med par de spang ba'ang min blang ba'ang minatso/ gang zag gnyis kyis so/ /bgrod min la ni bgrod pa min/ /spang 1ba mi spong 'gyur ba dang / /blang bya mi len spang bar bya / /zhes pa la/ jeg pa chen po'i lam la zhugs pa'i gang zag gis/ mu stegs dang nyan thos kyi lam ngan pas phyis mi bgrod pa'o/ /spang zib phyis mi spong bar 'gyur ba'o/ /nyon mongs pa dang las kyis zhenyon mongs pa rnams te/de'i gzhi rnams spang zhes pa'o/ /blang bya mi len ni bskyed rdzogs kyi don de brtson 'grus kyis 'jug ces pa'o/ /dug lnga spong ba 6spang bar bya/ /blang ba yang ni spang ba yin/ /dug lnga ma spangs par 7spyad bya/ /zhes pa ste/ lung las / pha dang ma ni gsad 8par bya/ /rgyal po ngan pa bkur mi bya/ /bram ze grong khyer gzhom par bya/ /sems can don du gzhan dag gi/ /klubud med bsten 7cing mi gtsang spyadatso / /srog chags kyang ni gsad 7par bya/ /ma byin blang zhing brdzun smra dang / /gzhan la phrag dog myos 'gyur btung 1 / /'dis kyang grol bar 'gyur ba ste/ /dgongs pas bshad pa/ zhes ni dug lnga spang ba zhes pa ste rang ka ru mi spyad ces pa'o/ /gsang ba theg pa chen po'i gang zag skyes bu rnams kyis ni/ dug lnga mthun rkyen kyis blang zhing spyad par spang mi bya / 'gal rkyen dgra ru yang mi gzung ste/ spang bya blang bya ru byas nas lam bgrod na theg pa chen po'i rigs min te chung ngu'o/ /dgra dang gnyen du ma 25—1616

bzung kyeb ni spangs pa shugs te btang snyoms chen po'o/ /de ni theg pa chen bo mi slu 2ba'i lam la zhugs pa'o/ /dam pa ma yin bsten mi bya/ /zhes pa nas/rtag tu mi dang spyod pa bstun/ /zhes pa'i bar la/ log pa'i bla ma mi bsten pa dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi las kyi rim pa dang / de yang rtsa ba na gsal bas ma bris so/ /dang po dka' thub bsten pa ste/ /tha ma'i dus su spang bar bya / /chang sogs nyes par gyur pa spang / /zhes pa dang po bsten (pa lo'am zla ba ru brtan par gzung la dge slong gi bslab pa'i dus su bsnyen gnas logs su mi gos mete spang ba'o/ /yang na dang po sdom pa gsum la gnas par byas la/'jig rten mchog gi ye shes skyes tsam na/ dka' thub mi dgos kun brtags yin pa'i phyir ro/ /chang sogs nyes par gyur pa ni/ /sngags pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ba lnga rgyun du spang zhes pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sngags zlos pa rnams kyis brag btsong snyel sogs dang / mi nag sdig byed dang gsur chen la mi 'grogs so/ /thabs ldan dngos grub sbyor bar 'gyur na6/ grang ba can gyi nad sel ba'i sman phul dag re btung ba'am/ de ru yang rul sum shaṃ skyon spangs pa'o zhes nad gzhi'i rten mi byed pa btung ngo / /yang na bdud rtsi bsgrub pa bzhin btung zhes so/ /gang tshe bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /5zhes pa nas/ de phyir nyon mongs spang bar bya'i bar du rtsa bar 9gsal bas ma bris so/ /khyad par thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /zhes pa 11dang po bla ma la/ /dkyil 'khor me tog sngon por bcas/ /zhes pa dang po khyad par gye sdom pa blangs la 'phags pa gos sngon po can gyi sdom pa bsrung zhes pa'o/ /de nas khyad par gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i thod spyi phud dang 'dra ba'i sdom pa bsrung zhes pa'o/ /25—1617

thod ni bzang po ste/ chades phyag rgya chen po'i lhalam la phreng ba dang phreng thag bzhin 'byel pas kyang phreng ba'o/ /dam tshig la phreng ba dang 'dra bar phreng zhes so / /gos sngon po dang rak+ka 2dang / /rus pa'i phreng ba blang bar byagru/ /zhes pa la/ gos sngon po dang zer bas ngo tsha khrel yod gos/ stod g.yogs steng du gon pa ni gos sngon po'i rigs so/ /rak+ka ceni gnod sbyin phyaskrag pa'i rgyan sbrul dang stag dang bya khyung gis mtshan pa la sogs pa khro bo'i rgyan bsam zhes so / /rus pa'i phreng ba ni rin po che bai ḍūr+ya'i rgyan phrag pa g.yas la zar bu chags — 7su bsam mo/ /yang phreng ba ni phreng ba ste shing kur ྅rus byang chub sgrib sel gyi 'bras bu dang drag po la/ 'bor nye rus pa yang bgrang zhes te/ rgyan gyi dam tshig go/ /dus kun du ni rang lha mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma mnyes par bya/ /rtag tu rang lha'i bsnyen pa bya/ /rtag tu rang gi dushedam tshig bsrung / /dus zhes pa ni dus kun du'obye/ /lha mchod ni nyin mtshan du 6rang gi lhag pa'i lha la phyi nang dag dang bas mchod cing dang ba dang mos pas mnyes par bya ste/'jig rten pa'i lha la mi mchod ces so/ /rtag tu bla ma mnyes pa ni/ /dbang gi dus su yon gyis bla ma mnyes pa las dbang thob par bya ste/ phyis bla ma dang ma / nyams par dam pa'i chos dang mthun pas bla ma mnyes par bya zhes pa'o/ /rang lha'i bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ sgrub pa dang las sbyor min par rgyun du rtsa sngags bzlas te/ sngags de ni sbyong zhing nus pa bskyed pa'o/ /des ni sku gsung thugs kyi byin nye ba'o/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig ni 'phags pa gos sngon po can dang 'byel pa'i dam tshig rnams te mi dge ba las log pa'i tha tshig go/ /rtag tu sngags kyi spyod pa brten skru/ /rtag tu chos kyi dam pa blang / /rtag tu 25—1618

khrus kyi cho ga bya1 / /zhes pa la/ rtag tu sngags spyod pa ni zas dang /gtor ma dang 5khrus dang spyod lam gos dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa rnams dang nam du yang mi /'bral bar bsten zhes pa'o/ /rtag tu chos kyi dam pa blang ni 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi chos la chog ma ④shes par bri ba dang mnyan pa dang bsam pa ste/ theg pa 'og ma pa'i don dang ma 'byel zhes pa'i don to/ /rtag tu khrus kyi cho ga bya ni phyi nang gi khrus stong pa nyid chen po dang / phyi lha zhu ba ste / rigs lnga dang 'byel zhes pa'o/ /srog gcod pa'i sems can pas kun du rgyug par byed pa bla zhes pa la/ srog gcod pa 5dang gcod du stsal 4ba dang /yi rang ba'i las kyi las rnams kyis/ tsha ba dang tsha ba'i sems can rnams su skye ste / phyis de ni 7mnar du mi 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /sems can rnams la srog phongs shing srog gi zug rngu shin tu mi bzod pa'i phyir// rgyu des na ⑪'bras bu yang ngan song gsum du 'gro nges so/ /sdug bsngal yang spang du med de/gtso bsreg dus gcig la myong ba'o/ /de nas dge ba'i nang na srog gi sbyin pa che zhes rgyal bas gsungs so/ /des na srog gcod pa'i sems can pas/spang muzhing zas tshol ba bla ste bzang zhes pa'o/ /de nas srog gcod pa'i las rnam smin che zhing che bas srog gcod pa spong ngo / /grong khyer 'jug dang gtor ma gtong / /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong nyunango / /zhes pa la/ grong khyer du 5'jug ste rnyed pa'i phyir sbyin sreg dang gtor ma dang /ma4 gtsor chang dang brag btsong 7dang / rta rkyang sha la spyod pa 7dang bcas pa nga mkhas zhes zer ba ni/ chos zong du khyer te shā/ de ni ro myags rnge'i 'dam du skyes1 /zhes so/ /yang chos kyi mchog gi ye shes ༄ snayod pa de rnams kyis ni grong khyer du 25—1619

—gtor ma la sogs pas phan gdags pa'o/ /dam tshig rtag tu srung tshobyed pa'i/ /rnal 'byor de la dngos grub 'byung / /dam tshig ni spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig ste de bsrungs na de la mchog gi dngos grub dang thun mong gi dngos grub ri lu la sogs pa 'grub ces so/ /dam tshig rnams ni rdo rje che / /dam tshig gdug pa zil gyis gnon/ /dam tshig thub dka' gdug pa 'joms/ /de bas mkhas pa dus kun du/ /dngos grub rgyur 'gyur dam tshig bstan— / /zhes pa la/ dam tshig che snguni dam tshig dang ldan na/ nyon mongs rdo rje pha lam dang 'dra bar 'joms zhes pa'o/ /dam tshig bsrungs pa'i sagang zag gis gdug pa las klu'i gdon 6la sogs te/ nad gzhi mi 'byung zhes pa'o/ /dka' thub dam tshig ni sdom pa gsum ldan ni shin tu dga' ṣ+pebs dka'o/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud sel bas ring du mi gnas zhes pa'o/ /de bas na mkhas pas ni blang ba dang 9/ bshags pa'i don shes pa'o/ /dngos grub 'grub pa'i rgyu dam tshig yin pas bsrung zhes pas gong ma rnams dang 'byel to/ /gang dag dam tshig med cing sbyor ba kun spangs pa/ /rtag tu dngos grub spyor spangs 〉sdug bsngal thams cad skyed1 / /ces pa la/ gang dag dam tshig med pa ni/ /sdom pa gsum blangs nas mi srun pa 12ste nyams pa rnams so/ /spyor ba kun spongs ni nyams na bshags pa la mi 'jug cing chos kyi spyod pa gzhan 'dor ba'o/ /rtag tu dngos grub spyor spangs ni/ /dam tshig spyor ba med na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub med ces/ bla ma dam tshig nyams pa'i chos zab pa dang dbang dang man ngag la sogs pas rang nyid kyang mi grol te/ sa bon nyams pa la myu gu sngon po mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang nges par mugrol 25—1620

bar mi 'gyur te/ /gong gi rgyu nyams pas 'bras bu 'byin mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dang lung pa gcig gi chu la yang mi btung ste/snyug bsngal thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu dam tshig nyams pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel mdzad sangs rgyas rdo rje can/ /rtag tu thub byed sdom gnas rtag tu bde ba'i mchog /bla med lam mchog gsang chen de nyid spangs/ /zhes pa la/ 'gro ba ni rigs drug ste gcig nas gcig tu 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /sdug bsngal ni gsum mam brgyad do/ /de sel ba ni sangs rgyas rdo rje can no/ /rtag tu thub byed ni/ shākya thub pa'i 1bstan pa la/ de'i sdom pa gsum la ma gnas par lam gzhan med ces so/ /rtag tu bde ba'i mchog ni/ lam de la gnas pas/ rgyu dang 'bras bu dus gnyis bde/ /zhes pa'o/ /bla med lam ni 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i theg pa'o/ /gsang chen rnal 'byor chen po'i lam mo/ /de nyid spangs pa — —ni rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo spangs pa yin pa'i phyir ro//mi gnas dngos grub med cing tsha grang sdug bsngal myong / /don nor smra ba nyams shing slob dpon bka' 5sogs bcag /spyi nas bla med blang zhing mkha' 'gros snying nas 'dres 9/ /zhes pa la mi gnas ni sdom pa 7dam tshig nyams pas dngos grub rnam gnyis sked pa 'bras bu tsha grang gis sems can dmyal ba'i snyug bsngal myong zhes pa ste/ des na kyi hud bar med pa'i sdug bsngal 'di lta bu kyi hud e bzod thabs med pa'i tshe ring zhing 9 thar ba'i thabs med na/ de'i rgyu ni don na 0sdom pa nyams shing lta ba log rmig 1 zlum sha la sogs pa 'phral du srog dang bral ba'i sha 1 mi bza' ba dang / chang ni dug lnga bskyed pa'i rgyu yin pas/nyon mongs pa kun nas slong ba'o/ /shes pa myos byed ni ma yin no/ /dug lnga 25—1621

la sogs pa g.yeng ba'i rgyu ma lus pa spangs la/ sems can ma lus pa la snying rje chen pos sgrub ces te lku/ 2snod las su ma rung ba'i gang zag gi rnam pa'o / /smra ba nyams pa ni khas blangs na dkon mchog bslu ba yin pa'i phyir dang / gzhung bzhin ma byas pa'i phyir ro/ /slob dpon bka' sogs bcag pa ni/ /bla ma'i ngag ma mnyan zhing gsungs pa las bla ma rgyab tu gshe shing nor dang rdzas la ma gnang bar longs spyad pa ni/ yi dwags kyi sems can dmyal ba'o / /bla ma'i khyad par grogs la spyad cing / bla ma la 4rgyab kyis phyogs na/spyi nas rkang pa sog le 'bar bas 'dra zhing / thar thabs med pa'i snyug bsngal myong ba ste/ rgyu 'bras so/ /tshe 'di la mkha' 'gros snying nas 'dren zhes pa'o / /gang zag la la ni tshe 'di la grags pa snyan zhing bde zhing 'jig rten chos la dga' ba/ tshul 'chos g.yo can rnams snga ma'i bde ba'i las kyis 'dir bde zhes te/ tshe 'di 'das nas sdug bsngal myong zhes so/ /gnod byed me dbal byertag tu dgra bzhin spang / /zhes te/ dam tshig nyams pa bsrung zhes pa'o/ /yid bzhin nor bu rang gi srog bzhin btsa'/ /srog dang 'dra ba'i dam tshig ces so/ /dang po blang bsrung nyams pa bshags par bya ste/mkhas pa ni shes pa dang dad pa can no/ /gang zag des bde ba la gnas shing sdug bsngal spang 3/zhes pa'o/ /bdag gis 8 thabs 'di nas/ bde ba la gnas par shog gi bar rtsa ba na gsal zhing tshang bas ma bkrol 9lo/ /bdag gis 'grel 'di brtsams —par mi rigs kyang / /sems can dman pa rnams la phan pa dang / /dam tshig nyes dmigs mthong bas su/ /sdom pa dag la gnas par 'gyur/ /rang nyid sdom pa — la mos pas/ /dad pa'i dbang gis 25—1622

'grel 'di brtsams/ /ma legs nyes pa shor srid na/ /bla ma mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /'phags pa gos sngon dngos grub nyid/ /bdag gis myur du thob gnas pas/ /ma lus myur du thob par shog /shes bya sgrib pa phra mo rtsad nas rnam gcod cing / /cung zhig de nyid rtsad nas ma chod kyang / /rags dang phra ba'i rtog pa 'og mnan nas/ /drod dang rtse mo chos kyi phyag rgya dang / /gsang sngags zab mo dag gi lam la rab gnas nas/ /sdom pa gsum gyis lam gyi —1phyag rgya cher grol nas/ /sems can ma lus 'khor ba'i 'dam las bye'adon par shog /bdag gis 'grel 'di brtsams pa'i dge ba yis / /ma lus sems can thams cad kun/ /mdze dang shu ba g.yan la sogs/ /nad kyi zug rngu rtsad nas 'byung ༄ ba dang / /'khor ba'i chu rgyun bskams nas kyang / /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /gos sngon dngos grub thob par shog /dam tshig rgyan gyi 'grel pa mchog rab ma rdzogs so// //zangs dkar tshul khrims gzhon nus bsgyur ba lags so// //ce25—1623
